descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Logistik Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)

Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Abteilung und unsere Mission
Innerhalb des Unternehmensbereichs „Supply Chain“ verantwortet die Abteilung „Logistics“ die Versorgung der Standorte im Netzwerk und Kunden mit Gütern und logistischen Dienstleistungen. Kompetenz, Zuverlässigkeit, Flexibilität, kontinuierliche Qualitätsverbesserung und Kostenoptimierung sind die Werte, an denen wir unser Handeln ausrichten.
Der Logistikbereich 551/552 im Werk Penzberg verwaltet bestandsgeführte Materialien (Wareneingang / Bevorratung / Versand) und versorgt die Produktion und Kunden im Netzwerk oder außerhalb.

Angetrieben durch unsere Vision „Home for your success“ tragen wir tagtäglich dazu bei, dass am Roche-Standort Penzberg die Anliegen unserer Partner nachhaltig umgesetzt werden. Dafür ergreifen wir erfolgreich die Initiative und handeln leidenschaftlich und eigenverantwortlich.
Um diese Mission bestmöglich zu erfüllen, brauchen wir nun einen Logistik Mitarbeiter (m/w/d), der es versteht, durch Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen unseren Leistungen ein Gesicht zu geben.

Verantwortlichkeiten und was Dich erwartet
In der Logistik Penzberg umfasst dein Aufgabengebiet jegliche Art von Warenflüssen und die Verwaltung derer. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team stellst du die Versorgung der Produktionsbetriebe und Kundenbelieferungen sicher.

• Du bist zuständig für die Warenvereinnahmung eingehender Lieferungen von Rohstoffen, Gefahrstoffen, Zukaufs- & Handelswaren, sowie Ablieferungen aus den internen Produktionsbetrieben

• Wichtig bei deiner Tätigkeit ist die Feststellung der Chargen, die Kennzeichnung und Etikettierung der Waren und Einlagerung der Paletten unter Berücksichtigung der gültigen Arbeitsvorschriften, insbesondere von Temperatur- und Raumbedingungen, sowie den Umgang mit Gefahrstoffe/ Gefahrgut

• Du führst in verschiedenen SAP- Logistiksystemen Tätigkeiten durch und bearbeitest Aufträge für die Einlagerung und Kundenbelieferung.

• Du führst die Bedienung und Handhabung der logistischen Anlagen und deren Fehlerbehebung durch, auch der Transport mit Flurförderzeugen gehört zu deinen Aufgaben

• Du bist verantwortlich für die termingerechte Bereitstellung bestellter Waren aus den Logistikbereichen sowie die korrekte Verpackung und Auslieferung (die Tätigkeiten erfordern zeitweises Heben und Tragen von Lasten über 25 kg)

• Vorbereiten und Verpacken der Waren unter Berücksichtigung der Roche Verpa­ckungsvorschriften und der gesetzlichen Vorschriften für das In- und Ausland

• Vervollständigen des Packstückes mit den Speditionspapieren, Bereitstellen und Über­geben der Sendungen an die beauftragten Transportunternehmen

• Nach gründlicher Einarbeitung übernimmst du den Einsatz von Rufbereitschaften

Wer bist Du und welche Qualifikationen bringst Du mit

• Du verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fachkraft für Lagerlogistik (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Umfeld Logistik m

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• 職務内容
• 医療機関の臨床検査室を中心に、生化学(血液検査等)・免疫検査用の試薬・
• 検査機器などの提案営業をお任せします。
• 担当数は10～20施設。
• 病院の経営層(事務長・院長等)や臨床検査技師などの現場担当者と
• リレーションを構築し、抱えている課題を抽出。
• 経営・業務の効率化に向け、当社が持つリソースを組み合わせて、
• 課題を解決するソリューション観点で営業に取り組んでいただきます。 応募条件
• 業界を問わず、法人営業の経験をお持ちの方／キーマンアプローチの経験ある方
• ◎モノ売りではなく、自分のアイデアでお客様の課題解決に貢献したい方
• ◎業界トップクラスの企業で自己成長に取り組みたい方
• ◎関係各所へのコミュニケーション・調整を図れる方
• ◎将来はグローバルな視点で活躍したい方 ＜必要資格＞ 必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種 雇用形態および期間
• 雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
• 試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり） 業務内容 （雇い入れ直後）：募集職種 営業職（DMR）
• （変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり
• 就業場所
• （雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
• （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする 給与
• 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
• 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～ ※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
• 営業手当：月70,000円～
• ＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
• 諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など ※各種手当は当社規定により支給 労働時間・休憩時間
• 所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
• 勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
• 標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
• （※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
• 時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ） 休日および休暇
• 休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
• 休暇:
• ・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
• ・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休 暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など） 福利厚生 ・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
• 受動喫煙防止措置 屋内全面禁煙
• 募集者名 ロシュ・ダイアグノスティックス株式会社 (Roche Diagnostics K.K.) Compensation & Benefits This position also offers an attractive benefits package . Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 【職務内容】 担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。 【業務内容】 1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業（メインミッション）
• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。
• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。 2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携
• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。
• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。 【応募資格（必須要件）】
• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方
• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams. Your tasks and Responsibilities
• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.
• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.
• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.
• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness. Who you are
• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.
• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.
• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.
• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Bei Roche arbeiten wir an wegweisenden Innovationen. Als Surgical Device Liaison Manager (m/w/d) für unsere innovative "Port Delivery Platform" in der Ophthalmologie bist Du die entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen bahnbrechender Technologie und dem operativen Einsatz am Patienten. Du bist nicht nur ein:e Expert:in – Du bist ein:e Wegbereiter:in für eine neue Ära der Behandlung.

Dein neues Team:
Dich erwartet eine Gruppe von Pionier:innen und Fachexpert:innen, die eine gemeinsame Mission verbindet: die erfolgreiche und sichere Etablierung einer revolutionären chirurgischen Technologie in Deutschland. Obwohl oft eigenständig in den Regionen gearbeitet und direkt vor Ort im OP unterstützt wird, ist das Team sehr eng vernetzt.

Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich

• Du begleitest Operateure und ihre Teams direkt im Operationssaal, stellst eine reibungslose Anwendung unserer "Port Delivery Platform" sicher und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle chirurgischen Fragen.

• Du konzipierst und führst Anwendungstrainings durch – von modernen Virtual-Reality-Schulungen bis hin zu praxisnahen Workshops – und befähigst so medizinisches Personal, unsere Technologie sicher und effektiv zu nutzen.

• Du agierst als wissenschaftliche:r Partner:in auf Augenhöhe mit führenden Expert:innen, teilst Dein Wissen auf Kongressen und generierst wertvolle Einblicke aus der Praxis, die direkt in unsere globale Strategie einfließen.

• Du identifizierst strategische Exzellenz-Zentren und baust ein nachhaltiges Netzwerk aus wichtigen Meinungsbildner:innen und Anwender:innen in der Ophthalmochirurgie auf und pflegst dieses.

• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der klinischen Forschung betreust Du klinische Studien vor Ort und sorgst für die Einhaltung höchster Qualitätsstandards.

Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit

• Dein Fundament ist ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem naturwissenschaftlichen, (veterinär-)medizinischen oder pharmazeutischen Bereich. Du bringst bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Medizintechnik, idealerweise in der Ophthalmochirurgie, mit. Darüber hinaus hast du sehr gute Kenntnis über das Arbeiten nach Studienprotokollen und entsprechend der GCP- und ICH-Regularien

• Du bewegst Dich sicher im operativen Umfeld und die Kommunikation mit Ärzt:innen sowie medizinischem Fachpersonal ist für Dich selbstverständlich.

• Als kommunikationsstarke und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit überzeugst Du in Diskussionen, präsentierst souverän und nutzt digitale Kanäle geschickt zur Interaktion und Wissensvermittlung.

• Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert , hast eine proaktive Lernhaltung und die nötige Reisebereitschaft, um unsere Partner:innen in ganz Deutschland bestmöglich zu betreuen.

• Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und bringst sehr gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit unseren globalen Teams und für globale Trainings mit.

Folgende Gebiete sind zu besetzen:
West 2: Münster, Göttingen, Kassel, Braunschweig, Wolfsburg

Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. This position is located in Preclinical Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Control (pCMC), a department within the Synthetic Molecule Research organization in pRED Therapeutic Modalities, where we pave, in a diverse, ambitious and innovative environment, the path to bring drug candidates from early research into development. We are CMC experts and build our strength on a broad diversity of technical expertise in chemistry, formulation design, material science and analytical chemistry, delivering and innovating in the space of small molecules, peptides and nucleic acid based medicines. The Opportunity We offer an exciting opportunity for an experienced CMC professional to lead our Analytical Molecular Characterization (AMC) team while serving as a hands-on Mass Spectrometry (MS) subject matter expert. In this role, you will bridge discovery research and technical development, driving advanced analytical strategies to support our portfolio across the value chain. You will lead a multidisciplinary team spanning NMR, MS, and chromatography, while developing and applying high-resolution MS methods for the characterization of synthetic molecules. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on scientific contribution, shaping both team direction and analytical excellence. Your Responsibilities includes: Leadership & Strategy
• Lead and develop a team of analytical experts across MS, NMR, and chromatography
• Define and execute mid- to long-term AMC strategies aligned with project and portfolio goals
• Foster collaboration across discovery, technical development, and external partners Analytical & Scientific Expertise
• Develop and apply advanced high-resolution MS methods for structure elucidation and impurity characterization

• Drive analytical method development across SFC, HPLC, and GC for small molecules and peptides Innovation & Collaboration
• Partner with Data, Digital, and AI teams to advance data workflows, automation, and analytics capabilities

• Strong expertise in chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, with deep MS experience in structure elucidation
• Knowledge of API synthesis, impurity profiling, and separation technologies (U/HPLC, SFC)
• Proven leadership experience (≥3 years) managing multidisciplinary teams
• Familiarity with GMP and regulatory requirements

Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED) de Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Ce poste est situé dans la chimie préclinique, la fabrication et le contrôle (pCMC), un département de l'organisme de recherche sur les molécules synthétiques dans les modalités thérapeutiques pRED, où nous posons, dans un environnement diversifié, ambitieux et innovateur, la voie pour amener les candidats aux médicaments des premières recherches au développement. Nous sommes des experts du CMC et nous bâtissons notre force sur une vaste gamme d'expertises techniques en chimie, conception de formulation, science matérielle et chimie analytique, fournissant et innovant dans l'espace de petites molécules, peptides et médicaments à base d'acide nucléique. L'opportunité Nous offrons une occasion passionnante à un professionnel expérimenté du CMC de diriger notre équipe de caractérisation moléculaire analytique (CMA) tout en servant d'expert pratique en spectrométrie de masse (MS). Dans ce rôle, vous établirez un lien entre la recherche et le développement technique, en menant des stratégies analytiques avancées pour soutenir notre portefeuille dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Vous dirigerez une équipe multidisciplinaire couvrant la RMN, la MS et la chromatographie, tout en développant et en appliquant des méthodes MS à haute résolution pour la caractérisation des molécules synthétiques. Ce rôle combine leadership stratégique et contribution scientifique pratique, façonnant à la fois la direction de l'équipe et l'excellence analytique. Vos responsabilités comprennent : Leadership et stratégie
• Diriger et mettre sur pied une équipe d'experts en analyse à travers le MS, le RMN et la chromatographie
• Définir et exécuter des stratégies AMC à moyen et à long terme alignées sur les objectifs du projet et du portefeuille
• Favoriser la collaboration entre les chercheurs, le développement technique et les partenaires extérieurs Expertise analytique et scientifique
• Élaborer et appliquer des méthodes avancées de MS à haute résolution pour l'élucidation des structures et la caractérisation des impuretés
• Superviser les activités analytiques complexes, y compris la détermination stéréochimique et les études d'interaction (API-excipient)
• Diriger le développement de méthodes d'analyse à travers SFC, HPLC et GC pour les petites molécules et les peptides Innovation et collaboration
• Partenaire avec les équipes Data, Digital et AI pour faire progresser les flux de données, l'automatisation et les capacités d'analyse
• Identifier les tendances de l'industrie et maintenir les collaborations universitaires pour assurer le leadership scientifique
• Assurer un soutien analytique de haute qualité pour les IPC, les intermédiaires et les IPA à tous les stades de développement Qui vous êtes
• Doctorat en chimie analytique (ou domaine connexe) avec plus de 5 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie, ou MSc avec plus de 10 ans
• Forte expertise en techniques chromatographiques et spectroscopiques, avec une profonde expérience de l'EM dans l'élucidation des structures
• Connaissance de la synthèse des API, du profilage des impuretés et des technologies de séparation (U/HPLC, SFC)
• Expérience de leadership éprouvée (≥ 3 ans) en gestion d'équipes multidisciplinaires
• Connaissance des BPF et des exigences réglementaires
• Collaborateur fort capable de relier la profondeur technique aux objectifs stratégiques Prêt à faire l'étape suivante ? Nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Postulez maintenant pour explorer cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 em

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Position In dieser Führungsposition innerhalb von Pharma Technical Regulatory (PTR) verfügst du über ein breites Verständnis der regulatorischen Landschaft und setzt dein Wissen gezielt ein, um Ergebnisse im Einklang mit unserer „North Star“-Vision zu erzielen. Als Führungskraft bist du dafür verantwortlich, Veränderungen in der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben und unsere Mitarbeitenden in einem globalen Umfeld zu unterstützen. Du hast ein tiefgreifendes Verständnis für Prioritäten und Bereiche mit hoher Hebelwirkung, vernetzt die richtigen Personen und Ressourcen mit den entsprechenden Aufgaben und hilfst der Organisation, sich an veränderte regulatorische Anforderungen anzupassen. Du inspirierst unsere Teams zu mutiger Innovation und Zusammenarbeit, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die für Patienten, Stakeholder und das Unternehmen von entscheidender Bedeutung sind. In der Rolle des Regulatory Group Director verantwortest du sowohl das Portfolio-Management (mit Schwerpunkt im Bereich Biologics / ADCs) als auch die personelle Führung . Dabei unterstützt und befähigst du Teams und Einzelpersonen innerhalb dieses Betriebsmodells, die übergeordneten Geschäftsziele zu erreichen. Deine Chancen
• Strategische Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Aufsicht und Verantwortung für die Entwicklung und Implementierung von End-to-End-Regulierungsstrategien und -initiativen auf Portfolio-Ebene.
• Portfolio-Steuerung: Du definierst Strategien für ein spezifisches Portfolio (z. B. Produktportfolio innerhalb einer Modalität, cross-funktionale Initiativen für Innovation, Operational Excellence oder Policy) und übersetzt diese in konkrete Ergebnisse. Dabei sicherst du die Transparenz über Squads und Teams hinweg, priorisierst Aufgaben und steuerst die Ressourcenplanung sowie das Budgeting.
• Globale Kollaboration: Du arbeitest auf globaler Ebene eng mit anderen Führungskräften zusammen, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die Organisationsziele durch punktuelle Unterstützung von Projekten und Initiativen zu fördern.
• Trend-Monitoring: Du hältst dich über interne und externe Entwicklungen sowie Trends auf dem Laufenden, um die Auswirkungen auf alle Programme bewerten zu können, und stärkst das Bewusstsein hierfür im Unternehmen.
• Behördenmanagement: Du leitest Interaktionen mit Gesundheitsbehörden (Health Authorities) sowie die Überprüfung von Einreichungen (Submissions) für zugewiesene Projekte mit erweitertem Umfang. Du vertrittst den Bereich Technical Regulatory in multidisziplinären Terminen mit Behörden. Zudem bist du zentraler Ansprechpartner für einen oder mehrere regulatorische Kompetenzbereiche (z. B. CTA, NDA, LCM, Datenmanagement, Systeme) und treibst dort Effizienz und Exzellenz voran.
• Kommunikation & Stakeholder-Management: Du fungierst als Sprachrohr der Organisation und stellst sicher, dass Herausforderungen, Chancen und Maßnahmen der Führungsebene den Mitarbeitenden strukturiert und transparent vermittelt werden. Du baust Beziehungen zu internen Stakeholdern auf und räumst organisatorische Hindernisse aus dem Weg.
• Modern Leadership: Als Führungskraft befähigst du selbstverwaltete Teams, indem du als Visionär, Architekt, Coach und Katalysator agierst. Du bist für das Performance-Management deiner Direct Reports verantwortlich, gibst zeitnahes Feedback und förderst die individuelle Entwicklung durch regelmäßige Gespräche und Check-ins. Dein Profil Du verfügst über exzellente Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und bist in der Lage, komplexe Sachverha

The Position The Opportunity As the Team Lead for Design Control Excellence (DCE) in Sant Cugat, you will play a pivotal role in shaping how we develop life-saving diagnostic solutions. You will build and inspire a team of Process Managers dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency. This is an opportunity to lead a digital and cultural transformation, fostering a high-performance environment where agile mindsets drive better outcomes for patients. Empower and Grow Talent: Coach and mentor a team of six Process Managers, focusing on their technical growth, strategic thinking, and long-term career journeys. Champion Process Governance: Lead the optimization of critical system, software, and assay projects across Risk,
• Requirements, Configuration, Defect Management and Verification & Validation. Drive Operational Excellence: Ensure all development documentation meets rigorous global regulatory standards (such as ISO 13485) while championing radical simplification. Foster Global Collaboration: Act as a key bridge between Development, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Service teams to ensure seamless information flow and project success. Model Agile Leadership: Serve as a catalyst for cultural change by encouraging experimentation, trust, and cross-functional collaboration within a matrixed organization. Strategic Vision: Accelerate knowledge transfer and upskill your team to meet the evolving needs of a global diagnostics landscape. Who You Are You are a people-oriented leader who excels at navigating complex organizations through influence and collaboration. You are passionate about developing others and bring a strategic vision to technical process management. To be successful in this role, you bring: Strong Educational Foundation: An advanced university degree in Life Sciences, Natural Sciences, or Engineering. Industry Expertise: At least five years of experience in Product Development or Process Management, ideally within the Diagnostics or Medical Device sector. Leadership Track Record: Proven experience leading people in a line capacity with a focus on building networks and inspiring teams through change. Analytical & Influencing Skills: A deep understanding of design control processes and the ability to resolve conflicts and align stakeholders across global locations. Effective Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to partner with global teams; proficiency in Spanish or German is a valuable asset. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il programma RiSE (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) è un programma di ricerca studentesca altamente competitivo a Roche. Offre agli studenti di laurea e di laurea più talentuosi la possibilità di essere pienamente integrato nel nostro ambiente R&D interdisciplinare e internazionale del settore. Come studente RiSE, aumenterai le tue competenze, acquisirai una preziosa esperienza lavorativa con noi, e alla fine diventerai parte di una rete mondiale di RiSE Alumni. La Neuroscienza e Malattie Rare Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) sta sviluppando farmaci per una serie di gravi malattie neurologiche, tra cui sclerosi multipla, malattia di Alzheimer, malattia di Parkinson, autismo, atrofia muscolare spinale, e la malattia di Huntington. Come studente di RiSE nel NRD DTA vi unirete al nostro gruppo nel gruppo di laboratorio Neuromuscular Disorders (NMD), situato all'interno della sezione Neurotechnologies presso il Roche Innovation Center di Basilea, Svizzera. Il nostro team multidisciplinare riunisce competenze in biologia neuromuscolare, medicina genomica vettorizzata, ingegneria genetica e modelli 3D complessi. L'opportunità Nel vostro ruolo di studente RiSE, avrete l'opportunità di:
• Cultura del tessuto e manutenzione di modelli 2D (ad esempio cellule HEK-blue, mioblasti di derivazione hiPSC, ecc.), organoidi di giunzione neuromuscolare 3D e tessuti muscolari umani ingegnerizzati
• Pianificare, progettare, eseguire e analizzare saggi farmacologici di interesse (ad esempio piccoli trattamenti molecolari, espressione reporter, bioenergetica cellulare con sistema Seahorse di Agilent, valutazioni 3D twitch/tetanic force con configurazione Mantarray di CuriBio, live imaging e registrazioni di contrattilità di organoidi 3D, ecc.)
• Lavorare a stretto contatto all'interno di un team composto da 3-4 scienziati, collaboratori di ricerca, altri studenti, e coordinarsi con strutture interne (ad esempio imaging) e team interfunzionali (ad esempio neurogenomica e gruppi di metabolismo muscolare)
• Mantenere un quaderno di laboratorio elettronico dettagliato (ELN) e record di dati
• I risultati attuali della ricerca nelle riunioni interne
• Summarizzare il lavoro e redigere un manoscritto scientifico
• Sarete ospitati e guidati da scienziati Roche che forniranno una guida completa. Chi sei
• Ti sei laureato in un Master nell'ultimo anno o ti sei iscritto in un dottorato o in un corso di laurea in medicina presso un'università e hai portato un'esperienza dimostrabile in una o più delle seguenti aree:
• Coltura di modelli cellulari complessi e/o organoidi (ad esempio cellule derivate dal paziente, iPSC umani, ecc.)
• Elettrofisiologia in vitro (ad es. in vitro misure di forza utilizzando attrezzature Mantarray di CuriBio)
• In vitro tecniche / assaggi di cellule vive (ad esempio piattaforma Agilent Seahorse, microscopia di fluorescenza, indicatori di calcio, contrattilità, ecc.)
• Familiarità con software avanzato di analisi delle immagini (ad esempio, Armonia, FIJI/ImageJ, MuscleMotion, metriche funzionali Pulse, o simili)
• Tecniche di biologia molecolare di base (ad esempio attività segreta del reporter, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, DNA/RNA/protein isolamento)
• Proficienza nel software statistico (ad es. R, R e/o GraphPad) per l'analisi dei set di dati biologici, comprese le curve di risposta dose e l'uscita di elettrofisiologia
• Un forte interesse per espandere le tue capacità di biologia muscolare, in particolare utilizzando piccole tecnologie basate sulle molecole nei sistemi di modelli 2D e 3D. Informazioni aggiuntive Lo stage può iniziare tra agosto 2026 e ottobre 2026 – si prega di indicare chiaramente la data di partenza preferita nella vostra lettera di motivazione. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The RiSE program (Roche Internships for Scientific Exchange) is a highly competitive student research program at Roche. It offers the most talented graduate and medical degree students the opportunity to be fully integrated into our interdisciplinary and international industry R&D environment. As a RiSE student, you will enhance your competencies, gain valuable work experience with us, and eventually become part of a worldwide network of RiSE Alumni. The Neuroscience and Rare Diseases Discovery and Translational Area (NRD DTA) is developing medicines for a range of serious neurological diseases, including multiple sclerosis, Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, autism, spinal muscular atrophy, and Huntington’s disease. As a RiSE student in the NRD DTA you will join our group in the Neuromuscular Disorders (NMD) lab group, situated within the Neurotechnologies Section at the Roche Innovation Center Basel, Switzerland. Our multidisciplinary team brings together expertise in neuromuscular biology, vectorized genomic medicine, genetic engineering, and complex 3D models. The Opportunity In your role as a RiSE student, you will have the opportunity to:
• Tissue culture and maintenance of 2D models (e.g. HEK-blue cells, immortalized and hiPSC-derived myoblasts, etc.), 3D neuromuscular junction organoids, and engineered human muscle tissues
• Actively plan, design, perform, and analyze pharmacological assays of interest (e.g. small molecule treatments, reporter expression, cellular bioenergetics with Agilent’s Seahorse system, 3D twitch/tetanic force assessments with CuriBio’s Mantarray setup, live imaging and contractility recordings of 3D organoids, etc.)
• Work closely within a team composed of 3-4 scientists, research associates, other students, and coordinate with internal core facilities (e.g. imaging) and cross-functional teams (e.g. neurogenomics and muscle metabolism groups)
• Maintain a detailed electronic lab notebook (ELN) and data records
• Present research findings at internal meetings
• Summarize work and draft a scientific manuscript
• You will be hosted and mentored by Roche scientists who will provide comprehensive guidance. Who You Are
• You graduated from a Master's program within the last year or you are enrolled in a PhD or medical degree program at a university and you bring demonstrable experience in one or more of the following areas:
• Culturing complex cell models and/or organoids (e.g. patient-derived cells, human iPSCs, etc.)
• In vitro electrophysiology (e.g. in vitro force measurements using CuriBio’s Mantarray equipment)
• In vitro live cell techniques/assays (e.g. Agilent Seahorse platform, fluorescence microscopy, calcium indicators, contractility, etc.)
• Familiarity with advanced image analysis software (e.g., Harmony, FIJI/ImageJ, MuscleMotion, Pulse functional metrics, or similar)
• Basic molecular biology techniques (e.g. secreted reporter activity, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, DNA/RNA/protein isolation)
• Proficiency in statistical software (e.g. R, R and/or GraphPad) for analyzing biological data sets, including dose-response curves and electrophysiology output
• A strong interest in expanding your muscle biology skills, particularly using small molecule-based technologies in 2D and 3D model systems. Additional Information The internship can start between August 2026 and October 2026 – please clearly indicate your preferred starting date in your motivation letter. Application Process Application

En tant qu'étudiant RiSE, vous améliorerez vos compétences, gagnerez une expérience de travail précieuse avec nous et finirez par faire partie d'un réseau mondial d'anciens RiSE. La zone de découverte et de traduction des neurosciences et des maladies rares (DNT) met au point des médicaments pour diverses maladies neurologiques graves, dont la sclérose en plaques, la maladie d'Alzheimer, la maladie de Parkinson, l'autisme, l'atrophie musculaire de la colonne vertébrale et la maladie de Huntington. En tant qu'étudiant RiSE au NRD DTA, vous rejoindrez notre groupe au sein du groupe de laboratoire des troubles neuromusculaires (NMD), situé au sein de la Section des neurotechnologies du Roche Innovation Center Basel, Suisse. • Planifier, concevoir, exécuter et analyser activement des tests pharmacologiques d'intérêt (p. ex. traitements à petites molécules, expression des reporters, bioénergétique cellulaire avec le système de Seahorse Agilent, évaluations de la force 3D avec la configuration de Mantarray CuriBio, imagerie en direct et enregistrements de contractilité d'organoïdes 3D, etc.)
• Travailler en étroite collaboration au sein d'une équipe composée de 3-4 scientifiques, d'associés de recherche, d'autres étudiants, et coordonner avec les installations centrales internes (par exemple l'imagerie) et les équipes interfonctionnelles (par exemple les groupes neurogénomiques et métaboliques musculaires)
• Tenir un carnet de laboratoire électronique détaillé (ELN) et des dossiers de données
• Présenter les résultats de la recherche lors des réunions internes
• Résumer les travaux et rédiger un manuscrit scientifique
• Vous serez accueilli et encadré par des scientifiques de Roche qui vous fourniront des conseils complets. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes diplômé d'un programme de maîtrise au cours de la dernière année ou vous êtes inscrit à un programme de doctorat ou de diplôme médical dans une université et vous apportez une expérience démontrable dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants:
• Culturation de modèles cellulaires complexes et/ou d'organoïdes (par exemple cellules dérivées du patient, iPSC humains, etc.)
• Électrophysiologie in vitro (par exemple mesures de force in vitro à l'aide de l'équipement de Mantarray de CuriBio)
• Techniques/essais in vitro de cellules vivantes (p. ex. plate-forme Agilent Seahorse, microscopie à fluorescence, indicateurs de calcium, contractilité, etc.)
• Familiarité avec les logiciels avancés d'analyse d'images (par exemple Harmony, FIJI/ImageJ, MuscleMotion, Pulse métriques fonctionnelles, ou similaires)
• Techniques de biologie moléculaire de base (p. ex. activité des reporters sécrétés, qPCR/dPCR, WB, immunofluorescence, isolation ADN/ARN/protéine)
• Compétence en logiciels statistiques (par exemple R, R et/ou GraphPad) pour l'analyse des ensembles de données biologiques, y compris les courbes dose-réponse et la production d'électrophysiologie
• Un vif intérêt à développer vos compétences en biologie musculaire, en particulier en utilisant des technologies à base de petites molécules dans les systèmes de modèles 2D et 3D. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity People & Culture (P&C) Business Partner & Country Connector Canada In People & Culture, our vision is to bring our Roche purpose to life by unlocking the greatness in all our people and the organization. We are a catalyst for enabling high performance while nurturing a sense of belonging and an inclusive culture where we can all thrive. We build trust by protecting and creating value through our partnership with customers to deliver not just services, but impactful experiences. At Roche, we have moved away from traditional, hierarchical HR structures to build an advanced, agile People & Culture (P&C) organization. Guided by our belief that experts should focus on expert work, our P&C model is organized into six core global chapters: Integrated Workforce Strategies, Business Partnering, People Rewards and Recognition, People Support Solutions, People Insights and Technology, and People Organizational Growth . Each chapter reports directly into its respective global function rather than a local matrix. As the Business Partner Commercial and Country Connector , you will operate at the intersection of this model. This role requires a professional who is highly skilled in and comfortable with informal leadership; you will need to successfully influence, collaborate with, and align a team of highly competent, specialized P&C colleagues without the reliance on a direct reporting line. This is a senior, strategic leadership role responsible for shaping and driving the people and culture strategy for the Commercial organisation in Canada. This position requires the mindset of a business leader and entrepreneur and partner with multiple leadership areas in a part of the business as part of a global network. The position holds the additional responsibility of “ Country Connector ” with specific responsibilities for external system shaping, reputation management, collaboration with work councils as needed as well. In addition, this role connects and aligns the P&C ecosystem holistically across all Roche affiliates and legal entities in the country. What you’ll do Strategic Business Leadership
• Think beyond P&C and operate as a true business leader and entrepreneur and translate business objectives into impactful people strategies.
• Act as the lead P&C strategist for executive leaders, using deep business acumen to co-create long-range strategies focused on human capital, organizational design, and future-readiness.
• Direct and lead complex, enterprise-wide change initiatives and Work Product Teams (WPTs) as a change enabler, building leadership coalitions to drive meaningful shifts within the organization. Executive Coaching & Influence for Impact
• Provides guidance on talent management, workforce strategies, organization design and reward and recognition in partnership with other subject-matter experts to develop high quality solutions
• Maintains broad-based knowledge of multiple leadership areas across the organization and its operations; uses knowledge of business and P&C insights, metrics, expertise, and decision principles to effectively diagnose topics with a wide range of complexity
• Maintains knowledge of external environment and other related information on peer and comparison groups to effectively diagnose and implement strategies to help drive business decisions
• Provide expert organizational consulting to executive leadership, shaping a culture with shared values and behaviors.
• Apply systems thinking to recognize patterns

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a part of this role, you will be responsible for a highly talented engineering team targeting the healthcare industry, also making detailed plans to accomplish goals, and directing the integration of technical activities. You will work with the cross-functional teams and help to decide priorities and delivery of the tasks/objectives. The Opportunity:
• You will grasp and translate complex scientific data and concepts, particularly those from digital pathology workflows — including whole slide image (WSI) viewing, tissue morphology assessment, and AI-assisted image analysis — into user-friendly features and functionality within software solutions.
• You will collaborate on solution design with architects, tech leads, and stakeholders.
• You will create detailed product specifications and write user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
• You will align project priorities with business goals and assess technical feasibility.
• You will collect and act on post-release user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
• You will triage and prioritize issues, including defects, improvements, and bugs, for resolution.
• You will clearly and proactively communicate with department leadership, stakeholders about the health of the team, any impediments they are experiencing, and the impact of any changes to processes or procedures on the team and how you are addressing any issues.
• You will support the creation of clear vision for a feature with the business owners/customer and transmit it to the Development Team Who you are:
• Around 5+ years of experience and overall 4 years of product owner/product management experience preferably in an agile environment (scrum/lean/SAFe)
• Experience in the healthcare business/industry with strong understanding of laboratory workflows and processes, particularly those related to anatomical pathology, digital pathology, and whole slide image analysis, is highly desired.
• Familiarity with histopathology, tissue-based diagnostics, and/or cancer biology concepts to effectively communicate with scientific stakeholders — including pathologists and laboratory professionals — and translate their needs into product requirements.
• You demonstrate initiative. You go above and beyond. You offer bold, value-adding ideas and seek critical path tasks.
• You execute with excellence. You are able to set priorities within your scope. You are action oriented and decisive. You seek personal accountability, are highly dependable, and demonstrate excellent follow-through.
• Beyond just having an understanding of the value of Agile Principles, your experience and day-to-day work habits reflect a continued history of making these principles become a reality in your work and amidst those who you collaborate with.
• You enjoy teamwork and collaborate well with others through; ability to build trusting relationships, proactively approaching solving problems, and demonstrating an open, supportive, and positive style What you get:
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.
• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths).
• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).

The Position As a part of this role, you will be responsible for a highly talented engineering team targeting the healthcare industry, also making detailed plans to accomplish goals, and directing the integration of technical activities. You will work with the cross-functional teams and help to decide priorities and delivery of the tasks/objectives. The Opportunity:
• You will grasp and translate complex scientific data and concepts, particularly those from digital pathology workflows — including whole slide image (WSI) viewing, tissue morphology assessment, and AI-assisted image analysis — into user-friendly features and functionality within software solutions.
• You will collaborate on solution design with architects, tech leads, and stakeholders.
• You will create detailed product specifications and write user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
• You will align project priorities with business goals and assess technical feasibility.
• You will collect and act on post-release user feedback to drive continuous improvement.
• You will triage and prioritize issues, including defects, improvements, and bugs, for resolution.
• You will clearly and proactively communicate with department leadership, stakeholders about the health of the team, any impediments they are experiencing, and the impact of any changes to processes or procedures on the team and how you are addressing any issues.
• You will support the creation of clear vision for a feature with the business owners/customer and transmit it to the Development Team Who you are:
• Around 5+ years of experience and overall 4 years of product owner/product management experience preferably in an agile environment (scrum/lean/SAFe)
• Experience in the healthcare business/industry with strong understanding of laboratory workflows and processes, particularly those related to anatomical pathology, digital pathology, and whole slide image analysis, is highly desired.
• Familiarity with histopathology, tissue-based diagnostics, and/or cancer biology concepts to effectively communicate with scientific stakeholders — including pathologists and laboratory professionals — and translate their needs into product requirements.
• You demonstrate initiative. You go above and beyond. You offer bold, value-adding ideas and seek critical path tasks.
• You execute with excellence. You are able to set priorities within your scope. You are action oriented and decisive. You seek personal accountability, are highly dependable, and demonstrate excellent follow-through.
• Beyond just having an understanding of the value of Agile Principles, your experience and day-to-day work habits reflect a continued history of making these principles become a reality in your work and amidst those who you collaborate with.
• You enjoy teamwork and collaborate well with others through; ability to build trusting relationships, proactively approaching solving problems, and demonstrating an open, supportive, and positive style What you get:
• Annual bonus payment based on your performance.
• Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths).
• Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available).
• Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose).
• Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time).
• Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice). •

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche: Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad: Estamos en la búsqueda de un perfil proactivo, organizado y con una fuerte orientación al detalle para sumarse a nuestro equipo como Asistente de Operaciones y Finanzas Clínicas . En este rol, serás una pieza clave para garantizar la eficiencia administrativa y el cumplimiento de los procesos regulatorios y financieros que hacen posibles nuestros estudios clínicos. Si buscas dar tus primeros pasos en una empresa líder de salud y combinar habilidades administrativas con el mundo de la ciencia, ¡esta es tu oportunidad! Responsabilidades:
• Gestión Financiera y Pagos: Asistir al equipo local de estudios clínicos en tareas relacionadas con pagos a comités, entes regulatorios, investigadores y centros de investigación. Brindar soporte operativo integral en órdenes de compra y gestión de facturas.
• Actualización de Sistemas: Mantener al día la plataforma Veeva Clinical , así como otras herramientas y trackings esenciales para el adecuado seguimiento de los proyectos.
• Control de Calidad y Archivo: Archivar adecuadamente los documentos generados en los repositorios correspondientes, asegurando un estricto control de calidad de la información.
• Mejora Continua: Colaborar en la elaboración de instructivos y/o Procedimientos Operativos Estándar (POEs) locales para optimizar las actividades del equipo.
• Seguimiento de Datos: Cargar y actualizar datos en las planillas de seguimiento interno, además de revisar y archivar la documentación recibida. Quién eres:
• Estudiante Universitario: Cursando carreras de Ciencias Económicas, preferentemente Contaduría Pública o Administración de Empresas (deseable, no excluyente).
• Idiomas: Dominio avanzado del idioma inglés (requisito indispensable para interactuar con sistemas y equipos globales).
• Herramientas Informáticas: * Manejo fluido del entorno Office ( Excel , Word, PowerPoint).
• Facilidad natural para el uso de sistemas informáticos de gestión de datos (excluyente).
• Familiaridad con el ecosistema de Google (Mail, Calendar) y herramientas de IA/productividad como Gemini y Notebook LM .
• Competencias: Persona metódica, con gran capacidad de organización, orientación a la mejora continua y facilidad para el trabajo en equipo. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. The Position Business Intelligence Analyst We are People Insights & Technology (PI&T), parte dell'organizzazione People & Culture (P&C). La nostra visione è quella di fornire tecnologie integrate e approfondimenti democratizzati per creare un'esperienza senza attriti che accelera l'impatto su scala. Nell'ambito della People Insights Area of Practice (AoP) , lavoriamo come una squadra per trasformare come le persone vengono fornite informazioni a Roche. Combinando analisi, tecnologia e comprensione aziendale, creiamo soluzioni affidabili e scalabili che supportano decisioni informate e risultati significativi. L'opportunità: In qualità di Business Intelligence Analyst (BIA), ti aiuterà a plasmare come vengono fornite informazioni attendibili in tutta l'azienda, trasformando i dati complessi in soluzioni di analisi intuitive che permettono di prendere decisioni informate e creare impatto aziendale. Potrai progettare, sviluppare e evolvere continuamente soluzioni di business intelligence, traducendo le esigenze aziendali in prodotti di analisi governati. Con il design, la consegna, la qualità e il miglioramento continuo della soluzione, la proprietà end-to-end si unirà a competenze tecniche, comprensione del business e una forte collaborazione per creare soluzioni scalabili che garantiscono un impatto significativo e si adattano alle mutevoli priorità aziendali. Lavorando in team di prodotti, business e tecnici, aiuterà a modellare soluzioni, influenzare le decisioni di consegna e portare un approccio consultivo alla risoluzione dei problemi. Facendo domande riflessive, presupposti costruttivamente impegnativi, e bilanciando le considerazioni aziendali, tecniche e operative, vi aiuterà a fornire risultati efficaci e sostenibili. Sviluppo e Manutenzione di Dashboard & App
• Eseguire attività di analisi dei dati e modellazione dei dati per supportare lo sviluppo di soluzioni di business intelligence, sfruttando magazzini di dati centralizzati e più fonti di dati aziendali appropriate.
• Preparare e gestire i dati per le soluzioni di analisi, comprese le attività di pulizia, trasformazione, integrazione e validazione per garantire qualità, coerenza e usabilità.
• Sviluppare indicatori, metriche, calcoli e logica analitica in conformità alle regole aziendali stabilite, standard di governance e requisiti di reporting.
• Progettazione, sviluppo, manutenzione e valorizzazione di cruscotti, report e applicazioni analitiche che offrono intuizioni intuitive, pronte a decisioni e esperienze utente efficaci.
• Creare e mantenere la documentazione della soluzione, compresi i requisiti, la progettazione tecnica, le definizioni dei dati, i manufatti di prova e i materiali di guida dell'utente finale.
• Sviluppare casi di test e piani di test e svolgere attività di test funzionali, di integrazione e di accettazione degli utenti per convalidare le soluzioni di analisi e garantire risultati attesi.
• Eseguire procedure di garanzia della qualità per i prodotti BI, identificare proattivamente e risolvere i difetti, le incongruenze e i problemi di prestazioni. Amministrazione Ambiente
• Sostenere l'efficace amministrazione e il funzionamento di strumenti di business intelligence e piattaforme, tra cui la gestione dell'accesso utente, l'amministrazione della licenza, il supporto ambientale, la risoluzione dei problemi e il coordinamento con i partner tecnici per garantire la consegna affidabile, sicura e conforme.
• Contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo, all'implementazione e al miglioramento continuo delle iniziative, dei processi e dei modi di lavoro di Roche P&C.
• Servire come consulente tecnico in materia di business intelligence, fornendo indicazioni su strumenti BI, dati, soluzioni di analisi, pratiche di sviluppo e approcci tecnici.

The opportunity: As a Business Intelligence Analyst (BIA), you will help shape how trusted insights are delivered across the enterprise, transforming complex data into intuitive analytics solutions that enable informed decision-making and create business impact. You will design, develop, and continuously evolve business intelligence solutions, translating business needs into governed analytics products. With end-to-end ownership spanning solution design, delivery, quality, and continuous improvement, you will combine technical expertise, business understanding, and strong collaboration to create scalable solutions that deliver meaningful impact and adapt to changing business priorities. Working across product, business, and technical teams, you will help shape solutions, influence delivery decisions, and bring a consultative approach to problem-solving. By asking thoughtful questions, constructively challenging assumptions, and balancing business, technical, and operational considerations, you will help deliver effective, sustainable outcomes. Dashboard & App Development and Maintenance
• Perform data analysis and data modeling activities to support the development of business intelligence solutions, leveraging centralized data warehouses and multiple enterprise data sources as appropriate.
• Prepare and manage data for analytics solutions, including data cleansing, transformation, integration, and validation activities to ensure quality, consistency, and usability.
• Develop indicators, metrics, calculations, and analytical logic in accordance with established business rules, governance standards, and reporting requirements.
• Design, develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical applications that deliver intuitive, decision-ready insights and effective user experiences.
• Create and maintain solution documentation including requirements, technical design, data definitions, testing artifacts, and end-user guidance materials.
• Develop test cases and test plans, and perform functional, integration, and user acceptance testing activities to validate analytics solutions and ensure expected outcomes.
• Execute quality assurance procedures for BI products, proactively identifying and resolving defects, inconsistencies, and performance issues. Environment Administration
• Support the effective administration and operation of business intelligence tools and platforms, including user access management, license administration, environment support, troubleshooting, and coordination with technical partners to ensure reliable, secure, and compliant delivery. Service Delivery
• Actively contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Roche P&C initiatives, processes, and ways of working.
• Serve as a technical advisor on business intelligence matters, providing guidance on BI tools, data, analytics solutions, development practices, and technical approaches.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als Sie selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen, in denen Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich gedeihen können. Auf diese Weise wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder heute und für die kommenden Generationen Zugang zu Gesundheitsversorgung hat. Treten Sie Roche bei, wo jede Stimme zählt. Wir sind People Insights & Technology (PI&T), Teil der People & Culture (P&C) Organisation. Unsere Vision ist es, integrierte Technologien und demokratisierte Erkenntnisse zu liefern, um ein reibungsloses Erlebnis zu schaffen, das die Auswirkungen in großem Maßstab beschleunigt. Als Teil des People Insights Area of Practice (AoP) arbeiten wir als ein Team daran, die Art und Weise, wie Menschen bei Roche Einblicke erhalten, zu verändern. Durch die Kombination von Analyse, Technologie und Geschäftsverständnis schaffen wir vertrauenswürdige, skalierbare Lösungen, die fundierte Entscheidungen und sinnvolle Ergebnisse unterstützen. Die Chance: Als Business Intelligence Analyst (BIA) tragen Sie dazu bei, wie vertrauenswürdige Erkenntnisse im gesamten Unternehmen bereitgestellt werden, und verwandeln komplexe Daten in intuitive Analyselösungen, die fundierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen und geschäftliche Auswirkungen erzielen. Sie entwerfen, entwickeln und entwickeln kontinuierlich Business Intelligence-Lösungen und übersetzen Geschäftsanforderungen in regulierte Analyseprodukte. Mit End-to-End-Eigentum, das Lösungsdesign, Lieferung, Qualität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung umfasst, kombinieren Sie technisches Know-how, Geschäftsverständnis und starke Zusammenarbeit, um skalierbare Lösungen zu schaffen, die eine sinnvolle Wirkung erzielen und sich an sich ändernde Geschäftsprioritäten anpassen. Wenn Sie über Produkt-, Geschäfts- und technische Teams hinweg arbeiten, helfen Sie, Lösungen zu gestalten, Lieferentscheidungen zu beeinflussen und einen beratenden Ansatz zur Problemlösung zu entwickeln. Indem Sie nachdenkliche Fragen stellen, konstruktive Annahmen in Frage stellen und geschäftliche, technische und operative Überlegungen in Einklang bringen, tragen Sie dazu bei, effektive, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Dashboard & App Entwicklung und Wartung
• Führen Sie Datenanalyse- und Datenmodellierungsaktivitäten durch, um die Entwicklung von Business Intelligence-Lösungen zu unterstützen und gegebenenfalls zentralisierte Data Warehouses und mehrere Unternehmensdatenquellen zu nutzen. Bereiten und verwalten Sie Daten für Analyselösungen, einschließlich Datenbereinigung, Transformation, Integration und Validierung, um Qualität, Konsistenz und Benutzerfreundlichkeit zu gewährleisten.
• Entwicklung von Indikatoren, Metriken, Berechnungen und analytischer Logik in Übereinstimmung mit festgelegten Geschäftsregeln, Governance-Standards und Berichtspflichten. Design, Entwicklung, Pflege und Verbesserung von Dashboards, Berichten und analytischen Anwendungen, die intuitive, entscheidungsbereite Einblicke und effektive Benutzererfahrungen liefern.
• Erstellen und Pflegen von Lösungsdokumentationen, einschließlich Anforderungen, technischem Design, Datendefinitionen, Testartefakten und Endbenutzerleitfäden.
• Entwicklung von Testfällen und Testplänen sowie Durchführung von Funktions-, Integrations- und Benutzerakzeptanztests, um Analyselösungen zu validieren und die erwarteten Ergebnisse sicherzustellen.
• Durchführung von Qualitätssicherungsverfahren für BI-Produkte, wobei Mängel, Inkonsistenzen und Leistungsprobleme proaktiv identifiziert und behoben werden. Umweltverwaltung
• Unterstützung der effektiven Verwaltung und des Betriebs von Business Intelligence-Tools und -Plattformen, einschließlich Benutzerzugriffsmanagement, Lizenzverwaltung, Umgebungsunterstützung, Fehlerbehebung und Koordination mit technischen Partnern, um eine zuverlässige, sichere und konforme Lieferung zu gewährleisten.
• Aktiv zur Entwicklung, Implementierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Roche P&C Initiativen, Prozessen und Arbeitsweisen beitragen.
• Als technischer Berater für Business Intelligence-Angelegenheiten und als Leitfaden für BI-Tools, Daten, Analyselösungen, Entwicklungspraktiken und technische Ansätze.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. Le poste Analyste du renseignement d'affaires Nous sommes des gens d'affaires et de la technologie (PI-T), qui font partie de l'organisation People & Culture (P-C). Notre vision est de fournir une technologie intégrée et des idées démocratisées pour créer une expérience sans friction qui accélère l'impact à l'échelle. Dans le cadre du domaine de pratique de People Insights (AoP), nous travaillons en tant qu'une seule équipe pour transformer la façon dont les renseignements personnels sont fournis à Roche. En combinant l'analyse, la technologie et la compréhension des affaires, nous créons des solutions fiables et évolutives qui appuient des décisions éclairées et des résultats significatifs. L'occasion : En tant qu'analyste du renseignement d'affaires, vous aiderez à façonner la façon dont les informations de confiance sont fournies dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, en transformant des données complexes en solutions analytiques intuitives qui permettent une prise de décision éclairée et créent un impact commercial. Vous concevrez, développerez et évoluerez continuellement des solutions d'intelligence d'affaires, traduisant les besoins des entreprises en produits d'analyse gouvernés. Avec la conception, la livraison, la qualité et l'amélioration continue de la propriété de bout en bout, vous combinerez expertise technique, compréhension des affaires et collaboration solide pour créer des solutions évolutives qui produisent un impact significatif et s'adaptent à l'évolution des priorités commerciales. En travaillant avec des équipes de produits, d'affaires et de techniques, vous aiderez à façonner les solutions, à influencer les décisions de livraison et à adopter une approche consultative pour résoudre les problèmes. En posant des questions réfléchies, en contestant de façon constructive les hypothèses et en conciliant les considérations d'affaires, techniques et opérationnelles, vous aiderez à obtenir des résultats efficaces et durables. Dashboard & App Développement et maintenance
• Effectuer des activités d'analyse de données et de modélisation de données pour soutenir le développement de solutions d'intelligence d'affaires, en tirant parti des entrepôts de données centralisés et de multiples sources de données d'entreprise selon les besoins.
• Préparer et gérer les données pour les solutions analytiques, y compris le nettoyage des données, la transformation, l'intégration et les activités de validation pour assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la convivialité.
• Élaborer des indicateurs, des mesures, des calculs et une logique analytique conformément aux règles opérationnelles, aux normes de gouvernance et aux exigences en matière de rapports.
• Concevoir, développer, maintenir et améliorer des tableaux de bord, des rapports et des applications analytiques qui fournissent des informations intuitives, prêtes à prendre des décisions et des expériences utilisateur efficaces.
• Créer et tenir à jour la documentation sur les solutions, y compris les exigences, la conception technique, la définition des données, l'essai des artefacts et les documents d'orientation de l'utilisateur final.
• Élaborer des cas d'essai et des plans d'essai, et effectuer des activités d'essai fonctionnelles, d'intégration et d'acceptation des utilisateurs pour valider les solutions analytiques et garantir les résultats escomptés.
• Exécuter des procédures d'assurance qualité pour les produits BI, identifier et résoudre les défauts, les incohérences et les problèmes de performance. Administration de l'environnement
• Soutenir l'administration et le fonctionnement efficaces des outils et plateformes de renseignement d'affaires, y compris la gestion de l'accès des utilisateurs, l'administration des licences, le soutien à l'environnement, le dépannage et la coordination avec les partenaires techniques pour assurer une livraison fiable, sécurisée et conforme. Prestation de services
• Contribuer activement à l'élaboration, à la mise en oeuvre et à l'amélioration continue des initiatives, des processus et des méthodes de travail de Roche P&C.
• Servir de conseiller technique en matière de renseignement d'affaires, fournissant des conseils sur les outils, les données, les solutions analytiques, les pratiques de développement et les approches techniques.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
【職務内容】
担当エリアの大学病院、総合病院、臨床検査センターなどを対象に、新規開拓を中心としたコンサルティング営業をお任せします。 まだ自社製品を導入していない医療施設へアプローチし、医療現場や検査室が抱える課題をヒアリングから抽出、解消に導くことが最優先のミッションです。自社製品をただ売り込むのではなく、お客様の課題解決に向けた最適なソリューションを提供していただきます。

【業務内容】
1. 新規開拓・コンサルティング提案営業

• 臨床検査技師などの現場担当者から、医師、事務長そして経営層まで幅広くアプローチし、検査室の課題を抽出します。製品導入によって見込まれる改善点や新しい提案を粘り強く行い、新規導入を目指します。

• 生化学、免疫、遺伝子（PCR）、病理領域の検査機器をはじめ、検査室自動化やITソリューション、デジタルソリューションまで、多岐にわたる製品群の中から、顧客のニーズに合わせて最適な解決策を組み立て、費用対効果（ROI）の提示や契約交渉を行います。

2. 既存顧客への運用サポートおよび社内連携

• すでに導入いただいているお客様に対して運用面の課題解消もサポートしますが、業務の主軸は新規開拓となります。

• 学術やエンジニアリングなど社内の専門部署と緊密に連携し、どうすればお客様にとって最適なサポートができるかを常に考え、関係各所を巻き込んでプロジェクトを推進していただきます。

【応募資格（必須要件）】

• 医療業界における課題解決型の提案営業経験 （対象顧客：大学病院、総合病院、または開業医・クリニック等） 具体的には、以下のいずれかの経験において高い成果を上げている方

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

• 院長・事務長などの経営層や、医師・臨床検査技師などの現場担当者などのキーマンに対するアプローチおよび強固な関係構築経験

• 普通自動車第一種運転免許 （AT限定可）

【歓迎要件（優遇スキル）】

• 医療業界における新規開拓営業の経験。

• 臨床検査領域における専門知識、または同関連製品の営業経験。

【求める人物像（コンピテンシー）】

• Growth Mindset（変化を楽しむ力と成長意識）: 先行きが不透明で変化の激しいVUCA環境をポジティブに捉え、自ら変化を楽しみながら新たな学びを獲得できる方。同時に、日進月歩の医療知識や製品技術を主体的に探求し、あらゆる経験を糧として継続的な自己成長と専門性の研鑽にコミットできる方

• Achieving Results（高い目標の達成に向けて、根気強く行動し続ける）: 現状に満足せず高い目標を定め、目標達成に向けて自分で考え、粘り強く行動する方。自己成長に向けて、失敗を恐れずに挑戦し続け、自発的に学び続けるパッションがある方

• Managing Change（変化を前向きにとらえ、次のアプローチを柔軟に考える）: 過去の成功ややり方にとらわれず、多様な視点やバックグラウンドを持つメンバーの意見も尊重して、より良いアプローチを考えられる方。ビジネスや組織の変化に柔軟に対応し、適切な行動をとることができる方

• Teamwork & Collaborations（チームワークとコラボレーションを促進する）: 個人（I）よりチーム（We）を重視し、強力な信頼関係を構築して協働し合える方。困難な状況に直面しても他責にせず、他者を尊重し、メンバーがベストを尽くせるようサポートし合える方。

雇用形態および期間
雇用形態: 正社員（期間の定めのない雇用）
試用期間: あり（原則として入社日から3ヶ月間。ただし会社が必要と認めた場合、延長あり）

業務内容　（雇い入れ直後）：募集職種　営業職（DMR）
　　　　　（変更の範囲）：将来的に他業務への異動あり

就業場所（雇い入れ直後）: 本社 〒108-0075 東京都港区港南1-2-70 品川シーズンテラス
　　　　 （変更の範囲）：会社の定める場所（テレワークを行う場所を含む）、全国転勤あり※テレワークは原則月8回までとする

給与
　　 基本給（月額）：300,000円 〜 ※能力・経験等考慮の上、当社規定により決定
　　 住宅手当（月額）： 22,000円～
※本ポジションは、応募時に勤務地を指定しての採用となるため、入社に伴う転居が発生した場合でも、借上社宅制度の適用対象外となります。なお、住居に関しては、会社規定に基づき別途住宅手当を支給いたします。
　　 営業手当：月70,000円～
　　＜補足＞■賞与：年1回（3月）■昇給：年1回（4月）
諸手当：住宅手当、フィールド手当、時間外、休日、深夜勤務手当、通勤 手当、別居手当など　※各種手当は当社規定により支給

労働時間・休憩時間
所定就業時間: 1日7時間45分
勤務形態: フレックスタイム制度適用
標準勤務時間帯: 始業 8:30 ～ 終業 17:15（休憩60分）コアタイム: 11:00～15:00
（※対象職種によっては、コアタイムのないフレックスタイム制（社内呼称：フレックスタイムβ）が適用されます。）
時間外勤務・休日労働: あり（業務上必要がある場合のみ）

休日および休暇
休日: 土曜日、日曜日、国民の祝日、年末年始（12月29日～1月4日）、創立記念日（8月1日）、その他会社が必要と認める日
休暇:
・年次有給休暇（法定付与日数に加えて会社独自の付与日数あり）
・特別休暇（結婚休暇、配偶者出産休暇、忌引き休暇、My Special Day休暇、夏季休　暇、転勤休暇、罹災休暇、リフレッシュ休暇 など）

福利厚生・社会保険：健康保険、厚生年金保険、雇用保険、労災保険
受動喫煙防止措置　屋内全面禁煙

• 単なるモノ売りではなく、自社のリソースを組み合わせたソリューション観点での提案を行ってきた経験

The Position Deja tu Huella - Communications & Intern What do we offer? To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry. Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Pharma Technical Development Europe Biologics (PTDE) porta terapie innovative dalla fase clinica al lancio del mercato. Il nostro obiettivo è lo sviluppo di farmaci sicuri ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia nella produzione, nella cura clinica, nella formulazione, nell'imballaggio e nell'analisi. Il Drug Product Clinical Supply Center (PTDE-C) di Basilea produce e riempie forme di dosaggio sterile per gli studi clinici (Phase I-III) in strutture all'avanguardia. In qualità di tirocinante, supporta il Capitolo Manufacturing Compounding & Visual Inspection nella produzione di soluzioni prima di riempire e controllare visiva di flaconi e siringhe. Potrai anche ottenere informazioni in aree adiacenti come Filling, E2E Manufacturing Support, Scienza & Tecnologia e Garanzia di Qualità. Mansioni - Supporto di colleghi nella produzione di soluzioni e controllo visivo - Identificazione, valutazione e avanzamento dei miglioramenti nell'eccellenza operativa (Lean & Six Sigma), cGMP (Planned Events / Changes) - Valutazione tecnica e realizzazione di nuove attrezzature - Supporto per la cultura del team (New Ways of Working) - Creazione e ottimizzazione di documenti cGMP, ad esempio istruzioni di lavoro e utente nel Sistema Qualità applicabile (Veeva) - Garantire requisiti di qualità secondo cGMP - Creare un processo/attraverso il tracciamento del prodotto/per consentire le decisioni basate sui dati - Supporto auto-ispezione, Audit, Passeggiate Gemba
• Requisiti - Immatrikulation in un'università o college o studio completato che non è più di 12 mesi indietro, preferibilmente in un campo di scienze della vita, farmacia o ingegneria e porta le seguenti competenze con - Prima esperienza nello sviluppo tecnico / preparazione e/o controllo delle forme medicinali parenterali - Esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica (cGMP) o in un altro ambiente regolamentato - Alta capacità di squadra con ottime capacità di comunicazione in parola e scrittura in tedesco / inglese e apertura per avvicinarsi attivamente ai colleghi - Molto buone capacità di documentazione - Gestione Routinizzata dei sistemi IT (ad esempio Google Workspace, gSheet, MS Office, Smartsheet, Tableau, Minitab ecc.) - Impegno, motivazione e alta disponibilità a lavorare in modo indipendente Informazioni - Lo stage inizia il prima possibile. La durata dello stage è di 9-12 mesi. - Per l'applicazione abbiamo bisogno di una conferma di iscrizione valida, una lettera di motivazione e un CV. - I cittadini non UE / EFTA devono fornire una conferma dall'università che uno stage obbligatorio fa parte della formazione ai documenti di richiesta. Si prega di menzionare la data di inizio e la durata desiderata nella lettera di motivazione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere il nostro alto ambizioso, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono
