descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Title: Disease Area Marketing Lead As DAML, you will be building the marketing strategy for the assigned brands and overall disease area; and be responsible for ensuring the marketing strategy gets delivered with confidence and conviction in working closely with the cluster marketing and broader teams. You will connect with the CEETRIS/ global teams to pull brand solutions from the network and help develop via work packages where gaps exist. You will be a member of the Cross Functional Pan India Disease Squad; and report into the Disease Area squad Lead. The Opportunity
• You will be Co-creating portfolio strategy, plans and objectives leveraging outside in perspective
• Build the integrated DA and Brand Plan along with the DA Squad Lead, the cross functio nal Pan India DA team, and importantly the PPOCs across India. It will be critically important the strategy is built on the insights gained from the PJPs and HSPs and the cluster teams. They are closest to our customers and their insights need to lead the strategy development.
• You will be building strong relationships with the identified key stakeholders from Key Doctors, Accounts or Government stakeholders to build Roche equity and gain customer insights - to incorporate into our work.
• You will ensure compliance of the marketing strategy with Roche and Local guidelines for all Roche Initiatives and develop Patient Persona based solutions.
• You will liaison with Global & regional team for brand related campaigns, cross Pollination of Best Practices and share insights from cluster specific data on patients, diseases, patient journey etc and design solutions to increase patient impact
• Design of awareness campaigns solving for patient journey challenges & calculate ROIs and support customization of pricing. In this context, the role provides commercial insights to inform Access & Medical functions, but does not own decision-making for pricing, commercial contracting, reimbursement, etc. Marketing and field insights will be generated using methodologies that comply with data privacy laws, competition laws, and ethical standards.
• You will gather insights and prepare effective pre-launch / launch strategies for new assets in the respective disease areas ensuring that the latest innovations reach patients in need Who you are We are seeking a highly collaborative, process-oriented Marketing Postgraduate with 5+ years of specialized experience within the Oncology therapeutic area (specifically lung or liver cancer). This individual will possess a powerful combination of commercial acumen, strong alliance management capabilities, and a proven track record of high-impact marketing execution within the complex Indian healthcare ecosystem. Key Competencies & Qualifications
• Oncology Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Indian healthcare ecosystem , emerging market landscapes, and specific clinical nuances of lung/liver oncology.
• Commercial & Strategic Marketing: Strong mastery of marketing fundamentals, a data-driven insight generation mindset, and a history of flawless campaign execution.
• Alliance Management & Collaboration: Exceptional networking and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to manage complex external alliances and drive cross-functional teamwork.
• Operational Rigor & Project Management: A highly structured, process-oriented approach backed by strong project management skills, fluency in modern productivity tools, and strict compliance with organizational SOPs an

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche in 50 Worten: Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Deine Abteilung Die Roche Diagnostics Deutschland GmbH vertreibt zukunftsweisende Diagnostika zur Blutanalyse sowie Laborkonzepte und -lösungen in Kliniken und Laborinstituten. In den kommenden Jahren wird eine große Anzahl an Systemen im Markt ausgetauscht. Damit wir diese große Herausforderung bewältigen, suchen wir in unserem neuen, zukunftsweisenden Pre-Configuration Center Unterstützung. Die neue Gerätegeneration (cobas pro & cobas pure) wird hier kundenspezifisch betriebsbereit vorinstalliert und für die Implementierung im Kundenlabor vorbereitet. Wir sind stolz darauf, wer wir sind, was wir tun und wie wir es tun und haben dabei ein klares Ziel vor Augen: Doing now what patients need next. Deine Hauptaufgaben, nach einer ausführlichen Einarbeitung, sind dabei:
• Ergebnisorientierte Geräte-Vorbereitung im Pre-Configuration Center.
• Installation, Justage und Inbetriebnahme (Software, Applikation & finale Testung) von komplexen Roche Standardanalysengeräten z.B. cobas pure / cobas pro inkl. cobas c 703 nach Zielvereinbarungen.
• Termingerechter und fachgerechter Aufbau (applikativ u. technisch) sowie ggf. Reparatur von Roche-Systemen mit einfachem Schwierigkeitsgrad, einschließlich abschließendem Test- nzw. Routinelauf inkl. Dokumentation (im CRM System)
• Durchführung der elektrotechnischen Sicherheitsüberprüfung und Endabnahme der vorkonfigurierten Systeme vor der Auslieferung.
• Mitwirkung bei der Datensicherung sowie der Erstellung und Pflege der Dokumentation (z.B. Installations- und Inbetriebnahme Pläne) gemäß den Anforderungen und internen Vorgaben.
• Selbstständige Fehlersuche und Beseitigung von Störungen an Analysesystemen und elektronisch gesteuerten Anlagen und Maschinen.
• Termingerechte Berichterstattung und unverzügliche Meldung kritischer Probleme/Reklamationen an das Roche Customer Support Center.
• Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Pflichten eines Medizinprodukteberaters gem. § 31 MPG (siehe Anlage) und Sicherstellung der vorgabenkonformen Reklamationsbearbeitung. Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast eine anerkannte und abgeschlossene mindestens zweijährige Berufsausbildung mit Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Elektronik, Mechanik, IT-Systemelektronik, oder vergleichbar
• Idealerweise hast Du bereits erste Berufserfahrung im technischen Bereich
• Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Technischen-Systemen (Fluidic, Elektronik, Messtechnik, Messtechnik, IT)
• Du kannst idealerweise Steuerungs / Betriebssoftware anwenden.
• Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Deutsch; Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind wünschenswert. Diese Arbeit erfordert eine Zuverlässigkeitsüberprüfung für Luftfracht (ZÜP), die eventuell während der Einarbeitungszeit absolviert werden kann. Standort: Der Dienstsitz ist in Monsheim, nähe Worms. Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. Deine Bewerbung Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten wir Dich, einen aktuellen Lebenslauf, ein für die Stelle passendes Motivationsschreiben und relevante Zeugnisse hinzuzufügen. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni At Roche, ogni voce conta. Qui puoi essere te stesso, apprezzato per le tue unicità e incoraggiato a esprimerti personalmente, dialogare apertamente e creare connessioni genuine. La nostra cultura valorizza, accetta e rispetta ogni individuo, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie, garantendo a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche e contribuisci a fare la differenza. ## La Posizione Presso Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), la nostra missione è chiara: diagnosticare prima, sviluppare più velocemente e personalizzare il trattamento perché ogni paziente è unico. Il nostro team di Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) guida l'innovazione per migliorare i risultati sanitari a livello globale. Ci consideriamo una squadra che può raggiungere il suo pieno potenziale solo lavorando insieme ai nostri clienti. Ascoltando attentamente i pazienti e i medici e sfruttando la digitalizzazione e le nuove tecnologie, ci avviciniamo alle loro esigenze reali. Questo spirito collaborativo crea un ambiente in cui le idee possono crescere e si possono provare nuovi modi di fare le cose - con il risultato di prodotti competitivi che arrivano ai pazienti più velocemente. Il nostro lavoro copre l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla scoperta al post-lancio. Collaborando con i team interni, i partner esterni e i pazienti, il capitolo CDMA fornisce preziose informazioni mediche, progetta ed esegue gli studi clinici e offre il supporto sul mercato. Infine, generiamo le prove cliniche complete che dimostrano la sicurezza, l'efficacia e la validità scientifica del prodotto - facilitando la registrazione, l'adozione e il rimborso dei prodotti a livello globale per salvare vite e migliorare la qualità della vita dei pazienti. ## L'Opportunità In Roche crediamo che le cure debbano iniziare prima che la malattia si manifesti. Come Senior Clinical Data Specialist nel nostro team di Clinical Operations, svolgerai attività di gestione dei dati di livello esperto che consentono directly l'innovazione, le intuizioni basate sui dati e il miglioramento continuo sui nostri progetti clinici e di sviluppo. In questo ruolo chiave, ti assicurerai che i dati completi e accurati siano pronti per l'analisi e la presentazione regolamentare, aiutandoci a consegnare soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita più velocemente ed efficientemente. ## Responsabilità Chiave - **Guida Progetti Complessi**: Funziona come Lead Data Manager (LDM) e punto di contatto principale per le questioni di gestione dei dati clinici, guida i team di gestione dei dati sui programmi di grandi dimensioni e gestisce i tempi e la pianificazione delle risorse. - **Definizione dell'Architettura dei Dati**: Utilizza la tua esperienza professionale per definire i flussi di lavoro dei dati specifici dello studio, le esigenze del database clinico e crea la documentazione di gestione dei dati completa (inclusi i moduli CRF, i piani di gestione dei dati, le specifiche del database e le specifiche del trasferimento dei dati). - **Garantire l'Eccellenza dei Dati**: Sorveglia la qualità dei dati definendo le metriche di prestazione, analizzando le tendenze e eseguendo revisioni dei dati esperte per identificare e risolvere i dati incompleti o discordanti. - **Collaborazione Cross-Funzionale**: Rappresenta la Gestione dei Dati negli incontri del team di studio cross-funzionale, fornendo chiarimenti tecnici e favorendo forti partnership tra i dipartimenti. - **Mentoring e Coaching**: Promuovi l'eccellenza del dipartimento mentendo i membri del team, condividendo le migliori pratiche e supportando l'implementazione di nuove tecnologie. ## Chi Sei Sei un collaboratore analitico che risolve i problemi e che prospera in un ambiente dinamico, eccellendo nella traduzione dei complessi concetti tecnici dei dati per i colleghi non tecnici. Porti un forte giudizio professionale, una dedizione alla qualità dei dati e una passione per la mentoring degli altri per raggiungere il loro pieno potenziale. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti: - **Formazione Accademica**: Una laurea o una laurea magistrale in una disciplina scientifica. - **Esperienza nella Gestione dei Dati Clinici**: Esperienza estesa e progressiva nella gestione dei dati clinici con una comprensione completa del processo di studio clinico. - **Conoscenza Regolamentare**: Una solida conoscenza delle normative e delle linee guida internazionali per la gestione dei dati clinici. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro team delle risorse umane.

Unser Team von Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) leitet Innovationen, um die Gesundheitsergebnisse weltweit zu verbessern. Wir betrachten uns als ein Team, das sein volles Potenzial nur durch die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden erreichen kann. Wenn wir Patienten und Ärzte aufmerksam zuhören und die Digitalisierung und neue Technologien nutzen, nähern wir uns ihren wirklichen Bedürfnissen. Dieser kollaborative Geist schafft eine Umgebung, in der Ideen wachsen können, und Sie können neue Wege versuchen, Dinge zu tun - mit dem Ergebnis von wettbewerbsfähigen Produkten, die zu Patienten schneller kommen. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams, externen Partnern und Patienten bietet das CDMA-Kapitel wertvolle medizinische Informationen, Designs und führt klinische Studien durch und bietet Marktunterstützung. Schließlich generieren wir komplette klinische Studien, die die Sicherheit, Wirksamkeit und wissenschaftliche Gültigkeit des Produktes demonstrieren - die Registrierung, Annahme und Erstattung von Produkten weltweit, um Leben zu retten und die Qualität des Patientenlebens zu verbessern. Die Chance In Roche glauben wir, dass die Behandlung beginnen sollte, bevor sich die Krankheit manifestiert. Als Senior Clinical Data Specialist in unserem Klinischen Operations-Team werden Sie kompetente Datenmanagement-Aktivitäten durchführen, die Innovationen, datenbasierte Erkenntnisse und kontinuierliche Verbesserungen in unseren klinischen und Entwicklungsprojekten direkt ermöglichen. In dieser Schlüsselrolle stellen Sie sicher, dass vollständige und genaue Daten für die regulatorische Analyse und Präsentation bereit sind und helfen uns, Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern, die das Leben schneller und effizienter verändern. Schlüsselverantwortung - Guide Complex Projects: Es arbeitet als Lead Data Manager (LDM) und Hauptkontaktpunkt für klinische Datenmanagement-Probleme, führt Datenmanagement-Teams zu großen Programmen und verwaltet Zeit- und Ressourcenplanung. - Definition von Data Architecture: Benutzen Sie Ihre Berufserfahrung, um studienspezifische Daten-Workflows, klinische Datenbankanforderungen zu definieren und eine vollständige Datenverwaltungsdokumentation zu erstellen (einschließlich CRF-Module, Datenmanagementpläne, Datenbankspezifikationen und Datentransferspezifikationen). - Datenschutz-Exzellenz: Es überwacht die Qualität der Daten durch Definition von Leistungsmetriken, Analyse von Trends und Durchführung von Expertendaten-Revisionen, um unvollständige oder diskrete Daten zu identifizieren und zu lösen. - Cross-Function-Kollaboration: Es stellt das Data Management in den Sitzungen des funktionsübergreifenden Studienteams dar und bietet technische Klärung und Förderung starker Partnerschaften zwischen den Abteilungen. - Mentoring and Coaching: Fördern Sie die Exzellenz der Abteilung durch lügende Teammitglieder, teilen Sie die besten Praktiken und unterstützen Sie die Umsetzung neuer Technologien. Sie sind ein analytischer Mitarbeiter, der Probleme und Drives in einem dynamischen Umfeld löst und sich in der Übersetzung komplexer technischer Datenkonzepte für nichttechnische Kollegen auszeichnet. descriptionByLocale.fr: Chez Roche, chaque voix compte. Ici vous pouvez être vous-même, apprécié pour votre unicité et encouragé à vous exprimer personnellement, dialoguer ouvertement et créer de véritables connexions. Nos valeurs culturelles, accepte et respecte chaque individu, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois au niveau personnel et professionnel. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, arrêter et guérir les maladies, en assurant l'accès aux soins aujourd'hui et pour les générations futures. Rejoignez Roche et aidez à faire la différence. Position Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est claire : diagnostiquer d'abord, développer plus rapidement et personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. Notre équipe Développement clinique et affaires médicales (CDMA) guide l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale. Nous nous considérons comme une équipe qui ne peut atteindre son plein potentiel qu'en travaillant avec nos clients. En écoutant attentivement les patients et les médecins et en profitant de la numérisation et des nouvelles technologies, nous abordons leurs besoins réels. Cet esprit de collaboration crée un environnement où les idées peuvent grandir et vous pouvez essayer de nouvelles façons de faire - avec le résultat de produits compétitifs qui arrivent aux patients plus rapidement. Notre travail couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la découverte à la post-lancement. En collaboration avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales précieuses, conçoit et réalise des études cliniques et offre un soutien commercial. Enfin, nous produisons des essais cliniques complets qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique du produit - facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits dans le monde entier pour sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. Possibilités À Roche, nous pensons que les soins devraient commencer avant que la maladie ne se manifeste. En tant que spécialiste principal des données cliniques au sein de notre équipe des opérations cliniques, vous effectuerez des activités de gestion des données d'experts qui permettent directement l'innovation, les idées fondées sur les données et l'amélioration continue de nos projets cliniques et de développement. Dans ce rôle clé, vous veillerez à ce que des données complètes et précises soient prêtes pour l'analyse et la présentation réglementaires, nous aidant à fournir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie plus rapidement et efficacement. Key Responsibility - Guida Progetti Complessi: Il fonctionne comme gestionnaire de données principal (DND) et principal point de contact pour les questions de gestion des données cliniques, guide les équipes de gestion des données sur les grands programmes et gère la planification du temps et des ressources. - Définition de l'architecture des données : Utilisez votre expérience professionnelle pour définir les flux de données spécifiques à l'étude, les besoins des bases de données cliniques et créer une documentation complète de gestion des données (y compris les modules CRF, les plans de gestion des données, les spécifications des bases de données et les spécifications de transfert de données). - Assurer l'excellence des données : Il supervise la qualité des données en définissant des paramètres de rendement, en analysant les tendances et en effectuant des révisions de données d'experts pour identifier et résoudre des données incomplètes ou discordantes. - Collaboration interfonctions : Représente la gestion des données aux réunions de l'équipe d'étude interfonctionnelle, fournissant des éclaircissements techniques et favorisant des partenariats solides entre les ministères. - Mentorat et coaching : Promouvoir l'excellence du département en faisant partie de l'équipe, en partageant les meilleures pratiques et en appuyant la mise en oeuvre de nouvelles technologies. Qui êtes-vous un collaborateur analytique qui résout les problèmes et prospère dans un environnement dynamique, excellent dans la traduction de concepts de données techniques complexes pour les collègues non techniques. Apportez un jugement professionnel fort, un dévouement à la qualité des données et une passion pour le mentorat afin d'atteindre leur plein potentiel. Pour y arriver, vous devrez : - Formation académique : Maîtrise ou diplôme dans une discipline scientifique. - Expérience en gestion des données cliniques: Expérience étendue et progressive en gestion des données cliniques avec une compréhension complète de l'essai clinique. - Connaissances régulières : Une connaissance solide des règlements et lignes directrices internationaux pour la gestion des données cliniques. Contact Pour plus d'informations ou pour postuler, visitez notre site Web ou contactez notre équipe de ressources humaines.

Mansioni Descrizione A Roche, puoi mostrare il tuo vero io, apprezzato per le tue unicità. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuina, dove sei valorizzato, previsto e rispettato per chi sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. Questo è il modo in cui miriamo a comandare, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. L'Opportunità Come Lead Clinical Site Manager specializzato in IVDR e Study Start-Up, sarai responsabile della progettazione, pianificazione, coordinamento e conduzione indipendente di tutte le attività necessarie nell'avvio, monitoraggio e dimostrazione degli studi di ricerca clinica. Giocarai un ruolo fondamentale nell'assicurarti che gli studi siano consegnati, registrati e segnalati in conformità ai protocolli, alle procedure operative standard e alle linee guida normative globali. In questo ruolo, preoccupatevi: - Guidare le attività di avvio dello studio dall'inizio alla fine, guidando la selezione del sito, l'attivazione e le probabilità di qualifica per garantire il lancio efficiente e il rispetto dei requisiti normativi degli studi clinici. - Gestire le presentazioni alla Commissione Etica (EC) e all'autorità Competente (CA), assicurando che tutta la documentazione degli studi, i contratti locali e le approvazioni istituzionali rispettino i rigorosi tempi normativi. - Fornire una robusta vigilanza sui fornitori esterni, monitorando i loro risultati, tracciando i progressi e assicurando che le prestazioni dei fornitori siano in linea con gli standard di qualità di Roche. - Fare da punto di contatto principale e esperto di studio per il personale del sito assegnato, formazione, assistenza tecnica e coordinamento le certificazioni necessarie. - Piattaformare la documentazione critica dello studio, inclusi i piani di monitoraggio dello studio, i documenti di consenso informato, le guide per l'istruzione del paziente e i moduli di registrazione dei boss per i protocolli diagnostici. - Eseguire attività di monitoraggio del sito e convalida dei dati, eseguendo visite al sito in tutte le fasi dello studio, dalla fase di avvio alla chiusura finale. - Collaborare con team globale, locali e virtuali, attraverso Ricerca e Sviluppo, Gestione dello Studio e Biometria per rilevazione clinica soluzionihe di primo livello. - Leadership & Coaching: Dedicherai del tempo a coachare i allenatori, aiuta gli altri a sviluppare le loro competenze e agendo come risorsa per i membri del team meno esperti.
• Requisiti Chi sei? Sei un professionista di ricerca clinica proattivo, collaborativo e altamente organizzato che prospera in un ambiente di matrice veloce. Possiedi forti competenze di risoluzione dei problemi, prendi decisioni indipendenti e eccelli nella gestione dei rapporti con i fornitori esterni. Per avere successo in questo ruolo, porti con te: - Istruzione & Esperienza: Un titolo di studio in un campo scientifico

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies. If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic area, specifically in Near Patient Care , we would love to hear from you! Key Responsibilities :
• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.
• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D, Biostatistics, Data Management, Medical Affairs and CDMA Project Teams.
• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.
• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.
• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.
• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).
• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.
• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.
• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers. Your Profile:
• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication and Near Patient Care or Point of Care. Experience with studies in an emergency department setting is a plus.
• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field. A backgro

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Global Study Lead to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will lead global study teams to ensure the successful execution of clinical studies. You will be responsible for delivering high-quality study designs, adhering to timelines and budgets, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to support evidence generation strategies. If you have a passion for advancing clinical trials in the cardiovascular/metabolic disease area (CVMD), specifically in Core Lab SWA (Serum Work Area) Systems and Automation, we would love to hear from you! Key Responsibilities :
• Lead and oversee the global study team, ensuring full accountability for study deliverables including quality, budget, and timelines.
• Collaborate with Program Leadership to prepare different scenarios for evidence generation (e.g., study, real-world evidence) and ensure cross-functional cooperation with Regulatory Affairs, R&D,Biostatistics, Data Management and CDMA Project Teams.
• Develop key study documents such as Design Validation Plans, study protocols, training materials, study forms, templates, and study reports.
• Maintain responsibility for the study-level budget of assigned studies.
• Ensure compliance with regulations, guidelines, and standard operating procedures, while ensuring audit/inspection readiness.
• Oversee execution of sponsored studies for registrational and non-registrational purposes through all study phases (planning, start-up, conduct, and close-out).
• Manage study activities outsourced to service providers, including CROs, ensuring timely and quality execution.
• Work with the Publication Team to ensure study results are effectively published.
• Track project performance and ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and within budget.
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including cross-functional teams, CROs, opinion leaders, investigators, and key customers. Who are you:
• Strong experience in clinical trial management, particularly in the cardiovascular/metabolic indication. Experience with IVD clinical and analytical system studies in the Core Lab Serum Work Area setting is a plus.
• You have a degree in Life Sciences, Healthc

descriptionByLocale.it:

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . As a Clinical Site Manager for the Study Delivery Near Patient Care CVMD team, you are designing, planning, coordinating, and conducting all activities involved in initiating, monitoring, and completing clinical research studies at the clinical study sites. You are delivering other data generation methodologies, working independently to ensure studies are delivered, recorded, and reported in accordance with protocol, standard operating procedures, good clinical practices, and other applicable regulatory requirements. The Opportunity
• Acting as the primary contact and clinical trial expert for assigned study site personnel, coordinating training, certification, and providing technical assistance to ensure successful study execution.
• Performing site assessments and qualification visits to support the site selection decision process and site activation activities, including contracting and obtaining IRB/EC/Health Authority approvals in compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Developing and managing key study site documentation, such as Study Monitoring Plans, informed consent documents, source documents, patient instruction guides, and case report forms, while contributing technical expertise to review study protocols, data management plans, reports, and manuscripts.
• Overseeing CROs for the delivery of site management activities, including training CRO CRAs, escalating issues, and collaborating with international investigators and key customers while mentoring and supporting colleagues to enhance their skills and expertise.
• Executing site management activities for sponsored studies in assigned focus areas across all phases of study (start-up, conduct, and close-out) for both registrational and non-registrational purposes.
• Validating product performance claims, supplying data for critical regulatory submissions, defining the functional and clinical utility of products, and gathering feedback and opinions from laboratories or customers regarding the products.
• Working in local and global study teams, including virtual teams, demonstrating diversity, cultural awareness, and fostering strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional team members, internal stakeholders, and external partners to achieve business goals and ensure operat

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We believe that meaningful impact starts with how we connect—with patients, healthcare professionals, and each other. If you are passionate about building strong customer relationships and driving business growth in the healthcare space, this opportunity could be for you. The Opportunity As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for managing sales performance, developing strategic customer relationships, and promoting Roche Diagnostics’ product portfolio within your assigned territory. You will play a key role in driving sustainable business growth while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and alignment with Roche’s global standards. In this role, you will:
• Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets through effective territory and account planning
• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers to establish long-term partnerships
• Identify and develop new business opportunities across Roche Diagnostics products and services
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external partners to execute commercial activities effectively
• Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and provide insights to support business strategy. Deliver timely and accurate reporting
• Ensure proper management of operational processes including contract documentation and supply coordination
• Contribute to a collaborative team environment with a strong focus on customer satisfaction Who you are You are driven, resilient, and able to navigate a dynamic, customer-facing environment. You take ownership of your territory, are proactive in identifying opportunities, and are committed to delivering results. You bring:
• Bachelor’s degree in any field; Life Sciences background is an advantage, with a minimum of 3 years of sales experience in Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Pharmaceutical industry
• Understanding of the healthcare ecosystem, including hospital or institutional structures
• Ability to work independently and deliver results with minimal supervision
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage stakeholders effectively
• Proficiency in English (written and spoken) and basic digital literacy
• Demonstrated learning agility and willingness to adapt to new products and business areas Compensation & Benefits This position also offers an attractive benefits package . Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories and doctors’ offices. The company employs nearly 3000 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics’ main sites. The Opportunity
• Support the Systems Engineering team with process optimization for medical device development
• Create and develop use cases of AI for design analysis, system performance, and documentation
• Contribution to department specific tasks (maintenance of product specific records, such as requirements or risks using a Lifecycle Management tool (RETINA from codebeamer)
• Collaborate in interdisciplinary development teams
• Status reporting to the respective stakeholder according to project specific requirements Who You are:
• You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program or have recently graduated (within the last 12 months prior to the start date) in one of the following fields: biomedical, electrical or mechanical engineering, systems engineering, biotechnology, chemistry, etc.
• You are interested in new technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence
• You are excited to start your professional career in the medical diagnostics industry
• You should have the ability to communicate clearly with different target groups
• You are motivated to build, manage and foster relationships and networks
• Quick grasp and understanding of complex issues, conceptual and creative thinking
• You have good knowledge of spoken and written English, German is a plus Application process:
• Please upload a current CV, a copy of your diploma certificate, an enrollment certificate, and a motivation letter indicating your preferred start date for the internship.
• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il dipartimento finanziario di Roche Pharma Schweiz AG combina specialisti di vari settori, come finanza, approvvigionamento, supply chain e approfondimenti strategici e analisi. Insieme, siamo responsabili di analizzare i dati da diverse fonti e generare intuizioni e quindi creare la migliore base possibile per il nostro business. La possibilità Siamo alla ricerca di uno stagista per il nostro Cluster Finance and Business Partnering nella filiale con sede a Basilea, Svizzera. Si lavorerà a stretto contatto con vari membri del team per acquisire preziosa esperienza nella catena di fornitura, sondaggi di soddisfazione del cliente, finanze e appalti. Chi sei:
• Sei attualmente iscritto a un corso di laurea magistrale in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o un campo correlato, o hai completato i tuoi studi ad un massimo di 12 mesi prima dell'inizio dello stage.
• Hai forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving.
• Lavorate in modo affidabile e preciso.
• Hai una comunicazione eccellente e competenze interpersonali.
• Sei sicuro nel gestire Google cSuite e Microsoft Office.
• È possibile lavorare in modo indipendente e in una squadra.
• È possibile padroneggiare perfettamente la lingua tedesca, la conoscenza dell'inglese che è sicuro dalla negoziazione è un vantaggio.
• Supporti la gestione dei dati master.
• Supporti l'implementazione di ricerche di mercato e studi di soddisfazione del cliente per comprendere meglio i nostri clienti e trarre le giuste raccomandazioni da loro.
• Sostenere la finanza nel bilancio mensile, nonché analisi finanziarie, pianificazione e reporting.
• Parteciperete a vari progetti multi-team assegnati dal Finance and Business Partnering Team. Processo di applicazione: La vostra domanda deve contenere un CV e una lettera di motivazione. Informazioni aggiuntive:
• Si prega di notare che, nell'ambito dei documenti di richiesta, i cittadini non UE/EFTA devono presentare un certificato universitario che indica che uno stage è obbligatorio e la durata dello stage obbligatorio.
• Questo stage non è adatto per una tesi master. Se si desidera sviluppare in un ambiente che promuove il lavoro di squadra e l'innovazione, Roche è la società giusta per voi. Qualsiasi ruolo in Roche aiuta a migliorare la vita dei pazienti. Contatta subito! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

The Position Data Advisory and Insights Specialist Exp- 7+ years Location - Pune Job description The Data Advisory & Insights Specialist is a key member of the Global ERP organization within a leading Swiss pharmaceutical company, reporting to the ERP Business Operations Lead (member of the ERP Leadership Team). This role designs, builds, and runs the ERP program's performance management capability — translating complex program, financial, and operational data into actionable insights for the ERP Leadership Team. You will own the end-to-end insights value chain: from data quality and automation (leveraging AI where it adds value), through dashboard and reporting solutions, to proactive identification of emerging risks and strategic advisory to senior leadership. This role requires deep analytical expertise, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence decision-making at the leadership level — combining hands-on delivery with strategic thinking. Description of the area The Global ERP team drives one of the company's largest transformation programs, implementing and sustaining a harmonized ERP landscape across the enterprise. The Business Operations function provides the department with workforce planning, financial steering, governance, and performance management — ensuring leadership has the transparency and insights needed to steer a complex, multi-year, global program. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or equivalent experience.
• Extensive experience providing data-driven insights and strategic recommendations to senior business leaders, ideally within large transformation programs (ERP/SAP context a strong plus).
• Proven track record of building and running performance management or business intelligence solutions in complex, global organizations.
• Experience with program/portfolio reporting, financial planning data, or workforce analytics is an advantage. Technical Skills
• Expertise in data visualization and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent) and advanced analytical methodologies.
• Strong capability in managing, integrating, and analyzing enterprise-level datasets from multiple sources.
• Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to data quality, reporting, or insight generation; productive use of AI tools in daily work.
• Ability to design, implement, and own end-to-end reporting frameworks — from data pipeline to executive-level presentation. Additional Qualifications
• Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to distill complex data into clear, decision-ready narratives for senior leadership.
• Deep understanding of how data-driven decision-making supports program steering and business strategy.
• Proactive, ownership-driven mindset — comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-moving global program environment.
• Strong collaboration skills across functions, geographies, and cultures; experience working in global delivery models (e.g., with European headquarters) is a plus. Job Responsibilities
• ERP Performance Management: Design, build, and operate the ERP performance management framework — dashboards, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms that consolidate program, financial, workforce, and delivery data into a coherent picture for the ERP Leadership Team.
• Proactive Insights & Early Warning: Move beyond retrospective reporting — develop forward-looking analytics that identify emerging risks, delivery bott

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• The Head of Customer Engagement & Marketing is a pivotal executive role within the Roche Turkey Leadership Team, entrusted with holistically architecting, leading, and executing the commercial vision and go-to-market strategies for the company's entire pharmaceutical portfolio. This role functions as the "Chief Commercial Conductor," orchestrating and unifying both the strategic business units (Disease Area Teams) and the central marketing capabilities that serve them (Marketing Leads / Marketing Chapter) under a single, cohesive vision. This leader directly manages and develops two distinct leadership groups: the Disease Area (DA) Leads and the Marketing Leads. Through the DA Leads, they hold ultimate accountability for the therapeutic area strategies and full P&L outcomes. Concurrently, through the Marketing Leads, they are responsible for embedding marketing excellence, fostering state-of-the-art capabilities, and ensuring the agile, strategic allocation of marketing resources across the entire Organization. The fundamental purpose of this role is to build a seamless bridge between high-level strategy and flawless execution. By leveraging a deep strategic partnership with the Medical, Access, Regulatory & Government affairs, as well as the Business Excellence Division, this leader will ensure Roche achieves its ambitious market leadership and patient impact goals. Core Responsibilities and Accountabilities 1. Integrated Commercial, Access, Medical, and Government Affairs strategy & execution:
• Architect and drive the overarching commercial strategy for all Disease Areas, ensuring the creation of integrated, omnichannel marketing and sales plans that are executed with excellence in the field.
• Lead portfolio-level strategic planning, including lifecycle management, competitive readiness, and new asset launch sequencing to maximize the long-term commercial value and patient impact of Roche’s portfolio.
• Assume ultimate ownership of commercial forecasting in partnership with finance, resource allocation, and budget management to ensure financial targets are met, and investments yield maximum ROI.
• 2. Disease Area (DA) P&L and Performance Leadership:
• Provide strategic direction, coaching, and empowerment to the DA Leads, holding full P&L accountability for the entire commercial organization. Drive the achievement of ambitious revenue growth, market share, and profitability targets.
• Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, and urgency within the DA teams, ensuring they remain laser-focused on overcoming obstacles and achieving their strategic objectives.
• Ensure DA teams have the necessary resources, capabilities, and cross-functional support to win in their respective markets.
• 3. Marketing Capability & Excellence (Marketing Lead) Leadership:
• Lead and cultivate the central Marketing Leads (Marketing Chapter) team, acting as the chief steward of marketing talent and capability within the organization.
• Take direct responsibility for the professional development, career progression, performance management, and succession planning for the marketing talent pool.
• Implement a dynamic resource allocation model, ensuring marketing expertise is deployed fluidly and effectively to the highest-priority strategic initiatives within the DA teams.
• Champion and embed a culture of marketing excellence across the organization, setting the gold standard for brand planning, digital marketing, data analytics, customer journey mapping,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is initially for a fixed-term contract 12 months. The employment contract will be concluded by our vendor/third party for outsourcing services. We have a fantastic and challenging opportunity to fully combine your recruiting and consulting skills to seek, attract, and bring in the very best talent into Roche. This is with a focus on supporting the demand for talent within our Roche EMEA region. As a Talent Acquisition Partner you will play a pivotal role in ensuring we are hiring the best talent to meet our business ambitions. Make Your Mark. Improve Lives. You will be part of the Roche EMEA Recruiting team, a group of highly skilled professionals in our Integrated Workforce Strategies organization. The geographic focus will be Extended Eastern Europe (EEE) & CIS countries, however you will also be collaborating closely within the Region EMEA where we swarm our capacities to achieve our region’s goals as one team, and also within our global network. This position reports to the Recruiting Lead EEE & CIS countries. Your Impact
• Be a professional and consultative partner for our business leaders regarding all talent acquisition aspects
• Expertly drive end-to-end recruiting processes and provide customized talent acquisition strategies and solutions, including active candidate sourcing & pipelining, talent marketing, talent selection, candidate experience, and Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
• Manage the offer process with all necessary stakeholders (create an offer proposal following our Roche compensation and benefits framework and pay equity considerations, obtain approvals, extend offers, and negotiate with the candidate if required)
• Closely collaborate with the other People and Culture colleagues in-country, particularly the Business Partners to have insight about the coming business priorities, and the People Relations Partners to ensure a high confidentiality of recruitment-related topics
• May lead recruitment transformation projects across functions/countries Who You Are
• University degree in Human Resources Management, Business Management, Economics, Marketing, Finance is preferred
• You are fluent in English but also having additional language skills are an advantage
• You are preferably working in the Life Science/Tech industry and have a high passion for People and Culture, particularly for Talent Acquisition with proven success as a recruiter or head-hunter
• You are well-versed in talent attraction, sourcing, and assessing across multiple geographies and varied levels of complexity and expert in applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, LinkedIn
• You excel at building and maintaining relationships with stakeholders across all levels, both within our business and the People and Culture team, leveraging excellent communication, interpersonal, and influencing skills to collaborate, negotiate, and innovate effectively
• You have excellent coaching and advising skills, and thus are a trusted partner to your business clients and enable them in their hiring decisions
• You can work in a multinational matrix organization with the dexterity to participate in or lead recruiting squads across regions or globally Salary starts from 2000 EUR gross/month. Final salary will depend on the level of experience and skills. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare toda

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns bewegt, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft ständig voran und sorgen dafür, dass alle Menschen heute und in Zukunft Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben, die sie brauchen. Eine Welt zu schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht. In der R&D-Abteilung Process Technologies and Material Science (Teil von Roche Diagnostics Solutions) entwickeln wir chemische Einsatzstoffe für das gesamte diagnostische Produktportfolio. Das Team Bioorganic Development & Transfer besteht aus 8 Mitarbeitenden mit wissenschaftlichem und technischem Hintergrund. Wir arbeiten an organisch-chemischen Synthesen und Up-scale Projekten und gehen dabei flexibel und zielorientiert vor, um maßgeschneiderte Moleküle für unsere Projektpartner zu entwickeln. Dabei legen wir Wert auf eine hohe Qualität und den Spaß an der gemeinsamen Arbeit. Deine zentralen Aufgaben In dieser Rolle bringst Du Deine fundierte Labor-Expertise direkt in die Entwicklung innovativer Diagnostika ein:
• Synthese & Herstellung: Du planst und führst eigenständig organisch-präparative Synthesen im Bereich niedermolekularer Verbindungen und deren funktionellen Bausteinen durch
• Up-Scale Arbeiten: Darüber hinaus bist Du für die Maßstabsvergrößerung chemischer Reaktionen vom Milligramm- bis in den Multigramm-Bereich verantwortlich
• Chromatographie & Downstream Prozesse: Du bringst Deine Expertise in die Aufreinigung komplexer Reaktionsmischungen ein (z. B. Flash-Chromatographie, HPLC) und optimierst Downstream-Prozesse
• Charakterisierung : Du isolierst die Zielverbindungen und nutzt moderne analytische Methoden (z. B. NMR, MS, HPLC/UV) zur Strukturaufklärung und In-Prozess-Kontrolle
• Prozessoptimierung & Transfer: Du optimierst etablierte Syntheseprozesse, um einen reibungslosen Transfer in die Produktion vorzubereiten und erstellst die entsprechenden Verfahrensanweisungen
• Dokumentation & Innovation: Du dokumentierst Deine Ergebnisse präzise, präsentierst diese im Team und setzt Dein Spezialwissen ein, um Projekte innerhalb von Roche Diagnostics voranzutreiben Dein Profil
• Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in Chemie (Bachelor) mit Schwerpunkt Organische Chemie oder eine Ausbildung zum Chemielaborant mit Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Darüber hinaus bringst Du tiefgreifende Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung in der klassischen präparativen organischen Synthese mit
• Auf Dein fundiertes Know-how in der präparativen Chromatographie sowie auf Deine Erfahrung beim Up-scale von chemischen Prozessen können wir uns voll und ganz verlassen
• Ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Charakterisierungsmethoden (NMR, MS, HPLC) zeichnet Dich aus
• Du hast Freude an der Lösung komplexer chemischer Fragestellungen und am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Team
• Zuverlässigkeit, Gewissenhaftigkeit und eine strukturierte Vorgehensweise sind für Dich selbstverständlich
• Außerdem bist Du ein Teamplayer mit sicherem Kommunikationsstil in Deutsch und Englisch Diese Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. Deine Bewerbung Wir machen es Dir leicht: Bitte lade lediglich Deinen aktuellen, aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf sowie das Zeugnis Deines höchsten Abschlusses hoch. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global

En collaborant avec des équipes internes, des partenaires externes et des patients, le chapitre CDMA fournit des informations médicales cruciales, conçoit et exécute des études cliniques et offre un soutien sur le marché. En fin de compte, nous produisons les preuves cliniques complètes qui démontrent l'innocuité, l'efficacité et la validité scientifique des produits - en facilitant l'enregistrement, l'adoption et le remboursement des produits à l'échelle mondiale afin que nous puissions sauver des vies et améliorer la qualité de vie des patients. L'opportunité En tant que responsable de l'étude mondiale, vous serez pleinement responsable de la conception, de la planification et de l'exécution d'essais cliniques parrainés à l'échelle mondiale, depuis l'élaboration de protocoles jusqu'à la clôture. En vous joignant à une équipe dynamique et matricielle au sein de nos communautés de développement clinique et d'affaires médicales, vous superviserez divers portefeuilles d'études, y compris des diagnostics complémentaires, des programmes d'adoption précoce et des collaborations de recherche, assurant l'excellence opérationnelle, le contrôle budgétaire et la préparation absolue à l'inspection.
• L'excellence de l'étude : Dirigez l'équipe mondiale d'étude interfonctionnelle avec une responsabilité totale pour les études de haute qualité, les résultats cliniques, les budgets et les délais.
• Stratégies de mise en forme des données probantes : partenariat avec le leadership du programme pour définir des scénarios novateurs pour la production de données probantes à l'échelle mondiale, la collaboration entre les équipes des Affaires réglementaires, de la R-D et des projets médicaux.
• Author Core Study Documentation : Élaborer des documents cliniques critiques à impact élevé incluant des protocoles d'étude, des plans de validation de conception, des formulaires d'étude et des rapports d'étude approfondie.
• Champion Partenariats stratégiques : Superviser les fournisseurs de services externes et les organismes de recherche sous contrat (ORC), qui conduisent les performances des fournisseurs, la sélection et la gestion des relations au niveau de l'étude.
• Advance Diagnostics Innovation : Diriger les aspects opérationnels des études de diagnostics complémentaires parrainées par des partenaires externes, ainsi que les portefeuilles de collaborations d'accès et de recherche précoces.
• Cultiver les réseaux d'experts : Collaborer étroitement avec les leaders internationaux de l'opinion médicale, les chercheurs et les principales parties prenantes externes afin d'apporter des informations externes avancées à l'interne. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et analytique des opérations cliniques qui prospère dans des environnements rapides et mondiaux. Vous apportez un état d'esprit collaboratif, d'excellentes compétences en communication et une passion pour fournir des perspectives cliniques changeantes.
• Un diplôme en sciences de la vie, santé, ou un domaine scientifique connexe (un diplôme avancé est un plus).
• Expérience solide et progressive de la gestion des essais cliniques ou de l'exécution au niveau de l'étude dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou des biotechnologies. De préférence, l'expérience d'une étude portant sur la gestion des essais cliniques de DIV moléculaires.
• Bonne connaissance pratique des normes de recherche clinique

Compiti Chiave - Guida la Strategia Clinica: Guidare la strategia di sviluppo clinico per gli studi diagnostici clinici e i programmi complessi, nell'area delle Neuroscienze, definendo l'utilità clinica, l'uso previsto e le estensioni delle rivendicazioni su tutto il nostro portfolio. - Lead Interazioni con le Autorità Sanitarie: Lavorare a stretto contatto congli Affari Regolatori Globali per completare e presentare le domande di autorizzazione in tutto il mondo, redigendo sezioni critiche dei pacchetti di riunione e revisionando i documenti clinici per le presentazioni internazioni. - Costruisce Partnership congli Intervenant: Agire come responsabile clinico negli scambi esterni con le autorità sanitarie, costruire relazioni strategiche con i leader di opinione internazioni (KOL) e guidare i partenariati di sviluppo in tutto il settore e l'accademia. - Promuove l'Eccellenza nella Comunicazione: Sorvegliare l'attuazione delle strategie di comunicazione per gli studi clinici, rappresentando l'organisation nei maini congressi medici, nei consigli consulivi e nelle pubblicazioni chiave. - Promuove Innovazione ed Eccellenza: Agire come principale driver della differenziazione comppetitiva, dell'innovazione e delle attività del early pipeline mentre sviluppa strategie di proprietà intelletuale e ottimizza i processi clinici. - Coaching e Mentoring: Agire come coach dedicato per i membri del team, nutrendo la fiducia e aiutando i colleghi a sviluppare le loro rivalze e l'espérienza. Chi Sei Sei un pensatore strategico e analtico che prospera in un ambiente veloce e matriciale. Sei appassionato alla centratura sul cliente e sul paziente e eccelli nell'integrare le prospetive multifunzionali in una strategia clinica unificata.

Come piombo di sviluppo clinico, malattie cardiovascolari e metaboliche (CVMD) all'interno della nostra organizzazione di affari clinici e medici in diagnostica, si: - Drive Clinical Strategy: Guida la strategia di sviluppo clinico per studi su larga scala e programmi complessi nell'area CVMD, definendo utilità clinica, uso destinato e rivendicare estensioni attraverso il nostro portafoglio. - Lead Health Authority Interactions: Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli Affari Regolatori Globali nel completamento e nella presentazione degli archivi normativi globali, autorizzando sezioni critiche dei pacchetti di riunione e rivedendo i documenti clinici per le sottomissioni normative internazionali. - Forge Stakeholder Partnerships: Atto come leader medico nelle interazioni esterne con le autorità sanitarie, costruire relazioni strategiche con i leader internazionali delle opinioni chiave (KOLs), e guidare partnership di sviluppo in tutta l'industria e l'accademia. - Foster Communication Excellence: supervisionare l'attuazione delle strategie di comunicazione per gli studi clinici, che rappresentano l'organizzazione in importanti congressi medici, consiglieri e pubblicazioni chiave. - Champion Innovation & Excellence: Agite come autista chiave per la differenziazione competitiva, l'innovazione e le prime attività pipeline, sviluppando strategie di proprietà intellettuale e ottimizzando i processi clinici. - Coach e Mentor: agire come allenatore dedicato per i membri del team, nutrire la fiducia e aiutare i colleghi a sviluppare le loro competenze e competenze. descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) , our mission is clear: to diagnose earlier, develop faster, and personalise treatment because every patient is unique. Our Clinical Development & Medical Affairs (CDMA) team drives innovation to improve healthcare outcomes globally. We see ourselves and our customers as a team that can only reach its full potential together. By listening closely to patients and physicians, and leveraging digitalisation and new technologies, we get closer to their real-world needs. This collaborative spirit creates an environment where ideas can grow and new ways of doing things can be tried - resulting in competitive products that get to patients faster . Our work spans the entire product lifecycle, from discovery to post-launch. By collaborating with internal teams, external partners, and patients, the CDMA chapter provides crucial medical insights, designs and executes clinical studies, and offers on-market support. Ultimately, we generate the comprehensive clinical evidence that demonstrates product safety, effectiveness, and scientific validity - facilitating smooth product registration, adoption and reimbursement globally so we can save lives and improve patient quality of life . The Opportunity Are you ready to shape the future of healthcare by leading the clinical development strategy for next-generation diagnostic solutions? As a Clinical Development Lead, Cardiovascular and metabolic diseases (CVMD) within our Clinical and Medical Affairs organisation in Diagnostics, you will play a pivotal role in planning and implementing clinical development activities that bring medically-differentiated solutions to patients globally. In this role, you will act as a senior strategic voice and trusted advisor, fostering an environment where science and collaboration thrive. Key Responsibilities :
• Drive Clinical Strategy : Lead the clinical development strategy for large-scale studies and complex programs, in the CVMD area, defining clinical utility, intended use, and claim extensions across our portfolio.
• Lead Health Authority Interactions : Work closely with Global Regulatory Affairs in the completion and submission of global regulatory filings, authoring critical sections of meeting packages and reviewing clinical documents for international regulatory submissions.
• Forge Stakeholder Partnerships : Act as the medical lead in external interactions with health authorities, build strategic relationships with international Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), and drive development partnerships across industry and academia.
• Foster Communication Excellence : Oversee the implementation of communication strategies for clinical studies, representing the organisation at major medical congresses, advisory boards, and in key publications.
• Champion Innovation & Excellence : Act as a key driver for competitive differentiation, innovation, and early pipeline activities while developing intellectual property strategies and optimising clinical processes.
• Coach and Mentor : Act as a dedicated coach for team members, nurturing confidence and helping colleagues develop their skills and expertise. Who You Are You are an analytical, strategic thinker who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You are passionate about customer and patient-centricity, and you excel at integrating multiple cross-functional perspectives into a unified clinical strategy. Qualifications & Experience :
• Medical degree (MD) or an advanced degree (PhD) in cardiolo

Chi sei Sie sind ein analytischer, strategischer Denker, der in einer schnelllebigen, Matrix-Umgebung lebt. Sie sind leidenschaftlich an Kunden- und Patientenzentrierung, und Sie zeichnen sich durch die Integration mehrerer funktionsübergreifender Perspektiven in eine einheitliche klinische Strategie aus. Voraussetzungen Qualifiche e Esperienza - Medizinischer Abschluss (MD) oder fortgeschrittener Abschluss (PhD) in der Kardiologie oder einem verwandten Bereich - Nachweis der klinischen Entwicklung, mit einem starken Fokus auf Herz-Kreislauf- und Stoffwechselerkrankungen - Erfahrung in globalen regulatorischen Absprachen und Interaktionen von Gesundheitsbehörden - Gezeigte Fähigkeit, strategische Beziehungen zu externen Akteuren aufzubauen und zu pflegen - Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeit, mit Erfahrung in der Vertretung von Organisationen auf großen medizinischen Kongressen und in Schlüsselveröffentlichungen - Starke Führungs- und Coaching-Fähigkeiten, mit Erfahrung in Mentoring-Team-Mitgliedern und dem Fahren von Innovation - Fluency in English; Zusatzsprachenkenntnisse sind ein Vermögen Contattoo Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visitare il sito web von Roche o contattare il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.

Mansioni Développement clinique du plomb, maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques (MCV) Descrizione del lavoro Chez Roche, vous pouvez être vous-même et prospérer personnellement et professionnellement dans une culture qui valorise et respecte l'individualité. Notre mission est de prévenir, d'arrêter et de guérir les maladies, en veillant à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez-nous et faites une différence dans les soins de santé. Mansioni Équipe du développement clinique et des affaires médicales (CDMA) Chez Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS), notre mission est de diagnostiquer plus tôt, de développer plus rapidement et de personnaliser le traitement car chaque patient est unique. L'équipe CDMA stimule l'innovation pour améliorer les résultats en matière de soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale en collaborant avec les clients, les patients et les partenaires externes. L'entreprise Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir des soins de santé en dirigeant la stratégie de développement clinique des solutions diagnostiques de nouvelle génération? En tant que responsable du développement clinique, des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques (MCV) au sein de notre organisation des affaires cliniques et médicales en diagnostic, vous: - Diriger la stratégie clinique : Diriger la stratégie de développement clinique pour les études à grande échelle et les programmes complexes dans le domaine de la DMCV, définir l'utilité clinique, l'utilisation prévue et les extensions de revendications dans l'ensemble de notre portefeuille. - Interactions avec les autorités sanitaires principales : Collaborer étroitement avec les Affaires réglementaires mondiales à l'achèvement et à la soumission des dossiers réglementaires mondiaux, à la rédaction de sections critiques des dossiers de réunion et à l'examen des documents cliniques pour les présentations réglementaires internationales. - Forge Partnerships: Agir comme chef de file médical dans les interactions externes avec les autorités de la santé, établir des relations stratégiques avec les leaders internationaux de l'opinion clé (KOL) et stimuler les partenariats de développement entre l'industrie et le milieu universitaire. - Favoriser l'excellence en matière de communication : Superviser la mise en oeuvre de stratégies de communication pour les études cliniques, représenter l'organisation aux grands congrès médicaux, aux conseils consultatifs et dans des publications clés. - Champion Innovation & Excellence : agir comme moteur clé de la différenciation concurrentielle, de l'innovation et des premières activités de pipeline, tout en développant des stratégies de propriété intellectuelle et en optimisant les processus cliniques. - Entraîneur et mentor : agir comme entraîneur dévoué pour les membres de l'équipe, entretenir la confiance et aider les collègues à développer leurs compétences et leur expertise. Les Vous êtes un penseur analytique et stratégique qui prospère dans un environnement matriciel rapide. Vous êtes passionné par le client et le patient, et vous excellez dans l'intégration de multiples perspectives interfonctionnelles dans une stratégie clinique unifiée.
• Requisiti Qualifiche e Esperienza - Diplôme médical (MD) ou diplôme de doctorat en cardiologie ou domaine connexe - Antécédents prouvés en développement clinique, avec une forte focalisation sur les maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques - Expérience en matière de classements réglementaires mondiaux et d'interactions entre autorités sanitaires - Capacité démontrée d'établir et de maintenir des relations stratégiques avec des intervenants externes - Excellente capacité de communication et de présentation, avec l'expérience de représenter les organisations aux grands congrès médicaux et dans les publications clés - Des compétences solides en leadership et en coaching, avec de l'expérience dans le mentorat des membres de l'équipe et la conduite de l'innovation - La maîtrise de l'anglais; la maîtrise de langues supplémentaires est un atout Contatto Par ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visiter il sito web di Roche o combattre il nostro team delle Risorse Umane.
