descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is part of the Legal and Compliance department in Diagnostics Division with matrix reporting lines. Your direct report is to Head of Legal and Compliance with dotted line managers Head of Marketing and Head of Professional Services also with direct access to executive directors (as legally required). The Cybersecurity and Digital Solutions Lead is responsible for developing and implementing cybersecurity policies and protocols to protect Roche's products, information systems and technologies and managing the roadmap, governance, and value realization of key digital initiatives across the Czech Affiliate and its Diagnostics and Pharma businesses. Using your expertise in Roche's products and environment, you will ensure systems comply with all security and regulatory standards. You will also apply your technical skills to manage and mitigate cyber threats. The Opportunity
• Develop and oversee cybersecurity framework, strategy, policies and procedures (eg. ISO 27001 implementation, NIS2 local implementation) to safeguard digital systems and sensitive information.
• Manage the cybersecurity responsibilities across different teams in Roche Diagnostics and Pharma divisions and ensure cooperation throughout the organization and overall alignment with Roche's security objectives.
• Ensure Regulatory Compliance with cybersecurity and data protection requirements.
• Manage the Risk Framework and monitor risk management activities.
• Perform risk assessments to identify potential cyber threats and establish and coordinate a risk management plan in the context of the organisation as well as individual installation cases.
• Assess system vulnerabilities and implement security measures.
• Monitor network and information security systems for potential breaches and intrusions.
• Coordinate potential cyber security incidents.
• Cooperate and coordinate the process of cybersecurity asset management.
• Conduct regular security audits and compliance checks across all systems and applications and elaborate regular reports on cybersecurity risks and mitigation steps.
• Liaise and communicate directly with the regulatory Authorities and relevant Bodies on topics of cybersecurity.
• Communicate directly and regularly with the management on the topics of cybersecurity, support Executive Management in cybersecurity-related decisions
• Prepare Security Assessments and Reports for Leadership.
• Maintain updated knowledge of cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and technologies.
• Collaborate with external IT and external business units (e.g. hospitals and laboratories, etc.) to ensure effective cybersecurity strategies are integrated into business processes.
• Provide training and awareness programs on cybersecurity best practices for all staff.
• Manage cybersecurity training and awareness programs across business functions.
• Oversee third-party risk management and vendor cybersecurity compliance.
• Define and maintain the digital portfolio roadmap for diagnostics, including connected devices, remote monitoring tools, and AI-driven decision support systems.
• Work cross-functionally with Product Management, IT, and Legal, Compliance and Regulatory teams to ensure timely and compliant delivery.
• Collaborate with all stakeholders (internal/ external) on development and implementation of Digital Products and Solutions strategy. Who You Are
• Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
• Certifications su

Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Como Practicante Profesional de Calidad en Ate, Perú , te integrarás al equipo encargado de asegurar que nuestros productos mantengan los más altos estándares globales antes de llegar a quienes más los necesitan. En este rol, tendrás un impacto directo en el mantenimiento de nuestro Sistema de Gestión de Calidad, colaborando estrechamente con operaciones locales y flujos de importación en un entorno de aprendizaje continuo. Oportunidad
• Realizas la inspección física, registro fotográfico y verificación de rotulados e insertos de los productos médicos que ingresan al almacén.
• Elaboras y mantienes actualizados los expedientes de lote ( batch records ) y las órdenes de inspección para los procesos de reacondicionado.
• Verificas los certificados de análisis (CoAs) y reportas oportunamente cualquier discrepancia detectada en los productos.
• Gestionas la segregación y el control del inventario de contramuestras según los requerimientos establecidos.
• Descargas, analizas y notificas el estado de los monitores de temperatura de las importaciones, asegurando la cadena de frío.
• Consolidas la información de los registros de temperatura del almacén y generas los informes mensuales de conformidad.
• Apoyas en la preparación de autoinspecciones y auditorías internas para los procesos de almacenamiento y distribución.
• Colaboras en la actualización de los procedimientos de calidad y en las capacitaciones del personal en buenas prácticas. Quien eres
• Eres egresado/a de las carreras de Química Farmacéutica, Toxicología o Tecnología Médica.
• Disponibilidad para realizar prácticas profesionales
• Posees un nivel de inglés intermedio.
• Demuestras un manejo intermedio de MS Office, especialmente en el uso de Excel.
• Destacas por tu orientación al detalle, capacidad de organización y un estilo de trabajo colaborativo.
• Conocimiento o familiaridad con herramientas de análisis de datos como Power BI y herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (Copilot, Gemini, etc.) sería preferible mas no requerido. Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. At Roche, we thrive to deliver more benefits to our patients as part of our 10-year Pharma vision. An integral part to achieving this vision is to deliver new and innovative data analytics solutions to our scientists across Pharma Technical Operations (PT). To do so, we have formed a new organization called PT Digital and Operational Excellence (PTE) with the aspiration to build industry-leading digital and lean operations across functions and our entire manufacturing footprint. PTE is the organization that catalyzes global development and execution of PT’s Digital and Operational Excellence strategy to enable PT to realize our performance promises. We build a strong cross-functional and inclusive community, put the power of data into the hands of our people, further develop the Lean and Digital skills across PT, and scale up our Digital and Advanced Analytics solutions, for the benefit of our colleagues and patients. We aim to activate data citizenship and digital mindset, revolutionize our FAIR data ecosystem and systems landscape, re-design excellent processes, and generate transformative insights. The Opportunity You will be responsible for driving the digital technology strategy through the delivery of key digital initiatives and use cases in the Quality domain and you take the role of an Agile Product Owner (PO) to partner with customers across PT functions to architect the planning (e.g. diagnose), execution (e.g. design & build), and sustainment of digital solutions to achieve the PT Digital Aspirations.
• Strategic Digital Transformation: Architecting key initiatives and acting as a digital translator between business needs and technical roles by navigating across both domains seamlessly.
• Impact: Defining impact aspirations (e.g. product vision, roadmap, value assessments, business cases) as well as leading deployment of a global solution in a function or site. Enable significant improvements in quality management processes through innovative digital solutions, confirmed through the measurement of key business metrics.
• Requirements Analysis: Utilize your broad Quality end to end Business understanding to perform detailed requirement analyses with the team, with a strong focus on balancing process requirements, stakeholder requirements with digital product simplicity, network scalability and sustainability.
• Prioritization and Team Setup: Conducting use case prioritization and assuming the product owner role to catalyze the implementation of key digital use cases. Coach teams that are developing and deploying digital use cases, e.g. share best practices, agile ways of working, backlog management, sprint planning and ensure full impact capture & coordination between different initiatives. Lead cross-functional project teams with digital experts and SMEs across multiple sites and time zones.
• Compliance and Solution Shaping: Facilitating compliant solutions for data and digital products in the GxP environment.
• Risk Assessment and Mitigation: Identify potential risks associated with digital quality initiatives and develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
• Innovation and Improvement: Continuously explore and assess emerging digital technologies and industry trends. Drive innovation and process improvements within the Quality domain to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Who you are You bring several years of experience in architecting and implementing digital

The Position Roche is seeking a strategic and collaborative ERP Product Lifecycle Management Business Partner to join the Informatics ERP Team at Roche. In this role, you will partner closely with business stakeholders across Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care to drive digital transformation initiatives spanning Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor between business functions and Informatics teams, ensuring that enterprise solutions align with operational, regulatory, product development, and manufacturing objectives across the Diagnostics discipline and Diabetes Care portfolio. Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as the primary Informatics business partner for ERP and PLM initiatives within Roche Diagnostics and Roche Diabetes Care.
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Commercial, and Operations teams.
• Facilitate alignment between business strategy and enterprise technology roadmaps.
• Drive effective communication between business users, solution architects, vendors, and delivery teams. ERP & PLM Strategy and Delivery
• Lead and support ERP and PLM transformation initiatives across Diagnostics and Diabetes Care.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, harmonization, and digital innovation.
• Translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.

• Participate in global PLM initiatives and projects, ensuring consistency and scalability of solutions across Roche divisions.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche, nos apasiona transformar la vida de los pacientes . Como Access & Value Lead , reportarás directamente al Gerente General y liderarás el diseño e implementación de estrategias integrales para asegurar el acceso sostenible y oportuno a nuestras soluciones innovadoras en el sistema de salud ecuatoriano . Dirigirás un equipo multidisciplinario enfocado en generar propuestas de valor diferenciadas con un alto impacto clínico, económico y social . ● Estrategia de acceso: Diseñar y liderar la estrategia integral de acceso (precios, reembolso, HTA,acuerdos innovadores), alineada con los objetivos del negocio y las prioridades de salud pública. ● Liderazgo de equipo: Guiar, desarrollar y empoderar al equipo de acceso, asegurando una cultura de altodesempeño, colaboración transversal e innovación constante. ● Gestión del entorno institucional: Construir relaciones estratégicas con entidades regulatorias, aseguradoras públicas y privadas, organismos multilaterales, asociaciones de pacientes y otros actores clave. ● Valor y evidencia: Trabajar en conjunto con Medical y otras áreas para generar evidencia local relevante (real world evidence, PROs, análisis farmacoeconómicos) que sustente las decisiones de acceso.
• ● Participación en políticas públicas: Representar a Roche en espacios de diálogo regulatorio, técnico ypolítico, e influir en la construcción de políticas sanitarias basadas en valor.
• ● Desarrollo de soluciones sostenibles: Impulsar modelos de acceso innovadores como esquemas de riesgo compartido, acuerdos de valor, compra por resultados, entre otros.
• ● Colaboración regional y global: Conectar la realidad local con las estrategias regionales y globales, aportando insights y adaptando mejores prácticas.
• ● Cumplimiento regulatorio y ético: Garantizar que todas las actividades de acceso se realicen en conformidad con las políticas de Roche, el marco legal local y los más altos estándares éticos. ● Desarrollo de personas: responsabilidad de actuar como líder visionario, arquitecto, catalizador y coach en el desarrollo de su equipo, fomentando el crecimiento profesional, y a su vez, el desarrollo de posibles sucesores para el rol. Tu Perfil Formación Académica: Ciencias de salud, economía, salud pública o políticas, con un enfoque en la implementación de políticas y dinámicas del mercado. Maestría finalizada en Salud Pública, Economía de la Salud, Políticas Públicas o un MBA . Experiencia Profesional: Cuentas con un mínimo de 8 años de experiencia liderando roles de acceso al mercado ( Market Access ), asuntos gubernamentales o política sanitaria en la industria farmacéutica o sector salud . Experiencia en fijación de precios, reembolso, HTA (Evaluación de Tecnologías Sanitarias) incluyendo la demostración de valor y el desarrollo de dosieres para pagadores. Conocimiento del Entorno: Demuestras un entendimiento profundo del sistema de salud ecuatoriano u otros parecidos, así como conocimientos específicos en HTA, economía de la salud, regulaciones y pricing . Comprensión profunda de los sistemas de salud y los entornos políticos, así como su impacto en el acceso al mercado. Pensamiento Estratégico: Tienes una sólida capacidad para analizar el impacto sistémico, simplificar procesos complejos y ejecutar con un fuerte enfoque en resultados e innovación . The Position The Histology Associate (2nd shift) supports the functions of RTD histology laboratories in the performance of routine histotechniques. This is an essential position supporting the organizational goals requiring attendance on weekends, holidays and during emergency or exceptional conditions. The Opportunity:
• Histotechniques (Tissue Sectioning and Staining)
• Demonstrates foundational histotechniques of embedding, microtomy, coverslipping, processing and primary staining.
• Operates laboratory or manufacturing equipment.
• Receives detailed directions on all work. Follows standard operating procedures.
• Monitors and prepares bulk reagents.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Sequencing Solutions is expanding with a Principal Data Scientist to lead and help drive forward R&D activity by providing a deep level of insight into experimental data, its interpretation and implications for project development efforts. This role seeks a highly advanced and versatile individual who combines deep statistical expertise with proficiency in advanced data analysis tools and a focus on applying these skills to complex biological problems. (Applicants whose primary experience is narrowly defined within established bioinformatics analysis workflows might not align for the scope of this Principal Data Scientist role.) Principal data scientists combine a number of skills from different domains to organize, process, and learn from data, often through the lens of domain-expert informed models that help to abstract concepts from the data, test their validity and make predictions. The Opportunity:
• You will analyze large datasets, identify patterns, correlations, and anomalies that might be hidden within the data. Use statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to extract meaningful insights.
• You will have experience with DOE for biological and assay development experiments, where we need to draw meaningful conclusions on small sample sizes.
• You will provide statistical analysis of experimental results and communicate it to internal customers in a way that is both approachable and informative.
• You will work cross functionally using various pilot studies to then integrate the necessary analytical or inferential routines into a pipeline through a collaborative software engineering effort; the overall goal resulting in a validated internal software product that may be used regularly by experimentalists to track their research progress.
• You will utilize AI based tools for data analysis and create AI based support tools for internal customers.
• You have the ability to create clear and informative visualizations of the data and analysis results, making it easier for the technical (and non technical) team(s) to understand the situation and make informed decisions.
• You are able to identify technical challenges as they pertain to your team as well as collaborating teams, definite requirements and architecture for next-generation machine learning and statistical analysis products. This position is based on-site in Santa Clara, CA. Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role. Who You Are: (Required)
• You have a PhD in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or other related areas of study and 5 years (or more) of experience handling various data sets/modules.
• You are able to define and lead analysis projects interfacing with multiple stakeholders.
• You have demonstrated experience handling large datasets, with demonstrated ability of transferring the data into meaningful and actionable reports.
• You have demonstrated experience in the application of statistical methods for process control and optimization (e.g., Statistical Process Control, A/B testing design/analysis, or advanced time series modeling) in a non-biological context.
• You have a demonstrated level of experience in a wide range of ML algorithms (traditional to advanced) and a strong understanding of the principles behind model training, validation and hyperparameter tuning.
• You have practical experience in designing and implementing automated workflows; the ability to troubleshoot/map out a solution.

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile partner del viaggio del paziente

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Impacto Sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. Líder con visión sistémica y emprendedora, responsable de garantizar que los Patient Journey Partners (PJP) generen resultados extraordinarios, agregando valor al sistema de salud, pacientes y negocio de Roche. Actúa como coach y mentor, fomentando colaboración y buenas prácticas para acelerar el acceso de pacientes. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Liderar y fomentar la colaboración del equipo PJP, poniendo al paciente en el centro y estimulando co-creaciones con clientes que beneficien la atención médica y aceleren la adopción del modelo operativo.
• Asegurar que las estrategias y planes de los PJPs estén alineados con las prioridades de Roche y el mercado de salud, garantizando resultados estratégicos y tácticos con base en insights.
• Desarrollar talento y fomentar una cultura de alto desempeño a través del liderazgo inspirador, coaching, retroalimentación frecuente e innovación en los enfoques de trabajo.
• Supervisar y optimizar la planificación, ejecución en campo y uso de recursos (segmentación, targeting, KPIs), promoviendo excelencia en interacción científica y persuasión consultiva.
• Identificar brechas de desempeño en los PJPs, diseñar planes correctivos, y garantizar reportes de calidad sobre interacciones e insights para apoyar el desarrollo estratégico.
• Coordinar el trabajo entre PJPs, squads, shaping roles y funciones habilitadoras, asegurando sinergias para maximizar el impacto y productividad con los recursos existentes. Tu perfil: La persona en esta posición práctica liderazgo de servicio y abarca el rol de visionario, arquitecto coach y catalizador según la situación lo requiera. Promueve un modelo de mentalidad de crecimiento y ser partidario de formas de trabajo ágiles y de experimentación, sin miedo a fracasar y celebrando los éxitos y los aprendizajes.
• Educación Universitaria completa.
• 5 años de experiencia como líder de equipos comerciales en la industria farmacéutica o relacionada, impulsando e implementando estrategias de acceso.
• Experiencia comprobada en la interacción profesional con stakeholders externos, incluyendo médicos, tomadores de decisión y otros actores clave del sector.
• Idioma Inglés avanzado oral y escrito. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position La Oportunidad
• Desarrolla la estrategia médica con propuestas de valor enfocadas en que el paciente correcto reciba el tratamiento correcto en el momento correcto.
• Genera un entendimiento profundo del ecosistema de la oncología con foco en Cáncer de Mama y medicina de precisión y ayuda a diseñar el camino para lograr que la medicina personalizada sea parte de la práctica clínica.
• Analiza e interpreta los datos relevantes médicos y científicos, así como la recolección de insights de diferentes fuentes incorporándolo a la estrategia médica con foco en nuestros clientes, ofreciendo a través de la educación médica, conocimiento profundo sobre el área de Cáncer de Mama.
• Lidera, desarrolla, co-crea e implementa estrategias de acceso temprano, mostrando el valor que tiene el portafolio para la identificación y tratamiento oportuno de las pacientes con Cáncer de Mama.
• En su rol de líder habilitador construye y fortalece una interacción sólida con sus stakeholders.
• Trabaja en estrecha colaboración con los Patient Journey Partners (PJPs) y Healthcare System Partners (HSPs) del área de oncología para identificar y anticipar las necesidades de los clientes (Health Care Professionals, pacientes y pagadores) para co-crear y desarrollar soluciones integradas junto con diferentes partes interesadas que brinden el máximo beneficio a los pacientes y estén alineadas con la visión estratégica y de resultados para la atención médica oportuna y personalizada.
• Aprovecha y maximiza el uso de los canales y herramientas digitales para brindar experiencias significativas al cliente que agreguen valor a los pacientes.
• Lidera el diseño e implementación de programas de soporte a pacientes alineado al plan médico a través de Programas de Diagnóstico y Monitoreo de la Enfermedad, apoyo a la administración de medicamentos y educación para el diagnóstico temprano y referencia de pacientes
• Trabajo en conjunto con el equipo de acceso y de política pública para navegar el proceso de reembolso de forma efectiva y ayuda a formar un ambiente favorable para la oncología.
• Responsable de la aprobación apropiada de materiales promocionales y no promocionales asegurando el cumplimiento de los requisitos locales y globales aplicables a oncología. Generación de Evidencia Local
• Trabajo en conjunto con el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes.
• Trabaja de forma colaborativa con operaciones clínicas en la identificación de potenciales estudios clínicos que puedan generar experiencia en nuestro país con nuestras moléculas. Medical Information
• Asegura de que la información médica y del producto se proporcione de acuerdo con los procedimientos operativos estándar, los requisitos locales y que todos los datos utilizados en la provisión de MI sean precisos y satisfagan las necesidades de los clientes internos y externos.
• Proporciona la información y los conocimientos necesarios en las respuestas relacionadas con el área de Cáncer de Mama cuando se requiera. Seguridad del Paciente y Calidad
• Convertirse en un embajador que promueva la seguridad de los pacientes, reportando de forma oportuna los EAs y fomentando a que el resto de los colegas internos y externos también lo realicen.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el área de calidad para asegurar altos estándares de nuestros productos (participación en r

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Estagiário(a) de Finanças e Propostas Comerciais você terá a oportunidade de criar impacto sendo essencial para o time, auxiliando na criação, revisão e envio das propostas comerciais da afiliada. Se você tem vontade de aprender e possui os requisitos necessários, junte-se a nós para aprimorar-se continuamente em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. A Oportunidade:
• Você elabora e acompanha as propostas comerciais para a equipe de Diagnóstica, oferecendo uma visão financeira estratégica para as demandas dos clientes.
• Você auxilia na revisão, no acompanhamento e no controle das propostas com os clientes, contribuindo ativamente para o cumprimento das cláusulas financeiras estabelecidas.
• Você gerencia stakeholders de diferentes áreas e realiza conexões com marketing, vendas e finanças para garantir a execução das estratégias comerciais da companhia.
• Você apoia o uso de ferramentas para o gerenciamento e acompanhamento contínuo dos indicadores gerenciais (KPIs).
• Você identifica oportunidades de melhoria nos processos diários e atua diretamente nas suas implementações.
• Você colabora com a equipe de pricing na execução, análise e definição das estratégias de precificação para produtos e serviços.
• Você suporta o time de finanças na preparação das análises de rentabilidade e de preços.
• Você prepara apresentações e mantém uma interface clara e contínua com a equipe de liderança. Quem você é:
• Você possui habilidade colaborativa, gosta de lidar com pessoas, tem comunicação clara e assertiva e se adapta facilmente a contextos de mudanças.
• Você demonstra agilidade no aprendizado, foco e organização nas atividades processuais, e proatividade para buscar melhorias.
• Você está cursando o Ensino Superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 2º ano de formação).
• Você possui forte habilidade analítica, facilidade com números e dados, e extrema atenção aos detalhes.
• Você tem conhecimento intermediário em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, etc.) e valoriza o trabalho em equipe em seu dia a dia. Diferenciais:
• Você tem conhecimento prático em ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, SQL, Python, R).
• Você possui nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado para interações corporativas. Benefícios de recolocação não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Con i suoi 1400 dipendenti, il centro di produzione Kaiseraugst (PTM) garantisce una cura continua dei pazienti con farmaci di alta qualità. PTM è il più alto standard di produzione farmaceutica, il più grande e innovativo centro di confezionamento di Roche e la fornitura di oltre 120 paesi. La possibilità L'esperto di processo GMP nel campo del riempimento sterile (Asset AFL) è responsabile del coordinamento delle attività per rispettare i requisiti GMP nella sua area intorno agli impianti, processi e prodotti fabbricati. Oltre a rispettare e attuare i requisiti GMP, la produzione senza problemi e stabile è un'altra priorità che si ottiene attraverso miglioramenti indipendenti e continui. Ciò richiede una buona conoscenza delle operazioni e dei sistemi, nonché ottime capacità organizzative per l'elaborazione dei progetti.
• Responsabilità di produzione e di processo: analisi basate sui dati degli indicatori di performance per aumentare l'efficienza, la garanzia della qualità e il monitoraggio dei processi nella produzione; supporto per lanci, trasferimenti e problemi di processo.
• Documentazione & Batch Management: Recensione di Batch Records, SAP Accounting Control e Gestione dei documenti GMP.
• Manufacturing Execution System (MES) : Creazione, sperimentazione e cura di ricette, regolamenti di produzione e record master batch.
• Gestione della qualità e della deviazione: deviazioni, reclami, cambiamenti e CAPA; Gestione delle cause di radice e analisi delle tendenze.
• Gestione dell'ispezione e gestione dei rischi di qualità (QRM) : Preparazione e monitoraggio delle verifiche/ispezione; Responsabilità per le analisi dei rischi e la loro moderazione.
• Formazione e sicurezza: organizzazione e implementazione della formazione; garantire la sicurezza e la protezione ambientale nel settore.
• Progetti & KPI: Supporto per progetti tecnici nell'ambiente GMP con relativa documentazione; revisione KPI, standardizzazione e utilizzo degli strumenti LPS, miglioramento dei processi.
• Esperienze professionali pluriennali nella produzione farmaceutica, nello sviluppo, nella garanzia della qualità e nel controllo o in un'industria vicina sono di grande vantaggio
• Molto buone capacità di comunicazione nella parola e nella scrittura in tedesco e in inglese
• Alto impegno per il lavoro e il datore di lavoro, apertura a nuove, resilienza e flessibilità nonché prestazioni costanti con mutevoli esigenze Ora applicare e diventare parte del nostro team per modellare il futuro insieme! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti Diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter offrire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

The Position With its 1400 employees, the Kaiseraugst (PTM) production centre ensures continuous patient care with high-quality drugs. PTM stands for the highest standards of pharmaceutical production, the largest, most innovative packaging centre of Roche and the supply of more than 120 countries. The possibility The GMP Process Expert in the field of sterile filling (Asset AFL) is responsible for coordinating the activities to comply with GMP requirements in the field of the systems, processes and manufactured products. In addition to adhering to and implementing GMP requirements, as trouble-free and stable production as possible is another priority which is achieved through independent and continuous improvements.This requires good knowledge of the operations and systems as well as very good organizational skills for project processing.

C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Avec ses 1400 employés, le centre de production Kaiseraugst (PTM) assure des soins continus aux patients avec des médicaments de haute qualité. PTM représente les plus hauts standards de production pharmaceutique, le plus grand centre d'emballages, le plus innovant de Roche et l'approvisionnement de plus de 120 pays. La possibilité Le GMP Process Expert dans le domaine du remplissage stérile (Asset AFL) est chargé de coordonner les activités pour se conformer aux exigences des BPF dans son domaine autour des usines, des procédés et des produits manufacturés. En plus de respecter et de mettre en œuvre les exigences des BPF, une production aussi stable et sans problèmes que possible est une autre priorité qui est atteinte par des améliorations indépendantes et continues. Cela exige une bonne connaissance des opérations et des systèmes ainsi que de très bonnes compétences organisationnelles pour le traitement des projets.
• Production et processus Responsabilité : Analyse basée sur les données des indicateurs de performance afin d'accroître l'efficacité, l'assurance de la qualité et le suivi des processus dans la production.
• Documentation et gestion par lots : examen par lots, contrôle comptable SAP et gestion des documents BPF.
• Système d'exécution de fabrication (MES) : Création, mise à l'essai et entretien des recettes, des règlements de fabrication et des dossiers de fabrication.
• Gestion de la qualité et des écarts : écarts, plaintes, changements et APC; analyse des causes profondes et analyse des tendances.
• Gestion de l'inspection et gestion des risques de qualité : préparation et suivi des audits/inspections; responsabilité des analyses de risques et de leur modération.
• Formation et sécurité: organisation et mise en œuvre de la formation; garantie de la sécurité et de la protection de l'environnement sur le terrain.
• Projets & ICR : Soutien aux projets techniques dans l'environnement des BPF avec documentation connexe ; examen, standardisation et utilisation des outils LPS, amélioration des processus. Qui vous êtes
• Études pharmaceutiques, scientifiques ou techniques terminées ou formation professionnelle équivalente
• Expérience professionnelle pluriannuelle dans la production pharmaceutique, le développement, l'assurance et le contrôle de la qualité ou dans une industrie proche sont d'avantage
• Très bonnes compétences en communication verbale et écrite en allemand et en anglais
• Engagement élevé en faveur de l'emploi et de l'employeur, ouverture à la nouveauté, résilience et flexibilité ainsi que performance constante avec des exigences changeantes Maintenant appliquez et devenez membre de notre équipe pour façonner l'avenir ensemble! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun un accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitieux au sommet, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Data & Insights Abilitazione - Lead Analyst (UI/UX) Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions Chennai / Hyderabad Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. Roche ha stabilito Global Analytics e Technology Center of Excellence (GATE) in India per guidare le soluzioni analitiche e tecnologiche, collaborando con gli affiliati Roche in tutto il mondo. Tutti i dipendenti di Roche dovrebbero contribuire efficacemente alla collaborazione e al coordinamento interfunzionali e rispettare tutte le leggi, regolamenti, politiche e procedure che governano il nostro business. In qualità di Data & Insights Enablement - Lead Analyst (UI/UX), lavorerai a stretto contatto con team di prodotti e altri stakeholder per progettare e migliorare dashboard e esperienze digitali. Il tuo ruolo si concentrerà sulla comprensione delle esigenze degli utenti, la modellazione delle funzionalità e i progetti di test per garantire che siano intuitivi, utili e forniscono un'esperienza utente fluida. This position is responsible for driving organic top line growth, leading new business development opportunities, and achieving efficient business performance in addition to demonstrating and instilling leadership values across team. This position partners with Roche Diagnostics colleagues nationally and to secure the long-term success of the business. Direct report to the Head Pathology Sales- India. Provides people direction and mentorship for team. Sets strategic vision and direction; develops and implements strategic plans and objectives for the function in alignment with RDIN strategy. • Establish Roche Digital Pathology & Sequencing leadership and business in India, through business development, Partnerships and building relationship with Key Opinion Leaders in field of Digital Pathology & Sequencing.
• Market development & conversion of prospects and opportunities, to help sales achieve targeted sales growth Strategic Planning
• Establish Roche DP experience curves in customer needs, competitive positioning, & business economics, commercial modelling & clinical evidence in India Solution Architecture
• Develop customer-specific strategies for Roche Digital pathology & Sequencing adoption; working closely with Histopathology laboratory/administrative leadership and pathology staff to develop and scope their Digital Pathology & Sequencing transformation.
• Provide subject matter expertise in pre and post sales capacity. Project Management & Implementation
• Establish new & effective operation approaches & interfaces within Roche functional groups (Sales/marketing, Service, Workflow) & external service provider for achieving desired Implementation.
• Work closely with sales team on presales engagements, drive turnkey solution package proposals, including workflow design (Histopathology & Sequencing set ups), and associated external requirement on network, IP, storage etc. Who You Are: You will have a successful and considerable proven track record in leading people, preferably acquired in the healthcare industry. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche in 50 Worten Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Beschreibung Abteilung/Team Der/Die Labormanager/in gewährleistet die Sicherheit, Einhaltung der Compliance und den reibungslosen Betrieb der zugeordneten Forschungs- und Entwicklungslabore. Diese Rolle dient als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen wissenschaftlichem Personal, Standortdiensten und externen Anbietern. Zu den Kernaufgaben gehört die Steuerung und Instandhaltung der Laborinfrastruktur, um sicherzustellen, dass dem wissenschaftlichen Personal alle erforderlichen Dienste zur Verfügung stehen. Zudem werden die Arbeitsprozesse und der Betrieb der zugewiesenen Laborbereiche überwacht und koordiniert, um die Einhaltung der Qualitätssysteme und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie ein ordnungsgemäßes Gerätemanagement zu garantieren. Die Rolle repräsentiert das Labormanagement-Team als Fachexpert:in für Labor- und Gerätefragen, baut professionelle Beziehungen zu funktionsübergreifenden Teams auf und fungiert als Kommunikationsschnittstelle für Labornutzer:innen, Management-Stakeholder und Auditor:innen. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten/Position
• Labororganisation & reibungslose Abläufe: Du übernimmst die Verwaltung und Überwachung der zugewiesenen R&D-Labore im Hinblick auf allgemeine Laborabläufe (z.B. Zugangskontrolle, Geräte, Reinigung und Wartung) und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Alltag.
• Sicherheit & Compliance: Du stellst die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen, behördlichen und SHE-relevanten Vorschriften sicher. Dabei setzt du unsere Laborstandards konsequent durch – inklusive bei Verstößen externen Nutzer:innen oder Besucher:innen den Zutritt zu verweigern oder verpflichtende Nachschulungen anzuordnen.
• Sicherheit & Gefahrstoffmanagement: Du stellst sicher, dass alle Gefahrstoffe in den Laboren nach den bestehenden Vorgaben ordnungsgemäß gekennzeichnet und gelagert werden.
• Equipment Management & Stakeholder-Kommunikation: Du fungierst als primäre Ansprechperson zwischen dem wissenschaftlichen Personal, dem internen Gerätemanagement und den Site Services. Du steuerst die Prozesse rund um Installation, Kalibrierung, Qualifizierung, Wartungen, Reparaturen, Umzügen und Außerbetriebnahmen von Neu- und Bestandsgeräten, um Ausfallzeiten in der Forschung auf ein absolutes Minimum zu reduzieren. Zudem stellst du sicher, dass die wissenschaftlichen Teams stets rechtzeitig über geplante Infrastrukturmaßnahmen (wie Stromausfälle oder Umbauarbeiten) informiert sind. Dazu leitest oder nimmst Du an regelmäßigen Labor-User Runden teil.
• Audit-Readiness & Repräsentation: Du stellst GxP-konforme Labordokumentation sicher und vertrittst die Labore souverän bei internen wie externen Audits und führst professionelle Laborrundgänge sowie Sicherheitseinweisungen für Besucher:innen durch.
• Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst und implementierst proaktiv Optimierungen von Prozessen im R&D-Labormanagement (z. B. bei Wartungsplänen oder der Freezer-Nutzung) und gießt diese Best Practices in nachhaltige Prozesse, Leitfäden und SOPs.
• Coaching & Wissensvermittlung: Du bist nicht nur operativ tätig, sondern gibst dein Wissen auch weiter, indem du andere LabManager:innen fachlich betreust, coachst und zielgruppengerechte Schulungen anbietest. Wer bist Du
• Background: Abgesch

Zudem stellst du sicher, dass die wissenschaftlichen Teams stets rechtzeitig über geplante Infrastrukturmaßnahmen (wie Stromausfälle oder Umbauarbeiten) informiert sind. Dazu leitest oder nimmst Du an regelmäßigen Labor-User Runden teil.
• Audit-Readiness & Repräsentation: Du stellst GxP-konforme Labordokumentation sicher und vertrittst die Labore souverän bei internen wie externen Audits und führst professionelle Laborrundgänge sowie Sicherheitseinweisungen für Besucher:innen durch.
• Prozessoptimierung: Du identifizierst und implementierst proaktiv Optimierungen von Prozessen im R&D-Labormanagement (z. B. bei Wartungsplänen oder der Freezer-Nutzung) und gießt diese Best Practices in nachhaltige Prozesse, Leitfäden und SOPs.
• Coaching & Wissensvermittlung: Du bist nicht nur operativ tätig, sondern gibst dein Wissen auch weiter, indem du andere LabManager:innen fachlich betreust, coachst und zielgruppengerechte Schulungen anbietest. Wer bist Du

title: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

titleByLocale.it: Security Ingegnere - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.en: Security Engineer - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management
titleByLocale.de: Security Ingenieur - RDT Vulnerability & Exposure Management

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a Security Engineer on the Vulnerability and Exposure Management Team, you will help protect sensitive data and defend computer systems and web applications from existing and emerging threats. You will not just be managing scanner output. You will help manage and reduce existing risks, assess and evaluate the weaponization of emerging risks, and act as a core builder of our future capabilities. The Opportunity As an integrated part of the Vulnerability and Exposure Management team, your main responsibilities include :
• Triage, investigate, and respond to critical vulnerabilities affecting Roche.
• Evaluate and prioritize vulnerabilities found through our tools, including our bug-bounty program.
• Research emerging vulnerabilities and develop methods to confirm exploitability against our attack surface.
• Communicate risk and work with system owners and other stakeholders to mitigate security vulnerabilities.
• Assess company systems and web applications using both automated and manual tools.
• Maintain, improve, and engineer our scanning, detection, and automation solutions.
• Participating in security monitoring for a global environment. Who you are
• You hold an Associate Degree in a relevant field or 5+ years of experience in the information security field .
• You possess a demonstrated ability to triage, analyze, and escalate security vulnerabilities.
• You have experience with attack surface management in a large and global environment.
• You bring programming experience (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript) combined with a familiarity with modern, AI-assisted code development and engineering workflows.
• You display a strong emphasis on web application, network, and computer security, along with experience validating vulnerabilities and basic exploit development.
• You have a track record of contributing to open-source security projects and writing custom detection logic/templates/scripts.
• You have hands-on cloud security experience and a genuine passion for the field of computer and network security.
• You exhibit strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex risks to non-technical audiences, balancing operational tasks with research projects.
• You are fluent in English. Preferred
• Industry certifications in the field of offensive security (e.g., OSCP, GWAPT, OSWE). Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Business Process Expert (m/f/d) - a tempo determinato

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Bereit, die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung aktiv mitzugestalten? Bei Roche verändern wir das Leben von Patient:innen jeden Tag aufs Neue. Für den Bereich Operations Near Patient Care – eine tragende Säule innerhalb der Global Diagnostic Operations – suchen wir ein kluges Köpfchen, das die Analyse, Stabilisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie den zugehörigen Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen unterstützt. Als funktionale Brücke zwischen Business und IT trägst Du maßgeblich dazu bei, produktionskritische Abläufe zu sichern. Werde Teil unserer Reise innerhalb der Digital Operations und sorge mit Deinem praktischen Wissen für ein starkes Fundament, auf dem nachhaltiges Wachstum entstehen kann. Dein neues Team: Unser Team innerhalb der Digital Operations im Bereich Operations Near Patient Care lebt von Vielfalt, gegenseitigem Vertrauen und einer engen, cross-funktionalen Zusammenarbeit. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team, das gemeinsam an zukunftsweisenden Lösungen feilt, Best Practices teilt und sich gegenseitig unterstützt. Hier erwartet Dich ein lebendiges Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Deine Stimme zählt und neue Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich
• Du unterstützt die Bereitstellung und Koordination des lösungsspezifischen Supports für zugewiesene Geschäfts- und Logistiksysteme.
• Du analysierst und behebst funktionale Störungen sowie Prozessunterbrechungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und der IT.
• Du bearbeitest funktionale System- und Prozessthemen im SAP ECC 6.0 Umfeld, insbesondere in den Bereichen Materialwirtschaft, Produktionsplanung, PP-PI und Fertigungssteuerung.
• Du unterstützt die Identifikation von wiederkehrenden Problemen oder Systemstörungen, um zu nachhaltigen Lösungen für produktionskritische Abläufe wie MES-Schnittstellen, Scan- oder Drucklösungen beizutragen.
• Du begleitest die Definition und Pflege von Standards für die unterstützten Systeme und Prozesse im Rahmen von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen.
• Du wirkst bei der Bewertung von Geschäftsanforderungen mit, unterstützt die Durchführung von funktionalen Tests sowie Regressionstests und stellst eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.
• Du erstellst und pflegst Schulungsunterlagen sowie Systemdokumentationen und führst Wissenstransfers für Key-User und Endanwendende durch. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, Supply Chain / Operations, der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Relevante Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre mit Bachelor bzw. 2–4 Jahre mit Master), idealerweise mit ersten Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit.
• Fundierte konzeptionelle und praktische Kenntnisse im Geschäftsprozessmanagement sowie im Bereich von Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen, idealerweise in einem ERP-Umfeld.
• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im SAP ECC 6.0 Support, insbesondere in den Modulen SAP MM, PP und PP-PI (wie Bestandsführung, Fertigungs- und Prozessaufträge oder Chargenmanagement).
• Praktisches Verständnis von Fertigungsumgebungen sowie der Unterstützung von Schnittstellen, MES-Prozessen, IDoc-Verarbeitung oder dem Output-Management.
• Strukturierte Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Kompetenz zur klaren Kommunikation zwischen technischen Teams und den Fachbereichen.

• Du wirkst bei der Bewertung von Geschäftsanforderungen mit, unterstützt die Durchführung von funktionalen Tests sowie Regressionstests und stellst eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation sicher.
• Du erstellst und pflegst Schulungsunterlagen sowie Systemdokumentationen und führst Wissenstransfers für Key-User und Endanwendende durch. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, Supply Chain / Operations, der Informatik, des Ingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Relevante Berufserfahrung (3–5 Jahre mit Bachelor bzw. 2–4 Jahre mit Master), idealerweise mit ersten Erfahrungen in der Projektarbeit.
• Fundierte konzeptionelle und praktische Kenntnisse im Geschäftsprozessmanagement sowie im Bereich von Geschäfts- und Logistiksystemen, idealerweise in einem ERP-Umfeld.
• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) im SAP ECC 6.0 Support, insbesondere in den Modulen SAP MM, PP und PP-PI (wie Bestandsführung, Fertigungs- und Prozessaufträge oder Chargenmanagement).
• Praktisches Verständnis von Fertigungsumgebungen sowie der Unterstützung von Schnittstellen, MES-Prozessen, IDoc-Verarbeitung oder dem Output-Management.
• Strukturierte Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung sowie die Kompetenz zur klaren Kommunikation zwischen technischen Teams und den Fachbereichen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Head of Operations, APAC Hub A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Head of Operations APAC HUB to lead and oversee our outsourced Global Distribution HUB based in Singapore, serving the Asia Pacific region. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, driving continuous performance improvement, and strengthening relationships with third-party logistics and distribution partners. The ideal candidate brings deep operational expertise, strong leadership capabilities, and a collaborative mindset to manage complex supply chain dynamics in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. The Opportunity
• Strategic & Operational Leadership: Oversee and align end-to-end operations of the APAC Distribution HUB with corporate and regional strategies, contributing to the development and execution of long-term distribution plans.
• Performance & Compliance Management: Define, track, and optimize key performance indicators (KPIs) and service levels, while ensuring full compliance with global trade regulations, regional customs requirements, and contractual agreements with 3PL partners.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with a wide range of internal teams and external partners to streamline processes, enhance customer satisfaction, and manage governance frameworks.
• Financial & Inventory Oversight: Manage a significant annual operating budget (SGD 25M) and an extensive inventory stock (~SGD 200M), balancing cost-effectiveness with service excellence and ensuring accuracy and availability across the region.
• Team Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team of more than 3 direct reports, fostering a culture of accountability and building future leadership pipelines.
• Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation: Champion the adoption of digital tools, automation, and analytics to drive operational visibility, predictive planning, and continuous process improvements.
• Risk Management & Business Continuity: Identify and mitigate operational risks through robust business continuity planning and crisis response strategies.
• Values & Sustainability Champion: Promote a safe, efficient, and inclusive work environment, championing sustainable practices aligned with Roche’s values and ESG goals. Who you are
• You should possess a minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in operations or supply chain management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a regional or global distribution environment. A Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field is required, while a Master’s degree (e.g., MBA or relevant technical specialization) is preferred.
• Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams while leveraging advanced analytical skills to drive data-driven decisions and contribute to long-term distribution strategies.
• Operational & Financial Oversight: Demonstrated success in managing complex outsourced operations and third-party logistics (3PL) providers, with a strong focus on optimizing financial performance, service levels, and inventor

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Als Biostatistiker (m/w/d) in unserem Team bist du der analytische Motor hinter der nächsten Generation medizinischer Diagnostik. In einem multidisziplinären Umfeld schaffst du die statistische Evidenz, die für weltweite Zulassungen lebensrettender Tests entscheidend ist. Unser Team an den Standorten Penzberg, Mannheim und Indianapolis lebt eine moderne, hybride Arbeitskultur und arbeitet regionen- und indikationenübergreifend in den Kundensegmenten Core Lab und Near Patient Care. Das erwartet Dich in der Rolle
• Verantwortung für die Planung und Durchführung statistischer Analysen für komplexe klinische Studien, damit unsere innovativen Diagnostiklösungen weltweit die Zulassungshürden nehmen und zeitnah beim Patienten ankommen.
• Du beherrscht ein breites Repertoir statistischer Standardmethoden und bist in der Lage, dich schnell in komplexe Verfahren einzuarbeiten.
• Professionelle Programmierung statistischer Analysen (primär in R) sowie Ursachenanalyse bei komplexen Fragestellungen während der Studiendurchführung.
• Du agierst als „Statistical Translator“ durch die adressatengerechte Präsentation von Ergebnissen für unsere Partner aus Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations sowie bei Behörden.
• Fachliche Anleitung und Mentoring von Teammitgliedern sowie Studierenden zur Förderung des internen Wissensaustauschs.
• Du wirkst aktiv an internen „Communities of Practice“ mit, um beispielsweise methodische und programmiertechnische Standards kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Wer du bist
• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium oder Promotion in Statistik, Biostatistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren quantitativen Fach.
• Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung (Master 5–7 Jahre / Promotion 3–5 Jahre), idealerweise im Bereich klinischer Zulassungsstudien.
• Du hast fundierte Programmierkenntnisse, idealerweise in R, sowie Erfahrung im Management großer Datensätze.
• Sicherer Umgang mit modernen statistischen Modellierungstechniken und deren Anwendung in einem regulierten Umfeld.
• Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, um komplexe statistische Theorien und Ergebnisse gegenüber fachfremden Stakeholdern souverän zu vertreten.
• Selbstständige und pro-aktive Arbeitsweise, analytisches Denkvermögen und ein ausgeprägtes Team-Mindset. Diese Position ist auf zwei Jahre befristet. Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Idealerweise auch Zeugnisse und ein Motivationsschreiben Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt. Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können. Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens 12.06.2026. (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global imp

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Lo sviluppo tecnico di Pharma porta terapie che cambiano il gioco dalla fase clinica I al mercato per servire ogni paziente, ogni giorno. Il nostro core business è quello di sviluppare farmaci sicuri, innovativi ed efficaci utilizzando tecnologie all'avanguardia per il processo di produzione (Drug Substance and Drug Product), fornitura clinica, formulazione, dispositivo, imballaggio e sviluppo analitico. Il nostro lavoro quotidiano comprende anche la compilazione di documenti normativi e il trasferimento di progetti di sviluppo alla produzione commerciale. Mansioni - Analisi di routine dei campioni di rilascio e stabilità in diversi progetti e caratterizzazione funzionale estesa. - A seguito di un flusso di lavoro conforme a GMP nel nostro paesaggio analitico all'interno dello sviluppo tecnico (CMC). - Sviluppo, miglioramento e convalida dei metodi analitici per la valutazione della qualità delle sostanze attive - Supportare le interfacce per la ricerca e lo sviluppo precoce e per l'organizzazione QC commercializzata.
• Requisiti - Tecnico di laboratorio con Apprenticeship (si prega di notare: questo ruolo è su misura per le qualifiche professionali; Master o PhD gradi sono al di fuori della portata di questa posizione) con almeno 5 anni di esperienza in un ambiente industriale che lavora su bioassay, idealmente in un'organizzazione QC e lavorare secondo GMP. - Esperienza pratica nelle metodologie immunologiche rilevanti come ELISA, saggi di gene reporter, saggi di proliferazione, saggi di uccisione cellulare e cultura cellulare. - Auto-organizzante modo di lavorare e la capacità di interagire e cooperare tra organizzazioni di matrice e dipartimenti/funzioni. - Buone competenze in lingua inglese e tedesca. Durata e nota Questa posizione è fissa per 2 anni. Cosa? Eccitato a plasmare il futuro con noi? Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Contatto Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.

The Position Pharma Technical Development brings game-changing therapies from clinical phase I into the market to serve every patient, every day. Our core business is to develop safe, innovative and effective drugs using cutting edge technologies for manufacturing process (Drug Substance and Drug Product), clinical supply, formulation, device, packaging, and analytical development. Our daily work also includes compiling of regulatory documents and the transfer of development projects to commercial manufacturing. The Opportunity:
• Routine analysis of release and stability samples across several projects as well as extended functional characterization.
• Following a GMP compliant workflow in our analytical landscape within technical development (CMC).
• Development, improvement and validation of analytical methods for the quality assessment of active substances
• Supporting the interfaces to early research and development as well as to marketed QC organization. Who You Are:
• Lab technician with Apprenticeship (please note: this role is tailored for vocational qualifications; Master’s or PhD degrees are outside the scope of this position) with at least 5 years of experience in an industrial setting working on bioassays, ideally in a QC organization and working according to GMP.
• Hands-on experience in relevant immunological methodologies like ELISA, reporter gene assays, proliferation assays, cell killing assays and cell culture.
• Self-organizing way of working and the ability to interact and cooperate across matrix organizations and departments/functions.
• Good written and spoken English and German language skills. This position is fixed term for 2 years. Excited to shape the future with us? We look forward to receiving your application! Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. La Posizione Pharma Technical Development bringt spielerische Therapien aus der klinischen Phase I in den Markt, um jeden Patienten jeden Tag zu bedienen. Unser Kerngeschäft ist die Entwicklung sicherer, innovativer und effektiver Medikamente mit modernsten Technologien zur Herstellung von Prozessen (Drug Substance and Drug Product), klinischer Versorgung, Formulierung, Gerät, Verpackung und analytischer Entwicklung. Unsere tägliche Arbeit umfasst auch die Erstellung von regulatorischen Dokumenten und die Übertragung von Entwicklungsprojekten auf die gewerbliche Fertigung. Mansion - Routineanalyse von Release- und Stabilitätsproben über mehrere Projekte sowie erweiterte Funktionscharakterisierung. - Nach einem GMP-konformen Workflow in unserer analytischen Landschaft in der technischen Entwicklung (CMC). - Entwicklung, Verbesserung und Validierung analytischer Methoden zur Qualitätsbewertung von Wirkstoffen - Unterstützung der Schnittstellen zur frühen Forschung und Entwicklung sowie zur vermarkteten QC-Organisation. Voraussetzungen - Labtechniker mit Lehramt (bitte beachten: diese Rolle ist auf berufliche Qualifikationen zugeschnitten; Master- oder PhD-Abschlüsse sind außerhalb des Rahmens dieser Position) mit mindestens 5 Jahren Erfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld, das an Bioassays arbeitet, ideal in einer QC-Organisation und arbeiten nach GMP. - Hands-on Erfahrung in relevanten immunologischen Methoden wie ELISA, Reporter-Gen-Assays, Proliferations-Assays, Zell-Tötungs-Assays und Zellkultur. - Selbstorganisierende Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, über Matrixorganisationen und Abteilungen/Funktionen zu interagieren und zu kooperieren. - Gut geschrieben und gesprochen Englisch und Deutsch Sprachkenntnisse. Durata e Note Diese Position ist für 2 Jahre befristet.

Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Contattoo Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche Diagnostics, we are redefining how we connect with customers globally. We are seeking a Solution Architect - Content Supply Chain & Web Experience to lead the technical evolution of our next-generation ecosystem. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping modular, cloud-native, and AI-enabled customer engagement capabilities across global and local markets. You will work within a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment alongside product leads, engineers, and strategic partners to translate business capabilities into future-state architecture. Your Responsibilities
• Shape Architecture Strategy: Define and maintain the target architecture, integration patterns, and technical guardrails for our Content Supply Chain and Web Experience capabilities.
• Design Scalable Solutions: Create reusable, secure, and compliant end-to-end architectures spanning content planning, creation, storage, activation, and real-time personalization.
• Lead Ecosystem Integration: Direct technical architecture across premiere platforms, including Adobe Experience Cloud (Sites, Assets, Workfront, GenStudio), Veeva Vault PromoMats, and advanced Customer Data Platforms (CDPs).
• Govern Technical Quality: Drive robust non-functional requirements including scalability, performance, security, and global compliance standards (such as GDPR).
• Collaborate and Guide: Partner closely with Technical Product Owners and engineering teams to validate technical designs, manage architectural dependencies, and ensure sustainable deliveries.
• Foster Innovation: Evaluate emerging technologies, championing proof-of-concepts in AI-enabled content operations, dynamic content assembly, and enterprise content intelligence. Who You Are
• You are a forward-thinking technical leader who thrives on turning complex digital ecosystem challenges into simplified, high-performing platform realities.
• You excel at bridging the gap between business vision and deep technical engineering, utilizing your exceptional stakeholder management skills to influence distributed global teams.
• Extensive Architecture Experience: 8+ years of proven success in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or complex digital platform engineering.
• Ecosystem Mastery: Demonstrated experience designing, integrating, and scaling enterprise web content management, digital asset management (DAM), and dynamic personalization technologies.
• Modern Engineering Mindset: Strong, practical understanding of cloud-native architectures, API-first delivery, integration patterns, and composable platform ecosystems.
• Technical Governance & Compliance: Robust knowledge of navigating non-functional requirements like web security, accessibility, performance optimization, and international data privacy regulations.
• Academic Foundation: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
• Nice-to-have highlights: Experience in regulated environments (such as life sciences or healthcare) or direct technical familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud and Veeva Vault platforms is highly valued. At Roche, we embrace emerging innovations, like AI, to enhance the patient journey. If you’re passionate about new technology and thinking ahead, we want you to join us! Job Responsibilities
