Develops, implements, and champions scope management strategies, frameworks, and best practices for relevant initiatives. Oversees the management of significant scope changes, ensuring strategic alignment and minimal disruption, while proactively identifying and driving improvements to scope-related processes for enhanced delivery efficiency.
• Stakeholder Management: Identifies key stakeholders, including senior management, across organizational boundaries and analyzes complex stakeholder networks. Develops and executes comprehensive stakeholder engagement and communication plans. Influences stakeholder decisions related to delivery, navigates conflicts to achieve alignment, and builds strong collaborative relationships across the organization.
• Impact/Strategy: Provides consistent leadership and significant impact across major products within a product line or domain. Drives significant impact on projects and programs by embedding Agile best practices and leading organizational change initiatives. Leads the evaluation of strategic solution options, fosters a culture of innovation, and proactively proposes improvements to help implement strategic objectives.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Manages complex projects or services, potentially across domains, and leads delivery within a program or large initiative. Manages highly complex delivery involving multiple dependencies, opportunities, and risks. Handles ambiguous delivery requirements and leads the implementation of delivery frameworks while navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.
• Strategic Facilitation: Acts as an essential catalyst between business stakeholders, Product Owners, and technical implementation teams. Facilitates alignment across cross-functional squads to ensure digital capabilities are delivered efficiently and translate into measurable business value.

• GxP Compliance & Quality Governance: Partners with the team to ensure Agile processes, definition of done (DoD), and delivery lifecycles inherently adhere to strict global regu

The Position Data Engineer Experience - 4 to 8 years Location- Pune Job description The Senior IT Data Engineer is responsible for leading, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and robust data pipelines and infrastructure. This role involves independently building ETL/ELT processes, optimizing data storage solutions (such as data warehouses and data lakes), ensuring data quality and reliability, and monitoring data systems. You will collaborate closely with data scientists and analysts to meet their specific data requirements, utilizing strong programming skills in Tableau, Snowflake, Talend, Python or Scala, expert SQL knowledge, and proficiency in big data technologies like Spark. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with experience working within Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, or Pharmacovigilance / Safety team with a solid understanding on the E2E process flow across R&D. Additionally, a proven track record of navigating the stringent requirements of GxP environments (GCP, GMP, GVP) and managing complex, cross-functional data workflows is highly desirable. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• End-to-End Pipeline Delivery: Independently leads the design, build, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines, managing specific data engineering projects autonomously from inception to deployment.
• Performance Optimization & Problem Solving: Solves complex data ingestion and processing challenges, actively optimizing data flows to enhance overall system performance and reliability.
• Stakeholder Alignment & Integration: Partners directly with business units and data scientists to understand data requirements, effectively bridging technical execution with non-technical business needs.
• Strategic Infrastructure Impact: Owns large-scale data engineering initiatives, implementing robust strategies that significantly modernize and strengthen the organization’s data infrastructure.
• Complex Data Integration: Manages large, intricate data ecosystems by seamlessly integrating multiple diverse data sources to ensure efficient, secure cross-platform data flows. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Large-Scale Data Systems Management: Demonstrated experience owning major data engineering initiatives and managing complex, high-volume enterprise data systems.
• Autonomous ETL/ELT Pipeline Development: Proven track record of independently architecting, building, and maintaining automated ETL/ELT data ingestion and transformation processes.
• Storage Solution Optimization: Hands-on experience designing and optimizing modern data storage environments, including data warehouses and data lakes, for peak performance and cost efficiency.
• Data Quality & Reliability Assurance: Expert capability in implementing rigorous data quality checks, data cleansing rules, and reconciliation frameworks across all pipelines.
• System Monitoring & Observability: Strong experience building robust monitoring, alerting, and logging systems to ensure continuous high availability and minimal downtime of data workflows.
• Technical Skills
• Programming & ETL/ELT Mastery: Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, and Scala combined with expert use of tools like Talend to build, ingest, and process complex structured and unstructured data streams.
• Cloud & Big Data Architecture: Deep expertise leveraging distributed computing frameworks (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud-native data platforms ( Snowflake) to manage

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Pharmaceuticals The Mission
• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.
• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche Hong Kong and Macau. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
• The PJP will deliver better outcomes for patients, better community value and better commercial results, the latter being the consequence of the first two. Committing to improving better care outcomes for patients is good business.
• This role is locally embedded in the Hong Kong ecosystem, it is an integrated role, primary point of contact, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example, in the network way of working. This is where solutions are sourced from the internal and external network first, to avoid duplications, and to achieve better patient outcomes faster.
• All Roche Hong Kong & Macau employees are to lead by example in accelerating the digital maturity of Roche internally and in the external healthcare environment, aligned with the long term Roche vision of Personalized Health Care. Major Accountabilities
• All Roche employees are expected to effectively contribute to cross-functional collaboration and coordination and comply with all laws, regulations, policies & procedures that govern our business.
• This position profile serves only to give a broad outline of the duties required and will be renewed and amended at periodic intervals in the consultation with the incumbent.
• The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
• With regards to the ecosystems of Hong Kong and Macau, the PJP will continue to evolve the collaboration within the ecosystem of HA clusters, public and private partnerships and the smooth rolling out of healthcare system changes in which the HSPs will be shaping. Details:
• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with both Hong Kong and Macau partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Partners with patient

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il Titolare del Prodotto Tecnico possiede la consegna end-to-end di un modulo prodotto specifico o una fetta di capacità definita traducendo le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili, conformi e utilizzabili. Operando all'interno della roadmap strategica fissata dal Team Lead, si fungerà da ponte principale tra il business Product Owner e i team di consegna tecnica. In questo ruolo, si lavorerà profondamente incorporato con team di ingegneria e fornitori esterni per garantire l'esecuzione tecnica di alta qualità. Le tue responsabilità
• Possedere e privilegiare il backlog del prodotto allineato alle priorità aziendali
• Tradurre le esigenze aziendali in chiare storie utente e requisiti tecnici
• Definire i criteri di accettazione e garantire la definizione di Ready / Done
• Guidare pianificazione, perfezionamento e risultati di consegna
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di prodotti aziendali per tradurre i requisiti in soluzioni implementabili
• Assicurare la tracciabilità tra i requisiti aziendali e la consegna tecnica
• Verificare i requisiti per i team di ingegneria, dati e fornitori
• Accettare o rifiutare le funzionalità fornite in base ai criteri di accettazione
• Assicurare soluzioni scalabili, sicure e conformi (ad esempio GxP, GDPR)
• Identificare e gestire dipendenze, rischi e trade-off
• Test di supporto, release e prontezza di produzione
• Agire come interfaccia giorno per giorno per team di ingegneria e fornitori
• Esecuzione di unità tra team interni e partner esterni
• Rimuovere i bloccanti e garantire il flusso di consegna continuo
• Partner con Solution Architects per garantire soluzioni possibili e allineate
• Contribuire a requisiti non funzionali (performance, scalabilità, integrazione)
• Assicurare l'adesione agli standard di architettura e alle protezioni Chi sei
• Hai una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria o campo relativo
• Hai costruito un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza lavorativa come proprietario di prodotto tecnico, gestione del prodotto, o simili, in ambienti GxP
• Lei è esperto di lavorare secondo le metodologie Agile (quadro agile crum/scaled )
• Hai costruito esperienza nella fornitura di piattaforme digitali aziendali (CRM, Marketing Technology , Web, dati, ecc), e l'esperienza con le tecnologie Web e cloud.
• Hai costruito esperienza lavorando con team di ingegneria e fornitori esterni, e sperimentato con requisiti di ingegneria e gestione backlog
• Sei in grado di tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni tecniche, e avere una profonda comprensione dei concetti di architettura software e trade-off
• Porti competenze di gestione e comunicazione avanzate degli stakeholder
• Sei analitico, strutturato e dotato di una mentalità orientata alla consegna Compensazioni e vantaggi L'intervallo di stipendio previsto per questa posizione, in base alla posizione principale del Grafit di Varsavia è 228,900.00 PLN-425,100.00 PLN. La compensazione finale sarà determinata da un certo numero di fattori, tra cui le vostre competenze, esperienza, qualifiche e posizione. Oltre alla retribuzione base, questo ruolo può essere idoneo per un bonus annuale discrezionale con un target del 20% soggetto sia alle prestazioni individuali che aziendali. Questa posizione offre anche un pacchetto di benefici interessanti. Scopri di più su come premiamo i nostri dipendenti a Roche. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando la nostra diagnostica

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Technical Product Owner owns the end-to-end delivery of a specific product module or defined capability slice by translating business needs into scalable, compliant, and usable technical solutions. Operating within the strategic roadmap set by the Team Lead, you will act as the primary bridge between the business Product Owner and technical delivery teams. In this role, you will work deeply embedded with engineering teams and external vendors to ensure high-quality technical execution. Your Responsibilities
• Own and prioritize the product backlog aligned to business priorities
• Translate business needs into clear user stories and technical requirements
• Define acceptance criteria and ensure Definition of Ready / Done
• Drive sprint planning, refinement, and delivery outcomes
• Partner closely with business Product Owners to translate requirements into implementable solutions
• Ensure traceability between business requirements and technical delivery
• Clarify requirements for engineering, data, and vendor teams
• Accept or reject delivered features based on acceptance criteria
• Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant (e.g. GxP, GDPR)
• Identify and manage dependencies, risks, and trade-offs
• Support testing, releases, and production readiness
• Act as the day-to-day interface for engineering teams and vendors
• Drive execution across internal teams and external partners
• Remove blockers and ensure continuous delivery flow
• Partner with Solution Architects to ensure feasible and aligned solutions
• Contribute to non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, integration)
• Ensure adherence to architecture standards and guardrails Who You Are
• You hold a BSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
• You built a minimum of 5 years of work experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Management, or similar, in GxP environments
• You are experienced working according to Agile methodologies (scrum / scaled agile framework )
• You built experience in delivering enterprise digital platforms (CRM, Marketing Technology , Web, data, etc.), and experience with Web and cloud technologies

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Der Technische Produktbesitzer besitzt die End-to-End-Lieferung eines bestimmten Produktmoduls oder einer definierten Leistungsscheibe, indem er die Geschäftsanforderungen in skalierbare, konforme und nutzbare technische Lösungen überträgt. In der vom Team Lead gesetzten strategischen Roadmap fungieren Sie als primäre Brücke zwischen dem Business Product Owner und technischen Lieferteams. In dieser Rolle werden Sie mit Ingenieurteams und externen Anbietern tief eingebunden arbeiten, um eine qualitativ hochwertige technische Ausführung zu gewährleisten. Ihre Aufgaben
• Eigenes und prioritäres Produkt-Backlog, das auf Unternehmensprioritäten ausgerichtet ist
• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in klare Benutzergeschichten und technische Anforderungen
• Annahmekriterien definieren und die Definition von Ready / Done sicherstellen
• Antriebssprintplanung, Verfeinerung und Lieferergebnisse
• Partner eng mit Business Product Ownern zusammen, um Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen umzusetzen
• Gewährleistung der Rückverfolgbarkeit zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und technischer Lieferung
• Anforderungen an Ingenieur-, Daten- und Herstellerteams klären
• Angenommene oder zurückgewiesene Merkmale basierend auf Annahmekriterien
• Gewährleistungslösungen sind skalierbar, sicher und konform (z.B. GxP, DSGVO)
• Ermittlung und Verwaltung von Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Abschlüssen
• Unterstützung von Tests, Releases und Produktionsbereitschaft
• Act als Tages-zu-Tag-Schnittstelle für Ingenieurteams und Anbieter
• Fahren Sie die Ausführung über interne Teams und externe Partner
• Blocker entfernen und den kontinuierlichen Förderstrom gewährleisten
• Partner mit Solution Architects, um mögliche und ausgerichtete Lösungen zu gewährleisten
• Nicht-funktionale Anforderungen (Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Integration)
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Architekturstandards und Schutzschienen Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen BSc-Abschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten Bereich
• Sie haben mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Technischer Produktbesitzer, Produktmanagement oder ähnliches in GxP-Umgebungen aufgebaut
• Sie erfahren die Arbeit nach Agile Methoden (Kreuz / skaliert agile Rahmen )
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung von digitalen Plattformen für Unternehmen (CRM, Marketing Technology, Web, Daten usw.) und Erfahrung mit Web- und Cloud-Technologien aufgebaut
• Sie haben Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieurteams und externen Anbietern aufgebaut und mit Anforderungen Engineering & Backlog Management erfahren
• Sie sind in der Lage, Geschäftsanforderungen in technische Lösungen zu übersetzen, und haben tiefes Verständnis von Software-Architektur-Konzepten und Trade-offs
• Sie bringen fortgeschrittene Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Sie sind analytisch, strukturiert und haben eine lieferungsorientierte Denkweise Vergütung & Leistungen Der erwartete Gehaltsbereich für diese Position, basierend auf dem primären Standort von Warschau Grafit ist 228,900.00 PLN-425,100.00 PLN. Die endgültige Entschädigung wird durch eine Reihe von Faktoren bestimmt, einschließlich Ihrer Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung, Qualifikationen und Standort. Zusätzlich zu den Basiszahlungen kann diese Rolle für einen diskontinuierlichen Jahresbonus mit einem Ziel von 20%, das sowohl der individuellen als auch der Unternehmensleistung unterliegt, in Betracht kommen. Diese Position bietet auch ein attraktives Leistungspaket . Erfahren Sie mehr darüber, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter bei Roche belohnen. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le propriétaire du produit technique possède la livraison de bout en bout d'un module de produit spécifique ou d'une tranche de capacité définie en traduisant les besoins commerciaux en solutions techniques évolutives, conformes et utilisables. Fonctionnant dans le cadre de la feuille de route stratégique établie par le chef d'équipe, vous jouerez le rôle de pont principal entre le propriétaire de produit d'entreprise et les équipes de livraison technique. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en profondeur avec des équipes d'ingénierie et des fournisseurs externes pour assurer une exécution technique de haute qualité. Vos responsabilités
• Autoriser et hiérarchiser l'arriéré de produits en fonction des priorités des entreprises
• Traduire les besoins des entreprises en histoires d'utilisateurs claires et exigences techniques
• Définir les critères d'acceptation et assurer la définition de prêt / fait
• Diriger la planification du sprint, le raffinement et les résultats de livraison
• S'associer étroitement avec les propriétaires de produits pour traduire les exigences en solutions implémentables
• Assurer la traçabilité entre les exigences opérationnelles et la livraison technique
• Clarifier les exigences en matière d'ingénierie, de données et de fournisseurs
• Accepter ou rejeter les caractéristiques livrées en fonction des critères d'acceptation
• Veiller à ce que les solutions soient évolutives, sûres et conformes (p. ex. GxP, RGPD)
• Identifier et gérer les dépendances, les risques et les compromis
• Soutenir les essais, les rejets et la préparation à la production
• Agir comme interface quotidienne pour les équipes d'ingénieurs et les fournisseurs
• Diriger l'exécution entre équipes internes et partenaires externes
• Enlever les bloqueurs et assurer un débit de livraison continu
• Partenaire avec Solutions Architectes pour assurer des solutions réalisables et alignées
• Contribuer aux exigences non fonctionnelles (performance, évolutivité, intégration)
• Assurer le respect des normes d'architecture et des garde-corps Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe
• Vous avez construit un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience de travail en tant que propriétaire de produit technique, gestion de produit, ou similaire, dans des environnements GxP
• Vous êtes expérimenté à travailler selon les méthodologies Agile (scrum / framework agile à échelle)
• Vous avez acquis une expérience dans la fourniture de plateformes numériques d'entreprise (CRM, Marketing Technology, Web, données, etc.), et une expérience avec les technologies Web et cloud
• Vous avez acquis de l'expérience en travaillant avec des équipes d'ingénierie et des fournisseurs externes, et vous avez acquis de l'expérience en ingénierie des exigences et en gestion de l'arriéré
• Vous êtes en mesure de traduire les besoins commerciaux en solutions techniques, et avez une compréhension approfondie des concepts d'architecture logicielle et des compromis
• Vous apportez des compétences avancées en gestion des parties prenantes et en communication
• Vous êtes analytique, structuré, et avez un état d'esprit axé sur la livraison Rémunération et avantages sociaux L'échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste, basée sur l'emplacement principal de Varsovie Grafit est 228,00 PLN-425,100.00 PLN. La rémunération finale sera déterminée par un certain nombre de facteurs, y compris vos compétences, votre expérience, vos qualifications et votre emplacement. En plus de la rémunération de base, ce rôle peut être admissible à une prime annuelle discrétionnaire dont l'objectif est de 20 %, sous réserve du rendement individuel et de celui de l'entreprise. Cette position offre également un ensemble attrayant d'avantages . Découvrez comment nous récompensons nos employés à Roche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests effectués avec notre diagnostic

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 您是谁 您负责管理内外部资源，服务客户，传递产品科学信息，收集需求和反馈，最终提高患者获益。 您的机会: A 规范诊疗
• 基于公司相关产品策略，介绍罗氏产品的关键信息，使医生及专家认知并了解罗氏的产品知识
• 基于公司疾病领域相关策略，传递相应疾病领域产品相关医学信息，促进医生制定规范治疗方案运用专业知识，助力生态圈内诊断准确度的提升 B 学科建设
• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范 C 疾病全程管理
• 支持协助患者解决方案经理，关注疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化 我们期待这样的您加入: •3年以上医药行业工作经验 •既往有销售/市场/医学经验 •跨职能工作经验为佳 教育程度/所获资格证书 •医学或药学相关本科及以上学历 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position As an Expert within the Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team, you move beyond "checking boxes" to become a strategic partner for global Engineering hubs. You will lead high-impact security and privacy risk assessments, ensuring Roche’s most ambitious digital projects—from GenAI to cloud-native platforms—are resilient, "Secure by Design," and compliant with global regulations. The Team The Information Security & Privacy Advisory (ISPA) team serves as the strategic bridge between IT, business, and legal functions at Roche. Our mission is to ensure that Roche’s digital landscape—from cutting-edge GenAI platforms to global enterprise solutions—is secure by design and compliant with international standards. We act as a global center of excellence that translates complex regulatory requirements into actionable security architecture, providing the expert guidance necessary to navigate a rapidly evolving global risk landscape. Key Responsibilities
• High-Risk Advisory: Lead Security Expert Reviews (SER) for complex architectures, performing deep-dive technical and privacy evaluations to identify and mitigate residual risks.
• Privacy: Bridge the gap between IT, Legal, and Data Protection Officers. Translate complex legal mandates (GDPR, CCPA etc.) into actionable technical and organizational controls.
• Information Security: Contribute to Security Design Patterns and Technical Baselines for emerging technologies like Generative AI and Cloud-native ecosystems.
• Risk Governance: Utilize ServiceNow IRM to ensure the integrity and traceability of security advisory, delivering data-driven, consistent, and audit-ready results.
• Peer Excellence: Foster a "Four-Eye" quality culture through peer reviews and collective knowledge exchange within a global team of experts. Who You Are Our Ideal Mindset: A proactive Expert & Influencer who brings deep industry experience to an established team. You have the confidence to lead initiatives independently while thriving in an environment of collective knowledge exchange. Qualifications:
• Experience: 5–10 years in Information Security/GRC, with a proven track record in Information Risk Assessments and DPIAs in complex, global environments.
• Technical Savvy: Deep understanding of Security Architecture and the ability to translate "Legal-speak" into "Engineering-speak."
• Regulatory Mastery: Expert knowledge of international privacy frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, etc.) and security standards (ISO 27001, NIST).
• System Proficiency: Experienced in using ServiceNow IRM to execute and document risk assessments, utilizing the platform to ensure consistent, high-quality, and transparent security guidance.
• Education: Degree in Computer Science or Legal. Certifications like CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/E, CIPM or ISO27001 Lead Auditor are highly valued.

Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Il Contesto Controllo qualità (QC) Basilea/Kaiseraugst consisteva in circa 350 dipendenti, organizzati in 7 dipartimenti con strutture subordinati. Rappresenta un punto chiave centrale per la produzione di medicinali di alta qualità. BS/KAU è responsabile dei test di qualità analitica di un ampio portafoglio di prodotti, che spazia da sostanze farmaceutiche e prodotti finiti a dispositivi medici, materiali sfusi, beni finitoti, materiali diretti e materiali di confezionamento. Scienza e tecnologia analitica (ASAT), come sezione specializzata all'interno di questa struttura, è responsabile dell'implementazione strategica di metodi di test moderni e tecnologie innovative nel sito Quality Control (QC) di Basel/Kaiseraugst. Agiamo come un hub centrale di competenza, non solondo metodi a livello locale ma trasferendoli attivamente anche ad altri siti. Gestendo l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto su base end-to-end (E2E), forniamo standardizzazione globale e guida tecnica. Questo garantisce il nostro "Right to Operate", la conformità costante e i più alti standard di qualità in tutta la rete Roche. L’Opportunità Mansioni - Guidare e coordinare progetti in stretta collaborazione con finali multifunzionali come Sviluppo Farmaceutico, Operazioni di Produzione e QC Commerciale - Promuovere l’agilità della rete partecipando attivamente a team di progetto globali per favorire la standardizzazione in tutta la rete Roche - Guidare l’implementazione di tecnologie, fungendo da punto di contatto principale per partner interni ed esterni riguardo a nuove tecnologie analitiche - Fornire supporto strategico agli obiettivi ASAT gestendo specifici incarichi tecnici e garanzie dirette di metodi senza preavviso - Redigere documentazione GMP, inclusi piani/rapporti di trasferimento/convalida, obiettivi del rischio e SOPs, gestendo al contempo Change Controls e Deviations come PMI - Supportare la preparazione agli audit Corsisi ed eseguendo ispezioni delle autorità sanitarie per mantenere il "Right to Operate" del sito - Gestire robustamente il ciclo di vita, garantendo standard analitici coerenti e guida tecnica durante l’intero ciclo di vita del prodotto
• Requisiti - Sei un professionista positivo e autorevole che prospera in un ambiente collaborativo e apprezza una cultura di dialogo aperto - In possesso di una laurea in Scienze della Vita (Chimica, Farmacia, Biotecnologie) o in un campo tecnico, abbinata a diversi anni di esperienza in un ambiente di qualità/GMP - Con una solida comprensione dei sistemi di sicurezza e qualità, supportata da un forte background analitico per problemi complessi - Proattivo e organizzato, con un alto grado di iniziativa personale, comprensione rapida e un approccio orientato alle soluzioni e autonomi - Collaborativo e un eccellente comunicatore, in grado di lavorare temporaneo in team interfunzionali e di costruire relazioni solide con stakeholder interni ed esterni - Con una mentalità globale e la capacità di navigare in ambienti complessi, bilanciando priorità multiple con facilità - Fluente in inglese (lingua aziendale); la conoscenza del tedesco è un vantaggio

BS/KAU is responsible for the analytical quality testing of an extensive product portfolio, ranging from drug substances and drug products to medical devices, bulk, finished goods, direct materials, and packaging materials. As a specialized section within this structure, Analytical Science and Technology (ASAT) is responsible for the strategic implementation of modern testing methods and innovative technologies at the Quality Control (QC) Basel/Kaiseraugst site. We act as a central hub of expertise, not only establishing methods locally but also actively transferring them to other sites. By managing the entire product lifecycle on an end-to-end (E2E) basis, we provide global standardization and technical steering. This ensures our 'Right to Operate', consistent compliance, and the highest quality standards throughout the entire Roche network. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad: En Roche LATAM Training Center , buscamos un/a Becario/a de Entrenamiento altamente motivado/a para apoyar en la gestión operativa y digital de las iniciativas de capacitación para personal interno y clientes. Esta posición ofrece una oportunidad única para desarrollarte en un entorno regional, colaborando en proyectos estratégicos de formación, adopción digital y mejora continua de la experiencia de aprendizaje. Responsabilidades:
• Gestión y Soporte: Actuar como apoyo de contacto para la revisión de incidencias técnicas en el sistema de entrenamiento interno y asegurar el correcto uso de la plataforma estándar para clientes.
• Soporte a Usuarios: Brindar acompañamiento a usuarios internos (afiliadas de LATAM) en el uso de plataformas de entrenamiento como Cornerstone u otras.
• Comunicación: Apoyar en la difusión de comunicados, convocatorias, recordatorios y cápsulas informativas, utilizando herramientas digitales e IA en el día a día.
• Gestión de Agendas: Coordinar calendarios de entrenamientos, seguimiento de registros, confirmaciones, listas de espera y gestión de cancelaciones.
• Actualización de Contenidos: Mantener actualizada la información de cursos, materiales y sesiones dentro de las plataformas.
• Análisis: Generar reportes de uso de plataformas, métricas de participación, tasas de cancelación y análisis de feedback de los usuarios.
• Mejora Continua: Recopilar insights de usuarios para proponer mejoras en procesos, contenidos y experiencia de entrenamiento.
• Materiales y Cápsulas: Apoyar en la creación de cápsulas informativas, guías rápidas y materiales de apoyo para usuarios.
• Apoyo a Entrenamientos: Colaborar en la logística y ejecución de entrenamientos dirigidos a personal interno y clientes finales.
• Colaboración: Trabajar de manera cross-functional con equipos de Training, Digital, Comercial y Soporte. Quién eres:
• Formación: Estudiante activo/a de últimos semestres en Administración, Comunicación, Sistemas o afines. No buscamos un perfil egresado.
• Perfil: Interés en el sector salud, entrenamiento, adopción digital y experiencia de usuario.
• Habilidades: Capacidad analítica, organización, atención al detalle y manejo de Excel (intermedio) y PowerPoint.
• Idiomas: Inglés intermedio (deseable manejo de portugués).
• Competencias: Proactividad, enfoque en el usuario, comunicación efectiva, aprendizaje ágil y trabajo colaborativo. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Job Summary: Lead the development and implementation of business plans and marketing activities focused on disease areas. Drive diagnostic solutions through deep cross-functional collaboration, particularly with Pharma partners, to achieve business targets. The Opportunity: 1. Establish and implement strategic marketing plans to achieve corporate objectives.
• Formulate and implement comprehensive market promotion plans aligned with the overall disease management diagnostic solutions strategy.
• Collaborate closely with Medical Science Affairs (MSA), Corporate Affairs, Communications and Sales teams to plan and execute integrated market events and promotional activities.
• Research, analyze, and monitor financial, technological, and demographic factors to capitalize on market opportunities and minimize effects of competitive activities
• Oversee and evaluate market research and adjust marketing strategy to meet changing market and competitive conditions
• Ensure effective control of marketing results, and take corrective action to guarantee that achievement of marketing objectives falls within designated budgets
• Establish and maintain relationships with industry influences, key communities and strategic partners
• Develop and manage Key Opinion Leader for products for effective promotion of product lines
• Regular key customers visit to understand their requirements and initiate project to maintain customer relationship and use as a marketing promotion material
• Guide preparation of marketing activity reports and presents to executive management
• Achieve satisfactory market share in relation to preset standards and industry and economic trends
• Recommend optimal pricing 2. Build KOL network in terms of product advisory board and speakers. 3. Build, coach, and lead a high-performing assay team. Develop the team's strategic capabilities to provide cross-disease/department strategic solutions. 4. Assist in yearly budgeting and control department expense within budget. 5. Develop career and development plan for the subordinates. Who you are: 1. Bachelor of Biology related discipline, Masters preferred. 2. Proficiency in both spoken and written English 3. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) This role serves as a hybrid strategic leader, combining the leadership of a composite team (comprising Medical Information & Medical Review and AI Product) with the development of a data- and AI-driven medical communication strategy. The mandate is anchored in establishing a "data-driven medical communication flywheel": leveraging AI to proactively capture customer perception insights, building personalized content generation platforms, and developing localized digital education platforms to empower strategic business decisions. Furthermore, the role drives the transformation of traditional MI and MR business models through the introduction of Agent technologies, forging a new paradigm of human-machine collaboration in medical inquiries and automated pre-approvals to accelerate internal process efficiencies and support high-quality business growth under strict compliance standards. Principal Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities 1. AI-Driven Strategy & Flywheel Construction Development and execution of a long-term, data-centric medical communication strategy, ensuring strict alignment with overarching business goals.
• Proactive Insight Generation: Leadership in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Social Listening) to proactively capture and analyze customer behaviors and perceptions, identifying market trends and opportunities to provide data-backed support for business decisions.
• Content Generation Platform & Impact: Establishment of a robust content generation platform to significantly accelerate the production speed of high-quality medical education materials. Leadership in the rapid construction of core scientific messaging and educational content derived from AI-driven insights to effectively influence and transform customer perceptions and clinical behaviors.
• Personalized Platform Development: Oversight of the construction of personalized content generation platforms and localized digital education platforms to ensure the medical value proposition is delivered precisely and efficiently based on targeted user personas. 2. Digital Product & Solution Leadership Lead the development, evolution, and ecosystem cooperation for strategic digital assets, ensuring they deliver measurable value to patients and the healthcare system.
• Portfolio Lifecycle Management: Oversee the roadmap and execution of key AI solutions, specifically, Social Listening, Content Generation, Digital Communication, MI Agent, and MR Agent.
• Agile Iteration: Driving the continuous iteration of cutting-edge technologies, such as Large Language Models (LLMs), within medical communication scenarios to optimize product performance in an evolving market landscape. 3. AI Agent Innovation & Human-Machine Collaboration
• Traditional Business Transformation: Leading the introduction and deployment of MI Agents and MR Agents to fundamentally revolutionize traditional medical information inquiries and compliance review workflows.
• Model Innovation: Establishment of a human-machine collaboration model for medical Q&A (MI Agent) and automated pre-approvals (MR Agent) to achieve a quantum leap in business responsiveness while ensuring 100% adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements. 4. Team Leadership & Capability Development Management and mentorship of a hybrid team of MI/MR and AI Product.
• Team Synergy: Elimination of functional barrier between traditional medical communication operations and technical product management

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Intern - Direct Procurement Contract type: Contract of mandate (umowa zlecenie) for 12 months Availability: 5 days per week, 25 - 40 hours per week Place of work: Warsaw Office or Remote Join our procurement team as an operational and administrative support specialist! This is an ideal opportunity for someone starting their career to learn procurement processes from the inside, gain experience working in SAP , and participate in the department's digital transformation. You will support us in ensuring supply continuity and building professional relationships with our suppliers. The Opportunity: Operational and Systems Support:
• SAP Order Management: Support in creating and processing orders, as well as monitoring delivery deadlines to clients.
• Vendor Database Management: Setting up new vendors and unblocking existing accounts in the system.
• Material Data Administration: Creating new material indexes in the system and performing regular price list updates. P rocess and Quality Support:
• Contractor Verification: Conducting supplier Due Diligence to secure current business operations and updating the Preferred Supplier List (LPD) .
• Documentation Oversight: Managing specialized documentation related to medical devices ( IVD/MD ).
• Fulfilment Monitoring: Supervising the status of order fulfillment and informing partners about delivery schedules. Administrative Tasks and Innovation:
• Contract Workflow and Archiving: Managing the signing process and circulation of documents with suppliers, and archiving documents within systems ( MyBuy ).
• Communication and AI: Maintaining the Procurement Intranet site and providing substantive oversight of materials for the AI assistant . Who you are:
• You own a University Degree or you are still studying
• You are meticulous and accurate when working with data and IT systems.
• You have strong time management skills and the ability to prioritize tasks.
• You have great communication skills and a desire to work in a dynamic, modern environment.
• You are proficient in Polish & English What you get:
• Flexibility: A contract of mandate ( umowa zlecenie ) that can easily be adjusted to your university schedule.
• Modern Toolkit: Opportunity to learn SAP and MyBuy tools within international structures.
• Exposure to Innovation: The chance to co-create solutions based on Artificial Intelligence (AI) in procurement.
• Expert Development: Working within a team of "team players" who focus on knowledge sharing and substantive support. If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it. Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche first-hand? Check out our blog! https://careers.roche.com/global/en/we-are-roche The controller of your personal data is Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o., ul. Domaniewska 28, 02-672 Warsaw. The data is processed for the purpose of recruitment. You have the right to access data, rectify it, delete it, limit processing, transfer it and - if processing is based on your consent - withdraw this consent at any time. Contact the Data Protection Officer at: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. More information on the principles of processing your personal data by Roche at the link: https://www.roche.pl/privacy-policy-recruitment-dia-en. Roche Diagnostics sp. z o.o. operates in full compliance with the law and does not tolerate any violations. Roche Diagnostics sp. z o.o. has implemented a Procedure for Reporting Violations of Law. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Wir sind Roche Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten. Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care ! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen! In deiner Funktion als Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig. Deine Aufgaben:
• Du bedienst Bereichsübergreifend Abfüll-, Etikettier,- Fertigungs- und Verpackungsanlagen zur Produktion von diagnostischen Produkten
• Das prüfst die zur Produktion eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen und Betriebsmittel unter Berücksichtigung geltender Arbeitsanweisungen
• Gemäß geltender Regularien führst du Inprozesskontrollen durch und dokumentierst diese GMP-konform
• Durch Deine aktive Mitarbeit erkennst Du auftretende Qualitätsmängel, führst vorgeschriebene Stichprobenprüfungen, Musterziehungen und optische Kontrollen durch und arbeitest aktiv am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess mit.
• Du behebst einfache technische Störungen und übernimmst einfache Umrüstungen
• Alle Aufgaben führst Du unter Beachtung der Arbeitsanweisungen, Hygienevorschriften, Arbeitsschutz-, GMP- und Umweltschutzregeln durch
• Das Arbeiten mit einer FFP3- Maske und einem Gebläse-Atemschutz stellt für Dich kein Problem dar.
• Ver- und Entsorgung der Produktionsbetriebe durch Materialanforderung/-transport, die sachgerechte Kennzeichnung sowie die Entsorgung des Materials liegen in deiner Verantwortung. Dabei nutzt Du manuelle und/oder angetriebene Transportmittel.
• Die Tätigkeit erfordert ständiges Stehen und das tägliche, regelmäßige Heben und Bewegen von schweren Lasten bis 15 kg (unter Umständen bis 28kg). Das bringst Du mit:
• Eine Berufsausbildung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem Produktions- oder Verpackungsbetrieb
• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.
• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).
• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop
• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.
• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.
• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.
• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Wir sind Roche Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten. Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care ! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen! In deiner Funktion als Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig. Deine Aufgaben:
• Du bedienst Bereichsübergreifend Abfüll-, Etikettier,- Fertigungs- und Verpackungsanlagen zur Produktion von diagnostischen Produkten
• Das prüfst die zur Produktion eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen und Betriebsmittel unter Berücksichtigung geltender Arbeitsanweisungen
• Gemäß geltender Regularien führst du Inprozesskontrollen durch und dokumentierst diese GMP-konform
• Durch Deine aktive Mitarbeit erkennst Du auftretende Qualitätsmängel, führst vorgeschriebene Stichprobenprüfungen, Musterziehungen und optische Kontrollen durch und arbeitest aktiv am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess mit.
• Du behebst einfache technische Störungen und übernimmst einfache Umrüstungen
• Alle Aufgaben führst Du unter Beachtung der Arbeitsanweisungen, Hygienevorschriften, Arbeitsschutz-, GMP- und Umweltschutzregeln durch
• Das Arbeiten mit einer FFP3- Maske und einem Gebläse-Atemschutz stellt für Dich kein Problem dar.
• Ver- und Entsorgung der Produktionsbetriebe durch Materialanforderung/-transport, die sachgerechte Kennzeichnung sowie die Entsorgung des Materials liegen in deiner Verantwortung. Dabei nutzt Du manuelle und/oder angetriebene Transportmittel.
• Die Tätigkeit erfordert ständiges Stehen und das tägliche, regelmäßige Heben und Bewegen von schweren Lasten bis 15 kg (unter Umständen bis 28kg). Das bringst Du mit:
• Eine Berufsausbildung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem Produktions- oder Verpackungsbetrieb
• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.
• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).
• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop
• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.
• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.
• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.
• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

titleByLocale.en: (Senior) Strategic Alliance Manager (高级)战略合作经理
titleByLocale.de: (Senior) Strategic Alliance Manager (高级)战略合作经理
titleByLocale.fr: (Senior) Strategic Alliance Manager (高级)战略合作经理

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 岗位： (高级)战略合作经理 工作地点：武汉，湖北 您将有机会： 执行所属地区关键医院的准入计划
• 根据总部与BU讨论的每年医院开发计划，准备地区的医院开发计划和时间表，确保在有临床提单情况下的开发成功率
• 推动需开发医院的药事会、临采流程，提供关键医院药学部解决方案
• 确保所属区域关键医院的已准入状态的维护；将医院总控影响降到最低；维护好与关键医院医保办合作
• 协助多渠道准入团队处理区域关键医院或自费药房的价格谈判
• 协助招标和多渠道准入团队处理区域关键医院确标和专家工作 负责所属地区关键医院业务计划（Account planning）制定
• 熟知所负责医院信息和动态变化，完成和完善地区关键医院的 Account Planning
• 根据每家医院的Account Planning，合理分配学术项目所负责的医院
• 根据确认的Account Planning ，向项目团队建议每家医院创新方案，
• 搭建跨部门的沟通平台，分享和落实部分关键医院的Account Planning 负责建立与所属地区关键医院的合作关系
• 根基公司CRM拜访要求，每月制定客户拜访计划，每周上报拜访报告，及时向上级反馈市场信息
• 了解和挖掘所负责地区关键医院业务和学术发展需求，与策略和项目团队讨论提供相应的学术支持
• 协助实施区域品牌项目，培养区域的讲者，打造公司在区域的影响力
• 支持策略和项目团队的全国和区域项目在所负责地区关键医院的实施
• 整合内外部资源，搭建平台，为核心关键医院提供解决方案 日常工作管理
• 按时准确完成日常工作和相关报告
• 完成年度KPI目标
• 严格遵守和执行公司的合规政策 我们期待您： Education/Qualifications 教育程度/ 所获资格证书 大学本科及以上学历 医药相关专业优选 Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力
• 具备3年及以上医药销售经理相关工作经验；或具备5年高级医药销售顾问工作经验
• 掌握专业知识和办公技能，具备主动学习能力，能提供建议和解决方案；
• 具备客户管理能力，能够反映客户经营情况、业务能力的数据信息指标；能根据情况变化、突发情况等给出建议，及时调整工作计划；能得到利益相关客户的建议和大力支持，同医院客户建立持久长期的良好合作关系，为客户提供价值
• 具备项目管理能力掌握项目管理基本知识和技能及工具，能针对性的设计修改项目方案，体现罗氏制药的独特价值；能在项目推进的过程中，灵活调整且做好风险预案，主动管理风险
• 具有谈判和影响能力，能够根据分析出客户的需求和底线，随机应变的给出对应策略；能进行双赢谈判方案设计，与上级、合作部门共同分析讨论，改进谈判方案；建立影响，传递价值，能够不断总结谈判的成功经验，确保谈判成果
• 具备团队合作能力，善于与团队内部或跨部门同事合作分工，合理安排彼此工作重点；具有重大事件解决能力，能对风险有所预判并准备相关预案；能独立策划与举办跨部门沟通合作平台会议
• 具有区域管理能力，落地执行区域发展策略，能在多项事物之间保持好资源投入的平衡；具有高质量地执行流程能力，能够妥善的处理异常情况；能够勇于坚持观点和承担后果，在团队中成为表率，影响带动他人
• 能适应环境和条件的变化，具有较强的抗压能力，主动学习和参与创新，追求卓越绩效
• 战略思维、沟通能力，学习能力，团队合作能力 Travel Frequency出差频率：25% - 50% Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten. Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen! In deiner Funktion als Schichtleiter im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig. Was Dich erwartet:
• Verantworte den reibungslosen Produktionsablauf unter Einhaltung von SOPs, GMP-Richtlinien und Reinraumregeln.
• Maximiere die Schichtleistung durch effiziente Personal- und Materialplanung sowie gezielte Kennzahlensteuerung.
• Führe und entwickle Dein Schichtteam gemäß der Roche-Führungsgrundsätze und fördere aktiv den „One-Team“-Gedanken.
• Manage das operative Personalgeschäft von Mitarbeitergesprächen und Zielvereinbarungen bis zur Zeitwirtschaft.
• Sichere die Qualität durch regelmäßige Teamschulungen, Shopfloor-Meetings und lückenlose Dokumentation.
• Treibe die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Anlagen in enger Abstimmung mit den Schnittstellen voran.
• Gewährleiste höchste Arbeitssicherheit durch proaktive Kontrollen, Sicherheits-Rundgänge und die Wartung der Anlagen. Wer Du bist:
• Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Du hast eine technische Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst langjährige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder diagnostischen Produktion mit.
• Führungspersönlichkeit: Du besitzt nachweisbare (fachliche) Führungskompetenz, arbeitest strukturiert und förderst eine offene Kommunikation im Team.
• Fach-Know-how: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes GMP-Verständnis sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktions-IT (z. B. MES, SAP) und MS Office.
• Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Organisationsgeschick und Belastbarkeit im dynamischen Produktionsumfeld aus.
• Rahmenbedingungen: Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift und bist bereit zur Arbeit im Vollkonti-Schichtmodell (18/21 Schichten). Deine Bewerbung: Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt und können bei Bedarf angefordert werden. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Führe und entwickle Dein Schichtteam gemäß der Roche-Führungsgrundsätze und fördere aktiv den „One-Team“-Gedanken.
• Manage das operative Personalgeschäft von Mitarbeitergesprächen und Zielvereinbarungen bis zur Zeitwirtschaft.
• Sichere die Qualität durch regelmäßige Teamschulungen, Shopfloor-Meetings und lückenlose Dokumentation.
• Treibe die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Anlagen in enger Abstimmung mit den Schnittstellen voran.
• Gewährleiste höchste Arbeitssicherheit durch proaktive Kontrollen, Sicherheits-Rundgänge und die Wartung der Anlagen. Wer Du bist:
• Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Du hast eine technische Ausbildung abgeschlossen und bringst langjährige Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder diagnostischen Produktion mit.
• Führungspersönlichkeit: Du besitzt nachweisbare (fachliche) Führungskompetenz, arbeitest strukturiert und förderst eine offene Kommunikation im Team.
• Fach-Know-how: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes GMP-Verständnis sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Produktions-IT (z. B. MES, SAP) und MS Office.
• Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Organisationsgeschick und Belastbarkeit im dynamischen Produktionsumfeld aus.
• Rahmenbedingungen: Du beherrschst Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift und bist bereit zur Arbeit im Vollkonti-Schichtmodell (18/21 Schichten). Deine Bewerbung: Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugnisse/Nachweise. Weitere Dokumente werden derzeit nicht zwingend benötigt und können bei Bedarf angefordert werden. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Roche Diagnostics Site Management | Chi siamo The “Biep” quando si apre il cancello rotante. Votando sul cantiere. Il taglio di metallo sul banco di lavoro. La lucentezza del fotovoltaico sul tetto. Il profumo di fagioli freschi nel bar del caffè. In Site Management, siamo molto più di un fornitore di servizi operativi: ci comprendiamo come progettista attivo e persona capace al nostro sito. Per tutti i dipendenti del sito, ad esempio nell'ambito delle nostre unità di produzione e di ricerca – cioè per le nostre unità aziendali – creiamo un ecosistema integrato che permette un lavoro senza soluzione di continuità, promuove l'innovazione e rafforza la produttività. Uniamo in modo affidabile l'affidabilità operativa quotidiana con argomenti previsionali come la digitalizzazione, la sostenibilità e gli ambienti di lavoro moderni. Così, forniamo un contributo strategico alla diagnostica di alta qualità e prodotti farmaceutici a beneficio dei nostri pazienti: sia in tutto il mondo. StartUp your Career - sei pronto? | Con il nostro programma StartUp Trainee, vi offriamo interessanti progetti e prospettive multi-sito all'interno delle funzioni di localizzazione come la gestione delle strutture, manutenzione, automazione, gestione dei rischi, sicurezza, salute e conformità dell'ambiente e ingegneria. Dal primo giorno in poi, si forma attivamente il vostro programma di 24 mesi. Prendere le seguenti attività eccitanti:
• Assumere la responsabilità: Si lavora in modo indipendente e nel team in fino a sei aree diverse delle nostre posizioni e prendere le proprie attività fin dall'inizio.
• Progetti di controllo: selezioni le priorità del progetto in modo proattivo, pianificale auto-organizzate e guidarle al successo.
• Costruire una rete: Si diventa parte di una comunità di tirocinanti viventi e anche collegare contatti preziosi con colleghi attraverso confini funzionali.
• Estendere le prospettive: Si utilizza l'opportunità di introdurre le vostre competenze in una delle nostre sedi Roche internazionali e di accompagnare un progetto indipendente lì.
• Sviluppo di progettazione: Si controlla il vostro sviluppo personale e professionale in modo indipendente, supportato da un portafoglio di sviluppo personalizzato e un mentoring da senior management.
• Assicurare il futuro: Si beneficia di una promozione a lungo termine – il nostro programma StartUp Trainee inizia direttamente con un contratto indefinito. Qualificazioni | Questo ti porta con diversi servizi, diversi come i nostri dipendenti. Per i nostri tirocinanti, una laurea magistrale è il requisito di base - si deve aver completato questo all'inizio, ma si può ancora applicare durante i vostri studi. Inoltre, stiamo cercando una personalità con un'unità interna e il potenziale per raggiungere la grandezza. Pertanto ti stiamo cercando:
• Hai completato con successo un master in ingegneria (economica), economia o informatica aziendale, incentrati idealmente sulla gestione delle strutture, analisi dei dati, gestione energetica/risorsa o automazione.
• Porti la prima esperienza pratica attraverso stage rilevanti in patria o all'estero, preferibilmente raccolti in uffici di ingegneria, aziende industriali o di servizio. Siete lieti di scoprire soluzioni innovative in un ambiente complesso, pensare imprenditoriale e comprendere i cambiamenti come ingegnere di sviluppo

The Position Business Systems Analyst- Pharma R&D Job description The Business Systems Analyst is an active and self-sufficient contributor within their project or product team. In this role, you will analyze business requirements independently and translate them into detailed system specifications. You will be responsible for configuring systems, planning and executing various levels of testing, and designing automated systems, including hardware and software compatibility. By providing direct consultation to users, creating detailed documentation, and offering technical assistance, you will ensure seamless operations while considering both the short-term and long-term implications of your decisions. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with experience working within Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Operations, or Pharmacovigilance / Safety team with a solid understanding on the E2E process flow across R&D. Additionally, a proven track record of navigating the stringent requirements of GxP environments (GCP, GMP, GVP) and managing complex, cross-functional data workflows is highly desirable. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Plays an active part within the project and/or product team. Provides constructive feedback, seeks feedback for self, reflects on own challenges and successes, and actively supports others.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Analyzes business requirements and translates them into system specifications. Configures system settings and options to meet user needs. Plans and executes unit, integration, and acceptance testing. Able to assess and communicate risks effectively.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. The Position Exp required- 5 to 12 years Work Location- Baner, Pune Job description The ERP Solution Consultant delivers ERP and EWM solutions independently, proactively addresses challenges, and contributes effectively to team efforts . In this role, you will solve a broad range of difficult problems, prioritize your work, and report status in the area of Inventory and Warehouse Management. You will communicate seamlessly within product teams and occasionally interact with stakeholders on small to medium engagements while ensuring compliance with Roche Service Level Management processes (incident management, change management etc.) . By demonstrating good ERP business analysis knowledge and good understanding of business processes , your work will make a direct impact within your project or workgroup. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Works independently to deliver ERP/EWM solutions and proactively identifies and addresses challenges. Seeks senior colleague support for complex product scenarios while ensuring adherence to processes for timely and high-quality results. Contributes to specific chapter-related outcomes, fosters effective teamwork, and actively solicits ideas from others within the project team .
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Deals with uncertainty and makes decisions at the product level with guidance from a more senior member. Provides solutions to a broad range of difficult problems.
• Stakeholder Management: Primarily interacts within product teams, squads, and across the Product Line as applicable. Interacts directly with stakeholders on small to medium engagements . Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions within product teams and clearly communicates the impact of their own work in the context of business needs.
• Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to a specific workgroup or project.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates the ability to prioritize and report status at the product level .
• Business / Technical ability: Applies understanding of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis . Demonstrates good knowledge of ERP IT Business Analysis and Consultancy concepts and practices with a focus on inventory and warehouse management. Qualifications Education / Experience
• Demonstrated experience independently delivering ERP solutions while fostering effective teamwork and adherence to quality processes.
• Experience making decisions at the product level under guidance and solving a broad range of difficult problems.
• Proven ability to prioritize tasks and accurately report status at the product level . Technical Skills
• Good knowledge of SAP ERP IT Business Analysis / Consultancy concepts and practices with focus on SAP MM/IM and EWM with 3-5 years of experience in a supply chain environment incl. experience across the SAP modules
• Good understanding and application of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
• Good level of business process domain knowledge .
• Experience in handling 3rd party logistic provider integrations (with LE-IDW) into ERP is a plus. Additional Qualifications
• Strong collaborative mindset with a track record of actively soliciting ideas from project team members.
• Solid stakeholder management and communication skills , capable of interacting on small to medium engagements and articulati
