titleByLocale.en: Country Study Start Up Team Leader
titleByLocale.de: Country Study Start Up Team Leader
titleByLocale.fr: Country Study Start Up Team Leader

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) Roche Nederland B.V., Woerden The Opportunity At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. In our Global Clinical Operations (PDG) team, we are looking for a Country Study Start-up Team Leader (cSTL) to take on a dual-impact role that is vital to our mission. You will be the driving force behind clinical trial submissions while simultaneously serving as a People Leader (for +- 30% of your time), guiding a dedicated team to success in our country delivery operations. In this pivotal role, you will balance strategic oversight of study start-up with hands-on leadership in regulatory submissions and people management. Your work ensures that we deliver innovative medicines to patients faster and more efficiently by streamlining the bridge between clinical design and site activation. In this role, you will:
• Lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving efficiency and innovation to ensure timely site activation.
• Drive clinical trial submissions and regulatory coordination, managing complex submission packages and responding to Health Authority queries.
• Serve as a People Leader for approximately 30% of your time, providing coaching, support, and professional development to your direct reports.
• Architect and oversee the management of Informed Consent Forms (ICF) and clinical site documentation to ensure global compliance.
• Champion process innovation by identifying opportunities for automation to improve trial initiation timelines.
• Collaborate with global stakeholders, including CROs and Health Authorities, to harmonise systems and influence the local start-up environment.
• Manage clinical site budgets and contracts, ensuring financial and legal alignment through expert negotiation. Who you are You are a proactive, visionary leader who combines deep technical expertise in clinical submissions with a genuine passion for developing others. You thrive in complex, matrixed environments and possess the analytical prowess to turn data into strategic improvements. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• Extensive industry expertise: Proven experience in clinical trial start-up and regulatory submissions, with deep knowledge of ICH-GCP and EU CTR.
• Transformation leadership: A track record in coaching, mentoring, and leading high-performing teams to deliver significant business impact.
• Advanced scientific background: A University degree (MD, PhD, MS, or BS) in life sciences; a postgraduate degree is highly desirable.
• Technical proficiency: Experience navigating complex clinical systems such as Veeva Vault, CTIS, and RIM.
• Exceptional communication: The ability to influence and partner with stakeholders, from local operational teams to global executive leadership.
• Language skills: Mandatory fluency in English and fluency in Dutch is strongly preferred Why Roche? For over 125 years, Roche has been working towards a healthier future with one clear goal: "Doing now what patients need next". We believe that the greatest medical challenges can only be solved through intensive collaboration with healthcare professionals and patients. Our impact goes beyond healthcare; we also take full responsibility for our planet. For instance, since 2025, all our locations have run on 100% sustainable electricity—a major milestone in our ambition to be fully climate neutral (net zero) by 2045. At Roche, you are not just working on the healthcare of tomorrow,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Experience Required- 6+ years The Accounts Payables ERP Solution Architect designs business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions within the Accounts Payables context. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements and evolving the architecture throughout the product life cycle. By solving complex technical problems, defining reference architectures, and aligning with the broader architecture community for governance, you will ensure robust ERP implementations that deliver enhanced value to the organization. Description of the area Our landscape in the Accounts Payables area integrates SAP ECC and S/4HANA with diverse procurement platforms to support the Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle. We ensure seamless processing from invoice receipt and compliant financial approval workflows through to the successful delivery of payment instructions to the Treasury solution. You will play a key role in navigating the transition from legacy environments to modern ERP standards, ensuring integration resilience and scalability as we re-engineer our global ERP landscape through the ASPIRE program. You will serve as the critical interface for translating business requirements into technical/ IT language. Your primary mission is to deeply explore and define the functional "why" behind business requests, ensuring that every technological solution is built upon a foundation of clearly mapped processes and validated organizational needs. Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs ERP solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a specific solution context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle, and aligns with the architecture community for proper governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex problems, taking a new perspective on existing solutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for the assigned ERP solution. Assesses and consults on impacts and dependencies of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape. Creates conceptual and logical data models, taxonomies, and ontologies for the solution and the related interfaces. Defines and drives reference architectures, needed NFRs, and ensures Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are recorded. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility for the solution, including vendor assessments.
• Stakeholder Management: Explains difficult or sensitive technical information and works collaboratively to build consensus among product teams, business stakeholders, and technical peers.
• Impact/Strategy: Develops and maintains the product's technology roadmap within the solution context. Provides technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific ERP technologies for product teams. Identifies opportunities to enhance value and business processes, improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies.
• Complexity / (Product Size): Operates primarily within the Accounts Payable product scope, managing the architectural complexities of specific ERP applications or components. In ad

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position At the heart of this internship, you will collaborate with our Simulation Teams to architect the future of System & Solution Design. As a key contributor, you will help build and validate ‘Digital Twins’ for our next-generation core lab solutions. Your work won’t just be theoretical, it will directly shape the physical architecture and the logical “brain” of cutting-edge, end-to-end laboratory systems. Your Key Responsibilities
• Model & Maintain: Create and maintain complex scenarios for software and hardware simulations.
• Execute & Analyze: Run simulations and perform deep-dive analyses of the results to identify system behaviors.
• Evolutionary Support: Provide status updates and issue notifications to support the continuous evolution of our simulators.
• Collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to improve departmental operations and project delivery. What You Will Learn & Develop
• Advanced Simulation: Gain hands-on experience with Discrete Event Simulation (DES) using tools like Simio or AnyLogic.
• Systems Engineering: Understand the "big picture" of how hardware, software, and logistics integrate into massive diagnostic solutions.
• Algorithmic Thinking: Design and implement efficient heuristics for real-time decision-making in robotics.
• Data Science: Use Python to transform raw simulation outputs into powerful, data-driven visual stories.
• Software Development: Level up your OOP (C# or Java ) skills by extending simulation logic.
• Global Collaboration: Experience working across borders with engineers and product owners in an international environment. Who You Are You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.
• Education: Mechanical Engineering, SW Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Industrial Engineering.
• Programming: Solid foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (C# or Java).
• Data Tools: Knowledge of SQL, Python, and Pandas for data management.
• Simulation: Familiarity with Discrete Event Simulations and statistical modeling.
• Communication: Fluent in English; able to present complex data with clarity.
• Mindset: You are a methodical, responsible team player who is eager to take ownership of technical challenges.A strong willingness to learn and a proactive approach to problem-solving. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Work closely with Product Teams to understand and determine testing requirements and assist in the development, planning, scoping and execution of testing activities (both in physical and cloud products).

• Participate in planning and managing red team exercises to assess the cyber resilience of products and solutions.

• Intensive 1 year intern graduate program (Contrato en prácticas).

The Position About the role Are you a tech enthusiast eager to bridge the gap between traditional Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Intern to join our development squads. In this role, you will be part of the team designing cutting-edge solutions for the future Core Laboratory. Your mission will be to help the department explore and implement AI use cases, directly contributing to projects that impact patient lives while developing your skills in a professional, high-tech environment. Main responsibilities
• AI Integration: Participate in initiatives to explore, prototype, and implement AI-driven features within our software ecosystem.
• Development: Support the squad in developing software components using C# and .NET , while leveraging Python for AI-specific implementations.
• Modern Tooling: Work with cutting-edge developer tools like GitHub Copilot and contribute to integrations with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers .
• Collaboration: Work within an Agile squad, participating in ceremonies (Daily, Sprint Planning) and contributing to the team's goals.
• Quality: Produce clean, maintainable code and participate in testing activities to ensure the reliability of our medical instrumentation software. How would your day-to-day look like? You will start your day synced with your squad, discussing progress and tackling challenges. Under the guidance of an assigned mentor , you will transition from your initial onboarding to making real contributions to our codebase. You will spend part of your time investigating how AI can optimize our projects and the other part implementing those solutions within our C#/.NET architecture. It is a balance of autonomous learning, creative exploration of AI, and structured teamwork. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position Role Overview Are you interested in how software R&D organizations evolve to integrate AI and stay ahead in a changing technological landscape? We are looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented R&D AI Transformation Intern to join our strategy team. You won't just be fetching coffee; you’ll be behind the scenes of major structural, cultural, and digital shifts as we embed AI into our engineering DNA, helping us bridge the gap between "traditional development" and "AI-augmented innovation." Key Responsibilities
• Data Analysis & Insights: Gather and analyze R&D performance metrics and AI tool adoption rates to identify bottlenecks and track the progress of ongoing AI transformation initiatives.
• Stakeholder Communication: Assist in drafting internal memos, newsletters, and presentation decks that translate complex AI strategies and LLM implementations into "human" language for our developers and engineers.
• Project Management Support: Maintain project timelines (Gantt charts) and follow up on action items from cross-functional workshops focused on AI integration and automated workflows.
• Research: Conduct competitive benchmarking and research best practices in AI-assisted coding, machine learning operations (MLOps), and organizational design for AI-first R&D teams.
• Workshop Facilitation: Help organize and document brainstorming sessions aimed at improving software delivery pipelines through AI and boosting developer engagement with new intelligent tools. What We’re Looking For
• Curiosity: A genuine interest in the intersection of software business strategy, AI ethics, and engineering culture.
• Communication: The ability to explain a complex technical AI concept or strategic shift simply and clearly.
• Agility: Comfort with ambiguity—navigating the rapid evolution of AI in R&D is rarely a straight line!
• Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data visualization) and PowerPoint (storytelling), with an interest in exploring AI productivity tools.
• Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Why Join Us? This isn't your typical administrative internship. You will gain a "bird's-eye view" of how a software R&D organization operates at scale and learn the methodologies used to drive meaningful change in the age of AI. If you're a problem-solver who loves to see the big picture in a high-tech environment, we’d love to have you on board. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About the role Are you a natural communicator with an analytical mind? Do you want to understand how a complex medical product is defined before a single line of code is written? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Product Owner / Requirement Engineer Intern . In this role, you will support our Product Owners in the vital task of defining "what" we build. You will act as a bridge between high-level business needs and the technical implementation teams, ensuring that every feature is clearly documented and understood. This is a unique opportunity to gain a holistic view of the healthcare business and the lifecycle of medical software. Main responsibilities
• Requirement Definition: Support the creation and maintenance of Feature Files and Product Requirements that guide our software implementation partners.
• Product Risk Management: Identify product risks in defined features and define appropriate risk control measures to mitigate risks that could cause patient harm.
• Operational Agility: Assist Product Owners in the day-to-day operational tasks, ensuring that requirements are ready for development "sprints" and resolving functional doubts.
• Tool Management: Work directly with our official requirement management tool, Retina (Codebeamer) , to keep documentation organized and updated.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Help gather needs and feedback from different areas, including Business Leaders (IPM), Global Service (GCS), and other cross-functional departments.
• Quality Assurance: Ensure that the defined requirements meet the necessary quality attributes for a regulated medical environment.
• Process optimization: Actively participate in and contribute to the continuous improvement of requirements processes within a SAFe environment. How would your day-to-day look like? Your day will involve a lot of interaction within the internal team and stakeholders from other areas and projects. You will participate in meetings with senior Product Owners to understand the strategic roadmap, and then translate those ideas into detailed documentation. You will spend time in Retina , refining feature descriptions, product risks, product requirements and ensuring the "definition of ready" is met for the developers. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to balance the needs of different stakeholders while building a strong network across various business areas. It’s a role that combines deep "desk work" (analysis and writing) with constant collaboration and networking. Who are you?
• Education: Recent graduate in Informatics, Telecommunications, or Biomedical Engineering . We value your understanding of the product domain and logic over coding skills.
• Analytical Skills: You have a knack for breaking down complex problems into clear, logical requirements.
• Communication: You are comfortable talking to people from different backgrounds (technical and non-technical) and have excellent writing skills.
• Organization: You are methodical and detail-oriented, especially when managing documentation and deadlines.
• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B2/C1 level) is essential, as you will interact with international stakeholders. This opportunity is part of the START TECH program, you can find more information about the program in the following link. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position ABOUT THE ROLE Are you fascinated by how software is deployed, scaled, and maintained in high-stakes environments? Our Instrumentation Development chapter in Sant Cugat (Barcelona) is looking for a Software Engineer Trainee to join our DevOps and Infrastructure operations. In this role, you will be the backbone of our development process. You won't just be writing code; you will be ensuring that our software reaches its destination (testing and production environments) smoothly and reliably. This is a unique opportunity to enter the DevOps world, a discipline built on experience and collaboration rather than traditional textbooks. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
• Environment Maintenance: Support the daily operations of our testing environments, ensuring they are ready for the testing team’s deployments.
• Pipeline Optimization: Collaborate with our implementation partners to maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, ensuring faster and safer software delivery.
• Infrastructure as Code: Assist in managing containerized environments using Docker, kubernetes and cloud resources within Azure and AWS .
• Daily Support: Provide support to the development squads in their day-to-day DevOps needs, troubleshooting deployment issues and monitoring system health.
• Continuous Improvement: Participate in initiatives to automate manual tasks and modernize our current infrastructure. HOW WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE? Your day will start with a sync meeting to identify any bottlenecks in our deployment pipelines or environments. Under the guidance of your assigned mentor , you will learn how to manage the infrastructure and how to orchestrate services with Kubernetes . You will work closely with both the testing team (to provide them with stable environments) and our external implementation partners (to learn and improve how we build software). It is a hands-on journey where you will see the immediate impact of your work on the speed and quality of the entire department. WHO ARE YOU?
• Education: Recent graduate in Computer Science, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related technical field.
• DevOps Passion: You are naturally curious about cloud technologies, automation, and the "behind the scenes" of software development.
• Tech Interest: While you don't need to be an expert, you have a basic understanding or a strong desire to master Cloud services and Kubernetes .
• Mindset: You are a problem-solver who enjoys technical challenges and thrives in collaborative environments.
• Languages: Professional proficiency in English (B1/B2 or higher). WHAT DO WE OFFER?
• A Real DevOps School: DevOps is learned by doing. We offer you the environment, the tools, and the team to transform your curiosity into a professional career.
• Mentorship: You will have a dedicated mentor to guide your learning path from day one.
• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).
• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.
• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

• High-Tech Stack: Gain hands-on experience with industry-standard tools (Azure, Docker, CI/CD).
• Flexibility: A flexible working model in our Sant Cugat office with remote work options.
• Program: This position is part of our START TECH program for young digital talent. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il gruppo Roche External Manufacturing (Commercial Drug Substance) è parte dell'unità di produzione Roche Drug Substance, siamo partner con le Organizzazioni Contrattuali (CMO) e garantiamo che gli obiettivi di produzione/produzione pertinenti vengano consegnati a Roche on-time, alla massima qualità e all'interno-budget e che i CMO operano in conformità con i requisiti attuali Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) e gli standard aziendali Roche. L'Externative Manufacturing and Business Operations Manager ha due responsabilità principali: Lei/he è il responsabile delle relazioni principali per le organizzazioni di produzione dei contratti partner specificate (CMO) o i siti. E agisce anche come Capo di Stato Maggiore per l'unità, assicura che l'implementazione di strategia sia ben eseguita, e porta la proprietà del processo di gestione delle prestazioni per il gruppo. L'opportunità: L'utente agisce come direttore principale e relazionale per gli OGM in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla selezione iniziale e dall'implementazione alla decommissione. Significa:
• Lead team di governance internazionale in diverse funzioni come Qualità, MSAT, Supply Chain, Legale e Procurement per garantire l'allineamento organizzativo durante la produzione di CMO, due diligence o Tech Transfers
• Fornire una stretta aderenza agli standard GMP, Qualità e SHE durante la conduzione di revisioni di rischio regolari per affrontare proattivamente i potenziali problemi di fornitura a CMO
• Serve come Capo di Stato Maggiore e consulente del team di leadership DS External Manufacturing Head e del sito, collaborando strettamente con gli sforzi per far avanzare il portafoglio verso la visione della rete di sostanza della droga
• Guidare il sistema di reportistica Performance Management, compresi gli obiettivi/KPI, l'allineamento PTN e l'esecuzione efficace delle recensioni settimanali, mensili e trimestrali
• Funziona a stretto contatto con la finanza e altri stakeholder per guidare la pianificazione aziendale e monitorare le prestazioni finanziarie
• Sviluppa la strategia globale per una comunicazione efficace tra i team, e conduce e assicura la gestione dei rischi attraverso DS External Manufacturing, identificando e incorporando i piani di mitigazione nel portafoglio prioritario del sito Chi sei? Abbiamo alte aspettative intorno al pensiero end-to-end e la collaborazione funzionale trasversale in una rete globale, prendendo la proprietà e delegare le decisioni a livello appropriato. Apprezziamo una mentalità imprenditoriale con la capacità di cambiare costantemente o adattarsi in un ambiente dinamico. Ci aspettiamo che ti concentri sul lavoro più efficace e di valore aggiungendo priorità ai tuoi sforzi con una chiara attenzione alla creazione di valore per il paziente. Sarete disposti a esplorare nuove opportunità, essere a proprio agio con ambiguità e prendere rischi intelligenti, nel rispetto delle ultime normative. Inoltre:
• Istruzione e esperienza di base: laurea in Ingegneria o Scienze della vita (preferito di laurea avanzato) con 10 anni di esperienza di produzione / operazioni all'interno di Pharma/Biotech o industrie similarmente regolamentate
• Leadership & Project Management: 3+ anni che portano rapporti diretti o squadre matrici, insieme a 5+ anni dirigendo progetti interfunzionali su larga scala e complessi (la certificazione di Project Management è un plus)
• Competenza Tecnica e Qualità: Profonda competenza in un ambiente GMP-regolato (specificamente sostanza biologica farmacologica), con un forte impegno per la conformità aziendale, l'integrità e le pratiche di miglioramento continuo Lean Six Sigma
• Procurement & Advanced Systems: Sfondo dimostrato nella strategia di approvvigionamento, nella gestione delle categorie e nell'ERP
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Roche External Manufacturing group (Commercial Drug Substance) is Part of the Roche Drug Substance manufacturing unit, we Partner with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and ensure that relevant production/manufacturing targets are delivered to Roche on-time, to the highest quality and within-budget and that the CMOs operate in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) requirements and Roche corporate standards. The External Manufacturing and Business Operations Manager has two main responsibilities: She/he is the primary relationship manager for specified partner Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) or sites. And She/he also acts as Chief of Staff for the unit, ensures strategy deployment is well executed, and carries ownership of the Performance management process for the group. The Opportunity: You act as the primary lead and relationship manager for CMOs throughout the entire product Lifecycle, from initial selection and implementation to decommissioning. That means:
• Lead international governance teams across diverse functions such as Quality, MSAT, Supply chain, Legal, and Procurement to ensure organizational alignment during CMO manufacturing, due diligences or Tech Transfers
• Enforce strict adherence to GMP, Quality, and SHE standards while conducting regular risk reviews to proactively address potential supply issues at CMOs
• Serves as the Chief of Staff and advisor to the DS External Manufacturing Head and site leadership team, closely collaborating on efforts to advance the portfolio toward the Drug substance Network vision
• Lead the Performance Management reporting system, including goals/KPIs, PTN Alignment, and the effective execution of weekly, monthly, and Quarterly Business Reviews
• Works closely with Finance and other stakeholders to lead the business planning and track financial performance
• Develops overall strategy for effective communication across teams, and leads and ensures Risk management across DS External Manufacturing, identifying and incorporating mitigation plans into the site's prioritized portfolio Who You Are: We have high expectations around end-to-end thinking and cross functional collaboration in a global network by taking ownership and delegating decisions to the appropriate level. We value an entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to constantly change or adapt in a dynamic environment. We expect you to focus on the most impactful and value adding work by prioritizing your efforts with a clear focus on creating value for the patient. You will be willing to explore new opportunities, be comfortable with ambiguity and taking smart risks, while complying with the latest regulations. Furthermore:
• Education & Core Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Life Sciences (advanced degree preferred) with 10+ years of manufacturing/operations experience within Pharma/Biotech or similarly regulated industries
• Leadership & Project Management: 3+ years leading direct reports or matrixed teams, coupled with 5+ years directing large-scale, complex cross-functional projects (Project Management certification is a plus)
• Technical & Quality Expertise: Deep proficiency in a GMP-regulated environment (specifically biologics drug substance), with a strong commitment to corporate compliance, integrity, and Lean Six Sigma/continuous improvement practices
• Procurement & Advanced Systems: Demonstrated background in sourcing strategy, category management, and ERP s

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Le groupe de fabrication externe de Roche (substances pharmaceutiques commerciales) fait partie de l'unité de fabrication de la substance médicamenteuse de Roche, nous collaborons avec des organismes de fabrication sous contrat (OCM) et nous veillons à ce que les objectifs pertinents de production et de fabrication soient livrés à Roche à temps, à la plus haute qualité et dans les limites du budget, et que les OCM fonctionnent conformément aux exigences actuelles des bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et aux normes de Roche. Le gestionnaire externe de la fabrication et des opérations commerciales a deux responsabilités principales : il est le principal gestionnaire de relations pour les organismes ou les sites de fabrication à contrat de partenaires déterminés. Elle est également chef d'état-major de l'unité, elle veille à ce que le déploiement de la stratégie soit bien exécuté et elle est propriétaire du processus de gestion du rendement pour le groupe. La possibilité : Vous êtes le principal responsable et gestionnaire de relations pour les OCM tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, de la sélection et de la mise en œuvre initiales au déclassement. Cela signifie :
• Diriger les équipes de gouvernance internationale dans diverses fonctions telles que la qualité, le MSAT, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les services juridiques et les achats afin d'assurer l'alignement organisationnel pendant la fabrication des OCM, les diligences dues ou les transferts de technologie
• Appliquer le strict respect des BPF, de la qualité et des normes de la SHE tout en procédant régulièrement à des examens des risques afin de s'attaquer de façon proactive aux problèmes d'approvisionnement potentiels des OCM
• Chef de cabinet et conseiller auprès de l'équipe de direction de DS External Manufacturing Chef et chef de site, collaborant étroitement aux efforts visant à faire progresser le portefeuille vers la vision du Réseau des substances médicamenteuses
• Diriger le système d'établissement de rapports sur la gestion du rendement, y compris les objectifs/ICP, l'alignement des NPT et l'exécution efficace des examens hebdomadaires, mensuels et trimestriels des activités;
• Collabore étroitement avec les Finances et d'autres parties prenantes pour diriger la planification des activités et suivre la performance financière
• Élaborer une stratégie globale pour une communication efficace entre les équipes, diriger et assurer la gestion des risques dans l'ensemble de la fabrication externe DS, identifier et intégrer des plans d'atténuation dans le portefeuille prioritaire du site Qui vous êtes : Nous avons des attentes élevées concernant la pensée de bout en bout et la collaboration interfonctionnelle dans un réseau mondial en prenant en main et en déléguant les décisions au niveau approprié. Nous apprécions un état d'esprit d'entreprise avec la capacité de changer constamment ou de s'adapter dans un environnement dynamique. Nous espérons que vous vous concentrerez sur le travail le plus efficace et le plus intéressant en priorisant vos efforts en mettant clairement l'accent sur la création de valeur pour le patient. Vous serez prêt à explorer de nouvelles opportunités, être à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté et prendre des risques intelligents, tout en respectant les dernières réglementations. En outre:
• Éducation et expérience de base: Baccalauréat en génie ou en sciences de la vie (diplôme avancé préféré) avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience de fabrication/opérations au sein de Pharma/Biotech ou des industries réglementées de la même manière
• Leadership et gestion de projets : 3 ans et plus de rapports directs ou d'équipes matricielles, associés à 5 ans et plus de projets interfonctionnels complexes à grande échelle (la certification de gestion de projets est un plus)
• Expertise technique et de qualité : Compétence approfondie dans un environnement réglementé par les BPF (spécialement une substance médicamenteuse biologique), avec un engagement ferme en matière de conformité, d'intégrité et de Lean Six Sigma/pratiques d'amélioration continue
• Achats et systèmes avancés : expérience démontrée en matière de stratégie d'approvisionnement, de gestion de catégorie et de PGI

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solution Management Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising solutions with multiple components (digital, physical, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As Business Solution Management Associate , you will support us in addressing the challenges in commercializing these integrated solutions. One of our key initiatives in commercializing integrated solutions with country organizations is the multi-year Stronger Solution Selling (S3) program . You will support the S3 core team in delivering strategic workshops with country organizations and optimizing essential solution-selling assets to help cross-functional affiliate teams better navigate Roche Diagnostic’s physical, digital, and service portfolios. This role offers a blend of project management and process refinement, providing a unique platform to shape how the organization delivers tailored value to its customers worldwide. Main responsibilities As a Business Solution Management Associate, you will help us in bridging the gap between strategic methodology and operational execution. Over the course of your one-year assignment, your core responsibilities will include:
• Project Management & Delivery : Take ownership of assigned tasks with a focus on structuring complexity and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
• Affiliate Support & Collaboration : Directly assist the S3 Core Team in driving activities with country organizations and country clusters.
• Asset & Tool Optimization : Refine existing and develop new solution-selling tools to help teams better navigate Roche’s physical and digital offerings.
• Change Management : Support ongoing activities aimed at sustaining the organizational shift toward effective solution selling.
• Process Improvement : Potentially step up into a process improvement project to refine workflows, systems, or insights that improve the effectiveness of solution selling. How would your day to day look like? As Business Solution Management Associate , you'll work closely with team members in the S3 core team, as well as subregional and country teams. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders for driving improvements in solution commercialization. Your day-to-day will be dynamic and diverse, and could begin by coordinating with the S3 Core Team to support global affiliates and manage project deliverables. You might spend the morning organizing workshops or refining assets that help teams navigate Roche's complex solution portfolio. This involves a high degree of ownership, as you structure complex information into clear, high-quality tools for country organizations. In the afternoon, you shift focus toward process optimization and change management. You might analyze workflows to improve solution-selling insights or collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure the S3 methodology is effectively embedded across the region. Each day concludes by ensuring all project milestones are on track, balancing technical learning with a proactive, delivery-f

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role Roche is the world’s largest biotech company, with truly differentiated medicines in oncology, immunology, infectious diseases, ophthalmology and diseases of the central nervous system. Roche is also the world leader in-vitro diagnostics and tissue-based cancer diagnostics, and a frontrunner in diabetes management. The Diagnostics Insights Solutions Team is part of Roche Diagnostics . We focus on developing and commercialising larger solutions with multiple components (digital products, physical products, and service offerings) to create value beyond individual products by comprehensively addressing customer needs. As a Technical Solution Management Associate you will act as a bridge between business needs and technical implementation of our solutions portfolio. You will work hand in hand with our team and different Solution Teams in the organization to support them with the automation of processes, contributing to the alignment with organizational objectives. Your main area of responsibility will be the application of Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence technologies to design and develop tailored tools to bring the end-to-end management of digital solutions to the next level. Main responsibilities As a Technical Solution Management Associate, your core responsibilities will include:
• Contribution to Ideation and Design: Actively participate in the ideation, analysis, and evaluation of solutions within the team's scope with the objective of optimizing processes and augmenting transparency and traceability with data.
• Process Optimization Tool Development: Identify opportunities for improvement and enhance solution management by leveraging data analytics and AI tools for diverse stakeholder groups (e.g., solution teams, affiliate members, or the broader organization). Additionally, identify inefficient processes and create tools to automate or streamline them.
• Team management (e.g. lean portfolio management, Aha! Automation, etc.)
• Technical solution management (e.g. requirements, version control,...)
• End-to-End solution management (e.g. coordination of solutions portfolio, traceability,...)
• Solution Lifecycle Management Support: Assisting with the administrative and documentation tasks related to the different stages of the lifecycle of complex software solutions.
• Reporting and Metrics Creation: Supporting the creation of data-driven tools to track the performance and adoption of key organizational solutions.
• Sustainable Development: Define the necessary maintenance and sustainability tasks to ensure the continued relevance and accuracy of the developed tools by e.g. enabling seamless retraining with new or updated training data. How would your day to day look like? As Technical Solution Management Associate in the Diagnostics Insights Solutions team, you'll work closely with our team members (Business Solution Managers and Technical Solution Managers) as well as cross-functional partners from across the organization. This role offers a great opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, including product managers, marketing leads, definition teams, engineering teams and subject matter experts. The successful candidate will play a dual role, handling management and administrative support tasks related to organizational solutions, while also developing and implementing tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our internal processes. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position What we do: The Demand to Pay (D2P) department brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with end-to-end D2P services & solutions tailored to their needs. The D2P teams provide customer service to Roche affiliates on D2P systems and processes (Accounts Payable, Payment Management, Order & Contract Management), ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with our customer-focused principles. We are a team that works very closely together to ensure good employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Your day to day responsibilities are : As an Accounts Payable Intern you are supporting the Roche-site in Budapest. Our team handles bills for all Roche employees working in mainly Europe and manages administration of all accounts payable related processes. In this function, you will contribute actively to dealing with complex processes and issues in the area of ​​accounts payable. Our former Accounts Payable Intern has progressed to a new exciting role and now we are seeking a talented and highly motivated individual who will shape the future of this challenging function. Our team is diverse, with members of different educational backgrounds and levels of experience. We offer a flexible working framework ( 2 office days/week on average ). As an Intern, you:
• Support AP invoice resolution
• Handle documents
• Work together closely with the Accounts Payable department. What can you bring to our team: ​ We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. In order to provide innovative healthcare solutions to our patients, we need the best talent in our organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you are currently studying in University/College on a day-time schedule . You have English and Hungarian language knowledge . Furthermore you have the following skills and qualifications:
• You have good communication skills
• You are available to work 25-30 hours on a weekly basis
• You are accurate and you like to work in a team. In exchange we provide you with: We offer you a strategic opportunity in a truly international work environment with high-profile colleagues and excellent in-house learning and networking opportunities, plus lots of flexibility to make your mark at Roche. We will make sure your daily work will make an impact and you will be able to learn a lot along the way.
• Valuable professional experience
• Competitive salary
• Flexible working hours according to your studies
• Support for university thesis writing
• Training opportunities
• Good, accessible location
• Great, people-focused company culture
• Young, diverse and dynamic environment
• Social events & team-building opportunities
• Opportunity for full time role after graduation Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unsere Mission Als Produktionsteam an unserem Standort Penzberg verfolgen wir ein gemeinsames Ziel: Menschen weltweit zuverlässig mit lebenswichtigen Medikamenten zu versorgen – sicher, effizient und mit höchstem Qualitätsanspruch. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, treiben neue Ideen voran und entwickeln uns stetig weiter – für unsere Patient:innen weltweit. Deine Rolle als People Lead Wir suchen People Leader (m/w/d) mit Macher-Qualitäten, die die Prozesse hinterfragen, Dinge proaktiv anpacken und als Servant Leader Teamgeist, Respekt und Vertrauen in unserer Organisation aktiv fördern. Vor allem kommt es uns darauf an, dass diese Position von jemandem mit einer positiv denkenden, lösungsorientierten, integren und selbstreflektierten Persönlichkeit ausgefüllt wird. Was Dich erwartet In dieser Position geht es nicht einfach nur darum, eine Führungskraft zu sein. Es geht vielmehr darum, als positives Beispiel voranzugehen und die neue Führungskultur erlebbar zu machen. Mitarbeitende werden von Dir disziplinarisch geführt und gefördert, um Fachexpertisen aufrechtzuerhalten und vor allem um der Organisation dabei zu helfen, heute zu leisten, was unsere Patienten morgen brauchen!
• Die konzeptionelle Ausrichtung sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung der Leistung des Teams, die Begleitung des Teams bei Veränderungen legen wir vertrauensvoll in Deine Hände.
• Du wendest LPS-Methoden (z.B. Gemba-Walks o.ä.) an, überträgst Verantwortungen im Sinne eines proaktiven “empowern” und richtest die Teamziele strategisch aus, um somit das Servant-Leadership-Konzept erlebbar zu machen.
• Coaching, Check-Ins, Weiterentwicklung, Fördern und Fordern sowie Motivieren sind Bestandteil Deiner täglichen Arbeit.
• Du sorgst für ein sicheres Arbeitsumfeld und gehst im Bereich SHE als gutes Beispiel voran.
• Als Change Agent gestaltest Du aktiv unsere Zukunft mit und begleitest Mitarbeitende bei Veränderungen.
• Die Motivation des Teams und eines jeden Mitarbeitenden ist uns ein besonderes Anliegen, daher ist es ebenso wichtig, dass das Team-Zusammenspiel von Dir empathisch begleitet und permanent entwickelt wird. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Tech Supervisors wird auch die Fachexpertise des Teams ausgerichtet und weiterentwickelt.
• Du bist verantwortlich für die Ressourcen- und die Kapazitätsplanung Deines Bereichs. Wer Du bist Du hast starkes Interesse diese Position kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, Ideen einzubringen, neue Wege miteinander zu gehen und diese gemeinsam zu diskutieren und umzusetzen. Für die Stelle bringst Du außerdem ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, einen Meistertitel oder eine abgeschlossene Technikerausbildung mit und hast erste Berufserfahrung in einer Führungsrolle mit Personalverantwortung, vorteilhaft in einem pharmazeutischen Umfeld sammeln können.
• Du hast ein intrinsisches Interesse daran Prozesse zu verstehen, setzt diese in einen Kontext und richtest Dein Handeln an dem Verständnis aus - Erfahrungen in der Durchführung von pharmazeutischen Produktionsprozessen und den begleitenden Qualitätsprozessen sind dabei von Vorteil.
• Deine Stärken liegen in der Beziehungsgestaltung (Mensch) und einer guten Komplexitätsverarbeitung (Überblick / Verstehen).
• Du verstehst Dich selbst als "Inspirierenden Leader", bist fähig situativ zu führen, nimmst Menschen mit, begeisterst und es gelingt Dir, sicherzustellen, dass alle die gleiche Strategie und Ziele verfolgen und als Team zusammenarbeiten.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Il laboratorio scolastico EXPERIO Roche entusiasma tutte le classi scolastiche con vari workshop nella zona STEM e accoglie ogni anno circa 2’500 visitatori. Come parte del team di laboratorio scolastico, sarete coinvolti in varie attività e progetti per consentire agli studenti: oltre che agli insegnanti di offrire una varietà di offerte. La possibilità
• Creare workshop creativi: parteciperai attivamente alla preparazione e al follow-up di diversi workshop nell'area STEM (matematica, informatica, scienze naturali e tecnologia) e porterà le tue idee.
• Condurre i vostri progetti: avrete l'opportunità di progettare e realizzare sub-aree o anche interi workshop in modo indipendente, dimostrando le vostre competenze.
• Promuovere l'innovazione: Diventa parte del team di laboratorio scolastico e supportaci nello sviluppo di nuove offerte innovative per ispirare ancora più giovani per gli argomenti STEM.
• Assicurare un ambiente liscio: aiuta a mantenere l'infrastruttura e l'inventario in laboratorio e il workshop in contatto in modo che tutti possano lavorare in modo ottimale.
• Benvenuto ai visitatori: sostenere il supporto di vari gruppi di visitatori e presentare il mondo emozionante di EXPERIO Roche.
• Networking e apprendimento: lavorare in progetti multidisciplinari e multiprofessionali di formazione professionale e ampliare la rete.
• Roche rappresenta: rappresenta il dipartimento di formazione professionale in varie fiere e ispira giovani talenti per una carriera a Roche. Chi sei La vostra passione per la MINT incontra il nostro entusiasmo per l'educazione. Se ti trovi nella seguente descrizione, hai ragione con noi:
• Studenti con entusiasmo: Sei attualmente iscritto a un'università o università in un programma di scapolo o utilizzare un anno intermedio per guidarti professionalmente e acquisire esperienza preziosa.
• Enthusiast STEM o educatore aspirante: studi in una zona STEM o pedagogia/insegnante e desideri trasmettere le tue conoscenze ai giovani talenti.
• Testa creativa: si desidera introdurre le proprie idee e sviluppare attivamente.
• Team player con impegno sociale: ti piace lavorare con i giovani in un ambiente multiculturale
• Gioia nel lavoro pratico
• Esperienze nelle aree STEM e il gruppo target sono vantaggiose
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese
• Creatività, autooccupazione e abilità di squadra La data di inizio è inizio agosto 2026 (100% Pensum) ed è preferito per 12 mesi. Per tener conto della domanda, deve essere presentata almeno un CV corrente e una lettera di motivazione. Studenti non UE/non-EFTA: un certificato della loro università deve fornire che lo stage è una parte obbligatoria del grado. Il luogo offerto non è adatto per eseguire una tesi o una tesi di diploma. Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La Global Supply Chain and Product Strategy Organization (PTS) collega senza soluzione di continuità i mercati alla rete di produzione globale, gestendo la pianificazione dell'inventario, dell'offerta e del rifornimento. Organizziamo i flussi di valore tra i siti e le affiliate bilanciando la domanda e l'offerta, e garantiamo il corretto adempimento dell'ordine e la consegna dei farmaci attraverso la rete globale. Inoltre, siamo anche responsabili per le strategie di prodotto, leader nella progettazione di prodotti e catene di fornitura in linea con strategie di go-to-market e garantire la salute dei nostri prodotti. Siamo un'organizzazione agile con chiare responsabilità e una cultura orientata allo scopo che è costruita sulla fiducia e sulla collaborazione, dove le persone sono ispirate a creare soluzioni e sviluppare le capacità necessarie per fornire la nostra missione. L'organizzazione Supply Chain Insights and Performance all'interno di PTS è fondata per guidare l'orchestrazione a livello aziendale, le migliori pratiche di benchmark e accelerare l'ottimizzazione delle prestazioni attraverso i nostri flussi di valore end-to-end. Operando come pilastro centrale all'interno di questo dipartimento, il team di Supply Chain Excellence si concentra sull'integrazione di una cultura permanente del miglioramento continuo, del processo decisionale basato sui dati e della creazione di capacità organizzative. L'opportunità Come lead di eccellenza della supply chain, si riferirà direttamente al capo di eccellenza della supply chain. In questo ruolo, si agirà come agente di cambiamento chiave, identificare le sfide operative e implementare miglioramenti sostenibili e ad alto impatto sulla supply chain globale. Le tue responsabilità specifiche includono:
• Proseguire iniziative di miglioramento continuo e guidare l'efficienza operativa attraverso processi di supply chain end-to-end utilizzando metodologie Lean e Six Sigma.
• Promuovere una cultura del miglioramento continuo e dell'apprendimento, mentre l'orchestrazione di capacità operative di eccellenza costruzione attraverso la supply chain.
• Identificare e privilegiare le opportunità di miglioramento, le principali iniziative di performance aziendali utilizzando il framework DMAIC, e incorporando tali miglioramenti in modo pulito nei processi e sistemi della supply chain.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. The Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) at Roche Diagnostics Denmark will lead serves as a key business partner to the commercial organization. As the FEP Lead, you will act as a trusted thought partner across the entire value chain, leveraging your financial expertise and deep business understanding to drive strategies that deliver value for our customers, the affiliate, and the wider enterprise. In this pivotal role, where you will be reporting to Head of Finance and Operation, Roche Diagnostics Denmark - will have a team of specialists and experts, specifically overseeing a team of FEPs and Finance Excellence Partners (FxPs), while also holding dotted-line management responsibility for the Tender Manager. Your Impact Leadership & Team Management
• Leads a team of specialists/experts, adapting plans and priorities to address resource and operational challenges.
• Role models the role of a leader as visionary, architect, catalyst and coach (VACC) and lives the Roche operating principles.
• Creates a psychologically safe environment and culture necessary for the team to be successful.
• Supports network building across the organization (including the Finance Excellence Partner) to share best practices and co-create solutions.
• Empowers decision-making at the lowest level, enabling team members to come up with innovative designs and solutions. Tender Management & Commercial Strategy
• Architects robust process and financial rigor into tenders, acting as a dotted-line manager to the Tender Manager to ensure highly competitive and profitable bids.
• Playsan active part in ensuring sustainable commercial deals by considering risk evaluation, competitor assumptions and implementing sustainable pricing strategies.
• Serves as a key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy and commercial business related processes such as business planning and opportunity prioritization.
• Supports the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency. Financial & Operational Rigor
• Acts as a key guide for P&L and financial target achievement. This involves close monitoring of the numbers, from top-line to bottom-line, and providing direction on accounting implications.
• Proposes and drive ideas for P&L improvement, especially upsell opportunities, efficiency/waste improvement, and risk reduction.
• Solves problems autonomously with minimal guidance.
• Balances resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities.
• Ensures financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions.
• Monitors and manages customer performance over the whole contract life cycle with a profitability and outcomes based perspective. What You Bring
• Experience in leading, developing and coaching individuals in a team.
• An entrepreneurial, commercial, and customer-centric mindset with an ability to put all available financial and operational information into a holistic picture.
• An understanding of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) to be able to guide the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow implications of decisions for the sales affiliate
• Strong business and financial acumen, coupled with experience partnering with stakeholders.
• Strong analytical skills and a data-d

Driven by groundbreaking innovation, greater patient empowerment, and the expanding wealth of medical information, our ecosystem is adapting to new challenges and heightened demands on public resources. As an Disease Area Partner, you will work locally, deeply integrated within the healthcare community, focusing exclusively on building meaningful stakeholder relationships without the constraints of sales targets or incentives. This allows you to focus entirely on delivering impactful, needs-based support for patients and healthcare providers. Your Impact
• Steward Roche’s products through their lifecycle and support their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner
• Implement campaigns with customers and distribute promotional materials as per marketing plan and customer needs
• Organize group meetings in major hospitals
• Propose new ideas related to campaigns, promotional material to the pod and are responsible for the implementation after approval.
• Gathering Data & Insights from the market that would help the pod to make decisions.
• The DA partner focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Identifies important customers and keeps customer Personas up-to-date.
• Continuously revises and updates the customer list & no. of patients in cooperation with the pod.
• Positively participates in Internal meetings to review and discuss: achievements, Opportunities/challenges, Competitors activities.
• Reporting Adverse Events to the Local Safety Unite within Roche timelines.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who you are
• You bring 1-2 years of experience within the pharmaceutical industry.
• You have good business acumen, with desired experience in commercialization, medical, and customer experience excellence, and can leverage digital tools effectively
• You demonstrate a personal commitment to improving the patient journey, with a strong drive to create value and impact on the ecosystem
• You embody a strategic vision to enhance patient journeys and embed this within your actions
• You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, continuously seeking opportunities to innovate and contribute
• You maintain a growth mindset, learning and unlearning rapidly, experimenting, and sharing insights within and beyond Roche
• You display integrity in every action, upholding honesty, ethics, and authenticity
• You bring excellent stakeholder engagement skills, effectively partnering with therapeutic area experts (TAEs), organizations, and ideally with patient advocacy groups (PAGs)
• You are fluent in the local language and proficient in English, facilitating collaboration across Roche’s broader enterprise. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• 業務内容
• ・検査機器の設置時のアプリケーションセットアップ業務
• ・検査試薬を用いた正確なデータ取得のためのサポート業務
• ・医師・コメディカルとのコミュニケーションを通じた関係構築と当社製品の情報提供及び拡販活動
• （病院内、検査センター内向けの勉強会の実施等を含む）
• ・機器 / 試薬販売における営業へのサポート業務 特定の施設への定期訪問というよりは、自身の専門領域＆担当エリアにおいて、施設担当の営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職からの依頼。及び電話一次対応のカスタマーサポートからの依頼で、病院や検査センターに訪問となります。ルーチン的な業務に追われるのではなく、営業職（DMR）やフィールドサービスエンジニア職よりも検査に関して高度な専門性を持つ役割として、高い責任感を持ち、検査室の検査の質や生産性向上に貢献いただく業務です。 応募条件
• 【必須（MUST）】
• ・普通自動車運転免許および運転経験を有し、以下、1〜4いずれかのご経験者
• ・全国転勤可であること
• 1：臨床検査技師資格を有し、病院、または検査センターでの検体検査の実務経験があり、個別化医療に関わり、顧客の臨床検査の価値向上への志向をお持ちの方
• ※遺伝子検査、免疫・生化学検査、病理検査の経験者が好ましいですが、ヘマトロジー検査、尿検査、血液凝固検査など幅広く歓迎

• 收集、反馈药品临床使用情况、药品不良反应及临床需求等信息 B 学科建设
• 访问临床及病理医生，按时按质的完成相关客户(尤其重点专家)对于疾病领域洞见的收集进行总结、分析和反馈
• 组织、协调并整合各类治疗领域学术会议，推动建立治疗领域治疗规范 C 疾病全程管理

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At the heart of Product Development Data Sciences (PDD) lies a mission to redefine what’s possible in healthcare through data. To achieve this, we need a backbone of strategic discipline and operational agility. As a key member of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, you will do more than manage processes, you will champion an innovation mindset, driving the evolution of our operating model and facilitating the strategies (such as in silico and 3D) that represent the future of medicine. Join us to help harmonize our strategic efforts and turn complex challenges into coordinated progress. By connecting enterprise priorities with operational realities, BSO drives consistency, clarity, and coordinated progress across PDD and the broader development organization. The Opportunity:
• You partner with sub-functional leaders to drive connectivity and coordinate planned and ad-hoc PDD-wide and functional strategic efforts in alignment with PDD priorities
• You drive key initiatives impacting the organization’s strategic and operating model, using an enterprise and innovation mindset
• You facilitate structured planning and reporting activities across sub-functions, proactively identifying and resolving issues in a dynamic and fast-paced setting to support the execution of strategies such as in silico and 3D
• You navigate high ambiguity and complexity, proactively driving clarity, alignment, and prioritization across multiple stakeholders and initiatives
• You operate with a continuous improvement mindset to proactively identify process gaps and opportunities for improved alignment, communications, and resource across key planned and ad-hoc efforts with a bias for action
• You independently organize and manage recurring leadership meetings (including Quant Team), develop agendas, and document and support the drive and follow-through of outcomes and next steps
• You maintain tools for initiative tracking, performance monitoring, and cross-functional alignment
• You lead or co-lead preparation of communications and presentations for functional updates, governance forums, senior leadership reviews, and evolving sub-functional or PDD-wide requirements in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, life sciences, public health, or data sciences
• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic operations, business planning, or project management in pharma or healthcare settings; or an advanced degree with 5 years of equivalent work experience
• You demonstrate ability to independently lead initiatives, manage planning cycles, and facilitate leadership forums
• You are familiar with data- and R&D-oriented operating models and cross-functional execution
• You have capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You have excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language Preferred:
• Prior experience managing operational workstreams or planning cycles within life sciences or data-focused environments
• Working knowledg

As a key member of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, you will do more than manage processes, you will champion an innovation mindset, driving the evolution of our operating model and facilitating the strategies (such as in silico and 3D) that represent the future of medicine. Join us to help harmonize our strategic efforts and turn complex challenges into coordinated progress. By connecting enterprise priorities with operational realities, BSO drives consistency, clarity, and coordinated progress across PDD and the broader development organization. The Opportunity:
• You partner with sub-functional leaders to drive connectivity and coordinate planned and ad-hoc PDD-wide and functional strategic efforts in alignment with PDD priorities
• You drive key initiatives impacting the organization’s strategic and operating model, using an enterprise and innovation mindset
• You facilitate structured planning and reporting activities across sub-functions, proactively identifying and resolving issues in a dynamic and fast-paced setting to support the execution of strategies such as in silico and 3D
• You navigate high ambiguity and complexity, proactively driving clarity, alignment, and prioritization across multiple stakeholders and initiatives
• You operate with a continuous improvement mindset to proactively identify process gaps and opportunities for improved alignment, communications, and resource across key planned and ad-hoc efforts with a bias for action
• You independently organize and manage recurring leadership meetings (including Quant Team), develop agendas, and document and support the drive and follow-through of outcomes and next steps
• You maintain tools for initiative tracking, performance monitoring, and cross-functional alignment
• You lead or co-lead preparation of communications and presentations for functional updates, governance forums, senior leadership reviews, and evolving sub-functional or PDD-wide requirements in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, life sciences, public health, or data sciences
• You have a minimum of 5 years of experience in strategic operations, business planning, or project management in pharma or healthcare settings; or an advanced degree with 5 years of equivalent work experience
• You demonstrate ability to independently lead initiatives, manage planning cycles, and facilitate leadership forums
• You are familiar with data- and R&D-oriented operating models and cross-functional execution
• You have capacity for independent thinking and ability to make decisions based upon sound principles
• You have excellent strategic agility including problem-solving and critical thinking skills, and agility that extends beyond technical domain
• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You have excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language Preferred:
• Prior experience managing operational workstreams or planning cycles within life sciences or data-focused environments
• Working knowledg

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Principle Roles & Responsibilities / Accountabilities Technical responsibilities
• Oversee and guide the technical strategy and direction of validation activities for PT Shanghai in the preparation and execution of validation protocols, including facility, utilities, equipment, cleaning, and computer system validation.
• Review and approve site Validation Master Plan (VMP)/project plans and ensure the strategy meets business and regulatory requirements. As needed, review/approve validation protocols, engineering change orders, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP), engineering commissioning and turnover packages.
• Provide input and review for site-specific and corporate validation procedures and shared practices as applicable and in accordance with the requirements set forth in the governing quality standards in partnership with Global Quality.
• Oversee and guide execution of the validation of tech transfer oversight, new facility expansions and construction projects.
• Review and approve all relevant Quality Validation and other Site documentation and ensure documentation supports a compliant state.
• Provide expert interpretation and application of regulatory guidelines to ensure operations, facilities and documentation meet Roche standards and regulatory requirements.
• ensuring that the department ensures quality oversight of the qualification and validation processes. This applies across the entire lifecycle of the processes and equipment. This includes:
• Plant qualification of production equipment and the entire infrastructure (pharmaceutical water, HVAC, process gases).
• Validation of production, cleaning and transport processes
• Validation of computer systems and software (CSV), including ensuring current data integrity requirements.
• Oversight of product and process transfers from or to other locations and partners
• Other activities assigned. Leadership responsibilities
• Establish and lead a competitive team to ensure the delivery and good performance through strong team work and shared responsibilities
• Create an environment of strong team spirit, timely and effective communications, sense of urgency, high motivation and inspire teams to achieve goals in the immediate and longer term. Be an active and visible change agent, promoting flexible and open mindsets to new opportunities.
• As a leader within the Quality Leadership team, drive network activities and alignment, cross-functional planning, and decision making. Qualification and Experience Education/Qualifications
• Bachelor Degree or above (Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical, bioengineering, Chemistry or other relevant discipline is preferred). Leadership Competencies
• Leads by example
• Strong leadership, teamwork and management skills
• Ability to effectively communicate and influence across all levels of the organization
• Good accountability of problem solving
• Empower and trust people to make decisions
• Discover and develop the potential in people Job Required Competencies
• 10 or more years' work experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry
• 3 or more years' people management experience
• 5 or more years' experience in a commercially licensed GMP facility Knowledge/Skills/Competencies
• Expert knowledge of Quality System, Quality Validation and QA principles, practices and standards for the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device related product operations including local and international qual

• 成长性思维和快速学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
• 优秀的沟和资源整合能力
• 合作伙伴及大客户管理能力 工作年限 •5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先 •有跨职能、或者治疗领域经验优先 教育程度/所获资格证书 •医学或药学相关本科及以上学历 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
