descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Istituto di Biologia Umana (IHB), incorporato all'interno della Divisione Ricerca e Sviluppo Anticipato di Roche, è un istituto di ricerca leader incentrato sull'accelerazione dello sviluppo di farmaci trasformativi. Si specializza nello sviluppo di nuovi e robusti sistemi di modello umano che assomigliano funzionale alla fisiologia e alla malattia umana. Separando il divario tra la scoperta accademica e l'applicazione industriale, IHB facilita la rapida traduzione della scienza innovativa in soluzioni orientate ai pazienti. L'opportunità Stiamo costruendo modelli renali umani di nuova generazione affrontando un problema centrale non risolto nel campo: come generare organotipi, organoidi renali vascolarizzati che mostrano una maggiore maturazione. Come parte di una borsa IHB appena finanziata, guiderai un ambizioso programma di ricerca all'interfaccia di biologia delle cellule staminali, biologia vascolare e genomica monocellulare, con l'obiettivo di creare sistemi traduttivamente rilevanti per la scoperta e la sicurezza della droga. In questo ruolo, definirete approcci innovativi per scoprire i principi biologici dell'interazione vascolare-parenchimale, contribuendo infine a stabilire una nuova classe di sistemi di modello umano attraverso le seguenti responsabilità:
• Guidare lo sviluppo di organoidi renali derivati da iPSC vascolarizzati, con un focus sulle specifiche del tessuto e la maturazione
• Utilizzare genomica a singola cella per dissezionare le specifiche endoteliali, la maturazione del nefro e la comunicazione cellulare
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i bioingegneria per integrare la biologia in sistemi di cultura profusi e di prossima generazione
• Tradurre intuizioni biologiche in modelli funzionali e predittivi rilevanti per la sicurezza dei reni umani Chi sei
• Uno scienziato con un dottorato di ricerca e un forte record di traccia nei modelli 3D derivati da iPSC o organoidi. Per qualificarsi per questa posizione di primo soccorso, devi aver completato gli studi di dottorato negli ultimi quattro anni.
• Sperimentato nella generazione e nell'analisi di dati transcriptomici monocellulari e nella comoda traduzione di set di dati complessi in una visione biologica
• Scientificamente ambizioso, con la capacità di guidare nuovi concetti piuttosto che seguire i protocolli stabiliti
• Idealmente con un forte background in biologia dello sviluppo, con esperienza in sistemi di organi renali, vascolari o correlati Informazioni aggiuntive Sarete incorporati in un ecosistema altamente interdisciplinare in IHB, lavorando con i principali esperti in bioingegneria, biologia delle cellule staminali e analisi computazionali, e strettamente collegati ai team di scoperta e sicurezza della droga di Roche. Questa è un'opportunità unica per definire come i modelli renali umani sono costruiti e utilizzati in futuro, dalla biologia fondamentale all'impatto diretto sullo sviluppo della droga. Processo di applicazione Per applicare, si prega di inviare i seguenti materiali:
• CV attuale: Si prega di fornire un CV completo, tra cui un elenco completo delle pubblicazioni peer-reviewed.
• Riferimenti professionali: Includere i dettagli di contatto per due riferimenti che possono parlare con la vostra competenza scientifica e carattere professionale.
• Ph.D. Documentazione: Fornire un diploma ufficiale o un certificato che confermi il diploma (se già ottenuto).
• Timeline & Disponibilità: La data di inizio di questa posizione è 1 settembre 2026. La durata iniziale è di 2 anni, con il potenziale di estensione. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Institute of Human Biology (IHB), embedded within Roche’s Pharma Research and Early Development (pRED) Division, is a leading research institute focused on accelerating the development of transformative medicines. It specializes in developing novel and robust human model systems that functionally resemble human physiology and disease. By bridging the gap between academic discovery and industrial application, IHB facilitates the rapid translation of groundbreaking science into patient-focused solutions. The Opportunity We are building next-generation human kidney models by tackling a central unsolved problem in the field: how to generate organotypic, vascularized kidney organoids that show enhanced maturation. As part of a newly funded IHB fellowship, you will drive an ambitious research program at the interface of stem cell biology, vascular biology, and single-cell genomics, with the goal of creating translationally relevant systems for drug discovery and safety. In this role, you will define innovative approaches to uncover the biological principles of vascular–parenchymal interaction, ultimately helping to establish a new class of human model systems through the following responsibilities:
• Drive the development of vascularized iPSC-derived kidney organoids, with a focus on tissue specification and maturation
• Use single-cell genomics to dissect endothelial specification, nephron maturation, and cell–cell communication
• Work closely with bioengineers to integrate biology into perfusable, next-generation culture systems
• Translate biological insights into functional, predictive models relevant for human kidney safety Who You Are
• A scientist with a PhD and a strong track record in iPSC-derived 3D tissue models or organoids. To qualify for this early-career position, you must have completed your doctoral studies within the last four years.
• Experienced in generating and analysing single-cell transcriptomic data and comfortable translating complex datasets into biological insight
• Scientifically ambitious, with the ability to drive new concepts rather than follow established protocols
• Ideally with a strong background in developmental biology, with expertise in kidney, vascular, or related organ systems Additional Information You will be embedded in a highly interdisciplinary ecosystem at IHB, working with leading experts in bioengineering, stem cell biology, and computational analysis, and closely connected to Roche’s drug discovery and safety teams. This is a unique opportunity to define how human kidney models are built and used in the future—from fundamental biology to direct impact on drug development. • Current CV: Please provide a comprehensive CV, including a full list of your peer-reviewed publications.
• Professional References: Include contact details for two references who can speak to your scientific expertise and professional character.
• Ph.D. Documentation: Provide an official diploma or certificate confirming your degree (if already obtained).
• Timeline & Availability: The start date of this position is 1st September 2026. The initial duration is for 2 years, with the potential for extension. • Übersetzen Sie biologische Einblicke in funktionelle, prädiktive Modelle, die für die menschliche Nierensicherheit relevant sind Wer bist du?

• Erlebt bei der Generierung und Analyse von einzelligen transkriptomischen Daten und komfortabler Übersetzung komplexer Datensätze in biologische Erkenntnisse
• Wissenschaftlich ambitioniert, mit der Fähigkeit, neue Konzepte anzutreiben, anstatt etablierte Protokolle zu folgen
• Ideal mit einem starken Hintergrund in der Entwicklungsbiologie, mit Expertise in Nieren-, Gefäß- oder verwandten Organsystemen Weitere Informationen Sie werden in ein hochinterdisziplinäres Ökosystem der IHB eingebettet, das mit führenden Experten in der Biotechnik, Stammzellbiologie und rechnergestützten Analyse und eng mit den Pharma-Entdeckungs- und Sicherheitsteams von Roche verbunden ist. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'Institut de biologie humaine (IHB), qui fait partie intégrante de la Division de la recherche et du développement précoce (PRED) de Roches Pharma, est un institut de recherche de premier plan axé sur l'accélération du développement des médicaments transformateurs. Il se spécialise dans le développement de systèmes de modèles humains nouveaux et robustes qui ressemblent fonctionnellement à la physiologie et à la maladie humaines. En comblant l'écart entre la découverte académique et l'application industrielle, l'IHB facilite la traduction rapide de la science révolutionnaire en solutions axées sur le patient. L'opportunité Nous construisons des modèles rénaux humains de nouvelle génération en s'attaquant à un problème central non résolu dans le domaine : comment générer des organoides rénaux organotypiques et vasculaires qui montrent une maturation accrue. Dans le cadre d'une bourse nouvellement financée de la DGSI, vous dirigerez un ambitieux programme de recherche à l'interface de la biologie des cellules souches, de la biologie vasculaire et de la génomique monocellulaire, dans le but de créer des systèmes translationnels pertinents pour la découverte et l'innocuité des médicaments. Dans ce rôle, vous définirez des approches novatrices pour découvrir les principes biologiques de l'interaction vasculaire-parenchymique, en fin de compte aider à établir une nouvelle classe de systèmes modèles humains par les responsabilités suivantes:
• Favoriser le développement d'organoïdes rénaux dérivés de l'iPSC vasculaires, en mettant l'accent sur la spécification des tissus et la maturation
• Utilisez la génomique monocellulaire pour disséquer les spécifications endothéliales, la maturation du néphron et la communication cellulaire
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les bioingénieurs pour intégrer la biologie dans les systèmes culturels perfusables de la prochaine génération
• Traduire les connaissances biologiques en modèles fonctionnels et prédictifs pertinents pour la sécurité rénale humaine Qui vous êtes
• Un scientifique avec un doctorat et une solide expérience dans les modèles de tissus 3D ou organoïdes dérivés de l'iPSC. Pour être admissible à ce poste de début de carrière, vous devez avoir terminé vos études de doctorat au cours des quatre dernières années.
• Expérience dans la production et l'analyse de données transcriptomiques monocellulaires et la traduction confortable de ensembles de données complexes en données biologiques
• Scientifiquement ambitieux, avec la capacité de conduire de nouveaux concepts plutôt que de suivre des protocoles établis
• Idéalement avec une solide expérience en biologie du développement, avec une expertise dans les systèmes rénaux, vasculaires ou apparentés Informations complémentaires Vous serez intégré dans un écosystème hautement interdisciplinaire à l'IHB, en collaboration avec des experts de premier plan en bioingénierie, biologie des cellules souches et analyse computationnelle, et étroitement lié aux équipes Roches de découverte de médicaments et de sécurité. Il s'agit d'une occasion unique de définir comment les modèles rénaux humains sont construits et utilisés à l'avenir, de la biologie fondamentale à l'impact direct sur le développement des médicaments. Processus de demande Pour postuler, veuillez soumettre les documents suivants :
• CV actuel: Veuillez fournir un CV complet, y compris une liste complète de vos publications évaluées par les pairs.
• Références professionnelles : Inclure les coordonnées de deux références qui peuvent parler de votre expertise scientifique et de votre caractère professionnel.
• Doctorat : fournir un diplôme ou un certificat officiel confirmant votre diplôme (si déjà obtenu).
• Chronologie et disponibilité: La date de début de cette position est le 1er septembre 2026. La durée initiale est de deux ans, avec un potentiel de prolongation. The Position La persona en este cargo actúa como vínculo de la compañía con las cuentas asignadas para favorecer la imagen corporativa y ofrecer propuestas de valor. Debe administrar las cuentas de manera rentable mediante la planeación de cuotas de venta, manejo de inventarios y negociaciones para cumplir los objetivos. Además, es responsable de desarrollar nuevos modelos de negocio e implementar estrategias para incrementar las ventas en instituciones públicas y privadas, gestionando proyectos con distribuidores y hospitales. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen: ● Lograr los objetivos de venta y participación de mercado mensuales, cuatrimestrales y anuales en las cuentas y territorios asignados. ● Realizar pronósticos de necesidades por producto y cuenta para maximizar el potencial de ventas del territorio. ● Implementar planes de acción para asegurar el desplazamiento del producto y ofrecer soluciones integrales. ● Desarrollar actividades de promoción visitando médicos, asociaciones, hospitales (Privados y Públicos) y distribuidores para detectar necesidades del mercado. ● Realizar análisis de datos para tomar decisiones estratégicas fundamentadas, reduciendo riesgos y aumentando la competitividad. ● Elaborar el presupuesto anual (forecast) y coordinar las operaciones comerciales con los clientes. ● Identificar oportunidades en sectores donde no se tiene presencia y desarrollar una propuesta comercial. ● Mantener actualizada la base de datos de los diferentes stakeholders para un seguimiento estratégico en los diferentes negocios del territorio Tu perfil:
• Estudios universitarios completos y graduación son un requerimiento
• Experiencia de al menos 3 años en el sector farmacéutico, estrategias comerciales, conocimiento del mercado público y privado, manejo administrativo y estadístico, así como experiencia en el uso de portales de compras gubernamentales y manejo de licitaciones.
• Conocimiento intermedio del idioma inglés
• Colaboración o Relaciones Externas: Instituciones públicas y privadas, distribuidores, clientes y proveedores. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Are you ready to shape the future of quality management in healthcare? As an Associate Quality Lead within our Pharma Development Quality (PDQ) function, you will play a vital role in supporting the delivery of quality-focused strategies that reinforce trust in our Quality Management System (QMS). Working with a high degree of independence, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure our clinical and safety data meets rigorous global regulatory standards. In this dynamic position, you will have the unique opportunity to champion a culture of continuous improvement and innovation. By leveraging data analytics and digital tools, you will help optimize data collection and provide key insights that directly support our mission of delivering life-changing medicines to patients faster and more securely. The Opportunity:
• Implement Quality Strategies: Support the design, execution, and tracking of risk-based quality management strategies across the PDQ portfolio.
• Deliver Quality Assurance: Execute targeted activities to assess quality assurance status and generate confidence in our end-to-end systems.
• Manage Quality Data: Enhance data collection procedures, perform ad-hoc analyses, and deliver high-quality data insights to fulfil external regulatory needs.
• Present to Health Authorities: Demonstrate the effective implementation of quality strategies.
• Drive Compliance Projects: Participate in departmental or cross-functional compliance initiatives aimed at optimizing daily operations.
• Champion Innovation: Drive the adoption of innovative digital tools and technologies into daily workflows to foster a proactive quality culture.
• Foster Collaboration: Build and maintain an inclusive, supportive work environment while executing departmental goals and initiatives under limited supervision.
• Audit Execution : Utilize AI and automated tools to execute audits and synthesize audit evidence.
• Inspection Support : Provide logistical and compliance support for GCP inspections, including scribe duties and back-room document QC. Who You Are You are a proactive, organized professional looking to elevate your career in quality management within a global, life-changing industry. You thrive in environments that value continuous learning, offer room for professional growth, and empower you to work independently to make a genuine impact on patient outcomes. To be successful in this role, you bring:
• A Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or quality-related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and 1-3 years' of experience.
• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry, with a foundational understanding of product development and GxP regulations (e.g., GCP, GVP, MDR).
• Strong digital and data literacy, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into actionable quality insights.
• Exceptional organizational and execution skills, alongside a demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects proactively.
• Developing expertise in Critical to Quality (CtQ) factors and functional group operations.
• Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong presentation skills. Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting. #MQRS The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 89,256.00 and 117,148.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Responsibilities: Quality and Safety: ● Maintain the Right to Operate and ensure that all processes are performed safely and healthily; Address and escalate any potentially unsafe hazards. ● Ensure accuracy and completeness of all procedures and instructions related to the proper receipt, quarantine, storage, and disbursement of materials as it relates to FDA, OSHA, FAA, QSR, ISO, Good Manufacturing Practices, manufacturing exception events (MEEs), and other Roche policies and procedures.
• ● Audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.); Performs department initiatives to prepare for internal/external audits and inspections.
• ● Timely reporting of safety hazards, incidents, and near misses.
• ● Completes all assigned training. Responsible for maintaining 95% or above training compliance. Production:
• ● Performs daily assigned standard work according to the department’s governing processes (i.e., GSP’s, OPs, QPs, or SOPs)
• ● Ensures materials are distributed on time and accurately per the production schedule.
• ● Inventory counting and adherence to inventory control processes.
• ● Provides support to non-operations stakeholders with their good receipts, allocation, movements, and shipments.
• ● Learns and operates automated systems/equipment, and sequences of operation, including Equipment setup, operation, and cleaning; Monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting of equipment.
• ● Responsible for daily attendance in Tier meetings.
• ● Responsible for the operation of powered industrial vehicles in a safe and compliant manner.
• ● Required to handle or manage hazardous materials. Continuous Improvement: ● Organize and maintain logistics areas according to 6S principles. ● Identifies gaps and may participate in process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean principles and tools. Teamwork and Collaboration:
• ● Proactively collaborate with peers in other shifts/functions to achieve daily targets.
• ● Support the leaders to maintain and cultivate the organization's culture. Collaborate with the team and leaders to achieve departmental goals.
• ● Communicates outside the department with manufacturing and associated organizations. Performs other duties as assigned. Who you are: Education/Experience:
• ● High School Diploma/GED required
• ● 1 year of relevant work experience, preferably in a GMP environment
• ● 1 year of experience operating power industrial vehicles Knowledge Skills and Abilities:
• ● Demonstrated experience with Lean / Continuous Improvement
• ● Ability to read, write and comprehend English
• ● Strong communication skills - written and verbal
• ● Ability to be flexible and agile in a fast-paced, constantly changing, and high-volume environment.
• ● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• ● Ability to use PC-based applications and general data entry skills
• ● Previous experience with ERP systems; SAP preferred
• ● Ability to work with cross-functional teams
• ● Self-motivated
• ● Ability to have prompt, regular and reliable worksite attendance. Physical conditions and PPE requirements: The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by an individual to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. ● Required to stand, walk, sit, kneel, bend, and crouch for a combined 4 or more hours per day. ● Required to push, pull, and lift a minimum of 50 pounds. Repetitive, consistent movements of the wrists, hands

• ● Audit readiness (OSHA, FAA, FDA, etc.); Performs department initiatives to prepare for internal/external audits and inspections.

• Responsibilities / Accountabilities主要职责/责任 Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness: ● Participate in new facility realization, including but not limited to FAT, SAT, IOPQ etc. to contribute to project delivery. ● Participate in the implementation of warehouse operation readiness, eg: draft equipment operation procedures and logbook, 5S, etc. according to readiness plan. ● Trained and qualified in the daily operation in the warehouse. Routine Operation: Technical & Operational ● Material Handling: Receive raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods. Verify quantity and inspect for damage or discrepancies against purchase orders and shipping documents. Also including dangerous and chemical goods ● Storage and Inventory: Safely store materials in designated warehouse locations. Perform accurate and timely stocktaking, including cycle counts and physical inventories, to ensure stock accuracy. ● Documentation: Maintain precise and complete records for all warehouse activities, including receiving records, material transfer forms, and inventory records. Ensure all documentation is accurate and legible. ● Picking and Packing: Accurately pick materials for production orders or shipments. Stage materials in designated areas, ensuring they are ready for use or transport. Prepare finished goods for shipment, including packing, labeling, and documentation. ● System Operations: Operate the Warehouse Management System (WMS) or other inventory management software to record all material movements and transactions. ● Equipment Operation: Safely operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment. Perform pre-operational checks and report any maintenance issues. ● Other tasks assigned by AM. Compliance & Safety ● Adhere to all GMP and SOPs to ensure the quality and integrity of all materials and products. ● Follow all SHE rules and regulations, including wearing appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintaining a clean and orderly work area. ● Report any deviations, quality issues, or safety hazards immediately to the supervisor/manager. ● Participate in team meetings, safety training, and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualification and Experience 能力与经验 Education/
• Qualifications ● A college degree or above in logistics management, warehouse management, or related fields (Pharmaceutical / Biological is preferred) ● Qualification of dangerous and chemical goods handling Job Required Competencies 岗位所需胜任力 ● 3 years of experience in a warehouse or logistics environment. ● Experience operating a forklift and other material handling equipment. ● Familiarity with WMS (e.g. SAP, MES) and Microsoft Excel (data entry and basic reports) ● Strong knowledge of cGMP and regulations relevant to the pharmaceutical industry, especially in the biological industry ● Good communication with team members and cross function colleagues. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are looking for a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist based in Ireland (ideally Dublin area).

Job Summary

As a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist at Roche Diagnostics Ltd. in Ireland, you are at the forefront of the healthcare revolution, moving diagnostics closer to the patient to enable faster, more clinical decision-making. You will manage a high-value portfolio—including Point-of-Care (POC) and associated digital solutions—across hospitals, HSE clinics, and community care settings.

• Location: Field-based (Ireland).

• Role Type: Permanent

• Company: Roche Diagnostics Ltd.

• Primary Goal: To drive the adoption of "Near Patient Care" technologies, ensuring healthcare providers have the tools to deliver real-time results that improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Sales & Territory Management

• Drive Revenue: Meet and exceed sales targets for the Near Patient Care portfolio (e.g., blood gas, glucose monitoring, and rapid diagnostic platforms).

• Market Growth: Identify new business opportunities within the HSE, private hospitals, and community health districts.

• Tender Management: Lead and contribute to complex tender submissions for business acquisition and retention within the Irish healthcare landscape.

2. Customer Partnership & Consultation

• Relationship Building: Nurture deep relationships with key stakeholders, including Hospital Managers, Laboratory Directors, Point of Care Coordinators, and HSE procurement.

• Solution Selling: Consult with clinical teams to understand their workflow challenges and develop tailored diagnostic solutions that enhance service delivery.

• Clinical Education: Provide high-quality product demonstrations and in-service training for healthcare professionals to ensure the effective use of Roche technology.

3. Market Intelligence & Analysis

• Competitive Awareness: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to inform strategic sales planning.

• CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and sales pipelines within Salesforce to support forecasting and territory reporting.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

• Education: Degree level in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Experience: Proven track record in medical device or diagnostic sales with experience in the Irish HSE ecosystem.

• License: Full, clean driving license.

• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and "respectfully challenge the status quo".

Desirable:

• Point-of-Care Expertise: Specific knowledge of "Near Patient" or Point of Care (POC) diagnostic workflows.

• Agile Mindset: Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to a rapidly evolving pathology pipeline.

Why Join Roche?

• Impact: Be part of a global leader that aims to "prevent, stop, and cure diseases" by ensuring access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Culture: A collaborative environment that encourages "personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections".

• Growth: Extensive opportunities for professional development and career progression within the broader Roche network.

Who we are

Job Summary

As a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist at Roche Diagnostics Ltd. in Ireland, you are at the forefront of the healthcare revolution, moving diagnostics closer to the patient to enable faster, more clinical decision-making. You will manage a high-value portfolio—including Point-of-Care (POC) and associated digital solutions—across hospitals, HSE clinics, and community care settings.

• Location: Field-based (Ireland).

• Role Type: Permanent

• Company: Roche Diagnostics Ltd.

• Primary Goal: To drive the adoption of "Near Patient Care" technologies, ensuring healthcare providers have the tools to deliver real-time results that improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiencies.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Sales & Territory Management

• Drive Revenue: Meet and exceed sales targets for the Near Patient Care portfolio (e.g., blood gas, glucose monitoring, and rapid diagnostic platforms).

• Market Growth: Identify new business opportunities within the HSE, private hospitals, and community health districts.

• Tender Management: Lead and contribute to complex tender submissions for business acquisition and retention within the Irish healthcare landscape.

2. Customer Partnership & Consultation

• Relationship Building: Nurture deep relationships with key stakeholders, including Hospital Managers, Laboratory Directors, Point of Care Coordinators, and HSE procurement.

• Solution Selling: Consult with clinical teams to understand their workflow challenges and develop tailored diagnostic solutions that enhance service delivery.

3. Market Intelligence & Analysis

• Competitive Awareness: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to inform strategic sales planning.

• CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and sales pipelines within Salesforce to support forecasting and territory reporting.

Requirements & Qualifications

Essential:

• Education: Degree level in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Experience: Proven track record in medical device or diagnostic sales with experience in the Irish HSE ecosystem.

• License: Full, clean driving license.

• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and "respectfully challenge the status quo".

Desirable:

• Point-of-Care Expertise: Specific knowledge of "Near Patient" or Point of Care (POC) diagnostic workflows.

• Agile Mindset: Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to a rapidly evolving pathology pipeline.

• Impact: Be part of a global leader that aims to "prevent, stop, and cure diseases" by ensuring access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

• Growth: Extensive opportunities for professional development and career progression within the broader Roche network.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione A Roche, stiamo espandendo il nostro team di affari medici globali in oftalmologia con due aperture per un Global Medical Science Leader (GMSL). Questo team è dedicato alla comprensione, all'anticipazione e alla trasformazione della pratica medica nell'area della malattia. Ti unirai a un ambiente altamente collaborativo e matrice in cui le competenze scientifiche soddisfano la pianificazione strategica per migliorare i risultati dei pazienti negli ecosistemi sanitari in tutto il mondo. In qualità di Global Medical Science Leader, servirai come esperto medico e clinico di base, portando i contributi di strategia medica alla strategia integrata per i nostri prodotti. Potrai colmare il divario tra la ricerca clinica e la pratica medica, assicurando che le nostre strategie di ciclo di vita siano informate da approfondimenti di fornitori di assistenza sanitaria, pazienti e paganti. L'opportunità Per eccellere in questo ruolo, guiderai l'evoluzione della pratica medica attraverso le seguenti responsabilità chiave:
• Guidare e coordinare i contributi di strategia medica per la strategia integrata e la strategia del ciclo di vita per i prodotti assegnati o le aree di malattia.
• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di generazione di prove che incorporano "dati di pratica clinica essenziali" e affrontare le esigenze di "accesso".
• Coordinare la strategia globale di prova integrata, comprendente piani di sviluppo clinico (CDP) e le esigenze di dati per l'accesso al mercato.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con partner interfunzionali in Comunicazione Scientifica, Partenariato Paziente, Marketing e Sviluppo della Droga.
• Mantenere una visione attuale delle tendenze esterne, tra cui la salute digitale, la medicina personalizzata e l'ecosistema-centricità sanitaria.
• Rappresentare le competenze mediche nella ricerca clinica e nella pratica medica per catalizzare la trasformazione della rispettiva area malattia.
• Integrare le prospettive di diversi stakeholder, tra cui HCP, pazienti, infermieri e paganti, nel processo decisionale strategico. Chi sei Sei un pensatore strategico con un profondo background scientifico e una passione per la formazione del futuro dell'oftalmologia. Dovresti portare:
• Un MD con un'esperienza di ricerca clinica o di pratica medica rilevante (decisione di cura paziente), o un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (ad esempio, PhD / PharmD) con uno sfondo compatibile.
• Corso di specializzazione ed esperienza specificatamente in Oftalmologia (altamente desiderato).
• Prove capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente matrice con diversi colleghi interfunzionali.
• Forte comprensione del processo di pianificazione integrata dello sviluppo e della commercializzazione.
• Competenza nella generazione delle prove e capacità di tradurre dati medici complessi in strategia attuabile. Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datori di lavoro per le pari opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are expanding our global medical affairs team in Ophthalmology with two openings for a Global Medical Science Leader (GMSL). This team is dedicated to understanding, anticipating, and contributing to the transformation of medical practice within the disease area. You will join a highly collaborative, matrixed environment where scientific expertise meets strategic planning to improve patient outcomes in healthcare ecosystems worldwide. As a Global Medical Science Leader, you will serve as a core medical and clinical expert, leading the medical strategy contributions to the integrated strategy for our products. You will bridge the gap between clinical research and medical practice, ensuring our life cycle strategies are informed by deep insights from healthcare providers, patients, and payers. The Opportunity To excel in this role, you will lead the evolution of medical practice through the following key responsibilities:
• Lead and coordinate medical strategy contributions to the integrated strategy and life cycle strategy for assigned products or disease areas.
• Develop and execute evidence generation strategies that incorporate "essential clinical practice data" and address "access" needs.
• Coordinate the overall integrated evidence strategy, encompassing Clinical Development Plans (CDP) and data needs for market access.
• Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Scientific Communication, Patient Partnership, Marketing, and Drug Development.
• Maintain a current view of external trends, including Digital Health, personalized medicine, and healthcare ecosystem-centricity.
• Represent medical expertise in clinical research and medical practice to catalyze the transformation of the respective disease area.
• Integrate perspectives from multiple stakeholders, including HCPs, patients, nurses, and payers, into strategic decision-making. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker with a deep scientific background and a passion for shaping the future of ophthalmology. You should bring:
• An MD with relevant clinical research or medical practice experience (patient care decision-making), or an advanced life-science degree (e.g., PhD / PharmD) with a compatible background.
• Specialization degree and experience specifically in Ophthalmology (highly desired).
• Proven ability to work effectively in a matrix environment with diverse cross-functional colleagues.
• Strong understanding of the Integrated Development and Commercialization Planning process.
• Expertise in evidence generation and the ability to translate complex medical data into actionable strategy. Ready for the next step? We look forward to hearing from you. Apply now to discover this exciting opportunity! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Bei Roche erweitern wir unser globales medizinisches Team in der Augenheilkunde mit zwei Öffnungen für einen Global Medical Science Leader (GMSL). Dieses Team widmet sich dem Verständnis, der Vorfreude und dem Beitrag zur Transformation der medizinischen Praxis im Krankheitsbereich. Sie werden sich einer hochkollaborativen, Matrix-Umgebung anschließen, in der wissenschaftliche Expertise auf strategische Planung trifft, um die Patientenergebnisse in Gesundheitsökosystemen weltweit zu verbessern. Als Global Medical Science Leader werden Sie als kernmedizinischer und klinischer Experte fungieren und die Beiträge der medizinischen Strategie zur integrierten Strategie für unsere Produkte leiten. Sie werden die Lücke zwischen der klinischen Forschung und der medizinischen Praxis überbrücken und sicherstellen, dass unsere Lebenszyklusstrategien durch tiefe Einblicke von Gesundheitsdienstleistern, Patienten und Zahlern informiert werden. Die Chance Um in dieser Rolle zu exceln, führen Sie die Entwicklung der medizinischen Praxis durch die folgenden Hauptaufgaben:
• Führen und koordinieren medizinische Strategiebeiträge zur integrierten Strategie und Lebenszyklusstrategie für zugeordnete Produkte oder Krankheitsgebiete.
• Entwicklung und Durchführung von Strategien zur Erstellung von Beweisen, die "wesentliche klinische Praxisdaten" enthalten und "Zugriffsbedürfnisse" ansprechen.
• Koordinieren Sie die Gesamtintegrierte Beweisstrategie, die die klinischen Entwicklungspläne (CDP) und den Datenbedarf für den Marktzugang umfasst.
• enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Partnern in der wissenschaftlichen Kommunikation, Patientenpartnerschaft, Marketing und Drogenentwicklung.
• Bewahren Sie eine aktuelle Sicht auf externe Trends, einschließlich Digital Health, personalisierte Medizin und ökosystemzentrierte Gesundheitsversorgung.
• Repräsentieren Sie medizinisches Know-how in der klinischen Forschung und medizinischen Praxis, um die Transformation des jeweiligen Krankheitsbereichs zu katalysieren.
• Integrieren Sie Perspektiven von mehreren Stakeholdern, einschließlich HCPs, Patienten, Krankenschwestern und Zahlern, in strategische Entscheidungsfindung. Wer bist du? Sie sind ein strategischer Denker mit einem tiefen wissenschaftlichen Hintergrund und einer Leidenschaft für die Zukunft der Augenheilkunde. Du solltest mitbringen:
• Ein MD mit relevanter klinischer Forschung oder medizinischer Praxis (Patienten-Care-Entscheidungsfindung), oder ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss (z.B. PhD / PharmD) mit einem kompatiblen Hintergrund.
• Spezialisierungsgrad und Erfahrung speziell in der Ophthalmologie (hoch erwünscht).
• Bewiesene Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer Matrixumgebung mit unterschiedlichen funktionsübergreifenden Kollegen zu arbeiten.
• Starkes Verständnis des Prozesses der integrierten Entwicklung und Kommerzialisierung.
• Expertise in der Generierung von Beweisen und der Fähigkeit, komplexe medizinische Daten in eine handlungsfähige Strategie umzusetzen. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt, um diese spannende Gelegenheit zu entdecken! Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben. Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft. Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position À Roche, nous développons notre équipe mondiale des affaires médicales en ophtalmologie avec deux ouvertures pour un leader mondial des sciences médicales (GMSL). Cette équipe se consacre à la compréhension, à l'anticipation et à la transformation de la pratique médicale dans la région de la maladie. Vous rejoindrez un environnement fortement collaboratif et matricié où l'expertise scientifique rencontre la planification stratégique pour améliorer les résultats des patients dans les écosystèmes de santé du monde entier. En tant que leader mondial des sciences médicales, vous serez un expert médical et clinique de base, dirigeant les contributions de la stratégie médicale à la stratégie intégrée pour nos produits. Vous comblerez l'écart entre la recherche clinique et la pratique médicale, en veillant à ce que nos stratégies de cycle de vie soient éclairées par des connaissances approfondies des fournisseurs de soins de santé, des patients et des payeurs. L'opportunité Pour exceller dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez l'évolution de la pratique médicale à travers les responsabilités clés suivantes:
• Diriger et coordonner les contributions de la stratégie médicale à la stratégie intégrée et à la stratégie du cycle de vie pour les produits ou les domaines de maladies assignés.
• Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies de production de données probantes qui intègrent des « données essentielles sur les pratiques cliniques » et répondent aux besoins en matière d'« accès ».
• Coordonner la stratégie globale intégrée en matière de données probantes, qui englobe les plans de développement clinique et les besoins en données pour l'accès aux marchés.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les partenaires interfonctionnels de la communication scientifique, du partenariat patient, du marketing et du développement des médicaments.
• Maintenir une vision actuelle des tendances externes, y compris la santé numérique, la médecine personnalisée et la centricité des écosystèmes de soins de santé.
• Représenter l'expertise médicale dans la recherche clinique et la pratique médicale pour catalyser la transformation du domaine de la maladie.
• Intégrer les points de vue de multiples parties prenantes, y compris les HCP, les patients, les infirmières et les payeurs, à la prise de décisions stratégiques. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un penseur stratégique avec un fond scientifique profond et une passion pour façonner l'avenir de l'ophtalmologie. Vous devriez apporter:
• un MD ayant une expérience pertinente en recherche clinique ou en pratique médicale (prise de décision en matière de soins aux patients) ou un diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie (p. ex. doctorat/pharmD) avec une expérience compatible.
• Diplôme de spécialisation et expérience spécifique en ophtalmologie (hautement désiré).
• Capacité éprouvée de travailler efficacement dans un environnement matriciel avec divers collègues interfonctionnels.
• Une bonne compréhension du processus de planification du développement intégré et de la commercialisation.
• Expertise en matière de production de données probantes et capacité à traduire des données médicales complexes en stratégie concrète. Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante! Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Purpose of the role: We are looking for a creative, innovative and open-minded intern to join the Global Regulatory Affairs team. As an Intern in Regulatory Affairs, you have the opportunity to support regulatory and product care activities, and get insights into the IVD/MD industry and the applicable regulations and standards for IVD/MD products. In Global Regulatory Affairs we work on specific challenges as a team within all areas of the diagnostic business around the globe, to grow together to bring the best products to patients while choosing a work environment that fits our life. As AI plays an increasing role in our daily lives we are also looking for colleagues who are keen in taking part in high-impact projects that leverage machine learning (ML), natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to optimize how we navigate the complex landscape of global health regulations. In this intern role, you can clearly demonstrate your creativity and leave a footprint in our products’ lifecycle. You will directly contribute to Roche Diagnostics' vision: innovating diagnostics, shaping healthcare & changing lives. Your key responsibilities: After your onboarding program, you will be assigned to tasks or projects. You’ll be mostly spending your time in:
• Assisting in the worldwide registrations and activities for various IVD/MD products, at various stages of their development and lifecycle
• Supporting the preparation and maintenance of global documentation for our IVD/MD products
• Collaborating with other regulatory affairs teams, including local affiliates, for registrational activities
• Coordinating with global interdisciplinary project teams to provide regulatory input to development, submission planning, and documentation needed
• Supporting the global regulatory affairs team members in their non-registrational activities
• Assisting in the design, development, and testing of AI-powered tools and dashboards for regulatory tracking, document analysis, and automated reporting.
• Participating in the training and fine-tuning of ML and NLP models tailored for regulatory use cases, ensuring high accuracy and compliance with internal standards.
• Keep abreast of emerging AI technologies and changing regulatory guidelines regarding AI in the healthcare and pharmaceutical industries. Who you are:
• You have recently graduated (within the last 3 years) in the field of Biology, Life Sciences, Engineering, or Data Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation in diagnostics. As part of our Start Tech Program , we are looking for a motivated recent graduate to join our team in Sant Cugat and contribute to cutting-edge diagnostic development. This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic laboratory environment while working alongside experienced professionals in the field. Your Responsibilities As a Start Tech Graduate Intern, you will support the development of diagnostic solutions and contribute to laboratory operations. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Participating in the development of diagnostic assays, including clotting, enzymatic, and immunological methods
• Independently supporting the execution of analytical experiments, including data analysis, interpretation, and presentation of results
• Assisting in the planning, implementation, evaluation, and documentation of development activities, including literature research
• Contributing to general laboratory tasks to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
• Taking responsibility for the proper use and maintenance of assigned laboratory equipment What We Are Looking For
• Recent graduate in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related field
• Strong interest in diagnostics and laboratory-based research
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment
• Good communication skills and willingness to learn What We Offer
• Hands-on experience in a leading global healthcare company
• Exposure to innovative diagnostic technologies and methodologies
• A collaborative and international work environment
• Opportunities for learning, growth, and future career development within Roche If you are eager to start your career in diagnostics and want to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Opportunity
• Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con la estrategia del Disease Management Squad .
• Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios, brindando soporte científico y técnico integral a los clientes .
• Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno .
• Co-crear y ejecutar los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración estrecha con los Key Account Managers (KAMs) y los clientes .
• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas y efectivas con clientes y stakeholders clave del sector científico y técnico para influir en la estrategia de negocio .
• Colaborar con el Healthcare Manager y el equipo multidisciplinar para integrar los aportes del mercado en la estrategia general de la enfermedad .
• Actuar como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto para los clientes dentro de tu área de especialidad . Who you are
• Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica o carreras afines.
• Experiencia comercial dentro de la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica es deseable.
• Conocimientos técnicos críticos y trayectoria demostrable en biología molecular.
• Dominio del idioma inglés para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global y corporativo .
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, manejo de objeciones y una fuerte capacidad para influir en múltiples stakeholders .
• Mentalidad orientada al pensamiento sistémico, con alta capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas de negocio .
• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para viajar de forma frecuente a través de la red de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia . Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización . • Diseñar e implementar los planes y estrategias de desarrollo de negocios en total alineación con la estrategia del Disease Management Squad .
• Liderar de punta a punta la ejecución de proyectos de desarrollo de negocios, brindando soporte científico y técnico integral a los clientes .
• Relevar de forma proactiva insights del mercado y de los clientes para compartirlos con el squad , moldeando la estrategia según las necesidades del entorno .
• Co-crear y ejecutar los planes de cuentas clave en colaboración estrecha con los Key Account Managers (KAMs) y los clientes .
• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas y efectivas con clientes y stakeholders clave del sector científico y técnico para influir en la estrategia de negocio .
• Colaborar con el Healthcare Manager y el equipo multidisciplinar para integrar los aportes del mercado en la estrategia general de la enfermedad .
• Actuar como el punto de contacto principal y referente experto para los clientes dentro de tu área de especialidad . Who you are
• Profesional graduado en Ciencias Naturales, Bioquímica o carreras afines.
• Experiencia comercial dentro de la industria de diagnóstico o farmacéutica es deseable.
• Conocimientos técnicos críticos y trayectoria demostrable en biología molecular.
• Dominio del idioma inglés para interactuar fluidamente en un entorno global y corporativo .
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, negociación, manejo de objeciones y una fuerte capacidad para influir en múltiples stakeholders .
• Mentalidad orientada al pensamiento sistémico, con alta capacidad de análisis y resolución de problemas de negocio .
• Disponibilidad y flexibilidad para viajar de forma frecuente a través de la red de Argentina, Uruguay, Paraguay y Bolivia . Esta posición no ofrece beneficios de relocalización . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a UK Country Study Start-Up Team Leader, you will drive the efficient and compliant initiation of Roche-sponsored clinical trials. You will play a key role in delivering clinical trials to patients by enabling innovative trial execution and ensuring a seamless experience for investigators and clinical site staff in the UK The Opportunity You will be responsible for leading the country's study start-up strategy, focusing on efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external partners. Your work will have a direct impact on the speed and quality of our clinical trials. This role is internally known as the Country Study Start-Up Team Leader (cSTL). Your key responsibilities will include:
• Overseeing start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient site activation and regulatory compliance.
• Serve as a key member of the Country Leadership Team, contributing actionable insights and leadership influence to advance clinical study start-up environments.
• Build and maintain collaborative relationships with regional and global counterparts to standardise systems, improve study timelines, and implement innovations across study processes.
• Leading the development and oversight of clinical trial submissions and amendments, managing packages, and ensuring document maintenance.
• Identifying and driving opportunities for process automation, standardisation, and innovation at the country and site level.
• Providing strategic oversight for all aspects of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and negotiating contracts.
• Engaging with government and institutional bodies, such as Ethics Boards and Health Authorities, to align on and influence evolving clinical trial policies and practices.
• Driving department-wide engagement by fostering a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and high performance while championing inclusion and belonging. Inspire, motivate, and develop talent within the team, ensuring a focus on individual growth and leadership development to build a strong, elevated talent pipeline aligned with organisational objectives.
• Leading by example in demonstrating and championing inclusive behaviours in your team, PDG, PD, and the Roche Enterprise. Provide opportunities for growth and development for all team members and address any barriers that may exist.
• People management-related administration (e.g. Workday People & Culture Management system tasks) and contact for employment-related matters. You will also provide coaching, support, and leadership to a team of direct reports. You will champion inclusive behaviours and provide opportunities for growth and development for all team members. Who you are You are an experienced professional with a demonstrated background in clinical trial start-up, regulatory submissions, and cross-functional collaboration. You possess a strong understanding of ICH-GCP, MHRA CTA, and the UK regulatory environment. The ideal candidate will also have:
• You bring proven experience and hold a degree in life sciences (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) or equivalent; a postgraduate or master’s degree is highly desirable.
• You have extensive experience in clinical trial start-up processes, including regulatory submissions, site activations, and amendments.
• Proven leadership or line management experience, with a track record of coaching, motivating, and driving teams toward shared goals.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in clinical systems such

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Località: Budapest (HU) / Manheim (Germania) Il Financial Compliance SAP Authorization Governance è responsabile per la progettazione di un'autorizzazione del singolo processo di business e ruoli aziendali. Durante il processo di progettazione, garantiamo la governance del processo di business e tutti i requisiti di conformità sono soddisfatti. L'opportunità In qualità di Global Compliance Global Business Process Specialist ( SAP Authorization Specialist) farai parte dell'Area del Prodotto di Compliance Finanziaria RSS e riferirai direttamente al Lead del Capitolo. Guidare l'attuazione della strategia di Business Process Management (BPM).
• Progettazione di processi e autorizzazioni globali, cross-divisionali, all'avanguardia nell'area di processo aziendale assegnata
• Agire come un decisore abilitato in tutte le divisioni, allineato con GBPM guardrails per la proprietà del processo end-to-end
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con E2E GBPM e la rete GBPS per garantire soluzioni di processo e di sistema adeguate
• Rivedere i concetti e i processi di autorizzazione globali, allineare il design del ruolo e delle funzioni di lavoro, garantire la conformità in tutta la fase di progettazione, affrontare le questioni relative all'autorizzazione basate sull'analisi delle cause principali e coordinare le richieste di ruolo di conseguenza Chi sei Stiamo cercando qualcuno che è auto motivato, davvero appassionato del suo lavoro e capisce che fornire un servizio di alta qualità è fondamentale per l'organizzazione. Al fine di fornire soluzioni sanitarie innovative ai nostri pazienti, abbiamo bisogno del miglior talento nella nostra organizzazione. Come membro del team ideale siete open-minded, dedicato a fare la differenza e aperto allo sviluppo costante. Inoltre, avresti:
• Competenza nelle autorizzazioni SAP: comprovata esperienza nella progettazione, costruzione e mantenimento dei ruoli di sicurezza SAP
• Corso di laurea in Finanza, Business Administration, Informatica, Ingegneria o una formazione comparabile e 5-7 anni di esperienza professionale, preferibilmente in Business Process Management, Gestione delle informazioni / IT, Finanza / approvvigionamento, Risk/Internal Control Management, Contabilità, Audit
• Forte conoscenza nell'ambito dell'autorizzazione e della gestione degli accessi e degli strumenti GRC, basati sulla gestione dei processi aziendali o sull'esperienza e sull'esperienza IT
• SAP ABAC Specialist: Prove esperienze di progettazione e attuazione delle politiche di controllo dell'accesso basato sugli attributi (ABAC) utilizzando il framework standard SAP per integrare il tradizionale RBAC (Role-Based Access Control).
• Avanzate competenze tecniche nei privilegi analitici SAP S/4 HANA, nonché interfacce con analisi e reportistica e come la sicurezza focalizzata sui dati si traduce dallo strato di applicazione allo strato del database.
• Esperienza preferenziale che lavora con BI moderno multipiattaforma specificatamente AppSheet, LookerStudio, TABLEAU e Alteryx.
• Fluency aziendale in inglese In cambio vi forniamo:
• Opportunità di sviluppo: Roche è ricca di risorse di apprendimento. Forniamo costanti opportunità di sviluppo, corsi di lingua gratuita e formazione, la possibilità di incarichi internazionali, cambiamenti di posizione interna e la possibilità di modellare la propria carriera.
• Vantaggi eccellenti: pacchetto di stipendio competitivo e caffetteria, bonus annuale, servizi medici privati, programma di assistenza ai dipendenti, tutto è possibile spostare lo sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunità, programma amico, team building, festa.
• Flessibilità: Supportiamo anche la flessibilità per aiutarti a trovare il tuo equilibrio. L'ufficio domestico è comunemente disponibile (tipicamente 2 giorni di ufficio / settimana in media.) Ci siamo

Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Lieux: Budapest (HU) / Manheim (Allemagne) La gouvernance de l'autorisation de conformité financière SAP est responsable de la conception de l'autorisation de tâches de processus opérationnel unique et des rôles opérationnels. Au cours du processus de conception, nous veillons à ce que la gouvernance liée au processus opérationnel et toutes les exigences de conformité soient respectées. L'opportunité En tant que spécialiste des processus opérationnels mondiaux de conformité financière (spécialiste des autorisations du SAP), vous ferez partie du secteur des produits de conformité financière du RSS et relèverez directement du responsable du chapitre. Diriger la mise en oeuvre de la stratégie de gestion des processus opérationnels de bout en bout.
• Concevoir des processus et des autorisations mondiaux, interdivisionnels et à la fine pointe de la technologie dans le domaine des processus opérationnels
• Agir en tant que décideur habilité entre les divisions, aligné sur les garde-corps GBPM pour la propriété de bout en bout du processus
• Collaborer étroitement avec les GBPM E2E et le réseau GBPS pour assurer des solutions de processus et de systèmes adaptés aux besoins
• Examiner les concepts et les processus d'autorisation à l'échelle mondiale, harmoniser le rôle et la conception des fonctions, assurer la conformité tout au long de la phase de conception, traiter les questions liées à l'autorisation fondées sur l'analyse des causes profondes et coordonner les demandes de rôle en conséquence; Qui vous êtes Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui est motivé par lui-même, qui est vraiment passionné par son travail et qui comprend que la prestation d'un service de haute qualité est cruciale pour l'organisation. Afin de fournir des solutions de santé innovantes à nos patients, nous avons besoin des meilleurs talents de notre organisation. • Expertise dans les autorisations SAP : Expérience éprouvée dans la conception, la construction et le maintien des rôles de sécurité SAP

descriptionByLocale.it:
In Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni autentiche, in cui sei apprezzato, accettato e rispettato per quello che sei, permettendoti di prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale. È così che miriamo a prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana Da oltre 30 anni l'osteria Roche è diventata un'azienda di catering di successo nel settore della ristorazione collettiva. Tavero AG è una filiale al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Nelle nostre sedi di Basilea e Kaiseraugst diamo lavoro a circa 350 persone provenienti da oltre 37 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia ristoranti per il personale che abbracciano la diversità, sia ristoranti raffinati con una cucina raffinata e un servizio eccellente. Offriamo anche ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varietà, preparato dai nostri baristi, nonché le lounge più alte della Svizzera: fantastici luoghi dopo il lavoro sopra i tetti della città. Le offerte Grab'n'Go dal sushi agli hamburger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta. Offriamo inoltre ai nostri ospiti una sala riunioni e un catering per eventi che possono ospitare fino a 1.500 persone. I ristoranti pubblici, lo Schöpfli nel parco e lo Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely, completano la nostra offerta. Cerchiamo subito un aiuto cuoco per la Tavero AG a Kaiseraugst. Principali mansioni:
• Lavorare nella cucina fredda o calda, nel free flow o nel ristorante per il personale
• Preparazione puntuale dei pasti secondo le ricette Tavero
• Lavoro preparatorio e continuo rifornimento della mise en place
• Fornitura di consegne per le nostre filiali
• Informazioni amichevoli e competenti agli ospiti presso il vostro punto vendita o di servizio
• Gestione attenta e responsabile di attrezzature, macchine e alimenti
• Implementazione di nuove istruzioni di lavoro in conformità con la formazione interna
• Supporto in occasioni ed eventi speciali
• Lavorare economicamente per raggiungere gli obiettivi aziendali Profilo dei requisiti:
• Formazione completata come uno chef (EFZ) (desiderabile) o esperienza professionale in cucina
• Ti piace cucinare e maneggiare il cibo
• Lavori in modo indipendente e ti assumi responsabilità
• Lavoro di squadra e affidabilità sono per te un dato di fatto
• Conosci la legislazione alimentare svizzera
• Sei flessibile e pronto per il lavoro occasionale serale e nei fine settimana
• Hai una buona padronanza del tedesco parlato per fornire ai tuoi clienti una consulenza competente Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo si impegnano a far progredire la scienza, garantendo a tutti l’accesso all’assistenza sanitaria oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi hanno portato a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e a oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci diamo la forza reciproca di esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alte le nostre ambizioni, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita e hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Position Based in our Sant Cugat hub, you will join the Global Customer Support Knowledge & Learning Excellence (KLE) organization. As Content Creation and Management Sub-chapter, we create content that enables customers and Roche service personnel to use, install, and maintain diagnostic instruments and software. As a Technical Writer Intern, you will join a team evolving from traditional document-based publishing toward a content-first approach, focusing on modular reusable content and moving away from static outputs. You will work with a new content management system (CMS) to migrate and deliver high-quality information through a global content delivery platform. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a regulated, high-tech healthcare environment. What You Will Do
• Play a key role in transitioning our knowledge base to a new CMS, helping us move from "documents" to "intelligent, reusable content".
• Learn to author in XML, treating content as data. You will explore how this modular approach allows for reuse across different deliverables and platforms.
• Explore the use of AI applied to the content creation process.
• Learn to plan, develop, and organize technical documentation according to global corporate style guides and standards.
• Collaborate with content managers, project teams, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to gather complex information.
• Learn how to meet quality targets and timelines, while ensuring regulatory requirements are respected.
• Assist in creating and modifying multimedia content (photographs, screenshots, diagrams) using modern software tools.
• When ready, draft and update customer-facing and service content (User Guides, Installation Guides, Data Specifications, etc.) in English for Roche software and instruments.
• Contribute your fresh perspective to discussions aimed at the continuous improvement of our tools and processes. What You Bring
• A strong interest in technical writing, instructional design, or knowledge management.
• Excellent spoken and written command of English (C1/C2 level or native equivalent) as this is our primary working language.
• Familiarity with or curiosity about documentation tools and standards (e.g., XML/DITA, IXIASoft, Oxygen, or Figma) and multimedia tools.
• Enthusiasm for working collaboratively in an international, multicultural environment.
• Ability to join for a full-time internship (12 months) Who We Are At Roche, more than 100,000 people across 100 countries are pushing back the frontiers of healthcare. Working together, we’ve become one of the world’s leading research-focused healthcare groups. Our success is built on innovation, curiosity and diversity. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Are you ready to apply? We are looking for someone who thinks beyond the task at hand—a learner who sees this as a unique opportunity to shape the future of Diagnostics. If that is you, apply now! Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.
