The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) is the organization that manufactures and delivers Roche’s groundbreaking therapies to 127 million patients around the world. PT is involved in producing every Roche medicine – from the development process through clinical trials – and continuing to product maturity. Our organization coordinates all aspects of production of Roche medicines in all disease areas and dosage forms. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) is integral to Roche’s mission to develop innovative and transformative meaningful medicines for patients by applying leading technical expertise to design, develop, supply, and register clinical stage products globally. Within PTD, Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC) leverages advanced science and technology to drive the development of synthetic molecules from first-in-human studies through commercialization. Based in Basel, Switzerland, our team of approximately 700 experts works collaboratively to bring our vision to life, delivering impactful solutions that support our mission and uphold our core values. The Opportunity In the position, you will p rovide strategic direction and leadership for Clinical and Commercial Drug Substance manufacturing, ensuring alignment with PTDC’s long-term vision. In doing so you will l ead and oversee Clinical and Commercial Drug Substance manufacturing, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and innovation. You will also be accountable to:
• Drive the scale-up and transfer of Drug Substance processes for clinical and commercial supply.
• Ensure safe, compliant, and cost-effective production of clinical and commercial batches.
• Champion quality, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence, maintaining an "inspection-ready" state as well as p romote a strong Safety, Health, and Environment (SHE) culture within the organization.
• Drive operational excellence by embedding digital and data-driven strategies for process optimization and efficiency.
• Anticipate and mitigate technical, operational, and scientific risks while fostering innovation in drug substance manufacturing.
• Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of accountability and professional growth as well as cross-functional collaboration with internal and external partners to drive process innovation. Who You Are You bring significant experience in a leadership role within Synthetic Molecules clinical and commercial drug substance supply and enjoy shaping and navigating through complexities. Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Wir fördern die Wissenschaft, damit wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Pharma Global Technical Operations (PT) ist die Organisation, die Roches bahnbrechende Therapien auf 127 Millionen Patienten weltweit produziert und liefert. PT beteiligt sich an der Produktion jeder Roche-Medikament – vom Entwicklungsprozess über klinische Studien – und an der Produktreife. Unsere Organisation koordiniert alle Aspekte der Produktion von Roche-Medizinen in allen Krankheitsgebieten und Dosierungsformen. Pharma Technical Development (PTD) ist integraler Bestandteil der Mission von Roche, innovative und transformative sinnvolle Arzneimittel für Patienten zu entwickeln, indem sie führende technische Expertise für die Entwicklung, Entwicklung, Versorgung und Registrierung von klinischen Stage-Produkten weltweit anwenden. Innerhalb der PTD nutzt Synthetic Molecules Technical Development (PTDC) fortschrittliche Wissenschaft und Technologie, um die Entwicklung von synthetischen Molekülen aus ersten in-humanen Studien durch Kommerzialisierung zu fördern. Mit Sitz in Basel, Schweiz, arbeitet unser Team von rund 700 Experten gemeinsam, um unsere Vision ins Leben zu bringen, schlagkräftige Lösungen zu liefern, die unsere Mission unterstützen und unsere Kernwerte aufrecht erhalten. Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. Mansioni La posizione Missione lavorativa Noi, il Digital Biomarker (dBM) e il Capitolo Gestione Paziente Remota (RPM) in Roche Information Solutions (RIS), siamo un team integrato di scienziati, tecnologi, analisti di dati e esperti operativi, che sfrutta le tecnologie mobili come smartphone e wearables per portare la potenza delle misure sensoriali a pazienti ovunque: negli studi clinici sulla droga e nella cura clinica. Noi guidiamo ricerca, workflow e analisi per i biomarcatori digitali e la gestione dei pazienti remota in RIS. Insieme ai nostri partner, inventiamo, progettiamo e forniamo capacità di soluzione, prodotti e servizi per una migliore ricerca clinica e migliori risultati sanitari. Co-creare innovativi concetti di monitoraggio remoto digitale per gli endpoint sensibili e significativi di sviluppo della droga, implementarli in soluzioni tecnologiche, sviluppare misure di esito relative alla salute con i dati, cercare l'accettazione comunitaria e normativa dei corrispondenti endpoint e offrire loro alle aziende Biopharma e agli istituti di ricerca per l'uso in studi clinici. Stiamo anche stabilendo le basi scientifiche per il monitoraggio e le soluzioni di screening delle malattie remote nella pratica clinica e consentire ai pazienti e ai fornitori di assistenza sanitaria di sfruttare la potenza dei dati dei sensori per ottenere risultati migliori nella gestione delle malattie neurologiche, del diabete e altri. Responsabilità - Stabilire la capacità di scienza digitale del capitolo Digital Biomarker (dBM) e Gestione Paziente Remota (RPM) in RIS Data, Analytics & Research (DA&R). - Sviluppare una roadmap e condurre lo sviluppo di nuove misure di esito digitale per l'uso in studi clinici e la cura clinica e guidare la regolazione e l'accettazione della comunità. - Lead (stabilire, crescere e maturare) il team di scienza biomarcatrice digitale che serve la gamma completa delle esigenze RIS, dalla ricerca digitale di biomarcatori agli algoritmi convalidati clinicamente per l'uso nei prodotti RIS - Rappresentare la Scienza nel team di leadership del capitolo dBM&RPM e contribuire all'evoluzione del capitolo - Nel Gruppo Roche, collaborare con gli stakeholder nello sviluppo clinico, nel biomarcatore e nelle tecnologie traduttive, nella ricerca dei risultati concentrati sui pazienti, nella scienza dei dati, nella regolamentazione, nella privacy, nell'IP e nelle scienze farmaceutiche - Leva il tuo riconoscimento come esperto di Digital Biomarker e sostenitore nella comunità globale di ricerca e sviluppo per guidare l'accettazione degli endpoint digitali attraverso le task force di cross-industry e la comunicazione dei risultati alle conferenze e nelle pubblicazioni peer-reviewed. - Essere un grande driver di cambiamento internamente a Roche ed esternamente nella comunità, così come con i regolatori per sbloccare il pieno potenziale della tecnologia della salute digitale a sostegno di studi clinici e uso clinico.
• Requisiti - Grado universitario scientifico (livello PhD) in una scienza naturale quantitativa o in una disciplina medica con un focus sull'analisi dei dati su larga scala e un record di pubblicazione eccezionale - 10+ anni di esperienza professionale nel settore farmaceutico o relativo, idealmente direttamente impatto processo decisionale nello sviluppo di farmaci clinici o dispositivi medici - Passione intrinseca per trasformare la salute utilizzando la tecnologia digitale per modernizzare gli endpoint clinici nello sviluppo della droga e nella cura clinica - Ampia esperienza di leadership di livello senior in una grande organizzazione - Capacità di stabilire reti interne ed esterne - Riconosciuto come leader della salute digitale dalla comunità - Ampia esperienza nella progettazione e nell'analisi di esperimenti clinici complessi e a lungo termine Contatto (senza informazioni fornite)
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Mission We, the Digital Biomarker (dBM) and Remote Patient Management (RPM) Chapter in Roche Information Solutions (RIS), are an integrated team of scientists, technologists, data analysts and operations experts, that leverages mobile technologies like smartphones and wearables to bring the power of sensor measures to patients everywhere: in clinical drug trials and clinical care. We drive research, workflows and analytics for Digital Biomarkers and Remote Patient Management in RIS. Together with our partners, we invent, design and deliver solution capabilities, products and services for better clinical research and improved healthcare outcomes. We co-create innovative digital remote monitoring concepts for sensitive and meaningful drug development endpoints, implement them in technology solutions, develop health related outcome measures with the data, seek community- and regulatory acceptance of corresponding endpoints and offer them to Biopharma companies and research institutes for use in clinical trials. We are also establishing the scientific foundations for remote disease monitoring and screening solutions in clinical practice and enable patients and healthcare providers to leverage the power of sensor data for better outcomes in the management of neurological disease, diabetes and others. The Opportunity:
• Establish the digital science capability of the Digital Biomarker (dBM) and Remote Patient Management (RPM) chapter in RIS Data, Analytics & Research (DA&R).
• Develop a roadmap and lead the development of novel digital outcome measures for use in clinical trials and clinical care and drive regulatory and community acceptance.
• Lead (establish, grow and mature) the digital biomarker science team serving the full range of RIS needs, from digital biomarker research to clinically validated algorithms for use in RIS products
• Represent Science in the dBM&RPM chapter leadership team and contribute to the evolution of the chapter
• In the Roche Group, collaborate with stakeholders in clinical development, biomarker, and translational science and technologies, patient-centered outcomes research, data science, regulatory, privacy, IP and pharmaceutical sciences
• Leverage your recognition as a respected Digital Biomarker expert and advocate in the global research and development community to drive the acceptance of digital endpoints through cross-industry task forces and the communication of results at conferences and in peer-reviewed publications.
• Be a major driver of change internally at Roche and externally in the community as well as with regulators to unlock the full potential of Digital Health Technology in support of clinical trials and clinical use. Who you are:
• Scientific university degree (PhD. level) in a quantitative natural science or medical discipline with a focus on large-scale data analysis and an outstanding publication record
• 10+ years professional experience in the pharmaceutical or related industry, ideally directly impacting decision making in clinical drug or medical device development
• Intrinsic passion for transforming healthcare using digital technology to modernize clinical endpoints in drug development and clinical care
• Extensive senior level leadership experience in a large organization
• Ability to establish internal and external networks
• Recognized as a digital health leader by the community
• Extensive experience in the design and analysis of complex and long-term clinical experiments

Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. The Opportunity As a Principal Engineer within our PCR HW Chapter, you will be a hands-on technical leader driving innovation for Molecular, Core, and Point of Care laboratory solutions. In this domain-expert role, you will define, build, and release high-quality software for both IVD and non-IVD products, directly influencing our future product portfolio through the following responsibilities:
• Conceptual Leadership: Develop technical concepts and lead feasibility studies to ensure all technical requirements and overarching system designs are met.
• Software Lifecycle Ownership: Perform hands-on development tasks, including defining, estimating, and planning work packages while documenting SW unit specifications and designs.
• Architectural Contribution: Contribute to the SW architecture, defining key quality attributes and ensuring the team stays current with evolving technology trends.
• Quality & Maintenance: Conduct root-cause analysis for complex issues and provide high-quality bug fixes for post-market software releases using established checklists and templates.
• Risk Management: Continuously assess and report project risks, creating contingency and scenario plans for major risks on the critical path.
• Process & Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to regulatory and market standards (IVD) while proposing process improvements to enhance development efficiency.
• Cross-Functional Communication: Collaborate across business areas to present complex technical topics to high-level audiences, utilizing excellent verbal and written communication skills. Who You Are You’re a self-motivated team player who wants to influence your own development. It is natural for you to be proactive in working with your teammates and other parts of the organization. You like sharing your know-how to help the whole team advance. Bringing in new ideas to improve existing products with new functions and cost optimization is important to you. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies—where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point. To be successful in this role, you should possess the following core qualifications and experience:
• 10+ Years of Technical & Management Experience: Must demonstrate:
• Management: Proven history of direct oversight of global teams, including talent acquisition, performance management, and strategic program delivery.
• Technical: Continuous, active, hands-on architectural leadership in high-end embedded systems.
• Expert-Level Medical Instrument Control: Proven mastery in designing and architecting software for Real-Time Linux (Debian/Yocto) environments, specifically for complex, high-precision laboratory or diagnostic medical instruments (IVD).
• Advanced Modern Systems Stack: Deep technical proficiency in C++ a

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Travel & Expense GBPS , you will be part of the Roche Services & Solutions (RSS) Business Process Management (BPM) organization. In this role you will actively contribute to the implementation of the end-to-end BPM strategy for corporate Travel & Expense (T&E) management. You are responsible for the global, cross divisional, state-of-the-art process design and you work in close collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Procurement & IT, to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions. Please note that this is a 1 year fixed-term role with a possibility to extend for another year. The Opportunity Your main responsibilities include:
• Actively contribute to the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E Global Business Process Owner (GBPO) and Global Business Process Managers (GBPMs)
• Deliver lean cross-divisional processes & solutions, with maximum standardization and harmonization
• Ensure documentation of process requirements, implementation through guidelines and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
• Drive efficiencies and improvements (incl. automation) across E2E business process, RSS Operations, affiliates and IT.
• Manage prioritization, justification and realization of change requests and initiatives in line with the strategic roadmap, with support of the GBPMs and other Global Business Process Specialists
• Contribute to partner projects, providing advice and guidance
• Supporting the development of agile ways of working in teams and the organization Who you are A successful candidate will have a customer orientated (agile) and design thinking mindset. Completed degree in Business, Finance or related field and a minimum 2-3 years of professional experience in Finance, Procurement or IT. You demonstrated your ability of working in cross-functional projects (preferably transformation of nature) and cross-functional teams. For this position, you bring the following qualifications:
• Solid background in Finance or Procurement with proven Business Process Management skills.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, leading to effective decision-making.
• Strong influencing and communication skills (written and verbal in English is essential) for working with international teams and complex stakeholder networks.
• Familiarity with upstream Finance & Procurement processes and systems is a plus.
• Good understanding of End-to-End (E2E) travel & expense processes and systems, along with technical expertise in SAP ERP & Concur. In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits & flexibility: competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party. We also ensure flexibility, to help you find your balance: home office is a common practice (2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global diverse community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED ) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti al fine di affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie al mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in farmaci. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza è un’organizzazione globale che consente alle unità di Ricerca e Sviluppo Anticipato di Roche di diventare più basate sui dati, più digitalmente adattate e meglio preparate per le sfide del futuro. All'interno del Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza, il dipartimento di Biologia Computazionale si concentra sull'ulteriore comprensione delle malattie, delle popolazioni dei pazienti e della biologia di destinazione, avendo accesso ai più grandi dataset Pharma R&D al mondo. In collaborazione con i nostri scienziati attraverso pRED, creiamo migliori farmaci aumentando ogni parte della R&D attraverso la nostra cultura basata sui dati. L'opportunità Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato computazionale altamente motivato per unire la nostra sotto-unità di ricerca oncologia della biologia computazionale. Sarete membri di un team di scienziati computazionali leader nel mondo con l'obiettivo preciso di sviluppare un vantaggio competitivo per la pRED attraverso l'applicazione della biologia computazionale nello spazio Oncology. Sarete anche parte della più ampia unità Computational Biology and Medicine all'interno del Centro di Scienze Computazionali di Eccellenza che traccia l'esperienza condivisa e le competenze dei colleghi a livello globale. Per garantire la consegna di successo per il portafoglio, si collabora con altri subunità in Biologia di Computazione e/o Medicina Computazionale dove necessario. Il nostro successo collettivo nella sottounità Oncology e il nostro contributo agli obiettivi pRED/Pharma saranno la misura del vostro impatto. In questo ruolo, voi:
• Guidare ed eseguire la strategia di dati e analisi per la tua area, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder per concentrarsi sulle opportunità di impatto più alto.
• Generare intuizioni chiare e di alto valore da dati complessi per supportare il processo decisionale e contribuire ad avanzare progetti verso un impatto significativo del paziente.
• Agire come partner affidabile per gli scienziati e le squadre interfunzionali, collaborare per modellare le priorità e fornire obiettivi condivisi.
• Contribuire a un ambiente di team collaborativo e inclusivo condividendo competenze, supportando i coetanei e impegnandosi attivamente in una cultura ricca di feedback.
• Contribuire a migliorare continuamente come lavoriamo, contribuendo a rafforzare la Biologia Computazionale come un driver chiave dell'innovazione e dell'impatto all'interno di pRED Chi sei
• Ha un PhD in Bioinformatica, Biostatistica, o un campo quantitativo correlato, con una solida base nella risoluzione dei problemi data-driven, modellazione statistica e machine learning.
• Si porta una solida comprensione della biologia del cancro e sono motivati ad applicare la scienza dei dati per guidare l'impatto nella scoperta della droga e nel processo decisionale.
• Hai una forte esperienza nei flussi di lavoro AI/ML e AI-driven moderni, tra cui l'esperienza hands-on con LLM, codifica assistita da AI, o flussi di lavoro agentici applicati a problemi biologici.
• Sei esperto in R e/o Python e di lavorare in ambienti Linux/Unix, inclusi i dati di elaborazione sulle piattaforme HPC/cloud.
• Hai esperienza di lavoro con set di dati biologici su larga scala (ad esempio, genomica, transcriptomics, omics spaziale/imaging), idealmente compreso depen cellulare tumorale

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED ) ​, we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. The Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence is a global organisation enabling Roche’s Research and Early Development units to become more data-driven, more digitally adept and better prepared for the challenges of the future. Within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence , the Computational Biology department focuses on furthering our understanding of disease, patient populations, and target biology by having access to the largest Pharma R&D datasets in the world. In partnership with our scientists across pRED, we create better medicines by augmenting every part of R&D through our data-driven culture. The Opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated computational scientist to join our Research Oncology sub-unit of Computational Biology. You will be a member of a team of world-leading computational scientists with the express aim of developing a competitive advantage for pRED through the application of computational biology in the Oncology space. You will also be part of the wider Computational Biology and Medicine unit within the Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence drawing on the shared experience and expertise of colleagues globally. To ensure successful delivery for the portfolio, you collaborate with other subunits in Computation Biology and/or Computational Medicine where needed. Our collective success in the Oncology sub-unit and our contribution to pRED/Pharma goals will be the measure of your impact. In this role, you will:
• Drive and execute the data and analytics strategy for your area, working closely with stakeholders to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
• Generate clear, high-value insights from complex data to support decision-making and help advance projects toward meaningful patient impact.
• Act as a trusted partner to scientists and cross-functional teams, collaborating to shape priorities and deliver on shared goals.
• Contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team environment by sharing expertise, supporting peers, and actively engaging in a feedback-rich culture.
• Contribute to continuously improving how we work, helping to strengthen Computational Biology as a key driver of innovation and impact within pRED Who you are

• You have strong expertise in AI/ML and modern AI-driven workflows, ideally including hands-on experience with LLMs, AI-assisted coding, or agentic workflows applied to biological problems.

Die Position In Roches Pharmaforschungs- und Frühentwicklungsorganisation (pRED ) machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in Medikamente zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Das Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence ist eine globale Organisation, die es Roches Forschungs- und Frühentwicklungseinheiten ermöglicht, datengesteuerter, digitaler adeptischer und besser auf die Herausforderungen der Zukunft vorbereitet zu werden. Im Zentrum der Computational Sciences Excellence konzentriert sich die Abteilung Computational Biology auf die Weiterentwicklung unseres Verständnisses von Krankheiten, Patientenpopulationen und Zielbiologie, indem sie Zugang zu den größten Pharma-FuD-Datensätzen der Welt haben. In Partnerschaft mit unseren Wissenschaftlern über pRED schaffen wir bessere Medikamente, indem wir jeden Teil der FuE durch unsere datengetriebene Kultur verstärken. Die Chance Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Informatiker, der sich unserer Research Oncology Untereinheit Computational Biology anschließt. Sie sind Mitglied eines Teams weltweit führender Informatiker mit dem ausdrücklichen Ziel, einen Wettbewerbsvorteil für pRED durch die Anwendung von Rechenbiologie im Onkologie-Raum zu entwickeln. Sie werden auch Teil der breiteren Computational Biology and Medicine Unit im Computational Sciences Centre of Excellence sein, die sich auf die gemeinsame Erfahrung und Expertise von Kollegen weltweit bezieht. Um eine erfolgreiche Lieferung für das Portfolio zu gewährleisten, arbeiten Sie bei Bedarf mit anderen Untereinheiten in der Computation Biology und/oder Computational Medicine zusammen. Unser kollektiver Erfolg in der Onkologie-Untereinheit und unser Beitrag zu pRED/Pharma-Zielen wird das Maß Ihrer Wirkung sein. In dieser Rolle wirst du:
• Führen Sie die Daten- und Analysestrategie für Ihren Bereich aus und arbeiten eng mit den Stakeholdern zusammen, um sich auf höchste Chancen zu konzentrieren.
• Erzeugen Sie klare, hochwertige Erkenntnisse aus komplexen Daten, um die Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen und Projekte in Richtung sinnvoller Patientenwirkung zu fördern.
• Aktivieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Partner Wissenschaftlern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um Prioritäten zu formen und gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen.
• Beitrag zu einer kollaborativen und integrativen Teamumgebung durch Erfahrungsaustausch, Unterstützung von Peers und aktives Engagement in einer rückgekoppelten Kultur.
• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Funktionsweise und zur Stärkung der Computational Biology als Schlüsseltreiber von Innovation und Wirkung innerhalb von pRED Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel in Bioinformatik, Biostatistik oder ein damit verbundenes quantitatives Feld, mit einer starken Grundlage in datengesteuerter Problemlösung, statistischer Modellierung und maschinellem Lernen.
• Sie bringen ein solides Verständnis der Krebsbiologie und sind motiviert, die Datenwissenschaft anzuwenden, um Auswirkungen in der Drogenentdeckung und Entscheidungsfindung zu treiben.
• Sie verfügen über ein starkes Know-how in KI/ML und modernen KI-getriebenen Workflows, idealerweise inklusive Hand-on-Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-assisted Codierung oder agierenden Workflows, die auf biologische Probleme angewendet werden.
• Sie sind in R und/oder Python kompetent und komfortabel in Linux/Unix-Umgebungen, einschließlich der Verarbeitung von Daten auf HPC/Cloud-Plattformen.
• Sie haben Erfahrung mit umfangreichen biologischen Datensätzen (z.B. Genomik, Transkriptomik, räumliche Omics/Imaging), ideal einschließlich Krebszellendepen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans l'organisation de recherche pharmaceutique et de développement précoce (PRED ) Roche, nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Au PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médicaments. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles est une organisation mondiale qui permet aux unités de recherche et de développement précoce de Roches de devenir plus axées sur les données, plus performantes sur le plan numérique et mieux préparées aux défis de l'avenir. Au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles , le département de biologie computationnelle s'efforce de mieux comprendre les maladies, les populations de patients et la biologie cible en ayant accès aux plus grands ensembles de données de R-D pharmaceutique au monde. En partenariat avec nos scientifiques, nous créons de meilleurs médicaments en augmentant chaque partie de la R-D grâce à notre culture axée sur les données. L'opportunité Nous cherchons un scientifique computationnel très motivé pour rejoindre notre sous-unité de recherche en biologie computationnelle. Vous serez membre d'une équipe de scientifiques informatiques de premier plan dans le but exprès de développer un avantage concurrentiel pour pRED par l'application de la biologie computationnelle dans l'espace Oncologie. Vous ferez également partie de l'unité de biologie et de médecine computationnelles au sein du Centre d'excellence en sciences computationnelles, en s'appuyant sur l'expérience et l'expertise partagées de collègues à l'échelle mondiale. Pour assurer une prestation réussie pour le portefeuille, vous collaborez avec d'autres sous-unités en biologie de calcul et/ou en médecine computationnelle au besoin. Notre succès collectif dans la sous-unité Oncologie et notre contribution aux objectifs pRED/Pharma seront la mesure de votre impact. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Dirigez et exécutez la stratégie de données et d'analyse pour votre région, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes pour se concentrer sur les opportunités les plus importantes d'impact.
• Générer des informations claires et de grande valeur à partir de données complexes pour appuyer la prise de décision et aider à faire avancer les projets vers un impact significatif sur le patient.
• Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance des scientifiques et des équipes interfonctionnelles, en collaborant à l'élaboration des priorités et à la réalisation d'objectifs communs.
• Contribuer à un environnement d'équipe collaboratif et inclusif en partageant l'expertise, en appuyant les pairs et en s'engageant activement dans une culture riche en commentaires.
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre fonctionnement, en aidant à renforcer la biologie computationnelle en tant que moteur clé de l'innovation et de l'impact au sein de pRED Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un doctorat en bioinformatique, en biostatistique ou dans un domaine quantitatif connexe, avec une base solide pour la résolution de problèmes, la modélisation statistique et l'apprentissage automatique.
• Vous apportez une compréhension solide de la biologie du cancer et êtes motivé à appliquer la science des données pour stimuler l'impact dans la découverte de médicaments et la prise de décisions.
• Vous disposez d'une solide expertise en AI/ML et de workflows modernes, incluant idéalement une expérience pratique avec les LLM, le codage assisté par AI ou les workflows agents appliqués à des problèmes biologiques.
• Vous êtes compétent en R et / ou Python et confortable de travailler dans les environnements Linux/Unix, y compris le traitement des données sur les plateformes HPC/cloud.
• Vous avez l'expérience de travailler avec des ensembles de données biologiques à grande échelle (p. ex. génomique, transcriptomique, omique spatiale/imagerie), y compris idéalement le depen de cellules cancéreuses

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Patient Safety Intern will embark on a growth journey upon joining Roche. The intern will develop fundamental knowledge in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Risk Management throughout the lifecycle of a product and enabling safe access to innovative treatments for the patients, ensuring optimal beneﬁt-risk balance for a therapeutic product. At the end of the internship, the intern should achieve the following;
• To understand and apply pre-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc
• To understand and apply post-marketing pharmacovigilance requirements in Asia Paciﬁc
• To understand EU Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) and its implementation in global processes
• To be able to accurately assess and independently complete some basic Pharmacovigilance requirements
• Demonstrate soft skills, project management and presentation skills Qualiﬁcations:
• Currently pursuing a degree in Biological Sciences, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or Pharmaceutical Science.
• Preferably a student who can commit from July 2026 to December 2026 .
• Willing to work at our Singapore oﬃce located in Paya Lebar Quarter . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Clinician Selling Specialist , you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of our innovative biomarkers and solutions within the clinical communities. You will build strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), researchers, and healthcare providers to advance our mission of improving patient outcomes through personalized medicine and better chronic disease management. In this role, you will be the reference person for clinical and technical aspects in the Barcelona and Tarragona area . You will be responsible for promoting our solutions with a technical-scientific approach, adapting global strategies to the local reality of Primary Care and specialized centers, ensuring our innovations reach the right patients at the right time. Your Key Responsibilities
• Strategic Sales & Technical Promotion: Promote products and services with differentiating scientific messages. You will negotiate with health centers and hospitals, providing high-level technical explanations focused on treatment and patient management.
• Primary Care & Diabetes Focus: You will be a key partner for Primary Care providers, especially in the context of Diabetes , promoting sales with a treatment-oriented approach and identifying new business opportunities within existing accounts.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Identify and cultivate a network of advocates (KOLs, Clinical Leaders, Medical Directors). You’ll adapt sales plans to satisfy their needs and communicate public tender implications to the Zone Manager.
• Clinical Training: Educate nursing staff and healthcare professionals in both hospitals and Primary Care centers on product use, coordinating the involvement of nurses in patient care protocols.
• Scientific Expertise: Act as the local expert, presenting Roche solutions at regional forums and symposia. You’ll stay updated on IVDR regulations and patient management algorithms.
• Market Intelligence: Gather and share insights on market trends and competition. You will implement marketing campaigns and collaborate with Product Managers on local promotional activities (congresses, workshops, etc.).
• Investment & ROI: Propose and implement investments in your territory based on a defined return (ROI) and ensure all customer commitments are met.
• Mobility: This role requires high field presence, with expected travel within the designated area (Barcelona/Tarragona) 70+% of the time. Who You Are We are looking for a scientific profile with a strong commercial spark and experience in the local healthcare ecosystem.
• Education: Bachelor's Degree is needed. Bachelor's in Science with be higly valued.
• Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience in the life sciences industry. Proven experience in Primary Care is essential.
• Subject Matter Expertise: Deep knowledge or experience in Diabetes is highly valued.
• Relationship Building: Strong ability to build and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals at all levels.
• Languages: Fluency in Spanish and Catalan is highly valued; strong proficiency in English is mandatory for global collaboration.
• Location: You must be based in the working area Barcelona. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnosti

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Principio ruoli e responsabilità
• Sviluppare la pianificazione del marchio e il piano operativo di Enspryng
• Sviluppo e attuazione vanno alla strategia di mercato e alle campagne
• Identificare l'opportunità di crescita e generare informazioni sui clienti nei segmenti target
• Sviluppare messaggi di differenziazione nei segmenti target e migliorare la consegna dei messaggi
• Tracciare i risultati del marchio e trovare approfondimenti beneficio marca.
• Guidare il team della funzione trasversale locale per accelerare i ricavi di Enspryng velocemente al picco
• Gestire le spese promozionali in modo efficace

titleByLocale.it: Regional Finanza Enterprise Partner (South, Ireland & Nationals)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Finance Business Partner for Roche Diagnostics (internally known as Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP)), you'll play a pivotal role in driving the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) journey. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial health of our business while delivering market-leading customer experiences. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and customers to identify profitable commercial opportunities, improve contract performance, and ensure sustainable business outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the financial strategy, contract management, and performance insights within the network. You will collaborate across teams to ensure the success of our commercial pipeline and contribute to the development and execution of the annual business plan. By leveraging your expertise, you’ll ensure that our contracts are financially sustainable, competitive, and aligned with Roche Diagnostics' long-term goals. The Opportunity:
• Lead the Quote-to-Contract (Q2C) processes for a portfolio of contracts, ensuring financial sustainability. This includes modelling new tenders, extensions and amendments.
• Monitor and improve contract financial health in collaboration with customers
• Lead negotiations regarding complex contracts and dispute resolution.
• Contribute to the business planning process and actively participate in the regional network governance, aligning targets with the annual cycle.
• Support the commercial pipeline by balancing growth with profitability and timely cash generation, while driving sustainable commercial deals that consider risks, competitor assumptions, and pricing.
• Develop and partner key stakeholders, providing coaching and support, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and building trusted cross-functional partnerships to achieve shared objectives and co-lead critical affiliate business plan initiatives. Who you are:
• You hold a university degree (Upper Second Class or equivalent), a Master’s or MBA is preferred but not required.
• Strong, proven commercial finance experience, professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA, or international equivalent) is preferred
• Excellent excel skills and experience with financial modelling
• You're a customer-centric professional, adept at delivering solutions that meet both client and business objectives.
• Experience in navigating complex Customer Relationships and Negotiations
• You excel at navigating complex, matrix organizations, fostering strong collaborative networks, and translating complex financial ideas into easily understandable insights.
• You embrace change as an opportunity, thrive in both independent and team environments, and are driven by results and continuous improvement.
• Fluent in English, you're passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences that drive business success. This role is based onsite at our Burgess Hill office in West Sussex, United Kingdom. Please upload only your current compelling CV and / or Cover Letter. We look forward to receiving your application! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, en

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team Im Standort Management Mannheim/Penzberg, sind wir gut 1'300 Spezialisten für verschiedenste Infrastruktur- und Professional-Services, die diese für die Standorte Mannheim und Penzberg zur Verfügung stellen. In einem dynamischen Umfeld fördern wir die nahtlose Zusammenarbeit über Geschäftsbereiche und Funktionen hinweg, bieten innovative Lösungen und verbessern die Arbeitsumgebung der Mitarbeitenden an den Standorten Mannheim und Penzberg. In dieser Funktion bist du Teil der Roche Diagnostics GmbH Risk Management & SHE Compliance, explizit des Teams Environmental Safety. Wir handeln stets mit dem Bewusstsein für unsere große Verantwortung gegenüber der Umwelt und der Gesellschaft und verwalten daher nicht nur, sondern gestalten aktiv eine zukunftsorientierte umweltrechtliche Compliance. Werde jetzt Teil eines Teams werden, dass sich wie folgt auszeichnet:
• Zwei Standorte, ein Team: Trotz der räumlichen Distanz verbindet uns ein engmaschiger, standortübergreifender Austausch und ein starker Teamgeist.
• Gesetzliche Fachexpertise: Wir übernehmen die zentralen Rollen der gesetzlichen Betriebsbeauftragten für Umweltschutz und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Innovationen & Assets stets auf einem rechtssicheren Fundament stehen.
• Vom Berater zum Gestalter: Wir verstehen uns nicht als „Bedenkenträger“, sondern als lösungsorientierte Gestalter. Wir handeln business-orientiert und unterstützen die operativen Einheiten dabei, Nachhaltigkeit und Effizienz in Einklang zu bringen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle unterstützt Du die Geschäftsführung und die operativen Einheiten bei der Sicherstellung der technischen Anlagen- und Verfahrenssicherheit. Mit Deiner Expertise im Boden- und Gewässerschutz agierst Du am Standort Mannheim als zentrale Instanz für die Überwachung und fachliche Beratung zur Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen. Du stellst sicher, dass die Betreiberverantwortung durch fundierte Expertise und proaktive Begutachtung gestärkt wird, und übernimmst darüber hinaus folgende spannende Aufgaben:
• Du überprüfst sicherheitstechnische Konzepte und stellst sicher, dass diese den gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen im Bereich Gewässerschutz entsprechen.
• Du übernimmst die fachliche Überprüfung und auditierst die Umsetzung von Umwelt- und Sicherheitsvorgaben für Gewässer- und Bodenschutz, um die Einhaltung der Standards nachhaltig zu sichern.
• Durch die Bestellung zum Gewässerschutzbeauftragten und die fachliche Beratung der Verantwortlichen minimierst du proaktiv Risiken und sicherst die Compliance ab.
• Bei umweltrelevanten Vorfällen führst du fundierte Ursachenanalysen durch und verantwortest das Reporting gemäß gesetzlichen und Roche-internen Standards in Deinem Fachgebiet. Bei Bedarf unterstützt du intern im Rahmen der Gefahrenabwehr und im Notfallmanagement.
• Du agierst als kompetente:r Berater:in für die Fachbereiche, indem du Du komplexe Vorschriften wie das WHG oder die AwSV analysierst und in klare, praxisnahe Handlungsanweisungen für unsere Business Units übersetzt.
• Du agierst als Schnittstelle zu Genehmigungs- und Aufsichtsbehörden in Deinem Fachgebiet und begleitest die Fachbereiche proaktiv bei externen Audits und Inspektionen.
• Du beteiligst dich aktiv in internen (z.B. Communities of Practice) und externen (z.B. VCI) Gremien und und trägst mit Deinem Fachwissen zu pragmatischen und wirtschaftlichen Lösungsfindungen bei. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast ein Studium (Bachelo

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Account Executive - Core Lab A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity This is a Capital Equipment Sales Role. Responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week required in assigned territory, both existing and prospects. Able to do overnights as needed. Works to build and maintain a network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of the area of the clinical laboratory. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is a fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in their own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. Responsible for maintaining existing business and work in ways that will ensure sales goals, achievements and growth. This is a field-based role covering the Florida Panhandle, Tallahassee and Jacksonville areas. Candidates must reside within 50 miles of the territory. Job Facts
• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted (hospital and reference laboratory) accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche (chemistry, immunoassay and automation) products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• Minimum of 10 to 15 in person sales calls per week
• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to (laboratory diagnostics) customers.
• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate (capital equipment) sales process and productivity.
• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare (reagent and capital equipment) proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency.

The Position The Opportunity: As a Senior Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.

• Manage vendor accounts
• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution
• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries
• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams
• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer Who you are:
• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment

title: Domain Architect - International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement

titleByLocale.it: Domain Architetto - International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement
titleByLocale.en: Domain Architect - International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement
titleByLocale.de: Domain Architect - International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Principal Domain Architect designs business-driven, future-ready solutions for our International Pharma Commercial Marketing & Customer Engagement portfolio. In this strategic role, you will define the architectural vision for how we engage with patients and HCPs across international markets. You will align technology deployments with commercial priorities, ensuring our "Global-to-Local" scaling strategy is seamless, compliant, and data-driven Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Designs solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards within a Multiple Solution, Platform, or Product Line Context. Manages Non-Functional Requirements (NFR) and fitness functions. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle and strictly aligns with the architecture community for governance.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Guides others in resolving highly complex issues and problems with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes. Defines and manages architecture, governance, and technology aligned with stakeholder needs. Maintains the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for a complete platform or product line. Creates Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways. Defines and drives reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions, ensuring Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) are systematically recorded and published across the platform. Drives external technology trends and assesses feasibility, including comprehensive vendor assessments.
• Stakeholder Management: Communicates complex ideas and influences senior-level stakeholders to adopt new approaches. Deeply connects with and understands the business needs, closely partnering with Commercial Excellence, Medical Affairs and Marketing stakeholders. Drives seamless information sharing across the complete customer engagement products .
• Impact: Provides high-level technical oversight, guidance, and consultation on specific technologies for product teams. Improves existing solutions, manages technical debt, and researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption of new technologies. Identifies strategic opportunities to enhance value and business processes within a Platform or Product.
• Domain Strategy: Maintain the technology roadmap for the International Commercial landscape, focusing on CRM, Omnichannel Marketing, and other capabilities
• Business / Technical ability: Applies in-depth and expert-level knowledge across multiple technology areas. Serves as a recognized leader in Architecture Practices development and mentoring. Qualifications Education / Experience
• 5+ years of experience in designing and architecting business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a multiple solution, platform, or product line context.
• Experience resolving highly complex issues with implications on cross-functional organizational processes and outcomes.
• Proven track record acting as a recognized leader in architecture practices, including significant experience mentoring and developing architectural talent.
• Experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry Technical Skills
• Demonstrates deep technical authority across diverse technology stacks to solve complex, enterprise-scale challenges.
• Expert at designing Conceptual and Logical Data Models, Taxono

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for an IT senior engineer to join one of our teams in Roche Digital Technology. In Roche Digital Technology we focus on delivering technology that evolves the practice of medicine and helps patients live longer, better lives. You will be responsible for the Design and Implementation of Directory Services (mainly Microsoft Active Directory) solutions and tier 2-3 operational support, performance, lifecycle management and continuous improvement of the underlying technologies. You will be part of multiple initiatives or projects with multiple specialists across multiple time zones in order to achieve the organizational objectives. As a Manufacturing Specialist Directory Services you would be part of a multicultural and global team protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access, security risks and cyber attacks. Job Responsibilities
• Collaborate in small to medium sized technical teams and contribute to the end to end design of infrastructure solutions producing and maintaining sufficient documentation.
• Interact with senior internal and external partners on significant technical matters and contribute to determining success criteria and evaluation of promising solutions/technologies via Proofs of Concepts (PoC’s) and feasibility studies.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd level support. Operationally manage and support and implement the Directory Services Infrastructure on premises for manufacturing environments and its associated compliments and applications.
• Proactively monitor systems and platforms for performance, availability and capacity management and ensure that the solution and component escalations are minimized.
• Promptly responding to customer requests, resolve incidents and implement changes, ensuring a high level of customer engagement and satisfaction
• Understanding, implementing and following relevant concepts of ITIL, GxP and Project Management. These include Request Management, Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Document Management, Qualification and Validation and Project Management
• Actively focusing on own self-development and creating actionable plans to improve
• Provide 24x7 on-call support. Flexibility regarding working hours
• Occasional international travel is required Qualifications Education / Experience
• Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline; or recognition of prior working experience which is equivalent.
• 4+ years experience administering and advance troubleshooting in Active Directory
• Robust experience working in a major global organization, preferably in a regulated industry Technical Skills
• Strong design and hands-on technical background. Solid experience on Microsoft Active Directory, Lightweight Directory Services (LDAP) and desirable in Entra ID.
• Powershell Scripting skills will be required
• Ability to apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis in practical scenarios
• Skill in evaluating change and technology impacts with increasing accuracy, and breaking down complex technical concepts with minimal guidance Additional Qualifications
• Proven interpersonal skills to interact effectively with individuals in multiple countries and in varying cultures
• Willingness to continually evolve, acquire and maintain the technical and soft skills appropriate to the requirements of this position
• Committing to operational excellence, with a willin

descriptionByLocale.it: # Mansioni - **Product Manager - Delivery Organization Primary Operational Anchor and Practitioner-Leader** # Descrizione dell'Area - Guida una squadra di consegna diversificata, composta da Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs e STEs. - Opera come un leader praticante, bilanciando la mentorship approfondita con l'esecuzione della rete. - Stabilisce una fiducia assoluta con i leader aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione costante e una partnership attiva. # Opportunità: - **Guida la Strategia del Prodotto:** Responsabile della direzione del prodotto, garantendo che tutte le funzionalità e le roadmap si allineino con gli obiettivi finanziari e gli obiettivi organizzativi definiti. - **Dirige l'Eccellenza Cross-Funzionale:** Orchestra il flusso continuo del flusso di valore Agile mentre guida distinti programmi e progetti verso il completamento riuscito. - **Favorisce Partnerships Fiduciarie:** Costruisce alleanze profonde con i dirigenti aziendali e IT attraverso una comunicazione trasparente per colmare il divario tra strategia ed esecuzione. - **Promuove la Centralità del Cliente:** Funziona come il proprietario principale del problema del cliente, priorizzando i bisogni interni degli utenti per consegnare soluzioni che forniscono un valore tangibile. - **Esegue la Gestione del Ciclo di Vita End-to-End:** Guida l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dalla pianificazione strategica iniziale all'ideazione, al lancio, all'espansione e alla fine al pensionamento. - **Innova con l'IA:** Integra proattivamente le capacità rilevanti dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) nella roadmap del prodotto per mantenere un portafoglio competitivo e pronto per il futuro. - **Ottimizza le Prestazioni:** Definisce e traccia gli indicatori chiave delle prestazioni (KPI) e le metriche di soddisfazione dell'utente per informare le iterazioni e le ottimizzazioni del prodotto basate sui dati. - **Nurture Team Development:** Funziona come un coach praticante, mentor della squadra per padroneggiare la facilitazione SAFe e navigare paesaggi ibridi complessi (Agile/Waterfall). # Chi sei: - **Leader Esperto del Prodotto:** Porti 5+ anni di esperienza in gestione del prodotto o analisi aziendale con un track record comprovato di lancio di prodotti tecnologici. - **Specialista del Settore:** Possiedi 2+ anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico o nella tecnologia regolamentata del settore sanitario. - **Leader Esperto:** Possiedi 1+ anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership nella gestione di squadre tecniche multidisciplinary e nell'esercizio dell'autorità sulle persone. - **Tecnicamente Proficuo:** Hai una forte comprensione dell'architettura del software (API, cloud) e del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del prodotto, compresi GxP e GDPR. - **Comunicatore Strategico:** Eccelli nella traduzione degli obiettivi scientifici di alto livello in roadmap concrete e nell'influenzare gruppi diversi verso una visione comune. - **Esperto di Agile:** Sei esperto nella facilitazione SAFe e sei in grado di rimuovere gli ostacoli sistemici per mantenere l'eccellenza operativa e il flusso. - **Fondamento Accademico:** Sei altamente istruito in un campo scientifico, tecnico o aziendale rilevante, che sostiene la tua capacità. # Contatto - Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il sito web di Roche o contatta il tuo recruiter dedicato.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe it’s urgent to deliver medical solutions right now – even as we develop innovations for the future. We are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are fearless in both decision-making and taking action. You will be the primary operational anchor and practitioner-leader for our delivery organization, bridging the gap between strategic intent and technical execution. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead engineering teams in building sustainable products that accelerate the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines. Description of the Area We are seeking a hands-on leader, ideally with experience as an STE, RTE, Program Manager or Initiative Owner, to guide a diverse delivery team, including Senior Project/Program Managers, Deployment Leads, RTEs, and STEs. You will operate as a practitioner-leader, balancing deep mentorship with Network Execution. Success in this role relies on establishing absolute trust with Business and IT leaders through constant communication and active partnership. The Opportunity:
• Drive Product Strategy: Accountable for setting the product direction, ensuring all features and roadmaps align with defined financial objectives and organizational goals.
• Lead Cross-Functional Excellence: Orchestrate the continuous flow of the Agile Value Stream while simultaneously driving distinct programs and projects to successful completion.
• Foster Trusted Partnerships: Build deep alliances with Business and IT executives through transparent communication to bridge the gap between strategy and execution.
• Champion Customer-Centricity: Act as the primary owner of the customer's problem, prioritizing internal user needs to deliver solutions that provide tangible value.
• Execute End-to-End Lifecycle Management: Lead the entire product lifecycle from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement.
• Innovate with AI: Proactively integrate relevant Artificial Intelligence (AI) capabilities into the product roadmap to maintain a competitive and future-ready portfolio.
• Optimize Performance: Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and user satisfaction metrics to inform data-driven product iterations and optimizations.
• Nurture Team Development: Act as a practitioner-coach, mentoring your team to master SAFe facilitation and navigate complex hybrid (Agile/Waterfall) landscapes. Who you are:
• Experienced Product Leader: You bring 5+ years of experience in product management or business analysis with a proven track record of launching technology products.
• Industry Specialist: You possess 2+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry.
• Proven People Lead: You have 1+ years of experience in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary technical teams and holding people authority.
• Technically Proficient: You have a strong understanding of software architecture (APIs, cloud) and the product development lifecycle, including GxP and GDPR.
• Strategic Communicator: You excel at translating high-level scientific goals into concrete roadmaps and influencing diverse groups toward a common vision.
• Agile Expert: You are skilled in SAFe facilitation and capable of removing systemic impediments to maintain operational excellence and flow.
• Academic Foundation: You are highly educated in a relevant scientific, technical, or business field, supporting your ability

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni Pharma Technical Operations (PT) è responsabile della produzione, della catena di fornitura e della qualità in tutta la rete farmaceutica. All'interno di PT, PTT (MSAT & Engineering) si occupa di garantire che PT rimanga all'avanguardia nella tecnologia dei nostri impianti e supporti i nostri processi robusti e operativi funzionanti. Ci concentriamo sull'integrazione della salute del prodotto, della salute del processo con l'attrezzatura adatta allo scopo e la prontezza dell'impianto a della rete di produzione. Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT garantisce che i nostri prodotti collegati ai dispositivi, inclusi i piattaforme e i sistemi di sorveglianza, siano progettati in modo robusto, prodotti in modo efficiente e consegnati e mantenuti in modo sicuro. Il team di piattaforme per dispositivi medici di Roche sviluppa sistemi di somministrazione di farmaci innovativi che supportano i portafogli terapeutici, per la cura degli occhi e degli incretin.
• Stiamo cercando un Ingegnere di progettazione di piattaforme per dispositivi medici altamente qualificati per contribuire alla progettazione e alla manutenzione delle piattaforme di Autoinjector e/o PFS-Needle Safety Device utilizzata nei prodotti farmaco-dispositivo. L'opportunità Il candidato ideale è un risolutore di problemi pratici, un pensatore strategico e un consulente tecnico attendibile che può essere immergersi nei problemi di ingegneria che forniscono e feedback azionabili in tutto il ciclo di vita dello sviluppo e dell'ingegneria di manutenzione di Roche. * Fare da esperto di progettazione di prodotto tecnico che supporta i team di sviluppo e ingegneria di manutenzione per tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto sulla piattaforma. * Fornire competenze professionali di progettazione ingegneristica meccanica su più prodotti, dalla generazione del all'analisi ingegneristica alla tecnologia di progettazione della piattaforma del dispositivo utilizzata sia internamente che esternamente. * Interagire con i fornitori esterni e i partner per fornire la supervisione tecnica sulla meccanica progettazione dei componenti e dei sottosistemi utilizzati nei prodotti di combinazione (siringhe pre-riempite e autoiniettori), guidando le prestazioni, la responsabilità e l'innovazione. * Condurre dirette dell'ingegneria della affidabilità, inclusi i test al limite di fallimento, le attività di gestione delle varianze, le competenze della sensibilità delle tolleranze e la manutenzione dei modelli di ingegneria assistita dal computer e dei gemelli digitali per la raccolta dei dati analitici virtuali. * Ricercare attivamente, anticipare e risolvere i problemi tecnici funzionalità e di assemblaggio dei prodotti di combinazione basata sulla piattaforma Autoinjector e PFS-NSD. * Condurre e partecipare alla scrittura delle specifiche del prodotto e del cliente, alle revisioni di progettazione e di fase di progettazione, alle conseguenze del rischio del prodotto e del processo, alle indagini sulle cause radicali e al piano di azione correttiva. Chi sei? Questo ruolo è ideale per un ingegnere versatile e motivato, con una solida base tecnica di progettazione e la capacità di adattarsi rapidamente ai diversi discipline, progetti e sfide. * Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o titolo di studio equivalente con esperienza, inclusa una comprensione approfondita delle siringhe pre-riempite, degli autoiniettori, dei dispositivi di sicurezza delle siringhe pre-riempite e/o dei processi di progettazione e produzione dei sistemi di somministrazione dei farmaci innovativi. * Conoscenza della scienza dei materiali, in particolare come si relaziona ai sistemi di somministrazione dei farmaci, inclusa la conoscenza dei meccanismi di danno, dei difetti comuni e dei test delle prestazioni. * Conoscenza dei metodi e degli strumenti di modellazione del sistema.
