At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Pharma Technical Operations (PT) is responsible for manufacturing, supply chain, and quality across the pharmaceutical network. Within PT, PTT (MSAT & Engineering) is responsible for ensuring that PT stays at the forefront of technology in our facilities and supports our robust processes & efficient operations. We focus on integrating product health, process health with equipment fit for purpose, and facility readiness in support of the manufacturing network. Global Device, Packaging and Distribution MSAT ensures our device-related products including platforms and packaging systems are robustly engineered, efficiently manufactured, and safely delivered and maintained. The medical device platform team at Roche advances innovative drug delivery systems supporting Roche’s therapeutic, eye care and incretin portfolios. We are seeking a highly skilled Medical Device Platform Design Engineer to contribute to the design and maintenance of Autoinjector and/or PFS-Needle Safety Device platforms utilized in drug-device combination products. The Opportunity The successful candidate is a hands-on problem solver, a strategic thinker, and a trusted technical advisor who can both dive deep into engineering challenges and provide actionable guidance and feedback across Roche’s development and sustaining engineering lifecycles.
• Act as technical product design expert supporting product development and sustaining engineering teams throughout the platform-based combination product lifecycle.
• Provide professional mechanical engineering design expertise on multiple products, from concept generation and engineering analysis to both internally and externally utilized device design platform technologies.
• Interface with external suppliers and partners to provide technical oversight on the mechanical design of components and subassemblies used in combination products (prefilled syringes and autoinjectors), driving performance, accountability, and innovation.
• Lead reliability engineering assessments including edge-of-failure testing, variance management activities, tolerance sensitivity assessments, and creation/maintenance of Computer Aided Engineering models and digital twins for virtual analytical data collection.
• Actively seek out, anticipate, and solve significant functional and assembly related technical challenges of platform based Autoinjector and PFS-NSD combination products.
• Lead technical investigations, both within Roche as well as at third party manufacturers, for technical challenges related to design, manufacturing, and scale-up processes, to resolve device and assembly issues timely and effectively.
• Lead and participate in writing product and customer requirements, design and design phase reviews, product and process risk assessments, root cause investigations, and corrective action planning. Who you are This role is ideal for a versatile, self-motivated engineer with a broad technical design foundation and the ability to adapt quickly across disciplines, projects, and challenges.
• BS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent technical degree with experience including in-depth understanding of prefilled syringes, Autoinjector, PFS-Needle Safety Device and/or novel drug delivery design and manufacturing processes
• Familiarity with materials science, particularly as it relates to drug delivery systems, including knowledge of damage mechanisms, common defects, and performance testing.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job description As a Cloud DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE6 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps solutions across the entire infrastructure landscape. Possessing deep knowledge of the impact of DevOps practices on business infrastructure, you will make critical technical decisions across multiple product lines with considerable independence. In this role, you will proactively influence technology strategy, mentor teams, and ensure alignment with organizational objectives and regulatory standards. Description of the area Job Responsibilities
• Scope / (Content Leadership): Establishes technical direction to the whole lifecycle of platforms and services—from inception and design through deployment, operation, and retirement. Applies software engineering principles to build and manage large-scale IT infrastructure products and services, abstracting away the complexity of infrastructure to provide self-service tools and APIs for developers. Designs complex CI/CD pipelines, designs and develops self-healing features, and leads Disaster Recovery design and execution plans.
• Accountability/Problem Solving: Strategically applies advanced problem-solving and decision-making skills to address highly complex issues spanning multiple product lines within a domain. Leads the maintenance of live services by designing metrics to measure availability, latency, and system health, and is responsible for identifying critical metrics used to establish SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs. Proactively plans for IT Infrastructure capacity, performance, and scalability, and leads large initiatives aimed at optimizing inter-related platforms. Accountable for availability, tuning, efficiency, change and configuration management, and emergency response.
• Stakeholder Management: Demonstrates exceptional customer and delivery focus by proactively leading partnership and collaboration with developers, Managed Services suppliers, and vendors to continuously improve application development velocity and optimize services reliability. Works closely with development teams to ensure new features are rolled out with a strategic understanding of reliability. Provides direction, guidance, and priority setting, acting as a senior analyst to transform customer and developer needs into specific requirements.
• Impact/Strategy: Ensures implemented solutions comply with Quality/Regulatory standards and is responsible for implementing and updating cost, compliance, and security best practices. Leads complex audit exercises, providing required evidence to audit teams, and leads audit remediation plans. Manages ITSM processes, challenges requirements to scale systems sustainably, and applies innovation to foster business strategy.
• Complexity/ (Product Size): Demonstrates proven ability to collaborate effectively with diverse virtual teams globally, driving success across multiple product lines within a domain. Leads geo-distributed teams through influence and mentorship, providing specialized guidance to optimize performance and innovation.
• Business/Technical ability: Utilizes wide experience applying Software Engineering principles, automated testing, and CI/CD tools to define technical computing infrastructure entirely under the control of software with no human intervention. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. We have co-created a forward-looking recruitment model designed to secure top-tier talent while prioritizing the needs of our customers and patients. Our services are tailored to organizational requirements, with a commitment to quality and efficiency. As a Talent Acquisition Partner, you will work across borders within an empowered, self-organized environment. You will support team development and deliver exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences by leveraging diverse talent and specialized expertise. The Position
• Drive the end-to-end global standardized recruiting process while providing customized talent acquisition strategies, employer branding, and expert candidate selection and offer negotiation.
• Act as a professional consultant and strategic partner to global teams for comprehensive talent acquisition needs, including proactive sourcing and hiring.
• Demonstrate leadership by partnering with hiring managers and senior business leaders to build, develop, and sustain high-performing teams.
• Lead cross-regional recruitment initiatives and manage complex transformation projects, interpreting business challenges to recommend best practices that enhance our ability to attract top-tier talent.
• Collaborate seamlessly with Rewards, People Services, Business Partnering, and People Relations to execute global recruitment strategies.
• Empower and coach team members to drive organizational growth, proficiently mentoring individuals and global teams within the recruiting function.
• Proactively develop talent pipelines using advanced applicant tracking and sourcing tools, while staying at the forefront of global recruitment trends. Who you are
• University degree with 6+ years of proven recruiting experience in a corporate, biotech, or pharmaceutical environment.
• Fluency in Spanish and English is mandatory; Portuguese language skills are highly desirable.
• Proven recruiting experience across different countries in Latin America
• Superior stakeholder management capabilities, with a focus on effective communication, influencing, and collaborative partnering.
• High learning agility, capable of spotting patterns, processes, and influencing outcomes.
• Technical expertise in diverse sourcing, direct sourcing, web recruitment tools, offer process/systems management, and proactive talent/candidate sourcing with various ATS systems, Workday and Phenom preferred
• Possesses an enterprise mindset, excelling in ambiguous situations, and demonstrating strong business acumen.
• Strong consultative problem-solving skills, an agile mindset, and the ability to champion organizational change. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Die Abteilung Pharma Technical Characterization Cell and Genetherapy (PTCG ) ist verantwortlich für die technische Entwicklung von in vivo Gentherapeutika in der präklinischen und klinischen Entwicklungsphase. Das Team Die Funktion Gentherapie-Analytik konzentriert sich auf die analytische Charakterisierung, Qualitätskontrolle sowie die Entwicklung und Implementierung neuartiger analytischer Technologien von präklinischen Studien bis zur Marktzulassung (BLA, Biologics License Application) und Markteinführung für gentherapeutische Modalitäten. Deine Aufgaben Wir suchen Dich mit speziellem Fokus auf Liquid Handling und Automation analytischer Methoden für die Testung und Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren und Plasmiden . Zudem übernimmst du Projektverantwortung für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte in der Entwicklung.
• Automation & Innovation: Scouting, Evaluierung, Entwicklung sowie die Implementierung und routinemäßige Anwendung innovativer vollautomatisierter E2E Lösungen von Methoden für die Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (vorwiegend rAAV) und Plasmiden.
• Portfolio Projektverantwortung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner in präklinischen sowie klinischen Phasen für Gentherapie Portfolioprojekte, agierst als Vertreter der Analytischen Entwicklung und Qualitätskontrolle in den Technical Development Teams (TDT) und koordinierst anstehende Aufgaben innerhalb der Teams unter Berücksichtigung der Timelines.
• Funktionelle Analyse : Vorantreiben der Technologien zur Quantifizierung und funktionellen Charakterisierung in einem hochmotivierten, agilen und interdisziplinären Team.
• Praktische Durchführung: Eigenverantwortliche, selbstorganisierte Durchführung von Experimenten, Methodenentwicklung sowie Gerätequalifizierung und Test-Validierung unter GMP-Anforderungen inklusive der Durchführung der Analysen.
• Strategische Mitwirkung: Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Definition von Kontroll- und Prüfstrategien für gentherapeutische Vektorenprodukte.
• Datenmanagement: Selbstständige Interpretation, Bewertung und Dokumentation von Daten sowie Erstellung von Analyseberichten gemäß den geltenden regulatorischen Vorschriften. Unser Wunschprofil
• PhD-Abschluss in Biologie, molekularbiologischen oder einer anderen einschlägigen biowissenschaftlichen Disziplin mit > 3 Jahren praktische Erfahrung mit Liquid Handling Systemen für analytische Anwendungen.
• Darüber hinaus bringst du ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Datenbanken und Datenflüsse mit sowie Grundlagen in SQL, VBA, Python oder ähnlichen Programmiersprachen.
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz und Fachkenntnisse (sowohl theoretisch als auch praktisch) in der Charakterisierung von viralen Vektoren (AAV, Lentiviren etc.) mittels analytischer Methoden.
• Expertenwissen auf dem Gebiet der Plasmide und gentherapeutischen Modalitäten (AAV, Lentiviren, etc.)
• Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen mit den Grundsätzen der GMP (z.B. Datenintegrität, Gerätequalifizierung, Testvalidierung).
• Ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Ergebnisorientierung und Teamfähigkeit.
• Fließende englische und deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift). Diese Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Ready to put the voice of the customer at the heart of healthcare innovation? As our new field-based Regional Customer Account Manager - South you won’t just manage a team—you will inspire a regional squad of Account Managers and Senior Account Managers to redefine the Roche customer experience. If you are a strategic commercial leader who thrives on the road, builds deep, meaningful relationships, and knows how to turn a superior customer experience into long-term business growth, we want you on our frontline. Reports to: Head of Customer Account Management Key Responsibilities
• Creates and influences account management strategies that cross organisational boundaries to achieve broad business goals
• Establishes and maintains consistent and productive relationships with customer Senior lab management and especially with the “C” suite level leadership teams
• Manages/leads critical regional support escalations, often including multiple internal and external support teams and often with visibility to internal and external leadership teams
• Leads sharing of best practices with sales & account management team community
• Leads clients to drive service performance improvements through effective long term partnerships Key Activities Customer experience management
• Manages service delivery of a team of peers and account managers, leads through influence
• Manages the delivery of recommended/agreed-upon services to achieve high customer satisfaction and trust at a regional level
• Manages a diverse and complex scope of support issues at a regional level. Solves complex support issues effectively through the internal network of Roche professionals
• Assesses customers’ risks & needs and recommends appropriate service offerings to proactively address customer issues at a regional level as well as providing input to the Access and Innovation function
• Establishes and maintains relationships with regional sales and cross functional teams to execute on a regional account plan Contract Development
• Ensures Roche and third party stakeholders understand each customer’s requirements and the pressures/opportunities they are experiencing
• Works closely with colleagues, third party partners and the customer to ensure changes in and novation to MS contracts are timely and appropriate
• Ensures all proposals meet with customer requirements and stage of the contract life cycle Key Contributions (impact of the role)
• Retains and grows customer business and profitability within the region via C suite engagement
• Increases NPS for customer satisfaction within region
• Drives ideation with innovation and business development function
• Drives service performance initiatives with internal and external stakeholders to improve processes focussed on improving customer experience Team Development
• Motivates and leads the team to success, through: development in role; delivery of timely feedback, celebration of success, fostering a culture of team working and collaboration
• Organisation of regular 1:1 meetings with team and timely feedback
• Active performance management Decision Making Authority
• Authority to make decisions in line with current DOA - Supported by the Customer Account Management Team and Commercial Director NB: Key Responsibilities/Activities may differ according to each customer requirement Who you are
• Educated to degree level or equivalent
• Full valid UK Driving License
• Mobile (ability to stay away from home mid-week on oc

La Oportunidad

The Position As a Learning Intern , you will join our Global Learning Services (GLS) team within the People Support Solutions (PSS) organization in Roche. In this role, you will assist with executing routine administrative and system data maintenance activities in our Learning Management System ( Cornerstone ). You will gain hands-on learning experience in a shared service environment, supporting learning processes and ensuring high-quality, customer-focused support for our global learning community. Your Key Responsibilities
• System Administration : Execute routine data maintenance and system administrative tasks within Cornerstone and other relevant learning systems in a timely and accurate manner.
• Process Support : Assist with the administrative coordination of various training events, including new employee orientation, leadership training, professional training, and other training requests.
• Customer Support : Help provide customer service and troubleshooting support regarding training records, learning processes, and system inquiries to internal HR experts and business partners.
• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.
• Compliance & Integrity : Perform daily duties with high integrity, adhering to global and local guidelines, including strict data privacy rules and safety, security, and environmental (SHE) regulations. Who You Are We are looking for an analytical, proactive and collaborative university students who bring the following skills and competencies:
• Education : Currently enrolled in a university program with active/passive full-time student status in Hungary (studies in HR, Business, or Social Sciences are preferred).

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist based in Ireland (ideally Dublin area). Job Summary As a Near Patient Care Sales Specialist at Roche Diagnostics Ltd. in Ireland, you are at the forefront of the healthcare revolution, moving diagnostics closer to the patient to enable faster, more clinical decision-making. You will manage a high-value portfolio—including Point-of-Care (POC) and associated digital solutions—across hospitals, HSE clinics, and community care settings.
• Location: Field-based (Ireland).
• Role Type: Permanent
• Company: Roche Diagnostics Ltd.
• Primary Goal: To drive the adoption of "Near Patient Care" technologies, ensuring healthcare providers have the tools to deliver real-time results that improve patient outcomes and hospital efficiencies. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Sales & Territory Management
• Drive Revenue: Meet and exceed sales targets for the Near Patient Care portfolio (e.g., blood gas, glucose monitoring, and rapid diagnostic platforms).
• Market Growth: Identify new business opportunities within the HSE, private hospitals, and community health districts.
• Tender Management: Lead and contribute to complex tender submissions for business acquisition and retention within the Irish healthcare landscape. 2. Customer Partnership & Consultation
• Relationship Building: Nurture deep relationships with key stakeholders, including Hospital Managers, Laboratory Directors, Point of Care Coordinators, and HSE procurement.
• Solution Selling: Consult with clinical teams to understand their workflow challenges and develop tailored diagnostic solutions that enhance service delivery.
• Clinical Education: Provide high-quality product demonstrations and in-service training for healthcare professionals to ensure the effective use of Roche technology. 3. Market Intelligence & Analysis
• Competitive Awareness: Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and emerging technologies to inform strategic sales planning.
• CRM Management: Maintain accurate records and sales pipelines within Salesforce to support forecasting and territory reporting. Requirements & Qualifications Essential:
• Education: Degree level in Life Sciences, Biomedical Science, or a related field.
• Experience: Proven track record in medical device or diagnostic sales with experience in the Irish HSE ecosystem.
• License: Full, clean driving license.
• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and "respectfully challenge the status quo". Desirable:
• Point-of-Care Expertise: Specific knowledge of "Near Patient" or Point of Care (POC) diagnostic workflows.
• Agile Mindset: Ability to work in an agile environment and adapt to a rapidly evolving pathology pipeline. Why Join Roche?
• Impact: Be part of a global leader that aims to "prevent, stop, and cure diseases" by ensuring access to healthcare today and for generations to come.
• Culture: A collaborative environment that encourages "personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections".
• Growth: Extensive opportunities for professional development and career progression within the broader Roche network. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines

The Position Technical Manager - Regional Customer Support Centre Are you looking for an exciting challenge? Are you ready to lead a specialist team in delivering world-class diagnostic support across the UK, Ireland and Northern Europe? Roche Diagnostics is looking for a Technical Manager to lead our SWA/Core Lab Hardware remote support team. Based within our Regional Customer Support Centre (RCSC) in Burgess Hill, you will be the strategic lead for a team of 16 specialists providing critical technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio. The Role As Technical Manager, you will lead a team of 16 specialists who provide remote technical and systems support for the Roche Core Laboratory portfolio, alongside customer and staff training. You will be the driving force behind the team’s operational and strategic success, ensuring we deliver a "best-in-class" customer experience. You will be accountable for the successful delivery of service requirements across the UK, Ireland, Nordics and the wider EMEA-LATAM region. Key Responsibilities:
• Leadership & Coaching: Use your skills to empower your team, remove obstacles and foster high performance.
• Line Management: Drive recruitment of ideal skill sets, manage performance and take ownership of the team's professional development.
• Strategic Collaboration: Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Regional Service Managers to ensure the technical service offering aligns with broader business goals.
• Operational Excellence: Oversee the delivery of high-value remote support and the implementation of Roche Global standards. Location & Flexibility This is an office based role with an expectation of a minimum of 2 days a week in our office in Burgess Hill, Sussex. Who you are You are a resilient leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You don’t just manage tasks; you inspire innovation and possess a "questioning" approach that challenges the status quo to exceed customer expectations. Essential Requirements:
• Education: A degree in a relevant field OR a proven track record of technical mastery and leadership in an engineering environment.
• Experience: A minimum of 3 years experience of leading technical teams
• Technical Background: A proven track record of supporting complex healthcare instrumentation and/or deep experience within a Blood Sciences laboratory.
• Leadership: Proven experience in line management or a clear ability to demonstrate the leadership competencies required to coach and develop a high-performing team.
• Technical Proficiency: Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office, Google Suite, and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce).
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a matrix environment.
• IT Literacy: Strong digital skills, including Microsoft/Google Suite and CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce). Investing in you Roche is a company that invests as much in its people as it does in R&D (over £6.5 billion worldwide). In addition to a competitive salary and benefits package, you will receive recognised product training and continuous support to build your knowledge and potential. • Lead or act as the automation maintenance team coordinate with Engineering department, production department, quality department, vendors, etc. for cooperation to achieve the positive goal.
• Establish and develop the automation system in alignment with the Roche standards including maintenance management system, people training and qualification, CCS strategy and implementation to support robust operation readiness.
• Support manager to develop a competent team through coaching, mentoring and training by having in place a skill competencies development and appraisal program to strengthen the technical expertise and capabilities.

• Implementations Support
• Improve management of, and access to, business-critical scientific data for all scientific disciplines across Roche.
• Provide consultation with regards to automation systems, computerized systems and software, implementation and validation.
• Business Partnering and Solution Provision
• Strive to provide the best workable solution using the software/systems and systems available in alignment with the sites digital strategy.
• Develop an in-depth understanding of Automation/IT and business initiatives, strategies and needs for the future and ensure alignment of Automation/OT strategy.
• Be aware of current and emerging technologies which could benefit/add value to the site and promote these opportunities internally.
• Provide strategic directions to the automation group specifically around the areas of software and hardware. Responsible for implementing site digital roadmap according to Roche global strategy.
• Automation Operations
• Provide SME support to manufacturing and other departments for the design and operation of process automation equipment.
• Conduct troubleshooting and technical analyses on manufacturing equipment and process automation system including PI data analyses, code review/troubleshooting, etc.
• Act as controls engineer for tech transfer or new process into the facilities.
• Support production and project teams in all questions of Automation and controls
• Develop technical knowledge on manufacturing equipment and process automation system.
• Secures professional and economic execution of all activities and high availability of manufacturing unit and equipment.
• Also provide training to site users to ensure the operational use, and shop floor service during production.
• Create/Revise/Review Automation and manufacturing related SOP's Functional Specs, work instructions, equipment and process changes.
• Perform high level system administration of Automation systems: managing the user roles, including their configurations, security rights and access rights.
• On call for system emergent complex trouble shooting escalated from technicians.

• 偏差与变更管理： 在 SME 指导下，协助收集 GMP 偏差（Deviation）和变更（Change Control）相关的背景数据和证明文件。

• 现场调查支持： 参与生产设备或工艺偏差的现场调研，协助收集故障相关的运行参数和物料数据，并整理成报告草案。 任职资格要求： 教育背景：
• 本科或研究生在读， 制药、生物工程、自动化、信息技术、工业工程 或相关专业背景优先。 技能要求：
• 熟练使用 Office 办公软件（尤其是 Excel 的数据处理能力）。
• 具备良好的文档撰写能力，逻辑清晰。

title: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)

titleByLocale.it: Ricerca e valutazione China Strategy Lead (CVRM)
titleByLocale.en: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)
titleByLocale.de: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)
titleByLocale.fr: Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead (CVRM)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche aims to be an innovation accelerator in China, collaborating with partners to jointly develop and deliver novel therapies for patients across the world. This effort is designed to expand and deepen their collective impact on patient health. The global I2CVRM Search & Evaluation (S&E) team, a component of Corporate Business Development (CBD), is focused on identifying and securing external innovation opportunities that strategically align with the Immunology & Infectious Diseases (I2) and Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism (CVRM) Therapeutic Areas (TAs). This involves active engagement with the external innovation community, including academic institutions, venture capital firms, Roche Accelerator, KoL, PI and the startup biotech ecosystem. The S&E team works collaboratively with internal teams (e.g. Asian partnering team) to advance opportunities from initial identification and incubation through to pre-due diligence. A key function is translating the I2CVRM TA's end-to-end strategy (DAS) into regional sourcing and activation plans designed to bring high-impact science into our pipeline. We are looking to partner with pharma and biotech in China. Currently, the global I2CVRM S&E team has one Search and Evaluation China Strategy Lead CVRM opportunity available in Shanghai . The Opportunity The CVRM S&E China Strategy Lead will be responsible for proactively shaping and nurturing key relationships and stakeholders (prioritized academic research centers, Roche accelerator, venture capital investors, life science and health technology incubators and start-ups) to ensure Roche is perceived as a “Partner of Choice” in their respective regions. This leader will also work closely with the global S&E I2CVRM team & local Asian partnering team, to scout, triage and conduct early evaluations activities to understand the true value of further pursuit through provision of scientific expertise. This role reports to the Global Head I2CVRM S&E who is based in Basel (CH). Responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to the following:
• External Search: to cover the China CVRM landscape, to partner closely with the Global S&E Head to set the sourcing strategy and engagement plan aligned with the TA end to end strategy & CBD priorities
• To lead the triage process and work closely with TA partners and CBD colleagues to conduct initial evaluations and ensure alignment with our strategic focus. To provide scientific thought leadership and analysis in initial scientific review.
• The S&E China CVRM Strategy Lead will maintain overall oversight of S&E CVRM activities in China, with the autonomy to delegate specific landscaping, scouting or evaluation tasks to CBD team members (e.g. BDPLs from Asia partnering team) as appropriate.
• Building close relationships with relevant Roche & Genentech businesses. This is to both understand/contribute to strategy/requirements and to develop sufficient influence in order to champion new opportunities, including those that are potentially “off strategy” but where a compelling business case can be made.
• Supports the transition of identified opportunities to the Due Diligence phase via collaboration and transfer of background and scientific context to a BDPL
• Serves as an ambassador for CBD internally and externally at industry events
• The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list, and you may be required to undertake any other reasonable duties compatible with your experience and competencies.

• Assist Head of Microbiology lab to complete GMP Self-Inspection as well as the relevant CAPAs to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Key Responsibilities
• Metabolite Profiling & Identification: Conduct in vitro (e.g. microsomes, hepatocytes, S9, lysosome) and in vivo (e.g. plasma, urine, feces, bile, tumor tissue) metabolite identification studies across various species.
• Mass Spectrometry Lead: Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain advanced LC-HRMS instrumentation (e.g., Orbitrap or Q-TOF).
• Structural Elucidation: Interpret complex MS/MS fragmentation patterns to propose accurate chemical structures for metabolites.
• Pathway Mapping: Propose biotransformation pathways and identify potential "soft spots" in chemical leads to guide medicinal chemistry efforts.
• Reactive Metabolite Screening: Design and execute glutathione (GSH) trapping assays to assess potential idiosyncratic toxicity risks.
• Regulatory & Reporting: Oversee and manage CRO partnerships to ensure the delivery of high-quality technical reports; provide expert MetID authorship and scientific review for IND/NDA regulatory filings.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Medicinal Chemistry, DMPK/PD Lead, and Clinical Pharmacology lead to communicate the impact of metabolic data on project strategy. Qualifications & Skills
• Educational Background: Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, or related, with 4+ years of experience; or an MS with 8+ years of dedicated industry experience in small molecules and/or ADC DMPK.
• Technical Expertise: Proven mastery of liquid chromatography and high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) for structure elucidation.
• Biotransformation Expertise: Demonstrates a mastery of Phase I/II biotransformation pathways with the ability to translate in vitro metabolic data into predictive in vivo outcomes; experience navigating the unique MetID challenges of Antibody-Drug Conjugates (ADCs) is a significant plus.
• Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to "distill the essence" of complex data for stakeholders at all levels. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position Job Summary: Serving as an AI strategic catalyst, consultant, and coach, this role acts as the pivotal bridge between cutting-edge AI technology and business; customer needs in the IVD industry. The primary mission is to identify and incubate AI-driven digital products and solutions tailored for the IVD market. Furthermore, by establishing, expanding and iterating a corporate AI knowledge hub, this position will ensure technical accumulation and expertise sharing to empower the internal team, ultimately accelerating intelligent business evolution and the “AI-Native” transformation of organizational operations. The Opportunity : AI Business Innovation and Product Solution Incubation
• Deeply analyze needs in clinical labs, pathology, and hospital management to transform frontline feedback and pain points into clear, actionable AI-driven requirements, and closely collaborate with RIS to transfer ideas to product.
• Expertly interpret technical feedback from R&D by integrating AI application trends and customer insights; provide high-value perspectives to resolve conceptual misalignments and drive project milestones.
• Collaborate with internal product owners and lead the innovative iteration of launched digital products by identifying new AI-driven features and service models that align with market evolution.
• Serve as an AI subject matter expert during customer visits to articulate global AI trends and the unique value propositions of Roche’s digital portfolio, assist in defining product market positioning and collaborate to explore business model innovation. AI Capability Building and Organizational AI Native Reshaping
• Act as an internal AI consultant, orchestrating internal and external expertise to provide targeted AI training for pre-sales, post-sales, and general staff. This initiative focuses on boosting the team's overall proficiency in AI application and hands-on practical capabilities.
• Diagnose existing business processes from a consulting perspective and leverage AI tools to reconstruct internal operating models for efficiency and cost reduction, empowering AI transformation at organizational level.
• Build, expand and iterate the RDSL enterprise-level AI Knowledge Hub. Who you are:
• Master’s degree or above in CS, Bioinformatics, Data Science;
• Experience in the IVD, Pharmaceutical or MedTech industry is highly preferred.
• AI Technical Mastery - Proficient in LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and mainstream AI tools; ability to translate algorithmic logic into business language.
• Business Acumen - Deep understanding of clients’ pain points and the ability to match AI technology with specific IVD business scenarios.
• Soft Skills - Change management capabilities, cross-functional communication, and a relentless curiosity for new technologies. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The application specialist is responsible for responding to customers’ needs and expectations with high quality scientific answers, to contribute to customer long term loyalty, ensuring immediate and proper scientific support to customers (incl. providing instrument training and troubleshooting, settlement of scientific problems and timely update on new methods, techniques and Product Bulletins), and documenting all calls, activities on the CRM System. This is a field-based role. Key Responsibilities:
• Provide high-level scientific support and operator training to customers.
• Handle all calls received from customers that relate to CPS and troubleshoot them to provide instant solutions to reagent and software problems due to customer complaints.
• Escalate unsolved cases to 2nd level support CIR, and/or GCS with complete case explanation.
• Ensure follow-up until the issue has been resolved and the customer is satisfied.
• Provide scientific documentation to customers.
• Document all his activities in Rexis/Lightning/ NFSS.
• Deliver best in class support utilizing appropriate systems and processes and providing a consistent and high level of support to customers.
• Continuing development of application skills to ensure resilience in the support of all CPS products.
• Proactively propose and implement activities aligned with customer satisfaction surveys and on-going customer and business area feedback.
• Ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner and guarantee the activity reporting at the CRM (Rexis) software and appropriate escalation of product issues to management center and ensure that all administration is completed in a timely and accurate manner. Who you are:
• B.S. Medical Laboratory Sciences, Chemistry, Histopathology, Biology or Biochemistry or work-related experience.
• Good knowledge and experience in pathology solutions - an advantage.
• Fluent in English (oral and written).
• Technical vocabulary & terminology.
• Advanced computer skills (Windows and Microsoft Office).
• Experience in laboratory practice and/or experience in the use of automated laboratory equipment (Roche instruments preferably).
• Experience in laboratory manual practice and chemicals handling.
• Verbal and written communication skills.
• Planning, administration and decision making.
• Work well in a team environment.
• Service/Customer oriented.
• Creativity & well critical thinking with a proactive mindset. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Position At Roche/Genentech, we have a bold Pharma Ambition to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2030. Within Portfolio Strategy & Management (PSM), we bring this Ambition to life by driving high quality decisions to shape our portfolio. We want you to join our vision and be part of our passionate, collaborative, global PSM team! We are a strong, closely-knit, trusting team that operates from a creative mindset. We try things, openly discuss and learn from mistakes and failure, experiment and iterate to achieve our aspirations. We are THE place for talent to grow and contribute; our talent feels valued, connected, and a sense of belonging to something impactful. We have high impact; stakeholders rely on our expertise to help actively manage our portfolio in order to meet our Pharma Ambition. The Opportunity: As Portfolio Leader, Oncology you will focus on co-creating the Portfolio Strategy and managing the portfolio of the Oncology Therapeutic Area. You will be expected to closely collaborate with colleagues in groups beyond PSM (e.g., Global Product Strategy, PD Functions, other Portfolio groups in Roche, Program Management, Finance, gRED, pRED, Chugai) in your day to day work. Accountabilities include, but are not limited to, a combination of the following areas:
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Strategy development - Partner with PD & GPS Therapeutic Area Heads and other Pharma Leaders (LSPC members, PD & GPS Franchise Heads, pRED & gRED Therapeutic Area Leaders, LifeCycle Leaders) to co-create and deliver robust Oncology portfolio strategies that provide the scaffolding for molecule decisions
• Therapeutic Area Portfolio Management - Actively manage the Oncology portfolio with an enterprise mindset, providing data-driven actionable portfolio insights that contextualize individual molecule and project decisions within the Therapeutic Area, Late Stage, as well as Pharma portfolio priorities. Collaborate closely with the Late Stage Governance Team in implementing the governance process at the Therapeutic Area setting, as well as enabling development and business reviews in advance of portfolio investment decisions.
• Decision Support and Valuation - Serve as an active thought partner to decision-makers and mentor to Portfolio Leads for areas including, but not limited to defining/scoping of tactics to deliver on defined portfolio strategies; content expertise to develop strategic options and valuations; trade-off analysis, and/or decision framing including portfolio context. Serve as an objective and expert reviewer at Boards when invited, focusing on strategic options, trade-off analyses, and valuation
• Portfolio assessments and presentations - Understand and communicate portfolio dynamics (risk, value, mix, competitive positioning etc) at the Therapeutic Area, Late Stage, as well as Pharma levels to influence portfolio decisions.
• You will actively support and model talent flow to work with the highest impact across PSM as well as the broader portfolio community across R&D units to deliver more patient benefit. Who You Are: You are a talented and passionate individual, driven by our shared purpose of co-creating and delivering the portfolio for the benefit of patients. You bring the following background and experience:
• Bachelor's degree in science, business, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree and/or certification (e.g. MBA, PhD, PharmD, MS, MPH) preferred.
• Experience in matrix cross-functional leadership
• Excellent interpersonal skills, including clear, succinct and timely communication, proven ability to build trusting relationships with and influence stakeholders at all levels.
• Strong drug development understanding, along with planning and organizational skills.
• Demonstrated thought partnership and/or ability to influence Senior Leaders on complex topics, including framing, decision support, and options analysis.
• Experience

I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Strategia & Design: strategie di progettazione e ottimizzazione dei farmaci di piombo e profilazione dei composti per tutti gli aspetti del metabolismo e della farmacocinetica (DMPK), con un forte focus sui concetti di convalida della biologia di destinazione e di convalida traduttiva PK/Pharmacodinamica (PD).
• Valutazione traduttiva: fornire supporto ai team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione di destinazione attraverso l'applicazione di considerazioni biochimiche e farmacologiche.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Eseguire attività M&S fondamentali, tra cui PKPD, Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), e predizione dose/regimen umano, per fornire un supporto essenziale per progetti che spaziano dall'ottimizzazione del piombo (LO) all'ingresso nell'uomo (EIH).
• Supporto normativo: Preparare e fornire valutazioni scientifiche di alta qualità di informazioni DMPK non cliniche per le recensioni dei programmi interni e le sottomissioni normative esterne (ad esempio, Investigational New Drug (IND), Brochure dell'investigatore (IB), Applicazione clinica di prova (CTA), Nuova applicazione della droga (NDA), Applicazione della licenza di Biologics (BLA)).
• Attuazione: implementazione di biomarcatori e strategie bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con partner chiave per garantire la sicurezza dei pazienti e il raggiungimento di un significativo beneficio terapeutico.
• Collaborazione: Facilitare processi decisionali trasparenti e basati sui dati all'interno di team e team di progetto, coltivando e mantenendo relazioni professionali affidabili con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni. Si prega di notare che questa posizione è un contratto temporaneo di 2 anni. Chi sei
• Hai un PharmD o un PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia o Bioingegneria, abbinato a oltre 5 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico.
• Possiedi profonda esperienza nella scoperta, caratterizzazione precoce PK, distribuzione e PKPD attraverso varie modalità, sostenuta da una solida base in farmacologia e fisiologia.
• Lei dimostra esperienza pratica con la modellazione e la simulazione, la competenza nell'applicazione dell'Intelligenza Artificiale (AI) Machine Learning (ML) alla strategia DMPK, e un forte impulso a strumenti master come Phoenix, Ber
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond. The Opportunity As part of the Translational DMPK-PD and Clinical Pharmacology chapter, you will focus on providing the right drug at the right dose to patients safely with an efficacious benefit. You will collaborate closely with therapeutic areas to convert hypotheses into innovative medicines, driving nonclinical strategies to bring forward the best clinical candidates for specific indications. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategy & Design: Lead drug design and optimization strategies and compound profiling for all Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) aspects, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.
• Translational Evaluation: Provide support to early discovery teams in the development of translational strategies for the clinical evaluation of target modulation through the application of biochemical and pharmacological considerations.
• Modeling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimization (LO) through Entry into Human (EIH).
• Regulatory Support: Prepare and deliver high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK information for internal program reviews and external regulatory submissions (e.g., Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).
• Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.
• Collaboration: Facilitate transparent, data-driven decision-making processes within project teams and squads while cultivating and maintaining trustful professional relationships with both internal and external stakeholders. Please note that this position is a 2-year temporary contract. Who you are
• You hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, or Bioengineering, paired with over 5 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related field.
• You possess deep expertise in discovery, early PK characterization, distribution, and PKPD across various modalities, backed by a solid foundation in pharmacology and physiology.
• You demonstrate hands-on experience with modeling and simulation, proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) Machine Learning (ML) to DMPK strategy, and a strong drive to master tools like Phoenix, Ber

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in die Medizin zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. PS unterstützt Entdeckung und Entwicklung in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von der Zielbewertung bis zum Markt und darüber hinaus. Sie werden eng mit therapeutischen Bereichen zusammenarbeiten, um Hypothesen in innovative Arzneimittel umzuwandeln und nicht-klinische Strategien zu treiben, um die besten klinischen Kandidaten für spezifische Indikationen vorzubringen. Ihre Auswirkungen und Aufgaben:
• Strategie & Design: Lead Drug Design und Optimierungsstrategien und Compound-Profiling für alle Aspekte des Drogenmetabolismus und der Pharmakokinetik (DMPK) mit einem starken Fokus auf Zielbiologie Validierung und Translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) Konzepte.
• Translational Evaluation: Unterstützung von Früherkennungsteams bei der Entwicklung von Translationsstrategien zur klinischen Bewertung der Zielmodulation durch Anwendung biochemischer und pharmakologischer Überlegungen.
• Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Durchführung grundlegender M&S-Aktivitäten, einschließlich PKPD, Physiologisch-basierter Pharmakokinetik (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI) und menschlicher Dosis/Regimen-Vorhersage, um wesentliche Unterstützung für Projekte von Lead Optimization (LO) durch Entry into Human (EIH) bereitzustellen.
• Regulatorische Unterstützung: Bereiten und liefern qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Informationen für interne Programmbewertungen und externe regulatorische Einreichungen (z.B. Investigational New Drug (IND), Investigator's Brochure (IB), Clinical Trial Application (CTA), New Drug Application (NDA), Biologics License Application (BLA)).
• Umsetzung: Biomarker- und bioanalytische Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Schlüsselpartnern implementieren, um sowohl die Patientensicherheit als auch die Erzielung sinnvoller therapeutischer Vorteile zu gewährleisten.
• Zusammenarbeit: Erleichterung transparenter, datengesteuerter Entscheidungsprozesse innerhalb von Projektteams und Teams bei gleichzeitiger Kultivierung und Aufrechterhaltung vertrauensvoller Berufsbeziehungen mit internen und externen Akteuren. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Position ein 2-jähriger befristeter Vertrag ist. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel oder Doktortitel in Pharmazie, Pharmakologie oder Bioengineering, gepaart mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie in einem pharmakokinetischen Bereich.
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes Know-how in der Entdeckung, frühe PK-Zeichen, Verteilung und PKPD über verschiedene Modalitäten, unterstützt durch eine solide Grundlage in der Pharmakologie und Physiologie.
• Sie zeigen praktische Erfahrungen mit Modellierung und Simulation, Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) Machine Learning (ML) auf DMPK-Strategie und einen starken Antrieb für Master-Tools wie Phoenix, Ber
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité Dans le cadre du chapitre sur la DMPK-PD et la pharmacologie clinique, vous vous concentrerez sur la fourniture du bon médicament à la bonne dose aux patients en toute sécurité avec un bénéfice efficace. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les domaines thérapeutiques pour convertir les hypothèses en médicaments innovants, en conduisant des stratégies non cliniques pour présenter les meilleurs candidats cliniques pour des indications spécifiques. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Stratégie et conception : Les stratégies de conception et d'optimisation des médicaments et le profilage des composés pour tous les aspects du métabolisme et de la pharmacocinétique des médicaments (DMPK), l'accent étant mis sur la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/Pharmacodynamique translationnelle (PD).
• Évaluation translationnelle: fournir un soutien aux équipes de découverte précoce dans l'élaboration de stratégies translationnelles pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible par l'application de considérations biochimiques et pharmacologiques.
• Modélisation et simulation (M&S): Exécuter des activités fondamentales de M&S, y compris la PKPD, la Pharmacocinétique physiologique (PBPK), l'interaction médicament-drogue (DDI) et la prédiction de la dose humaine/régime, afin de fournir un soutien essentiel aux projets allant de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) à l'entrée dans l'humain (EIH).
• Soutien réglementaire : Préparer et fournir des évaluations scientifiques de haute qualité de l'information DMPK non clinique pour les examens internes des programmes et les présentations de règlements externes (p. ex., les nouveaux médicaments expérimentaux (IND), la brochure de l'enquêteur (IB), la demande d'essai clinique (CTA), la demande de drogue nouvelle (NDA), la demande de licence de produits biologiques (BLA).
• Mise en oeuvre : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de biomarqueur et de bioanalyse en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires clés afin d'assurer à la fois la sécurité des patients et l'obtention d'avantages thérapeutiques significatifs.
• Collaboration : Faciliter des processus décisionnels transparents et axés sur les données au sein des équipes et des équipes de projet tout en cultivant et en maintenant des relations professionnelles de confiance avec les parties prenantes internes et externes. Veuillez noter que ce poste est un contrat temporaire de 2 ans. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie ou bioingénierie, jumelé à plus de 5 ans d'expérience industrielle dans un domaine lié à la pharmacocinétique.
• Vous disposez d'une expertise approfondie en découverte, caractérisation précoce de la PK, distribution et PKPD sur différentes modalités, soutenue par une base solide en pharmacologie et en physiologie.
• Vous démontrez l'expérience pratique de la modélisation et de la simulation, la compétence dans l'application de l'intelligence artificielle (AI) Machine Learning (ML) à la stratégie DMPK, et une forte volonté de maîtriser des outils comme Phoenix, Ber

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición. OBJETIVOS DEL CARGO: Planear y liderar la implementación de estrategias de educación médica y de acceso al sistema sanitario para el área de Oncología y Neurología, impulsando el reembolso y la adopción médica de la tecnología diagnóstica. Generar proyectos, establecer y mantener una relación de estrecho contacto académico, profesionales de la salud y tomadores de decisión, en todo el país, con el objeto de facilitar el acceso de los pacientes y la diseminación de evidencia relacionada con las áreas diagnósticas de Oncología y Neurología. Ser punto de contacto para resolver dudas de la comunidad médica y científica que requieran de información sustentada en evidencia, mediante el desarrollo e implementación de programas educativos específicos y medibles. Ser parte de un equipo estratégico para el desarrollo de planes que mejoren la penetración al sistema de salud de los productos de Alto Valor Médico. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad:
• Diseñar y ejecutar, junto a las Unidades de Negocio, estrategias de acceso y educación médica en Oncología y Neurología, liderando su implementación en centros estratégicos a nivel nacional.
• Liderar la generación y diseminación de evidencia médico-científica en entornos remotos y presenciales hacia profesionales de la salud, investigadores y tomadores de decisión, asegurando un enfoque no promocional y cumplimiento regulatorio.
• Construir relaciones estratégicas de largo plazo con la comunidad médica y stakeholders clave, identificando oportunidades de colaboración, investigación y co-creación de soluciones innovadoras que mejoren resultados en pacientes y optimicen costos del sistema de salud.
• Impulsar la generación de evidencia clínica y económica local, liderando actividades educativas, presentaciones científicas y proyectos multidisciplinarios, asegurando alineación con estándares de compliance, políticas internas y normativas vigentes. Tu Perfil:
• Título universitario en el área de la salud.
• Deseable posgrado, maestría o PhD en Administración y Gestión en Salud, Economía de la Salud o Salud Pública.
• Experiencia en el sector salud público o privado, ya sea en prestadores de salud o proveedores de tecnologías sanitarias.
• Nivel de inglés intermedio y deseable experiencia en metodologías ágiles. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position F ield Application Specialist (Molecular Biology & Pathology) – Castilla y León ¿Te apasiona la intersección entre la ciencia de vanguardia y la tecnología de diagnóstico? En Roche, no solo trabajamos; somos pioneros en biotecnología para mejorar la salud y el bienestar en todo el mundo. Buscamos un Field Application Specialist con base en Valladolid (valorando otras zonas de Castilla y León) para liderar nuestras líneas de Biología Molecular y Anatomía Patológica . Tu Misión: Transformar el Diagnóstico Tu rol será el motor que garantice que nuestras soluciones operen con la máxima excelencia. Serás el referente científico y técnico para nuestros clientes, asegurando que cada sistema instalado se convierta en una ventaja competitiva que mejore la vida de los pacientes. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día?
• Excelencia Operativa: Ejecutarás instalaciones, configuraciones y mantenimientos (preventivos y correctivos) de nuestros analizadores y software.
• Empoderamiento del Cliente: Capacitarás y entrenarás a los usuarios en el manejo de soluciones de alta tecnología.
• Consultoría Científica: Proporcionarás información técnica profunda y apoyo en la implementación de nuevos protocolos y controles de calidad.
• Socio Estratégico: Colaborarás estrechamente con el equipo de Ventas y Marketing para identificar necesidades y respaldar nuevas oportunidades comerciales.
• Gestión Digital: Reportarás tu actividad en CRM, asegurando que toda la documentación técnica esté siempre al día y bajo los más altos estándares. ¿Quién eres?
• Formación: Grado en Ciencias de la Salud (Biología, Biomedicina, Biotecnología o similar) o Ingeniería.
• Experiencia: Se valorará muy positivamente contar con experiencia previa en el sector del diagnóstico in vitro o laboratorios clínicos , así como conocimiento en flujos de trabajo automatizados.
• Especialización: Conocimiento o especialización en Biología Molecular y/o Anatomía Patológica .
• Idiomas: Nivel fluido de español e inglés (capacidad para interactuar con referentes globales).
• Habilidades: Eres una persona curiosa, con gran capacidad de comunicación, liderazgo y una clara vocación de servicio al cliente.
• Movilidad: Tienes carnet de conducir B1 y disponibilidad para viajar por el territorio nacional e internacional cuando sea necesario.
• Residencia: Preferiblemente en Valladolid u otras zonas de Castilla y León. ¿Qué te ofrecemos?
• Impacto Real: Participar en un proyecto donde tu trabajo mejora directamente la calidad de las decisiones clínicas.
• Entorno de Innovación: Trabajar con la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector.
• Crecimiento Profesional: Desarrollo continuo en una empresa líder, con un entorno de trabajo inclusivo, colaborativo y dinámico .

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Como Especialista de Dados em Supply Chain, você terá a oportunidade de transformar dados em inteligência estratégica para otimizar a Cadeia Logística da Roche Diagnóstica Brasil. Seu foco está em elevar a experiência do cliente e maximizar a rentabilidade através de decisões fundamentadas. Você será responsável por promover a cultura de dados utilizando desde soluções analíticas clássicas até Advanced Analytics , atuando como um facilitador para parceiros de negócios na identificação de casos de uso de alto impacto. Você é um agente ativo na transformação digital da companhia, convergindo tecnologia e logística para atender às demandas do cliente. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Supervisão de KPIs, metas e governança de dados para o chapter de Supply Chain, garantindo a integridade dos cálculos.
• Atuação como parceiro estratégico de stakeholders, direcionando soluções de dados alinhadas aos objetivos de negócio.
• Gestão de Produtos de Dados através da manutenção e otimização contínua das ferramentas e produtos de dados da área.
• Desenvolvimento e manutenção de dashboards de visualização para suporte à tomada de decisão.
• Automação através da criação de bots e scripts para extração automatizada de dados em diversas plataformas e sistemas.
• Engenharia de Dados (ETL): Desenho e gerenciamento de rotinas de estruturação, movimentação e organização de dados.
• Mapeamento de fluxos de informação para erradicar tarefas manuais e maximizar o uso de recursos nativos.
• Liderança de projetos do subchapter de Supply Chain Excellence, apoiando a governança e a excelência operacional. Quem você é:
• Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Física, Matemática ou similares.
• Experiência relevante em Análise de Dados, administração e manutenção de bancos de dados, aliadas ao desenho de fluxo de informações e processos.
• Proficiente no desenvolvimento de scripts e uso de linguagem de programação.
• Experiência com uso de linguagem de programação para banco de dados e automações, como Python, SQL ou similares.
• Experiência em uso de ferramentas de visualização como Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ou similares.
• Desejável experiência com fluxos e conteúdos ligados a operações logísticas, manufaturas e/ou supply chain.
• Inglês avançado
• Disponibilidade para atuar com base na zona sul de São Paulo no modelo híbrido (3x escritório) Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Purpose: As the FEP Lead, you will bridge the gap between commercial strategy and financial expertise. Your mission is to partner with the business to drive strategic commercial decisions incorporating an end-to-end view while simplifying how we operate daily and ensuring that every decision supports the sustainable growth of the company. In this role, you will lead a team of 5 professionals and report directly to the Finance Manager as their strategic sparring partner while collaborating closely with the Sales and Marketing teams. The Opportunity:
• Coach and mentor a team of 5 Finance Enterprise Partners to accelerate their development and drive high performance.
• Drive operational change by challenging old habits, simplifying and continuously improving team processes, and maintaining lean, fit‑for‑purpose governance and risk-compliant financial practices.
• Support commercial growth by partnering with the commercial organization on product launches, customer pricing, and evaluation of commercial opportunities to ensure sustainable business outcomes.
• Drive P&L and performance improvements by proposing and scaling initiatives (upselling, efficiency and waste reduction, risk mitigation) and leading sales planning and reporting in close collaboration with the Performance Finance Enterprise Partner Lead, including monitoring results and advising on corrective actions to meet financial objectives. • University degree in Finance, Business, Engineering or a related discipline, with 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
• Experience in finance business partnering and proven ability to collaborate beyond the finance function; prior mentoring or guiding of small teams is highly valued (formal leadership not required).

• Führung von mehreren Teams von Führungskräften und Spezialisten im Bereich Mechanik.
• Verantwortung für die Teamleistung und Ergebnisse im eigenen Verantwortungsbereich.
• Setzen und Umsetzen kurzfristiger Abteilungsziele und Prioritäten unter Berücksichtigung des Budgets.
• Etablierung und Verwaltung von externen Partnerschaften in Übereinstimmung mit den Anforderungen und der Strategie des Projekts
• Formuliert die Vision für das Subchapter und unterstützt bei Schlüsselprojekten zur Entwicklung von Geschäftseinheitsstrategien und Unternehmensprozessen.
• Eigenständige Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Entscheidungen zur Problemlösung im Verantwortungsbereich.
• Förderung der Kompetenzentwicklung im Team durch gezieltes Skill-Management. Dein Profil
• Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik oder einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung. Ein Masterabschluss oder eine Promotion ist von Vorteil.
• Mindestens 8 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung, bevorzugt im Bereich der Medizintechnik.
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Führungserfahrung, einschließlich Personalverantwortung.
• Vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Maschinenentwicklung und -betreuung, bevorzugt im Bereich Sondermaschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt auf vollautomatisierten Produktionsmaschinen.
• Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch.
• Ausgeprägte Führungsfähigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Anleitung und Mentoring von Mitarbeitenden.
• Teamorientierte Arbeitsweise und Fähigkeit zur effektiven Zusammenarbeit.
• Analytisches Denkvermögen und Fähigkeit zur Entwicklung von Strategien für die Einheit. Ganz pragmatisch: Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch oder bewirb Dich mit Deinem Workday-Profil.
