descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sulla funzione Global Procurement, che supporta l’obiettivo di Roche di portare soluzioni innovative ai pazienti attraverso partnership di business e fornitori. Agiamo come ponte tra le funzioni aziendali Roche e i nostri fornitori, offrendo valore attraverso produttività, velocità, gestione dei rischi, sostenibilità, soluzioni innovative e esperienze di acquisto semplificate. L'opportunità In qualità di Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), farai parte di Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Il nostro scopo è quello di promuovere la consegna del valore attraverso soluzioni digitali e eccellenza, con Digital & AI che aumenta e amplifica la nostra capacità e capacità di magnificare i risultati, alla fine di fornire un maggiore impatto per persona e una migliore esperienza di approvvigionamento. Segnalandosi al Leader delle soluzioni AI di appalti, la vostra responsabilità primaria è quella di progettare, costruire, testare e distribuire agenti AI e flussi di lavoro agentici che trasformano i processi di approvvigionamento. Sfruttando la tua profonda conoscenza specializzata e la tua vasta esperienza, lavorerai a stretto contatto con l'IA Generativa, piattaforme di orchestrazione del flusso di lavoro, API, sistemi aziendali e fonti di dati interne per fornire soluzioni AI pronte alla produzione. Aiuterai proattivamente il Global Procurement a migliorare la produttività, la velocità, l'esperienza utente, la qualità e il processo decisionale in tutto l'ecosistema di approvvigionamento. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con le PMI di approvvigionamento, gli ingegneri della soluzione AI interna, i coetanei digitali, l'IT, l'analisi e le insights e i partner esterni per spostare idee ad alto valore dall'opportunità di inquadrare in concetti di soluzione robusta, piloti e implementazioni scalabili. Potrai operare come leader di pensiero e driver strategico in un ambiente globale in rapida evoluzione. Avrete a ponte le priorità strategiche dell'IA e le realtà pratiche di costruire soluzioni affidabili e pronte all'impresa in un complesso ambiente di approvvigionamento globale. Tu guiderai e guiderai altri colleghi su iniziative che incidono negativamente sugli obiettivi funzionali e aumenterai significativamente l'efficacia, l'efficienza e l'esperienza degli utenti dei processi e delle soluzioni di approvvigionamento in tutta l'azienda. In qualità di Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale in base alla tua vasta esperienza, alla tua conoscenza e ai requisiti strategici di business/team, inclusi ma non limitati a:
• Soluzione AI Discovery & Design: Partner con i team di approvvigionamento per identificare, strutturare e convalidare i casi di automazione ad alto impatto e utilizzo di AI. Traduci le esigenze aziendali, la complessità del processo, i requisiti politici, le realtà dei dati e le considerazioni sull'esperienza degli utenti in progetti di soluzione chiari.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Progettare e costruire una logica di flusso di lavoro intelligente per l'approvvigionamento di casi di utilizzo, combinando le capacità AI, le regole aziendali, le integrazioni API, i controlli dei dati, i passaggi umani-in-the-loop e i controlli di qualità misurabili. Creare, configurare e incorporare agenti AI in sistemi e processi di approvvigionamento esistenti per automatizzare le attività end-to-end.
• Prototipazione rapida: Costruire e testare le prove iniziali-di-concetto (PoC) utilizzando strumenti di automazione del flusso di lavoro (ad esempio, n8n, Zapier) e fonti di dati interne per convalidare il valore rapidamente prima dell'ingegneria su larga scala. Traduci gli insegnamenti in specifiche attuabili per team interni, partner esterni e ingegneri di soluzioni.
• Valutazione della soluzione e osservabilità: Utilizzare strumenti di osservazione e valutazione LLM aziendali per monitorare il comportamento dell'agente, monitorare l'accuratezza, analizzare i modi di guasto e iterare sistematicamente su suggerimenti e logica del flusso di lavoro per garantire la rel di qualità della produzione
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This role is based in the Global Procurement function, which supports Roche’s goal of bringing innovative solutions to patients through business and supplier partnerships. We act as the bridge between Roche business functions and our suppliers, delivering value through productivity, speed, risk management, sustainability, innovative solutions, and streamlined buying experiences. The Opportunity As the Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will be part of Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Our purpose is to advance value delivery through digital solutions & excellence, with Digital & AI augmenting and amplifying our capacity and capability to magnify outcomes, eventually delivering greater impact per person and a better procurement experience. Reporting to the Procurement AI Solutions Lead, your primary responsibility is to design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and agentic workflows that transform procurement processes. Leveraging your deep specialized knowledge and extensive expertise, you will work hands-on with Generative AI, workflow orchestration platforms, APIs, enterprise systems, and internal data sources to deliver production-ready AI solutions. You will proactively help Global Procurement improve productivity, speed, user experience, quality, and decision-making across the procurement ecosystem. You will work closely with Procurement SMEs, internal AI solution engineers, Digital peers, IT, Analytics & Insights, and external partners to move high-value ideas from opportunity framing into robust solution concepts, pilots, and scalable implementations. You will operate as a thought leader and strategic driver in a fast-moving, global environment. You will bridge strategic AI priorities and the practical realities of building reliable, enterprise-ready solutions in a complex global procurement environment. You will mentor and guide other colleagues on initiatives that demonstrably impact functional goals and significantly increase the effectiveness, efficiency, and user experience of procurement processes and solutions across the enterprise. As a Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (AI), you will play a pivotal role according to your extensive experience, knowledge, and strategic business/team requirements, including but not limited to:
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner with procurement teams to identify, structure, and validate high-impact automation and AI use cases. Translate business needs, process complexity, policy requirements, data realities, and user experience considerations into clear solution designs.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Design and build intelligent workflow logic for procurement use cases, combining AI capabilities, business rules, API integrations, data checks, human-in-the-loop steps, and measurable quality controls. Independently build, configure and embed AI agents into existing procurement systems and processes to automate end-to-end tasks.
• Rapid Prototyping: Build and test initial proofs-of-concept (PoCs) using workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier) and internal data sources to validate value quickly before full-scale engineering. Translate learnings into actionable specifications for internal teams, external partners, and solution engineers.
• Solution Evaluation & Observability: Utilize enterprise LLM observability and evaluation tools to monitor agent behavior, track accuracy, analyze failure modes, and systematically iterate on prompts and workflow logic to ensure production-grade rel
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Diese Rolle basiert in der Global Procurement-Funktion, die Roche unterstützt, innovative Lösungen für Patienten durch Unternehmens- und Lieferantenpartnerschaften zu bringen. Wir fungieren als Brücke zwischen Roche-Geschäftsfunktionen und unseren Lieferanten und liefern Mehrwert durch Produktivität, Geschwindigkeit, Risikomanagement, Nachhaltigkeit, innovative Lösungen und optimierte Einkaufserlebnisse. Die Chance Als Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (AI) gehören Sie zu Digital Procurement Solutions & Excellence. Unser Ziel ist es, die Wertschöpfung durch digitale Lösungen und Exzellenz voranzutreiben, indem Digital & AI unsere Kapazität und Leistungsfähigkeit erweitert und erweitert, um die Ergebnisse zu steigern, schließlich mehr Auswirkungen pro Person und ein besseres Beschaffungserlebnis zu bieten. Ihre primäre Verantwortung bei der Beschaffung von AI Solutions Lead liegt darin, KI-Agenten und Agenzien, die Beschaffungsprozesse transformieren, zu entwerfen, zu testen und einzusetzen. Mit fundiertem Fachwissen und umfangreichem Know-how arbeiten Sie mit Generative KI, Workflow-Orchestrationsplattformen, APIs, Unternehmenssystemen und internen Datenquellen zusammen, um produktionsbereite KI-Lösungen zu liefern. Sie helfen Global Procurement dabei, Produktivität, Geschwindigkeit, Benutzererfahrung, Qualität und Entscheidungsfindung im gesamten Beschaffungs-Ökosystem zu verbessern. Sie arbeiten eng mit Beschaffungs-KMU, internen KI-Lösungs-Ingenieuren, Digital Peers, IT, Analytics & Insights und externen Partnern zusammen, um qualitativ hochwertige Ideen von Gelegenheits- und Lösungskonzepten, Piloten und skalierbaren Implementierungen zu bewegen. Sie werden als Gedankenleiter und strategischer Treiber in einer schnelllebigen, globalen Umgebung arbeiten. Sie werden strategische KI-Prioritäten und die praktischen Gegebenheiten des Aufbaus zuverlässiger, unternehmensbereiter Lösungen in einem komplexen globalen Beschaffungsumfeld überbrücken. Sie betreuen und leiten andere Kollegen zu Initiativen, die nachweislich die funktionellen Ziele beeinflussen und die Effizienz, Effizienz und Nutzererfahrung von Beschaffungsprozessen und Lösungen im gesamten Unternehmen deutlich steigern. Als Sr. Procurement Solutions Manager (AI) spielen Sie eine zentrale Rolle nach Ihren umfangreichen Erfahrungen, Kenntnissen und strategischen Geschäfts- und Teamanforderungen, einschließlich aber nicht beschränkt auf:
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partner mit Beschaffungsteams, um hocheffiziente Automatisierungs- und KI-Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren, zu strukturieren und zu validieren. Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen, Prozesskomplexität, politische Anforderungen, Datenrealitäten und Benutzererfahrung Überlegungen in klare Lösungsdesigns.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Entwerfen und bauen intelligente Workflow-Logik für Beschaffungszwecke, Kombination von KI-Fähigkeiten, Geschäftsregeln, API-Integrationen, Datenkontrollen, human-in-the-loop-Schritten und messbaren Qualitätskontrollen. Unabhängig vom Aufbau, Konfigurieren und Einbetten von KI-Agenten in bestehende Beschaffungssysteme und Prozesse zur Automatisierung von End-to-End-Aufgaben.
• Rapid Prototyping: Erstellen und testen Sie erste Nachweise-of-concept (PoCs) mithilfe von Workflow-Automatisierungstools (z.B. n8n, Zapier) und internen Datenquellen, um den Wert schnell vor dem Full-Scale Engineering zu validieren. Übersetzen Sie das Lernen in handlungsfähige Spezifikationen für interne Teams, externe Partner und Lösungsingenieure.
• Solution Evaluation & Observability: Verwenden von LLM-Beobachtbarkeits- und Auswertetools, um das Verhalten von Agenten zu überwachen, die Genauigkeit zu verfolgen, Fehlermodi zu analysieren und systematisch auf Aufforderungen und Workflow-Logik zu unternehmen, um eine produktionsfähige Rel zu gewährleisten
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ce rôle est basé sur la fonction d'approvisionnement global, qui soutient l'objectif de Roches d'apporter des solutions innovantes aux patients par le biais de partenariats d'affaires et de fournisseurs. Nous faisons le pont entre les fonctions commerciales de Roche et nos fournisseurs, offrant de la valeur grâce à la productivité, la rapidité, la gestion des risques, la durabilité, des solutions innovantes et des expériences d'achat simplifiées. L'opportunité En tant que gestionnaire des solutions d'approvisionnement (AS), vous serez membre de Solutions d'approvisionnement numérique et Excellence. Notre objectif est de faire progresser la livraison de valeur grâce à des solutions numériques et à l'excellence, avec le numérique et l'IA augmentant et amplifiant notre capacité et notre capacité d'amplifier les résultats, ce qui a finalement un plus grand impact par personne et une meilleure expérience d'approvisionnement. Rendre compte au responsable des solutions d'IA d'approvisionnement, votre responsabilité principale est de concevoir, construire, tester et déployer des agents d'IA et des workflows d'agents qui transforment les processus d'approvisionnement. Grâce à vos connaissances spécialisées approfondies et à votre vaste expertise, vous travaillerez de manière pratique avec l'IA Generative, les plates-formes d'orchestration de workflow, les API, les systèmes d'entreprise et les sources de données internes pour fournir des solutions d'IA prêtes à la production. Vous aiderez proactivement Global Approvisionnement à améliorer la productivité, la rapidité, l'expérience utilisateur, la qualité et la prise de décisions dans l'ensemble de l'écosystème d'approvisionnement. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les PME d'Approvisionnement, les ingénieurs internes de solutions d'IA, les pairs numériques, les TI, Analytics & Insights et les partenaires externes pour faire passer les idées de grande valeur de la conception d'opportunités à des concepts de solutions robustes, des projets pilotes et des implémentations évolutives. Vous agirez en tant que leader de la pensée et moteur stratégique dans un environnement mondial en évolution rapide. Vous rapprocherez les priorités stratégiques de l'IA et les réalités pratiques de la construction de solutions fiables et prêtes à l'entreprise dans un environnement d'approvisionnement mondial complexe. Vous guiderez et guiderez d'autres collègues sur des initiatives qui ont manifestement une incidence sur les objectifs fonctionnels et qui accroissent considérablement l'efficacité, l'efficience et l'expérience utilisateur des processus et des solutions d'approvisionnement dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise. En tant que gestionnaire des solutions d'approvisionnement (AI), vous jouerez un rôle central en fonction de votre expérience, de vos connaissances et de vos besoins stratégiques en affaires/équipes, notamment :
• AI Solution Discovery & Design: Partenaire avec les équipes d'approvisionnement pour identifier, structurer et valider les cas d'automatisation à impact élevé et d'utilisation de l'IA. Traduire les besoins des entreprises, la complexité des processus, les exigences des politiques, les réalités des données et l'expérience utilisateur en conceptions de solutions claires.
• Workflow & Agent Design: Concevoir et construire une logique de workflow intelligente pour les cas d'utilisation d'approvisionnement, combinant les capacités d'IA, les règles d'affaires, les intégrations d'API, les vérifications de données, les étapes humaines dans la boucle et les contrôles de qualité mesurables. Construisez, configurez et intégrez des agents d'IA dans les systèmes et processus d'approvisionnement existants pour automatiser les tâches de bout en bout.
• Prototypage rapide: Construisez et testez les premières preuves de conception (PoCs) à l'aide d'outils d'automatisation de flux de travail (par exemple n8n, Zapier) et de sources de données internes pour valider rapidement la valeur avant l'ingénierie à grande échelle. Traduire les apprentissages en spécifications pratiques pour les équipes internes, les partenaires externes et les ingénieurs de solutions.
• Évaluation et observabilité de la solution : utiliser les outils d'observation et d'évaluation LLM de l'entreprise pour surveiller le comportement des agents, suivre l'exactitude, analyser les modes de défaillance, et itérer systématiquement sur les prompts et la logique de workflow pour assurer la qualité de production rel

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Overview We are seeking a skilled and proactive QA / Test Automation Engineer to join our engineering team. In this role, you will be a champion for product excellence, ensuring our software meets strict quality standards and exceeds customer expectations. You will be responsible for the end-to-end testing lifecycle—from analyzing requirements and designing robust test strategies to coding automated test suites and fostering a "built-in quality" mindset across the organization. Your Main Tasks & Duties
• Test Strategy & Execution: Compose, execute, and assess functional and non-functional tests aligned with the defined test strategy to ensure product quality and customer satisfaction. + Requirements & Design Review: Review the product backlog, requirements, and specifications for clarity, testability, and traceability. Analyze system designs and architecture with a sharp eye for code quality, risks, and testability.
• Test Case Management: Create, maintain, and review test cases for software across all lifecycle phases within our designated tooling and documentation standards + Test Automation: Build software that tests software by writing automated test code or integrating robust third-party tools into our existing test suites.
• Environment & Infrastructure Management: Configure, manage, and maintain stable and scalable Test Environments + Defect Tracking & Metrics: Execute test cases, analyze results, report/track issues, and verify incoming fixes. Define and monitor relevant quality metrics to track overall product health.
• Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation under your responsibility (including test cases, test results, tooling guides, and best practices).
• Risk & Compliance: Collaborate on product risk assessments by identifying potential failures and ensuring adequate test coverage. Guarantee strict adherence to quality standards, relevant Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs), SOPs, and Working Instructions. Continuous Improvement & Leadership
• Process Optimization: Provide continuous input to improve testing processes and overall efficiency, heavily leveraging test automation where appropriate.
• QA Initiatives: Actively participate in internal testing improvement initiatives to elevate our engineering standards.
• Mentorship & Culture: Share, coach, and actively train team members both within and outside the department to promote a strong built-in quality mindset . Who you are
• Experience: Proven experience as a QA Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or in a similar software testing role.
• Automation Skills: Experience building test frameworks via code (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript) or integrating modern third-party automation tools.
• Analytical Mindset: Strong ability to review architectural designs, pinpoint technical risks, and ensure full test traceability.
• Compliance Awareness: Familiarity working within structured environments governed by SOPs, QAPs, and strict quality guidelines is a plus.
• Soft Skills: Excellent collaboration, communication, and coaching skills to advocate for quality across cross-functional teams. There is a preferred candidate. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conduct

The Position Publication Data Entry Specialist Healthcare’s future is driven by the exchange of science and data. As a Publication Data Entry Specialist at Roche, you’ll be actively shaping this future and giving our wealth of science a voice as a member of the Scientific Communications Community. The Opportunity Publication Data Entry Specialists execute Scientific Communications (SC) Strategies by assisting with the accurate and timely entry, validation, and maintenance of all publication-related data within designated management systems. This meticulous documentation of publication activities supports effective project oversight and reporting across product-specific teams, Disease Areas, early research, and other cross-lifecycle engagements, ultimately contributing to the goal of changing medical practice.
• Scientific Data Curation: Research, enter, and maintain high volumes of publication data with 100% accuracy.
• Metadata Validation: Review and audit data points to ensure completeness.
• Quality Assurance: Perform quality control checks on peer-reviewed content and historical archives under supervision.
• SOP Support: Assist with the creation and documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for specialized data harvesting.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with IT and Therapeutic Areas to improve the data entries.
• Reporting: Assist in generating status reports on database health and publication trends for management.
• System Integrity: Assist with data migrations and help identify system errors within our publication management tools. Who You Are
• Technical Skills: Ability to learn and implement new IT Systems across the network; keyboarding speed & accuracy is required.
• Experience: 0-5 years experience in customer service or data entry positions. Fresh graduates and students are encouraged to apply for this position.
• Attention to Detail: Exceptional focus on accuracy; able to maintain high standards while processing large datasets with minimal supervision.
• Organizational Skills: Strong time management skills; able to prioritize tasks independently based on data volume and deadlines.
• Communication: Fluency in written and spoken English is a must.
• Ability to operate successfully in a matrix environment with shared responsibilities. In exchange we provide you with
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes, and the chance to shape your own career.

Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. • Technical Savvy: Hai una solida conoscenza di lavoro di Workday e esperienza di gestire le relazioni con i fornitori di payroll esterni.
• Esperto Stakeholder: Possiedi la capacità di coinvolgere e influenzare partner diversi oltre la funzione HR, tra cui Finanza e IT.
• Process Oriented: Hai uno sfondo ideale nella gestione dei processi aziendali e una comprovata traccia delle principali iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• Leader del progetto: si portano forti competenze di gestione del progetto e la capacità di priorità requisiti concorrenti in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione.
• Contabile & analitico: Lei dimostra la responsabilità end-to-end, utilizzando il pensiero critico e problem-solving per garantire la consegna di servizio di alta qualità.
• Communicatore fluente: Possiedi eccellenti competenze in inglese (scritto e parlato) e abbracci il lavoro all'interno di un'organizzazione multiculturale e globale. In Exchange vi forniamo:

• Présentation de l’équipe:
• Au cœur de l’équipe Medical & Evidence Data science, tu auras pour mission de travailler sur la stratégie de génération de données médicales. Stage de 6 mois à pourvoir à partir de janvier 2026 Basé à Paris, Boulogne-Billancourt (92)
• Quel sera ton impact ?
• ● tu travailleras essentiellement sur des données de vie réelle, issue de registres, cohortes ou de bases de données médico-administratives comme le SNDS (Système National des données de santé
• ● Tu coordonneras des groupes de travail pour identifier les besoins clefs en
• données médicales robustes sur une indication et identifier des solutions adaptées ● Tu co-construiras les plans de génération de preuves avec le médical et l’accès au marché, intégrant essais cliniques, données épidémiologiques, accès précoces et support à l’efficience du système de santé. ● Tu réaliseras des revues de littérature ● Tu valideras les protocoles d’étude, notamment des études en vie réelle, les plans d' analyse statistique et les rapports d'études produits par les partenaires ou en interne, en collaboration avec les expertises scientifiques internes requises.
• ● Tu participeras à la rédaction de d’abstract , poster ou d’articles ou coordonner sa rédaction
• ● Tu établiras un plan de publication adapté aux enjeux clefs de l’aire thérapeutique.
• ● Tu seras amené à faire de la coordination de projet transverse ou de projet clinique Ton ADN
• ● Tu as envie d’apprendre
• ● Tu es autonome dans la gestion de ton planning avec des réunions hebdomadaires
• programmées entre toi et ton tuteur.
• ● Tu es rigoureux(se) et pragmatique
• ● Tu as des connaissances en épidémiologie, sur les données de vie réelle ou le développement clinique
• ● Tu as un esprit d’équipe
• ● Tu as un bon niveau d ’anglais car tu auras beaucoup de contacts avec des
• anglophones;
• ● Tu es curieux, motivé(e) et proactif(ve) et tu souhaites t’immerger dans le monde de l’entreprise ! Pourquoi nous rejoindre? ● Cette stage va te permettre d'apprendre et maîtriser des découvrir tous les aspects du Medical Evidence & Data science dans le milieu de la santé. ● Notre entreprise dispose d'un environnement collaboratif et stimulant, où tu pourras travailler aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et passionnés, ce qui facilitera ton apprentissage et ton développement professionnel. ● Tu auras la possibilité de contribuer à des activités qui ont un impact direct sur la compréhension et le traitement des maladies, ce qui ajoutera une dimension enrichissante à ton travail ● Nous considérons les stagiaires comme de véritables partenaires qui pourront être amenés à évoluer à nos côtés. Ta contribution, tes propositions seront écoutées et valorisées par les équipes. ● Conformément à la réglementation, tous nos postes sont ouverts au recrutement de travailleurs handicapés. Si tu as besoin d’un aménagement spécifique en vue de l’entretien de recrutement, n’hésite pas à nous le signaler lors de l’entretien. ● Tu cherches un sens à ce que tu fais ? Rejoins un groupe qui œuvre pour des projets à fort impact et l’avancée pour la santé de tous. Si tu es prêt(e) à faire partie de notre écosystème novateur et à propulser ta carrière avec Roche, envoie dès maintenant ta candidature! Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Please note that this role offers a fixed-term contract (up until Feb 29, 2029). The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. The Opportunity As a Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process . In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:
• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities
• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts
• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions
• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices
• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling
• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP
• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions
• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. The Position Roles & Responsibilities Routine Operation : Implement GMP compliance against global GMP standards and China GMP requirement
• By assisting the Head of Analytical Testing lab to conduct GMP Self-Inspection, and follow-up the implementation action to maintain the global level of GMP compliance.
• By maintaining the quality system and documentation system to ensure quality system operations in QC meets the regulatory requirements. Complete the assigned routine inspection of sample, issue the reliable analytical report in reasonable lead time. Implement the maintenance and calibration of assigned instruments
• By accomplishing the calibration and maintenance of assigned instruments, to ensure they are in good order to meet the analytical needs any time.
• By keeping the relevant document to trace the calibration, maintenance history and any change of the instruments.
• By keeping contact with instrument company to obtain the sufficient application technical support and repair service in time. Maintain the analysis methods to be current and effective.
• Implement the defined analysis method validation via planning, executing and reporting process.
• Perform method periodical review timely. Report the abnormal status, unexpected results to supervisors with initiative.
• By reporting abnormal status and unexpected results during analysis processing by detailed data and information to alert the supervisor to investigate and solve the problem in the correct way and in time.
• By leading the investigation precession to identify the actual data and information, and try to find the cause to help to prevent the same issue from happening repeatedly. Stick lab safety regulations to prevent occurrence of accidents.
• By obeying the safety instruction of the storage, usage and disposal of reagent, narcotics, medicines, lab waste.
• By following the usage instructions of facilities of water, electricity and steam etc. in lab. Tutor colleagues to fulfill analysis tasks
• By providing technical support to colleagues if necessary and sharing knowledge and experience within working section.
• By checking and reviewing the testing process and analysis data to feedback improve opportunity. As the experienced SME, proactive drive the continuous improvement in Analytical Testing lab by leading the taskforce to identify and implement new technologies to improve the compliance and efficiency in routine QC operations. Engineering Project Support and Operation Readiness : Analytical Transfer Support: Support the establishment of the product control strategy and implement Analytical Transfer activities. Analytical method validation and qualification: Support and establish analytical method validation activities and perform method monitoring. Equipment Support: Drive the Performance Qualification (PQ) of laboratory equipment and ensure routine operation. Qualification and Experience Education/Qualifications
• Bachelor’s Degree (Life Sciences, Microbiology, or Analytical Sciences is preferred) and above
• Special Equipment management certification Leadership Competencies
• Models Integrity
• Focus on value and customer
• Align for success
• Deliver results
• Learn for the future Job Required Competencies
• 3 or more years of QC experience, QC experience, with a focus on protein analysis in pharmaceutical industry. MNC Bio-pharma experience is preferred
• Sound knowledge of quality control procedures and legal standards, with experience in aseptic assurance an

• You will serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• You will document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction. Who You Are:
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or work experience are required.

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.
• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.
• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential. The Position As the Global Business Process Specialist (GBPS) – Accounting Tax Integration, you are part of the Global Business Process Management Organization in Roche Service & Solutions. In this position, you report into the Accounting Tax Integration Sub-Chapter Lead within the Finance BPM. You act as Business Process Specialist for the APAC Regional Deployment team in the Finance/ Tax area. You roll-out the Aspire Global Template to the APAC countries, in particular for Chugai company codes in the area of Taxes, including Tax Localization. You will work in close collaboration with stakeholders from Finance, Commercials, Demand-to-Pay, Supply Chain and IT, cross divisionally (Pharma and Diagnostics). You will be :
• Responsible for global, cross divisional state-of-the-art process design within their business process area within the E2E proces. Empowered decision making for their area across divisions and in line with the E2E Business Process Management guardrails from the Global Business Process Manager (GBPM)
• Work closely with the E2E GBPMs & GBPS network to ensure fit-for-purpose solutions. Supports the SAP S4/HANA Template deployment. Actively pursue the implementation of the E2E BPM strategy, according to guardrails set by the E2E GBPO and GBPMs
• Deliver solutions including processes, ICFR, Authorizations, laws and regulations, technology, analytics for own dedicated area, in line with the E2E BPM strategy & guardrails as well as continuous improvements, with support of the GBPM and GBPSs. Support business acceptance globally across divisions and functions on a operating level for the dedicated business process area. Drive and implement the BPM strategy for your own dedicated area
• Roll-out Global template solutions for the area of Finance/ Tax, including solution documentation & implementation, test management, business process operations including integrated training management. Evaluate Local GAP and design localization extensions for the Global Template as part of the deployment activities for the Aspire roll out.
• Safeguard the global template and harmonized processes while collaborating with different project streams and other BPM networks to develop new processes for future releases. You translate local Tax business requirements into IT solutions and manage changes to such specifications. Actively drive and support the project deployment relevant deliverables throughout the full rollout lifecycle.
• Ensuring that all parallel deployments as well as the S/4Hana work package are on track Ensuring, monitoring and optimization of business processes with regards to efficiency and effectiveness. The position may involve a fair amount of travel (up to max. 25%). You liaise with the other stakeholder within the E2E processes. You lead process alignments/solution design with business stakeholders under template governance Who you are:
• A business or finance degree with 4-5 years of relevant work experience. An SAP FI specialist with solid experience in business process management, SAP ERP, S/4Hana, IT, and ERP transformation programs.
• Extensive experience with SAP Tax solutions, covering Indirect Taxes, Withholding Taxes, and Corporate Income Taxes. Deep knowledge of SAP S/4Hana tax solutions, including SAP country versions, SAP Document and Reporting Compliance, and implementation of SAP systems, particularly S4 Finance.
• Experience with other SAP Tax solutions like Sovos add-on for tax code determination is advantageous.
• Excellent analytica

The Position Security Analyst - Penetration Testing Exp- 4 to 7 yers Location- Pune Position Overview We are seeking an experienced Security Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across our diverse technology landscape, identifying and documenting security risks to strengthen our overall security posture. Primary Responsibilities
• Conduct thorough penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, and AI/LLM system using industry-standard tools and methodologies
• Perform hands-on security assessments and identify vulnerabilities in web-based systems and APIs
• Execute practical penetration tests against target systems, documenting real-world findings and exploitation methods
• Develop and execute custom exploitation payloads and attack scenarios
• Analyze application logic, authentication mechanisms, and access control implementations
• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to define scope, validate findings and track remediation efforts
• Maintain detailed testing documentation, evidence of assessments, and proof of concept demonstrations
• Participate in security reviews and contribute to threat modeling exercises
• Stay current with emerging web application security threats and attack vectors
• Quickly adapt to new tools, technologies, and emerging security challenges in the threat landscape Required Qualifications Certifications (Mandatory - at least one of the following)
• OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) or
• CPTS (Certified Penetration Testing Specialist) or
• OSCE (Offensive Security Certified Expert) or
• Equivalent recognized penetration testing certification Experience & Technical Skills Primary Expertise (Web Application and LLM - Hands-On Required):
• 3+ years of demonstrated hands-on experience in web application penetration testing
• Proven ability to identify and exploit real-world vulnerabilities in production and pre-production environments
• Practical expertise with OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, including SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication bypass, and API security flaws
• Proficiency with web security testing tools (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Postman, etc.)
• Experience bypassing security controls and WAF implementations
• Hands-on experience with API penetration testing (REST, GraphQL, SOAP)
• Practical expertise with LLM security assessments, including prompt injection, model manipulation, and output validation weaknesses.
• Understanding of LLM vulnerabilities including prompt injection, jailbreaking, data leakage, and model poisoning attacks
• Experience evaluating guardrails, content filters, and safety mechanisms in AI systems
• Proficiency with LLM security testing frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications)
• Familiarity with LLM penetration testing tools (e.g., Claud CLI, PRFU, Garak, promptfoo, etc.) Required Secondary Skills (Hands-On Demonstrated):
• Mobile Penetration Testing: Practical hands-on experience testing iOS and Android applications, including runtime analysis, reverse engineering, and security assessment of mobile APIs
• Cloud Security: Hands-on experience conducting security assessments on public cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including services like EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, RDS, and cloud misconfiguration identification. Core Competencies:
• Strong understanding of networking, encryption, authentication, and authorization mechanisms

The Position The Position We are building a global Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team to support critical commercial and internal platforms and applications. As an SRE , you will help design, build, and scale reliable distributed systems that power healthcare innovation worldwide. This role is focused on reliability, scalability, automation and operational excellence. You will influence system design, define reliability standards and reduce operational toil through engineering solutions. This role includes participation in a structured on-call rotation. Who We Are At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Step into the Future of IT with Roche! descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Business Operations Lead A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche . As a Business Operations Lead , you serve as a strategic and tactical partner to the Functional Leadership team, driving strategy and goals in alignment with Site and Network objectives. You are a multi-discipline professional representing the Site Business Support group, working collaboratively to drive excellence in project portfolio management, change leadership, and operational excellence. You play a key role in deploying site-wide business processes and leading strategic projects, such as product technical transfers and business programs. You push boundaries to enable a continuous improvement mindset and implement lean practices that result in quick and efficient innovation. Your Opportunity
• Functional Partnership & Excellence: You drive business results by facilitating functional goal development using lean strategy tools. You manage the functional project portfolio process, leading prioritization to ensure alignment with resource management and business timelines.
• Operational Excellence (OE) Deployment: You act as a strong advocacy and change agent for Lean/OE to build a strong continuous improvement culture. You lead process improvement activities to realize productivity outcomes and coach improvement projects to achieve functional goals.
• Organizational Change Management (OCM): You develop and implement effective change management programs to drive execution excellence. You lead site-wide initiatives to build OCM business processes and change leadership capabilities at both leadership and individual levels.
• Program & Project Management: You provide leadership for site-wide initiatives, including CAPEX and Product Technical Transfers. You ensure due diligence is performed to mitigate risks to safety, quality, compliance, and delivery.
• Coaching & Capability Building: You act as a coach for colleagues, helping them develop skills in project management and change leadership methodologies. You serve as a subject matter expert on continuous improvement methods and tools.
• Communication & Safety: You manage functional communications in line with the site plan, ensuring impactful content and timing. You ensure a safe working environment by complying with all Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements and site security measures. Who You Are
• Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.
• Experienced Professional: You have a minimum of 8 years of related working experience, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment.
• Project Expert: You possess a proven track record of at least 5 years managing small to medium-scale projects of varying complexity. PMP certification is preferred.
• Technical Specialist : You have essential competencies in Project Portfolio and Program Management, and you are a certified Black Belt in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.
• Change Leader: You have experience leading change initiatives on local, regional, or global levels and are familiar with industry change management standards such as PROSCI .
• Strategic Influencer: You possess excellent verbal and written

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Solution Architect (Demand to Pay, Travel & Expense Management) focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within a complex enterprise context. In this role, you will play a critical role in translating complex business requirements into technical designs for the T&E solutions which includes the Concur platform and other systems, ensuring seamless integration with other enterprise systems and driving continuous improvement. You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the vision and roadmap for the T&E landscape, and serve as a key leader and point of escalation for Concur-related issues within the organization. Your Responsibilities
• Design T&E solutions that meet product requirements and enterprise standards across a multiple-solution context, managing non-functional requirements (NFRs) and fitness functions while ensuring configurations adhere to data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) and audit requirements.
• Define and drive reference architectures, ensuring that Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), taxonomies, ontologies, and integration pathways are documented and published for the T&E product.
• Develop comprehensive architecture documentation and manage data flows between Concur and other enterprise systems, including Workday, SAP ERP, ServiceNow (EPP), IQVIA, and Oversight.
• Lead the design and management of non-standard integrations utilizing RESTful APIs, WebServices, and secure SFTP, leveraging middleware platforms such as Mulesoft and Denodo.
• Optimize system performance and business objectives by utilizing reporting systems and data platforms, including Concur Intelligence, Snowflake, and standard reporting configurations.
• Proactively contribute to the development of global Architecture Practices and provide technical oversight and mentoring to product teams.
• Maintain the roadmap for T&E solutions, evaluating external technology trends—such as AI-driven expense categorization and RPA— to enhance value and manage technical debt. Who You Are
• You have a minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and implementing solutions within the Concur platform, with at least 5 years focused on integration enhancements to and from Concur Intelligence, Travel, and Expense.
• You possess expert-level knowledge of the Concur modules and a proven track record of integrating them with SAP ERP, HR systems (Workday), and other enterprise applications.
• You are experienced in RESTful API consumption, data transformation via middleware (Mulesoft/Denodo), and creating conceptual and logical data models.
• You are capable of maintaining a vision for multiple solutions and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and the application landscape.
• You bring exceptional negotiation skills and the ability to communicate difficult concepts, influencing stakeholders to adopt different points of view or innovative solutions.
• You have a strong understanding of database concepts, SQL, web services, and XML/JSON data formats.
• You understand financial accounting principles and industry-specific T&E best practices; experience with pharmaceutical industry regulations is a significant plus.
• You hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field; a "Certified Professional - Expense Configuration" credential is preferred. Compensation & Benefits The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Position - Zonal Manager - Molecular Lab Your Opportunity In this role you will be responsible for total account management and selling the full Molecular portfolio. You will have the responsibility to drive molecular business in Bhubaneswar and the states of Odisha, Bihar, and Jharkhand . Understanding of the market and also willingness to travel for better penetration in the given territory will be required. You will manage channel partners. Exposure of working with Molecular segment would be added preference. As part of the Roche Molecular portfolio you will also be positioning IT solutions that will connect instruments across the continuum of care in both inpatient and outpatient settings. This position requires conducting presentations and business reviews to potential customers thereby demonstrating in-depth knowledge of our product line, as well as relevant healthcare/industry trends including related products or services. Role Responsibilities:
• Generates new customer demand and expansion for Molecular products.
• Penetrates large, complex accounts to gain access to and favor with all buying influences and key decision makers.
• Demonstrates strong clinical and financial acuity with ability to listen and understand customer needs and align Roche Molecular products within segment.
• Translates customers’ defined business/technical and personal goals into internal action while balancing key business priorities and goals.
• Balances the need to advocate for customers while also demonstrating the drive and ability to negotiate and achieve strong business results for Roche.
• Develops territory-specific executional strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
• Applies competitive, customer, and product knowledge to establish competitive barriers.
• Works cross functionally with internal colleagues and peers to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills including making impactful presentations.
• Conducts system demonstrations & presentations where applicable; Molecular Committee Meetings, Trade Shows, VIPS, etc. Who you are
• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• 5+ years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellowship or rotational program may be considered in lieu of experience Preferred Qualifications
• 5+ years of field sales experience in Molecular Diagnostics/ Oncology
• 5+ years of experience negotiating contracts with Integrated Health Networks
• 5+ years of experience driving revenue growth via strategic territory development Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Grade: SE6-SE8 1. The PJP Mission
• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.
• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives 2. Responsibilities The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. 3. Mindset & Behaviors/ VACC The PJP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the patient journey, as well as strong passion to create value and impact on the ecosystem. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.
• Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys
• Mindset:
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand)
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take

• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives 2. Responsibilities The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. 3. Mindset & Behaviors/ VACC The PJP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the patient journey, as well as strong passion to create value and impact on the ecosystem. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.
• Visionary: defining and embedding the strategy around creating improved patient journeys
• Mindset:
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding partnering capabilities (coaching, consulting, ability to deeply listen, question and understand)
• Growth mindset, able to learn and unlearn quickly, take

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We deliver knowledge on the safety profiles of our medicines, define how to manage risks to patients and coordinate the pharmacovigilance system activities for the company providing a safe journey for each individual patient, everywhere. The Opportunity:
• Contribute to shaping the future of healthcare by providing essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support across the entire Roche portfolio, influencing both early and late-phase development activities.
• Serve as a key member of the safety team, offering crucial safety oversight and input into all aspects of study management from development through post-market.
• Lead critical post-market safety activities, including signal evaluation, benefit-risk assessment, and comprehensive safety risk management.
• Take ownership of individual and aggregate case reporting, encompassing ICSR case management and critical aggregate reporting activities like DSUR and PBRER.
• Drive signal detection and management, and contributing to the strategic review of safety assessments and drug safety reports.
• Influence product safety strategy and provide vital drug safety input into the overarching Clinical Development strategy.
• Contribute significantly to risk management by preparing and maintaining CCDS, labeling documents (including the IB), risk communications, RMP, and REMS.
• Act independently with minimal supervision, demonstrating strong self-leadership, and proactively identifying and pursuing areas for personal and professional development. Who you are:
• Preferred Qualifications: A relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g. PHD/MSc in a Life sciences discipline; Medical qualification; PharmD or other post-graduate health professional qualifications) would be advantageous
• Demonstrate a strong understanding of GxP, regulated processes, and the end-to-end clinical trial lifecycle.
• Exhibit excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, capable of effectively collaborating with remote partners on a global team.
• Adept at applying complex data analysis and statistical methods to evaluate, interpret, and present scientific data with clarity.
• Possess strong presentation skills, effective at summarizing and presenting key considerations and decision points to diverse audiences.
• Proven ability to act independently and with minimal supervision, managing safety responsibilities on study teams and supporting safety science activities. Please note the role level will be determined based on experience and demonstrated expertise. This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Mansioni L'opportunità Come Leader per gli Affari Medici, svolgerai un ruolo centrale e altamente collaborativo nella nostra missione globale, pianificando e implementando attività mediche per i nostri prodotti nell'area clienti di Core Lab Reagents con particolare attenzione al portafoglio di salute e e endocrinologia femminile. Ti unirai a un ambiente a matrice rapida, dove il tuo acum scientifico e il tuo focus operativo plasmaranno direttamente il nostro Piano Medico Globale. Questa è un'opportunità per combinare la scienza con la strategia, assicurando che il valore clinico e le intuizioni mediche siano perfettamente integrate nel nostro ciclo di vita del prodotto. Oltre all'esperienza in una o più delle seguenti indicazioni: Salute femminile, Endocrinologia, Medicina di laboratorio. - Matrix Leadership Mastery: un comprovato track record di leader all'interno di organizzazioni matrici, prendere decisioni strategiche e influenzare efficacemente gli stakeholder. - Agility interculturale: Capacità dimostrata di collaborare in diverse regioni, culture e fusi orari per costruire attivamente un ambiente di appartenenza e inclusione. - Comunicazione efficace: eccellenti capacità di comunicazione inglese verbali e scritte, permettendo di navigare in modo indipendente situazioni complesse e spiegare concetti difficili. Vous vous joindrez à un environnement matricié et rapide où votre acuité scientifique et votre concentration opérationnelle façonneront directement notre Plan Médical Mondial. C'est l'occasion de combiner la science et la stratégie, en veillant à ce que la valeur clinique et les connaissances médicales soient intégrées de façon transparente dans notre cycle de vie des produits. Vos principales responsabilités - Former des plans médicaux mondiaux : contribuer à la planification médicale annuelle et continue, fournir une analyse de situation et une stratégie définie pour conduire le cycle de vie de nos innovations diagnostiques. - Maîtriser l'engagement des parties prenantes : Conduire la cartographie des leaders mondiaux de l'opinion et des sociétés professionnelles, gérer les listes d'experts actuels et émergents pour apporter un savoir-faire externe en interne. - Exécuter des activités à haut impact : Diriger l'exécution de bout en bout de l'enseignement médical, des conseils consultatifs et des activités scientifiques dans les grands congrès internationaux en étroite collaboration avec nos affiliés locaux. - Gérer les budgets stratégiques : Surveiller les budgets des activités médicales et planifier l'affectation des ressources en fonction des équipes de produits et des finances de l'entreprise. - Assurer l'intégrité scientifique : procéder à des examens approfondis du matériel médical non promotionnel, en assurant un alignement absolu sur les codes de pratique mondiaux en matière de droit, de réglementation et d'entreprise. - Cultiver des partenariats mondiaux : établir et maintenir des relations de collaboration solides avec des chefs de file interfonctionnels, des chercheurs en essais cliniques et des partenaires d'alliance externes, y compris des organismes de recherche contractuels. - Optimisation des processus d'entraînement : Optimisation permanente des processus pour améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité de nos opérations médicales.
• Requisiti Qui vous êtes Vous êtes un professionnel proactif et adaptable qui prospère en collaborant entre différentes équipes. Vous êtes profondément axé sur le patient, possédant l'état d'esprit stratégique et les compétences de communication nécessaires pour traduire des données complexes en concepts médicaux clairs et influencer divers points de vue. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez : - Contexte scientifique avancé : Diplôme d'études supérieures en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe, associé à une expertise pertinente dans l'industrie de la santé ou les universités. - Expérience de secteur profond: 5 ans et plus d'expérience dans les affaires médicales, le développement clinique ou les fonctions de communication scientifique est préféré; la gestion de projet ou l'expérience de marketing de produits est un plus. En plus de l'expérience dans une ou plusieurs des indications suivantes: santé des femmes, endocrinologie, médecine de laboratoire. - Maîtrise du leadership matricielle : une expérience éprouvée de leadership au sein des organisations matricielles, de prise de décisions stratégiques et d'influence efficace des intervenants. - Agilité transculturelle : Capacité démontrée de s'associer à diverses régions, cultures et fuseaux horaires pour construire activement un environnement d'appartenance et d'inclusion. - Communication efficace : Excellentes compétences de communication verbale et écrite en anglais, vous permettant de naviguer de façon indépendante dans des situations complexes et d'expliquer des concepts difficiles.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (pRED) , facciamo medicinali trasformativi per i pazienti per affrontare alcune delle più dure esigenze sanitarie non soddisfatte del mondo. A pRED, siamo uniti dalla nostra missione di trasformare la scienza in medicina. Insieme creiamo una cultura definita dalla curiosità, dalla responsabilità e dall'umiltà, dove i nostri talenti sono responsabili e ispirati a portare avanti una straordinaria innovazione che cambia la vita a velocità. Il gruppo Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) di pRED consente la scoperta e lo sviluppo di terapeutici sicuri ed efficaci a dosi ottimali nelle popolazioni rilevanti con una visione di potere traduzione, migliorare continuamente l'accuratezza delle nostre previsioni e accelerare lo sviluppo dei farmaci di domani. PS supporta la scoperta e lo sviluppo di tutta la catena del valore dalla valutazione dell'obiettivo al mercato e oltre. L'opportunità Come leader di progetto DMPK-PD esperto all'interno del gruppo DMPK-PD Traduzionale, sarete fondamentali per garantire che il farmaco giusto sia consegnato alla dose giusta, in modo sicuro ed efficace, ai pazienti. Condurrai strategie non cliniche e traduttive, collaborando in aree terapeutiche per trasformare le ipotesi scientifiche in candidati clinici innovativi. I vostri impatti e responsabilità:
• Leadership strategica: Definire e condurre la progettazione avanzata della droga, strategie di ottimizzazione e profilazione completa dei composti, integrando i principi DMPK all'avanguardia con la convalida della biologia di destinazione e concetti di PK/PD traduttivi complessi.
• Competenza traduttiva: Servire come esperto di materia tematica, guidare i team di scoperta precoce nello sviluppo di sofisticate strategie di traduzione per la valutazione clinica della modulazione target, sfruttando la conoscenza biochimica e farmacologica profonda.
• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): attività M&S avanzate dirette (comprese PKPD complessi, PBPK, DDI e sofisticate predizioni di dose/regimen) per informare criticamente e de-rischiare i progetti da Lead Optimisation (LO) attraverso lo sviluppo clinico precoce (EIH).
• Mastery di regolamentazione: Autore e presente valutazioni scientifiche definitive e di alta qualità dei dati DMPK non clinici per le revisioni critiche dei programmi interni e tutte le principali sottomissioni normative esterne (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), garantendo la conformità globale e tempi accelerati.
• Attuazione e innovazione: pioniere e supervisionare l'implementazione di robuste strategie biomarcatrici e bioanalitiche in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder chiave per massimizzare la sicurezza dei pazienti e il beneficio terapeutico.
• Influenza trasversale: il processo decisionale trasparente, basato sui dati, funge da consulente affidabile e coltiva relazioni professionali di alta fiducia tra team di progetto globali, enti di governance e partnership esterne. Chi sei
• Ha un PharmD o PhD in Scienze Farmaceutiche, Farmacologia, Bioingegneria o simili, accoppiato con oltre 10 anni di esperienza nel settore progressivo in un ruolo legato alla farmacocinetica senior.
• Possiedi competenze profonde e complete in tutto lo spettro di scoperta, nonclinico e di sviluppo, coprendo la caratterizzazione PK, la distribuzione e PKPD per diverse modalità (piccole molecole, biologiche, nuove terapeutiche), radicate nella conoscenza autorevole della farmacologia e della fisiologia.
• Lei dimostra la padronanza di piattaforme di modellazione e simulazione avanzate (ad esempio, Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) e possiede esperienza pratica o un forte sforzo per applicare l'intelligenza artificiale (AI)
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED) , we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicine. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. pRED's Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) group enables discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines. PS supports discovery and development across the whole value chain from target assessment to on-market and beyond. The Opportunity As an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients. You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates. Your Impact & Responsibilities:
• Strategic Leadership: Define and lead advanced drug design, optimisation strategies, and comprehensive compound profiling, integrating cutting-edge DMPK principles with target biology validation and complex translational PK/PD concepts.
• Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.
• Advanced Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Direct advanced M&S activities (including complex PKPD, PBPK, DDI, and sophisticated human dose/regimen prediction) to critically inform and de-risk projects from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early clinical development (EIH).
• Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of nonclinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.
• Implementation & Innovation: Pioneer and oversee the implementation of robust biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close partnership with key stakeholders to maximise patient safety and therapeutic benefit.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships. Who You Are
