Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position In der Pharma- und Early Development-Organisation (pRED) von Roche machen wir transformative Medikamente für Patienten, um einige der weltweit härtesten ungenutzten Gesundheitsbedürfnisse zu bewältigen. Bei pRED sind wir vereint von unserer Mission, Wissenschaft in die Medizin zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam schaffen wir eine von Neugier, Verantwortung und Demut definierte Kultur, in der unsere talentierten Menschen befähigt und inspiriert sind, außergewöhnliche lebensverändernde Innovation mit Geschwindigkeit voranzubringen. Die Gruppe Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften (PS) von pRED ermöglicht die Entdeckung und Entwicklung sicherer und effektiver Therapeutika bei optimalen Dosierungen in relevanten Populationen mit einer Vision zur Energieübersetzung, die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Genauigkeit unserer Vorhersagen und die Entwicklung der Medikamente von morgen. PS unterstützt Entdeckung und Entwicklung in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von der Zielbewertung bis zum Markt und darüber hinaus. Die Chance Als erfahrener DMPK-PD Projektleiter innerhalb der Translational DMPK-PD Gruppe, werden Sie entscheidend dafür sein, dass das richtige Medikament in der richtigen Dosis, sicher und effektiv, an Patienten geliefert wird. Sie führen nicht-klinische und translatorische Strategien, die über therapeutische Bereiche zusammenarbeiten, um wissenschaftliche Hypothesen in bahnbrechende klinische Kandidaten zu verwandeln. Ihre Auswirkungen und Aufgaben:
• Strategische Führung: Definieren und führen fortgeschrittenes Arzneimitteldesign, Optimierungsstrategien und umfassendes Compound-Profiling, Integration moderner DMPK-Prinzipien mit Zielbiologie-Validierung und komplexen Translations-PK/PD-Konzepten.
• Translationale Expertise: Als Fachexperte dienen, führen frühe Entdeckungsteams bei der Entwicklung anspruchsvoller Translationsstrategien für die klinische Bewertung der Zielmodulation, mit tiefem biochemischem und pharmakologischem Wissen.
• Fortgeschrittene Modellierung und Simulation (M&S): Direkte Fortgeschrittene M&S-Aktivitäten (einschließlich komplexer PKPD-, PBPK-, DDI- und ausgeklügelter menschlicher Dosis/Regimen-Prädiktion) zur kritischen Information und De-Risiko-Projekte von Lead Optimization (LO) durch frühe klinische Entwicklung (EIH).
• Regulatory Mastery: Autor und präsentieren endgültige, qualitativ hochwertige wissenschaftliche Bewertungen von nicht-klinischen DMPK-Daten für kritische interne Programmrezensionen und alle wichtigen externen regulatorischen Einreichungen (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), die globale Compliance und beschleunigte Timelines gewährleisten.
• Implementierung & Innovation: Pioneer und beaufsichtigen die Umsetzung von robusten Biomarker- und bioanalytischen Strategien in enger Partnerschaft mit den wichtigsten Akteuren, um die Patientensicherheit und den therapeutischen Nutzen zu maximieren.
• Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger Berater und kultiviert hoch vertrauensvolle Berufsbeziehungen über globale Projektteams, Governance-Einrichtungen und externe Partnerschaften. Wer bist du?
• Sie halten einen Doktortitel oder Doktortitel in der Pharmakologie, Pharmakologie, Bioengineering oder dergleichen, verbunden mit über 10 Jahren fortschrittlicher Branchenerfahrung in einer hochrangigen pharmakokinetischen Rolle.
• Sie verfügen über fundiertes, umfassendes Know-how über das gesamte Entdeckungs-, Nicht-Klinik- und Entwicklungsspektrum, das PK-Charakterisierung, Verteilung und PKPD für vielfältige Modalitäten (kleine Moleküle, Biologik, neuartige Therapeutika) abdeckt, die in maßgeblichem Wissen über Pharmakologie und Physiologie begründet sind.
• Sie demonstrieren Meisterschaft von fortschrittlichen Modellierungs- und Simulationsplattformen (z.B. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) und verfügen über praktische Erfahrungen oder einen starken Antrieb zur Anwendung von künstlicher Intelligenz (KI)

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Dans Roches Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development Organization (PRED) , nous fabriquons des médicaments transformatifs pour les patients afin de répondre à certains des besoins de santé les plus difficiles du monde. Chez PRED, nous sommes unis par notre mission de transformer la science en médecine. Ensemble, nous créons une culture définie par la curiosité, la responsabilité et l'humilité, où nos talents sont autonomisés et inspirés pour faire avancer rapidement l'innovation qui change la vie. Le groupe des Sciences Pharmaceutiques (PS) de pRED permet de découvrir et de développer des traitements sûrs et efficaces à des doses optimales dans les populations concernées, avec une vision pour la traduction de puissance, d'améliorer continuellement la précision de nos prédictions et d'accélérer le développement des médicaments de demain. SP appuie la découverte et le développement dans l'ensemble de la chaîne de valeur, depuis l'évaluation des cibles jusqu'au marché et au-delà. L'opportunité En tant que chef de projet expérimenté de DMPK-PD au sein du Groupe DMPK-PD, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel pour vous assurer que le bon médicament est livré à la bonne dose, de façon sûre et efficace, aux patients. Vous dirigerez des stratégies non cliniques et translationnelles, en collaborant dans des domaines thérapeutiques pour transformer des hypothèses scientifiques en candidats cliniques révolutionnaires. Votre impact et vos responsabilités :
• Leadership stratégique: Définir et diriger la conception avancée des médicaments, les stratégies d'optimisation et le profilage complet des composés, en intégrant les principes de pointe de DMPK avec la validation de la biologie cible et les concepts de PK/PD translationnels complexes.
• Expertise translationnelle: servir d'expert en matière, guidant les équipes de découverte précoce dans le développement de stratégies translationnelles sophistiquées pour l'évaluation clinique de la modulation cible, en tirant parti de connaissances biochimiques et pharmacologiques profondes.
• Modélisation et simulation avancées (M&S): Diriger les activités de M&S avancées (y compris la PKPD complexe, la PBPK, la DDI et la prédiction sophistiquée des doses/régimes humains) afin d'informer et de dérisquer les projets de l'optimisation du plomb (OL) jusqu'au développement clinique précoce.
• Maîtrise de la réglementation : Auteur et présentation d'évaluations scientifiques définitives de haute qualité des données DMPK non cliniques pour les examens internes critiques des programmes et toutes les principales présentations de réglementation externe (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), assurant la conformité mondiale et l'accélération des délais.
• Mise en œuvre et innovation: pionnier et supervision de la mise en œuvre de stratégies biomarqueurs et bioanalytiques robustes en partenariat étroit avec les principales parties prenantes afin de maximiser la sécurité des patients et les avantages thérapeutiques.
• Influence interfonctionnelle : Championne, prise de décisions transparente et axée sur les données, en tant que conseillère de confiance et en cultivant des relations professionnelles de haute confiance entre les équipes de projet mondiales, les organes de gouvernance et les partenariats externes. Qui vous êtes
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un PharmD ou d'un doctorat en sciences pharmaceutiques, pharmacologie, bioingénierie ou similaire, associé à plus de 10 ans d'expérience industrielle progressive dans un rôle pharmacocinétique senior.
• Vous possédez une expertise approfondie et complète sur l'ensemble du spectre de découverte, non clinique et de développement, couvrant la caractérisation, la distribution et la PKPD de PKPD pour diverses modalités (petites molécules, produits biologiques, nouveaux traitements), fondées sur une connaissance autorisée de la pharmacologie et de la physiologie.
• Vous démontrez la maîtrise des plates-formes de modélisation et de simulation avancées (p. ex. Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, SimCyp) et vous possédez une expérience pratique ou un puissant effort pour appliquer l'intelligence artificielle (AI)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Purpose Support the implementation, maintenance and oversight of the local PV system for the assigned affiliate(s)/country(ies), to ensure an efficient and effective PV system that complies with global Roche and local legal/regulatory authority PV requirements, safeguarding our License to Operate. Support the execution of IPS & Affiliate’s Patient Safety (APS) strategies, ensuring high-quality implementation of global and local safety solutions, while demonstrating leadership in ownership, collaboration, and decision-making within assigned responsibilities. Key Responsibilities PV System
• Execution of safety-related activities relevant to the PV (Pharmacovigilance) system through partnership with key stakeholders such as Patient Safety Operations and Affiliate PV Net, to ensure monitoring of the safety profile of Roche products and their safety risk management, meeting regulatory requirements, and ensuring license to operate. Proactively identify opportunities to optimize the PV system. Key areas of activities include the following in line with Roche standard operating procedures (where applicable):
• Individual Case Safety Reports (e.g. data collection)
• Signal Detection & Signal Management for Local Products
• Aggregate safety reports (e.g. submission to Health Authority)
• Pharmacovigilance Agreements (e.g. PVA, Safety Data Exchange Agreement)
• Risk Management and Safety Communication (e.g., Direct Healthcare Professional Communication, Risk Minimization Measures, emerging safety issues)
• Studies, Programs and other projects with PV implications (e.g., ICT, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP, Dicela)
• Safety Labeling and PV Commitments
• (Local) Pharmacovigilance System Master File
• As a contributor, shape country PV regulations and the broader country pharmacovigilance ecosystem according to APS grouping, particularly to promote regulatory reliance and international harmonization in partnership with (including but not limited to) local pharma industry associations, healthcare organizations, patient groups etc. (e.g. simplification of local implementation of aRMM together with trade associations and HA). Local Safety Risk Management (according to APS grouping)
• Identify, analyze and share safety insights by understanding disease areas (Roche portfolio, patient journey), engaging with key stakeholders, and ensuring timely, proactive integration into Affiliate and global strategies.
• Implementation of safety solutions and launch readiness activities: Implement global safety solutions locally within the integrated therapeutic strategy, and execute product safety launch readiness activities.
• Risk management and safety communication: Support the country-level risk management strategy to optimize patient outcomes in collaboration within relevant networks and ensure compliant and transparent PV communications (e.g., DHPCs) to healthcare professionals, patients, and external partners in collaboration with Medical Affairs and the cross-functional team. Further responsibilities may include assuming additional roles (e.g. RMP IC, core or extended member of the Affiliate Safety Disease Area Communities (ASDACs), Safety Responsible for MAP and DiCELA, Disease Area Expert, PV System Expert). Who you are: Education/Qualifications
• Qualification and/or Degree in life science or healthcare-related discipline (e.g., PharmD, MSc, BSc, Nursing, etc.). Experience
• Proven experience in pharmacovigilance, ideally in an affiliate setting •

The Position Como Executivo de Vendas, você será responsável por superar os objetivos comerciais da Roche Diagnóstica por meio do desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias comerciais de impacto. Você irá colaborar para o crescimento do negócio, através de metas que visam garantir a sustentabilidade do negócio e a retenção/conquista de novos clientes, além de assegurar continuamente a melhoria da experiência dos clientes com os nossos produtos e serviços. Você terá também a responsabilidade de apoiar o Gerente de Contas Estratégicas na execução da estratégia nacional voltada ao cliente público, com foco especial no Ministério da Saúde, suas secretarias vinculadas, autarquias reguladoras e centros de referência. Além da atuação comercial, você deverá desenvolver um relacionamento institucional de alto nível, identificar oportunidades estratégicas, apoiar a execução contratual e atuar como elo entre os diversos stakeholders internos e externos, assegurando a sustentabilidade e expansão dos negócios com o setor público. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Identificar oportunidades e promover soluções para sustentar e ampliar a base de clientes, priorizando clientes foco e metas definidas no "Valor em Ação".
• Construir planos de contas com base nas necessidades, metas, estratégias e ambiente de negócios dos clientes, fortalecendo o relacionamento.
• Cumprir metas de desempenho relacionadas a vendas, rentabilidade, NPS e outros indicadores, promovendo iniciativas sustentáveis para aumento de resultados.
• Liderar e executar Planos de Contas Estratégicas alinhados aos objetivos de crescimento da empresa, com foco em impacto de curto, médio e longo prazo.
• Gerenciar informações e contatos dos clientes no CRM, garantindo transparência, consistência e pipeline de vendas atualizado.
• Criar e manter relações transparentes e duradouras com KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders) e conectar os clientes a diferentes áreas da Roche.
• Identificar oportunidades em eventos, gerenciar leads e assegurar transições eficazes entre segmentos ou equipes, garantindo excelência no atendimento.
• Prover informações estratégicas, atender auditorias e melhorar KPIs de eficiência operacional para oferecer uma ótima experiência ao cliente. Quem você é:
• Apoio à Estratégia do Ministério: Você irá apoiar o gerente de contas estratégicas na execução da estratégia do MS, identificando sinergias com estados e municípios em ações descentralizadas. Acompanha iniciativas de políticas públicas de saúde que impactam a atuação da empresa, sugerindo ações proativas
• Prospecção de Oportunidades: você vai identificar editais, projetos-piloto, chamadas públicas e parcerias estratégicas, conectadas com a agenda do Ministério da Saúde. Monitorar e relatar iniciativas estaduais e locais alinhadas com diretrizes federais (ex: Planos Estaduais de Saúde, programas estratégicos
• Biologia Molecular: você tem experiência comprovada no segmento de biologia molecular, relacionamento com os principais stakeholders e decisores no Ministério da Saúde, bem como nos centros de referência tais como: INCA, Fiocruz, IAL (Instituto Adolf Lutz, etc). Representa a empresa em reuniões, fóruns, câmaras técnicas e eventos públicos relevantes.
• Execução Operacional e de Contratos: você acompanha a execução técnica de contratos públicos, garantindo aderência aos SLAs e resolução de entraves técnicos e administrativos. Contribuir na coleta de dados para análises de desempenho, elaboração de relatórios, estudos técnicos e processos de ren

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Procurement Manager – Research & Lab Materials Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions Hyderabad A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Healthcare is evolving, and Global Procurement is responding by continuously striving for the highest possible performance, taking innovative and strategic approaches to business and supplier partnerships. Global Procurement proactively manages the entire supplier ecosystem, making a vital contribution to improving health outcomes, reducing costs for patients and global healthcare systems, and ensuring that Roche continues doing now what patients need next. The Opportunity This role sits within the Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group, which covers the core procurement activities from category management, strategic and operational sourcing, supplier management, contracting, content strategy definition, and execution. The Materials, Manufacturing & CAPEX Procurement Delivery group comprises many communities grouping categories of the same value chain or having commonality, including Raw Materials, External Manufacturing Services, Logistics, Research & Laboratory Materials, and Engineering (CAPEX). Within Research & Laboratory Materials, we cover two categories:
• Lab Chemicals & Consumables (LCC)
• Lab Equipment & Maintenance (LEM) This structure enables strong category expertise while allowing flexibility in the procurement delivery response to the evolving needs of our customers. As a Procurement Manager, you will bring analytical thinking, planning, execution, and focus to the procurement sourcing and delivery capability area. Using your specialized knowledge and in-depth expertise in project management and procurement overall, you will proactively identify and drive strategies and approaches for managing and sourcing third-party spend requirements. You can also play the role of Category Strategy Owner in charge of driving, coordinating, and signing the category strategy. You will collaborate with internal procurement functions (such as Business Partners, Solutions, Analytics, Contracting, etc.) and business stakeholders to build and implement comprehensive LEM/LCC sourcing and spend management strategies that are aligned to business needs and functional objectives. You will work closely with other team members, as a peer coach, project, or workstream lead to identify opportunities to aggregate customer demand, drive buying channel automation, deliver on day-to-day activities, and provide capacity, expertise, and oversight to productivity and other customer-oriented projects/solutions. As a Procurement Manager, you will play a variety of roles according to your experience, knowledge, and business requirements, including but not limited to:
• You are a category and sourcing subject matter expert, conducting market and internal analysis to develop strategies, best practices, and guidance on tactical plans for how Roche should source, negotiate, and manage suppliers in this space to maximize value for Roche.
• You are a procurement delivery practitioner delivering and executing sourcing strategies and major initiatives by leveraging spend, category know-how, robust sourcing, negotiation, contracting, supplier management methodologies, and project management s

The Position Roche Diagnostics Cape Town is seeking a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist to join their team on a 1 year fixed-term contract . As a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist you will conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding, whilst maintaining quality and managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives. You will play a vital role in ensuring the high-quality production of life-saving molecular solutions. You will join a collaborative team where technical precision meets a passion for patient impact. Key Challenges
• Conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding while managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives or schedules.
• Assumes responsibility for the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of production work or testing activities. Summarizes batch or experimental results, and uses technical writing skills to produce clear reports, documents, and summaries.Effectively communicate results/ experimental outcomes and project status to supervisor and/or project leaders, proactively highlighting significant findings or critical problem areas.
• Analyzes and interprets test results, experimental data using various data analysis software, spreadsheets and or applying quantitative methods. Present findings at internal team meetings as required.
• Assumes accountability for batch record, hard copy or electronic lab notebook documentation, ensuring experimental methods and results are recorded timely, accurately and consistently, and according to established formats.
• May troubleshoot issues related to equipment or instrumentation. With guidance, analyzes and brainstorms alternative approaches to solve problems, makes recommendations and implements solutions to solve problems.
• Establish and maintain positive internal, cross-functional, and (where applicable) customer relationships.
• Other duties as assigned by management. Who You Are as an Ideal Candidate Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Chemical/Biochemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
• 3 years of relevant industry experience or general laboratory experience In the absence of relevant qualifications, experience in the relevant field and at the relevant level will be considered. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Ability to execute relevant laboratory experimentation. Hands-on experience with standard molecular biology and biochemistry lab techniques.
• Demonstrated ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Manufacturing Instructions (MI) and Work Instructions (WI) documents. Working knowledge of relevant international ISO Standards (13485) would be advantageous.
• Demonstrated competency in reading and completing charts, forms, and other documents.
• Ability to use a personal computer with basic word-processing and spreadsheet applications.
• Excellent written and verbal communication and personal task management skills
• Accountability, the ability to multitask, perform consistently under pressure and work without supervision.

The Position Roche Diagnostics Cape Town is seeking a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist to join their team on a 1 year fixed-term contract . As a Reagent Manufacturing Scientist you will conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding, whilst maintaining quality and managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives. You will play a vital role in ensuring the high-quality production of life-saving molecular solutions. You will join a collaborative team where technical precision meets a passion for patient impact. Key Challenges
• Conduct and monitor production activities or laboratory experiments utilizing established and published procedures or batch records and technical and theoretical understanding while managing schedules and workflow to accomplish assigned objectives or schedules.
• Assumes responsibility for the accuracy, quality, and timeliness of production work or testing activities. Summarizes batch or experimental results, and uses technical writing skills to produce clear reports, documents, and summaries.Effectively communicate results/ experimental outcomes and project status to supervisor and/or project leaders, proactively highlighting significant findings or critical problem areas.
• Analyzes and interprets test results, experimental data using various data analysis software, spreadsheets and or applying quantitative methods. Present findings at internal team meetings as required.
• Assumes accountability for batch record, hard copy or electronic lab notebook documentation, ensuring experimental methods and results are recorded timely, accurately and consistently, and according to established formats.
• May troubleshoot issues related to equipment or instrumentation. With guidance, analyzes and brainstorms alternative approaches to solve problems, makes recommendations and implements solutions to solve problems.
• Establish and maintain positive internal, cross-functional, and (where applicable) customer relationships.
• Other duties as assigned by management. Who You Are as an Ideal Candidate Qualifications and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Chemical/Biochemical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline or equivalent combination of education and work experience.
• 3 years of relevant industry experience or general laboratory experience In the absence of relevant qualifications, experience in the relevant field and at the relevant level will be considered. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Ability to execute relevant laboratory experimentation. Hands-on experience with standard molecular biology and biochemistry lab techniques.
• Demonstrated ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Manufacturing Instructions (MI) and Work Instructions (WI) documents. Working knowledge of relevant international ISO Standards (13485) would be advantageous.
• Demonstrated competency in reading and completing charts, forms, and other documents.
• Ability to use a personal computer with basic word-processing and spreadsheet applications.
• Excellent written and verbal communication and personal task management skills
• Accountability, the ability to multitask, perform consistently under pressure and work without supervision.
• Experience and understanding of protein purification techniques and enzyme analysis. Experience with AKTAs (FPLC) or HPLC w

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Estamos buscando um(a) Key Account Manager para atuar em nossa estrutura da Roche Diagnóstica para ser responsável posição de alta visibilidade e liderança, responsável pela gestão de um portfólio que abrange dispositivos médicos, diagnóstico in vitro (IVD) e soluções de saúde digital. Você terá visão de ecossistema, assegurando o crescimento sustentável do negócio em uma das contas mais estratégicas da companhia. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Atuar como o principal ponto de contato executivo para uma rede diagnóstica nacional de primeira linha ( Tier-1 ), alinhando o roadmap de inovação da Roche aos objetivos de negócios de longo prazo do cliente.
• Liderar negociações de alto valor para dispositivos médicos, produtos de diagnóstico e serviços científicos, gerenciando todo o ciclo de vida comercial de ponta a ponta.
• Influenciar times internos (técnicos, científicos e de supply chain ) para garantir a excelência operacional e a entrega impecável nos sites do cliente.
• Identificar oportunidades de expansão e novas frentes de negócio dentro da pegada geográfica da conta, incluindo diagnósticos especializados. Habilidades e Experiências desejadas:
• Graduação completa preferencialmente em áreas Científicas ou de Gestão. Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial.
• Experiência sólida em Gestão de Vendas ou Key Account Management nos setores de Life Sciences , Dispositivos Médicos (Medical Devices) ou Indústria Farmacêutica.
• Histórico comprovado no gerenciamento e negociação com grandes redes de laboratórios ( Big Labs ) ou grandes grupos hospitalares no mercado brasileiro.
• Expertise em negociações B2B complexas, gestão de P&L e consultoria de saúde baseada em valor ( Value-Based Healthcare ).
• Pensamento estratégico, excelente comunicação executiva e resiliência para navegar em ambientes corporativos complexos.
• Capacidade de colocar o cliente no centro das decisões, simplificando processos complexos para gerar valor real ao negócio. Os benefícios de realocação não estão disponíveis para essa posição. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione In qualità di Data & Analytics Specialist, ti siederai all'incrocio tra Forecasting, Advanced Data Analytics e Product Management. Questo è un ruolo di alto impatto progettato per un pensatore strategico che può fornire intuizioni operative con minima supervisione. Si agirà come partner strategico per le operazioni cliniche, trasformando complessi set di dati in narrazioni che guidano il futuro del nostro portafoglio clinico. L'opportunità:
• Agire come partner di pensiero per le Comunità di Area Malattia (CODACs) e le Comunità che abilitano il Portfolio (COPECs) per diagnosticare i problemi aziendali e raccomandare azioni basate sui dati.
• Partner con Franchise Leads, Study Management e il Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) per allineare la produzione analitica con le priorità aziendali.
• Condividere apertamente le prospettive per elevare il pensiero del team, pesare efficacemente i trade-off e comunicare il "perché" dietro le decisioni strategiche.
• Aumentare la raffinatezza dei nostri metodi analitici, utilizzando prototipi di machine learning e scalabili per misurare le prestazioni di studio alla velocità del business.
• Creare e gestire le serie temporali e le previsioni basate sul paziente, incorporando elementi di progettazione di prova, attività concorrente e impatti di selezione paese/sito.
• Applicare metodi statistici a più fonti di dati (primarie e secondarie) per rispondere a complesse domande aziendali e ottimizzare il valore degli investimenti clinici.
• Gestire il ciclo di vita delle soluzioni analitiche dall'ideazione attraverso l'implementazione.
• Mantenere corrente con metodologie e strumenti emergenti per garantire che il nostro approccio rimanga "adatto allo scopo" e impattante. Chi sei:
• Corso di laurea (Business, Economia, Statistica, Matematica, o Scienze Fisiche o campo correlato è un plus); MBA o Laurea Grado è preferito
• Inglese avanzato
• Mastery in aree specializzate come pazienti/Investigatori Insights, Forecasting o Statistica, con l'obiettivo di informare le decisioni cliniche e aziendali.
• La competenza nella programmazione e negli strumenti analitici di alto livello (Python, R, SQL, SAS) per eseguire l'esplorazione dei dati autonoma e sofisticata oltre l'analisi tradizionale.
• comprovata capacità di tradurre set di dati complessi in narrazioni e visualizzazioni convincenti che semplificano i concetti tecnici per gli stakeholder.
• Esperienza di navigazione in ambienti internazionali, interfunzionali (Scientific, Business, Operativo) utilizzando l'influenza senza autorità per guidare i risultati.
• Agire come consulente imprenditoriale per il business, gestire i fornitori esterni, e identificare i metodi analitici giusti per problemi specifici.
• Capacità di fondere fonti di dati disparate con meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli, assicurando che tutti i risultati siano persuasivi, accurati e fattibili.
• Disponibilità di lavorare in un modello ibrido con sede a San Paolo Le prestazioni di trasferimento non sono disponibili per questa posizione. Se si applica la trasparenza dei pagamenti, i dettagli vengono forniti in base alla posizione di pubblicazione primaria. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è San Paolo. Se siete interessati a posizioni aggiuntive in cui il ruolo può essere disponibile, forniremo i dettagli relativi di compensazione più tardi nel processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo ciascuno

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Data & Analytics Specialist, you will sit at the intersection of Forecasting, Advanced Data Analytics, and Product Management. This is a high-impact role designed for a strategic thinker who can provide operational insights with minimal supervision. You you will act as a strategic partner to Clinical Operations, turning complex datasets into narratives that guide the future of our clinical portfolio. The Opportunity:
• Act as a thought partner to Disease Area Communities (CODACs) and Portfolio Enabling Communities (COPECs) to diagnose business problems and recommend data-driven actions.
• Partner with Franchise Leads, Study Management, and the Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) to align analytical output with business priorities.
• Openly share perspectives to elevate team thinking, effectively weighing trade-offs and communicating the "why" behind strategic decisions.
• Increase the sophistication of our analytical methods, utilizing machine learning and scalable prototypes to measure study performance at the speed of business.
• Create and manage time-series and patient-based forecasts, incorporating trial design elements, competitor activity, and country/site selection impacts.
• Apply statistical methods to multiple data sources (primary and secondary) to answer complex business questions and optimize the value of clinical investments.
• Manage the lifecycle of analytical solutions from ideation through implementation.
• Stay current with emergent methodologies and tools to ensure our approach remains "fit-for-purpose" and impactful. Who you are:
• Bachelor’s Degree (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Physical Sciences or related field is a plus); MBA or Graduate-level Degree is preferred
• Advanced English
• Mastery in specialized areas such as Patient/Investigator Insights, Forecasting, or Statistics, with a focus on informing clinical and business decisions.
• Proficiency in high-level programming and analytical tools (Python, R, SQL, SAS) to perform autonomous, sophisticated data exploration beyond traditional analysis.
• Proven ability to translate complex datasets into compelling narratives and visualizations that simplify technical concepts for stakeholders.
• Experience navigating international, cross-functional environments (Scientific, Business, Operational) by using influence without authority to drive results.
• Acting as an entrepreneurial consultant to the business, managing outside vendors, and identifying the right analytical methods for specific problems.
• Ability to merge disparate data sources with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring all findings are persuasive, accurate, and actionable.
• Availability to work in a hybrid model based in São Paulo Relocation benefits are not available for this position. Dies ist eine hochwirksame Rolle für einen strategischen Denker, der operative Einblicke mit minimaler Aufsicht bieten kann. Sie werden als strategischer Partner für klinische Operationen fungieren und komplexe Datensätze in Erzählungen verwandeln, die die Zukunft unseres klinischen Portfolios führen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Aktivieren Sie als Gedankenpartner bei den Gemeinschaften (CODACs) und Portfolio Enabling Communities (COPECs), um betriebswirtschaftliche Probleme zu diagnostizieren und datengesteuerte Aktionen zu empfehlen.
• Partner mit Franchise Leads, Study Management und dem Late Stage Portfolio Committee (LSPC) zur Ausrichtung der analytischen Leistung auf Unternehmensprioritäten.
• Offene Perspektiven teilen, um Teamdenken zu erhöhen, Trade-offs effektiv zu wägen und die "Warum" hinter strategischen Entscheidungen zu kommunizieren.
• Erhöhen Sie die Raffinesse unserer analytischen Methoden, indem Sie maschinelles Lernen und skalierbare Prototypen verwenden, um die Leistungsfähigkeit der Studie mit der Geschwindigkeit des Unternehmens zu messen.
• Erstellung und Verwaltung von Zeitreihen und geduldigen Prognosen, einschließlich Testdesign-Elemente, Konkurrentenaktivität und Länder-/Siteauswahl-Effekte.
• Statistische Methoden auf mehrere Datenquellen (primär und sekundär) anwenden, um komplexe Geschäftsfragen zu beantworten und den Wert der klinischen Investitionen zu optimieren.
• Verwalten Sie den Lebenszyklus von analytischen Lösungen von der Idee über die Umsetzung.
• Bleiben Sie aktuell mit aufstrebenden Methoden und Werkzeugen, um sicherzustellen, dass unser Ansatz "tauglich" und wirkungsvoll bleibt. Wer du bist:
• Bachelor-Abschluss (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, oder Physical Sciences oder verwandten Bereich ist ein Plus); MBA oder Graduate-Level-Abschluss ist bevorzugt
• Erweitertes Englisch
• Mastery in spezialisierten Bereichen wie Patienten/Untersuchungsinsights, Prognosen oder Statistiken, mit dem Fokus auf die Information von klinischen und geschäftlichen Entscheidungen.
• Effizienz in hochrangigen Programmier- und Analysetools (Python, R, SQL, SAS) zur Durchführung autonomer, anspruchsvoller Datenexploration über die traditionelle Analyse hinaus.
• bewährte Fähigkeit, komplexe Datensätze in überzeugende Erzählungen und Visualisierungen zu übersetzen, die technische Konzepte für Stakeholder vereinfachen.
• Erleben Sie das Navigieren internationaler, funktionsübergreifender Umgebungen (Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, Betrieb), indem Sie Einfluss ohne Autorität nutzen, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen.
• Als Unternehmerberater für das Unternehmen fungieren, außerhalb von Anbietern verwalten und die richtigen analytischen Methoden für spezifische Probleme identifizieren.
• Fähigkeit, verschiedene Datenquellen mit sorgfältiger Liebe zum Detail zu verschmelzen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Ergebnisse überzeugend, genau und handlungsfähig sind.
• Verfügbarkeit in einem Hybridmodell mit Sitz in São Paulo Verlagerungsleistungen sind für diese Position nicht verfügbar. Bei Anwendung der Bezahlungstransparenz werden auf der Basis des primären Buchungsorts Angaben gemacht. Für diese Rolle ist der primäre Standort Sao Paulo. Wenn Sie an weiteren Standorten interessiert sind, an denen die Rolle zur Verfügung stehen kann, stellen wir die entsprechenden Vergütungsdetails später im Einstellungsprozess zur Verfügung. Wer wir sind Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir bestärken jeden Zahn
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que spécialiste des données et de l'analyse, vous serez à l'intersection de la prévision, de l'analyse avancée des données et de la gestion des produits. Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact conçu pour un penseur stratégique qui peut fournir des informations opérationnelles avec une supervision minimale. Vous agirez comme partenaire stratégique des Opérations cliniques, transformant des ensembles de données complexes en récits qui guident l'avenir de notre portefeuille clinique. La possibilité :
• Agir en tant que partenaire de réflexion des communautés de maladies (CODAC) et des communautés habilitantes de portefeuille (COPEC) pour diagnostiquer les problèmes commerciaux et recommander des mesures axées sur les données.
• S'associer aux responsables de franchises, à la gestion des études et au comité du portefeuille en retard pour aligner les résultats analytiques sur les priorités opérationnelles.
• Partager ouvertement des perspectives pour élever la pensée d'équipe, peser efficacement les compromis et communiquer le "pourquoi" derrière les décisions stratégiques.
• Accroître la sophistication de nos méthodes d'analyse, en utilisant l'apprentissage automatique et des prototypes évolutives pour mesurer les performances d'étude à la vitesse des affaires.
• Créer et gérer des séries chronologiques et des prévisions basées sur le patient, intégrant des éléments de conception d'essais, l'activité des concurrents et les impacts de sélection pays/site.
• Appliquer des méthodes statistiques à de multiples sources de données (primaires et secondaires) pour répondre à des questions complexes et optimiser la valeur des investissements cliniques.
• Gérer le cycle de vie des solutions analytiques depuis l'idée jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Restez à jour avec les méthodologies et les outils émergents pour s'assurer que notre approche reste « adaptée à l'usage » et efficace. Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat (Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathématiques, Sciences physiques ou domaine connexe est un plus); MBA ou diplôme de niveau supérieur est préféré
• Anglais avancé
• Maîtrise dans des domaines spécialisés tels que le Patient/Inspection des enquêteurs, la prévision ou les statistiques, en mettant l'accent sur l'information sur les décisions cliniques et commerciales.
• Connaissance des outils de programmation et d'analyse de haut niveau (Python, R, SQL, SAS) pour effectuer une exploration autonome et sophistiquée des données au-delà de l'analyse traditionnelle.
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire des ensembles de données complexes en récits et visualisations convaincants qui simplifient les concepts techniques pour les parties prenantes.
• Expérimentez la navigation dans des environnements internationaux et interfonctionnels (scientifiques, commerciaux, opérationnels) en utilisant l'influence sans autorité pour produire des résultats.
• En tant que consultant en entreprise auprès de l'entreprise, en gérant des fournisseurs extérieurs et en identifiant les méthodes d'analyse appropriées pour des problèmes spécifiques.
• Capacité de fusionner des sources de données disparates avec une attention méticuleuse aux détails, en veillant à ce que toutes les constatations soient convaincantes, précises et réalisables.
• Disponibilité pour travailler dans un modèle hybride basé à São Paulo Les indemnités de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour ce poste. Lorsque la transparence de la paye s'applique, les détails sont fournis en fonction du lieu d'affectation principal. Pour ce rôle, l'endroit principal est Sao Paulo. Si vous êtes intéressé par d'autres endroits où le rôle peut être disponible, nous fournirons les détails pertinents de la rémunération plus tard dans le processus d'embauche. Qui nous sommes Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous responsabilisons chaque oth

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position You will be:
• Co-ordinate with SSC KL Finance teams (AP, GAMA, AR, TR, T&E, Compliance and Procurement) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with month-end close checklist.
• Perform analytical review of profit and loss accounts and balance sheet, accountable for the financial accuracy of the affiliate’s Financials. Responsible of all Internal Controls of Financial Reporting (ICFR) documentation and internal controls matters, act as owner for the ICFR tools – INVOLVE and BWISE
• Review monthly balance sheet reconciliation – follow up on open items and rectify any anomalies encountered. Submission other reporting packages accurately and within specified timeline i.e. Sustainability, Insurance reporting. Responsible of IFRS 16 Leasing related matters i.e SimSol /Planon . Review and provide approval for all manual journal entries for posting by SSC KL team. Responsible for all management accounting aspects i.e. Period cost allocation, COPA allocation, SSC allocation, etc
• Accounts Receivables / Accounts Payables : Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Receivables – review and approve manual billings, review debtors ageing and determine follow up actions, ensure all sales related activities are reported timely and accurate. Responsible for all aspects of Accounts Payables – review and provide approval of AP related activities i.e. vendor invoices, payment, etc.
• Treasury : Cash flow management - forecast current and future cash flow requirement and arrangement for necessary fund transfers (if required). Responsible for all treasury matters i.e. FX deal, credit facilities, payment request, banking matters.
• Master Data : Managing of master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Others activities which include : Preparation of statutory taxes calculations and reconciliation, including tax reporting and liaising with Tax Consultant. Preparation of audit related schedules and documentation, including liaising with the Auditor. Participate in any compliance audits and responding to audit queries. Identify, recommend and implement solutions in consultation with the management for continuous improvement opportunities in the areas of operation. Being the main contact person for SSC KL Finance teams for issue resolution for all financial matters. Being the main contact person for FM in the affiliates for all financial matters, requests and advisory. Who you are :
• A degree in Finance/ Accounting/ Commerce or equivalent. ACCA, CPA Australia or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage.
• Minimum 5 years of working experience in related field and minimum 3 years In accountant role / audit experience. Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit and taxation.
• Proficiency in relevant accounting software preferably SAP and MS office tools. Meticulous, independent, proactive and ability to execute tasks within tight deadlines.
• Strong communication skills, expressing ideas and expectations in a clear and concise manner. Proven track record of effective relationship and stakeholder management with diverse populations (customers, colleagues and senior leaders). Proficiency in influencing skills. Comfortable working in a dynamic, changing and growing environment. The ability to operate effectively across diverse cultural and business environments.Ab

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity As a Customer Account Manager for our Managed Service Contracts in the North region, you will act as the vital link between Roche and our healthcare partners. You will ensure our customers receive a superior experience while bringing their voice directly into our organization to shape the future of diagnostics.
• Build meaningful partnerships: Develop and maintain long-term commercial relationships across all levels of your assigned customer base.
• Drive strategic value: Connect customer business goals with Roche’s product and service suite to support their success during periods of healthcare transformation.
• Lead service delivery: Co-create Strategic account plans and coordinate cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services) to ensure seamless execution.
• Manage the lifecycle: Oversee the full customer experience for our Optimall branded Managed Services, serving as the primary point of escalation for Roche and third-party partners.
• Foster a culture of excellence: Champion the "voice of the customer" internally to ensure we continue to "do now what patients need next." Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a passionate customer advocate who thrives on delivering value and building resilient commercial relationships.
• Experienced Account Manager: You bring a proven track record in contract management and commercial engagement within the healthcare sector.
• Strategic & Analytical: You possess the ability to interrogate large datasets to draw meaningful insights (Advanced Excel) and understand complex business workflows.
• Collaborative Leader: You are skilled at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously while working alongside experts in technical support, finance, and marketing.
• Effective Communicator: You are a strong listener who can identify pain points and develop clear solutions, maintaining a professional demeanor under pressure.
• Education: You are educated to degree level or equivalent in a relevant field. Together, we’ll create a healthier, brighter future for all. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. • El Especialista en Sistemas de Salud (HSP) a nivel central para el sector privado, actúa de conformidad con el modelo del líder Visionario, Arquitecto, Coach, Catalizador (VACC), es catalizador y coach interna y externamente.
• Colabora estrechamente y reúne la experiencia de diferentes áreas a nivel local y en la red de Roche, según sea necesario, incluyendo a otros Especialistas en Sistemas de Salud (HSPs) y Especialistas en Experiencia del Paciente (PJPs), MVLs, equipo de economía de la salud, precio, etc.
• Alcanza un profundo entendimiento de su ecosistema, da seguimiento y se actualiza en las tendencias y patrones de los sistemas de salud, particularmente del ecosistema de salud bajo su responsabilidad.
• Provee a Roche del conocimiento de su ecosistema que tiene para trabajar estratégicamente y brindar experiencia, ciencia y conocimiento al Ecosistema bajo su responsabilidad.
• Desarrolla las estrategias y coordina los proyectos de inclusión de los medicamentos e indicaciones terapéuticas nuevas aprobadas por la Cofepris para que el formulario de medicamentos de las aseguradoras cuenten con los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche así como participar en las licitaciones y concretar los contratos y adjudicaciones para los medicamentos de Roche en este sector.
• Coordina el trabajo estratégico para este sector y junto con el chapter médico y el equipo de economía de la salud y de precios brindar la información médica, económica y de precios que apoyen el rápido acceso de nuestros medicamentos en este sector.
• Trabaja junto con los directivos y administradores para detectar posibles barreras para mejorar la calidad de atención de los pacientes y junto con ellas busca posibles soluciones para mejorar los ecosistemas del sector para beneficio de los pacientes a nivel público. Trabaja en forma coordinada con los equipos de Roche en la entrega de los mensajes médicos y FE que sustentan el uso de nuestros medicamentos.
• Participa con los squads para definir y alinear las estrategias de acceso para este sector bajo su responsabilidad, así como la detección de obstáculos y oportunidades para que los medicamentos e indicaciones de Roche se incluyan para beneficio lo más rápidamente posible de los pacientes en este sector. Tu perfil: La persona en esta posición tiene la capacidad de colaborar y construir relaciones con diversos actores en el ecosistema de atención médica. • Gestionar y expandir la operación comercial de las cuentas asignadas, asegurando el cumplimiento de objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, alineados con el código de conducta Roche, normativas locales y lineamientos corporativos.
• Liderar negociaciones estratégicas e implementar soluciones integrales adaptadas a las necesidades de los clientes, desarrollando propuestas de valor basadas en un entendimiento profundo de sus operaciones y desafíos.
• Construir y fortalecer relaciones de largo plazo con clientes y stakeholders clave, brindando una experiencia superior de servicio, realizando visitas estratégicas y participando activamente en actividades externas como congresos, talleres y jornadas.
• Identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio y contribuir al desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas, apoyando procesos de licitación, análisis de mercado, actualización de CRM y colaboración interdisciplinaria enfocada en el paciente y el cliente.
• Impulsar una cultura de trabajo colaborativa y de crecimiento continuo, participando en iniciativas internas, fortaleciendo habilidades comerciales y contribuyendo al desarrollo y capacitación de nuevos integrantes del equipo. Tu Perfil:
• Profesional del área de la salud, idealmente Tecnólogo Médico o Bioquímico, con residencia en Temuco y disponibilidad para viajar dentro de la zona asignada.
• Experiencia mínima de 3 años en el área comercial de soluciones diagnósticas para laboratorio clínico, idealmente en entornos de diagnóstico clínico, equipos médicos o industrias relacionadas.
• Deseable formación en ventas profesionales, manejo de herramientas CRM como Salesforce, y conocimientos comerciales orientados a negociación estratégica y desarrollo de cuentas.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position External Job Ad Text The Opportunity The PJP role is a Local customer-facing role, unlocking value along patient journeys. The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey PJP Mission
• Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve.
• The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
• The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions.
• This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
• It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives As the PJP, you will be responsible for:-'=
• The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
• Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster.
• Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community.
• Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner.
• By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem.
• The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs.
• Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services. Who You Are:
• System thinker and deep listener
• Excellent stakeholder engagement skills including partnering with TAE's and organizations is required. Experience leading Cross-functional team is required.
• Experience in both formulating cross-functional strategies and orchestrating cross-functional teams is highly desired.
• Strong business acumen with desired expertise in commercialization, medical and customer experience excellence
• Able to understand and leverage digital means and tools is desired
• Deep experience in agile way

Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les personnes que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. Nous recherchons un(e) spécialiste du service client pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact significatif sur notre organisation. En tant que spécialiste du service client, vous aurez l'occasion de développer des relations de confiance solides avec nos précieux clients, en veillant à une expérience d'approvisionnement positive. En identifiant proactivement les besoins des clients et en collaborant avec notre équipe, vous contribuerez à améliorer et à adapter l'expérience globale du client. Vos solides compétences en leadership et en influence vous permettront de remettre en question le statu quo et de rechercher l'efficacité, en faisant des recommandations qui garantissent un service fiable et constant. Par-dessus tout, vos compétences exceptionnelles en communication et votre capacité d'écoute active seront la clé de la réussite dans ce rôle. Rejoignez notre équipe et saisissez cette opportunité passionnante pour une croissance personnelle et professionnelle. Postulez maintenant et laissez votre passion pour des expériences client exceptionnelles briller en tant que spécialiste du service client. L'opportunité
• Vous gérez les solutions de lots réservés pour tous les clients du Canada, en veillant au respect des politiques et des procédures de Roche. En collaboration étroite avec l'équipe de planification de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous vous assurez de l'exactitude des données et de la gestion des demandes des clients, des renouvellements et de la maintenance des contrats pour assurer un flux de commandes efficace.
• Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse et de la communication avec les clients concernant les problèmes de lots réservés, ainsi que de la transmission des besoins des clients à l'équipe de planification.
• Vous gérez des comptes spécialisés avec des exceptions logistiques, en maintenant et en gérant des "accords planifiés" pour tous les clients/territoires afin d'assurer des niveaux élevés d'exactitude des données.
• Vous prenez les appels des clients et apportez un soutien à leurs demandes, en collaborant avec les équipes régionales pour offrir une expérience d'approvisionnement exceptionnelle.

• Vous êtes responsable des ajustements de facture (crédits/débits) conformément aux procédures, le cas échéant.
• Vous analysez les rapports quotidiens, élaborez des plans d'action pour traiter les commandes en cours et communiquez tout retard ou changement de délai de livraison et de traitement aux clients à des fins de planification. Qui vous êtes
• Vous possédez un diplôme collégial ou un diplôme universitaire (administration ou commerce préférable).
• Vous possédez au moins 3 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle dans le domaine des soins de santé ou des sciences de la vie.
• Vous faites preuve de compétences en leadership et avez une passion pour la collab

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position El Medical Ecosystem Partner (MEP) está en el centro de la nueva organización en Roche, desafiando el papel que jugamos en la sociedad para pasar de ofrecer medicamentos de clase mundial a construir alianzas, co-crear, innovar y liderar la atención médica. Es directamente responsable de entregar los mejores resultados para los pacientes, su comunidad, el ecosistema y la organización de una manera más rápida. El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general. La Oportunidad
• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.
• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.
• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.
• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.
• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.
• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”
• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.
• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.
• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.
• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones
• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

El objetivo de esta función es también colaborar con la comunidad científica y médica externa para proporcionar información clara, científicamente sólida, coherente y oportuna sobre nuestros productos, servicios y áreas de enfermedad, y recopilar información externa relevante para la estrategia general. La Oportunidad
• El MEP es un rol clave dentro de la afiliada, que tiene las habilidades para identificar y superar barreras de acceso con el fin de tener un mayor impacto en el viaje del paciente.
• El MEP se enfoca en la importancia de traer y compartir insights trabajando de cerca con nuestros clientes para descubrir las oportunidades potenciales para transformar los resultados en salud para los pacientes, de forma más rápida. Comparte la experiencia, la ciencia y el conocimiento de Roche a los diferentes ecosistemas de salud.
• Participa y promueve el trabajo en red (Network) para agilizar, colaborar e innovar, así como atraer experiencia y recursos a nivel local.
• Procesa , analiza y proporciona información médica valiosa, tanto interna como externamente, de forma proactiva o basada en solicitudes.
• Trabajar de cerca con todos los actores que intervienen directamente en el manejo de la enfermedad (en un área terapéutica determinada), compartiendo con los Expertos de Áreas Terapéuticas (TAEs) un profundo y actualizado conocimiento sobre el manejo de la patología, información relacionada con los productos con FOCO EN PIPELINE acorde a los estándares de Roche y de las regulaciones locales, así como asociaciones de pacientes y otras partes interesadas.
• Comunica propuestas de valor a los diferentes grupos de interés para acelerar soluciones de acceso “One Roche”
• Brinda apoyo como experto en los ecosistemas locales, fomentando el trabajo multidisciplinario y el desarrollo de iniciativas OneRoche que apoyen el desarrollo de la estrategia de una Medicina Integral y Personalizada.
• Asegura de que las consultas de información médica cumplan con los estándares de calidad, las políticas y los SOP de Roche, y satisfagan las necesidades del cliente.
• Asegura de que los departamentos de Farmacovigilancia y Calidad tengan información oportuna sobre los informes de eventos adversos y quejas de calidad, y realizar las conciliaciones requeridas por estos departamentos.
• Participa de forma significativa con las comunidades globales y regionales pertinentes, participando activamente (compartiendo experiencias y participando en grupos de trabajo) y defendiendo el valor de las redes y la colaboración.
• Trabaja en conjunto con el Squad y el área de RWE en la identificación de Gaps de evidencia local para co-crear con los actores de los ecosistemas soluciones que puedan cubrir los gaps para mejorar el acceso y la atención personalizada de los pacientes y lograr que se generen publicaciones
• Cuenta con entendimiento profundo del ecosistema médico (médico tratante, tomadores de decisión en instituciones públicas y privadas, asociaciones médicas y de pacientes) para encontrar oportunidades y moldearlo, facilitando que más pacientes reciban mejores solucion

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Backlog Elaboration Team Lead The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an accomplished Systems Engineer with a strong background in end-to-end new product development programs and successful launches, you will play the role of Backlog Elaboration Team Lead being at the forefront of leading Roche Tissue Diagnostics’ design & development programs. Using the Agile method of development, you will primarily focus on the prioritization, definition, estimation, tracking and continuous maintenance of solution level backlog by heavily collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders. The Opportunity
• You will facilitate and improve Backlog Elaboration by leading backlog elaboration meetings, ensuring they are productive and owning the project’s backlog elaboration WiKi site.
• You will collaborate and seek guidance from the program’s Solution Train Engineer to continuously iterate and refine processes with a goal to have backlogs sequenced, defined & estimated for confident predictability and project schedule tracking.
• You will manage interdependencies by developing a deep understanding of System, Software, Assay, Consumables and Hardware teams & the Agile Release Trains (ARTs) to ensure that all Epics, Capabilities & Features are clearly defined & documented in the backlog.
• You will continually look for ways of enhancing tools (such as Azure DevOps and Lucid) and communication by streamlining our workflow, be the central point of contact for backlog-related communications & engaging with a wide range of stakeholders (including Product Managers, ART leads, and senior leadership) to align everyone towards a unified goal.
• You will strategize and plan for the future by developing and communicating yearly backlog goals that provide clear direction for the teams. This includes implementing Agile SAFe's rolling-wave planning approach involving detailed planning for upcoming Program Increments while keeping a high-level view of future PIs. Over time, this role can grow into co-facilitating PI Planning with the Solution Train Engineer. Who you are
• An Agile & SAFe expert with strong understanding of Agile principles including backlog elaboration, just-in-time planning, and rolling-wave planning. You must know how to apply these concepts to maintain a healthy and predictive backlog.
• An expert at organizational & planning skills to effectively manage complex backlogs, track dependencies across multiple teams (SW, Assay, System, etc.), and maintain the Project Backlog Elaboration wiki. The ability to sequence work and ensure a high-level project schedule will be a direct outcome of this skill.
• While not a developer, you must have a solid grasp of the development lifecycle and key milestone deliverables. This technical acumen & understanding is crucial for effective communication and for ensuring that backlog items are well-defined and feasible.
• Expert in using Azure DevOps and Lucid tools is essential. You'll be responsible for driving tool improvements and using these platforms to manage and visualize the backlog, dependencies, and project flow.
• An excellent facilitator & communicator. This role requires strong skills in facilitating meetings and communicating with diverse stakeholders, from team members
