descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Supply Chain Maintenance Specialist, you will be able to contribute to shape the future of the Roche Global Supply Chain organization by maintaining the reliability and performance of the equipment utilized within the Hub Operations Americas group located in Indianapolis. Your Opportunity Position’s most important individual tasks:
• Complete preventative maintenance tasks according to detailed procedures and schedules.
• Perform electrical or mechanical troubleshooting to determine problems in non-functioning equipment, used within warehousing areas.
• Dismantle, adjust, repair, and assemble equipment according to layout plans, blueprints, operating or repair manuals, rough sketches, or drawings.
• Use test and diagnostic equipment to perform checkouts & rebuild equipment as required.
• Perform equipment modifications including installation, validation support and start-up of new equipment, as well as decommissioning activities as directed by engineers
• Use predictive maintenance technologies and techniques in order to improve operational efficiencies.
• Apply advanced knowledge and skills to complete assignments requiring judgment and initiative. You will understand the implications of work and make recommendations for solutions. You will receive little instruction on daily assignments and may determine methods and procedures on new assignments. Who you are: Minimum qualifications:
• High school diploma or equivalency
• 2+ years of related experience in maintenance experience. Preferred Qualifications:
• Associates degree, journeyman’s card or equivalent military training related to maintenance of equipment in an industrial setting.
• At least 5 years of experience in technical support and maintenance roles.
• Preferred credentials: CMRT, CRL, CMRP, etc
• Strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience with electrical, mechanical and pneumatic systems. Preferred experience: familiar with conveyor systems and other equipment used within warehouse operations.
• Proficiency in troubleshooting and diagnosing technical issues, using diagnostic tools, and interpreting equipment manuals and schematics.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
• Familiarity with preventive maintenance programs, spare parts management, and relevant safety regulations.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, managing multiple priorities and adapting to changing circumstances. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Pay transparency The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Tucson is 54,300.00 - 100,800.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore ne

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care. The Opportunity The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:
• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.
• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.
• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.
• Advanced and specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system, or equipment with regard to technologically advanced instruments and scientific applications. Requires specific training and certification.
• Utilizes independent judgment and discretion in the analysis of customer particularized needs and issues that arise both during and after the implementation process. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment, and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Independently analyzes and resolves most customer questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.
• Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this highly responsible position. This is a field-based role - the territory is Southwest, 90% travel is expected for this position. The ideal candidate for this role will reside in Phoenix, AZ or within 50 miles on Phoenix. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience.
• 3 + years of experience implementing and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipment, reagents and/or systems. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Histology, Immunohi

With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care. The Opportunity The Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Applications Specialist you will:
• Acting as the primary liaison/customer representative throughout the implementation process and future histology application support, Includes planning and coordination for the implementation and customer training, as well as problem-solving issues that arise for customers throughout the life cycle of the solution.
• Provide highly visible, self-supervised and self-directed, extensive on-site advisory customer support through the implementation of Roche Tissue instrumentation and tailored customer training on our Roche solutions to meet customer needs based on an individualized assessment of the customer’s personnel, organizational structure, workflow, and maximization of equipment capabilities, which may include: equipment, applications, systems, and IT solutions.
• Act as an advisor on customer issues and drive efficiencies & optimization for the customer and Roche through independent analysis and problem-solving. Additionally, will be responsible for increased sales revenue by identifying opportunities for new system consumables for clients (i.e. reagents, primary antibodies, bio-markers, software). Performs these job duties remotely and independently.
• Advanced and specialized knowledge generally of a particular area, system, or equipment with regard to technologically advanced instruments and scientific applications. Requires specific training and certification.
• Utilizes independent judgment and discretion in the analysis of customer particularized needs and issues that arise both during and after the implementation process. May adapt procedures, processes, tools, equipment, and techniques to meet the more complex requirements of the position. Independently analyzes and resolves most customer questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to higher levels.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions.
• Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of this highly responsible position. This is a field-based role - the territory is Southwest, 90% travel is expected for this position. The ideal candidate for this role will reside in Phoenix, AZ or within 50 miles on Phoenix. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s degree in Medical Technology, Information Technology, Computer Science, Chemistry, Biology or Clinical Laboratory or equivalent work experience.
• 3 + years of experience implementing and evaluating complex laboratory, IT products, medical diagnostic equipment, reagents and/or systems. Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Histology, Immunohi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Um futuro mais saudável. É isso que nos motiva a inovar. Promover continuamente a ciência e garantir que todos tenham acesso à assistência médica de que precisam hoje e pelas próximas gerações. Criar um mundo onde todos nós temos mais tempo com as pessoas que amamos. É isso que nos faz Roche. Como Parceiro de Jornada do Paciente (Digital) , você terá como missão transformar a forma como a Roche interage com stakeholders, posicionando-se no centro de uma abordagem inovadora e disruptiva. Em um mercado farmacêutico em constante evolução, você atuará como interface buscando trazer a voz do cliente para dentro da empresa utilizando estratégias e inovações omnichannel, aliadas às ferramentas digitais para otimizar as interações com o ecossistema de saúde. O PJP Digital é uma posição estratégica e agnóstica em termos de responsabilidade, focada em criar impacto no ecossistema de saúde, indo além das barreiras geograficas, uilizando estratégias omnichannel e insights baseados em dados para melhorar a tomada de decisões e maximizar a eficiência operacional. Com uma visão 360° das contas e stakeholders, você irá colaborar com outros parceiros de negócio para atender ao potencial das contas e alavancar o acesso, destravando barreiras e otimizando a jornada do paciente nos pilares de Prevenção/Diagnóstico, Decisão Médica, Acesso e Financiamento e Tratamento. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Estabelecer metas desafiadoras e identificar oportunidades de ampliação do acesso a soluções inovadoras em seu território, promovendo maior alcance e impacto para nossos pacientes.
• Gerenciar contas e stakeholders, criando estratégias de engajamento e planos de ação alinhados com os objetivos da Roche, de forma a fortalecer relações e impulsionar resultados consistentes.
• Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos digitais e garantir a eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde, acelerando a entrega de valor e ampliando o acesso às nossas inovações.
• Ser responsável pelo lançamento de informações no EpiCX (CRM) e outras plataformas que otimizem e personalizem a comunicação com profissionais de saúde, garantindo a eficácia das interações e a melhoria contínua dos processos através de visão analítica de dados.
• Contribuir para a ampliação da eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde. Quem é você:
• Graduação completa e inglês intermediário.
• Experiência em relacionamento com clientes e desejável conhecimento em gestão de projetos.
• Visão intermediária multidisciplinar em Acesso, Médico Científico e Gestão de contas, além de conhecimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.
• Experiência com diversos stakeholders do setor de saúde (HCP e HCO), com diferencial para atuação virtual.
• Forte comunicação empática e ativa, com habilidade para engajar de forma omnichannel (repetido no original).
• Mindset multicanal e data-driven, com domínio em marketing digital, mídias sociais e ferramentas como CRM (OCE-IQVIA) (repetido no original).
• Experiência na construção de eventos científicos nos formatos presencial, digital e híbrido (repetido no original).
• Persuasão para transformar interações em oportunidades de negócio, com abordagem criativa, resolutiva, proatividade, foco em resultados e agilidade na tomada de decisão.
• Agilidade cultural/organizacional, facilidade para trabalhar em equipe em ambientes ambíguos, flexíveis e fluidos, mantendo o controle emocional e capacidade de gerenciar expectativas.
• Disponibilidade para atua

O PJP Digital é uma posição estratégica e agnóstica em termos de responsabilidade, focada em criar impacto no ecossistema de saúde, indo além das barreiras geograficas, uilizando estratégias omnichannel e insights baseados em dados para melhorar a tomada de decisões e maximizar a eficiência operacional. Com uma visão 360° das contas e stakeholders, você irá colaborar com outros parceiros de negócio para atender ao potencial das contas e alavancar o acesso, destravando barreiras e otimizando a jornada do paciente nos pilares de Prevenção/Diagnóstico, Decisão Médica, Acesso e Financiamento e Tratamento. Sobre a oportunidade:
• Estabelecer metas desafiadoras e identificar oportunidades de ampliação do acesso a soluções inovadoras em seu território, promovendo maior alcance e impacto para nossos pacientes.
• Gerenciar contas e stakeholders, criando estratégias de engajamento e planos de ação alinhados com os objetivos da Roche, de forma a fortalecer relações e impulsionar resultados consistentes.
• Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos digitais e garantir a eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde, acelerando a entrega de valor e ampliando o acesso às nossas inovações.
• Ser responsável pelo lançamento de informações no EpiCX (CRM) e outras plataformas que otimizem e personalizem a comunicação com profissionais de saúde, garantindo a eficácia das interações e a melhoria contínua dos processos através de visão analítica de dados.
• Contribuir para a ampliação da eficiência omnichannel nas interações com o ecossistema de saúde. Quem é você:
• Graduação completa e inglês intermediário.
• Experiência em relacionamento com clientes e desejável conhecimento em gestão de projetos.
• Visão intermediária multidisciplinar em Acesso, Médico Científico e Gestão de contas, além de conhecimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.
• Experiência com diversos stakeholders do setor de saúde (HCP e HCO), com diferencial para atuação virtual.
• Forte comunicação empática e ativa, com habilidade para engajar de forma omnichannel (repetido no original).
• Mindset multicanal e data-driven, com domínio em marketing digital, mídias sociais e ferramentas como CRM (OCE-IQVIA) (repetido no original).
• Experiência na construção de eventos científicos nos formatos presencial, digital e híbrido (repetido no original).
• Persuasão para transformar interações em oportunidades de negócio, com abordagem criativa, resolutiva, proatividade, foco em resultados e agilidade na tomada de decisão.
• Agilidade cultural/organizacional, facilidade para trabalhar em equipe em ambientes ambíguos, flexíveis e fluidos, mantendo o controle emocional e capacidade de gerenciar expectativas.
• Disponibilidade para atua

titleByLocale.it: Centro di Servizi Associati di Pagamento - 3

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position PROPÓSITO DEL PUESTO Es responsable de asistir a los equipos de estudios clínicos en todas las actividades financieras transaccionales relacionadas con el proceso de pagos de los estudios clínicos gestionados por el Departamento Local de Operaciones Clínicas, en cada uno de los países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Perú, Chile, Colombia, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica, Centroamérica y Caribe) y otras tareas de asistencia (de ser requerido). FUNCIONES O RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES Trabajar en conjunto con los equipos de Estudios clínicos de cada país en la ejecución de las siguientes actividades:
• Verificar la información de visitas completadas y procedimientos adicionales (Adhocs) en CTMS y plantillas excel por parte del CRA (Monitor) (Para Latam) o Generar los reportes necesarios para consolidar una propuesta de pagos por país, donde se incluya la información del Investigador Centro y Paciente según la frecuencia de pagos de cada uno de los países de Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica.
• Cuando se requiera, Confirmar con el Centro de Investigación (para USA) que la información de pagos sea proporcionada de forma exacta y oportuna.
• Gestionar pagos para los Centros de Investigación de Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica a través de los sistemas SAP, CCOPS y CTMS al equipo de Cuentas por pagar.
• Asistir a los Centros de Investigación (Latam, USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica) en caso de solicitudes conciliación de cuentas o dudas en relación con temas de pagos.
• Es responsable de solicitar y verificar la creación de los vendor (SAP) relacionados a estudios clínicos (USA).
• Configurar en CCOPS la información requerida para cada centro de Investigación. De acuerdo a las tareas que le sean asignadas, podrá:
• Colaborar con el CSM y CSS para asegurar que se obtengan todas las revisiones y autorizaciones internas adecuadas y requeridas para el proceso de pagos relacionado con los estudios.
• Asegurar el registro de información necesarios en sistemas Roche para generar la propuesta de pagos correspondientes.
• Hacer recomendaciones a los equipos locales del estudio en relación con las soluciones nuevas e innovadoras para los procesos de pagos, pronósticos y recursos que podrían incrementar la precisión, eficiencia y productividad del proceso.
• Brindar apoyo a los equipos locales del estudio en relación con las mejores
• prácticas, acompañando a los CSM en las actividades de pronósticos y el manejo de los gastos relacionados con los proyectos.
• Gestionar soporte al proceso de pagos de los departamentos locales de
• Investigación Clínica en Latam USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica, para asegurar un proceso ágil y eficiente de pago.
• Apoyar en el entrenamiento activo a los miembros del departamento de
• Investigación Clínica sobre uso de herramientas de reporte corporativas y locales desarrolladas por el área de Investigación.
• Asegurar la calidad de la información del sistema manteniendo control de los reportes de discrepancias.
• Mantener los sistemas CTMS/CCOPS actualizados de acuerdo a las fechas calendario clave pre-establecidas para toma de decisiones de los equipos de Investigación clínica de Latam USA, UK, Canadá, Bélgica. PERFIL DEL PUESTO – REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS Y PROFESIONALES
• Carrera técnica/Universitaria. (Administración, Finanzas, Contabilidad, o carrera a fin.)
• De 2 a 5 años de experiencia en Accounts Payable.
• Inglés Intermedio-Avanzado (B2) Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe ar

title: フィールドサービスエンジニア

titleByLocale.en: フィールドサービスエンジニア
titleByLocale.de: フィールドサービスエンジニア
titleByLocale.fr: フィールドサービスエンジニア

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position
• 職務内容
• フィールドサービスエンジニアとして、下記の業務を行います。
• ・当社検査機器(免疫・生化学・遺伝子・病理検査関連の医療機器)の据付、保守点検業務、トラブル対応
• ・ユーザーに対する検査機器の操作方法の説明
• ・保守点検スケジューリングや作業報告書の作成
• ・保守契約の締結、請求 応募条件
• （必須）
• ・機器メンテナンスやフィールドサービスに関する知識・経験（業界不問）
• ・普通自動車運転免許資格および運転経験
• ・全国転勤可
• （歓迎）
• ・対顧客コミュニケーションスキルのある方
• ・関係各所へのコミュニケーション・調整を取ってきた方
• ・医療機器または診断薬業界における検体検査機器の取扱い経験
• ・ネットワーク関連の知識
• ・病院でのMEとしての経験 ＜必要資格＞ 必要条件：普通自動車免許第一種 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche Diagnostics K.K. is a member of Roche group, one of the world's leading healthcare groups in the fields of pharmaceuticals and diagnostics, in charge of in-vitro diagnostic and equipment business in Japan. Roche Diagnostics K.K is also the leading company in our business field in Japan, providing high quality products and latest information as one of the most important sites in Diagnostic division of Roche group. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Descrizione del lavoro Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità Roche Diagnostics sta cercando un Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing) basato preferibilmente nel Western Cape con esperienza commerciale nel settore diagnostico / medico. Il ruolo coinvolgerà lo sviluppo di strategie di conto e portafoglio, l'identificazione e la sicurezza delle opportunità di vendita, la costruzione di relazioni con i decisori esecutivi chiave nei clienti per aumentare la quota di mercato Roche. Mentre l'attenzione è sul Capo occidentale, il ruolo coinvolgerà i viaggi in altre province. Le sfide chiave Stakeholder Engagement and Management - Per costruire relazioni con i clienti partecipando a Roche e eventi del settore, identificare e coinvolgere i decisori esecutivi, comprendere le tendenze del mercato e fornire feedback e input come richiesto - Per creare e mantenere la mappatura dell'account cliente identificando gli stakeholder, preparando un profilo sui decisori formali e informali e creando un organogramma del conto come richiesto - Per identificare le tendenze dei dati di vendita a livello di portafoglio estraendo i dati di vendita, intraprendendo l'analisi, identificando le tendenze e le variazioni e coinvolgendo queste informazioni e fornendo motivi mensili - Capire le esigenze del cliente e vuole - Mantenere relazioni interne efficaci coinvolgendo persone e dipartimenti pertinenti, influenzando l'allineamento e la mobilitazione verso le strategie di account e portafoglio chiave, fornendo informazioni e feedback e affrontando eventuali quesiti come richiesto - Mantenere le conoscenze relative ai prodotti, all'industria e al settore, coinvolgendo i giocatori di mercato, inclusi ma non limitati ai concorrenti e ai clienti, analizzando le informazioni e le attività, identificando i problemi e le tendenze e fornendo un feedback alle persone o ai dipartimenti pertinenti, come richiesto Gestione account - Per implementare la strategia di account e portfolio comprendendo i requisiti dei clienti, collaborando con il marketing, implementando strategie nei segmenti di mercato e garantendo nuovi clienti e/o espandendo l'impronta nei clienti esistenti, come richiesto - Per identificare le opportunità di vendita impegnandosi con i clienti a comprendere nuovi prodotti o opportunità, analizzando l'opportunità, sviluppando proposte e presentando ai clienti mensilmente e come richiesto - Per implementare campagne coinvolgendo Product Managers, coinvolgendo i clienti e facendo eventi campagna come richiesto - Per rispondere alle domande relative alle vendite comprendendo il problema, sourcing il feedback appropriato e fornire feedback ai clienti come richiesto - Per segnalare le prestazioni di vendita comprendendo i KPI, analizzando quotidianamente i dati di vendita, identificando tendenze e modelli, fornendo feedback sulle prestazioni, monitoraggio e raggiungimento della redditività e redazione report mensili e come richiesto - Per raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita gestendo le opportunità di vendita, caricando sul sistema CRM, impegnandosi con i clienti, preparando e presentando proposte, assicurando offerte, monitorando la soddisfazione del cliente nell'implementazione, identificando i rischi e implementando azioni correttive ogni giorno - Per amministrare il processo di vendita caricando tutte le informazioni di vendita nel sistema CRM, aggiornando le informazioni, tracciando il progresso delle tubazioni, identificando le aree di rischio e opportunità e implementando un'azione appropriata

• To identify sales data trends at portfolio level by extracting the sales data, undertaking the analysis, identifying trends and variances and engaging with this information and providing reasons monthly
• Understanding the customer needs and wants
• To maintain effective internal relationships by engaging with relevant individuals and departments, influencing alignment and mobilisation towards key account and portfolio strategies, providing information and feedback and addressing any queries as required
• To maintain relevant product, industry and sector knowledge by engaging with the market players including but not limited to competitors and customers, analysing information and activities, identifying issues and trends and providing feedback to the relevant individuals or departments as required Account Management
• To implement the account and portfolio strategy by understanding customer requirements, collaborating with marketing, implementing strategies in market segments and securing new clients and/or expanding footprint in existing clients as required
• To identify sales opportunities by engaging with customers to understand new product or opportunities, analysing the opportunity, developing proposals and presenting to customers monthly and as required
• To implement campaigns by engaging with Product Managers, engaging with customers and running campaign events as required
• To respond to sales related queries by understanding the issue, sourcing the appropriate feedback and providing feedback to clients as required
• To report on sales performance by understanding KPIs, analyzing sales data daily, identifying trends and patterns, providing feedback on performance, monitoring and achieving profitability and drafting reports monthly and as required
• To achieve sales targets by managing sales opportunities, loading onto the CRM system, engaging with customers, preparing and presenting proposals, securing deals, monitoring customer satisfaction in implementation, identifying risks and implementing corrective action daily
• To administer the sales process by loading all sales information into the CRM system, updating information, tracking pipeline progress, identifying areas of risk and opportunity and implementing appropriate ac
descriptionByLocale.de: Roche - Job Beschreibung Beschreibung Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Chance Roche Diagnostics sucht einen Key Account Manager (Histology & Sequencing), der vorzugsweise im Westkap mit kommerziellen Erfahrungen in der Diagnostischen / Medizinischen Industrie basiert. Die Rolle wird die Entwicklung von Konto- und Portfoliostrategien, die Identifizierung und Sicherung von Vertriebsmöglichkeiten, die Zusammenarbeit mit den wichtigsten Entscheidungsträgern der Geschäftsleitung bei Kunden zur Steigerung des Marktanteils von Roche beinhalten. Während der Schwerpunkt auf dem Westkap liegt, wird die Rolle Reise in andere Provinzen beinhalten. Die wichtigsten Herausforderungen Stakeholder Engagement und Management - Um Kundenbeziehungen durch die Teilnahme an Roche- und Branchenveranstaltungen aufzubauen, Entscheidungsträger zu identifizieren und zu engagieren, Markttrends zu verstehen und nach Bedarf Feedback und Input zu liefern - Erstellung und Aufrechterhaltung des Kundenkontos durch Identifizierung von Interessenvertretern, Erstellung eines Profils auf den formellen und informellen Entscheidungsträgern und Erstellung eines Organogramms des Kontos nach Bedarf - Ermittlung der Verkaufsdatentrends auf Portfolioebene durch Extraktion der Verkaufsdaten, Analyse, Identifizierung von Trends und Abweichungen und Einbeziehung dieser Informationen und Bereitstellung von Gründen monatlich - Verständnis der Kundenbedürfnisse und Wünsche - effektive interne Beziehungen zu pflegen, indem sie relevante Individuen und Abteilungen einbeziehen, die Ausrichtung und Mobilisierung auf Key-Account- und Portfoliostrategien beeinflussen, Informationen und Feedback bereitstellen und alle erforderlichen Abfragen ansprechen - Um relevante Produkt-, Branchen- und Branchenkenntnisse zu erhalten, indem sie mit den Marktteilnehmern zusammenarbeiten, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Wettbewerber und Kunden, die Analyse von Informationen und Aktivitäten, die Identifizierung von Problemen und Trends und die Bereitstellung von Rückmeldungen für die betreffenden Personen oder Abteilungen nach Bedarf Kontoverwaltung - Um die Konto- und Portfoliostrategie durch das Verständnis der Kundenanforderungen zu implementieren, mit Marketing zusammenzuarbeiten, Strategien in Marktsegmenten umzusetzen und neue Kunden zu sichern und/oder den Footprint in bestehenden Kunden nach Bedarf zu erweitern - Um Vertriebschancen zu identifizieren, indem sie sich mit den Kunden beschäftigen, um neue Produkte oder Möglichkeiten zu verstehen, die Möglichkeit zu analysieren, Vorschläge zu entwickeln und den Kunden monatlich und nach Bedarf zu präsentieren - Um Kampagnen zu implementieren, indem Sie sich mit Product Managers engagieren, mit Kunden und laufenden Kampagnen-Events wie erforderlich einbinden - Um auf verkaufsrelevante Fragen zu reagieren, indem Sie das Problem verstehen, das passende Feedback ausgeben und den Kunden nach Bedarf Feedback geben - Bericht über die Verkaufsleistung durch das Verständnis von KPIs, Analyse von Verkaufsdaten täglich, Identifizierung von Trends und Mustern, Feedback zu Leistung, Überwachung und Erzielung von Rentabilität und Erstellung von Berichten monatlich und nach Bedarf - Um Verkaufsziele durch die Verwaltung von Verkaufsmöglichkeiten zu erreichen, das Laden auf das CRM-System, das Mitnehmen mit Kunden, die Vorbereitung und Präsentation von Vorschlägen, die Sicherung von Angeboten, die Überwachung der Kundenzufriedenheit bei der Umsetzung, die Identifizierung von Risiken und die Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmen täglich - Verwalten des Verkaufsvorgangs durch Verladen aller Verkaufsinformationen in das CRM-System, Aktualisierung von Informationen, Verfolgung von Pipeline-Fortschritten, Identifizierung von Risiko- und Gelegenheitsbereichen und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - Description du travail Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Un avenir plus sain. C'est ce qui nous pousse à innover. Faire progresser continuellement la science et veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins dont il a besoin aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Créer un monde où nous avons tous plus de temps avec les gens que nous aimons. C'est ce qui fait de nous Roche. L'opportunité Roche Diagnostics est à la recherche d'un responsable de compte clé (Histologie et séquençage) basé de préférence dans l'ouest du Cap avec une expérience commerciale dans l'industrie diagnostique / médicale. Le rôle consistera à élaborer des stratégies de compte et de portefeuille, à identifier et à obtenir des débouchés commerciaux, à établir des relations avec les principaux décideurs de la clientèle afin d'accroître la part de marché de Roche. Bien que l'accent soit mis sur le cap ouest, le rôle consistera à se rendre dans d'autres provinces. Principaux défis Engagement et gestion des intervenants - Établir des relations avec la clientèle en participant aux événements de Roche et de l'industrie, en identifiant les décideurs et en les engageant avec eux, en comprenant les tendances du marché et en fournissant des commentaires et des commentaires au besoin - Créer et maintenir la cartographie des comptes clients en identifiant les parties prenantes, en établissant un profil des décideurs officiels et informels et en créant un organigramme du compte au besoin - Déterminer les tendances des ventes au niveau du portefeuille en extrayant les données sur les ventes, en procédant à l'analyse, en identifiant les tendances et les écarts et en s'engageant avec ces informations et en fournissant des raisons mensuelles - Comprendre les besoins et les désirs du client - Maintenir des relations internes efficaces en s'engageant avec les personnes et les départements concernés, en influençant l'alignement et la mobilisation vers les principales stratégies de comptabilité et de portefeuille, en fournissant des informations et des commentaires et en répondant aux demandes de renseignements, au besoin - Maintenir les connaissances pertinentes en matière de produits, d'industries et de secteurs en s'engageant avec les acteurs du marché, notamment les concurrents et les clients, en analysant l'information et les activités, en identifiant les problèmes et les tendances et en fournissant des commentaires aux personnes ou aux ministères concernés au besoin Gestion des comptes - Mettre en œuvre la stratégie de compte et de portefeuille en comprenant les besoins des clients, en collaborant avec le marketing, en mettant en œuvre des stratégies dans les segments de marché et en obtenant de nouveaux clients et/ou en élargissant l'empreinte des clients existants au besoin - Identifier les opportunités de vente en s'engageant avec les clients pour comprendre les nouveaux produits ou opportunités, en analysant les opportunités, en développant des propositions et en présentant aux clients chaque mois et selon les besoins - Mettre en œuvre des campagnes en s'engageant avec les responsables de produits, en s'engageant avec les clients et en organisant des manifestations de campagne au besoin - Répondre aux questions relatives aux ventes en comprenant le problème, en obtenant les commentaires appropriés et en fournissant les commentaires aux clients au besoin - Faire rapport sur les résultats des ventes en comprenant les KPI, en analysant les données sur les ventes chaque jour, en identifiant les tendances et les tendances, en fournissant une rétroaction sur les résultats, en surveillant et en réalisant la rentabilité et en rédigeant des rapports mensuels et au besoin - Pour atteindre les objectifs de vente en gérant les opportunités de vente, en chargeant sur le système CRM, en engageant les clients, en préparant et en présentant des propositions, en obtenant des offres, en surveillant la satisfaction des clients dans la mise en œuvre, en identifiant les risques et en mettant en œuvre des mesures correctives quotidiennement - Administrer le processus de vente en chargeant toutes les informations sur les ventes dans le système CRM, en mettant à jour les informations, en suivant les progrès des pipelines, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités et en mettant en œuvre les mesures appropriées

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Position: The AI Full Stack Engineer is a pivotal role within the Service Intelligence team, responsible for designing and deploying the software solutions that turns Roche Support Network (RSN) operational data into actionable tools. This individual will bridge the gap between complex AI models and the daily operations of field and depot service teams, ensuring that intelligence is not just generated, but accessible and intuitive for the enterprise. Your mission is to design, craft, deploy, and sustain software solutions that are tailored to business requirements and objectives using a combination of frontend, backend, full-stack, and mobile development expertise. You adhere to in-depth domain knowledge and promote a DevOps and Cloud-focused approach. You will also act as a technical lead for projects and lead employees and processes in programming activities. You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You are passionate about the application of software engineering practices and their advanced application to data science to drive insights and value within a business-centric environment. The Opportunity:
• Drives End-to-End Service AI Applications : Oversees the full lifecycle of applications that support service performance, from initial design to the deployment of tools used by the RSN organization.
• Integrate Service Ecosystems : Design and deploy production-grade APIs and interfaces that connect AI insights with core service systems like Salesforce® FSM and SAP®.
• Engineers for the Full Stack : Designs, crafts, and deploys production-grade AI solutions using Python (Flask/FastAPI), SQL, and modern front-end frameworks (like React or Vue.js with JavaScript). This includes building backend APIs, managing data pipelines as needed, and creating interactive user interfaces.
• Implements and Manages MLOps Infrastructure : Establishes and maintains the CI/CD/CT (Continuous Integration/Delivery/Training) pipelines necessary for automating the deployment, monitoring, and retraining of machine learning models in a cloud environment.
• Champions Service Intelligence Architecture : Ensures all solutions are built with scalability, reliability, and security in mind. Promotes best practices in version control (Git), containerization (Docker and Kubernetes), and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
• Agile Prototyping for Service Excellence : Use agile methodologies to rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions based on feedback from service stakeholders and field leadership.
• Regulatory Alignment : Ensure all developed code and documentation adhere to the Roche Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards such as ISO 13485
• Leads with Change Agility : Acts as a catalyst for transitioning the team from a project-based support function to a product-driven AI platform team, driving the adoption of new technologies from IT, and methodologies in a positive manner. Who You Are:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or other related field or equivalent work experience
• 7 years experience with previous business application system implementations / ERP system configuration or AI or data science

The Position: The AI Full Stack Engineer is a pivotal role within the Service Intelligence team, responsible for designing and deploying the software solutions that turns Roche Support Network (RSN) operational data into actionable tools. This individual will bridge the gap between complex AI models and the daily operations of field and depot service teams, ensuring that intelligence is not just generated, but accessible and intuitive for the enterprise. Your mission is to design, craft, deploy, and sustain software solutions that are tailored to business requirements and objectives using a combination of frontend, backend, full-stack, and mobile development expertise. You adhere to in-depth domain knowledge and promote a DevOps and Cloud-focused approach. You will also act as a technical lead for projects and lead employees and processes in programming activities. You have an overall understanding of the key challenges in our industry. You are passionate about the application of software engineering practices and their advanced application to data science to drive insights and value within a business-centric environment. The Opportunity:
• Drives End-to-End Service AI Applications : Oversees the full lifecycle of applications that support service performance, from initial design to the deployment of tools used by the RSN organization.
• Integrate Service Ecosystems : Design and deploy production-grade APIs and interfaces that connect AI insights with core service systems like Salesforce® FSM and SAP®.
• Engineers for the Full Stack : Designs, crafts, and deploys production-grade AI solutions using Python (Flask/FastAPI), SQL, and modern front-end frameworks (like React or Vue.js with JavaScript). This includes building backend APIs, managing data pipelines as needed, and creating interactive user interfaces.
• Implements and Manages MLOps Infrastructure : Establishes and maintains the CI/CD/CT (Continuous Integration/Delivery/Training) pipelines necessary for automating the deployment, monitoring, and retraining of machine learning models in a cloud environment.
• Champions Service Intelligence Architecture : Ensures all solutions are built with scalability, reliability, and security in mind. Promotes best practices in version control (Git), containerization (Docker and Kubernetes), and cloud services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
• Agile Prototyping for Service Excellence : Use agile methodologies to rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions based on feedback from service stakeholders and field leadership.
• Regulatory Alignment : Ensure all developed code and documentation adhere to the Roche Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards such as ISO 13485
• Leads with Change Agility : Acts as a catalyst for transitioning the team from a project-based support function to a product-driven AI platform team, driving the adoption of new technologies from IT, and methodologies in a positive manner. Who You Are:
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or other related field or equivalent work experience
• 7 years experience with previous business application system implementations / ERP system configuration or AI or data science

• Achievement of monthly/quarterly/yearly sales targets.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Was Dich erwartet: Als Systembetreuer Junior (m/w/d) sorgst Du eigenverantwortlich zusammen mit Deinen Teamkolleg:innen im Raum Ingolstadt/Nürnberg/Erlangen für den technischen und applikativen Kundenservice. Von der Installation über die Einarbeitung, Wartung, Modifikation und Störungsbeseitigung begleitest du unsere Systeme über den gesamten Lebenszyklus bei Deinen Kund:innen. Du kümmerst Dich um Analysensysteme, Reagenzien und deren IT-Anbindung und hast folgende Aufgaben:
• In Deinem Betreuungsgebiet bist Du erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für den Service unserer Kund:innen und pflegst einen engen Kontakt mit ihnen im Privatlabor oder Krankenhaus.
• Dein technisches Geschick stellst Du bei der Planung von Geräteinstallationen, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Beweis.
• Die Analyse und Behebung von komplexen, technischen Fehlern sowie die Durchführung von Test- und Routineläufen gehören zu Deinem Tagesgeschäft.
• Deine Kenntnisse im Projektmanagement baust Du im Rahmen von Automationsprojekten stetig aus.
• Du betreust Roche-Laborsysteme im Bereich der Präanalytik, klinischen Chemie, Immunologie und Gerinnung und berätst die Kund:innen nicht nur bei technischen, sondern auch bei applikativen Fragestellungen.
• Du begleitest die digitale Transformation und bringst Deine IT Kenntnisse im speziellen bei der Netzwerktechnik, bei Installations- sowie internen Projekten ein.
• Du arbeitest eng vernetzt mit unserem Verkauf und dem Innendienst und berätst gemeinsam unsere Kund:innen zu den Themen vorbeugende Wartung, Serviceverträge und Geräteablösungen/-neuanschaffung.
• Deine Leistungen bei den Kund:innen dokumentierst und fakturierst Du in unserem CRM-System.
• Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, bei Bedarf ca. 30% teamübergreifend und damit deutschlandweit die genannten Servicetätigkeiten zu übernehmen. Wer Du bist: Für die spannende Position als Systembetreuer Junior (m/w/d) bringst Du ein abgeschlossenes Studium im ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Technikerausbildung mit. In den Bereichen Elektronik, Mechanik, Mechatronik, Automatisierungstechnik, Hydraulik, IT & Netzwerktechnik, EDV-Schnittstellen sowie Messtechnik hast Du erste Erfahrung sammeln können. Außerdem begeisterst Du Dich nicht nur theoretisch für technische Fragestellungen, sondern zeigst auch praktisches Geschick. Wenn Du über erste Berufserfahrung im Service-Außendienst oder im Diagnostikumfeld verfügst, ist das von Vorteil. Die ausführlichen Trainings rund um unsere Systeme sowie unsere umfassende Einarbeitung machen Dich nach deinem Start bei Roche zum Experten (m/w/d) in unserem Umfeld. Diese weiteren Aspekte runden Dein Profil ab:
• IT Themen sind dir vertraut: Du hast Spaß daran Netzwerke, Server, Firewalls, Schnittstellen, etc. aufzusetzen und diese zu managen.
• Medizinische und applikative Aspekte unserer Diagnostik findest Du spannend.
• Du bist sehr gut selbstorganisiert, hast eine hohe Eigeninitiative und kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichsten Hierarchieebenen.
• Deutsch und Englisch sprichst Du fließend, auch im technischen Umfeld.
• Du besitzt einen Führerschein und freust Dich auf Dienstreisen mit Deinem von Roche zur Verfügung gestellten Dienstwagen, der auch privat genutzt werden darf.
• Deine Aktivitäten startest du aus dem Homeoffice heraus und bist bereit Not- und Bereitschaftsdienste auch an Wochenenden und Feiertagen zu übernehmen.
• Du wohnst vorzugsweise bereits in Deinem Betreuungsgebiet im Raum Ingolstadt/Nürnberg/Erlangen Bewer

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That is what makes us Roche. An exciting opportunity has arisen to take a Medical Enabler role within the Roche Diagnostics Philippines team. The Medical Enabler is a key strategic role that will help identify and address the relevant medical needs of clinical practice, to successfully support the optimal use of Roche diagnostic solutions. In this role, you will provide technical and clinical expertise and advisory to internal and external customers for all Roche Diagnostics products. This role also develops and executes medical initiatives to support medical strategy/medical plan that will drive the growth of the priority products of the affiliate, develops and cultivates strategic relationships with disease area experts and other external influencers and stakeholders, leads KOL development and engagements in a scientific manner, provides medical support on clinical research, data generation and demonstration projects that will drive strategic growth for the affiliate and participates in health authority interactions. Key responsibilities include Development and management of the medical plan
• Align with Commercial Teams: Marketing, Sales and Near Patient Care teams on focused disease areas and products
• Develop local patient journey map and identify diagnostic gaps to position Roche diagnostic solutions
• Align the local medical plan with global medical plan, under the supervision of Head of Access and Medical Affairs Medical expertise and customer insights
• Inspire high levels of medical expertise and a scientific mindset across the affiliate and instil an enabling mindset throughout the affiliate
• Establish and maintain local medical and scientific independence and assurance of medical compliance, ensuring business integrity and company reputation
• Offer expert opinion on scientific medical information to identify and develop effective peer-to-peer relationships to execute our product strategies, while holding high ethical standards, compliance to Roche SOP and local/ international regulations.
• Research, collate, present, and offer data insights related to the dedicated disease area and product(s)
• Manage the integrity and accuracy of scientific and medical data communication both internally and externally for promotional and non-promotional purposes
• Manage Medical Information activities in accordance with regional/ local model, referencing global standard responses
• Develop a customer centricity culture, making sure promotional/ medical/ scientific communications address HCP needs and optimize patient benefit and safety while keeping a fair balance and compliance with regulations and SOPs
• Provide early insights on new products and indications in close collaboration with the Commercial Team KOL development, engagement plan and execution
• Identify and develop scientific relationship with external KOLs/experts who are qualified sources of insight and advice
• Develop and maintain regular contacts with top tier KOLs
• Develop KOL deck on priority and focused disease area
• Ensure that all activities towards external experts/ KOLs are harmonized across the affiliate
• Planning and execution of relevant scientific advisory board and expert meetings
• Conduct of KOL training, scien

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Position Summary As a Transformation and Solution Partner (TSP) , you will engage and partner primarily with People & Culture (P&C) colleagues across all Chapters and business stakeholders globally. Your mission is to govern M&A and transformation data management frameworks with right solution expertise while driving global P&C solution improvements. You will serve as a centre of excellence for transformation ideation, navigating complex business transformations to ensure a seamless partner experience in collaboration with Transformation and Solution Advisor (TSA). You help translate business goals into P&C priorities, leveraging holistic data and historical learning to iterate and improve the overall global transformation flow. Your opportunity as Transformation & Solution Partner
• M&A / Transformation Framework Governance: Lead the governance of transformation frameworks to ensure consistency and excellence across global initiatives.
• Transformation Solution & Framework Expertise: Provide expert guidance and implementation support for digital transformation tools. Serve as a Centre of Excellence for transformation improvement ideations, capturing historical learnings to further iterate and enhance existing transformation experience.
• Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with Business Partners and business leaders of globally-scaled transformations to provide framework consultancy, from preliminary until embedment stages.
• Cross P&C Solution Improvement: Drive improvements for the overall global transformation flow, identifying gaps and implementing proactive solutions across the P&C network.Collaborates on complex P&C challenges and demands, connecting with the right P&C chapters to develop an end-to-end solution, determine ownership and drive effective change management.
• Continue Improvement : Proactively identifies customer needs or P&C solutions’ gaps, and translates these needs to change requests and builds cross-functional squads to implement continuous improvements within our P&C network.
• Collaboration & Innovation: Share best practices for emerging technologies, such as AI-driven org design and job design to build Transformation and solution advisory team knowledge and capability. Who you are You bring the following skills and competencies:
• Passion for Change: Deep interest in project management, process improvement, and change management.
• Digital Proficiency: Strong expertise in digital solutions like Airtable and Workday, with the ability to lead the transition from manual spreadsheets to integrated technology platforms.
• Exceptional Stakeholder Management: Ability to represent the P&C/PSS vision and articulate the strategy and “the why” behind complex transformations.
• Agility: Ability to work independently and deliver results in a matrixed, fast-paced environment while balancing competing priorities.
• Influencing Skills: Exceptional communication, consulting, and negotiation skills, with the ability to coach colleagues and lead without direct authority. Further requirements
• Education: University degree or equivalent, HR preferred.
• Experience: Extensive experience (typically 7–8 years) with HR processes, HR shared services, or HR functional expertise, ideally in a global environment.
• Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in managing large-scale global transformations and M&A activities.
• Languages: Fluent in English required; additional languages are a plus.
• Certification: Project management a

descriptionByLocale.it: Roche - Rappresentante dell'Utente Posizione a Basilea Descrizione A Roche puoi presentarti come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La Posizione A Basilea, 650 dipendenti lavorano nell'area Drug Substance Manufacturing, producendo API Large e Small Molecule (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients) per uso commerciale e clinico. La Possibilità - Come rappresentante in progetti tecnici, è responsabile per le strutture di produzione dalla pianificazione alla messa in servizio. - No. Pianifica e coordina le attività di ricerca officina come revisioni, modifiche e risoluzione dei problemi. - No. Ottimizzare, innovare e armonizzare le soluzioni tecniche all'interno dell'unità di produzione. - No. Lavorate sulle analisi dei rischi tecnici e sulla pianificazione e l'attuazione delle attività di validazione. - No. Sei responsabile dell'analisi dei costi e dell'applicazione delle risorse finanziarie per i progetti. - No. Fornite formazione specifica per piani e processi per i dipendenti e create SOP di revisione per le strutture. - No. Collabora con altri dipartimenti e fornitori esterni. Chi sei... Hai una laurea o sei un esperto di produzione con formazione professionale completa, idealmente nella produzione farmaceutica o in un campo correlato. - No. Hai una buona comprensione di GMP e un'alta consapevolezza della qualità e della sicurezza. - No. Hai esperienza con impianti altamente automatizzati su scala industriale e un forte interesse per gli aspetti tecnici della produzione. - No. Si mostra alta motivazione, flessibilità e lavoro indipendente in un ambiente complesso. - No. Hai ottime competenze in lingua tedesca e inglese per parlare e scrivere. Contatto pronto per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applicare ora per scoprire questa eccitante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, la garanzia ha accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Roche - User Representative Position in Basel Descrizione Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassés pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à garantir que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La Posizione À Bâle, 650 employés travaillent dans la région de la Fabrication de substances médicamenteuses, produisant de grandes API moléculaires (ingrédients pharmaceutiques actifs) à des fins commerciales et cliniques. La Possibilità - En tant que représentant dans les projets techniques, vous êtes responsable des installations de production de la planification à la mise en service. - Oui. Vous planifiez et coordonnez les activités de recherche d'atelier comme révisions, modifications et dépannage. - Oui. Vous optimisez, innovez et harmonisez les solutions techniques au sein de l'unité de fabrication. - Oui. Vous travaillez sur des analyses techniques des risques, la planification et la mise en œuvre d'activités de validation. - Oui. Vous êtes responsable de l'analyse coûts-avantages et de l'application des ressources financières pour les projets. - Oui. Vous offrez une formation sur la planification et les processus particuliers aux employés et créez et examinez les PNE pour les installations. - Oui. Vous collaborez de façon constructive avec d'autres ministères et fournisseurs externes. Le Président Vous avez un diplôme universitaire ou êtes un expert de la production expérimenté avec une formation professionnelle terminée, idéalement dans la production technologique pharmaceutique ou un domaine connexe. - Oui. Vous avez une très bonne compréhension des BPF et une grande sensibilisation à la qualité et à la sécurité. - Oui. Vous avez de l'expérience avec des installations hautement automatisées à l'échelle industrielle et un vif intérêt pour les aspects techniques de la production. - Oui. Vous montrez une motivation élevée, une flexibilité et un travail indépendant dans un environnement complexe. - Oui. Vous avez de très bonnes compétences en langue allemande et anglaise dans la parole et l'écriture. Contatto Prêt pour la prochaine étape ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant pour découvrir cette opportunité passionnante! Chi siamo Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 personnes à travers le monde sont dédiées au progrès de la science, la garantie a accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et à plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitieux au sommet, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial. Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain. Roche è un datore di lavoro che offre uguali opportunità.

For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management. The Pharma Technical Operations Supply Chain (PTS) is a complex, global network that requires seamless coordination and a highly motivated workforce to deliver medicines to patients worldwide. The PTS Chief of Staff office plays a crucial role in ensuring smooth business operations, driving strategic leadership initiatives, and fostering a highly engaged and informed workforce across this global network. Effective communication and strong employee engagement are critical to aligning our global teams with Roche’s strategic vision and ensuring everyone understands how their work contributes to the bigger picture. The Opportunity You will directly support the Chief of Staff of PTS, helping to execute internal communication strategies, manage global employee engagement initiatives, and optimize day-to-day business operations for the leadership team.
• Internal Communications: Assist in drafting, editing, and publishing newsletters, intranet articles, leadership messages, and organizational announcements to keep the PTS global community informed and aligned.
• Engagement & Event Management: Support the planning, coordination, and execution of internal events such as global town halls, leadership offsites, team-building activities, and employee recognition programs.
• Business Operations Support: Assist the Chief of Staff with preparing executive presentations, managing meeting agendas, and tracking the progress of key strategic deliverables for the PTS leadership team.
• Content Creation & Design: Develop engaging multimedia content (presentations, graphics, short videos) to help translate complex supply chain and strategic topics into accessible, inspiring messaging for the broader organization. Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'opération technique Pharma (PT) comprend une gamme d'activités, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement aux affaires réglementaires aux finances aux gens et à la culture. Cliquez ici pour connaître la gamme des ministères concernés, ainsi que les projets antérieurs. Ce stage se déroulera dans l'espace de la PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Le stage comprendra une formation sur les concepts de base du travail effectué dans les différents départements. Les stagiaires pourront également profiter des ressources de Roche sur des sujets comme l'entrevue, la présentation, la gestion du temps, etc. Pour ce stage, nous examinons un champ plus spécifique et ciblé de la gestion de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Le domaine d'intérêt du PHM au sein des Opérations techniques Pharma (PT) vise à conduire les capacités E2E nécessaires pour avoir une atténuation robuste, opportune et conforme des risques tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Ce rôle vise à s'assurer que les produits et les chaînes d'approvisionnement sont conçus pour offrir un avantage concurrentiel et gérer de façon proactive la santé des produits, du lancement initial à la fin du cycle de vie. Vous contribuerez à l'élaboration des lignes directrices qui permettent aux équipes de produits de mesurer la santé, de fixer des objectifs et de les documenter dans les outils existants afin que nous puissions générer des renseignements stratégiques sur le portefeuille. L'opportunité
• L'évolution du cadre : adapter les orientations globales pour mesurer la santé des produits (PH), y compris la redéfinition des paramètres et la fixation des objectifs correspondants pour suivre la manière dont les produits répondent aux besoins du marché.
• Mise en œuvre numérique : soutenir la collecte de métriques et d'actions PH sur Monday.com en tant que plate-forme centrale de surveillance et soutenir la création de tableaux de bord qui visualisent PH et leur lien avec les prévisions de marque.
• Formation : concevoir et exécuter un plan de formation pour les équipes de produits afin de pouvoir exécuter leur deuxième itération d'évaluation PH suite à l'orientation et à la documentation adaptées sur lundi.com.
• Exécution : procéder à la prochaine évaluation de la PH et consolider les résultats de la prochaine Revue de santé du portefeuille.
• Visibilité stratégique : une exposition profonde à la stratégie des produits, à la gestion de portefeuilles et à la génération de « solutions gagnantes » entre produits pharmaceutiques.
• Renforcement des compétences techniques : développer des compétences à forte demande dans la mise en œuvre des outils numériques (Monday.com) et la définition d'un guide qui évalue les performances de gestion des produits.
• Impact durable : Mettre en place le mécanisme de surveillance qui permet de prendre des décisions fondées sur les données pour l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits de l'organisation. Qui vous êtes Vous étudiez actuellement pour un baccalauréat ou un master avec un intérêt pour les opérations techniques de soins de santé. En outre, vous avez
• Un fort intérêt technique pour les processus commerciaux, les tableaux de bord numériques et la stratégie des produits.
• Compétence dans les applications Microsoft/Google. L'expérience avec la visualisation des données et la narration est un plus.
• Compétence en anglais.
• Un esprit créatif et des défis d'approche avec une attitude constructive. En outre, vous êtes un apprenant proactif et résoudre les problèmes. Informations complémentaires

• Charge de travail: 100%
• Durée: minimum 3 mois, jusqu'à 6 mois

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Pharma Technical Operations (PT) involves a range of activities, from Supply Chain to Regulatory Affairs to Finance to People & Culture. Click here to find out the range of departments involved, as well as previous projects worked on. This internship will be in the space of the PTS Pharma Supply Chain and Product Strategy. Included in the internship will be training on the basic concepts of the work done in the respective departments. The interns will also be able to take advantage of Roche resources on subjects such as interviewing, making presentations, time management, and more. For this internship, we are looking into a more specific and focused scope of supply chain management. We are seeking a motivated intern to join the Pharma International Supply Chain (PTSR) organization. This role focuses on supporting the Affiliate Demand Review Process as a critical component of our Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) initiative. The opportunity You will help bridge the gap between local market needs and global supply chain orchestration, ensuring that the "voice of the affiliate" is heard and acted upon. Furthermore, you will
• Support the creation and maintenance of standardized process maps and training materials for the Affiliate Demand Review.
• Develop automated methods (potentially exploring AI applications) to consolidate demand insights, Risks, and Opportunities (R&Os) from various global affiliates.
• Ensure consolidated insights are effectively shared back with affiliates to close the communication loop.
• Help identify and prepare critical R&Os for escalation to the Global Demand Review Meeting (gDRM). Who you are You are currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree. In addition, you have
• Technical Savvy: Strong proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications (Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint). Experience with ERP systems or an interest in AI/Automation is a plus.
• Business Acumen: A high interest in demand planning, finance and healthcare strategy.
• Proactive mindset: We are looking for team players who think outside the box, share their ideas, and are eager to find new solutions to complex challenges. Additional information

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche potete mostrare voi stessi, allenamenti per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuine, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendo a voi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è come intendiamo portare, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unitevi a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione I medicinali contraffatti e i prodotti diagnostici rappresentano un rischio significativo per la sicurezza dei pazienti. I prodotti contraffatti possono essere trovati in paese qualsiasi e spesso assomigliano alle versioni autentiche, rendendoli difficili da rilevare, soprattutto per i pazienti. I pazienti credono di fissare il trattamento giusto, ma in realtà sono a rischio. I contraffatti possono troppo o troppo poco degli ingredienti attivi, o nessuno, ostacolindo ai pazienti di ricevere il trattamentossunto. Inoltre, i contraffatti sono realizzati con sostanze tossiche o preparazioni inefficaci che possono causare gravi malattie o addirittura la morte. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Counterfeit medicines and diagnostic products pose a significant risk to the safety of patients. Counterfeit products can be found in any country and often look identical to authentic versions, making them difficult to detect, particularly for patients. Patients believe they are taking the right treatment, but they are actually at risk. The counterfeits may contain too much or too little of the active ingredients, or none at all, preventing patients from receiving the proper treatment. Even worse, counterfeits are made with toxic substances or ineffective preparations that can cause serious illness or even death. Counterfeiting is an illegal activity that has serious consequences for public health and patient safety. That’s why Roche is fully committed to working with health authorities and law enforcement agencies worldwide to aid their investigations into the source of counterfeits and prevent their distribution. We employ several anti-counterfeit strategies to combat this global threat to public health and help ensure the integrity of our products, and we are committed to giving healthcare professionals and patients the information they need to safely access them. The opportunity You will support the GRACC team in executing vital anti-counterfeiting strategies, ensuring the integrity of our global supply chain, and helping to protect patients from the dangers of counterfeit medicines. Furthermore, you will
• Assist in the ongoing development and monitoring of Roche's anti-counterfeit strategies and supply chain security initiatives.
• Support the creation of educational materials and communications aimed at healthcare professionals and patients to help them recognize authentic products and avoid counterfeits.
• Help coordinate efforts between internal teams, health authorities, and law enforcement agencies to aid in tracking and investigating counterfeit sources.
• Assist in tracking global counterfeiting trends and data to help the team identify potential vulnerabilities in the market. • Strong proficiency in Microsoft/Google applications (Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint). Experience with data tracking or risk analysis tools is a plus.
• A strong interest in patient safety, global supply chain security, regulatory affairs, and public health policy.
• A team player mindset who thinks outside the box, shares their ideas, and has a strong ethical commitment to safeguarding patient health and well-being.
• Proficiency in English. Additional information
