Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position e pilier des communications scientifiques et de l'engagement au sein de notre organisation mondiale de la sécurité des patients et des affaires médicales (PSMA) construit les moteurs numériques à grande échelle qui protègent les patients et accélèrent la science. Cette organisation fournit les plateformes mondiales essentielles aux affaires médicales modernes et axées sur les données, y compris les flux de travail de communication scientifique d'entreprise, la gestion mondiale de l'information médicale et l'architecture de contenu compatible avec l'IA dans des dizaines de filiales mondiales. Nous sommes à la recherche d'une élite, la première technologie chef de produit (chef de produit principal) . Il s'agit d'un poste de direction de haut niveau et de haute visibilité. Il ne s'agit pas d'une fonction de gestion administrative des relations d'affaires. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un dirigeant de technologie visionnaire et dirigeant organisationnel qui peut commander une salle de cadres médicaux supérieurs, gérer des équipes d'ingénierie polyvalentes à grande échelle, démanteler l'ancien silos d'application et architecte un écosystème de produits moderne et évolutive. Vous posséderez le cycle de vie technologique de bout en bout et l'écosystème des personnes pour ce portefeuille vital. Votre défi principal est de conduire la transformation organisationnelle : transformer des exigences commerciales complexes et globales en spécifications techniques robustes, tout en renforçant le talent d'ingénieur, en dirigeant les fournisseurs mondiaux et en gérant le changement culturel nécessaire pour exécuter une stratégie moderne de contenu et de données. Principales responsabilités et objectifs stratégiques
• Leadership d'entreprise et partenariat d'affaires: agir en tant que partenaire technologique équivalent et faisant autorité auprès des cadres supérieurs des affaires médicales. Fournir le leadership numérique nécessaire pour repousser les frontières opérationnelles, automatiser les flux de travail complexes et consolider agressivement les systèmes existants fragmentés.
• In-House Engineering Talent Transformation: Héritage, mentor et développe activement une équipe mondiale de leaders de produits, d'ingénieurs logiciels et d'experts de domaine. Exécuter une stratégie conçue pour accroître les compétences internes et les capacités stratégiques de développement et de configuration de logiciels de base
• Gouvernance mondiale des fournisseurs et des services gérés : maintenir une responsabilité opérationnelle et financière stricte pour les budgets de plusieurs millions de dollars. Surveiller, évaluer et tenir responsables fournisseurs de services et fournisseurs de logiciels gérés à l'échelle mondiale, en assurant l'alignement absolu sur nos principes internes d'ingénierie des logiciels.
• Stratégie technique et consolidation du paysage : façonner la feuille de route technique à moyen et long terme du portefeuille. Dirigez vos équipes à migrer activement le paysage hérité loin des infrastructures fragmentées et vieillissantes vers un écosystème de produits unique, moderne et hautement intégré.
• Architecting the Content "Golden Source": Diriger la stratégie technique et la mise en œuvre globale de notre plan de contenu d'entreprise, ancrer notre architecture de données dans des cadres cloud modernes pour éliminer la duplication opérationnelle et assurer une gestion transparente du cycle de vie des actifs.
• Convergence avancée de l'IA et des plateformes croisées: Diriger l'évaluation technique, l'échelle de production et l'alignement interfonctionnel pour les initiatives d'automatisation de prochaine génération. Il s'agit notamment de diriger les équipes vers le déploiement de narrations compatibles avec l'IA et d'outils de génération de contenu intelligents à l'échelle mondiale, tout en fusionnant des plateformes de lecture en phase initiale sur une pile de texte et de données unifiée et performante.

title: Global Medical Affairs Lead Genomic Profiling

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Global Medical Affairs Genomic Profiling
titleByLocale.en: Global Medical Affairs Lead Genomic Profiling
titleByLocale.de: Global Medical Affairs leitendes genomisches Profiling
titleByLocale.fr: Global Medical Affairs Le principal profil génomique

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Unisciti a un team esperto e collaborativo di Global Medical Affairs Leaders in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) presso Roche Diagnostics. Lavorare con il team internazionale di business per la medicina della Fondazione ex-US per lo sviluppo e la commercializzazione di soluzioni complete di genomica e diagnostica molecolare in oncologia ed ematologia. Questa è un'opportunità impareggiabile per lo sviluppo della carriera e la soddisfazione del lavoro, come si aiutano gli avanzamenti nella salute personalizzata in tutto il mondo per migliorare le esperienze e i risultati dei pazienti. La posizione si trova a Basilea, in Svizzera. L'opportunità
• Competenze di materia nel campo della genomica del cancro, dell'oncologia e della diagnostica di ematologia per fornire un contributo strategico medico e scientifico e la leadership nello sviluppo di strategie mediche globali per la generazione di prove integrate, studi di ricerca, collaborazioni di ricerca e comunicazioni mediche, nonché nell'esecuzione di attività mediche tra cui consiglieri, simposi scientifici, formazione medica indipendente o sponsorizzata.
• Costruire partnership forti con comunità mediche e pazienti, tra cui leader di pensiero globale, ricercatori, reti accademiche e società professionali per guidare l'adozione sicura di soluzioni di profilazione genomica complete, garantendo al contempo l'eccellenza operativa e la conformità con le normative del settore e le linee guida di interazione HCP.
• Sviluppare e fornire contenuti per una comunicazione tempestiva ed efficace della scienza e dei dati clinici all'interno e all'esterno dell'organizzazione in programmi educativi, pubblicazioni e presentazioni congressuali.
• Partner tra funzioni, regioni, culture e fusi orari per creare un ambiente di appartenenza e identificare valore reciproco e opportunità di collaborazione.
• Paziente campione e customer-centricity in mentalità, comportamenti e azioni mettendo sempre le esigenze dei pazienti e dei clienti prima.
• Model Roche valori di integrità, coraggio e passione e We@Roche Diagnostics (cultura, mentalità e comportamenti) in tutto quello che fai.
• Atto in linea con gli standard legali, regolamentari e aziendali e i codici di pratica, tra cui il codice di condotta Roche e altre direttive e linee guida pertinenti.
• Assicurare la conformità alle linee guida di interazione HCP, gestire le domande e le considerazioni di conformità, completare tutte le attività di formazione e le responsabilità specifiche richieste oltre la portata standard del lavoro e supervisionare la documentazione e la reportistica appropriate.
• Lavorare autonomamente e autonomamente, fungere da allenatore per i colleghi con meno esperienza. Chi sei Sei qualcuno che vuole promuovere la salute a livello globale e influenzare il proprio sviluppo. Stai cercando una società in cui hai la possibilità di perseguire i tuoi interessi attraverso funzioni e geografie, dove un titolo di lavoro non è considerato la definizione finale di chi sei, ma il punto di partenza.
• Hai una vasta conoscenza e competenza nella genomica del cancro con un grado avanzato (MD e / o PhD) in discipline correlate, così come 5+ anni di esperienza del settore in oncologia e e ematologia questioni mediche o sviluppo che guida la progettazione e l'implementazione di studi clinici, comunicazione scientifica e gli sforzi educativi che aiutano il trattamento su misura per i singoli pazienti.
• Hai una profonda comprensione degli approcci terapeutici guidati dalle molecole e delle linee guida della pratica clinica, traducendo i dati genomici e del mondo reale in azioni clinicamente rilevanti negli ecosistemi sanitari complessi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Join an experienced and collaborative team of dedicated Global Medical Affairs Leads in Clinical Development and Medical Affairs (CDMA) at Roche Diagnostics. Work with the International Business team for Foundation Medicine ex-US on the development and commercialization of Comprehensive Genomic Profiling and molecular diagnostics solutions in oncology and hematology. This is an unparalleled opportunity for career development and job satisfaction as you help advancements in personalized healthcare around the globe to improve patient experiences and outcomes. The position is based in Basel, Switzerland. The Opportunity
• Subject matter expertise in cancer genomics, oncology and hematology diagnostics to provide strategic medical and scientific input and leadership developing global medical strategies for integrated evidence generation, investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations and medical communications, as well as executing medical activities including advisory boards, scientific symposia, independent or sponsored medical education or training events.
• Build strong partnerships with medical and patient communities including global thought leaders, investigators, academic networks and professional societies to drive safe adoption of comprehensive genomic profiling solutions while ensuring operational excellence and compliance with industry regulations and HCP interaction guidelines.
• Develop and deliver content for timely and effective communication of science and clinical data within and outside the organization in educational programs, publications and congress presentations.
• Partner across functions, regions, cultures, and time zones to create an environment of belonging and identify mutual value and opportunities for collaborations.
• Champion patient and customer-centricity in mindset, behaviors and actions by always putting the needs of the patients and customers first.
• Model Roche’s values of integrity, courage, and passion and We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mindset and behaviors) in everything you do.
• Act in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice including Roche Code of Conduct and other relevant directives and guidelines.
• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines, handle compliance questions and considerations, complete all required training and specific responsibilities beyond the standard scope of work and oversee appropriate documentation and reporting.
• Work independently and autonomously, act as coach for colleagues with less experience. Who you are You’re someone who wants to advance healthcare globally and influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions and geographies, where a job title is not considered the final definition of who you are, but the starting point.
• You have extensive knowledge and expertise in cancer genomics with an advanced degree (MD and/or PhD) in related disciplines, as well as 5+ years of industry experience in oncology and hematology medical affairs or development leading the design and implementation of clinical studies, scientific communication and educational efforts that help tailor treatment to individual patients.
• You have a deep understanding of molecular-guided therapeutic approaches and clinical practice guidelines, translating genomics and real-world data into clinically relevant actions in complex healthcare ecosystems.
• You have excel

• Partner über Funktionen, Regionen, Kulturen und Zeitzonen, um eine Umgebung der Zugehörigkeit zu schaffen und gegenseitigen Wert und Möglichkeiten für Kooperationen zu identifizieren.
• Champion-Patienten und Kundenzentrierung in Gedanken, Verhaltensweisen und Aktionen, indem immer die Bedürfnisse der Patienten und Kunden zuerst gestellt.

• Gesetz im Einklang mit den gesetzlichen, regulatorischen und Unternehmensnormen und -codes, einschließlich Roche-Code of Conduct und anderen einschlägigen Richtlinien und Richtlinien.
• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der HCP-Interaktionsrichtlinien, der Umgang mit Compliance-Fragen und -Betrachtungen, der Absolvierung aller erforderlichen Schulungen und spezifischen Aufgaben über den Standardumfang der Arbeit hinaus und der Überwachung geeigneter Dokumentationen und Berichterstattung.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Joignez-vous à une équipe expérimentée et collaborative de chefs de file en développement clinique et en affaires médicales (CDMA) à Roche Diagnostics. Collaborer avec l'équipe d'affaires internationale de la Fondation Médecine ex-US sur le développement et la commercialisation de solutions de profil génomique global et de diagnostic moléculaire en oncologie et en hématologie. Il s'agit d'une occasion inégalée pour le développement de carrière et la satisfaction au travail que vous aidez à progresser dans les soins de santé personnalisés partout dans le monde pour améliorer les expériences et les résultats des patients. Le poste est basé à Bâle, en Suisse. L'opportunité
• Expertise en génomique du cancer, en oncologie et en diagnostics hématologiques pour fournir une contribution et un leadership médicaux et scientifiques stratégiques en vue d'élaborer des stratégies médicales mondiales pour la production intégrée de données probantes, des études initiées par les chercheurs, des collaborations de recherche et des communications médicales, ainsi que pour l'exécution d'activités médicales, y compris des conseils consultatifs, des colloques scientifiques, des activités d'éducation ou de formation médicales indépendantes ou parrainées.
• Établir des partenariats solides avec les milieux médicaux et les patients, y compris les leaders mondiaux de la pensée, les chercheurs, les réseaux universitaires et les sociétés professionnelles, afin de favoriser l'adoption en toute sécurité de solutions globales de profilage génomique tout en assurant l'excellence opérationnelle et le respect des règlements de l'industrie et des lignes directrices sur l'interaction HCP.
• Mettre au point et diffuser des contenus permettant une communication rapide et efficace des données scientifiques et cliniques à l'intérieur et à l'extérieur de l'organisation dans le cadre de programmes éducatifs, de publications et de conférences.
• Établir des partenariats entre les fonctions, les régions, les cultures et les fuseaux horaires pour créer un environnement d'appartenance et identifier la valeur mutuelle et les possibilités de collaboration.
• Champion patient et centre client dans la mentalité, les comportements et les actions en mettant toujours les besoins des patients et des clients en premier.
• Modèle Roches valeurs d'intégrité, de courage et de passion et We@Roche Diagnostics (culture, mentalité et comportement) dans tout ce que vous faites.
• Agir conformément aux normes et codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris le Code de conduite de Roche et d'autres directives et directives pertinentes.
• Assurer le respect des lignes directrices sur l'interaction avec le PCS, traiter les questions et les considérations relatives à la conformité, compléter toute la formation requise et les responsabilités spécifiques au-delà de la portée normale du travail et superviser la documentation et les rapports appropriés.
• Travailler de manière autonome et indépendante, agir comme coach pour les collègues ayant moins d'expérience. Qui vous êtes Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut faire progresser les soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale et influencer votre propre développement. Vous êtes à la recherche d'une entreprise où vous avez la possibilité de poursuivre vos intérêts à travers les fonctions et les géographies, où un titre d'emploi n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui vous êtes, mais comme le point de départ.
• Vous avez une vaste connaissance et une expertise en génomique du cancer avec un diplôme avancé (MD et/ou doctorat) dans des disciplines connexes, ainsi que 5+ ans d'expérience de l'industrie en oncologie et en hématologie affaires médicales ou développement menant la conception et la mise en œuvre d'études cliniques, communication scientifique et efforts éducatifs qui aident à adapter le traitement aux patients individuels.
• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des approches thérapeutiques et des lignes directrices de la pratique clinique, traduisant la génomique et les données du monde réel en actions cliniquement pertinentes dans des écosystèmes de santé complexes.
• Vous avez excelle

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams. Your tasks and Responsibilities
• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.
• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.
• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.
• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.
• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness. Who you are
• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.
• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.
• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.
• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we are working to make next-generation sequencing simple and accessible enough for routine use. By accelerating clinical research, streamlining workflows, and expanding assay menus, we are broadening access to genomic data and lowering barriers to adoption. Our Systems Technology Group, a part of Roche Sequencing Solutions, is focused on creating and advancing technologies to significantly enhance DNA sequencing workflows. We are seeking a hands-on Chemistry & Fluidic Systems Integration Scientist/Engineer to serve as a key contributor in chemistry and biology. Joining our current team of talented scientists and engineers, you will help bridge the gap between complex molecular biology, physical chemistry and cutting-edge microfluidic instrumentation and consumables. The ideal candidate will thrive at this intersection, actively porting and translating complex workflows onto novel systems during the earliest stages of research and development. You will be responsible for rigorously testing new concepts, performing complex assays, troubleshooting integrated subsystems, and optimizing overall performance based on first principles. Your Role and Responsibilities:
• You will contribute to efforts to translate, test, and optimize complex, multi-step chemical and molecular biology workflows (e.g., purification, synthesis, library prep, target enrichment, amplification, and sequencing) on early-stage microfluidic systems.
• You will support the selection, formulation, and optimization of buffers, surfactants, coatings and critical additives. You will leverage your understanding of the distinct purpose of each reagent to maintain efficiency and optimize chemical and enzymatic reactions within microfluidic or closed-system environments.
• You will design and execute rigorous experiments using statistical methods to characterize system performance, solving potentially complex problems by analyzing possible solutions using experience, judgment, and precedents.
• You will conduct early-stage troubleshooting for complex performance issues on novel systems. You will connect systemic failures such as leaks, null results, or surface fouling back to first-principles root causes, whether molecular, chemical, material, or physical.
• You will act as a technical resource for colleagues with less experience, serving as a go-to person for explaining complex molecular biology and sequencing chemistry concepts to a team of talented engineers.
• You will analyze complex, multi-modal data sets and serve as a key technical partner to both assay development scientists and hardware design engineers. You will provide data-driven feedback to guide the co-development of reagents, consumables, and instrument hardware. A cover letter is required for this application. Please outline your relevant experience and explain why you are interested in this role and our company. This is an on-site position based in Santa Clara, CA. Relocation benefits are not being offered for this role. Who You Are (Required):
• You have a PhD in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Molecular Biology, Bioengineering, Biomedical Engineering (or a closely related discipline) with 3+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Master's degree in one of the above disciplines with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; OR a Bachelor's degree with 7+ years of relevant industry experience.
• You possess a strong understanding of the fundamental principles of chemistry and molecular biolog

descriptionByLocale.it:
Who We Are Roche Diagnostics International Ltd in Rotkreuz is one of the world’s leading providers of diagnostic system solutions for clinics, laboratories, and doctors’ offices. The company employs over 2200 people in Rotkreuz and is one of Roche Diagnostics main sites. Roche is an equal opportunity employer and strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. ( Please note that this vacancy is currently not linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.) The Position In a global and cross-functional environment, the System Development department is responsible for workflow optimization and the successful integration of hardware, software, consumables and reagents to finally perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments. As a System Integration Troubleshooter, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team on the development or product care of complex diagnostics systems consisting of fluidcs, robotics software, thermal, electrical, mechanical and biochemistry elements. As System Integration Troubleshooter, your main responsibilities will consist of (but will not be limited to):
• Conducting root-cause investigations of systemic issues found during development or escalated from field or Operations in all lifecycle phases (from early feasibility to product care), and collaborate with other functions do develop solutions for complex issues
• Building up subject matter expertise and providing support to the RMD Development Teams (Assay-, Software- and Instrument-Development), Global Customer Support (GCS), Case Investigation and Resolution (CIR) and Operations. This requires close cross-department interaction to gather all information needed to ensure high-quality support.
• Responsible for internal repair visits, retrofitting of mechanical parts, configuration management monitoring and tracking and installing or updating of the Instrument Software.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Wer wir sind Die Roche Pharma AG in Grenzach ist eines der führenden Pharmaunternehmen und sucht ab sofort einen motivierten Praktikanten (m/w/d), der unser Site Services Team in den Bereichen Fleet & Mobility unterstützt. In diesem Praktikum bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, wertvolle Erfahrungen in der Umstellung unserer Dienstwagenflotte auf Elektromobilität sowie in der Erarbeitung und Implementierung von Mobilitätskonzepten für unseren Standort und unsere Mitarbeitenden zu sammeln. Deine Hauptaufgaben
• Unterstützung bei der Implementierung einer Fleet Management Company (FMC), Effiziente Koordination und Dokumentation regelmäßiger Abstimmungstermine mit Lieferanten zur Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Informationsflusses
• Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Mobilitätskonzepten für den Standort, unter Berücksichtigung von Nachhaltigkeit, Effizienz und Kostenoptimierung (z.B. Ladesäulen, Jobrad, Fahrzeug UVV, Führerscheinprüfung, etc.)
• Analyse von Mobilitätsdaten und Entwicklung von Lösungsansätzen zur Verbesserung der Mitarbeitermobilität
• Aktive Mitarbeit in Projekten zur Verbesserung der Fleet, Mobility & Travel Prozesse
• Administrative Unterstützung des Teams sowie Mitgestaltung und Erarbeitung einer nachhaltigen Ablagestruktur für ein konsistentes Wissensmanagement Wer du bist
• Fortgeschrittenes Studium in den Bereichen Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Projektmanagement, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mobilitätsmanagement oder einem verwandten Fachbereich
• Interesse an Elektromobilität und nachhaltiger Mobilität
• Analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und Lösungen zu erarbeiten
• Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamgeist
• Eigeninitiative, Selbstständigkeit und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise
• Gute Kenntnisse in MS Office und Google Anwendungen
• Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Wir bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen und innovativen Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Du deine Ideen einbringen und umsetzen kannst. Du wirst von erfahrenen Fachleuten unterstützt und erhältst Einblicke in die neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich der Elektromobilität und nachhaltigen Mobilitätslösungen. Was wir Dir bieten ● Flexible Zeiteinteilung ● 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum ● Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine Deine Bewerbung Bitte lade nur Deinen Lebenslauf online hoch. Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum ausschließlich an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden. Zeitraum: ab 01. Juli 2026 für die Dauer von 6 Monaten. Beachte bitte, dass Empfehlungen für alle studentischen Tätigkeiten (z.B. Praktika, Abschlussarbeiten, etc.) ausgeschlossen sind. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose In this very versatile position you act as supporter, trainer and coordinator at the pivotal point between our global affiliates and our internal departments. You will be responsible of:
• Technical Support: Provide high-level (Tier 2) remote and on-site support to resolve technical issues and minimize product downtime.
• Knowledge Management: Maintain an updated product knowledge base and create essential service documentation, manuals, and technical notifications.
• Training & Education: Develop learning paths and conduct training sessions for customers and internal staff, including managing trainer certifications.
• Strategic Optimization: Define service concepts and optimize support processes to improve overall quality, efficiency, and regional cooperation.
• Product Launch Support: Assist with product pilots, prepare preliminary documentation for new launches, and handle up to 30% international travel. Your Profile:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, MIS, or a medical-technical field with strong IT knowledge.
• Experience & Expertise: Proven background in software support and training, backed by high subject matter expertise.
• Communication Skills: Fluency in English (Spanish is a plus) and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for others.
• Soft Skills: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with a deep focus on customer service and teamwork.
• Adaptability: Comfortable working in global matrix structures, self-managed teams, and culturally diverse environments. Following Knowledge Domains and Experience are additional assets:
• Healthcare environments like Lab Middlewares, LIS or HIS.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence. The Opportunity:
• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)
• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.
• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.
• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).
• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.
• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).
• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data. Who you are:
• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;
• 10+ years of clinical drug development experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related sector (e.g. academia; CRO; etc); preferably including at least 5 years of experience in a clinical drug safety-related role.
• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.
• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence, with and without authority, in a global matrix envir

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Senior Safety Director at Roche, you'll be a recognized expert and strategic leader in drug safety, driving safety strategy for our most complex molecules while building organizational capability across the Clinical Safety organization. You'll provide expert mentorship to colleagues, lead high-stakes regulatory submissions, and represent Roche's safety expertise to regulatory authorities, governance committees, and senior leadership. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic influence. This is the perfect opportunity for a safety leader ready to shape the future of drug development and drive organizational excellence. The Opportunity:
• Takes the lead in defining, owning, progressing, and guiding the defined safety strategy for their program(s)
• Accountable for establishing and maintaining the company position on the safety profile and shaping the proactive patient risk communication and risk management strategy.
• Must provide an objective and neutral position as a safety professional, even when facing conflicting business priorities or viewpoints.
• Is the expert content reviewer for safety aspects and must be consulted for safety profile decision-making across the product lifecycle (e.g., updates to the Investigator’s brochure (IB)/safety label, Integrated Safety Management Plan/Risk Management Plan (RMP)).
• Leads the development of the safety strategy by providing input into clinical development programs, Target Product Profiles (TPPs), Integrated Evidence Plans (IEPs), health technology assessment (HTA) dossier, and launch strategies.
• Provides critical safety input to inform decision-making on clinical development plans and individual study designs. Also provides requisite oversight and expert review for safety components of regulatory authority submissions (e.g., IND, NDA, MAA).
• Influences key stakeholders (e.g., triad or cross-functional development teams, regulatory leader, medical affairs). Works closely with PCS (Portfolio Clinical Safety) to meet Clinical Safety deliverables and provide medical and scientific interpretation of emerging clinical and nonclinical safety data. Who you are:
• Qualified healthcare professional or Life Sciences graduate and a minimum 10+ years of drug development experience in pharmaceutical or related industry, including at least 5 years in drug safety; expert-level understanding of scientific aspects of safety, pharmacovigilance, and clinical/patient risk management with demonstrable knowledge of GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements;
• 10+ years of clinical drug development experience in the biopharmaceutical industry or a related sector (e.g. academia; CRO; etc); preferably including at least 5 years of experience in a clinical drug safety-related role.
• Demonstrate expert understanding of the scientific aspects of safety, PV and clinical/patient risk management (e.g. via demonstrable knowledge of the application of GVP, GCP & CTR requirements) is essential.

titleByLocale.it: Esperto di supporto commerciale (CRM Product Manager)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a Commercial Support Expert (CRM Product Manager) , you will provide hands-on execution support for ongoing CRM product activities. Your role is critical in bridging the gap between business strategy and technical execution, focusing on day-to-day support by translating complex business needs into functional requirements and ensuring a healthy, prioritized product backlog. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Product & Delivery Support: Assist with requirements clarification and documentation, creating detailed user stories with clear use cases and acceptance criteria. You will develop business process flow documents and maintain product backlogs and JIRA stories.
• Operational & BAU Support: Support ongoing CRM enhancements, minor configuration requests, and release activities—including release notes and deployment readiness. You will help track dependencies and risks across workstreams and support the triage of requests from business stakeholders.
• Cross-Functional Coordination: Serve as a key point of contact between CRM operations, developers, QA teams, and vendors. You will participate in agile ceremonies (stand-ups, grooming, sprint reviews) and maintain project documentation in Confluence and JIRA.
• Quality & Testing: Support SQA and UAT planning, coordination, and defect tracking to ensure high-quality delivery.
• Data & Reporting: Assist with basic CRM reporting needs and validate data outputs, ensuring all documentation aligns with necessary compliance and audit requirements. Who you are: You are a highly organized professional with strong communication skills, capable of working in a fast-paced, matrixed environment to turn business vision into technical reality. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: University degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Experience: 5+ years of experience supporting Veeva CRM platform ideally within the Life Sciences, Commercial, or Medical sectors.
• Technical Skills: Strong Product Management expertise with experience writing functional requirements and user stories.
• Hands-on experience with JIRA and Confluence .
• Deep familiarity with Agile / Scrum delivery models.
• Competencies: Ability to translate business needs into technical specifications.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and dependencies.
• A proactive approach to problem-solving and backlog hygiene. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è un momento emozionante per aderire alla rete di supporto Roche. Se siete appassionati di problem solving allora questa è la posizione per voi! In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. Mansioni In qualità di Field Applications Specialist, sarai un membro chiave del nostro team di assistenza clienti come principale rappresentante scientifico e tecnico nella regione dell'Alabama per i sistemi Roche nei laboratori dei clienti all'interno dello spazio Core Lab. Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. - Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche. - Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate. - Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati. - Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc. - Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche. - Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback dai clienti sulle prestazioni, caratteristiche e usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo. - Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi. - Assicurare un'esperienza clienti coerente seguendo i protocolli e le procedure Roche.

Foodlicious is our daily business

The Position
Wichtig: Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns innerhalb weniger Tage per E-Mail bei dir. Um sicherzustellen, dass du keine wichtige Nachricht verpasst, bitten wir dich, neben deinem Posteingang auch den Spam- oder Junk-Ordner zu prüfen. Falls du innerhalb einer Woche nichts von uns hörst, melde dich unter basel.berufslehre@roche.com .

Weisst Du bereits, was du nach deinem Abschluss machen wirst? Weltverbesserer oder Lebensretterin werden? Nicht nur Du musst Deine Zukunft neu erfinden. Auch wir. Wir bei Roche arbeiten mit einem Ziel - innovative Tests und Medikamente zu entwickeln und Daten auf neue Weise zu nutzen, um Menschen zu einem längeren und besseren Leben zu verhelfen. Lernen. Zukunft. Roche.

Top Argumente für den Job

• Du stellst Wirkstoffe für Medikamente in der biotechnologischen und chemischen Produktion her

• In der pharmazeutischen Produktion verarbeitest du diese Wirkstoffe zu Medikamenten (Arzneiform)

• In der biotechnologischen Produktion wird mit lebenden Organismen gearbeitet, so werden beispielsweise Zellen aufgetaut, vermehrt und aufgereinigt

• In der chemischen Produktion führst du chemische Reaktionen durch, destillierst, extrahierst, zentrifugierst und trocknest die hergestellten Wirkstoffe

• In der pharmazeutischen Produktion werden die zuvor hergestellten Wirkstoffe mit Hilfsstoffe gemischt, granuliert, tablettiert, kapsuliert oder auch Injektionslösungen hergestellt

• Du bist zuständig für die Planung, Vorbereitung und Durchführung biotechnologischer, chemischer und pharmazeutischer Prozesse

• Du überwachst und bedienst hochkomplexe Anlagen

• Du führst analytische Arbeiten der laufenden Prozesse durch und bist verantwortlich für alle Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbelange

Dein Profil

Du hast dir schonmal Gedanken über naturwissenschaftliche und technische Prozesse und Zusammenhänge gemacht? Prima!
Du bist schonmal gescheitert, wieder aufgestanden und hast weitergemacht? Perfekt!
Du möchtest dein Wissen rund um die Gebiete der chemischen-, biotechnologischen- und pharmazeutischen Produktion ausbauen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Was du mitbringen solltest:

• Dich fasziniert die Kombination von Naturwissenschaft und Technik und du möchtest bei der Herstellung von Wirkstoffen und Medikamenten an vorderster Front stehen

• Du hast Spass an der Arbeit mit grossen und hochkomplexen Apparaturen und Maschinen, die zur Herstellung von Produkten und Zwischenprodukten benötigt werden

• Du arbeitest gerne im Team, beteiligst dich aktiv an Diskussionen und hast Spass daran eigene kreative Lösungsansätze zu finden

• Zuverlässigkeit und Präzision sind zwei wichtige Fähigkeiten die man mitbringen sollte

• Gute Leistungen in Mathematik und in naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern

• Mindestens Schulniveau Sek E (BS/BL/SO), Sek (AG), Mittlere Reife (D) oder höhere Schulstufen

• Deutsch: Muttersprache oder Niveau B2

Deine Vorteile

• Du arbeitest in einer internationalen Umgebung und erhältst erstklassige Einblicke in die Firma und den Berufsalltag

• Du besuchst eine praxisorientierte Werkschule

• Du arbeitest mit hochmodernen Anlagen, Geräten und zukunftsorientierten Einrichtungen

• Wir unterstützen dich nach der Ausbildung weiterhin und dir stehen verschiedene Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten offen

• Du hast die Möglichkeit in Basel ein Zimmer im Roche Wohnhe

The Position
Misión
En Roche Diagnostics, estamos comprometidos no solo con el avance de soluciones diagnósticas que puedan ayudar a los profesionales sanitarios a tomar decisiones críticas para la salud de sus pacientes, sino también con la mejora de la forma en que estas herramientas esenciales se integran en los sistemas sanitarios de todo el mundo, a un coste menor, sin dejar de obtener los mejores resultados posibles.

En más de 100 países, ofrecemos la cartera de pruebas de diagnóstico in vitro más completa del sector, combinada con apoyo a la toma de decisiones clínicas, consultoría, diagnóstico digital, gestión de enfermedades, automatización de laboratorios y soluciones de software para proporcionar soluciones integradas a laboratorios, clínicos y sistemas sanitarios.

El Field Service Engineer presta un servicio científico/técnico a los sistemas y soluciones instalados en cliente, garantizando la mayor eficiencia y eficacia en cada una de las actividades asignadas: Instalaciones, mantenimiento preventivo, correctivo, evolutivo y modificaciones. Asegura que el servicio prestado genera ventaja competitiva, convirtiéndose en el elemento diferencial de la propuesta de valor de Roche, y consiguiendo niveles óptimos de satisfacción del cliente.

Responsabilidades

Como Field Service Engineer tus principales responsabilidades van a ser:

• Alcanzar y mantener un nivel de operatividad excelente en todas las soluciones asignadas (que incluyen instrumentos, reactivos y software) mediante una correcta ejecución de los procedimientos previstos para mantenimientos preventivos, correctivos, evolutivos, instalaciones y modificaciones, capacitando a los usuarios en el manejo y uso de los mismos.

• Establecer y mantener un excelente nivel de comunicación, seguimiento y colaboración proactiva con el Cliente, informando de las actualizaciones de los reactivos y controles de calidad e implementar nuevos protocolos.

• Incorporar la digitalización en el área de servicio postventa mediante el uso de herramientas digitales que permitan evolucionar hacia un modelo de servicio más eficiente y proactivo, orientado a maximizar la experiencia de servicio de nuestros clientes.

• Reportar la actividad en CRM de las actividades realizadas de forma remota o in situ, garantizando a su vez la correcta documentación de las características técnicas de la instalación en cliente y su actualización cuando se requiera, según los estándares de calidad de reporte definidos por la Organización.

• Asegurar, el seguimiento y cumplimiento en tiempo y forma de las modificaciones y mantenimientos preventivos de los sistemas instalados en los clientes asignados, utilizando el Dashboard de Servicio como herramienta clave para garantizar la sostenibilidad de los clientes y el cumplimiento de las metas estratégicas de servicio.”

The Position
Mit seinen 1400 Mitarbeitenden stellt das Produktionszentrum Kaiseraugst (PTM) die ununterbrochene Patientenversorgung sicher. Im Bereich DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) im Team Business Automation Support (BAS) bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit, die digitale Integrität unserer Verpackungsanlagen auf ein neues Level zu heben.

Die Möglichkeit

• In diesem Praktikum bist du an der vordersten Front des Produktionssupports tätig. Dabei schlägst du die Brücke zwischen hochmoderner Automatisierung und strengen regulatorischen Vorgaben.

• Unterstützung: Du unterstützt das Team von DOI Business Automation Support im Daily Business im Verpackungsbetrieb und in der sterilen Produktion.

• Technische Dokumentation: Du erstellst neue Anleitungen für verschiedene Betriebssysteme (Windows, Linux und Legacy-Systeme wie DOS) und führst selbständig GMP Assessments durch.

• Schnittstellenmanagement: Du koordinierst die Durchführung der GMP Assessments gemeinsam mit den Schnittstellen QA, Betrieb und Engineering vor Ort.

Wer Du bist

• Studium: Du studierst Pharmatechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Medizintechnik, oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang oder Du hast Dein Studium innerhalb von 12 Monaten vor dem Startdatum abgeschlossen.

• GMP-Interesse: Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) oder Data Integrity gesammelt oder möchtest erste Erfahrungen sammeln.

• Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, präzise und behältst auch bei einer grossen Anzahl von Aufgaben den Überblick.

• Prozessoptimierungen :: Starke Durchhaltefähigkeit bei repetitiver Arbeit und entsprechende Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu optimieren.

• Kommunikation: Du bist ein Teamplayer und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte sowohl für Techniker an der Linie als auch für die Qualitätssicherung verständlich formulieren.

• IT-Affinität: Du hast einen versierten Umgang mit Betriebssystemen (Windows, Linux) und keine Berührungsängste mit älteren Systemumgebungen.

• Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Deine Vorteile

• Einblick in das weltweit grösste und innovativste Verpackungszentrum der Roche.

• Verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem Projekt mit hoher Sichtbarkeit.

• Zusammenarbeit mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Ingenieuren, IT-Experten und Qualitätsmanagern.

• Die Chance, theoretisches Wissen über Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) und Computerized System Validation (CSV) direkt in die Praxis umzusetzen.

Bewerbungsprozess

• Deine Bewerbung muss einen Lebenslauf und ein Motivationsschreiben enthalten.

Zusätzliche Information

• Bitte beachte: Aufgrund von Vorschriften müssen Nicht-EU/EFTA-Bürger als Teil der Bewerbungsunterlagen eine Bescheinigung der Universität vorlegen, aus der hervorgeht, dass ein Praktikum verpflichtend ist, sowie die Dauer des Pflichtpraktikums.

• Dieses Praktikum kann sowohl in Teilzeit als auch in Vollzeit absolviert werden.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
Avec ses 1400 employés, le centre de production Kaiseraugst (PTM) assure des soins continus aux patients. Dans le domaine de la DOI (Digital, Operational Excellence & Innovation) chez Team Business Automation Support (BAS), nous vous offrons la possibilité de porter l'intégrité numérique de nos systèmes d'emballage à un nouveau niveau.

La possibilité

• Dans ce stage, vous travaillez à l'avant du support de production. Ce faisant, vous dormez le pont entre l'automatisation de pointe et des exigences réglementaires strictes.

• Support: Vous aidez l'équipe de DOI Business Automation Support dans le Daily Business dans l'emballage et la production stérile.

• Documentation technique : Obtenez de nouvelles instructions pour différents systèmes d'exploitation (Windows, Linux et systèmes existants tels que DOS) et effectuez des évaluations GMP indépendamment.

• Gestion des interfaces: Vous coordonnez la mise en œuvre des évaluations des BPF avec les interfaces QA, exploitation et ingénierie sur le site.

Qui vous êtes

• Etude : vous étudiez la technologie pharmaceutique, la technologie d'automatisation, l'informatique, l'informatique commerciale, la technologie médicale, ou un diplôme comparable ou vous avez terminé vos études dans les 12 mois avant la date de début.

• GMP-Interesse: Idéalement, vous avez déjà collecté les premiers points de contact avec les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) ou l'intégrité des données ou souhaitez acquérir de premières expériences.

• Les talents organisationnels : Vous travaillez structuré, précis et suivez un grand nombre de tâches.

• Optimisation des processus: remettre en question et optimiser une forte résilience dans le travail répétitif et les processus correspondants.

• Communication: Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe et pouvez facilement formuler des problèmes complexes tant pour les techniciens en ligne que pour l'assurance qualité.

• IT-affinité: Vous avez une gestion expérimentée des systèmes d'exploitation (Windows, Linux) et aucune crainte de toucher avec les environnements système plus anciens.

• Langues: Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais dans la parole et l'écriture.

Vos avantages

• Découvrez le plus grand et le plus innovant centre d'emballage de Roche dans le monde.

• Tâches sensibles dans un projet à haute visibilité.

• Coopération avec une équipe interdisciplinaire d'ingénieurs, d'experts en informatique et de gestionnaires de qualité.

• La possibilité de mettre en pratique directement des connaissances théoriques sur les bonnes pratiques de fabrication (BPF) et la validation informatisée des systèmes (CSV).

Processus de demande

• Votre demande doit contenir un CV et une lettre de motivation.

Informations complémentaires

• Veuillez noter: En raison de la réglementation, les citoyens non membres de l'UE/AELE doivent présenter un certificat universitaire indiquant qu'un stage est obligatoire et la durée du stage obligatoire.

• Ce stage peut être complété à temps partiel et à temps plein.

Si vous voulez vous développer dans un environnement qui favorise le travail d'équipe et l'innovation, Roche est la bonne entreprise pour vous. Tout rôle dans Roche contribue à améliorer la vie des patients. Prenez contact !

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts conduisent à plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Unser Global Internship Programme in Innovation & Sustainability (#IP2TIS) bietet motivierten Talenten die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen in der pharmazeutischen Industrie zu sammeln und dabei einen positiven Beitrag für Umwelt und Gesellschaft zu leisten. Bist Du bereit, Teil eines globalen Netzwerks in mehr als 20 Ländern zu werden, in dem kluge Köpfe gemeinsam an realen Herausforderungen in Innovation & Sustainability arbeiten? Möchtest Du an wirkungsvollen Projekten mitarbeiten, die Zukunft mitgestalten und Veränderung von innen heraus vorantreiben? In diesem Praktikum analysierst Du das Potenzial dezentraler Wärmepumpenlösungen in Niedertemperatur-Netzen an Roche-Standorten in Deutschland. Ziel ist es, bislang ungenutzte Energiepotenziale in Gebäuden zu identifizieren und nachhaltige Konzepte zu entwickeln, um Wärme- und Kühllasten effizienter zu decken. Dabei untersuchst Du, wie Abwärme aus bestehenden Abluft- und Kühlsystemen genutzt werden kann, um CO2-Emissionen zu reduzieren und den Einsatz primärer Energien zu senken. Innerhalb der ersten drei Monate sollst Du konkrete Potenziale bewerten, ein geeignetes Pilotgebäude identifizieren und ein erstes Konzept für eine Pilotlösung mit Wärmepumpe entwickeln. Darüber hinaus leistest Du einen direkten Beitrag zu Roches Net-Zero-Ambitionen, indem Du die Grundlage für einen skalierbaren Rollout an weiteren Standorten schaffst. Das Praktikum bietet Dir die Möglichkeit, an einem Thema mit hoher Sichtbarkeit zu arbeiten und einen messbaren Einfluss auf zukünftige CO2-Reduktionen zu erzielen. Die Möglichkeit
• Du analysierst Gebäudeautomationsdaten sowie Energieverbräuche von Medien- und HLK-Systemen in Gebäuden
• Du berechnest Heiz- und Kühllasten bestehender Gebäude sowie deren Gleichzeitigkeit
• Du bewertest, inwieweit Heiz- und Kühllasten durch Wärmepumpen abgedeckt werden können
• Du recherchierst geeignete am Markt verfügbare Wärmepumpenlösungen und vergleichst sie mit den identifizierten Potenzialen
• Du identifizierst ein geeignetes Pilotgebäude und erarbeitest ein Pilotkonzept auf konzeptioneller Ebene
• Du schätzt den lokalen und globalen Wirkungspotenzialbeitrag für Roche weltweit ab
• Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung eines möglichen Rollout-Plans für verschiedene Standorte Wer Du bist Du bist an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert und studierst im Master oder MBA, vorzugsweise in den Fachrichtungen Energieversorgung, Automatisierung, Energiemanagement, Thermodynamik, Physik, Nachhaltigkeitsmanagement oder Facility Management, und möchtest Dein Wissen im Rahmen eines mindestens 3-monatigen Praktikums in einem modernen Arbeitsumfeld anwenden. Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:
• Erfahrung in der Analyse großer Datenmengen
• Idealerweise erste Kenntnisse in der Berechnung von KPIs, Energiebilanzen oder energietechnischen Auswertungen
• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse sowie Deutschkenntnisse; gesprochenes Deutsch ist von Vorteil Eine kollaborative Arbeitsweise und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Schnittstellen
• Flexibilität sowie Interesse daran, nachhaltige technische Lösungen mitzugestalten Wenn Du die meisten, aber nicht alle Qualifikationen mitbringst, freuen wir uns trotzdem über Deine Bewerbung. Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2.268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
• 37,5h die Woche
• Flache Hierarchistufen trotz Konzernstruktur
• Mitarbeitervergünstigungen (Corporate Benefits) Deine Bewerbung Für eine vollständige Bewerbung bitten w

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
L'opportunità

In qualità di catalizzatore integrato dell'impegno medico, si svolgerà un ruolo vitale nel sostenere l'esecuzione e il progresso di queste iniziative strategiche. Questa posizione si concentra sull'applicazione pratica di nuovi strumenti di comunicazione e quadri, assicurando che siano robusti, user-friendly, e fornire valore misurabile alla comunità medica. Come contributore chiave, vi aiuterà a consentire la necessaria evoluzione di come i dati scientifici sono condivisi e sperimentati a livello globale.

• Innovare l'impegno medico: Immaginare e abilitare l'evoluzione dei modelli di fidanzamento medico, assistendo nello sviluppo pratico di nuovi strumenti, modelli e piattaforme.

• Esecuzione dell'azionamento: Piombo e abilitare la consegna di nuovi quadri per la comunicazione medica, la gestione dei flussi di lavoro del progetto e la garanzia di raggiungimento delle pietre miliari e che le "noci e bulloni" operative dei nuovi modelli di comunicazione e di impegno funzionino efficacemente per l'eccellenza operativa dell'utente finale per l'utente finale.

• Scale Experiments: testa esperimenti di fidanzamento innovativi, progettando percorsi per standardizzare e scalare modelli di successo in tutta la rete medica globale.

• Foster Collaboration: lavorare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne e le agenzie esterne per facilitare l'implementazione di nuovi standard e risolvere le barriere di implementazione.

• Assicurare l'integrità tecnica: assicurarsi che tutti i nuovi quadri e tecnologie aumentano l'impatto del cliente, pur rimanendo facili da adottare per le squadre di Medical Affairs.

• Rispettare la conformità: assicurarsi che tutte le attività seguano i codici legali, normativi e aziendali, comprese le direttive Roche e le politiche di impegno HCP.

Chi sei

Sei un professionista proattivo con una passione per "Scientific Storytelling". Si prospera in un ambiente dinamico e trasformazionale. Si guarda oltre i processi attuali per risolvere i punti di dolore ed evolversi per il futuro. Sei un comunicatore collaborativo, fluente in inglese, che può navigare in ambienti di matrice e costruire partnership significative tra team interni ed esterni.

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, si porta:

• Competenza qualificata: Preferito un grado avanzato di vita-scienza (PhD, PharmD, o MD) con 2-3 anni di profonda conoscenza negli Affari Medici (Comunicazioni Scientifiche, Istruzione Medica, o Medicina di Campo).

• Agilità strategica: forti capacità di gestione del progetto con la capacità di priorizzare più obiettivi in un ambiente frenetico.

• Conoscenza dell'industria: una forte comprensione dell'ambiente bio-farmaceutico regolamentato e un impegno ad elevati standard etici.

• Mindset orientato al futuro: una passione per l'innovazione e la capacità di semplificare i messaggi complessi per il pubblico diverso.

• Spirito collaborativo: un comprovato record di lavoro in modo efficace all'interno di team globali e interfunzionali.

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni elevate, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.
