descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Opportunity

As an Integrated Medical Engagement Catalyst, you will play a vital role in supporting the execution and advancement of these strategic initiatives. This position focuses on the practical application of new communication tools and frameworks, ensuring they are robust, user-friendly, and deliver measurable value to the medical community. As a key contributor, you will help enable the necessary evolution of how scientific data is shared and experienced globally.

• Innovate Medical Engagement: Envision and enable the evolution of medical engagement models, assisting in the hands-on development of new tools, templates, and platforms.

• Drive Execution: Lead and enable the delivery of new frameworks for medical communication, managing project workstreams and ensuring ensuring milestones are met and that the operational "nuts and bolts" of new communication & engagement models function effectively for the end-useroperational excellence for end-user.

• Scale Experiments: Test innovative engagement experiments, designing pathways to standardise and scale successful models across the global medical network.

• Foster Collaboration: Work closely with internal stakeholders and external agencies to facilitate the rollout of new standards and troubleshoot implementation barriers.

• Ensure Technical Integrity: Ensure all new frameworks and technologies increase customer impact while remaining easy for Medical Affairs teams to adopt.

• Uphold Compliance: Ensure all activities follow legal, regulatory, and company codes of practice, including Roche directives and HCP engagement policies.

Who You Are

You are a proactive professional with a passion for "Scientific Storytelling". You thrive in a dynamic, transformational environment. You look beyond current processes to solve pain points and evolve for the future. You are a collaborative communicator, fluent in English, who can navigate matrix environments and build meaningful partnerships across internal and external teams.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

• Qualified Expertise: An advanced life-science degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD preferred) with 2-3 years of deep knowledge in Medical Affairs (Scientific Communications, Medical Education, or Field Medical).

• Strategic Agility: Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple goals in a fast-paced environment.

• Industry Knowledge: A strong understanding of the regulated bio-pharmaceutical environment and a commitment to high ethical standards.

• Future-Oriented Mindset: A passion for innovation and the ability to simplify complex messages for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative Spirit: A proven track record of working effectively within global, cross-functional teams.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.

Die Position
Die Chance

Als Integrierter Medical Engagement Catalyst werden Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung dieser strategischen Initiativen spielen. Diese Position konzentriert sich auf die praktische Anwendung neuer Kommunikationsinstrumente und -rahmen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie robust, benutzerfreundlich sind und der medizinischen Gemeinschaft messbare Werte liefern. Als wesentlicher Beitrag helfen Sie, die notwendige Entwicklung der Weitergabe und Erfahrung von wissenschaftlichen Daten weltweit zu ermöglichen.

• Innovate Medical Engagement: Vergewissern Sie sich und ermöglichen die Entwicklung von medizinischen Eingriffsmodellen und unterstützen Sie bei der praktischen Entwicklung neuer Werkzeuge, Vorlagen und Plattformen.

• Drive Execution: Führen und ermöglichen die Bereitstellung neuer Frameworks für die medizinische Kommunikation, das Management von Projekt-Workstreams und die Sicherstellung von Meilensteinen und dass die operativen "Nüsse und Bolzen" von neuen Kommunikations- & Engagement-Modellen effektiv für die Endbenutzer-Exzellenz für Endbenutzer funktionieren.

• Scale Experiments: Erprobte innovative Engagement-Experimente, die Wege zur Standardisierung und Skalierung erfolgreicher Modelle im globalen medizinischen Netzwerk.

• Foster Collaboration: Arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Interessenvertretern und externen Agenturen zusammen, um das Ausrollen neuer Standards und die Fehlerbehebung der Implementierungsbarrieren zu erleichtern.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass die technische Integrität: Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle neuen Rahmenbedingungen und Technologien die Auswirkungen des Kunden erhöhen, während Sie für die Teams von Medical Affairs leicht bleiben.

• Einhaltung der Einhaltung: Gewährleistung aller Aktivitäten, die den Rechts-, Rechts- und Unternehmenskodizes der Praxis entsprechen, einschließlich Roche-Richtlinien und HCP-Vermittlungspolitiken.

Wer bist du?

Sie sind ein proaktiver Profi mit einer Leidenschaft für "Scientific Storytelling". Sie blühen in einer dynamischen, transformierenden Umgebung. Sie schauen über aktuelle Prozesse hinaus, um Schmerzpunkte zu lösen und entwickeln sich für die Zukunft. Sie sind ein kollaborativer Kommunikationspartner, fließend auf Englisch, der Matrixumgebungen navigieren und sinnvolle Partnerschaften über interne und externe Teams aufbauen kann.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, bringen Sie:

• Qualifizierte Expertise: Ein fortgeschrittener Life-Science-Abschluss (PhD, PharmD oder MD bevorzugt) mit 2-3 Jahren tiefem Wissen in der Medizin (wissenschaftliche Kommunikation, Medizinische Bildung oder Feldmedizin).

• Strategische Agilität: Starke Projektmanagementfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Ziele in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu priorisieren.

• Branchenwissen: Ein starkes Verständnis der regulierten biopharmazeutischen Umgebung und ein Engagement für hohe ethische Standards.

• Future-Oriented Mindset: Eine Leidenschaft für Innovation und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Botschaften für unterschiedliche Publikum zu vereinfachen.

• Collaborative Spirit: Eine bewährte Erfolgsbilanz der effektiven Arbeit innerhalb globaler, funktionsübergreifender Teams.

Wer wir sind
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation. Gemeinsam sind mehr als 100’000 Mitarbeiter auf der ganzen Welt der Wissenschaft gewidmet, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat und für Generationen kommen. Unsere Bemühungen führen zu mehr als 26 Millionen Menschen, die mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt werden, und über 30 Milliarden Tests, die mit unseren Diagnostics-Produkten durchgeführt werden. Wir befähigen uns, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und unsere Ambitionen hoch zu halten, damit wir lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen liefern können, die einen globalen Einfluss haben.

Wir bauen gemeinsam eine gesündere Zukunft.

Roche ist Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte.

La position
L'opportunité

En tant que catalyseur d'engagement médical intégré, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'exécution et l'avancement de ces initiatives stratégiques. Cette position met l'accent sur l'application pratique de nouveaux outils et cadres de communication, s'assurant qu'ils sont robustes, conviviaux et offrent une valeur mesurable au milieu médical. En tant que contributeur clé, vous contribuerez à l'évolution nécessaire de la manière dont les données scientifiques sont partagées et vécues à l'échelle mondiale.

• Innovez l'engagement médical : envisagez et activez l'évolution des modèles d'engagement médical, contribuant au développement pratique de nouveaux outils, modèles et plateformes.

• Exécution de l'entraînement: Diriger et permettre la mise en place de nouveaux cadres pour la communication médicale, gérer les flux de travail des projets et veiller à ce que les étapes soient franchies et que les "écrous et boulons" opérationnels des nouveaux modèles de communication et d'engagement fonctionnent efficacement pour l'excellence opérationnelle de l'utilisateur final.

• Expériences à l'échelle : Tester des expériences d'engagement innovantes, concevoir des voies pour normaliser et évaluer des modèles réussis dans le réseau médical mondial.

• Favoriser la collaboration: Collaborer étroitement avec les parties prenantes internes et les organismes externes pour faciliter le déploiement de nouvelles normes et résoudre les obstacles à la mise en œuvre.

• Assurer l'intégrité technique : veiller à ce que tous les nouveaux cadres et technologies accroissent l'impact client tout en restant faciles à adopter par les équipes des affaires médicales.

• Maintien de la conformité : Veiller à ce que toutes les activités respectent les codes de pratique juridiques, réglementaires et d'entreprise, y compris les directives Roche et les politiques d'engagement du HCP.

Qui vous êtes

Vous êtes un professionnel proactif avec une passion pour « Scientific Storytelling ». Vous prospèrez dans un environnement dynamique et transformationnel. Vous regardez au-delà des processus actuels pour résoudre les points de douleur et évoluer pour l'avenir. Vous êtes un communicateur collaboratif, parlant couramment l'anglais, qui peut naviguer dans les environnements matriciels et construire des partenariats significatifs entre les équipes internes et externes.

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous apportez :

• Expertise qualifiée : Diplôme avancé en sciences de la vie (PhD, PharmD ou MD préféré) avec 2-3 ans de connaissances approfondies en affaires médicales (communications scientifiques, éducation médicale ou médecine de terrain).

• Agilité stratégique : Des compétences solides en gestion de projet avec la capacité de prioriser plusieurs objectifs dans un environnement rapide.

• Connaissance de l'industrie : une bonne compréhension de l'environnement biopharmaceutique réglementé et un engagement envers des normes éthiques élevées.

• L'esprit d'avenir : une passion pour l'innovation et la capacité de simplifier des messages complexes pour divers publics.

• L'esprit collaboratif : une expérience éprouvée de travail efficace au sein d'équipes globales et interfonctionnelles.

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions à un niveau élevé, de sorte que nous puissions offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur de l'égalité des chances.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We combine life-changing diagnostics and medicines to prevent, stop and cure diseases, helping people live healthier, longer lives. Key Responsibilities Logistics & Operations Management
• Material Handling: Lead and perform the receiving, picking, packing, issuing, and sampling of materials to support manufacturing and quality needs.
• Inventory Accuracy: Maintain impeccable inventory levels through diligent cycle counting and precise data entry into SAP and other database systems.
• Shipment Coordination: Monitor all inbound and outbound shipments, ensuring receiving, picking and packing procedures are followed.
• Team Collaboration: Contribute to Warehouse team activities to ensure consistent operational support and warehouse improvement projects. Quality Compliance
• Standards: Adhere strictly to cGMP, GDP, local/corporate policies, and safe handling requirements for Material Handling Equipment (MHE).
• Documentation: Perform accurate order fulfillment; initiate and follow up on Change Requests and event discrepancies.
• Reporting: Promptly escalate abnormal events and ensure proper labeling and segregation of materials. Safety, Health & Environment (SHE)
• Maintain a "safety-first" mindset by complying with all SHE requirements.
• Report workplace accidents, near misses, or hazards immediately.
• Observe site security measures and report suspicious activity to ensure a secure work environment. Continuous Improvement
• Embody the Lean Production System (LPS) mindset.
• Lead and drive warehouse continuous improvement initiatives. Who You Are
• Diploma, Higher NITEC, NITEC, or Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Prior experience in warehouse/logistics operations, preferably in a GMP-regulated environment, is an advantage.
• Familiarity with ERP systems and warehouse operations is preferred.
• Candidates must possess a valid forklift license , as operating a forklift will be part of the job responsibilities.
• Willing to be based at Singapore Tuas Bay Link. Company shuttle bus is provided at the MRT stations.
• Willing to commit for one year contract. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mission: Rattaché(e) à la Direction Juridique et Compliance, au sein de l’Unité Juridique composée d’un Directeur des Affaires Juridiques, de 3 Juristes, d’1 Paralégal et d’un Délégué à la Protection des Données, véritable business partner, vous aurez pour mission d'assurer conseil et assistance aux collaborateurs dans tous les domaines du droit. Il s'agit d'un CDD 4 mois à pourvoir dès le 01 Juin 2026 (potentiellement prolongeable). Vos principales responsabilités:
• Vous apportez conseil aux différentes équipes que vous accompagnez sur tous les segments du droit – à l’exception du droit social, et notamment en matière de droit commercial, responsabilité pharmaceutique, droit de la santé, droit économique, droit de la concurrence.
• Vous élaborez, négociez et proposez des contrats liés aux activités du Groupe: (contrats de recherche clinique, contrats de partenariats, prestations de services, contrats de recherche, accords de confidentialité…).
• Vous préparez et suivez les actions de précontentieux et de contentieux en lien avec des cabinets partenaires.
• Vous procédez aux démarches nécessaires vis-à-vis des différentes autorités administratives indépendantes le cas échéant.
• Vous sensibilisez, informez et formez les collaborateurs aux problématiques juridiques qui les concernent ainsi le cas échéant qu’aux risques subséquents.
• Vous participez aux projets transverses au niveau de la filiale France ou au niveau du Groupe.
• Vous assurez une veille juridique active sur les nouvelles réglementations du droit de la santé. Qui vous êtes:
• Formation supérieure en Droit (DJCE, Master II droit des Affaires, de la santé, de la concurrence, …)
• Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins 2 ans acquise en techniques contractuelles et Droit des Affaires d’une entreprise
• Une expérience dans le secteur pharmaceutique serait idéale
• Vous savez négocier et convaincre tout en restant à l’écoute dans un environnement matriciel
• Votre capacité à prendre des initiatives est clé pour le succès dans cette fonction Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche: Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad:
• Título del Puesto: Becario / Practicante de Farmacoeconomía
• Departamento: Acceso al Mercado / Farmacoeconomía
• Reporta a: Gerente de Farmacoeconomía
• Propósito del Puesto: Brindar soporte técnico y analítico al equipo de Farmacoeconomía en la generación de evidencia local, optimizando los tiempos de entrega de los dosieres de valor y materiales económicos necesarios para el posicionamiento de las terapias de Productos Roche. Responsabilidades:
• Investigación y análisis de datos: Realizar búsquedas sistemáticas de literatura científica, guías clínicas y datos epidemiológicos o de costos locales en fuentes oficiales.
• Soporte en Modelaje: Apoyar en la adaptación, control de calidad y actualización de modelos de impacto presupuestal y costo-efectividad.
• Desarrollo de Entregables: Colaborar en la redacción y armado de secciones técnicas de los dossiers de valor para sometimientos institucionales.
• Gestión de Información: Mantener actualizadas las bases de datos internas del área (precios, competidores, resoluciones institucionales). Quién eres:
• Educación: Estudiante activo de los últimos semestres (con al menos 6 meses a 1 año restante de carrera) en Licenciaturas de Economía, Actuaría, Matemáticas o carreras afines con un fuerte enfoque analítico.
• Habilidades Técnicas: * Manejo de Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado (fórmulas, tablas dinámicas).
• Comprensión de lectura técnica en inglés (indispensable para la revisión de artículos científicos).
• Deseable (no exclusivo): Conocimiento básico o interés en estadística o economía de la salud.
• Competencias: * Atención al detalle y rigurosidad analítica.
• Proactividad y alta capacidad de organización.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación escrita. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Key Responsibilities
• Audits expense reports submitted for reimbursement.
• Communicates with supported affiliate employees in a professional manner when corrections or clarification is required on expense report submissions.
• Ensure Travel and Expense Policy is up to date and being enforced in the Concur and TRAM systems
• Communicate and collaborate proactively with various business partners and management to resolve issues or alert of T&E or Healthcare Professionals compliance discrepancies.
• Serve as T&E representative on large or cross functional projects; lead small departmental projects or change initiatives with appropriate improvement requirements .
• Ensures best practices are shared across team members.
• Ensure all business activities comply with Travel & Expense Policy, FGAR, relevant SOPs, local guidelines.
• Ensure SLA audit and compliance principles between SSC and affiliates are met. Qualifications
• Strong ability to prioritize and organize work effectively, adhere to tight and established deadlines.
• Demonstrated communication skills with a focus on customer service.
• Knowledge of Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes.
• Effective and professional verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to perform work with limited direction and guidance.
• Ability to prioritize effectively and multitask.
• Works well with others and follow through to execute all tasks to deliver on deadlines.
• Language requirements: English, Spanish and Portuguese desirable.
• University Degree (>2 Years) in Finance, Accounting or Business Administration or equ ivalent work experience. Experience of 2+ years experience in an operational T&E or audit role. Experience with related T&E SAP systems TRAM and Concur is highly desirable. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position The P&C Enabling Support Network (ESN) is a self-organized global Network of P&C Enabling Support Specialists supporting the P&C world-wide integrated network. The P&C Enabling Support Specialist is a passionate, agile, client focused professional, located in a global support network which is the foundation of the P&C organization and enabler of its success. This position is future-oriented in business support and administration of the worldwide integrated network, connecting the dots across all functions. Your Opportunity
• Partnering with different stakeholders using agile methodologies, contributing to strategic project management, planning and managing events.
• Providing technology support and continuous improvement of processes, implementation of embedded technology within the network.
• Taking an active role in developing our self-organized P&C Enabling Support Network further, while contributing to network related initiatives and projects.
• Providing support to global, regional & local P&C colleagues on a variety of tasks and levels of complexity. (e.g. complex travel and expense management, support for large events, complex meeting structures,).
• Handle local site/chapter specific requests Line manager can also add any specifics here if appropriate.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Purpose : The Customer Care Country Expert is reporting to the Customer Care Team Manager or other Customer Care Leader and is responsible for the technical, analytical, and operational support of the area and coordinating country-related topics. She/He could assist the leader in daily people management tasks and take over deputy functions in case of leader absence. Additionally, it is providing excellent customer front-line assistance through a variety of channels and technology to patients with diabetes, caregivers, and healthcare professionals, understanding their needs and following all the systems and procedures established.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a role model and first point of reference for advisors: provide constructive technical/behavioral feedback, coaching (with the leader), training on country-specific topics, and support in quality management (call audits, documentation checks, complaint handling).

• Ensure smooth daily operations and team administration: oversee day-to-day running, communicate and follow up on operational topics, manage holidays/absences, and replace the leader in their absence.

• Support leadership on country-related topics: participate in country meetings, define and implement operational processes, distribute country tasks, monitor correct application of country procedures, identify training needs, and keep the knowledge base up to date.

• Contribute to people and performance processes: support recruitment (interviews, first selection with P&C); monitor and analyze KPIs; handle escalated customer interactions with exemplary solutions; and maintain outstanding communication with interfaces.

• Deliver high-quality customer service and continuous improvement: process complex technical and marketing-oriented customer requests (incl. diabetes-related inquiries) and complaints per quality and regulatory guidelines; manage CRM workflow objects and data in real time; gather information on new processes; and propose optimizations and special projects.

Who you are:

• Fluent in German and English (other languages a plus), with 3–5+ years’ experience in customer care or similar, ideally within Roche Diabetes Care Customer Care as Expert Advisor (CGM, DMS) and with consolidated knowledge of Roche DC products and solutions.

• Strong analytical and IT skills: role model in IT navigation and fast learning of new technologies, experienced in KPI monitoring and report building, able to develop deep product/service knowledge and work autonomously with sound, quick decision-making.

• Outstanding customer orientation and service mindset, able to handle complex requests, multitask in a dynamic environment, remain agile and flexible to changes, and engage actively in continuous improvement and learning.

• Inspirational people and communication skills: role model in listening and clear communication; understands what motivates people; conveys objectives and expectations; gives constructive feedback and recognition; and contributes positively to team spirit and a pleasant working environment.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and business mindset: proactive in suggesting improvements, actively participating in meetings, supporting team decisions, showing genuine interest in leading people, working with a teamwork attitude, having a humble growth mindset, and having schedule flexibility (including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Stiamo cercando un nuovo membro del team per l'unità di prova della velocità di imballaggio all'interno della funzione di materiali e dispositivi di imballaggio QC come parte del controllo di qualità BS/KAU. Il team Packaging Speed Testing verifica la qualità dei materiali di imballaggio (ad esempio cartoni pieghevoli, siringhe, iniettori automatici) prima che possano essere utilizzati nelle operazioni di imballaggio, sviluppo, fornitura clinica o riempimento. La possibilità
• Attuazione dei test di imballaggio secondo i requisiti di prova e i metodi di prova
• Applicazione dei metodi di prova fisici secondo i requisiti delle norme di prova
• Garantire un rigoroso rispetto della buona pratica manifatturiera (cGMP)
• Funzionamento di dispositivi semplici e inizializzazione di modelli
• Documentazione dei risultati del test nel sistema SAP. Confronto dei valori di misura con specificazione e documentazione dei risultati.
• Eseguire la revisione batch
• Gestione del progetto: progetti di miglioramento, auto-organizzazione, 5S, ottimizzazione dei processi, innovazione e investimenti
• Sviluppo dell'auto-organizzazione di entrambi i circoli
• Sviluppo organizzativo attraverso il pensiero “fuori dalla scatola” Chi sei
• Formazione tecnica con esperienza professionale pluriennale e esperienza professionale nel settore GxP
• Interessi nella comprensione di nuove relazioni tecniche
• Personalità comunicativa e decisionale con potere persuasivo e capacità di far rispettare, gioia in un'attività indipendente e di iniziativa
• Buona conoscenza dei sistemi di qualità e cGMP
• fluente tedesco nella parola e nella scrittura Pronti per il prossimo passo? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Iscriviti ora per scoprire questa entusiasmante opportunità! Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
• PARTNER NA PUTU PACIJENTA
• za teritoriju Crne Gore, sa sjedištem u Podgorici

U Roche-u vjerujemo da je ključno da isporučimo medicinska rješenja odmah, čak i kada razvijamo inovacije za budućnost. Strastveni smo po pitanju transformacije života pacijenata i neustrašivi u odlukama i akciji. I vjerujemo da dobro poslovanje znači i bolji svijet. Zato dolazimo na posao svaki dan. Posvećujemo se naučnoj tačnosti, neprikosnovenoj etici i pristupu medicinskim inovacijama za svakog. Sve to radimo danas da bismo izgradili bolje sjutra.

Partner na putu pacijenta ima ključnu ulogu u optimizaciji iskustva pacijenata kroz sve faze njihovog puta kroz zdravstveni sistem. On funkcioniše kao spona između pacijenata, zdravstvenih predstavnika, drugih zainteresovanih strana i kompanije kako bi se osiguralo da pacijenti dobiju blagovremenu njegu i podršku.

Glavni zadaci i odgovornosti radnog mjesta:

• ● Bićeš partner od povjerenja i primarna kontakt osoba između zdravstvenih predstavnika i Roche-a
• ● Definisaćeš strategiju, na osnovu spoljnih uvida u radu sa zdravstvenim predstavnicima, u cilju otkrivanja svih potencijalnih mogućnosti za poboljšanje ishoda liječenja za pacijente
• ● Donosićeš odluke koje će omogućiti unapređenja na putu pacijenta
• ● Sarađivaćeš sa zdravstvenim predstavnicima na putovanju pacijenata i iniciraćeš kampanje/projekte za povećanje mogućnosti za kreiranje vrijednosti za pacijente i zajednicu

• Potrebno je da imaš sledeće kvalifikacije:
• ✔VSS (oblast medicinskih nauka – farmaceutski, medicinski, stomatološki fakultet)
• ✔ 2-3 godine iskustva u farmaceutskoj/biotehnološkoj industriji ili u apoteci
• ✔ Imaš strateško razmišljanje i analitičke veštine
• ✔ Imaš želju da stičeš nova znanja, i dijeliš uvide sa drugima
• ✔ Imaš dobre komunikacijske vještine, timski si igrač i preuzimaš inicijativu

Ukoliko je odgovor na gore navedene zahtjeve DA, onda je ovo prava pozicija za tebe!

Ko smo mi U Roche-u, više od 100,000 ljudi u 100 zemalja pomjera granice zdravstvene zaštite. Radeći zajedno, postali smo jedna od vodećih svjetskih zdravstvenih grupa koje su fokusirane na istraživanje. Naš uspjeh se gradi na inovativnosti, radoznalosti i različitosti. Vjerujemo u moć različitosti i inkluzije i nastojimo da identifikujemo i stvorimo mogućnosti koje omogućavaju svima da pokažu svoje jedinstveno ja u Roche-u. Roche je Poslodavac jednakih mogućnosti.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position
Be part of our inclusive team at Roche Informatics, where we're driven by a shared passion for technological novelties and optimal IT solutions. As an IT Workplace Services Professional you continuously evaluate and improve the employee experience through subject matter expertise in the digital workplace, focusing on efficiency, employee satisfaction, and ensuring business continuity. This is a varied role and can give you a springboard into other careers in Informatics and beyond.

The Opportunity

• You will act as a digital enabler for our business colleagues & functions

• You act as the owner of the digital employee experience for the respective site

• You drive employee productivity through consultancy, provide intimacy and site proximity at the sites, and ensure a personalized Roche employee experience.

• You leverage available data (e.g.: Nexthink, SNOW) for proactive support

• You support and manage the Incident/ Request management processes to ensure SLAs are met and drive continuous improvement through trend analysis.

• You manage IT hardware lifecycle management & deskside support processes/managed services for the site

• You provide support & guidance for onsite services (e.g. events and meetings) by leveraging from internal and external providers. Drive the user experience and promote best practices.

• You drive and enable standard workplace infrastructure, global/local projects, and deployments in collaboration with product teams.

• You proactively address and follow through on process-improvement ideas

• You support & drive budgeting process related to the respective site

• You support local audit, inspection and certification requirements

• You support local Business Continuity and IT Disaster Recovery planning activities

Who you are:

• Exhibits a Lean-Agile Mindset

• Manages risks progressively and in a way that leads to opportunity

• Enterprise mindset that can break down silos. Focus on delivery through collaboration, and bringing people together to work towards the same purpose across organizational boundaries.

• Exhibits intellectual curiosity and integrity and has a strong passion for innovation

• Understanding of Roche-supported operating systems, devices and applications, including the Google Suite of Applications, MS Office, etc.

• Experience with ticketing systems and troubleshooting hardware, software and mobile devices.

• Excellent working knowledge of the ITIL v3 processes in an IT service delivery

• Solid written and oral communication skills in German and English.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
We are seeking a Unix Access Management Engineer (Red Hat IDM) to serve as a trusted technical leader and independent expert within our Enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) team. In this role, you will drive the design, implementation, and optimization of Unix access management infrastructure while leading the analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents. You will bridge deep technical expertise with business acumen to champion security excellence across Roche's global identity and access management infrastructure, protecting our information and assets from unauthorized access and cyber threats.

The Opportunity
This position offers a unique blend of strategic influence and hands-on technical leadership within a multicultural, global team. You will work across multiple Identity and Access Management (IAM) products, managing end-to-end security analysis tasks, leading security incidents, and fostering continuous improvement in security operations and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Unix Access Management & Infrastructure Leadership

• Lead the design, integration, and automation of Unix Access Management systems using Red Hat IDM, with Centrify product knowledge a significant advantage

• Provide strategic consultations with stakeholders to identify security requirements, design system integrations, and develop implementation roadmaps for enterprise initiatives

• Lead large-scale migrations of virtual machines to Red Hat IDM infrastructure

• Enable and strengthen Red Hat IDM infrastructure and monitoring capabilities to support high-volume VM environments across cloud and on-premises data centers globally

Security Analysis & Incident Management

• Independently lead analysis of moderately complex cybersecurity incidents and technical problems, defining security scope and driving root cause analysis

• Participate in and lead troubleshooting efforts as part of 2nd or 3rd level support with 24x7 on-call availability for major and critical issues

• Deliver comprehensive security requirements, designs, and validation of effective controls

• Apply advanced analytical reasoning to identify security patterns and threats

Stakeholder Collaboration & Advisory

• Collaborate with key business partners to understand and address their security needs and concerns

• Act as a trusted advisor, managing relationships with diverse security stakeholders across functional areas

• Define and drive stakeholder engagement strategies for complex initiatives, facilitating workshops and resolving conflicts

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

• Manage day-to-day Tier 3 operational support, performance optimization, and lifecycle management of Unix access management infrastructure

• Stay current with latest security tools, techniques, and best practices; recommend improvements and strategic enhancements

• Coach and mentor peers and junior colleagues in this technology area

• Proactively shape team processes and contribute to Communities of Practice

Technical & Process Development

• Apply CI/CD methodologies to maintain and develop infrastructure

• Implement ITIL, GxP, Product Management, and Agile Methodologies (Request, Incident, Change, and Problem Management)

• Translate business requirements into strategic implementation plans aligned with organizational objectives

• Apply tools and principles related to requirements analysis, data management, and process optimization

Additional Duties

• Occasional international travel as require

The Position
• At Roche/Genentech Pharma Product Development Global Clinical Operations (PDG), we are
• determined to transform drug development and realize our Pharma Ambition to deliver 20
• transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden by 2029.
• As a key member of our Country Study Start-Up team, you will drive and facilitate the efficient
• initiation of clinical trials, ultimately helping to deliver innovative treatments to patients. You will
• work in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment, where you have the opportunity
• to influence and shape our clinical trial delivery strategy. This is a unique opportunity to use your
• expertise to make a meaningful impact by ensuring seamless trial execution for patients,
• investigators, and clinical site staff.

The Role
• ● Lead Country Strategy: You will lead the country strategy for study start-up, driving
• efficiency, innovation, and collaboration with external stakeholders.
• ● Oversee Operations: You will oversee start-up operations to ensure timely and efficient
• site activation and regulatory compliance.
• ● Drive Process Improvements: You will identify and lead opportunities for process
• automation, standardization, and innovation at both the country and site levels.
• ● Collaborate and Harmonize: You will collaborate with regional and global counterparts
• to harmonize systems and improve timelines.
• ● Manage Clinical Trial Submissions: You will oversee the development and
• management of clinical trial submissions and amendments, ensuring regulatory
• coordination.
• ● Strategize on Budget ; Contracts: You will provide strategic oversight for all aspects
• of budgeting and contract management, including developing budget strategies and
• negotiating with internal and external stakeholders.
• ● Influence the Environment: You will participate in external industry collaborations to
• influence the countrys start-up environment.

Who You Are
• ● You have a degree (MD, PhD, MA/MS, BA/BS) in life sciences or a related field. A postgraduate degree in clinical trials or clinical research is highly desirable.
• ● You have demonstrated experience in clinical trial start-up in Spain, regulatory

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The team provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information to support the Head of Group Controlling and Accounting, Head of Strategic Finance, Pharma CFO and ultimately the CEO, the Corporate Executive Committee and the Board of Directors in value creation and financial performance management. In addition, it provides timely, accurate and decision-relevant information and analysis of actual and planned financial performance of the Pharmaceutical Division management units.

The Opportunity

The Enterprise Center of Excellence (eCoE) focuses on three areas: delivering a high-level of financial expertise, innovative insights, and an entrepreneurial mindset that enables agility and flexibility for stakeholders.
This role involves preparing presentations for the Pharma Leadership Team and Pharma Finance Leadership Team, alongside supporting the compilation of critical management reports for the Corporate Executive Committee, Board of Directors, and other key decision-makers. You will also assist in analyzing the performance of the Roche Pharma Division, generating valuable insights, and contributing to various ad-hoc financial projects, ensuring all reports are updated and continuously enhanced. Furthermore, you will assist in the preparation of evidence and supporting documents to back-up the reported financial results.

Who You are:

• You are currently enrolled at University studying Finance / Economics or a similar degree, or you completed your degree within the past 12 months prior to the start date.

• You are someone who wants to influence your own development and you are an enthusiastic team player who enjoys working in a global and dynamic environment.

• You are looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests across functions.

• Exceptional Analytical and Technical Proficiency: Possess strong analytical skills, quick perception, and a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail. This includes advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VBA is a plus) and PowerPoint, as well as Google Sheets and Google Slides.

• Adaptability and Resilience: Demonstrate an accurate working style and the ability to perform effectively under pressure and within tight timelines, coupled with an open-minded and flexible attitude.

• Strong Communication and Language Skills: Exhibit excellent command of English, enabling clear and effective communication within a global environment.

• High Motivation and Continuous Learning Mindset: Show outstanding motivation and a strong willingness to continuously learn and develop, reflecting a genuine interest in Finance.

• Proactive and Improvement-Oriented Approach: A growth mindset with a passion for improving the status quo is highly valued, as are IT skills for introducing automation.

Application process:

• Please upload your current CV and a Motivation Letter, where you indicate your preferred start date of the internship.

Additional Information:

• Please note, due to regulations, non-EU/EFTA citizens must provide a certificate from the university stating that an internship is mandatory as part of the application documents, and must be continuously enrolled in their university for the whole duration of this internship.

• Part-time employment is not possible.

• Earliest start date: 1 August 2026 or upon availability

• Duration: 12 months, full- time (40 hours/ week)

• Location: Basel

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Hoover, AL is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care.

This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses.

The Opportunity:
Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:

• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.

• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.

• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.

• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.

• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.

• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction.

This field-based role requires up to 25% travel. This person will support Hoover, AL.

Who You Are:

• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience

• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking

• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy

• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required

Preferred Qualifications:

• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.

• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.

• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Hoover, AL is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below.

title: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery

titleByLocale.en: Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.it: Capo Team PT Insights & Data Delivery
titleByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe PT Insights & Data Delivery

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
The Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery (Product Manager) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape.
Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards.

Description of the area
PT Insights and Data Delivery focuses on the reliable delivery of high quality data combined with the use of data in analytics solutions for both existing and anticipatory business needs with a cross-functional scope and mandate.
The role will lead a team of over 20 people to bring the following key benefits to PT

• Reusable and scalable systems that are efficiently operated

• Faster and more robust solutions to meet business challenges

• Reliable delivery of key metrics and performance indicators

• Identifying areas for cost savings and where to invest

• Data/evidence driven decisions

• Process enabling efficient maintenance of reliable enterprise data

The role will need knowledge and experience in the following areas
Analytics excellence for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• Supports business process from Make, Assess to Release

• GMP and Non-GMP Reporting

• Different Levels of Views (Helicopter vs Front Line)

• Enhanced Business Planning

• Self service reporting

• Reducing workload for knowledge workers

• Drive towards actionable insights

• Reliable key performance indicators and metrics

• Comparison across manufacturing sites

Data Delivery for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• Reliable and high quality delivery of core manufacturing, supply chain and quality dataDevelopment and support of FAIR data pipelines and data products across PT

• Efficient and reliable DataOps

• Brings together information from multiple systems, so that interdependencies between data can be managed and resolved

Job Responsibilities

• Strategy & Vision
Accountable for setting the direction for a product and ensuring that it achieves defined outcomes and financial objectives. Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

• Customer-Centricity
Actively collect, understand, and prioritize the needs of internal users. Act as the primary owner of the “customer's” problem and be responsible for defining and delivering a solution that provides tangible value. Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.

• Product Lifecycle Mgmt.
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, guide its development, and manage its gro

title: Strategic Alliance Manager - Custom Biotech - LA / San Diego Region

titleByLocale.it: Strategic Alliance Manager - Custom Biotech - LA / Regione di San Diego
titleByLocale.en: Strategic Alliance Manager - Custom Biotech - LA / San Diego Region
titleByLocale.de: Manager der strategischen Allianz – Custom Biotech – LA / San Diego Region
titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d'alliance stratégique - Biotech personnalisée - LA / San Diego Region

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Un futuro più sano. È ciò che ci spinge a innovare. Per avanzare continuamente la scienza e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute di cui hanno bisogno oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Creare un mondo in cui tutti abbiamo più tempo con le persone che amiamo. Questo è ciò che ci rende Roche. L'opportunità: Basato su oltre 30 anni di esperienza nel settore, Roche Custom Biotech utilizza le potenti competenze multidisciplinari che si trovano nelle strutture Roche di tutto il mondo. Il team offre prodotti e soluzioni per i produttori nel settore della diagnostica e della biotecnologia, che vanno dalle materie prime alle soluzioni di sistema per il bioprocessing. Sfruttando il know-how unico di Roche Diagnostics e Roche Pharmaceuticals, i nostri Strategic Alliance Managers lavorano per collaborare con i leader nei mercati di diagnostica biofarmaceutica, cellulare o in vitro per consentire offerte di approvvigionamento strategico. Lo Strategic Alliance Manager è responsabile per la costruzione, la gestione e l'ottimizzazione dei rapporti con i principali partner strategici, assicurando che le partnership si allineano con gli obiettivi aziendali globali dell'azienda. Questo ruolo coinvolge la collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni per guidare iniziative congiunte, massimizzare il valore dei partenariati e promuovere la crescita strategica dell'azienda nei mercati diagnostici biofarmaceutici e molecolari.
• Identificare, valutare e stabilire alleanze strategiche con le aziende farmaceutiche, le imprese di biotecnologia, le organizzazioni di ricerca e altri partner rilevanti sulle opportunità nuove e esistenti.
• Promuovere relazioni forti con i partner esistenti, lavorando a stretto contatto con il vostro leader, Key Account Executives, garantendo una comunicazione coerente, fiducia e allineamento degli obiettivi. Pianificazione e esecuzione strategica
• Collaborare con team interni (ad esempio, leadership di vendita, sviluppo aziendale, regolamentazione, R&D, marketing) per definire obiettivi di partnership e metriche di successo.
• Sviluppare piani di business e strategie per massimizzare il valore delle partnership in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Monitorare e valutare i risultati dell'alleanza, formulando raccomandazioni basate sui dati per migliorare le prestazioni e affrontare le sfide. Collaborazione interfunzionale
• Agire come collegamento tra l'organizzazione e le aziende partner, garantendo una comunicazione e un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità.
• Collaborare con il team di vendita attraverso la rete, l'identificazione del piombo, ecc.
• Coordinare i team interni a fornire impegni di partenariato e pietre miliari, quali progetti di cooperazione, opportunità di licenze congiunte o strategie di immissione sul mercato.
• Sostenere gli sforzi normativi, operativi e logistici legati agli accordi di partenariato. Analisi del mercato & Identificazione delle opportunità
• Condurre l'intelligenza competitiva e il benchmarking del settore per identificare le opportunità di partenariato nei nuovi e emergenti mercati farmaceutici.
• Resta aggiornato sulle tendenze, i progressi tecnologici e i cambiamenti normativi del settore per identificare potenziali nuove partnership o opportunità di espansione. Risoluzione dei problemi e gestione dei rischi
• Affrontare conflitti o sfide in partnership con un approccio orientato alle soluzioni, garantendo un buon progresso verso obiettivi reciproci.
• Monitorare e mitigare i rischi associati alle alleanze, inclusi i rischi di mercato, legale e finanziario. Reporting & Performance Monitoring
• Preparare e presentare recensioni trimestrali e aggiornamenti alla gestione senior o agli stakeholder chiave, evidenziando le prestazioni del partenariato e le raccomandazioni future. Questa è una posizione basata sul campo. Il territorio è all'interno

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity: Building on over 30 years of industry experience, Roche Custom Biotech uses the powerful multidisciplinary skills found in Roche facilities across the world. The team offers products and solutions for manufacturers in the diagnostics and pharma biotech industry, ranging from raw materials to system solutions for bioprocessing. Leveraging the unique know-how of Roche Diagnostics and Roche Pharmaceuticals, our Strategic Alliance Managers work to partner with leaders in the biopharmaceutical, cell therapy, or in vitro diagnostics markets to enable strategic sourcing deals. The Strategic Alliance Manager is responsible for building, managing, and optimizing relationships with key strategic partners, ensuring that partnerships align with the company's overall business objectives. This role involves collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to drive joint initiatives, maximize value from partnerships, and promote the company's strategic growth in the biopharmaceutical and molecular diagnostic markets. The Opportunity:
• Identify, evaluate, and establish strategic alliances with pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, research organizations, and other relevant partners on new and existing opportunities.
• Foster strong relationships with existing partners, working closely with your leader, Key Account Executives, ensuring consistent communication, trust, and alignment of goals. Strategic Planning & Execution
• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., sales leadership, business development, regulatory, R&D, marketing) to define partnership objectives and success metrics.
• Develop business plans and strategies to maximize the value of partnerships in line with company goals.
• Monitor and evaluate alliance results, making data-driven recommendations to improve performance and address challenges. Cross-functional Collaboration
• Act as the liaison between the organization and partner companies, ensuring seamless communication and coordination.
• Collaborate with the sales team through networking, lead identification, etc.
• Coordinate internal teams to deliver on partnership commitments and milestones, such as co-development projects, joint licensing opportunities, or market entry strategies.
• Support regulatory, operational, and logistical efforts linked to partnership agreements. Market Analysis & Opportunity Identification
• Conduct competitive intelligence and industry benchmarking to identify partnership opportunities in new and emerging pharmaceutical markets.
• Stay updated on trends, technological advancements, and regulatory changes in the industry to identify potential new partnerships or expansion opportunities. Issue Resolution & Risk Management
• Address conflicts or challenges in partnerships with a solutions-oriented approach, ensuring smooth progress toward mutual objectives.
• Monitor and mitigate risks associated with alliances, including market, legal, and financial risks. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns zur Innovation. Um die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zu der Gesundheitsversorgung hat, die sie heute und für Generationen benötigen. Erstellen einer Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben. Das macht uns Roche. Die Gelegenheit: Ausgehend von über 30 Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie nutzt Roche Custom Biotech die leistungsfähigen multidisziplinären Fähigkeiten, die in Roche-Einrichtungen auf der ganzen Welt gefunden werden. Das Team bietet Produkte und Lösungen für Hersteller in der Diagnostik- und Pharma-Biotech-Industrie, von Rohstoffen bis hin zu Systemlösungen für die Bioverarbeitung. Mit dem einzigartigen Know-how von Roche Diagnostics und Roche Pharmaceuticals arbeiten unsere Strategic Alliance Manager zusammen, um mit Führungskräften in den Bereichen Biopharmazeutika, Zelltherapie oder in vitro Diagnostik zusammenzuarbeiten, um strategische Beschaffungsangebote zu ermöglichen. Der Strategic Alliance Manager ist für den Aufbau, das Management und die Optimierung von Beziehungen zu strategischen Partnern verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass Partnerschaften mit den allgemeinen Geschäftszielen des Unternehmens übereinstimmen. Diese Rolle beinhaltet die Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Akteuren, um gemeinsame Initiativen zu fördern, den Wert von Partnerschaften zu maximieren und das strategische Wachstum des Unternehmens in den biopharmazeutischen und molekularen Diagnostikmärkten zu fördern.
• strategische Allianzen mit Pharmaunternehmen, Biotechnologieunternehmen, Forschungsorganisationen und anderen relevanten Partnern über neue und bestehende Möglichkeiten identifizieren, bewerten und etablieren.
• Fokus starke Beziehungen zu bestehenden Partnern, eng mit Ihrem führenden, Key Account Executives zusammenarbeiten, um eine konsequente Kommunikation, Vertrauen und Ausrichtung von Zielen zu gewährleisten. Strategische Planung & Ausführung
• Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (z.B. Vertrieb, Geschäftsentwicklung, Regulierung, F&D, Marketing) zur Festlegung von Partnerschaftszielen und Erfolgsmetriken.
• Entwicklung von Geschäftsplänen und Strategien, um den Wert von Partnerschaften entsprechend den Unternehmenszielen zu maximieren.
• Überwachen und bewerten Sie die Ergebnisse der Allianz, indem Sie datengesteuerte Empfehlungen zur Verbesserung der Leistungsfähigkeit und der Bewältigung von Herausforderungen machen. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit
• Aktivieren Sie die Verbindung zwischen Organisation und Partnerunternehmen, um eine nahtlose Kommunikation und Koordination zu gewährleisten.
• Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam durch Vernetzung, Lead-Identifizierung usw.
• Koordinierte interne Teams, um Partnerschaftsverpflichtungen und Meilensteine wie Ko-Entwicklungsprojekte, gemeinsame Lizenzmöglichkeiten oder Markteintrittsstrategien zu liefern.

L'équipe propose des produits et des solutions aux fabricants de l'industrie du diagnostic et de la biotechnologie pharmaceutique, allant des matières premières aux solutions système pour le biotraitement. Forts du savoir-faire unique de Roche Diagnostics et de Roche Pharmaceuticals, nos gestionnaires d'alliances stratégiques collaborent avec des leaders des marchés biopharmaceutiques, de la thérapie cellulaire ou du diagnostic in vitro pour permettre des contrats d'approvisionnement stratégique. Le gestionnaire de l'Alliance stratégique est chargé d'établir, de gérer et d'optimiser les relations avec les principaux partenaires stratégiques, en veillant à ce que les partenariats cadrent avec les objectifs généraux de l'entreprise. Ce rôle implique la collaboration avec les intervenants internes et externes pour mener des initiatives conjointes, maximiser la valeur des partenariats et promouvoir la croissance stratégique de l'entreprise sur les marchés du diagnostic biopharmaceutique et moléculaire.

• Élaborer des plans d'affaires et des stratégies pour maximiser la valeur des partenariats conformément aux objectifs de l'entreprise.
• Surveiller et évaluer les résultats de l'alliance, en formulant des recommandations fondées sur les données pour améliorer les performances et relever les défis. Collaboration interfonctionnelle

• Collaborer avec l'équipe commerciale par le biais de la mise en réseau, de l'identification des dirigeants, etc.
• Coordonner les équipes internes pour respecter les engagements de partenariat et les jalons, tels que les projets de codéveloppement, les possibilités d'octroi de licences conjointes ou les stratégies d'entrée sur le marché.
• Soutenir les efforts réglementaires, opérationnels et logistiques liés aux accords de partenariat. Analyse de marché et identification des possibilités
• Mener des activités de veille concurrentielle et de benchmarking pour identifier les possibilités de partenariat sur les marchés pharmaceutiques nouveaux et émergents.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Job Description / Description of the Area Experience- 7+ years Work Location- Baner, Pune We are seeking a skilled and motivated Senior Developer with strong experience in MuleSoft to support the design, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration services. The successful candidate will be responsible for building scalable, secure, and reliable integrations across business-critical systems and platforms. This role combines hands-on development, solution design, API-led connectivity, troubleshooting, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery support within a complex enterprise environment. Key Responsibilities Design and Development
• Design, develop, and maintain integration solutions using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
• Build reusable System, Process, and Experience APIs following API-led connectivity principles.
• Develop integrations between enterprise platforms, cloud services, SaaS applications, and on-premise systems.
• Create reusable assets, shared templates, and accelerators to improve delivery efficiency.
• Contribute to solution architecture decisions focused on scalability, security, maintainability, and performance. API and Platform Engineering
• Design and implement REST, SOAP, asynchronous, file-based, and event-driven integration patterns.
• Develop complex transformations using DataWeave for JSON, XML, CSV, flat-file, and canonical data models.
• Configure API policies for authentication, rate limiting, client enforcement, logging, and threat protection.
• Manage deployments through CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, or hybrid runtimes.
• Use Anypoint Exchange, API Manager, Runtime Manager, Monitoring, Secrets Manager, and related platform services.
• Optimize performance, resilience, error handling, retry logic, and observability of integrations. Support and Operations
• Provide advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis for production incidents and platform issues.
• Support release, deployment, change, and environment management activities.
• Monitor integration platform health and proactively address risks or service degradation.
• Ensure documentation of technical solutions, runbooks, and support procedures. Collaboration and Delivery Support
• Work closely with architects, analysts, product teams, infrastructure teams, security, and business stakeholders.
• Translate business requirements into robust technical integration solutions.
• Support agile delivery ceremonies, planning sessions, estimations, and technical reviews.
• Mentor junior developers and contribute to team capability growth. Continuous Improvement
• Identify opportunities for simplification, modernization, automation, and reuse.
• Stay informed on integration trends, cloud-native architectures, and emerging technologies.
• Promote engineering excellence, coding standards, and secure development practices. Experience
• Proven experience as a Senior Developer, Integration Developer, or similar role.
• Strong hands-on experience delivering solutions on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
• Proven experience designing and building APIs in enterprise environments.
• Experience integrating ERP, CRM, identity, data, or other core enterprise platforms.
• Experience working in complex enterprise delivery environments with multiple stakeholders.
• Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, finance, or similar sectors is highly valued. Technical Skills
• Strong experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Studio, API M
