descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta.

La posizione
Foodlicious è la nostra attività quotidiana
In oltre 30 anni, Taverne Roche ha sviluppato un'azienda gastronomica di successo. Tavero AG è una controllata al 100% di F. Hoffmann-La Roche.
Nei siti di Basilea e Kaiseraugst, utilizziamo circa 350 persone provenienti da oltre 37 nazioni. La nostra offerta comprende sia ristoranti di personale che vivono la diversità, e ristoranti di Fine Dining con cucina su misura e un servizio eccellente. Inoltre, offriamo ristoranti con prelibatezze da tutto il mondo, caffè in tutte le varianti, incantato dai nostri baristi, così come i saloni più alti in Svizzera – posti di lavoro fantastici sui tetti della città. Grab'n'Go offre da sushi a Burger e il primo e unico club nella storia di Roche completano la nostra offerta.
Inoltre, offriamo ai nostri ospiti sala riunioni e catering per eventi fino a 1.500 persone. La gastronomia pubblica, lo Schöpfli nel parco e il Chez Jeannot nel Museo Tinguely completano la nostra offerta.

Stiamo cercando un:n Employee Staff Restaurant per Tavero AG a Kaiseraugst.

Principali compiti:

• Potting speditivo al buffet e fornisce costantemente cibo e bevande

• Correggere informazioni sull'offerta nel suo punto vendita/vendita

• Contrariamente a richieste speciali

• Esperienza di cash system

• Pulizia giornaliera e collaborazione nella lavanderia

• Alta soddisfazione del cliente

• disponibilità a ricevere benefici speciali al di fuori delle normali ore di lavoro

• Co-responsabile per il rispetto dei requisiti di igiene e sicurezza

• Ore lavorative: Mo-Fr per circa 2 - 3h/giorno (frame: 10.15 – 13.00)

Profilo dei requisiti:

• Esperienza nella zona di gastronomia e ufficio di almeno 2 anni

• La gastronomia è la vostra passione e gli ospiti soddisfatti sono la vostra destinazione quotidiana

• Sei flessibile e pronto per serate e fine settimana occasionali

• Buona gestione e sicurezza

• Lavoro autonomo, flessibile e organizzato

• Teamplayer

• In un mondo digitale, vogliamo anche garantire una gestione sicura dei programmi informatici (MS Office)

• Buone competenze linguistiche orali e scritte in tedesco, abilità inglesi di vantaggio

Chi siamo
Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100’000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati alla scienza avanzata, assicurando che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Potenziamo l'un l'altro per esplorare nuove possibilità, promuovere la creatività e mantenere alti i nostri ambiziosi, in modo da poter fornire soluzioni sanitarie che cambiano la vita che rendono un impatto globale.

Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme.

Roche è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

La nourriture est notre affaire quotidienne
En plus de 30 ans, Taverne Roche a développé une entreprise gastronomique prospère. Tavero AG est une filiale à 100% de F. Hoffmann-La Roche.
Sur les sites de Bâle et Kaiseraugst, nous employons environ 350 personnes de plus de 37 pays. Notre offre comprend à la fois des restaurants du personnel qui vivent la diversité, et des restaurants gastronomiques avec une cuisine haut de gamme et un excellent service. En outre, nous offrons des restaurants avec des spécialités du monde entier, du café dans toutes les variantes, enchantés par nos baristi, ainsi que les salons les plus haut de gamme en Suisse – des endroits fantastiques après le travail sur les toits de la ville. Grab'n'Go offre des sushis à Burger et le premier et seul club de l'histoire de Roche complète notre offre.
En outre, nous offrons à nos invités une salle de réunion et un événement pour accueillir jusqu'à 1 500 personnes. La gastronomie publique, le Schöpfli dans le parc et le Chez Jeannot dans le Musée Tinguely complètent notre offre.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un:n Staff Restaurant pour Tavero AG à Kaiseraugst.

Principales tâches:

• Potage spéditive au buffet et fourniture constante de nourriture et de boissons

• Des informations correctes sur l'offre dans son point de vente

• Contrairement aux demandes spéciales

• Système de trésorerie d'expérience

• Nettoyage quotidien et coopération dans la buanderie

• Haute satisfaction de la clientèle

• disponibilité à recevoir des prestations spéciales en dehors des heures de travail habituelles

• Co-responsable du respect des exigences d'hygiène et de sécurité

• Heures de travail: Mo-Fr pour environ 2 - 3h/jour (cadre: 10.15 – 13.00)

Profil des exigences:

• Expérience en gastronomie et bureau depuis au moins 2 ans

• Gastronomie est votre passion et les invités satisfaits sont votre destination quotidienne

• Vous êtes flexible et prêt pour des soirées et des week-ends occasionnels

• Manipulation saine et sûre

• Travail indépendant, travail flexible et organisé

• Joueur d'équipe

• Dans un monde numérique, nous souhaitons également assurer un traitement sûr des programmes informatiques (MS Office)

• Bonnes compétences en langue orale et écrite en allemand, compétences en anglais d'avantage

Qui nous sommes
Un avenir plus sain nous pousse à innover. Ensemble, plus de 100 000 employés à travers le monde se consacrent à faire progresser la science, assurant à chacun l'accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Nos efforts se traduisent par plus de 26 millions de personnes traitées avec nos médicaments et plus de 30 milliards de tests réalisés avec nos produits Diagnostics. Nous nous autorisons mutuellement à explorer de nouvelles possibilités, à encourager la créativité et à maintenir nos ambitions au plus haut niveau, afin de pouvoir offrir des solutions de santé qui changent la vie et qui ont un impact mondial.

Construisons ensemble un avenir plus sain.

Roche est un employeur à chances égales.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
职位名称：（高级）治疗领域专员

您是谁：
（高级）治疗领域专员是公司与相应疾病领域医生的主要接触点,发掘和管理内外部资源,通过各种学术活动、推广或非推广活动把罗氏的专业知识、科学和技术、产品关键信息带入生态系统,准确及时的传达给客户,并与客户和合作伙伴共同发现潜在的合作机会,以改善对患者旅程的影响,实现患者最终获益。

您的机会：
客户管理
1. 与关键客户建立良好的信息沟通渠道, 探寻医疗卫生专业人士(HCP)观念、学术需求
2. 传递专业化医学/疾病/产品信息

学科建设
1. 了解医院现有疾病领域诊疗路径及专家诊疗观念及流程
2. 梳理相关治疗科室及诊疗流程上的痛点

计划管理
1. 组织和支持区域专家会议
2.了解医生观念、需求、会议安排;制定会议及覆盖计划;执行会议计划;回访收集反馈

规范诊疗与疾病全程管理
1. 推动专家的诊疗观念及行为转变,实现规范化诊疗
2. 和患者解决方案经理协同合作,关注并推动疾病领域全程管理和治疗方案优化

自我管理和团队协作
1. 成为产品和疾病领域的专家
2. 对团队新成员提供辅导和支持

我们期待这样的您加入：
• 具备相关疾病领域的基础知识
• 良好学习能力
• 业务敏锐度
•3 年以上医药行业工作经验
•既往有销售/市场/医学经验
•医学或药学相关本科及以上学历

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni

La posizione di Field Engineering Specialist (FES) nel gruppo Roche Support Network offre l'opportunità di viaggiare e dimostrare la propria esperienza come specialista di riparazione e/o installazione tecnica per le linee di prodotti assegnate da Roche, assegnato un servizio di valore ai propri clienti del laboratorio in un territorio assegnato. Il FES serve come specialista di riparazione o installazione per i prodotti Roche per le linee di prodotti e le géographique assegnate.

Requisiti

- Deve essere situato a meno di 30 miglia da Scranton, Pennsylvania. Questa è una posizione campo e potrebbe richiedere di essere reperibile alcuni giorni.
- insegna supporto tecnico di routine ai clienti sulle operazioni e gli aspetti di manutenzione del sistema di attrezzature.
- Esegue servizi, riparazioni e/o installazioni sul posto dei prodotti dell'azienda. Ciò può includere qualsiasi aspetto di supporto campo e non è limitato a meccanico/hardware del sistema, software, networking/wireless networking.
- Serve come punto di contatto del cliente per problemi tecnici e di servizio di routine.
- Programma esegue la manutenzione preventiva secondo la politica del dipartimento.
- Monitora le prestazioni dell'attrezzatura del cliente e può rispondere e risolvere la maggior parte dei problemi di routine.
- Rinvia i problemi complessi a livelli superiori.
- Riceve formazione e fornisce servizi nell'ambito normale della posizione.
- Segue le pratiche, le politiche e le procedure documentate nel fornire il supporto di riparazione e installazione.
- Diagnostica i guasti meccanici, hardware, software e del sistema, utilizzando le procedure di regolazione.
- Determina la riparazione/resuzione più economica per minimizzare il tempo di inattività del cliente.
- insegnae analisi, feedback e competenze sulle tendenze di guasto del prodotto e sui problemi di servizio.
- Documenta tutte le attività in modo conforme alle procedure di qualità dell'azienda.
- È responsabile del mantenimento e dell miglioramento continuo del sistema di qualità e dell'ottenimento degli obiettivi di qualità attraverso le azioni quotidiane.
- È responsabile dell'assicurazione e del massimo della soddisfazione del cliente con l'attrezzatura Roche e i prodotti correlati.
- Promuove la comunicazione efficace, positiva e produttiva tra i membri del team per garantire e massimizzare la soddisfazione della base dei clienti.
- Gestisce i conti dei clienti a un livello che promuove la buona volontà, la fiducia e la credibilità per superare le aspettative del cliente in termini di qualità del prodotto, servizio e supporto.
- Identifica le opportunità di generazione di entrate e di risparmio sui costi, la realizzazione politica degli strumenti di servizio di Roche Diagnostics e cerca opportunità per promuovere i contratti di servizio ai clienti esistenti.

Cosa?

- Un ambiente di lavoro in cui puoi mostrare il tuo vero io, essere apprezzato per le tue qualità uniche e prosperare sia a livello personale che professionale.
- L'opportunità di lavorare aree in un'azienda di successo che offre interessanti opportunità di carriera e supporta lo sviluppo delle tue di interesse.
- Un impegno a creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati ed empowerment è un'esperienza quotidiana.

Contatto

Per ulteriori informazioni o per candidarsi, visita il nostro sito web o contatta il nostro ufficio delle risorse umane.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 职位名称：罗氏制药生物统计分析实习生 工作地点：上海 实习部门/团队介绍: 整合证据生成与合规团队 (Integrated Evidence Generation and Compliance) 隶属医学事务部，致力于整合临床与真实世界数据，通过科学研究填补证据缺口，论证产品医学价值，赋能医学策略与临床决策。 加入该项目你将：
• 深度参与前沿研究： 与统计师及数据科学家协作，处理多元化的真实世界数据，支持高标准的医学证据生成。
• 统计分析实战： 运用常规及探索性统计方法，完成从数据清洗、标准化到核心分析代码（SAS/R）的编写与调试。
• 工具创新与优化： 运行并优化现有分析工具，针对特定医学需求开发自动化分析插件或模型。
• 数据洞察可视化： 参与构建数据可视化看板（Tableau），将复杂结果转化为直观的科学洞察。 我们期待这样的你：
• 专业背景： 公共卫生、生物统计学、数据科学或相关专业在校研究生。
• 技术能力： 熟练掌握 SAS 或 R 语言进行统计建模；具备 Tableau / PowerBI 经验者优先。
• 办公技能： 精通 Excel（数据处理）及 PPT（可视化呈现）。
• 时间要求： 7月至9月期间，每周至少保证 3天 线下办公（到岗）。
• 核心素质： 具备严谨的科学思维、出色的逻辑分析能力及良好的团队协作精神。 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Job Purpose : The Customer Care Country Expert is reporting to the Customer Care Team Manager or other Customer Care Leader and is responsible for the technical, analytical, and operational support of the area and coordinating country-related topics. She/He could assist the leader in daily people management tasks and take over deputy functions in case of leader absence. Additionally, it is providing excellent customer front-line assistance through a variety of channels and technology to patients with diabetes, caregivers, and healthcare professionals, understanding their needs and following all the systems and procedures established.

The Opportunity:

• Act as a role model and first point of reference for advisors: provide constructive technical/behavioral feedback, coaching (with the leader), training on country-specific topics, and support in quality management (call audits, documentation checks, complaint handling).

• Ensure smooth daily operations and team administration: oversee day-to-day running, communicate and follow up on operational topics, manage holidays/absences, and replace the leader in their absence.

• Support leadership on country-related topics: participate in country meetings, define and implement operational processes, distribute country tasks, monitor correct application of country procedures, identify training needs, and keep the knowledge base up to date.

• Contribute to people and performance processes: support recruitment (interviews, first selection with P&C); monitor and analyze KPIs; handle escalated customer interactions with exemplary solutions; and maintain outstanding communication with interfaces.

• Deliver high-quality customer service and continuous improvement: process complex technical and marketing-oriented customer requests (incl. diabetes-related inquiries) and complaints per quality and regulatory guidelines; manage CRM workflow objects and data in real time; gather information on new processes; and propose optimizations and special projects.

Who you are:

• Fluent in German and English (other languages a plus), with 3–5+ years’ experience in customer care or similar, ideally within Roche Diabetes Care Customer Care as Expert Advisor (CGM, DMS) and with consolidated knowledge of Roche DC products and solutions.

• Strong analytical and IT skills: role model in IT navigation and fast learning of new technologies, experienced in KPI monitoring and report building, able to develop deep product/service knowledge and work autonomously with sound, quick decision-making.

• Outstanding customer orientation and service mindset, able to handle complex requests, multitask in a dynamic environment, remain agile and flexible to changes, and engage actively in continuous improvement and learning.

• Inspirational people and communication skills: role model in listening and clear communication; understands what motivates people; conveys objectives and expectations; gives constructive feedback and recognition; and contributes positively to team spirit and a pleasant working environment.

• Demonstrated leadership potential and business mindset: proactive in suggesting improvements, actively participating in meetings, supporting team decisions, showing genuine interest in leading people, working with a teamwork attitude, having a humble growth mindset, and having schedule flexibility (including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Wir sind Roche

Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche.

Hinter jeder Diagnose steht ein Mensch und seine Geschichte. Deshalb ist es unser Ziel bei Roche, Patienten und deren Angehörige auf ihrem Weg ideal zu begleiten.

Werde Teil eines unserer Lifecycle Teams in Near Patient Care ! Die herausragende Vielfalt der angewandten Technologien bietet dir großartige Lernmöglichkeiten. Gemeinsam mit dir wollen wir jetzt schon tun, was Patienten als nächstes benötigen!

In deiner Funktion als Produktionsmitarbeiter/Operator im Bereich NPC Internal Manufacturing Mannheim bist du primär für das Bedienen komplexer Produktionseinrichtungen zuständig.

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du bedienst Bereichsübergreifend Abfüll-, Etikettier,- Fertigungs- und Verpackungsanlagen zur Produktion von diagnostischen Produkten

• Das prüfst die zur Produktion eingesetzten Komponenten sowie die Reinigung der Produktionsanlagen und Betriebsmittel unter Berücksichtigung geltender Arbeitsanweisungen

• Gemäß geltender Regularien führst du Inprozesskontrollen durch und dokumentierst diese GMP-konform

• Durch Deine aktive Mitarbeit erkennst Du auftretende Qualitätsmängel, führst vorgeschriebene Stichprobenprüfungen, Musterziehungen und optische Kontrollen durch und arbeitest aktiv am kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess mit.

• Du behebst einfache technische Störungen und übernimmst einfache Umrüstungen

• Alle Aufgaben führst Du unter Beachtung der Arbeitsanweisungen, Hygienevorschriften, Arbeitsschutz-, GMP- und Umweltschutzregeln durch

• Das Arbeiten mit einer FFP3- Maske und einem Gebläse-Atemschutz stellt für Dich kein Problem dar.

• Ver- und Entsorgung der Produktionsbetriebe durch Materialanforderung/-transport, die sachgerechte Kennzeichnung sowie die Entsorgung des Materials liegen in deiner Verantwortung. Dabei nutzt Du manuelle und/oder angetriebene Transportmittel.

• Die Tätigkeit erfordert ständiges Stehen und das tägliche, regelmäßige Heben und Bewegen von schweren Lasten bis 15 kg (unter Umständen bis 28kg).

Das bringst Du mit:

• Eine Berufsausbildung hast Du erfolgreich abgeschlossen und besitzt mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einem Produktions- oder Verpackungsbetrieb

• Mit Deinem technischen Geschick überzeugst Du ebenso wie mit Deinen detaillierten Kenntnissen über die zu bedienenden Produktionsanlagen.

• Du verfügst über gute GMP-Kenntnisse sowie über praktische Erfahrung im Arbeiten in Bereichen mit besonderen Hygieneanforderungen (z. B. Produktion in einem Reinraum ISO 8 oder höher).

• Du bringst vertiefte Kenntnisse über manuelle Arbeit mit Kleinteilen in der Musterfertigung mit und hast bereits Erfahrung mit Arbeit an Messmikroskop

• In den gängigen Google Suite und MS Office Programmen bist Du sicher. Auch der sichere Umgang mit SAP und MES ist für Dich kein Problem. Du hast ein Grundverständnis für elektronische Abbildungen in prozessgesteuerten Anlagen.

• Deine Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in verschiedenen Produktionsteams sowie Dein Engagement zeichnet Dich aus.

• Du verfügst über Transportkenntnisse mit Flurförderfahrzeugen oder Gabelstapler.

• Du arbeitest gerne in wechselnden Arbeitszeiten (3-Schicht), um auf Produktionsänderungen entsprechend flexibel reagieren zu können. Auch die Bereitschaft zur Wochenendarbeit ist

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche , estamos comprometidos con la excelencia en el área de Neurociencias. Buscamos un profesional con visión estratégica y capacidad analítica para integrarse como Marketing Specialists para el portafolio de Neurociencias. Este rol es una pieza clave en la coordinación transfuncional para el diseño, ejecución y éxito de las estrategias de mercadotecnia en todo el ciclo de vida del producto. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Strategic Execution: Brindar soporte en la implementación de estrategias de portafolio, segmentación y targeting, colaborando estrechamente con Patient Journey Partners (PJP) para asegurar el posicionamiento de marca.
• Business Intelligence & Forecasting: Desarrollo de pronósticos mensuales de ventas y pacientes por canal, realizando un seguimiento riguroso de indicadores clave (KPIs) frente a los objetivos establecidos.
• Product Launch & Pipeline: Asegurar la ejecución impecable de lanzamientos y extensiones de línea, gestionando la logística y la administración presupuestaria (P&L).
• Compliance & Content Creation: Desarrollar materiales promocionales y de entrenamiento bajo estrictos estándares de Compliance , gestionando el proceso de aprobación e implementación en sistemas como Veeva .
• Stakeholder Management: Coordinar esfuerzos con áreas cross-funcionales (Médico, Comercial, Legal y Finanzas) y gestionar relaciones con proveedores estratégicos para Market Research.
• Operational Excellence: Liderar la planificación y ejecución logística de eventos de educación médica continua y programas de pacientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de tiempos y presupuestos.
• Digital Marketing: Generar materiales y colaborar en la estrategia omnichannel en conjunto con el Marketing Manager, para lograr el mejor impacto de la estrategia. Tu perfil: Buscamos candidatos con un alto sentido de responsabilidad, atención al detalle y mentalidad de crecimiento:
• Licenciaturas económicas administrativas, ingenieras industriales o afines
• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (capacidad de interactuar en entornos globales).
• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica. Dominio de google environment, paqueteria microsoft, capacidad de análisis de datos y comprensión de auditorías de mercado.
• Manejo de Veeva, SAP, Simple buy es un diferencial
• Comunicación asertiva e influencia. Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados. Resiliencia y gestión del cambio.
• Capacidad de colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.it: Safety Process Direttore / Senior Safety Process Direttore

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a member of the Safety Development & Processes (SDP) team within Product Development Safety, you will lead the evolution of global processes that enable world-class safety and vigilance activities across Roche’s drug and device development portfolio.. In this influential role, you will operate as a Global Process Owner or senior subject-matter expert, shaping the frameworks that underpin our safety activities for medicines, devices, and digital health solutions. You will drive strategic innovation and process excellence to ensure Roche remains at the forefront of patient safety and regulatory compliance. The Opportunity As the Safety Process Director / Senior Director, you will design and govern the global operating models that translate complex safety requirements into scalable, high-impact clinical and post-marketing practices. This role is internally known as Safety Process Director/Senior Director.
• Lead the design and continuous improvement of global safety processes, ensuring they remain robust, agile, and aligned with industry-leading standards.
• Act as a Global Process Owner or senior expert for complex safety and vigilance activities, providing strategic direction across the organization.
• Partner with key stakeholders , including Safety Science Leaders, the QPPV/PRRC offices, and cross-functional global teams to harmonize safety initiatives.
• Drive process innovation by identifying opportunities to strengthen Roche’s safety capabilities and participating in external industry collaborations.
• Translate scientific and regulatory foundations of Signal Management and Risk Management into effective global safety practices.
• Influence internal governance discussions to ensure safety and vigilance practices support the safe development of innovative medicines and digital health solutions. Who you are You are a strategic leader who thrives in a global matrix environment, combining deep technical expertise in Safety Science with the ability to coach and catalyze change across organizational boundaries.
• You hold a degree in Medicine, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• You bring extensive experience in Pharmacovigilance and Safety Science, with deep expertise in Signal Management and Risk Management.
• You possess a strong command of global pharmacovigilance and safety regulations (such as FDA, EMA, and MHRA).
• You have a proven track record of leading complex initiatives and influencing senior stakeholders to drive strategic improvement. We look forward to your application. This role is based onsite at our Welwyn, United Kingdom office. Our team follows a hybrid work structure, requiring a fixed number of onsite days per week. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A equipe de FEP atua como o braço analítico e financeiro junto às áreas de Vendas e Marketing. O escopo do time de FEP é estritamente focado em governança comercial, precificação corporativa ( Pricing ), gestão de capital de giro ( Working Capital ) e maximização da rentabilidade. A Oportunidade: Como Estagiário(a) de FEP no time de NPC, você atuará como um co-piloto estratégico de Vendas e Marketing, focando na linha de frente dos negócios. O dia a dia envolve o suporte à modelagem de business cases, análises de precificação e gestão da saúde financeira (AR/AP) de clientes Retail e Non-Retail.
• Modelagem Financeira: Suportar a estruturação e análise de business cases para avaliar a viabilidade financeira e a margem de contribuição de novos contratos comerciais e participação em pregões públicos.
• Gestão de Receita: Auxiliar no acompanhamento de KPIs dos portfólios de NPC, monitorando os impactos de descontos e verbas comerciais na rentabilidade das linhas de produto.
• Capital de Giro e Risco: Apoiar no controle e a visibilidade dos indicadores de Contas a Receber (análise de aging e DSO) e Contas a Pagar comerciais, garantindo a correta alocação e conciliação de provisões ( accruals ).
• Reporte Gerencial: Auxiliar na consolidação de bases de dados financeiras, atualizar dashboards de performance de vendas e auxiliar na automação de rotinas analíticas para os fóruns de revisão de resultados com as áreas de negócios. Quem é você:
• Você está cursando graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas (com previsão de formatura a partir de Dezembro/2027).
• Você possui domínio de Excel, incluindo o uso de funções lógicas, manipulação de grandes bases de dados e noções de modelagem financeira.
• Você tem nível de inglês intermediário ou avançado. Desejável:
• Você possui conhecimento em Power BI, LookerStudio, macros (VBA) ou outras ferramentas de visualização/manipulação de dados (considerado um diferencial competitivo). Informações Adicionais:
• Local de Trabalho: Zona Sul de São Paulo;
• Modelo de Trabalho: Atuação em modelo híbrido, presencial 3x por semana *Benefícios de relocalização não estão disponíveis para esta vaga. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

The Position Sobre Roche En Roche, nos impulsa el propósito de innovar en ciencia y apoyar transformaciones al sistema de salud para asegurar que las generaciones presentes y futuras disfruten de más y mejor tiempo con sus seres queridos. Creemos que la innovación no solo está en nuestros medicamentos, sino también en la excelencia de nuestros procesos internos. La Oportunidad Buscamos un becario proactivo con interés en tener una experiencia profesional de alto impacto en el área financiera, específicamente en Procurement y Supply Chain. En este rol, participarás en proyectos estratégicos para impulsar la eficiencia y agilidad operativa, experimentando la vida laboral en una farmacéutica de alta especialidad líder en el mundo. Tus Responsabilidades
• Due Diligence: Mantener el tracker al día y asegurar que la documentación esté completa en gDrive.
• Procesos de Licitación: Gestionar procesos de invitación a cotizar, asegurando el cumplimiento de los timelines y el resguardo de documentación.
• Data & Analytics: Mantener actualizadas las gráficas del Dashboard de Procurement y realizar la extracción de reportes.
• Gestión de Contenidos: Actualizar el GSite de Procurement y el material de capacitación según los requerimientos.
• Soporte Operativo: Apoyo en el seguimiento al proceso de alta de proveedores.
• Gestión de Órdenes: Registro y seguimiento de órdenes de compra (OC), garantizando precisión en datos y disponibilidad de stock.
• Cumplimiento Normativo: Control y elaboración de cartas de canje y corta caducidad.
• Reporting: Extracción de datos para la actualización de indicadores clave (KPIs) del área. ¿Quién eres? Para destacar en este rol, buscamos el siguiente perfil:
• Formación: Estudiante activo de Ingeniería Industrial, Negocios Internacionales, Finanzas o carreras afines.
• Mindset: Gran motivación por aprender, proactividad y una marcada orientación a resultados.
• Pasión: Interés por el manejo de información, el análisis de datos y la mejora continua de procesos.
• Habilidades: Capacidad para desarrollar visión estratégica y gestión de proyectos dentro del sector salud. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position A healthier future. That’s what motivates us to innovate. Continuously promote science and ensure that everyone has access to the health care they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Talent Acquisition Partner , you will work across borders within an empowered, self-organized environment. You will support team development and deliver exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences by leveraging diverse talent and specialized expertise. About the opportunity:
• Drive end-to-end standardized recruiting processes across multiple Latin American countries, delivering customized talent acquisition solutions, proactive sourcing, pipelining, and seamless candidate experiences.
• Manage the complete offer and negotiation process with all necessary stakeholders according to local specifications, ensuring compliance, creating proposals, and aligning with our total rewards strategy while securing internal approvals.
• Elevate customer value across the People & Culture suite by incorporating core behaviors and key metrics into every interaction with Hiring Managers, candidates, and stakeholders.
• Influence high-quality hiring decisions by focusing on the moments that matter most in the candidate journey and driving strategic talent conversations to enhance organizational efficiency.
• Leverage a scaled, AI-ready, and knowledge-sharing culture, utilizing and mastering advanced applicant tracking and sourcing tools such as Workday, Phenom People, and LinkedIn.
• Contribute directly to global recruiting priorities by participating in upskilling, talent exchange, or knowledge-sharing activities. Who you are:
• 4+ years of recruiting experience in a corporate, biotech, or pharmaceutical setting, with a required University Degree.
• Trilingual fluency in Portuguese, Spanish, and English (mandatory).
• Expertise in progressive sourcing options (direct sourcing, web recruitment tools, networking, diversity recruiting) and a proven track record in proactive talent acquisition.
• Demonstrated experience in end-to-end Talent Acquisition across Latin America within corporate or agency settings.
• Technical proficiency in ATS systems, with a preference for Workday and Phenom, alongside offer process and systems management.
• Strong business acumen combined with stakeholder management, consultative problem-solving, communication and influencing skills.
• Agile mindset with the flexibility to adapt, move, and support different functions/capabilities as needed within a matrix environment. Location: São Paulo – Hybrid model. Relocation benefits are not available for this position. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Présentation de l'équipe : Rattaché(e) au directeur de l’Unité Accès Regional au sein de la Direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication, ta mission sera de garantir l'accès à notre portefeuille produits Roche auprès des établissements de soins et des officines, dans les meilleures conditions et dans le respect du bon usage, au bénéfice des patients. Quel sera ton impact ? En étroite collaboration avec les autres équipes de la direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication (accès national, médicoéconomie…), les autres unités de l’entreprise (médical, marketing produit, omnicanalité…) et les squad parcours, tu contribueras : ● Lancement de produits innovants : Coordonner les référencements hospitaliers ou mise en place grossiste-répartiteur, en partenariat avec les équipes produits et les équipes terrain ● Lien ville-hôpital : Développer des solutions d'accompagnement pour les produits prescrits à l’hôpital et dispensés en ville, afin d’assurer une bonne coordination entre la ville et l'hôpital (pharmaciens, URPS, DAC, OMEDIT…). ● Nouvelles initiatives : Contribuer à faire évoluer notre offre et nos services par des propositions différenciantes (événements, site internet, dispositifs d’accompagnement), et à leur communication interne et externe en capitalisant sur les différents canaux de communication (omnicanalité). ● Gestion de projets marketing : Soutenir la création de Newsletters, d'événements et d'outils pour l'équipe terrain (slidedecks, brochures). ● Veille active : Surveiller l'environnement de l'accès aux soins en ville et à l'hôpital et anticiper les changements impactant notre écosystème. ● Analyse d'impact : Mesurer les résultats des actions menées à l'aide d'indicateurs pertinents. Ton ADN
• Tu es de formation supérieure scientifique et tu recherches une alternance pour ton master en marketing ou école de commerce
• Tu aimes travailler sur des sujets diverses, tu as la capacité à travailler en transverse, à convaincre et fédérer, tu es force de proposition, autonome, ouvert d'esprit, rigoureux et organisé
• Pour toi, un intitulé de poste n’est pas une définition figée de ce que tu es, mais le point de départ d’une carrière.
• Tu as des connaissances sur le système de santé français, tu es à l’aise la gestion de projets et les outils bureautiques (Google suite et les autres)
• Tu veux maîtriser ton développement professionnel.
• Tu recherches l’entreprise qui te donnera l’opportunité d’approfondir tes connaissances, et ce, quelle que soit ta fonction, ton lieu de travail. Alternance de 12 mois à compter de Septembre 2026 Poste basé à Paris Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
• Tu es intéressé(e) par le marketing au travers l’organisation d’événements, de congrès et de supports pour les équipes terrains mais tu cherches à t’ouvrir à d’autres univers comme l’accès au marché ? Ce poste est une belle opportunité de découvrir ces deux facettes.
• Cette alternance va te permettre de comprendre et maîtriser par des cas d’usage au quotidien, les différents aspects de l’accès régional via notamment la mise à disposition de nos innovations thérapeutiques auprès d’un large panel de clients (hôpitaux, grossistes, institutionnels en régions…) et la définition /mise en place / suivi / analyse d’impact de la stratégie marketing permettant d’atteindre ce but
• Notre laboratoire dispose d'un environnement collaboratif et stimulant, où tu pourras travailler aux côtés de professionnels expérimentés et passionnés, ce qui facilitera ton apprentissage

The Position Présentation de l'équipe : Rattaché(e) au directeur de l’Unité Accès Regional au sein de la Direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication, ta mission sera de garantir l'accès à notre portefeuille produits Roche auprès des établissements de soins et des officines, dans les meilleures conditions et dans le respect du bon usage, au bénéfice des patients. Quel sera ton impact ? En étroite collaboration avec les autres équipes de la direction Accès, Affaires Publiques et Communication (accès national, médicoéconomie…), les autres unités de l’entreprise (médical, marketing produit, omnicanalité…) et les squad parcours, tu contribueras : ● Lancement de produits innovants : Coordonner les référencements hospitaliers ou mise en place grossiste-répartiteur, en partenariat avec les équipes produits et les équipes terrain ● Lien ville-hôpital : Développer des solutions d'accompagnement pour les produits prescrits à l’hôpital et dispensés en ville, afin d’assurer une bonne coordination entre la ville et l'hôpital (pharmaciens, URPS, DAC, OMEDIT…). ● Nouvelles initiatives : Contribuer à faire évoluer notre offre et nos services par des propositions différenciantes (événements, site internet, dispositifs d’accompagnement), et à leur communication interne et externe en capitalisant sur les différents canaux de communication (omnicanalité). ● Gestion de projets marketing : Soutenir la création de Newsletters, d'événements et d'outils pour l'équipe terrain (slidedecks, brochures). ● Veille active : Surveiller l'environnement de l'accès aux soins en ville et à l'hôpital et anticiper les changements impactant notre écosystème. ● Analyse d'impact : Mesurer les résultats des actions menées à l'aide d'indicateurs pertinents. descriptionByLocale.it: Rock - Descrizione del lavoro Mansioni - Impacto sostenible: Contribuire a soluzioni che sostengono ai desafíos più urgenti della salute riducendo l'impatto sul pianeta. - Liderare la strategia di accesso e poliche pubbliche per il portafolio di Roche Diagnóstica nella regione di Ecuador e Perú-PEC. - Responsabilità: - Strategia di Accesso e Valor: Disegnare ed eseguire il Piano di Accesso per prodotti di alto valore medico, anticipationando le tendenze del mercato per definire proposte di valore innovativo che accelerino la loro inclusione. - Relazione di Livello Alto e Influenza: Costruire relazioni strategiche con Leader di Opinione (KOLs), società scientifique e authority à governance per guidare la partecipazione dell'azienda nella modifica delle poliche pubbliche e dei quadri normativi. - Mappatura degli Stakeholder e Percorso del Paziente: Piattaformare la mappatura degli attori chiave e delle istituzioni obiettivi, analizzando il percorso del paziente peridentice le priorità cliniche e le nuove opportunità di crescita. - Economia della Salute (HECON): Implementationare gli strumenti di economia della salute e i modelli di costo-beneficio per posizionare strategyemente il portafolio nelle competenze di salute della regione Perú e Ecuador. - Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Acte come il principale esperto scientifico del portafolio, diffondendo l'evidenza clinica attraverso le pubblicazioni, i façelli di esperti e diffusondo le esigenze dei pazienti e dei professionali in strategy di business. - Collaborazione Transversale: Lavorare in assenza con i team commerciali, di strategia e finanza per agevolare i processi di accesso e massimizzare le opportunità commerciali del portafolio. Obbligo - Professionista in Scienze della Salute, Amministrazione delle Imprese o corsi affini, con dominio Avvio del linguaggio inglese (parlato e scritto). - Più di 3 anni nell'industria farmaceutica o dell'assistenza sanitaria, guidando i ruoli di Accesso al Mercato e Politica Pubblica. - Profonda comprensione del sistema di saluto peruviano-escuadoriano, nonché la sua normativa e gli storeholder necessari per l'ecosistema della salutee. - Visione strategica e sistemica, con capacità dimostrate di incorrere e ispirare attraverso la leadership collaborazioniativo. - Desiderabile: - Studi aggiuntivi o specializzazione in Economy della Salute e Politiche Pubbliche. - Trayectoria comprovada in metodologías ágiles y colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios. Contatto I dettagli sulla trasparenza della percezione sono forniti sulla base della posizione di pubblicazione principale. Per questo ruolo, la posizione principale è Quito. Se sei interessato ad altre posizioni in cui il ruolo potrebbe essere disponibile, perniamo i dettagli sulla concessione pendente il processo di assunzione. Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge è stato innovativo. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a lontano avanzare la scienza, guarantorendo che tutti hanno accesso alle cure sanitarie oggi e per le generazioni future.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Impacto sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. La Oportunidad Liderar la estrategia de acceso y políticas públicas para el portafolio de Roche Diagnóstica en la región de Ecuador y Perú-PEC. En este rol, serás el principal experto ante el Ministerio de Salud y aseguradoras así como otros stakeholders relevantes para el sistema de salud, generando evidencia clínica de alto impacto para reducir barreras y crear oportunidades en el sistema de salud y garantizar que nuestras innovaciones lleguen a quienes más las necesitan. Responsabilidades
• Estrategia de Acceso y Valor: Diseñar y ejecutar el Plan de Acceso para productos de alto valor médico, anticipando tendencias del mercado para definir propuestas de valor innovadoras que aceleren su adopción.
• Relacionamiento de Alto Nivel e Influencia: Construir relaciones estratégicas con Líderes de Opinión (KOLs), sociedades científicas y autoridades gubernamentales para liderar la participación de la compañía en la modificación de políticas públicas y marcos regulatorios.
• Mapeo de Stakeholders y Ruta del Paciente: Desarrollar el mapeo de actores clave e instituciones objetivo, analizando el journey del paciente para identificar prioridades clínicas y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento.
• Economía de la Salud (HECON): Implementar herramientas de economía de la salud y modelos de costo-beneficio para posicionar estratégicamente el portafolio en las entidades de salud de la región Perú y Ecuador.
• Liderazgo Científico y de Opinión: Actuar como el principal experto científico del portafolio, difundiendo evidencia clínica a través de publicaciones, paneles de expertos y traduciendo las necesidades de los pacientes y profesionales en estrategias de negocio.
• Colaboración Transversal: Trabajar en sinergia con los equipos comerciales, de estrategia y finanzas para agilizar los procesos de acceso y maximizar las oportunidades comerciales del portafolio. Quién Eres
• Profesional en Ciencias de la Salud, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines, con dominio avanzado del idioma inglés (hablado y escrito).
• Más de 3 años en la industria farmacéutica o del cuidado de la salud, liderando roles de Acceso al Mercado y Política Pública.
• Profundo entendimiento del sistema de salud peruano- ecuatoriano, así como su normativa y los stakeholders relevantes para el ecosistema de salud
• Visión estratégica y sistémica, con capacidad demostrada para influir e inspirar a través del liderazgo colaborativo. Deseable
• Estudios adicionales o especialización en Economía de la Salud y Políticas Públicas.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche Support Network offers an exciting opportunity for individuals who are passionate about problem solving. As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche is dedicated to discovering, developing, and providing innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products. With a commitment to employee development and a work environment that values respect and empowerment, Roche offers exciting career prospects for those seeking to make a significant impact on patient care. This role offers the opportunity to support our Donor Screening business, which plays a critical role in detecting antibodies and antigens to aid in diagnosing infections, ensuring blood safety, and monitoring immune responses. The Opportunity: Roche Support Network is dedicated to providing exceptional support to customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist you will:
• Showcase your expertise in technical repair for Roche assigned product lines.
• Offer valuable service to laboratory customers in your assigned territory.
• Provide routine technical support, on-site service and repair of Roche products.
• Serve as a customer contact for technical and service-related issues and perform preventative maintenance.
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hardware, software, and system failures.
• Document all activities, contribute to quality improvement, and focus on maximizing customer satisfaction. This field-based role requires up to 50% travel. This person will support Detroit, MI and surrounding areas. Who You Are:
• High school diploma and 2 years of technical school or equivalent military training or equivalent work experience
• 5 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking OR a Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry or related field plus 1-2 years of progressive experience repairing or servicing complex mechanical/system hardware and software, or networking/wireless networking
• Successfully training or certification as defined by RD Services Leadership and policy
• Ability to travel, including some overnight travel, is required Preferred Qualifications:
• 8+ years of progressive experience or a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field plus 4+ years of progressive experience are required.
• Advanced knowledge of electronics, electro-mechanical systems, information technology, and basic chemistry.
• The ability to serve as an internal technical resource, provide support after hours and on weekends/holidays, and maintain strong customer relationships is essential. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Detroit, MI is 71,100.00 - 132,000.00 USD Annual. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance. This position also qualifies for the benefits detailed at the link provided below. Benefits Are you ready to apply? Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics

The Position

In a global, cross-functional environment, the System Development (SD) department is responsible for workflow optimization and successfully integrating hardware, software, consumables, and reagents to perform the system verification of diagnostics instruments.

As a Development Engineer, you will work as a part of a cross-functional team, working on Nucleic Acid Purification, PCR and Sequencing, on developing complex diagnostics systems. You will perform hands-on experiments, Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) testing, including evaluation of system performance, error handling, and reliability improvements.

Please note that this vacancy is not currently linked to an open position. We are anticipating future needs in our organization. If you are interested in this kind of role, please apply today, and we may contact you should a position matching your profile become available.

In this position, you will be responsible for the following areas:

• Plan and execute the work packages within the area of responsibility, including reporting and escalating issues to management.

• Generate required documentation/procedures/technical reports.

• Prepare and deliver presentations of project results to team and management.

• Experimental design and execution of the experiments in the biosafety levels S1 and S2 laboratory.

• Creation of Test Cases based on Product Requirements. Execution of Test Cases, analysis of the results, and creation of the respective regulatory documents. Issue tracking and verification of bug fixes/Anomalies.

• Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems. Document and maintain software functionality.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
As a Business Architect, you will define and maintain the architectural vision and strategy for the Roche organization, ensuring alignment with business goals and supporting the adoption and implementation of Roche’s Reference Architecture. Acting as the authority and guardian of the Reference Architecture, you will create comprehensive solutions, promote best practices, and ensure architecture components and building blocks are reusable, scalable, and align with established standards. Through collaboration across the organization, you will lead efforts to integrate applications and systems effectively, drive innovation, and uphold the architectural integrity of Roche's customer-facing products. Furthermore, you will play a key role in advancing Roche’s common platform strategy by contributing to its scalability, reliability, interoperability, and alignment with the needs of digital medical products and engineering teams.
Your tasks and Responsibilities

• Architectural Guardianship: Define and maintain the Architecture roadmap and Reference Architecture, ensuring all solutions are scalable, reliable, and aligned with the Roche Ecosystem strategy.

• Strategy & Integration: Lead the delivery of actionable technology strategies and blueprints, guiding the integration of applications using standard building blocks and reusable components.

• Platform Leadership: Drive "platform-first" approaches, identifying technical gaps and developing innovative solutions for data interoperability and event-driven frameworks.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Engineers, Product Managers, and Sales/Medical teams to support strategic outcomes and ensure consistent technological implementation across customer-facing products.

• Quality & Risk Management: Analyze non-functional requirements (security, performance, scalability) and establish governance to reduce duplication and improve system robustness.

Who you are

• Education & Experience: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering, with at least 10+ years of experience in business/reference architecture and shared platform strategies.

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of platform strategies, architectural governance, APIs, and shared services models. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and frameworks like TOGAF or SAFe is highly valued.

• Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with healthcare standards such as FHIR and HL7 , along with expertise in compliance-based design and industry regulations.

• Soft Skills: Advanced consulting and communication skills, with a proven ability to collaborate in cross-functional, global environments and translate business goals into technical roadmaps.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Mais aujourd’hui, face aux mutations profondes de notre société, nous devons faire encore mieux. Pour y parvenir, nous repensons radicalement notre façon d’innover et d’interagir avec notre écosystème, tout en tirant mieux partie de la science et de la technologie. Agilité, autonomie, flexibilité, transparence : ces notions vous parlent ? Rejoignez-nous et construisons ensemble le Roche de demain. Description Rattaché(e) à la Division Service Clients – Regional Customer Support Center (RCSC) et reportant au Responsable Customer Support Hardware, vous prendrez en charge les demandes clients et les accompagner pour de l'assistance téléphonique . Vous serez amené(e) à travailler sur les missions suivantes : Missions :
• Réception et traitement des demandes clients
• documentation dans le CRM
• diagnostic de pannes et proposition de solutions
• utilisation des possibilités de support à distance
• Identification et traitement des réclamations et des problèmes de qualité
• gestion de réclamations simples (communication avec RCSC et équipes filiales)
• identification des problèmes de qualité et escalade au niveau d’expertise supérieur
• Participer aux différents projets innovants initiés au sein du service
• Contribuer au partage des informations et à l’optimisation des pratiques
• Assurer la progression de ses propres compétences. Qui vous êtes ? Vous êtes quelqu'un qui veut influencer son propre développement. Vous recherchez une entreprise où le titre du poste n'est pas considéré comme la définition finale de qui vous êtes, mais le point de départ. Idéalement, vous correspondez au profil suivant :
• Formation Bac + 2/Bac +3 dans les domaines de l’automatisme, de l’instrumentation, de l’électronique et de l’informatique. (ex : DUT/BUT Mesures physiques, G2II…)
• Formation dans le domaine de l'analyse de biologie médicale avec une spécialisation dans l’instrumentation biomédicale (Licence professionnelle ScVBM, Instrumentation et Maintenance Biomédicales…)
• Français courant
• Anglais est indispensable (B1-B2) Qui sommes-nous ? Nous sommes convaincus qu’il est urgent de proposer des solutions thérapeutiques et de diagnostic dès aujourd’hui, tout en innovant pour l’avenir. Améliorer la vie des patients est notre raison d’être. Nous décidons et agissons avec courage. Et nous croyons fermement qu’une conduite responsable de nos activités servira le monde de demain. Rigueur scientifique, éthique irréprochable, accès à l’innovation médicale pour tous : tels sont nos engagements. Chez Roche, nous considérons que la diversité est source d'innovation. Nous sommes ouverts à tous les profils et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail agréable et inclusif. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, tog

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del servizio di consegna - RDT Pharma Technical Operations

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Delivery Services Manager leads the delivery and operational continuity of digital solutions supporting Pharma Technical Development (PTD) systems transitioning to RDT TechOps. In this role, you will own the end-to-end delivery management of a portfolio of GMP and non-GMP applications – ensuring service stability, compliance readiness, and stakeholder alignment throughout the knowledge transfer and steady-state operations. You will also act as IT Product Owner for your assigned systems, bridging the gap between business needs and technical execution. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as: Service Manager, Delivery Service Manager, and Technical Product Owner. The Opportunity In this role, you will be responsible for:
• Delivery & Service Ownership: Lead the end-to-end delivery and operational management of assigned PTD systems – including GMP-critical applications clinical manufacturing solutions at the intersection of process development and manufacturing – ensuring continuity, compliance, and performance throughout and after the transition from PTD to RDT TechOps.
• IT Product Ownership: Act as IT Product Owner for assigned systems, defining and prioritizing the product backlog, managing vendor relationships, and ensuring delivery is aligned with business value and regulatory requirements.
• GMP Compliance Awareness: Operate with a strong understanding of GMP-regulated environments, ensuring that all delivery activities, system changes, and documentation practices meet applicable quality and compliance standards.
• Knowledge Transfer Leadership: Drive structured knowledge transition from outgoing PTD resources, ensuring documentation, runbooks, and operating procedures are captured and validated before go-live.
• Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong working relationships with PTD business stakeholders, TechOps leadership, MSP vendors, and RDT product teams – acting as the primary point of contact for your assigned systems.
• Vendor & MSP Coordination: Manage third-party service providers and system integrator partners supporting your portfolio, ensuring SLA adherence and value delivery.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify and drive process improvements across delivery operations, contributing to the maturity of the broader RDT TechOps model.
• Agile Execution: Apply Agile methodologies to manage delivery cadence, facilitate ceremonies, and maintain transparency across workstreams. Who you are You are a delivery-oriented professional with a hands-on approach and a passion for operational excellence in regulated digital environments. You bring:
• Proven experience in a Delivery Management or Service Management role, ideally within a pharmaceutical, life sciences, or regulated industry context.
• A University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Information Technology, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience managing GMP or GxP-regulated systems, with an understanding of validation requirements and change control processes.
• Strong IT Product Owner capabilities, including backlog management, stakeholder prioritization, and vendor governance.
• Experience managing third-party technology providers and system integrator partners.
• Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive decisions in complex environments.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As an Operational Specialist in Treasury & AR , you will play a vital role within our Finance Shared Service Center. You will be responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial transactions while supporting the broader Treasury and Accounts Receivable functions. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is committed to continuous process improvement. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Operational Execution: Coordinate and support stringent financial tasks, including daily bank postings, interface controls, manual corrections, and the reconciliation of bank and bank suspense balance sheet accounts.
• AR & Treasury Management: Execute customer direct debit payments, cash allocation, and the clearing of AR and bank suspense accounts. You will be responsible for posting and reconciling treasury and AR transactions.
• Accounting & Compliance: Perform day-to-day activities according to agreed service levels and SOPs. This includes AR manual invoicing, GL journal posting, account reconciliations, and FX revaluation.
• Reporting & Communication: Manage intercompany reconciliation and reporting. You will handle incoming calls and emails from stakeholders in a timely, professional manner.
• Team Collaboration: Proactively seek opportunities for effective cooperation across teams and geographies. Provide support to team members to balance workloads and foster a positive team environment.
• Continuous Improvement: Propose process and system improvements and contribute to the overall performance of the Shared Service Center (SSC) through active participation in workshops and meetings. Who you are: You are a finance professional with a solid understanding of accounting processes, a customer-service mindset, and the ability to work effectively with limited direction. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: University or College degree, with a concentration in Finance or Accounting .
• Experience: 3-5 years of experience in Finance and Accounting .
• Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with Finance Shared Services and operational accounting processes. Knowledge of technology systems such as SAP and BlackLine is highly desired.
• Languages: Fluency in English and Spanish is required. Proficiency in Portuguese and/or French is a plus.
• Skills: * Strong ability to prioritize and organize work to meet tight deadlines.
• Excellent analytical, presentation, and communication skills.
• Ability to multitask and manage up effectively.
• High level of integrity and commitment to complying with corporate guidelines. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity The Head of US Government Affairs & Policy leads Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and public policy strategy, shaping the legislative and regulatory environment to advance innovation, protect market access, influence healthcare policy, and mitigate risk. Based in Washington, D.C., this executive serves as Roche Diagnostics’ principal representative to policymakers, regulatory agencies, trade associations and external stakeholders, while acting as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on political and policy developments affecting the business. This role reports to the Global Head of Quality, Regulatory & External Affairs, with a dotted-line relationship to the President and CEO, Roche Diagnostics North America. KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES Policy Strategy & Advocacy
• Develop and lead Roche Diagnostics’ US government affairs and policy strategy aligned with business priorities.
• Influence federal and state policy impacting diagnostics, reimbursement, healthcare innovation, trade and regulatory matters.
• Anticipate risks and opportunities and shape advocacy strategies to support growth and patient access.
• Serve as a strategic partner ensuring the US Government Affairs agenda is co-created with commercial leaders; translate complex political and regulatory shifts into strategic implications that inform business planning and investment decisions. Strategic Trade Association Leadership:
• Evaluate and recommend Roche Diagnostics’ participation in industry trade associations;
• Direct executive engagement within these forums to lead cross-industry efforts on critical medical technology and policy issues. Government & Stakeholder Engagement
• Serve as Roche’s senior liaison with Congress, Administration officials, federal agencies and state policymakers.
• Lead engagement with key trade associations, coalitions, patient groups and external stakeholders to advance Roche’s policy agenda. Partners with external stakeholders, as appropriate, to build alignment with Roche Diagnostics’ policy positions and encourage external advocacy efforts consistent with those positions. (e.g., non-profit associations, industry organizations, think tanks, coalitions).
• Lead Roche’s presence in government forums and strategically deploy internal subject matter experts (from manufacturing to R&D) to testify, brief officials, and provide technical guidance that advances the company's policy objectives. Strategic Counsel & Business Partnership
• Advise senior leaders on political, legislative and policy developments affecting Roche Diagnostics.
• Bring external insights into business strategy and translate policy developments into actionable implications.
• Support executive engagement with policymakers and key public affairs opportunities. Policy Leadership in Partnership with Commercial Organization
• Lead customer communications on policy in partnership with the US commercial team.
• Engage with policy counterparts from key customers as well as laboratory industry trade associations.
• Participate in US Commercial leadership forums including USLT (US Leadership Team) and ELT (Enterprise Leadership Team). Team Leadership & Capability Building
• Lead and develop a high-performing US Government Affairs and Policy team, including talent development, succession planning, coaching and organizational capability building.
• Assess resource needs and manage use of external advisors, consultants and advocacy partnerships.

titleByLocale.en: 区域生态圈负责人_乳腺治疗领域

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position 生态圈负责人负责管理生态圈资源，并率领区域生态圈团队服务客户，建立内外部合作，把罗氏产品的关键信息准确及时的传达给客户，实现区域生态圈罗氏对应疾病领域策略目标，最终提高患者获益。 A. 目标与计划管理
• 基于区域生态群属地策略，制定本生态圈发展目标，并对目标的负责实施计划和跟进有效性
• 分析区域业务，发现机会及风险，并率领团队共同制定并执行相应计划 B. 客户管理与区域合作
• 率领团队与客户建立广泛的合作和信任，并共同为罗氏产品组合相关领域的规范诊疗水平提高而积极采取行动
• 同生态圈合作伙伴合作，提高当地生态圈医疗质量，提升患者获益
• 和准入团队合作提升区域内治疗药物的可及性。 C. 团队管理
• 参与制定区域生态群人员及业务管理计划，并率领团队执行相应计划
• 吸引、招聘、辅导和发展生态圈各角色职能的团队成员，实现生态圈人才的复合性发展
• 打造绩效和影响为先的团队氛围，创新工作模式，以实现公司愿景 D. 财务和合规管理
• 分配并管理公司资源、预算以实现生态圈目标
• 确保业务开展符合公司和国家合规要求，通过必要的合规培训，以身作则和监管，打造一个合规的工作环境 我们期待这样的您加入：
• 5年以上医药行业工作经验，有管理经验者优先
• 充分践行领导者的角色，即远见者，架构师，教练及促成者
• 拥有正确的思维方式和领导力特质
• 思维方式：使命驱动，协作，成长思维
• 领导力特质：系统思维，真诚无畏，协作共赢，辅导培养
• 业务及资源规划能力
• 优秀的沟通，合作和资源整合能力 教育程度/所获资格证书 医学或药学相关本科及以上学历 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
