descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo è un momento emozionante per aderire alla rete di supporto Roche. Se siete appassionati di problem solving allora questa è la posizione per voi! In qualità di società di assistenza sanitaria focalizzata sulla ricerca, Roche scopre, sviluppa e fornisce prodotti e servizi diagnostici e terapeutici innovativi che forniscono benefici significativi ai pazienti e ai professionisti sanitari - dalla rilevazione precoce e prevenzione delle malattie alla diagnostica, al monitoraggio del trattamento e del trattamento. Roche è una società di successo che può offrire interessanti opportunità di carriera. Incoraggiamo e sosteniamo il vostro sviluppo in aree di vostro interesse che vi preparerà per il prossimo livello nel vostro percorso di carriera. Sappiamo che le persone sono responsabili del nostro successo e apprezziamo i nostri dipendenti. Il nostro impegno è quello di creare un ambiente di lavoro in cui sentirsi valorizzati, rispettati e potenziati è un'esperienza quotidiana. In qualità di Field Applications Specialist , sarete un membro chiave del nostro team di assistenza clienti come principale rappresentante scientifico e tecnico nella regione di Allentown , PA per i sistemi Roche nei laboratori del cliente all'interno dello spazio Core Lab. Sarete responsabili di fornire il miglior supporto clienti in loco, tra cui attività come, l'implementazione delle applicazioni, la formazione dell'operatore e la risoluzione dei problemi per la strumentazione diagnostica e le analisi durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. L'opportunità:
• Costruire e mantenere relazioni forti e collaborative con le parti interessate del cliente, garantendo un elevato livello di soddisfazione del cliente e creando valore nelle operazioni di laboratorio del cliente. Consultare i clienti sulle esigenze del laboratorio e agire come partner supportando il cliente durante tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto che potrebbe includere aggiornamenti di prodotto e altre modifiche.
• Eseguire e/o assistere con l'installazione di strumenti diagnostici complessi, software e applicazioni reagente nei laboratori del cliente. Convalida le prestazioni del sistema per garantire che soddisfi le specifiche del produttore. Assicurare un'applicazione efficace e coesa delle soluzioni appena installate.
• Fornire e, in alcuni casi, sviluppare una formazione completa in loco al personale di laboratorio sul corretto uso e manutenzione dei sistemi Roche, tra cui teoria del funzionamento, flusso di lavoro, controllo della qualità e interpretazione dei dati.
• Agire come risorsa principale in loco per risolvere problemi tecnici complessi relativi alla strumentazione, software e prestazioni di analisi. Eseguire l'analisi della causa radice e implementare azioni correttive per ridurre al minimo i tempi di fermo dello strumento. Partner con altri membri del team Roche per implementare e supportare soluzioni totali, come l'automazione, gli strumenti digitali, ecc.
• Fornire competenze scientifiche e applicative agli stakeholder di laboratorio (questo potrebbe includere supervisori, manager, direttori, tecnici) e professionisti medici (questo potrebbe includere patologi, medici), aiutandoli a garantire operazioni di laboratorio coesi ottimizzando i flussi di lavoro, implementando nuovi saggi e interpretando i risultati per il portafoglio di Roche.
• Servire come collegamento al cliente e raccogliere feedback da parte dei clienti sulle prestazioni, le caratteristiche e l'usabilità del prodotto, e poi relay queste informazioni di supporto e team commerciali, mantenendo un vantaggio competitivo.
• Partner con il team di vendita e sfruttare le conoscenze tecniche approfondite durante le attività pre-vendita, tra cui dimostrazioni di prodotto, consultazioni tecniche, ottimizzazione dei menu e altre opportunità post-vendita, generazione di ricavi.
• Assicurare esperienze di cliente coerenti seguendo i protocolli Roche
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. As a Field Applications Specialist , you will be a key member of our Customer Support team as the primary scientific and technical representative in the Allentown , PA region for Roche systems in customer laboratories within the Core Lab space. You will be responsible for providing best-in-class on-site customer support, including activities such as, application implementation, operator training, and troubleshooting for diagnostic instrumentation and assays throughout the entire product life cycle. The Opportunity:
• Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and creating value within the customer’s lab operations. Consult with customers on lab needs and act as a partner by supporting the customer throughout the product lifecycle which could include supporting product upgrades and other changes.
• Perform and/or assist with the installation of complex diagnostic instruments, software, and reagent applications in customer laboratories. Validate system performance to ensure it meets manufacturer specifications. Ensure effective and cohesive application of the newly installed solutions.
• Deliver and, in some cases develop, comprehensive on-site training to laboratory personnel on the proper use and maintenance of Roche systems, including theory of operation, workflow, quality control, and data interpretation.
• Act as the primary on-site resource for resolving complex technical issues related to instrumentation, software, and assay performance. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to minimize instrument downtime. Partner with other Roche team members to implement and support total solutions, such as automation, digital tools, etc.
• Provide scientific and applications expertise to laboratory stakeholders (this could include supervisors, managers, directors, technologists) and medical professionals (this could include pathologists, doctors), helping them ensure cohesive lab operations by optimizing workflows, implementing new assays, and interpreting results for Roche's portfolio.
• Serve as the customer liaison and collect feedback from customers on product performance, features, and usability, and then relay this information back to support and commercial teams, maintaining a competitive advantage.
• Partner with the sales team and leverage in-depth technical knowledge during pre-sales activities, including product demonstrations, technical consultations, menu optimization, and other post-sales, revenue-generating opportunities.
• Ensure consistent customer experiences by following Roche protocols
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Dies ist eine aufregende Zeit, sich dem Roche Support Network anzuschließen. Wenn Sie leidenschaftlich über Problemlösung sind, dann ist dies die Position für Sie! Als forschungsorientiertes Healthcare-Unternehmen entdeckt, entwickelt und bietet Roche innovative Diagnostik und therapeutische Produkte und Dienstleistungen, die für Patienten und medizinische Fachkräfte von der Früherkennung und Prävention von Krankheiten bis hin zur Diagnostik, Behandlung und Therapieüberwachung profitieren. Roche ist ein erfolgreiches Unternehmen, das spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten bieten kann. Wir fördern und unterstützen Ihre Entwicklung in Bereichen Ihres Interesses, die Sie auf die nächste Stufe in Ihrem Karriereweg vorbereiten. Wir wissen, dass Menschen für unseren Erfolg verantwortlich sind und wir unsere Mitarbeiter schätzen. Unser Engagement ist es, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem das Gefühl geschätzt, respektiert und gestärkt wird, ein tägliches Erlebnis ist. Als Field Applications Specialist werden Sie als primärer wissenschaftlicher und technischer Vertreter in der Allentown , PA-Region für Roche-Systeme in Kundenlaboren im Core Lab-Raum ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres Customer Support-Teams sein. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung vor Ort, einschließlich Aktivitäten wie, Anwendung Implementierung, Bedienertraining und Fehlerbehebung für diagnostische Instrumentierung und Assays während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Die Gelegenheit:
• Erstellen und pflegen Sie starke, kollaborative Beziehungen zu Kundenvertretern, um ein hohes Maß an Kundenzufriedenheit und Wertschöpfung im Laborbetrieb des Kunden sicherzustellen. Besprechen Sie den Kunden auf den Laborbedarf und handeln Sie als Partner, indem Sie den Kunden während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus unterstützen, der Produkt-Upgrades und andere Änderungen unterstützen könnte.
• Durchführung und/oder Unterstützung bei der Installation komplexer diagnosischer Instrumente, Software und Reagenzienanwendungen in Kundenlabors. Gültige Systemleistung, um sicherzustellen, dass es den Herstellerspezifikationen entspricht. Gewährleistung einer effektiven und kohäsiven Anwendung der neu installierten Lösungen.
• Bereitstellung und in einigen Fällen eine umfassende Vor-Ort-Training an Laborpersonal bei der ordnungsgemäßen Nutzung und Wartung von Roche-Systemen, einschließlich der Theorie der Operation, Workflow, Qualitätskontrolle und Dateninterpretation.
• Aktivieren Sie als primäre Vor-Ort-Ressource zur Lösung komplexer technischer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit Instrumentierung, Software und Testleistung. Führen Sie Root Ursache Analyse und implementieren Korrekturmaßnahmen, um Instrument Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren. Mit anderen Roche-Team-Mitgliedern werden Gesamtlösungen wie Automatisierung, digitale Werkzeuge etc. implementiert und unterstützt.
• Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen und Anwendungen Expertise für Labor-Stakeholder (dies könnte unter anderem Aufsichtspersonen, Manager, Direktoren, Technologen) und medizinische Fachkräfte (dies könnte Pathologen, Ärzte umfassen), die ihnen helfen, kohäsive Laboroperationen zu gewährleisten, indem sie Workflows optimieren, neue Assays implementieren und Ergebnisse für Roches Portfolio interpretieren.
• Servieren Sie als Kundenverbindung und sammeln Sie Feedback von Kunden über Produktleistung, Funktionen und Usability, und übermitteln Sie diese Informationen dann an Support- und Handelsteams, wobei ein Wettbewerbsvorteil erhalten wird.
• Partner des Vertriebsteams und nutzen fundiertes technisches Wissen während der Vorverkaufsaktivitäten, darunter Produktdemonstrationen, technische Beratungen, Menüoptimierung und andere Post-Sales, Umsatzerzeugende Möglichkeiten.
• Gewährleistung einheitlicher Kundenerfahrungen durch die folgenden Roche-Protokolle

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. En tant que spécialiste des applications sur le terrain, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de support client en tant que principal représentant scientifique et technique dans la région d'Allentown, PA pour les systèmes Roche dans les laboratoires clients de l'espace Core Lab. Vous serez responsable de fournir le meilleur service client en classe sur place, y compris des activités telles que la mise en œuvre d'applications, la formation des opérateurs et le dépannage des instruments de diagnostic et des essais tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. La possibilité :
• Établir et maintenir des relations solides et collaboratives avec les parties prenantes du client, en assurant un niveau élevé de satisfaction du client et en créant de la valeur dans les opérations du laboratoire du client. Consulter les clients sur les besoins des laboratoires et agir en tant que partenaire en appuyant le client tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, ce qui pourrait inclure des améliorations du produit et d'autres changements.
• Effectuer et/ou aider à l'installation d'instruments de diagnostic complexes, de logiciels et d'applications de réactif dans les laboratoires clients. Valider la performance du système pour s'assurer qu'il répond aux spécifications du fabricant. Assurer l'application efficace et cohérente des solutions nouvellement installées.
• Offrir et, dans certains cas, développer une formation complète sur place au personnel de laboratoire sur l'utilisation et la maintenance correctes des systèmes Roche, y compris la théorie du fonctionnement, le flux de travail, le contrôle de la qualité et l'interprétation des données.
• Être la principale ressource sur place pour résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes liés à l'instrumentation, aux logiciels et aux performances d'essai. Effectuer une analyse des causes profondes et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour minimiser les temps d'arrêt des instruments. Partenaire avec d'autres membres de l'équipe Roche pour mettre en œuvre et soutenir des solutions complètes, telles que l'automatisation, les outils numériques, etc.
• Fournir une expertise scientifique et des applications aux parties prenantes du laboratoire (y compris les superviseurs, les gestionnaires, les directeurs, les technologues) et aux professionnels de la santé (y compris les pathologistes, les médecins), les aider à assurer la cohérence des opérations de laboratoire en optimisant les flux de travail, en mettant en oeuvre de nouveaux tests et en interprétant les résultats pour le portefeuille de Roche.
• Servir de liaison avec le client et recueillir les commentaires des clients sur les performances, les caractéristiques et la facilité d'utilisation du produit, puis transmettre ces informations aux équipes de soutien et commerciales, en maintenant un avantage concurrentiel.
• S'associer à l'équipe de vente et tirer parti de connaissances techniques approfondies lors des activités préventes, y compris les démonstrations de produits, les consultations techniques, l'optimisation des menus et d'autres occasions de générer des revenus après les ventes.
• Assurer une expérience client cohérente en suivant les protocoles Roche

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Your Department We are a global team of 100+ biostatisticians and data scientists united by the ambition to advance diagnostic assays and elevate their use in clinical practice. Located across Roche Diagnostics sites in Penzberg, Mannheim, Indianapolis, and Sant Cugat del Vallès, our mission is to provide robust quantitative methods for all stages of the product lifecycle—from early research to market registration. By combining our statistical expertise with a profound understanding of the clinical questions at hand, we extract actionable information from data and deliver customer-tailored insights. Your Team Our team thrives on creating innovative solutions for both novel and traditional challenges in data analysis. We are heavily involved in early biomarker discovery projects, aiming to identify new biomarkers and develop clinical algorithms that solve unmet medical needs. To achieve our goals, we leverage data from clinical trials as well as real-world data. Collaboration is at our core; we work in close partnership with colleagues across clinical science, clinical operations, business, and assay development. Your Main Objectives and Tasks
• Conduct exploratory data analysis of clinical data and develop clinical algorithms by applying state-of-the-art statistical and machine learning methods.
• Perform statistical analysis for clinical studies and real world data, generate analysis reports, and present findings to stakeholders.
• Analyze data from biomarker discovery experiments using multivariate and machine learning techniques.
• Support peer-reviewed publications that demonstrate the clinical utility of your results.
• Proactively contribute to and support cross-functional project teams. Who You Are
• You hold a university degree (Master’s) in (Bio-)Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, (Bio-)Informatics, or a comparable field; a Ph.D. is a plus.
• You possess proven expertise in applying biostatistical and machine learning methods to clinical data, ideally in the context of biomarker evaluation or similar research tasks.
• You have excellent knowledge of R or a comparable programming language.
• You bring exceptional communication and analytical skills, with a strong desire to continuously expand your knowledge and apply new quantitative methodologies.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Stell Dir vor, Du bist der Architekt hinter den Kulissen, der die Vision einer vollautomatisierten Gesundheitsversorgung Realität werden lässt. Bei Roche Diagnostics treiben wir die Wissenschaft voran, damit jeder Mensch die bestmögliche Behandlung erhält. Als Projektmanager bist Du die treibende Kraft, die komplexe Laborsysteme zum Leben erweckt und so einen direkten Einfluss auf die Schnelligkeit und Präzision von Diagnosen für Millionen von Patient:innen weltweit nimmt. Dein neues Team: Du wirst Teil unseres Teams Field Force Workflow Solutions im Customer Service Außendienst. Wir sind eine dynamische Gemeinschaft aus Spezialist:innen, die technische Exzellenz, Erfahrung mit Laborprozessen mit einer großen Portion Teamgeist verbindet. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich In dieser Rolle gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Labordiagnostik durch professionelles Projektmanagement und Workflow-Optimierung:
• Du leitest überregionale Implementierungsprojekte für Automatisierungslösungen und behältst dabei Planung, Steuerung und Kontrolle fest im Griff.
• Du koordinierst Teilprojektleiter:innen sowie externe Partner, um Projektziele termingerecht und in höchster Qualität zu erreichen.
• Du steuerst die Kommunikation zu unseren Kunden und internen Stakeholdern und begleitest Veränderungsprozesse durch aktives Change Management.
• Du wirkst bei technischen Installationen mit, führst Testläufe durch und trainierst Kunden, um ihre Workflows perfekt auf ihre Bedürfnisse abzustimmen.
• Du analysierst abgeschlossene Projekte ("Lessons Learned"), optimierst unsere Prozesse und berätst Kunden als Spezialist:in für Prozessoptimierung.
• Du unterstützt internationale Länderorganisationen bei der Weiterentwicklung interner Standards und Best Practices. Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit Du verstehst es, Menschen für technische Innovationen zu begeistern und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick:
• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen (z. B. Medizintechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik), Biologie, IT oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
• Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Projekte sowie sichere Kenntnisse in modernen Projektmanagement-Methoden und -Tools mit.
• Umfangreiche Führungserfahrungen in Matrix-Organisationen helfen Dir dabei, Teams zu motivieren und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.
• Du hast ein Verständnis für Abläufe in medizinischen Laboren und begeisterst Dich für Software- sowie Netzwerktechnik.
• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch, auch auf Management-Ebene (C-Level), und überzeugst durch ein souveränes Auftreten.
• Ein Führerschein Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu (internationalen) Dienstreisen und gelegentlichen Rufbereitschaften sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Soweit so gut? Es geht noch besser. Wir bieten dir vielfältige Top-Benefits an unseren Standorten. Nur mit dir zusammen können wir das Leben von Patient:innen verbessern. Du machst Roche mit Deinem Beitrag einzigartig. Deswegen bieten wir außergewöhnliche Benefits, die Dich unterstützen, Dein Leben, Deine Finanzen und Deine Gesundheit so zu gestalten, wie Du es möchtest. Finde hier mehr heraus: https://go.roche.com/Kandidaten-Benefits-DE Bewerbungszeitraum bis mindestens: 10.06.2026 (Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist) Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf oder Workday-Profil
• Deine offiziellen (Bildungs-) Zeugniss

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position YOUR TEAM You will report to the HGR Officer and partner closely with the global biosample operations teams across the enterprise. You will be recognized as a leader and work autonomously in both local as well as global cross functional study teams. ROLE PURPOSE As a China Biosample Operations Asset Lead, you will provide biosample operational expertise to one or more cross-functional local or global study teams through all phases and stages in accordance with the appropriate quality standards and applicable local regulations. WHAT YOU WILL DO
• PROVIDE BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS GUIDANCE TO CLINICAL CHINA STUDY TEAMS AND GLOBAL STUDY TEAMS FOR CHINA RELATED ACTIVITIES by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all operational activities required to manage the lifecycle of study samples (collection, processing, analysis, data delivery and final disposition).
• LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CHINA SPECIFIC BIOMARKER MANAGEMENT PLAN WITHIN CLINICAL STUDIES based on input from scientific and operational stakeholders to execute biosample operational strategies in China
• PROVIDE INPUT TO HGRAC APPLICATION to support Country Study Managers - when applicable - and within Biosample Operations’ remit.
• PARTNER CLOSELY WITH BIOMARKER SCIENTISTS AND BIOSAMPLE OPERATIONS PROGRAM LEADS LOCALLY AND GLOBALLY to align study specific activities with program sample collection strategies. Evaluate the operational feasibility of specific testing in China and provide input to global program teams.
• PROVIDE OPERATIONAL INPUT AND RECOMMENDATIONS INTO STUDY RELATED DOCUMENTATION AND PROCESSES (e.g. protocol, ICF, HGRAC applications)
• PRESENT CHINA STUDY SAMPLE COLLECTION STRATEGY AT OPERATIONS TEAM MEETINGS AND CHINA INVESTIGATOR MEETINGS
• CONTRIBUTE TO LOCAL LAB/ REGIONAL VENDOR SELECTION FOR SPECIFIC TESTING in collaboration with Biosample Ops Lead, biomarker scientist, Procurement and based on technology expertise, performance and compliance.
• ESTABLISH BIOSAMPLE ANALYSIS AND DATA DELIVERY MILESTONES AND ENSURE ACCURATE TRACKING AND REPORTING OF BIOSAMPLE METRICS (sample collection, assay status, analyses updates). Provide study level updates to the study and global biomarker teams. Support study teams in addressing local vendor/site sample queries. Actively partner with Data Management to oversee and coordinate data format, and delivery timelines.
• PROVIDE DAY TO DAY OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT OF CHINA BIOSAMPLE VENDORS. Partner with internal/external stakeholders in the central lab set up, providing sample collection and processing instructions. Review central lab documents to ensure alignment with protocol and HGRAC submissions. Perform ongoing biomarker vendor management including development and oversight of scope of work, budget and performance management. Interact with vendors to help evaluate data size for compliance, plan sample shipments, export, storage, define data retention, ensure samples are analysed and data are transferred.
• IDENTIFY AREAS OF BEST PRACTICE AND PROCESS IMPROVEMENTS. Contribute to the development of internal guidelines within Biosample Operations’ remit, based on HGRAC process and local regulations as well as program needs. Partner with relevant stakeholders, both locally and globally, to optimize processes for sample management in China.
• DEMONSTRATE AGILITY AND ABILITY TO PERFORM IN A HIGHLY FAST-PACED, MATRIX ENVIRONMENT WHERE CROSS-TEAM COLLABORATION IS CRUCIAL. Leverage excellent verbal and written communication skills to motivate teams, neg

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Mit der Zukunft im Blick gestalten wir den Standort von Roche in Rotkreuz aktiv weiter. Einen wichtigen Beitrag hierzu leistet die Abteilung Engineering & Project: Hier liegt die Verantwortung für die strategische Weiterentwicklung des Standortes und sämtliche Investitionen in Gebäude und Anlagen. Dazu gehören Bauprojekte im Bereich Produktion, Forschung und Infrastruktur. Dabei legen wir besonderen Wert auf Nachhaltigkeit, Sicherheit, Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit und Wirtschaftlichkeit. In dieser anspruchsvollen Schlüsselfunktion bist du die zentrale Instanz für die operative Exzellenz und die baurechtliche Strategie auf dem Areal Rotkreuz. Du vereinst tiefgreifendes technisches Verständnis mit strategischem Prozessmanagement und repräsentierst das Unternehmen gegenüber Behörden und Partnern. Die Möglichkeit Strategisches Construction Management
• Standardisierung: Definition und Überwachung globaler Standards für die Auswahl, das Onboarding und die Steuerung von CM-Partnern, Generalplanern und Unternehmern.
• Schnittstellenmanagement: Agieren als entscheidendes Bindeglied zwischen Vendor Management und Projektleitung zur Sicherstellung prozesskonformer Projektabläufe.
• Beratung: Fachspezifischer Input bei komplexen Ausschreibungen und strategische Beratung der Projektleiter in allen Belangen des Construction Managements. Bebauungsplanung & Bewilligungsmanagement
• Arealstrategie: Verantwortung für die Einhaltung und strategische Weiterentwicklung bestehender Bebauungspläne in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.
• Process Ownership: Zentrale Steuerung sämtlicher Baubewilligungsprozesse sowie Definition standortweiter Bewilligungsstrategien für alle Investitionsprojekte.
• Behördenmanagement: Repräsentation der Unternehmensinteressen in städtebaulichen Gremien und erste Ansprechperson für Ämter und Behörden im Bereich Baurecht. Areal-Koordination & Safety (SHE)
• Sicherheitsstrategie: Implementierung von SHE-Standards (Safety, Health, Environment) und Befähigung der Projektteams zur sicheren Durchführung komplexer Bauvorhaben.
• Logistiksteuerung: Strategische Koordination der zeitlichen und logistischen Abfolgen aller Baustellen, um einen unterbrechungsfreien Betrieb der Kernprozesse am Standort zu garantieren. Capex-Projekt Manager
• Projektsteuerung (End-to-End): Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Erreichung der Projektziele (Termine, Kosten, Qualität, Sicherheit) von der Initiierung bis zum Projektabschluss.
• Anforderungs- & Scope-Management: Gemeinsame Definition der Projektanforderungen mit den internen Nutzern, Aufzeigen von Lösungsalternativen sowie konsequentes Risiko- und Change-Management.
• Teamführung & Stakeholder Management: Fachliche Anleitung des (agilen) Projektteams sowie zielgerichtete Kommunikation und Interessenvertretung gegenüber internen Schnittstellen und externen Partnern.
• Governance & Reporting: Strukturierte Fortschrittsverfolgung, regelmässiges Berichten an das Steering Committee und proaktives Herbeiführen von notwendigen Entscheidungen. Wer Du bist
• Abgeschlossenes Studium der Architektur, des Bauingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Expertise (z. B. MAS Baumanagement, eidg. Diplom als Bauleiter/Techniker HF) mit langjähriger Praxis.
• Fundierte Erfolgsbilanz in der Bau- oder Projektleitung von Hochbauprojekten innerhalb der Schweizer Baubranche.
• Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Teams innerhalb komplexer Matrixorganisationen.
• Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, Verhandlungsgeschi

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Payroll, Time and Benefits Senior Team Lead What we do: The People Support Solutions (PSS) organization brings its purpose to life by providing our colleagues worldwide with integrated HR solutions tailored to their needs. We work closely together as a team to ensure strong employee relations, anticipate our customers' future needs, and proactively develop solutions. Your day to day responsibilities: As a Payroll Time & Benefits Team Lead, you are responsible for leading a Payroll Time & Benefits Operations (PTB) team across multiple countries (a country cluster) and performing all people leadership activities in line with Roche People Practices. You will ensure local PTB performance targets are met at both the team and individual levels, and that regular operations reviews are held internally, as well as externally with relevant stakeholders. As a Qualified Lead you are:
• Leading and managing the Payroll Time and Benefits Operations (PTB) team by delivering best services and solutions towards the clients.
• Ensuring delivery of services in accordance with agreed performance levels (KPI) and in line with legal/regulations (compliance), continuously driving improvement activities/projects (simplification, standardization, automation) for service excellence and consistent customer experience.
• Working in line with overall People Support Solutions strategy, seeking better/creative solutions to support business needs as well as leveraging advanced technology to continually drive teamwork efficiency and enhance customer experience.
• Leading and facilitating people processes in line with Roche Leadership commitments, People Practices and policies, Roche values.
• Role Modeling our people practices, ensuring that ongoing dialog occurs on the topics of Career, Capabilities, Connections and Contributions.
• Developing team member’s knowledge, skills, capabilities in line with the Roche People Practices to retain and develop talented staff.
• Driving employee retention, engagement and talent management.
• Creating a safe and positive team culture and environment, ensuring the team is demonstrating the right mindset and attitude (trust, growth mindset, customer centricity, E2E accountability, problem solving).
• Ensuring consistent and reliable service delivery for customers serviced, maintaining strong customer satisfaction within the area of responsibility, pro-actively providing feedback/inputs to stakeholders from a service perspective.
• Setting and monitoring team working plan, resource allocations, workload.
• Seeking, identifying and driving continuous service and process improvement (in terms of standardization, automation, and simplification), and service enhancement based on monthly performance, customer feedback.
• Sustaining a win-win relationship with external vendors, as well as monitor the vendor performance through routine and/or project work.
• Collaborating with peers within the region and globally PTB community and achieving our People Support Solutions vision by driving global consistency through collaboration.
• Partnering with other Service teams (e.g. Advisory, People Support, Employee Lifecycle teams) for cross functional end to end service delivery and process improvement.
• Actively contributing to the global PTB program and People & Culture transformation to ensure the defined strategy is successfully implemented within the assigned countries. What you bring to our team: ​ We are looking for someone who is self-motivated,

• competenze linguistiche: sei fluente in tedesco e inglese
• Proficienza Tecnica: Hai competenze Excel avanzate (v-lookup, tabelle pivot) e una solida comprensione del ciclo di payroll e dei processi HR.
• Capacità analitica: Hai un occhio eccellente per i dettagli e può navigare strutture di dati complesse per risolvere gli errori e garantire l'accuratezza.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Team Lead PT Insights & Data Delivery (Product Manager) is accountable for the entire product lifecycle, from initial ideation and strategic planning through to launch, scaling, and eventual retirement. This role is pivotal in transforming scientific and business needs into tangible, high-value technology solutions. You will be responsible for defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, ensuring it aligns with the overarching goals of our organization and ultimately accelerates the delivery of life-changing diagnostics and medicines to patients. This role demands a distinctive combination of scientific inquisitiveness, technical proficiency, and business insight to successfully navigate the landscape. Your primary objective is to lead engineering and service teams building desirable, feasible, viable, and sustainable products that meet the evolving needs of our internal users while maintaining strict compliance with relevant industry standards. Description of the area PT Insights and Data Delivery focuses on the reliable delivery of high quality data combined with the use of data in analytics solutions for both existing and anticipatory business needs with a cross-functional scope and mandate. The role will lead a team of over 20 people to bring the following key benefits to PT
• Reusable and scalable systems that are efficiently operated
• Faster and more robust solutions to meet business challenges
• Reliable delivery of key metrics and performance indicators
• Identifying areas for cost savings and where to invest
• Data/evidence driven decisions
• Process enabling efficient maintenance of reliable enterprise data The role will need knowledge and experience in the following areas Analytics excellence for Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality

• GMP and Non-GMP Reporting

• Enhanced Business Planning
• Self service reporting
• Reducing workload for knowledge workers
• Drive towards actionable insights
• Reliable key performance indicators and metrics

Defines product strategy, roadmap, and features aligned with business goals, user needs and organisational policies. Proactively integrate relevant AI capabilities into the product roadmap. Define, track, and communicate relevant KPIs for the product to measure its performance and contribution to business goals and strategy.

Define and track key metrics related to user satisfaction, engagement, and value delivery, and use this data to inform product iterations.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Payroll, Time & Benefits Team focuses on payroll, benefits, absence management, customer service and advisory support to employees, manager and business partners ensuring end-to-end process completion in line with customer focused principles to ensure the Roche People Practices work for the business. The Opportunity As a Payroll Time Benefits Specialist - French speaking , you are responsible for payroll, time, benefits data maintenance and administrative activities in a timely and accurate manner. You are also contributing to the continuous improvement of the People Support Solutions delivery. This is coupled with strong customer focus, communication skills and solution orientation.
• Performing a variety of payroll, time and benefits administrative and analytical activities in support of the EMEA countries/affiliates and serving as a Tier 2 point of contact for all payroll, time & benefits customer inquiries
• Interpreting People & Culture policies and practices for EMEA payroll administration and ensuring Roche local time & absence policies are met
• Providing timely responses to customer payroll inquiries by using an internal case management system and proactively identifying and troubleshooting payroll issues to determine root cause and solutions for resolution
• Analyzing multiple payroll audits during processing to ensure accuracy and validity and corresponding with managers and leaders to confirm accuracy of employee time & absence entry
• Managing, processing and reconciling mass upload files for all pay frequencies and supporting inquires resolution, escalating requests to the appropriate resources as necessary
• Monitoring data flows to/from Workday to Vendor for accuracy and ensuring integrations are processed timely and resolving any errors ensuring accurately processed
• Analyzing and controlling payroll processes, accruals and employer obligations for EMEA countries and actively participating in the development and implementation of continuous improvement initiative ​ Who you are
• We are seeking an individual with 2+ years of experience in payroll services, in a shared service center environment preferably
• Strong communication skills in English and French (written and spoken) is essential.
• High learning agility on different payroll country practice and able to provide remote support in payroll, time, benefits administration operations with timely manner
• Excellent attention to detail and analytical ability
• Advanced Excel skills (pivot table, v-lookup, etc.) ​ In Exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.

The Position Deine Abteilung Wir sind in der Abteilung Einsatzstoff Entwicklung und unser Team ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung, Modifizierung und Charakterisierung von Reagenzien (Partikel) im Bereich Process Technologies and Material Science ( RRD Chemistry Solutions ). Wir sind ein Team von 10 Mitarbeitern und bearbeiten Entwicklungs- und Optimierungsprojekte für diagnostische Tests. Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung in die grundlegenden Techniken der Partikelsynthese (z. Bsp. Nanopartikel, Antikörper Immobilisierung) wollen wir Dich in aktuelle Projekte miteinbeziehen. Hierbei wirst du mit einem multikulturellen und motivierten Team zusammenarbeiten. Deine Aufgaben
• Du hilfst bei der Durchführung einfacher Synthesen in der Technologie Chemie (unter Anleitung), die unter Einhaltung der gültigen Arbeitssicherheits- und Sicherheitsvorgaben durchgeführt werden
• Nach einer Einweisung, führst Du Experimenten zur Partikeln Synthese, Charakterisierung und Anwendung unter der Anleitung und Überwachung einer qualifizierten Fachkraft, wie einem Chemielaborant, Chemieingenieur oder Chemiker durch
• Du kümmerst Dich um die Durchführung einfacher analytischer Tests
• Du dokumentierst Deine Arbeiten
• Du beachtest die Sicherheitsunterweisung und die internen und externen Vorgaben, hinsichtlich Arbeitssicherheit und Umweltschutz Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Chemie, Biotechnologie, Biologie, Verfahrenstechnik immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in einem Gap-Year
• Du bringst idealerweise erste Kenntnisse im Partikelsynthese, Charakterisierung und grundlegende theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in Protein-biochemischen Methoden mit
• Du arbeitest gern in einem Labor oder Technikum (pilot plant)
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung
• You are proficient in English and not afraid of talking to international clients Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine
• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge
• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus
• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle Deine Bewerbung Denke daran, daß sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor und Master Studium), wo es schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are looking for YOU to join our TALENT POOL at our Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest! The Global Digital Hub has been established within Roche Services & Solutions Center in Budapest. Our main purpose is to strengthen the digital capabilities of Roche globally by supporting central initiatives with Social Media Management, Brand Support, Digital Publishing Services, Marketing Automation, Copywriting and Creative Design. As a Global Digital Campaign Expert in the Digital Campaigns Chapter, you are central to global campaign content planning, creation, activation, and reuse. You establish and maintain key relationships with stakeholders across the global Pharma or Diagnostics networks, ensuring effective communication between brand and production teams. Your strategic insight allows you to offer crucial recommendations on content development, co-create omnichannel strategies, and drive content reuse across Roche. You leverage your knowledge of the Life Science industry to ensure global campaigns are strategically aligned and adaptable to evolving needs. You coordinate production of assets to support the global product strategy, ensuring asset quality and brand consistency. You manage global campaign asset creation by preparing briefs, coordinating production, and validating with stakeholders. You track content adoption and localization through reports, and dashboards, ensuring that existing assets are effectively utilized. Additionally, you forecast demand, schedule content creation and reuse, and manage global-to-local calendar mapping. You pilot new content services, ensuring high adoption and effective reuse. You oversee end-to-end campaign content production and serve as the main contact for global brand teams, creative teams and production teams, managing expectations and business discussions and ensuring timely, high-quality delivery. You coordinate a team of Campaigns Delivery specialists, facilitate regular communication and monitor progress, ensuring their priorities are clear and processes are aligned. The Opportunity:
• Establish and maintain relationships with stakeholders across global Pharma or Diagnostics networks, ensuring effective communication between brand and production teams.
• Provide strategic recommendations on content development, co-create omnichannel strategies, and drive content reuse across Roche.
• Utilize Life Science industry knowledge to ensure global campaigns are strategically aligned and adaptable to evolving needs.
• Coordinate production of assets to support the global product strategy, ensuring asset quality and brand consistency, and manage global campaign asset creation, including preparing briefs and validating with stakeholders.
• Track localization and adoption of content across affiliates, ensuring effective utilization of existing assets and oversee end-to-end campaign content production, serving as the main contact with global brand teams.
• Forecast demand, schedule content creation and reuse, and manage global-to-local content calendars, providing recommendations on KPIs and metrics across customer journey touchpoints.
• Support the Digital Campaigns Network by driving best practices, continuous improvement, feedback, and facilitating regular communication within a team of Digital Project delivery specialists to ensure priorities are clear and processes are aligned. Who you are:
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position In the area of Invasive Sensor Development, we shape the future of continuous monitoring systems at Roche. Our team works at the fascinating and technologically demanding interface between medical technology and the human organism. We research and develop innovative devices worn on or in the body, taking a deep dive into biological interfaces. We are characterized by an open culture, a strong team spirit, and a shared focus on significantly improving the quality of life for patients worldwide. The Opportunity / Your Tasks In this versatile role, you will contribute your profound expertise to decisively advance both existing products and our development pipeline:
• Driving Trends & Research: You identify scientific and technological trends and recognize forward-looking research areas for our strategic value streams.
• Leading Research Projects: Working closely with internal colleagues and external research institutions, you lead and conduct basic as well as applied research in the field of invasive sensors.
• Shaping the Pipeline: You support the organization with your expertise in making well-founded directional decisions within our complex product development pipeline.
• Product Development & Optimization: You integrate your expertise directly into the new development of products and simultaneously ensure that existing systems and the underlying development processes are continuously optimized.
• Interface Management: You steer and monitor work packages assigned to external research partners and ensure a seamless end-to-end (E2E) process chain. Who You Are You are a passionate, structured individual who is enthusiastic about scientific innovation and knows how to clearly comprehend complex technical and biological systems:
• Education: You have successfully completed a Master’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, or a related discipline – ideally, you also hold a PhD.
• Professional Experience: You possess several years of relevant professional experience following your graduation, enabling you to act fully independently and to provide technical guidance to other team members.
• System & Process Understanding: A strong understanding of systems and processes is a prerequisite for this position. As a systems thinker, you confidently navigate complex structures, understand the interaction between device and organism, and have the ability to clearly structure scientific workflows and interfaces.
• Mindset & Business Acumen: Strategic and creative thinking form the foundation of your excellent customer understanding and your strong business acumen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Sobre Roche: Un futuro más saludable. Es lo que nos impulsa a innovar. Avanzar continuamente en la ciencia y garantizar que todos tengan acceso a la atención médica que necesitan hoy y en las generaciones futuras. Crear un mundo en el que todos tengamos más tiempo con las personas que amamos. Eso es lo que nos hace ser Roche. Oportunidad: El becario apoyará al área de logística en actividades administrativas y operativas dentro del proceso de entrega y retiro de instrumentos acorde al marco de cumplimiento siguiendo los procedimientos establecidos dentro de las políticas con la finalidad de concretar proyectos y cumplir con los objetivos de venta. Responsabilidades:
• Coordinar con las diferentes áreas la instalación y puesta en marcha de equipos de diagnóstico en base a las políticas, con la finalidad de concretar proyectos y cumplir con los targets de venta.
• Solicitar la compra de equipos/accesorios de diagnóstico de acuerdo a la demanda del área comercial.
• Coordinar con el área de servicios y logística el retiro de los instrumentos de diagnóstico.
• Mantener la base instalada (actualización de proyectos, actualización de instrumentos de acuerdo al sitio de instalación) - SAP.
• Llevar el seguimiento a los indicadores del proceso.
• Mantener un control sano de inventarios de instrumentos Quien eres: Pasión por el propósito: Te motiva saber que tu trabajo detrás de cámaras permite que un paciente reciba un diagnóstico a tiempo. Agilidad: Te adaptas rápido a los cambios y tienes facilidad para priorizar tareas en un entorno dinámico. Integridad : El cumplimiento de normas y políticas es fundamental para ti; eres ético y responsable con el manejo de información e inventarios. Analítico : Te gusta trabajar con datos e indicadores para medir el éxito de tus actividades. Resiliencia y Enfoque: Entiendes que la logística tiene retos inesperados; mantienes la calma ante la presión y te enfocas en encontrar soluciones efectivas en lugar de detenerte ante los obstáculos (tolerancia a la frustración). Mentalidad de Innovación: No te conformas con "así se ha hecho siempre". Buscas constantemente formas de simplificar y automatizar tareas operativas para hacer los procesos más eficientes y libres de errores. Beneficios de reubicación no están disponibles para esta posición. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Auxilia na preparação e análise de dados de preços e realiza a monitorização ativa de contratos.
• Colabora diretamente com as equipas de vendas para desenvolver estratégias de gestão de faturação e pagamentos.
• Participa ativamente na preparação de relatórios e apresentações para a gestão sénior.
• Ajuda na implementação de medidas de eficiência e monitoriza a sua execução no dia a dia.
• Dá suporte à manutenção de sistemas de preços e ferramentas analíticas vitais para a equipa.
• Lidera o processo de implementação de reajustes com uma vasta carteira de clientes.

• Formação Acadêmica: em Administração, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas. Com previsão de conclusão de curso para 2028 .

• Disponibilidade para estagiar de 1 a 2 anos , mantendo vínculo ativo com a instituição de ensino durante todo o período.

• Ferramentas: Excel do nível intermediário ao avançado .

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Dein neues Team: Du wirst Teil unseres "Simplify Implementation Teams" innerhalb des Vertriebs Services. Wir sind ein dynamisches Team von Spezialist:innen, das in ganz Deutschland unterwegs ist, um unsere Diagnostiksysteme bei unseren Kunden (z. B. in Krankenhäusern und Laboren) zu implementieren. Als Team arbeiten wir eng zusammen, unterstützen uns gegenseitig bei komplexen Installationen und teilen unser technisches Wissen. Du bist ein wichtiger Knotenpunkt zwischen unseren Kund:innen, dem Vertrieb und dem technischen Service, um eine reibungslose Inbetriebnahme sicherzustellen. Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich Dein Fokus liegt auf der erfolgreichen Implementierung unserer Diagnostiksysteme. Dabei übernimmst du folgende Tätigkeiten:
• Du übernimmst die fachgerechte Aufstellung, Installation und Modifikation unserer Standard-Diagnostikgeräte direkt beim Kunden.
• Du führst eigenständig Testläufe durch, nimmst Applikationseinstellungen vor und stellst sicher, dass alle Systeme vom Start weg reibungslos funktionieren.
• Du bist der Schlüssel zu zufriedenen Kund:innen. Du übergibst das betriebsbereite System an das Laborpersonal und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Start.
• Falls bei der Installation technische oder applikative Fehler auftreten, bist Du zur Stelle. Du analysierst die Ursache und behebst Störungen im Rahmen der Implementierung.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position We are seeking a dedicated and experienced professional to join our team as a Senior Administrative Assistant / Event Planner. Your Opportunity The responsibilities for this role include: Corporate Event Management:
• Lead the planning, scheduling, and execution of various and complex events, such as inaugurations, town halls, global leadership team meetings, and other engagement or business events.
• Coordinate and manage facilities required for engagement events, including arrangement of cleaning, dining needs (e.g., coffee, tea), and other necessary resources.
• Liaise with suppliers and vendors for service contracts, event material procurement, and other necessary engagements.
• Create and manage budgets for events, track expenses, and ensure cost-effectiveness.
• Address and resolve any issues that may arise during event planning and execution.
• Develop and maintain strong working relationships with internal departments and external partners.
• Oversee all logistical aspects, such as transportation, accommodation, and on-site event setup and teardown.
• Arrange for audiovisual equipment, staging, and other technical requirements needed for the event.
• Act as the main point of contact for event stakeholders, including speakers, sponsors, and partners.
• Negotiate contracts with vendors, venues, and service providers to secure favorable terms and conditions.
• Develop and implement contingency plans to address potential risks and issues that may arise before and during the event.
• Conduct post-event evaluations to gather feedback from attendees, vendors, and team members.
• Analyze event success metrics, compile evaluation reports, and provide insights for future improvements.
• Support occupational health needs, participate in or provide input to the Emergency Committee and SHE (Safety, Health & Environment). Administrative Support:
• Manage calendars, workshops, and events for the organization.
• Handle financial support tasks, such as processing purchase orders (POs), invoices, and statements of work.
• Plan and schedule diverse types of meetings (e.g., events, offsites, interviews, stakeholder meetups) across multiple time zones for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring high confidentiality.
• Provide administrative support for business operations, including financial management processes, onboarding/offboarding activities, relationship management, learning management support, and department organization. Communication & Collaboration:
• Maintain relationships and information flow with the global management team.
• Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, ensuring effective teamwork.
• Skillfully manage the expectations and needs of internal and external stakeholders. Operational Efficiency:
• Schedule appointments, manage travel itineraries, and coordinate related arrangements.
• Prepare and manage expense reports through to settlement.
• Attend meetings, record and distribute meeting minutes.
• Prepare and analyze complex trends, reports, and presentations using data from various sources.
• Assist in preparing budget and project reports as required.
• Research, collect, compile, and analyze diverse data and information requests.
• Identify bottlenecks in administrative processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency. Quality & Improvement:
• Continuously improve quality and objectives.
• Manage all purchasing activities from order to execution of POs in the system.
• Review invoices

• Collaborate in the development of SHE related documentation.

• Ability to critically identify, analyze, and anticipate occupational safety hazards and risks.
• Understanding of critical tasks, safe work procedures and chemical management.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
• Proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to work collaboratively.
• Intermediate level of Google Workspace tools (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive). Preferred Skills
• Basic knowledge of SHE standards and regulations (e.g., ISO 45001, ISO 14001, NFPA).

As an R&D Scientist in our NGS Library Preparation and Target Enrichment team, you will be a key player in executing sample preparation workflows . You will work within a dynamic environment dedicated to advancing molecular biology research and contributing to innovative development efforts . This is an opportunity to thrive in a collaborative team that values technical excellence and scientific curiosity . The Opportunity
• Execute NGS library preparation from diverse sample types using various construction methods .
• Perform DNA and RNA extraction from biological samples, optimizing protocols for high yield and purity .
• Quantify nucleic acids accurately using instruments like Qubit and NanoDrop .
• Operate and troubleshoot sequencing platforms for routine laboratory runs .
• Conduct quality control for nucleic acids and libraries utilizing Agilent TapeStation .
• Maintain precise experimental records in laboratory notebooks and digital formats .
• Analyze experimental data to contribute to technical reports and team presentations .
• Collaborate with cross-functional team members on experimental design and troubleshooting . Who you are
• You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Molecular Biology, Genetics, Biochemistry, or a related field .
• You possess 2-4 years of relevant laboratory experience, ideally within an industry setting .
• You have hands-on experience with NGS library preparation protocols such as DNA-seq or RNA-seq .
• You are proficient in PCR, nucleic acid extraction, and standard molecular biology techniques .
• You demonstrate strong critical thinking skills and meticulous attention to detail in a fast-paced environment . Preferred
• Experience with advanced DNA QC instruments like Tapestation and Nanodrop .
• Strong interpersonal skills with a proven ability to work independently or as part of a collaborative team .
• Excellent organizational and time-management skills to meet project timelines . Relocation benefits are not available for this posting . descriptionByLocale.it: Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality. The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: Anchor Role: Engineering Management Who we are and what we care about? We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally. As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that saves lives. Interested? Great. We’d like to hear from you! Just click that “Apply Now” button and send us your CV in English …. and anything else that you think might impress us. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

titleByLocale.fr: Spécialiste de la stratégie et de l'analyse des données

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Questo ruolo si basa sul team Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) che guida l'eccellenza dei dati e l'analisi per potenziare il processo decisionale e la generazione delle prove all'interno di Roche Product Development. Sviluppiamo e implementiamo strategie di dati che sbloccano il valore dei dati clinici, operativi e reali per accelerare la generazione delle prove, il processo decisionale e l'innovazione in PD e oltre. Integrando i principi FAIR, promuovendo la governance dei dati e consentendo la produzione dei dati, RWCDS assicura che i dati non siano solo reperibili e utilizzabili, ma anche un driver di rigore scientifico, di prontezza regolamentare e di trasformazione AI-powered. Attraverso partnership profonde con funzioni interne e collaboratori esterni, forniamo un ecosistema di dati pronto per il futuro che supporta la salute personalizzata e lo sviluppo efficiente della droga. L'opportunità: Il Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contribuisce alla progettazione e all'esecuzione delle strategie e delle analisi dei dati che consentono la creazione di decisioni e approfondimenti in un'area terapeutica o in un portafoglio di molecole. Lavorando nell'ambito di Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, collaborerai con team interfunzionali per allineare la strategia dei dati con obiettivi clinici e traduttivi, identificare le risorse di dati chiave e supportare la fornitura di piani di prova integrati. Contribuirai anche alla traduzione delle esigenze scientifiche e aziendali in ambiti analitici e soluzioni basate sui dati. Questo ruolo richiede una solida base nella scienza dei dati, nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione di analisi, e una capacità di colmare le domande scientifiche con soluzioni pratiche dei dati.
• Si assiste a documentare strategie e requisiti di dati per programmi e aree terapeutiche
• Supporti gli sforzi di integrazione e armonizzazione dei dati applicando modelli e protocolli standard
• Contribuisci all'esecuzione analitica per casi di utilizzo sfruttando fonti di dati multi-modali in ambiti reali, clinici e operativi
• Contribuisci alla mappatura degli esercizi e alla documentazione della linea di dati per supportare il riutilizzo e la qualità dei dati
• Analizzi la struttura dei dati e supporti la standardizzazione della terminologia e dei metadati
• Collaborate con i membri del team e con i partner interni per mantenere asset di dati strutturati e accessibili Chi sei:
• Hai una laurea o un master in Informatica, Scienze della vita, Scienza informatica, o un campo correlato
• Hai uno sfondo forte in dati reali (RWD)
• Hai 2+ anni di esperienza lavorando con i dati strutturati in un ambiente di ricerca o assistenza sanitaria (esclusi gli stage)
• Hai conoscenza di base di R o Python
• Capisci dizionari di dati, mappature, o tagging dei metadati
• Conoscete i sistemi di dati utilizzati nelle impostazioni cliniche o operative
• Dimostra la capacità di pensare indipendente e la capacità di prendere decisioni basate su principi sani
• Esibisci un'eccellente agilità strategica, tra cui capacità di problem solving e di pensiero critico, e agilità che si estende oltre il dominio tecnico
• Lei dimostra il rispetto delle differenze culturali quando interagisce con i colleghi sul posto di lavoro globale
• Possiedi eccellenti capacità comunicative verbali e scritte, in particolare nei settori della presentazione e della scrittura, con la capacità di spiegare concetti tecnici complessi in linguaggio chiaro Preferiti:
• Esposizione a modelli di dati sanitari o set di dati clinici

We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development. The Opportunity: The Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contributes to the design and execution of data strategies and analyses that enable decision-making and insight generation across a therapeutic area or molecule portfolio. Working under the Data Strategy & Analytics Lead, you will partner with cross-functional teams to align data strategy with clinical and translational goals, identify key data assets, and support the delivery of integrated evidence plans. You will also contribute to the translation of scientific and business needs into analytical frameworks and data-driven solutions. This role demands a strong foundation in data science, analytics planning and execution, and an ability to bridge scientific questions with practical data solutions.

• You analyze data structure and support the standardization of terminology and metadata
• You collaborate with team members and internal partners to maintain structured and accessible data assets Who you are:

• You have basic knowledge of R or Python
• You understand data dictionaries, mappings, or metadata tagging
• You are familiar with data systems used in clinical or operational settings

• You demonstrate respect for cultural differences when interacting with colleagues in the global workplace
• You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills, specifically in the areas of presentation and writing, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in clear language Preferred Qualifications:
• Exposure to healthcare data models or clinical trial datasets
• Experience working in a matrixed or agile team environment Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position Ce rôle repose sur l'équipe de la Stratégie mondiale et clinique des données (RWCDS), qui stimule l'excellence et l'analyse des données afin d'améliorer la prise de décisions et la production de données probantes au sein du développement de produits Roche. Nous élaborons et mettons en oeuvre des stratégies de données qui débloquent la valeur des données cliniques, opérationnelles et réelles pour accélérer la production de données probantes, la prise de décisions et l'innovation dans la DP et au-delà. En intégrant les principes FAIR, en faisant progresser la gouvernance des données et en permettant la production de données, RWCDS s'assure que les données sont non seulement exploitables et utilisables, mais aussi un moteur de rigueur scientifique, de préparation réglementaire et de transformation assistée par l'IA. Grâce à des partenariats profonds avec des fonctions internes et des collaborateurs externes, nous formons un écosystème de données prêt à l'avenir qui soutient des soins de santé personnalisés et un développement efficace des médicaments. La possibilité : Le Data Strategy & Analytics Specialist contribue à la conception et à l'exécution de stratégies et d'analyses de données qui permettent de prendre des décisions et de générer des idées dans un domaine thérapeutique ou un portefeuille de molécules. Travaillant sous la direction de Data Strategy & Analytics, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour aligner la stratégie de données sur les objectifs cliniques et translationnels, identifier les principaux éléments de données et appuyer la mise en oeuvre de plans intégrés de données probantes. Vous contribuerez également à la traduction des besoins scientifiques et commerciaux en cadres d'analyse et en solutions basées sur les données. Ce rôle exige une base solide dans les domaines de la science des données, de la planification et de l'exécution des analyses, et la capacité de concilier les questions scientifiques avec des solutions pratiques en matière de données.
• Vous aidez à documenter les stratégies et les exigences en matière de données pour les programmes et les domaines thérapeutiques
• Vous soutenez les efforts d'intégration et d'harmonisation des données en appliquant des modèles et des protocoles standard
• Vous contribuez à l'exécution analytique pour les cas d'utilisation utilisant des sources de données multimodales dans des domaines réels, cliniques et opérationnels
• Vous contribuez aux exercices de cartographie et à la documentation de la ligne de données pour soutenir la réutilisation et la qualité des données
• Vous analysez la structure des données et soutenez la normalisation de la terminologie et des métadonnées
• Vous collaborez avec les membres de l'équipe et les partenaires internes pour maintenir des données structurées et accessibles Qui vous êtes :
• Vous êtes titulaire d'un baccalauréat ou d'une maîtrise en informatique, sciences de la vie, informatique ou un domaine connexe
• Vous avez une solide expérience en données du monde réel (RWD)
• Vous avez plus de 2 ans d'expérience en travaillant avec des données structurées dans un cadre de recherche ou de santé (à l'exclusion des stages)
• Vous avez une connaissance de base de R ou Python
• Vous comprenez les dictionnaires de données, les mappages ou le marquage des métadonnées
• Vous connaissez les systèmes de données utilisés en clinique ou en fonctionnement
• Vous démontrez votre capacité de penser et de prendre des décisions indépendantes sur la base de principes solides
• Vous présentez une excellente agilité stratégique, y compris la résolution de problèmes et la pensée critique, et l'agilité qui va au-delà du domaine technique
• Vous démontrez le respect des différences culturelles lors de vos interactions avec vos collègues sur le lieu de travail mondial
• Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite, en particulier dans les domaines de la présentation et de l'écriture, avec la capacité d'expliquer des concepts techniques complexes dans un langage clair Qualifications préférées :
• Exposition à des modèles de données de soins de santé ou à des ensembles de données d'essais cliniques
• Expérience de travail en équipe matricielle ou agile Les prestations de réinstallation ne sont pas disponibles pour cette affectation
