At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Role Purpose Roche Diagnostics provides integrated solutions for diagnostics testing in commercial and hospital labs, medical centers and laboratory networks. Our products and solutions support healthcare professionals in clinical decision making in a wide field of indications . Within the Healthcare Transformation and Access Department, we are seeking a Medical Affairs Advisor Advisor to provide medical and scientific support for our solutions with an initial core focus on Oncology diseases. The Medical Affairs Partner is a field-based medical expert in one or more therapeutic areas, responsible for developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) in order to create a better understanding of products and increase disease/product awareness, providing clinical and scientific support for HCPs, and providing medical information for our products to patients, caregivers, and the general public. Role scope: Key responsibilities
• Drives business-aligned medical strategy by leading annual and ongoing medical planning, including inputs on situational analyses and strategies
• Plan and implement medical tactics and activities for assigned therapeutic areas
• Plan and handle medical budgets
• Communicate, drive, and handle clinical research/study for medical evidence generation that helps practitioners, patients and payers make good health care decisions
• Establish and maintain relationships with healthcare professionals (HCPs) to create a better understanding of the company’s products and increase disease/product awareness
• Provide clinical and scientific support for HCPs, including answering questions about products and other related issues
• Prepare and deliver presentations on the therapeutic areas and company products, and participate in panel discussions
• Keep up to date on scientific and clinical developments in the therapeutic areas, and provide medical information to internal and external customers
• Review of non-, and promotional materials
• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and Roche Safety, Security, Health, and Environmental Protection policies, while demonstrating a solid understanding of compliance requirements and upholding the high standard of integrity. Additional task, duties and responsibilities:
• Responsible for acting in line with legal, regulatory and company standards and codes of practice (such as Roche Code of Conduct and any other Roche directives and guidelines)
• Work in a cross functional setup applying agile working methodology
• Ensure compliance with HCP interaction guidelines (e.g. iHCP) , and other guidelines from Roche quality and compliance groups Requirements: Education and experience
• Master’s degree or higher in science or related fields
• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the life sciences industry (diagnostics, pharmaceuticals, or biotechnology).
• Hands-on experience in medical affairs, clinical development, scientific communication, or product strategy .
• Prior experience in Oncology diseases is highly preferred.
• Good Compliance track record. No material Compliance violation is identified in the past 5 years Required skills and qualifications
• Good knowledge of Compliance requirements and clear understanding of high standards of Integrity
• Scientific and commercial understanding of diagnostic products, knowledge of product development and tri

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come Commercial Business Leader (CBL) per Foundation Medicine Institute, lavorerai all'interno di un ecosistema innovativo guidato da Foundation Medicine, un pioniere con oltre 15 anni di leadership nel combinare il progresso scientifico e tecnologico con le strategie di trattamento trasformativo. A Roche, ci impegniamo a trasformare la salute e ad avere un impatto positivo sulla vita dei pazienti. Unire il nostro team significa contribuire a promuovere la trasformazione della salute su scala globale in un ambiente dinamico che favorisce la collaborazione e l'eccellenza. In questo ruolo di alto impatto, avrete l'opportunità unica di plasmare il futuro della Medicina di Precisione su scala globale e garantire che le nostre soluzioni innovative traducono in benefici che cambiano la vita per i pazienti di tutto il mondo. Come membro centrale del International Business Team (IBT), rappresenterai l'International Commercial Business Unit, che fungerà da ponte strategico tra le funzioni globali e l'esecuzione regionale/locale. In questa capacità, si agirà come principale Collegamento Commerciale all'Area Business FMI, portando la "Voce del Cliente" all'avanguardia dell'organizzazione per informare i requisiti del prodotto e modellare le priorità del portafoglio. L'opportunità
• Strategia commerciale e esecuzione: guidare la progettazione, l'esecuzione e la priorità delle strategie commerciali, dei modelli operativi e dei progetti strategici chiave (ad esempio, le squadre, le comunità di pratica) per i mercati internazionali in collaborazione con le regioni.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: agire come collegamento commerciale alla corrispondente Business Area, Pharma e Rete Area Malattia, che rappresenta la voce del cliente dei mercati internazionali per dare priorità alla roadmap del portafoglio prodotti.
• Supporto affiliato & Market Expansion: Steer the business, supporto affiliati con diverse esigenze aziendali, guidare la riuscita implementazione dei prodotti FMI, identificare nuove opportunità di mercato / corsi, e gestire i rischi di mercato come definito nel Business Plan e P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliati in riunioni di clienti di alto livello / C (ad esempio, ospedali di alto livello, laboratori, paganti), fornire risorse centrali per trattative di contratto / clienti, e accelerare sinergie trasversali attraverso FMI IBT, iKAMs e Pharma.
• Integrazione della gestione delle malattie: assicurare l'integrazione della vostra area di attenzione in un approccio globale di gestione delle malattie, ove applicabile, collaborando strettamente con gli Affari medici e governativi / MAx e il capitolo della strategia regionale e innovazione.
• Change & Risk Management: Guidare cambiamenti organizzativi, sviluppare concetti di rete regionale, anticipare scenari di rischio, e stabilire adeguate strategie di gestione del rischio e mitigazione.
• Pianificazione finanziaria: collaborare con altri leader commerciali e finanza per preparare, tracciare e regolare il budget e la pianificazione aziendale internazionale in risposta alle influenze interne ed esterne. Chi sei
• Leader commerciale esperto: possiede un minimo di un diploma di laurea (o equivalente) con almeno 7 anni di esperienza in settori IVD o correlati, un forte record di decisioni commerciali strategiche, e l'esperienza preferita in un ruolo orientato al cliente o sul campo.
• Acume Strategico & Business: Dimostra l'agilità strategica comprovata per tradurre ampi piani concettuali in azioni semplificate, forte acume aziendale, e una solida comprensione del mercato clinico/prescrittivo (ad esempio, cura Oncologia) e sistemi sanitari.
• Progetto e cambiamento C
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As the Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine, you will work within an innovative ecosystem led by Foundation Medicine, a pioneer with over 15 years of leadership in combining scientific and technology advancement with transformative treatment strategies. At Roche, we are committed to transforming healthcare and making a positive impact on patients' lives. Joining our team means contributing to driving healthcare transformation on a global scale within a dynamic environment that fosters collaboration and excellence. In this high-impact role, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the future of Precision Medicine on a global scale and ensure that our innovative solutions translate into life-changing benefits for patients across the globe. As a core member of the International Business Team (IBT), you will represent the International Commercial Business Unit, serving as the strategic bridge between global functions and regional/local execution. In this capacity, you will act as the primary Commercial Liaison to the FMI Business Area, bringing the "Voice of the Customer" to the forefront of the organization to inform product requirements and shape portfolio priorities. The Opportunity
• Commercial Strategy & Execution: Drive the design, execution, and prioritization of commercial strategies, operating models, and key strategic projects (e.g., squads, communities of practice) for International Markets in collaboration with the regions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the corresponding Business Area, Pharma, and Disease Area Network, representing the customer voice of International Markets to prioritize the product portfolio roadmap.
• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Steer the business, support affiliates with diverse business needs, drive the successful implementation of FMI products, identify new market opportunities/trends, and manage market risks as defined in the Business Plan and P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support affiliates in high-stakes/C-level customer meetings (e.g., top hospitals, labs, payers), provide central resources for contract negotiations/tenders, and accelerate cross-functional synergies across FMI IBTs, iKAMs, and Pharma.
• Disease Management Integration: Ensure the integration of your focus area into an overall disease management approach where applicable, collaborating closely with Medical & Government Affairs / MAx and the regional strategy and innovation chapter.
• Change & Risk Management: Drive organizational changes, develop regional networking concepts, anticipate risk scenarios, and establish suitable risk management and mitigation strategies.
• Financial Planning: Collaborate with other commercial business leaders and finance to prepare, track, and adjust the International Business budget and business planning in response to internal and external influences. Who You Are
• Experienced Commercial Leader: Holds a minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with at least 7 years of experience in IVD or related sectors, a strong track record of strategic commercial decision-making, and preferred experience in a customer-facing or field-based role.
• Strategic & Business Acumen: Demonstrates proven strategic agility to translate broad conceptual plans into simplified actions, strong business acumen, and a robust understanding of the clinical/prescriber market (e.g., Oncology care) and healthcare systems.
• Project & Change Champion: P

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als Commercial Business Leader (CBL) for Foundation Medicine Institute arbeiten Sie in einem innovativen Ökosystem unter der Leitung von Foundation Medicine, einem Pionier mit über 15 Jahren Führungskraft bei der Kombination von wissenschaftlichen und technologischen Fortschritten mit transformativen Behandlungsstrategien. Bei Roche sind wir verpflichtet, die Gesundheitsversorgung zu transformieren und positive Auswirkungen auf das Leben der Patienten zu haben. Das Mitmachen unseres Teams bedeutet, in einem dynamischen Umfeld, das die Zusammenarbeit und Exzellenz fördert, einen Beitrag zur weltweiten Gesundheitstransformation zu leisten. In dieser wirkungsstarken Rolle haben Sie die einzigartige Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der Präzisionsmedizin global zu gestalten und sicherzustellen, dass unsere innovativen Lösungen weltweit zu lebensverändernden Vorteilen für Patienten übergehen. Als zentrales Mitglied des International Business Teams (IBT) vertreten Sie die International Commercial Business Unit, die als strategische Brücke zwischen globalen Funktionen und regionaler/lokaler Ausführung dient. In dieser Funktion fungieren Sie als primäre kommerzielle Verbindung zum FMI Business Area und bringen die "Voice of the Customer" an die Spitze der Organisation, um Produktanforderungen zu informieren und Portfolioprioritäten zu formen. Die Chance
• Kommerzielle Strategie & Ausführung: Fahren Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit den Regionen mit der Gestaltung, Durchführung und Priorisierung von Handelsstrategien, Betriebsmodellen und strategischen Schlüsselprojekten (z.B. Quads, Praxisgemeinschaften) für den internationalen Markt.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Act as the Commercial Liaison to the entsprechenden Business Area, Pharma und Disease Area Network, die die Kundenstimme von International Markets zur Priorisierung der Produktportfolio Roadmap darstellt.
• Affiliate Support & Market Expansion: Geschäftsführung, Support-Partner mit unterschiedlichen Geschäftsanforderungen, die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von FMI-Produkten, die Identifizierung neuer Marktchancen/Trends und die Bewältigung von Marktrisiken im Geschäftsplan und P&L.
• High-Stakes & Stakeholder Management: Support-Partner bei High-Stakes/C-Level-Kundensitzungen (z.B. Top-Krankenhäuser, Labore, Zahler), bieten zentrale Ressourcen für Vertragsverhandlungen/Tender und beschleunigen funktionsübergreifende Synergien über FMI IBTs, iKAMs und Pharma.
• Integration des Krankheitsmanagements: Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihr Schwerpunktgebiet in einen Gesamtansatz des Krankheitsmanagements eingebunden wird, der eng mit Medical & Government Affairs / MAx und dem regionalen Strategie- und Innovationskapitel zusammenarbeitet.
• Change & Risk Management: Organisationsänderungen antreiben, regionale Netzwerkkonzepte entwickeln, Risikoszenarien antizipieren und geeignete Risikomanagement- und Minderungsstrategien etablieren.
• Finanzplanung: Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Führungskräften und Finanzen für die Vorbereitung, Verfolgung und Anpassung des International Business Budgets und der Geschäftsplanung in Reaktion auf interne und externe Einflüsse. Wer bist du?
• Erfahrener Handelsführer: Erhält ein Minimum eines Bachelor-Abschlusses (oder gleichwertig) mit mindestens 7 Jahren Erfahrung in IVD oder verwandten Sektoren, eine starke Erfolgsbilanz der strategischen kommerziellen Entscheidungsfindung und bevorzugte Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten oder feldbasierten Rolle.
• Strategische & Business-Acumen: Demonstrate bewährte strategische Agilität, um breite konzeptionelle Pläne in vereinfachte Aktionen, starkes Business-Acumen und ein robustes Verständnis des klinischen/Präscriber-Marktes (z.B. Oncology Care) und Gesundheitssysteme zu übersetzen.
• Projekt und Wandel C
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que chef commercial (CBL) de la Fondation Medicine Institute, vous travaillerez au sein d'un écosystème novateur dirigé par Foundation Medicine, un pionnier de plus de 15 ans de leadership dans la combinaison des progrès scientifiques et technologiques avec des stratégies de traitement transformatrices. Chez Roche, nous nous engageons à transformer les soins de santé et à avoir un impact positif sur la vie des patients. Rejoindre notre équipe signifie contribuer à la transformation des soins de santé à l'échelle mondiale dans un environnement dynamique qui favorise la collaboration et l'excellence. Dans ce rôle à impact élevé, vous aurez l'occasion unique de façonner l'avenir de la médecine de précision à l'échelle mondiale et de veiller à ce que nos solutions innovantes se traduisent par des avantages qui changent la vie des patients à travers le monde. En tant que membre principal de l'International Business Team (IBT), vous représenterez l'International Commercial Business Unit, servant de pont stratégique entre les fonctions mondiales et l'exécution régionale/locale. À ce titre, vous agirez en tant que principale liaison commerciale avec le secteur d'activité de l'IMF, en mettant la « voix du client » au premier plan de l'organisation pour informer les exigences du produit et façonner les priorités du portefeuille. L'opportunité
• Stratégie commerciale et exécution: Diriger la conception, l'exécution et la hiérarchisation des stratégies commerciales, des modèles opérationnels et des projets stratégiques clés (par exemple, les équipes, les communautés de pratique) pour les marchés internationaux en collaboration avec les régions.
• Business Area & Pharma Liaison: Agir comme la liaison commerciale avec le Business Area, Pharma, et le réseau correspondant, représentant la voix des clients des marchés internationaux pour prioriser la feuille de route du portefeuille de produits.
• Soutien aux filiales et expansion du marché : dirigez l'entreprise, soutenez les filiales ayant des besoins d'affaires variés, dirigez la mise en oeuvre réussie des produits de l'IMF, identifiez de nouvelles opportunités/tendances du marché et gérez les risques du marché tels que définis dans le plan d'affaires et P&L.
• Hautes étapes et gestion des parties prenantes: soutenir les filiales dans les réunions de clients de haut niveau/C (p. ex., les hôpitaux de haut niveau, les laboratoires, les payeurs), fournir des ressources centrales pour les négociations contractuelles/appels d'offres, et accélérer les synergies interfonctionnelles entre les IBT de l'IMF, les iKAM et les Pharma.
• Intégration de la gestion des maladies : assurez l'intégration de votre domaine d'intervention dans une approche globale de gestion des maladies, le cas échéant, en collaborant étroitement avec les Affaires médicales et gouvernementales/MAx et le chapitre sur la stratégie régionale et l'innovation.
• Changement et gestion des risques: Diriger les changements organisationnels, élaborer des concepts de réseautage régional, anticiper les scénarios de risque et établir des stratégies appropriées de gestion et d'atténuation des risques.
• Planification financière: Collaborer avec d'autres chefs d'entreprise et de finance pour préparer, suivre et ajuster le budget des affaires internationales et la planification des affaires en réponse aux influences internes et externes. Qui vous êtes
• Leader commercial expérimenté : est titulaire d'un baccalauréat (ou d'un équivalent) d'au moins 7 ans d'expérience en DIV ou dans des secteurs connexes, d'une solide expérience en matière de prise de décisions commerciales stratégiques et d'une expérience privilégiée dans un rôle axé sur le client ou sur le terrain.
• Œuvre stratégique et d'affaires : Démontre une agilité stratégique éprouvée pour traduire des plans conceptuels généraux en actions simplifiées, un Œuvre forte d'affaires et une solide compréhension du marché clinique/prescripteur (par exemple, les soins oncologiques) et des systèmes de santé.
• Projet & Changement C

The Position Primary Purpose of Job (Job Summary) This role serves as a strategic leader driving the scaling and value acceleration of Roche’s AI and digital healthcare solutions from “10 to 100.” You will lead a hybrid team of AI Solution Catalyst Managers and Incubator & Partnership Managers to expand application scenarios, accelerate ecosystem adoption, and strengthen Roche’s leadership positioning in AI & Digital healthcare through ecosystem collaboration and innovation initiatives. The mandate is anchored in two core pillars: 1. AI Solution Value Amplification & Scaling Accelerating the adoption, expansion, and measurable value realization of Roche’s established AI and digital solutions across internal and external healthcare ecosystems. 2. Ecosystem Architecture, Policy Shaping & Healthcare Value Acceleration Architect and orchestrate a sustainable healthcare innovation ecosystem that accelerates AI solution value release through strategic partnerships, ecosystem collaboration, innovation platforms, and policy engagement. ➢ Healthcare Ecosystem Architecture & Digital Intelligence Incubator Leadership: Build strategic collaborations with hospitals, academic institutions and other ecosystem stakeholders. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About Roche UK A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. The Opportunity Imagine working for an organization that puts people at the heart of everything they do, where your contributions directly impact patient outcomes. At Roche, our number one priority is our patients, and we believe that every person plays a key role in achieving this mission. As a Regulatory Partner at Roche UK, you will be a vital part of our UK Regulatory Chapter. You will leverage your regulatory and scientific expertise to shape and drive strategic initiatives. This is your opportunity to make a difference and be part of a company dedicated to improving lives. UK Regulatory Group Responsibilities The Regulatory group collaborates with the wider business to translate the constantly evolving requirements of the UK regulatory environment into Roche policies, procedures, solutions, and strategies that ensure compliance and maximize the value for patients. Our activities encompass:
• Clinical Trial Applications
• National Licensing Applications
• Early Access to Medicines Applications
• National components of medicines authorization via the European Centralized procedure The team serves as Roche's primary contact with the MHRA, requiring effective cross-functional collaboration at both local and global levels, as well as the capability to negotiate and influence externally. Regulatory Partners need to be adaptable and entrepreneurial to identify opportunities, while maintaining a focused approach on ensuring compliance and playing a key role in retaining Roche UK's License to Operate. Who You Are You are a passionate regulatory expert with a clear vision for improving patient outcomes. With broad and comprehensive expertise within the UK regulatory environment, you will lead foundational work and partner with the business to solve complex regulatory issues impacting the chapter and/or wider business. You will contribute to the development of squad/chapter-based strategic plans and goals, and actively participate in the learning and development of other chapter members. You will have the ability to understand scientific and technical information relating to an assigned portfolio of Roche products. You also bring :
• A Scientific University degree
• Extensive experience in UK Regulatory Affairs
• Proven experience managing UK submissions post-Brexit
• Experience providing strategic and technical advice
• In-depth knowledge and experience of UK and EU regulatory requirements and procedures
• A proven track record of developing, implementing, and communicating regulatory strategies
• Excellent documentation skills to ensure high-quality and timely submissions
• Experience as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in defined subject areas or therapeutic areas
• Experience in mentoring peers, as well as managing stakeholder relationships Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambi

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Incident Response Operations) The Global Security Monitoring and Incident Response (MIR) team at Roche strives to keep our networks and users safe from constantly evolving threats. As a CyberSecurity Analyst, you will help protect proprietary information, patient data, keep computer systems clean, and provide a safe information environment for our users. Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems. As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents. Responsibilities:
• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment
• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information
• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts
• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents
• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations
• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team
• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group
• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management
• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes
• Mentor newer team members Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment
• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices
• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience
• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents
• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts
• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)
• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)
• Excellent organization and communication skills.
• Fluent spoken and written English Preferred Qualifications:
• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment
• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring
• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)
• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)
• A passion for the field of computer and network security
• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets
• Public speaking or mentoring experience Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build

Combing through massive amounts of signals, you will have to identify signs of abuse or compromise of on-premise as well as cloud resources. All team members share a set of core responsibilities, handling incidents, requests from experts, as well as enquiries from end users. CyberSecurity Analysts are responsible for monitoring security information, identifying threats, and showing initiative to defend all Roche information systems. As an incident responder, you are expected to take part in an on call rotation during weekends and can be mobilized during major incidents. Responsibilities:
• Monitoring and Incident Response for a global environment
• Take decisions, often under pressure, given partial information
• Contribute to proactive threat detection efforts
• Lead containment and remediation efforts during active security incidents
• Perform forensic analysis of relevant artifacts to support investigations
• Contribute to detection engineering activities across a global team
• Brief team members and leadership on relevant threats to the Roche group
• Communicate information security concepts and situations to senior management
• Contribute operational feedback to continuously strengthen detection and response processes
• Mentor newer team members Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field and 7+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years in a SOC/CERT/CSIRT environment
• Familiarity with TLP and information sharing best practices
• Ability to communicate information security-related concepts and situations to a non-technical audience
• Demonstrated ability to analyze, triage, and escalate information security incidents
• Knowledge of detection engineering and threat-hunting concepts
• Scripting and programming skills (Python, Javascript, Go, Rust, …)
• Demonstrated knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOs)
• Excellent organization and communication skills.
• Fluent spoken and written English Preferred Qualifications:
• Network and Endpoint security monitoring experience in a large complex environment
• Prior exposure to privacy frameworks in the context of IT security monitoring
• Knowledge of modern IAM controls and concepts (Zero Trust, Identity Aware Proxies, Active Directory Security, …)
• Knowledge of Cloud security concepts (multi-cloud environments, CSPM, …)
• A passion for the field of computer and network security
• Familiarity with various defensive AND offensive security toolsets
• Public speaking or mentoring experience Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione A Roche potete mostrare chi siete, addestrati per le qualità uniche che portate. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e le connessioni genuine, dove siete valorizzati, attrezzature e rispettati per chi siete, permettendo a voi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui intendiamo portare, fermare e curare le malattie e assicurare a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. Unitevi a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione La Divisione Roche Diagnostics è in un percorso eccitante per diventare più orientaleta ai dati, riconoscendo i dati come un bene critico per crescere il nostro business e imparare e aumentare costantemente. Questa trasformazione è guidata dall'implementazione di una strategia dati relativi e di un nuovo modello di gestione e governo dei dati, sovrainteso dall'Ufficio dei Dati Diagnostics (DDO).
• Stiamo cercando un esperito Lead per l'Adozione dei Dati con un forte background nell'industria delle scienze della vita. In questa posizione, fornire strategie e approcci per fornire ai key business e stakeholder tecnici per raggiungere la visione della Strategia dei Dati Diagnostics Roche, dove i dati sono condivisi e utilizzati di nuovo, e di nuovo, e di nuovo. L'Opportunità - Guidare e sovraintendere progetti di impatto alto che servono da catalizzatori per la Strategia Globale dei Dati Dia, diffusondo obiettivi di alto livello in piani organizzativi azionabili e scalabili, assicurando flussi di dati lisci e sicuri dai prodotti diagnostic cobas e navify. - Agire come partner strategico e individua, valutare e perfezionare le metodologie più efficaci per raggiungere gli obiettivi strategici in contesti di business diversifica. - Navigare una matrice globale complessa per allineare gli stakeholder in diverse regioni e aree colpite, compresi i Senior Management, gli Affiliati, il Legale e gli esperti tecnici e di dati. - Agire come moderatore principale per risolvere frizioni interfunzionali, colmando il pericolo tra le esigenze tecniche, le ragioni legali e le esigenze di business. - Identificare proattivamente gli ostacoli organizzativi e i sistemi blocchici che frenano l'adozione della strategia dei dati; progettare e implementare soluzioni creative per rimuoverli. - Dare potere e coachare i contributori e le squadre, raccolte loro strumenti e la mentalità necessaria per guidare il cambiamento all'interno dei propri domini. - Contribuire alla governance dei dati in ambito transdisciplinare, in modo che l'interoperabilità e la combinazione dei prodotti di dati siano facili lungo l'intero ciclo di vita, ad esempio dipendenti da politiche codificate e automatizzate. Chi sei? - Laurea magistrale in Informatica, Ingegneria o equivalente e 10+ anni di esperienza nell'industria delle scienze della vita, della salute o del medtech. - 8+ anni di esperienza in analisi di business, architettura, gestione di progetti e cambiamento. - Preferibilmente 4+ anni di esperienza in Coaching di Business e Sviluppo Organizzativo. - Risultato-orientato con una storia dimostrata di consegne in ambienti complessi. - Affinità forte per i dati e l'informazione. - Tracciato di esperienza dimostra di comunicazione e lavoro con un ampio spettro di stakeholder, dai data engineer e scienziati ai leader di business senior. - Conoscenza solida di metodi e approcci moderni di architettura dei dati (Domain-Driven Design, Data Mesh, FAIR principi, ecc.). - Fluenza in inglese (il tedesco è più). Chi siamo Un futuro più sano ci spinge a innovare. Insieme, più di 100.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo sono dedicati a avanzare la scienza, assicurando a tutti l'accesso alle cure oggi e per le generazioni future. I nostri sforzi portano a più di 26 milioni di persone trattate con i nostri farmaci e oltre 30 miliardi di test condotti utilizzando i nostri prodotti diagnostici. Ci empowerment reciprocamente per esplorare nuove possibilità, favorire la creatività e mantenere le nostre ambizioni alte, in modo da poter prendere soluzioni di cura che hanno un impatto globale. Costruiamo un futuro più sano, insieme. Roche è un Datore di Lavoro Uguale Opportunità.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Roche Diagnostics Division is on an exciting journey to become more data-driven, recognizing data as a critical asset to grow our business and continuously learn and optimise. This transformation is driven by the implementation of a comprehensive data strategy and a new data operating and governance model, overseen by the Diagnostics Data Office (DDO). We are seeking an experienced Data Adoption Lead with a strong background in the life sciences industry. In this position, you will liaise with key business and technical stakeholders to provide strategies and approaches in order to achieve the vision of the Roche Diagnostics Data Strategy, where data is shared and used again, and again, and again. The Opportunity
• Lead and oversee high-impact projects that serve as catalysts for the global Dia Data Strategy, translating high-level objectives into actionable, scalable organizational roadmaps, ensuring seamless and secure data flows from diagnostic cobas and navify products.
• Act as a strategic partner and identify, evaluate, and refine the most effective methodologies to achieve strategic goals within diverse business contexts.
• Navigate a complex global matrix to align stakeholders across diverse regions and impacted areas, including Senior Management, Affiliates, Legal and technical and data experts.
• Act as a lead moderator to resolve cross-functional frictions, bridging the gap between technical requirements, legal constraints, and business needs.
• Proactively identify organizational burdens and systemic bottlenecks that hinder data strategy adoption; design and deploy creative solutions to dismantle these obstacles.
• Empower and coach contributors and teams, providing them with the tools and mindset necessary to lead change within their own domains.
• Contribute to cross-domain data governance such that interoperability and combination of data products is straightforward along the whole lifecycle, e.g. reliant on codified and automated policies. ​ Who you are
• A Master's degree in Informatics, Engineering or equivalent and 10+ years of experience in life science, healthcare or medtech industries
• 8+ years of experience in business analysis, architecture, project and change management
• Preferably 4+ years experience in Business Coaching and Organizational Development
• Result-oriented with a demonstrated history of delivering in complex environments
• Strong affinity for data and information
• Proven track record of communicating and working with a broad spectrum of stakeholders, from data engineers and scientists to senior business leaders
• Sound knowledge of modern data architecture methods and approaches (Domain-Driven Design, Data Mesh, FAIR principles, etc.)
• Fluent in English (German is a plus) Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Who We Are At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives, and we are bold in both decision and action - we believe that good business means a better world. That is why we come to work every single day. We commit ourselves to scientific rigor, unassailable ethics and access to medical innovations for all. We do this today to build a better tomorrow. Roche is strongly committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We strive to build teams that represent a range of backgrounds, perspectives and skills. Embracing diversity enables us to create a great place to work and to innovate for patients. Step into the Future of IT with Roche! As a seasoned Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) Incident Manager at Roche, you will leverage your deep software engineering expertise to propel our products to new heights of robustness, scalability and reliability. You’ll be at the helm of incident management, orchestrating swift and effective responses to ensure our digital infrastructure remains available, performant, and secure. This isn't just a role—it's an invitation to shape the backbone of technological innovations forward. Your Mission Design and maintain cutting-edge tools, scripts and frameworks that automate repetitive tasks, streamline software deployment and manage expansive systems with unparalleled efficiency. Partner closely with forward-thinking development teams to architect and implement high-performance solutions that elevate system efficiency, optimize resource utilization and enhance deployment processes for superior uptime and user satisfaction. Your Impact Lead the charge in incident management and response. Detect system anomalies, troubleshoot swiftly and conduct thorough root cause analyses to prevent recurring issues. Champion continuous improvement by refining monitoring and alerting mechanisms, conducting insightful post-incident reviews and embedding best practices in software lifecycle management. Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant. By joining our elite team, you will play a pivotal role in delivering seamless experiences to our end-users, exceeding business and customer demands, and solidifying Roche's reputation as a leader in IT innovation. Your Core Responsibilities
• Lead the lifecycle of incidents from initial detection to successful resolution and post-incident review.
• Coordinate and guide response teams to resolve incidents quickly and efficiently.
• Develop, implement, and refine incident management processes and procedures.
• Conduct regular reviews to identify root causes and drive the implementation of corrective actions.
• Work on-call outside of normal working hours and weekends as scheduled to ensure continuous support.
• Oversee the onboarding of new products into our support ecosystem.
• Provide consistent and clear updates to technical teams, business users, and management.
• Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, product managers, test engineers, support teams, and administrators to enhance system reliability.
• Identify and implement opportunities to enhance incident management processes and tools.
• Align SRE activities with product release planning to streamline product adoption.
• Actively contribute to the growth and development of the SRE team's capabilities, nurturing a stronger, more inclusive, and resilient team. Who You Are:
• Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering

Your strategic foresight and meticulous planning will ensure our systems are not only reliable but also superlatively performant. • Lead the lifecycle of incidents from initial detection to successful resolution and post-incident review.

• Oversee the onboarding of new products into our support ecosystem.
• Provide consistent and clear updates to technical teams, business users, and management.
• Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, product managers, test engineers, support teams, and administrators to enhance system reliability.
• Identify and implement opportunities to enhance incident management processes and tools.
• Align SRE activities with product release planning to streamline product adoption.
• Actively contribute to the growth and development of the SRE team's capabilities, nurturing a stronger, more inclusive, and resilient team. Who You Are:
• Minimum Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. We are seeking an architect-level Principal Software Engineer II to lead the software evolution of Roche’s proprietary sequencing technology, SBX. In this role, you will bridge the gap between experimental data science and industrial software engineering. While you will still engage with the "science" of DNA sequencing, your primary mandate is to engineer the systems that make that science scalable, reproducible, and fast. You will serve as the Technical Lead for a hybrid squad, driving the transition of experimental AI/models from Jupyter notebooks into robust, version-controlled, and highly optimized production libraries running on high-performance infrastructure. You will define the software architecture for SBX data analysis. You are not just analyzing data; you are building the engine that processes it. You will ensure that our basecalling and sequencing algorithms are not only accurate but are also performant, maintainable, and deployable at scale. The Opportunity
• Define and enforce software engineering standards, including clean code practices, comprehensive unit/integration testing, and mandatory code reviews within the data science team.
• Develop modular and extensible software libraries for DNA analysis, separating algorithmic logic from infrastructure code.
• Implement and oversee continuous integration and deployment pipelines to automate testing and streamline research code release cycles.
• Optimize performance of Python/PyTorch codebases, reimplementing critical bottlenecks in C++ and CUDA for GPU cluster efficiency.
• Convert theoretical bioinformatics concepts into highly efficient production-ready code.
• Design and implement solutions for effective memory management and I/O operations, tailored for large-scale genomic datasets.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As a R2R Period-End Close Senior Analyst based in San José, Costa Rica, you will be an integral part of our Global Shared Services organization. This role serves as a subject matter expert, delivering advanced accounting support and complex financial analysis while driving process improvements and automation initiatives. You will act as a key point of contact for accounting and reporting matters, serving as a trusted advisor for our supported affiliates. Your key responsibilities will include:
• Accounting Expertise & Audit Leadership: Lead complex accounting analyses and audit activities for assigned areas. You will serve as a subject matter expert for affiliates and internal stakeholders, ensuring technical accounting excellence.
• Financial Reporting & Close Activities: Prepare and review complex financial statements and reports. You will manage month-end close activities, including journal entries, cost allocations, and reconciliations, while maintaining a proper audit trail and compliance with standards.
• Analysis, Commentary & Advisory: Analyze financial results to investigate variances and provide clear, actionable insights to management. You will interpret and communicate financial data effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
• Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Team Development: Support the growth of the team through coaching, reviewing work, and contributing to cross-functional initiatives and global projects.
• Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements and support automation initiatives to increase the efficiency of the Record-to-Report flow. Who you are: You are a highly analytical finance professional with a strong attention to detail, capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment to meet tight deadlines. Requirements and Qualifications:
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance , or a related field. A professional certification ( CPA, ACCA , or equivalent) is preferred.
• Experience: Minimum of 4+ years of experience in accounting or finance. Prior experience in a Finance Shared Services environment is preferred. Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry is a plus.
• Technical Skills: * Strong knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS .
• Experience with ERP systems, specifically SAP (FI, CO/PA, MM, FA, FCC) and BlackLine is highly desirable.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace.
• Languages: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent in English and Spanish . Portuguese and or French is preferred.
• Core Competencies: * Strong stakeholder management and collaboration abilities.
• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on process automation and continuous improvement.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision. Relocation benefits are not available for this posting. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position On en Roche Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one? Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale. What is it?
• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.
• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.
• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.
• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning. Why join?
• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges
• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale
• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations
• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams
• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback
• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche The Opportunity Drive business performance through financial insight, strategic sourcing, and data-driven decision-making. Rotations may include:
• Customer Finance
• Controlling & Reporting
• Procurement & Strategic Sourcing The Position
• Analyze financial and operational performance to identify risks and opportunities
• Support pricing, cost, and margin optimization initiatives
• Contribute to procurement and sourcing strategies
• Participate in forecasting, business planning, and performance management
• Monitor customer profitability and performance
• Support cross-functional transformation initiative Who you are We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, Data Science , or related fields
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)
• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments
• Full availability for a 24-month program Timelines & further information
• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)
• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe every patient deserves the best diagnostic outcome. As a Technical Service Manager, you will be the driving force behind the reliability of Roche diagnostic instruments in Indonesia — leading a team of Field Service Engineers and ensuring that every laboratory we serve can trust their equipment, every day. If you are a hands-on technical leader who thrives in the field, takes ownership of outcomes, and genuinely cares about the people you lead and the customers you serve, we want to hear from you. The Opportunity You will lead the Field Service Engineer (FSE) team for Roche Diagnostics Indonesia, owning the full lifecycle of instrument service — from installation and preventive maintenance through to troubleshooting and customer escalation management. Reporting to the Head of Customer Support, you will be accountable for team performance, customer satisfaction, and the operational discipline that keeps our instruments — and our customers' laboratories — running at their best. In this role, you will:
• Lead, develop, and manage a team of Field Service Engineers — setting clear targets, monitoring performance, and building their technical and professional capability
• Own instrument reliability across your territory: plan and execute preventive maintenance, manage escalations, and ensure all service activities are documented and traceable in line with Roche SOPs
• Drive customer satisfaction by resolving hardware and software issues with urgency, following up within 24 hours on all raised problems, and handling customer complaints with accountability
• Ensure operational compliance across all service activities — including case management in Rexis, service bulletin implementation, and trunk stock and spare parts management
• Report on team performance and operational metrics to the Head of Customer Support, providing clear monthly reviews and contributing to continuous service improvement Who You Are You bring:
• A Bachelor's degree in Electro Medical Engineering or Electrical Engineering from a reputable university

The Position Purpose: LumiraDx sensors are complex, highly regulated products that require precision manufacturing, supported by a detailed supply chain, and monitored closely for on-market issues. The product care engineer will support the manufacturing, logistics, R&D, and quality teams with material lifecycle management, on-market product support, and transfer of new products to manufacturing. Product or material issues are reviewed through the operations Action Team. Engineering resources are assigned to contain and troubleshoot problems, using a structured and methodical approach. Communication is key, and the product care engineer will report progress to the Action Team and other management stakeholders. Responsibilities:
• Technical supplier management – Work with cross-functional teams across sensor manufacturing and packaging to manage and support material lifecycles as LumiraDx transfers products to Roche branding and IVDR registration.
• On-market product support – Join the Action Team and perform root-cause investigations into product performance and manufacturing issues. Support material change projects by testing and validating changes from suppliers.
• Product design transfers – Aid the design transfer teams by developing and validating manufacturing processes for new products. Characterise product attributes and processes through DOE and test method development. Profile: Essential Education/ Qualifications:
• Degree qualified in relevant engineering or scientific discipline and/or proven experience working as an engineer within a regulated industry Requirements (incl. Key Skills):
• Hands-on engineer with experience in medical (or other regulated) industry
• Experience working in a fast-paced, target driven and regulated environment.
• Experience working on multiple projects in tandem, while meeting timelines.
• Experience / awareness of equipment, product, and process development and optimisation.
• Experience with, or willingness to learn, the use of metrology equipment to assess and characterise products and materials.
• Knowledge of statistical process controls, capabilities, and analysis techniques.
• Experience of writing and executing product and process verification protocols.
• High level of computer literacy in MS Office.
• Competent in documentation and report writing, specifically verification and validation protocols and reports. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Diagnostics are an integral part of decision-making along every step of a person’s health, wellness and disease journey. A diagnostic test alone can help clinicians change the course of someone’s healthcare experience – and their life. We are a healthcare pioneer and the industry’s global leader in in-vitro diagnostics, our Diagnostics Division pushes boundaries and challenges the status quo to redefine what’s possible. Our commitment to research and development means we can bring to the market integrated solutions in diagnostic testing, laboratory efficiency, healthcare digitalisation and decision support tools and software. Our products deliver increasingly precise information to help save lives, prevent or control the risk of infection and monitor treatment effectiveness. The Opportunity This position is primarily responsible for initiating, directing, and executing scientific research, development, and manufacturing process strategies to support both new and existing products. A central pillar of this role involves creating and scaling a comprehensive digital pathology workflow, bridging the gap between traditional histology and high-throughput data analysis. You will investigate the feasibility of applying a wide variety of scientific principles to potential inventions and products, with a specific emphasis on integrating state-of-the-art imaging tools and automated analysis platforms into the laboratory ecosystem. As a subject matter expert, you will maintain a broad knowledge of cutting-edge theories, serving as an in-house and outside consultant while making meaningful contributions to scientific literature and international conferences. You may act as a primary spokesperson for corporate scientific affairs and provide strategic advice to top management regarding the evolution of digital pathology and assay innovation. Furthermore, you will participate in and promote the professional growth of junior scientists. Utilizing advanced professional concepts, you will contribute to the development of product and process principles, achieving complex objectives through creative and effective methodologies.
• Digital Pathology & CDx Development: Participate in the creation and implementation of digital pathology workflows for Companion Diagnostics (CDx) projects, ensuring all methods and processes are optimized for clinical-grade imaging and data integrity.
• Research & Experimental Design: Plan and execute complex R&D projects using advanced scientific knowledge and DOE (Design of Experiments) to define new components, identify technical challenges, and develop potentially patentable reagents or systems.
• Data Analysis & Process Improvement: Analyze experimental data to form technical conclusions and implement improvements in work processes or documentation, consistently promoting a "Quality First Time" approach to all deliverables.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with cross functional teams to share expertise, contribute to project planning, and deliver presentations of results to internal and external stakeholders to advance corporate scientific goals. Who You Are:
• Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline plus 8 or more years of progressive work experienc

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally.

As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health.

The opportunity

• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods

• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants

• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes

• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes

• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature

Who you are

• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field

• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology

• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage

• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization

• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production

This position is limited to 2 years.

Application documents
To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Your contact to us! With people. For people.
Do you need further support?
Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity:
• Project Undertaking and Delivery: Assist and take ownership of key projects from various teams (MWA/OMSS/CB); responsible for decomposing strategic objectives into specific action plans. Lead project progress control, resource coordination, and cross-functional communication to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.
• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.
• AI Technology Empowerment: Act as the department's AI application expert; guide and assist product groups in building AI-based product management tools and intelligent workflows to drive digital transformation. Precisely identify business pain points within the ML department; develop and promote AI solutions to enhance the quality and efficiency of content generation.
• Team Productivity Enhancement: Leverage AI technology to deeply optimize internal approval processes, online operating systems, and user-facing business material preparation, significantly reducing the time investment of Product Managers in repetitive and administrative tasks.
• Large-scale Event Management: Oversee the planning and execution of major internal and external conferences (both online and offline) and brand promotion activities; responsible for vendor management and on-site operations.
• Omni-channel Media Operations: Optimize and maintain departmental marketing communication channels (e.g., WeChat, webinar platforms, and 3rd party professional media); ensure published content is highly aligned with corporate branding and compliance requirements.
• Vendor and Budget Management: Manage vendors to ensure projects meet departmental KPIs and compliance policies; monitor project implementation and strictly control budgets following the ROI principle. Who you are:
• Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Biological Engineering, Marketing, Business Management, or a related discipline.
• Proficiency in both spoken and written English
• Deep expertise in AI application tools (e.g., LLMs, Workflow Automation) and digital marketing; ability to translate business needs into technical AI solutions.
• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.
• At least 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

• Project Implementation: Collaborate with Product Managers to develop effective promotion tools; ensure product strategies and marketing activities are efficiently executed and implemented at the sales terminal.

• Bachelor’s degree or above in Clinical Medicine, Biological Engineering, Marketing, Business Management, or a related discipline.
• Proficiency in both spoken and written English
• Deep expertise in AI application tools (e.g., LLMs, Workflow Automation) and digital marketing; ability to translate business needs into technical AI solutions.
• Expertise in MS Office Suite and project management software (e.g., MS Project, Trello, or Jira). PMP or equivalent certification is a significant plus.
• At least 5 years working experience in a similar capacity and in a similar industry. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. The Position Job Purpose This role acts as a "T-shaped" Value Orchestrator. The primary mission is to break down traditional silos between procurement and finance by autonomously leading procurement strategies and end-to-end (E2E) processes. Crucially, this role ensures that the "savings" and "cash flow optimizations" generated from procurement activities are directly reflected in the affiliate's financial planning and budgeting (P&L), thereby maximizing enterprise business value. Key Responsibilities 1. Procurement Strategy & Vendor Management
• Develop and implement procurement strategies and savings plans to support business objectives and financial targets.
• Execute comprehensive Vendor Management, which includes coordinating supplier selection, onboarding, regular performance evaluations, and maintaining strong, strategic vendor relationships.
• Lead supplier negotiations to secure favorable commercial terms.
• Optimize payment terms to significantly reduce deposit/advance invoices and improve company cash flows. 2. Budgeting & Financial Planning
• Integrate procurement savings and cost optimization plans directly into the affiliate's planning events, including Business Plan (BP), T0, T3, Baseline, as well as Period cost, and M&D budgets.
• Ensure procurement savings initiatives are tightly aligned with and realized in the company’s financial targets and P&L. 3. E2E Process, Governance & SOPs
• Create, maintain, and regularly update Procurement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and formalized purchasing policies to ensure operational efficiency and compliance across all departments.
• Establish and maintain governance frameworks for the full procurement lifecycle and internal controls.
• Continuously evaluate and enhance procurement processes and controls to ensure scalability and effectiveness. 4. Collaboration & Network Orchestration
• Act as the bridge between Finance and Procurement, and collaborate closely with the Supply Chain team to align procurement processes with operational needs.
• Work with the Roche network (other affiliates and global) to find better solutions and share best practices. 5. Compliance & Risk Management
• Perform risk management on supply contracts, proactively identifying and resolving supply or quality issues.
• Conduct all business activities in full compliance with Roche Secure, Roche Behavior in Business, Roche Competition Law Interactive Dialogues, and external regulations. Key Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or above, preferably in Business Administration, Finance, or related.
• Experience: 5+ years of experience in procurement, supply chain management, or financial planning in Multinational Companies (MNCs).
• Professional Skills: Strong negotiation, analytical, and financial acumen (understanding of budgeting and P&L). Expertise in vendor management, procurement governance, SOP creation, and E2E processes. Familiarity with financial systems (e.g., SAP) is required.
• Attributes & Languages: Proven ability to solve problems, influence cross-functional teams, and build stakeholder relationships. Fluent in both oral and written English and Mandarin. Good compliance track record. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate.
