descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position This posting is for Talent Pool purposes and may not correspond to a current vacancy with an active recruitment process. However, it reflects a role for which we regularly recruit or anticipate having openings in the near future for permanent or fixed term opportunities. The Record to Report (R2R) Department is a global organization of over 650 experienced finance professionals working together to deliver financial services and solutions for Roche across the EMEA region. Our services cover financial management, period-end closing, capital and lease accounting, credit and receivables, manufacturing finance, and divisional reporting, ensuring compliance for 263 reporting entities in 96 countries with accounting standards (IFRS, GAAP) and providing assurance of financial integrity. The Opportunity As a Senior Financial Accountant you will perform day-to-day and closing activities in cooperation with cross-functional departments, according to predefined deadlines with full ownership of their tasks and in compliance with the Process Documentations of the respective business sub-process. In this position in close collaboration with the Country Chief Accountant, you will focus on:
• Leased assets, fixed asset and CAPEX accounting activities
• Taxes, GL journals and accruals/ provisions, reconciling BS accounts
• Clearing customer accounts and bank suspense accounts, collecting direct debit, daily bank posting, posting and reconciling treasury transactions
• Calculating and issuing AR manual invoices
• Defining and calculating cost and revenue allocation in controlling
• Conducting product closing in the Material Management module of SAP
• Performing Month-end Closing and Reporting for Consolidation and for Divisions
• Preparing audit documentation and participating in internal and external audits Who you are We are looking for someone who is self motivated, really passionate about his or her job and understands that providing a high-quality service is crucial for the organization. As an ideal team member you are open-minded, dedicated to make a difference and open to constant development. Furthermore, you have: University degree, preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline
• 2-4 years of experience in a relevant position
• Excellent communication and analytical skills
• Outstanding customer orientation and service focus
• Strong interpersonal skills and team player attitude
• Proficiency in English In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & training, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits : Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance

• Documentation : Assist in keeping team knowledge up to date by contributing to and updating Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) and local Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Continuous Improvement : Actively participate in team meetings, workshops, and work-related events to help identify process improvements and support new ways of learning.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position On en Roche Looking to launch your career in healthcare and make a real impact from day one? Join a global leader in diagnostics and be part of shaping the future of healthcare operations, finance, and supply chain at scale. What is it?
• ON en Roche is a 2-year rotational graduate program within Finance & Operations designed for high-potential early-career professionals.
• From day one, you will take ownership of real business challenges that directly impact operations, customer experience, and Roche’s end-to-end value chain.
• You will rotate across different areas within Finance & Operations, gaining hands-on experience and a holistic understanding of how a global healthcare organization operates.
• The program is designed to accelerate your development through structured rotations, cross-functional exposure, and continuous learning. Why join?
• Real ownership from day one on business-critical challenges
• Exposure to an end-to-end healthcare value chain at global scale
• Rotations across Finance, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations
• High-impact projects with international and cross-functional teams
• Structured development, mentoring, and continuous feedback
• Clear fast-track career progression within Roche The Opportunity Optimize real-world operations by improving efficiency, scalability, and digital transformation in industrial environments. Rotations may include:
• Site Operations
• Warehouse operations & material flow
• Customer Fulfillment & Service Operations
• Direct Procurement The Position
• Support site capacity planning and growth readiness
• Improve warehouse layout, material flow, and productivity
• Analyze operational flows to identify improvement opportunities
• Contribute to automation, analytics, and process redesign projects
• Translate operational data into actionable insights Who you are We are looking for high-potential early-career professionals with a strong analytical mindset and motivation to build a career in healthcare and operations.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations - focused profiles , or related fields
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent Spanish and English (written and spoken)
• Interest in healthcare, operations, and data-driven environments
• Full availability for a 24-month program Timelines & further information
• Full-time 24-month graduate contract (not a university internship agreement)
• Based in Sant Cugat (Barcelona)
• Start date: September 2026
• Assessment Center: July 7th
• Applications reviewed on a rolling basis Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Digital Campaign Delivery Specialist in the Global Digital Hub, you will ensure the successful delivery of digital campaigns content creation projects within the Digital Campaigns Chapter. This role plays a crucial part in coordinating and completing timely, high-quality digital campaigns while maintaining our delivery standards. You'll collaborate closely with affiliate business teams, brand teams, third-party vendors, campaign coordinators, and global campaign coordinators to bring digital initiatives to life. The Opportunity In this pivotal role, you will:
• Manage Campaign Delivery : Oversee the end-to-end digital campaigns content creation and delivery process, from initiation through final implementation, ensuring all projects meet established quality and timeline standards.
• Coordinate Stakeholder Feedback : Incorporate insights and feedback from diverse stakeholders, revising digital campaign content requests to align with expectations and project objectives.
• Drive Process Improvement : Coach stakeholders on new processes and requirements that enhance efficiency and optimize our ways of working in digital campaign delivery.
• Support Campaign Leadership : Collaborate with Campaign Coordinators and Global Campaign Coordinators on client communications, change management initiatives, and service offering updates.
• Establish Best Practices : Adopt and maintain existing processes, establish governance principles, and ensure proper documentation and implementation across your area of responsibility—contributing to our Center of Excellence. Who You Are You are a detail-oriented professional with a strong passion for project coordination and a solid understanding of digital marketing principles and content creation processes. Your exceptional organizational and communication skills allow you to juggle multiple projects with ease, consistently delivering high-quality results on time. You thrive in collaborative environments, building strong relationships with diverse stakeholders and gracefully adapting to feedback to exceed expectations. Required Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
• Minimum 1+ years of proven project management experience, preferably in digital marketing or content creation
• Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and campaign management
• Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities with a demonstrated track record of managing multiple simultaneous projects
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills with proven ability to collaborate effectively across diverse stakeholder groups
• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including designers, copywriters, marketers, and clients/stakeholders
• Strong time management skills to prioritize competing priorities
• Openness to learning new project management tools and software
• Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments Ready to make an impact? If you're excited about driving digital campaign success and leading seamless project delivery, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to join Roche's Global Digital Hub and help shape the future of our digital campaigns. Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Senior Software Verification & Validation Engineer (Test Automation) Roche Sequencing is not only changing science, but we are changing lives. Our software teams are laying the groundwork for the future by developing powerful bioinformatics algorithms, data analysis tools, and software/systems infrastructures so researchers and clinicians can make better health decisions faster. As a Senior Verification & Validation Engineer, you will design/develop verification tests, develop test framework and infrastructure, plan test strategies and document design history for Roche Sequencing products. Your work will help us create cutting-edge laboratory workflow software for our non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) and Oncology test offerings. Do you want to develop software products that scientists and others in the life sciences will use to diagnose, find treatments, and eventually beat diseases like cancer or help with early prenatal diagnoses of genetic conditions? Our team builds highly scalable, reliable software and secure systems for better diagnostics. Y ou will have meaningful work developing an innovative technology that saves and improves lives around the world. This is an opportunity to work in a highly collaborative team, working with some of the best engineers in the industry. The Opportunity
• You will collaborate with a cross-functional team of lab personnel, assay developers, algorithm scientists, and technical leadership developing cutting edge clinical laboratory products.
• You will author and confirm correctness of requirements-driven tests, covering aspects including testing approaches (exploratory, white box, black box, etc.), testing level, (end-to-end, system, integration, unit, etc.), and testing types (functional, performance, scalability, etc.).
• You will automate and execute front-end and back-end tests, covering instrument software and web applications.
• You will participate in requirements, architecture, and design specification reviews
• You will collate and report quality metrics and enhancing quality dashboards.
• You will perform root cause analysis of defects for products under development and supporting on-market issue investigation.
• You will document design history as required by the standard operating procedures and ensuring regulatory compliance of verification and validation deliverables.
• You will partner with developers and other V&V personnel on engineering excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
• You will support audits by providing test evidence and documentation. This position is based in Santa Clara, CA. This is a hybrid role requiring 3 - 4 days on site. Relocation benefits are not being provided. Who You Are:
• You have a Bachelor's in Science in Computer Science (or equivalent field); or a Masters in Computer Science or equivalent field
• You have 5+ years of experience in software development or software verification or validation
• You have demonstrated experience using Agile SW development and accompanying tools
• You have demonstrated experience authoring design history and software release documentation
• You have demonstrated experience working with global teams.
• You demonstrate excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
• You are familiar with modern automated test technologies (Selenium, GitHub, etc.) across a variety of platforms.
• Familiarity with SQL and basic database operations is a desirable skill. Preferred:
• You have experience working in a reg

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Der Global Customer Support (GCS) ist die globale, für technische Serviceleistungen zuständige Organisation im Bereich Diagnostik . Der GCS unterstützt die Serviceorganisationen der verbundenen Unternehmen von Roche und die Lifecycle-Teams . Ungefähr 200 Mitarbeitende sind am Standort in Mannheim tätig, der für die Produkte aus der Reihe Serum Work Area & Workflow sowie das globale Ersatzteilmanagement verantwortlich ist . Dein neues Team Wir sind ein internationales Team mit Sitz in Mannheim . Unsere Kernkompetenz ist der technische Support sowie die Gestaltung und Durchführung von Service-Trainings für Serum Work Area und Preanalytische Systeme (z.B. cobas pro, i 601 und cobas 8100) . Wir vertreten die Service-Perspektive bei Produktentwicklungen, serviceorientierten Initiativen und pflegen Netzwerke zu verschiedenen Stakeholdern innerhalb von Roche, den lokalen Serviceorganisationen und unserem externen Gerätehersteller Hitachi . Verantwortlichkeiten | Das erwartet Dich Als GCS Specialist stellst Du den technischen Support und den Wissenstransfer für unsere Produkte sicher . Ein wesentlicher Schwerpunkt liegt dabei auf dem cobas 8100 .
• Technischer Support: Du leistest 2nd Level Support für unsere Systeme im Markt, insbesondere für unseren cobas 8100 und SWA-Systeme . Du analysierst Probleme im Bereich Hard- und Software und erarbeitest Lösungen zur Minimierung von Stillstandzeiten .
• Trainingsentwicklung: Du konzipierst und erstellst Trainingsmaterialien (virtuell und Präsenz) für das cobas 8100 preanalytical system und zukünftige Module in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Projektteam und der Master Trainer Community .
• Projektmitarbeit: Du wirkst bei der Entwicklung von Servicekonzepten mit, um die globale Markteinführung und operative Exzellenz zu unterstützen .
• Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit R&D, Operations, Business, Postmarket Quality und den Ländergesellschaften (Affiliates) zusammen und unterstützt bei Bedarf durch weltweite Service-Einsätze . Qualifikationen | Das bringst Du mit
• Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Technik mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Mechanik und Elektronik (bevorzugt: Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik, Automatisierungstechnik) .
• Du hast bereits erste Berufserfahrung im Support von Laborsystemen gesammelt, idealerweise mit direktem Bezug zu unserem cobas 8100 .
• Du besitzt Kenntnisse über den cobas 8100 und hast innerhalb dieses Bereichs idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Trainer:in oder Trainingsteilnehmer:in gesammelt .
• Erfahrung mit der Erstellung von Servicedokumentation in RDK ist für Dich zwingend erforderlich .
• Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse daran, technische Trainingsinhalte zu konzipieren, methodisch aufzubereiten und in der Praxis umzusetzen .
• Du arbeitest gerne in globalen Matrixstrukturen, sprichst und schreibst fließend Englisch und zählst Teamfähigkeit sowie interkulturelle Kompetenz zu Deinen Stärken .
• Du bist bereit zu häufigen und erweiterten Dienstreisen weltweit (ca. 30%) . Bewerbungsfrist : 29.05.2026 Deine Bewerbung Wir bitten Dich um folgende Dokumente:
• Aktueller Lebenslauf/Workday-Profil

Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'assistenza sanitaria si sta evolvendo e Global Procurement risponde continuando ad impegnarsi per le più alte prestazioni possibili, adottando approcci innovativi e strategici per le partnership tra imprese e fornitori. Global Procurement gestisce proattivamente l'intero ecosistema dei fornitori, fornendo un contributo vitale per migliorare i risultati della salute, riducendo i costi per i pazienti e i sistemi sanitari globali, e assicurando che Roche continui a fare ora ciò che i pazienti hanno bisogno dopo. Questa è l’occasione per dare un impatto misurabile durante la formazione di una cultura di squadra che riflette l’impegno di Roche verso persone e pazienti. Oltre alla consegna del progetto, sarai un costruttore di comunità, che promuove una cultura della curiosità, della sicurezza psicologica e della collaborazione radicale in cui le persone si sentono in grado di sperimentare e crescere. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Présentation de l’équipe: Au cœur de l’équipe Medical Evidence & Data science, tu auras pour missions de travailler
• sur la génération d'un protocole de recherche pour la constitution de la plus grande base de données onco-génomique en France (50% du temps),
• sur l’utilisation d’une IA agentic afin de générer/valider des tables statistiques (50% du temps). Quel sera ton impact ? Constitution de la plus grande base de données onco-génomique en France : ● Prendre en charge les réunions et les aspects contractuels entre les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes. ● Évaluer le niveau d'interopérabilité des différentes sources de données ● Programmer sous R les alignements syntaxiques et sémantiques des données permettant de mettre en œuvre cette interopérabilité. ● Générer et soumettre un protocole de recherche, à partir d’un synopsis déjà rédigé ● Étudier la faisabilité de certains objectifs exploratoire, tels que: ● Participer au projet FALCON (réseau mondial de bases onco-génomiques utilisant une approche fédérée) ● link avec la base de données nationale du SNDS ● collecter des données supplémentaires en cas de besoin (imagerie, données non structurées) pour répondre à d'autres objectifs de recherche ultérieurs. ● Pour répondre à ces objectifs, la première étape sera de se former à la pathologie et aux outils/templates déjà disponibles en interne pour la génération d’un protocole et d’effectuer une revue de littérature ciblée. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Diagnostics Operation Penzberg ist das Herzstück der weltweiten Produktion diagnostischer Einsatzstoffe innerhalb des Roche-Konzerns. Als Weltmarktführer im Bereich der In-Vitro-Diagnostik verbinden wir höchste GMP-Qualitätsstandards mit technologischem Fortschritt. Hier arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer Qualitätskontrolle und der digitalen Transformation der Gesundheitsbranche. Als Praktikant:in (m/w/d) geben wir dir nicht nur Einblick in das „Daily Business“ der Qualitätskontrolle, sondern lassen dich aktiv an der Schnittstelle zwischen klassischer Laborarbeit und moderner IT-Infrastruktur mitwirken. Du lernst hautnah, was es bedeutet, in einem hochregulierten GMP-Umfeld beim weltweit größten Hersteller von In-Vitro-Diagnostik-Produkten zu arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben In diesem Praktikum bist du der Treiber unserer nächsten digitalen Evolutionsstufe. Wir arbeiten bereits digital – mit der Implementierung und Optimierung eines Labor-Informations-Management-Systems (LIMS) heben wir unsere Prozesse nun auf das nächste Level an Vernetzung und Effizienz. Als Content Creator überarbeitest du die bisherigen Dokumente und hilfst uns beim Erstellen neuer Stammdaten.
• Methoden-Check & Optimierung: Du hinterfragst Methodentexte kritisch, prüfst sie auf Aktualität und Logik und hilfst dabei, diese für die digitale Nutzung aufzubereiten
• Recherche & Dokumentation: Du führst eigenständige Recherchearbeiten durch und unterstützt bei der Erstellung technischer Dokumente
• Projektarbeit: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für kleinere, eigenständige Projekte im Bereich der QC Dein Profil
• Hintergrund: Du studierst Naturwissenschaften (Chemie, Biologie, Pharmazie), Bioinformatik, Medizintechnik oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang
• Mindset: Du bist motiviert, neugierig und hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Du liebst es, Dingen auf den Grund zu gehen und Texte kritisch zu hinterfragen
• IT-Affinität: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office und hast ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an digitalen Systemen (LIMS)
• Sprache: Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache fließend in Wort und Schrift
• Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest gewissenhaft, strukturiert und hast Freude an der Dokumentation Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung für eine gute Work-Life-Balance
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine
• Fitnessstudio auf dem Roche Campus
• Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und spannende Gastvorträge
• Möglichkeit der Unterbringung im Roche Boardinghaus
• Gut organisierte Verkehrsanbindung nach München mit unserem Roche-Shuttle
• Standort-Power: Lerne Diagnostics Operation Penzberg als weltweit größten Roche-internen Hersteller von diagnostischen Einsatzstoffen kennen
• Networking: Erhalte spannende Einblicke in globale Prozesse und knüpfe Kontakte in einem führenden Healthcare-Unternehmen Deine Bewerbung Wir machen es dir einfach: Bitte lade nur deinen Lebenslauf online hoch. Ein Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich. Denke daran, dass sich dieses Praktikum an Studierende (m/w/d) bei laufender Immatrikulation während des gesamten Zeitraums des Praktikums richtet oder alternativ an Personen in einem maximal einjährigen Gap-Year (zwischen Bachelor- und Masterstudium), bei dem schriftlich nachgewiesen werden kann, auf welcher Universität/Hochschule und genau wann (Monat/Jahr) innerhalb eines Jahres die Studien fortgesetzt werden. Roche Pharmaceuticals

• Guiding the business squads/teams as a strategic partner to drive patient and customer centric ambitions, driving outcome-based planning with end-to-end perspective , including fit-for-purpose planning, next level of business analytics and insightful decision-making with focus on short, mid and long-term.

• Drive P&L management to ensure rigorous execution and fast responses to the business needs and adjusted priorities.

• Effective resource allocation on sustainable investment , facilitating constructive discussions about difficult trade-off decisions with business partners within and across business areas and recognizing potential for new growth opportunities.

• Performing core financial management tasks , including Event Driven Planning and financial modeling seeking for continuous learning and improvement.

• Continuously examining and interpreting data , such as financial statements, price developments, market dynamics, productivity measures, investment opportunities to inform decision making.

• To strive for consistency and efficiency across business areas, by continuously finding opportunities to harmonize, pool and simplify finance processes while sustaining or improving the stakeholder experience .

• Seeking and building opportunities to partner and collaborate with local and global networks of experts .

• Squad/Team squad members peer coaching on financial and specific expertise , fostering collaboration and a constructive environment.

• Ability to articulate themes related to Procurement, Supply Chain, Accounting as well as RSS (Shared Service Center) , connecting the dots and harmonizing processes.

• Serving as guardians to enable new business opportunities, to safeguard our assets , and to provide transparency and uphold compliance.

• Owning their development to ensure they are continually growing skills , capabilities, mindset and behaviors in line with their passion and the needs of the ecosystem to perform at their best and deliver state of the art finance services.

• Collaborating with other key players in Roche, including Roche Global RSS (Shared Services) , ERP Analytics and Centers of Expertise (e.g., eCoE, and Global Networks), to ensure requirements for new solutions and enhancements are managed and delivered effectively.

Expected Skills and Capabilities

• Successful candidate must be CA/CPA qualified and CFA qualified is a plus.

• Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in Finance roles (e.g., FP&A, Planning & Controlling, etc)

• Business Acumen & Entrepreneurial Spirit in challenging the status quo and suggesting new solutions to complex issues.

• Strong Business Partner Skills, ‘seating at the table’ with the internal and external customers.

• Capacity to swarm strategically and operationally across the business.

• Leadership experience in working with self-aligned teams seeking for fast implementation of solutions in uncertain environments.

• Negotiation skills and ability to build strong partnerships, internally and externally.

• Enterprise mindset, connecting the dots and seeking for synergies that can concrete a bigger impact.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Project Manager – Deliver Impact, Drive Innovation

At Roche, we’re not just delivering solutions—we’re transforming lives. We’re seeking a Project Manager with the drive and vision to lead medium to high-complexity projects across Roche solutions and third-party collaborations. From pre-sales to full implementation, you’ll be at the heart of delivering meaningful innovation to our customers.

Location: UK (Field-based)

The Mission: To orchestrate the delivery of world-class diagnostic solutions that empower laboratories and improve patient lives across the UK.

Are you a strategic leader with a background in structured project delivery? Do you thrive on transforming complex technical requirements into seamless, operational healthcare solutions?

The Opportunity

As a Project Manager for Roche Solutions, you will be the bridge between commercial strategy and technical reality. You will drive medium to high-complexity projects, ensuring an enhanced customer experience from initial discovery through to the final transition to "live" status.

Key Responsibilities:

• Project Governance: Deliver projects in full alignment with the Roche Design and Implementation Framework (RDIF). You will utilize PRINCE2 principles to manage costs, aggressive timelines, and multidisciplinary resources.

• Commercial Strategy & Partnering: Collaborate with Commercial Teams and Consultants during the "Discover & Develop" phase. You ensure that proposed solutions are not only innovative but technically viable and accurately costed.

• Technical Implementation: Lead the coordination of technical milestones. From overseeing floor plan sign-offs to producing detailed Gantt charts and managing project phasing, you ensure precision at every step.

• Site Leadership: Act as the face of Roche on-site. You will lead customer meetings across UK to mobilize resources for our most complex system tracks, such as the CCM (cobas Connection Modules) and cobas 8100.

• Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary escalation point for implementations. You will maintain robust communication plans to keep both internal leadership and external customers informed and aligned.

• Risk & Quality Assurance: Proactively identify risks and dependencies. You will lead "lessons learned" reviews to ensure that every project at Roche is better than the last.

Who You Are

You are a disciplined professional who understands that in the world of diagnostics, precision in planning is as important as precision in testing.

Your Experience & Qualifications:

• Education: Educated to degree standard (or equivalent experience) with PRINCE2 Practitioner status strongly preferred.

• Methodology: A proven expert in Waterfall project management, capable of managing the rigid dependencies of laboratory installations.

• Industry Background: A track record of managing medium to high-complexity projects, ideally within a laboratory, clinical, or diagnostic environment.

• Technical Savvy: Comfortable leading spatial planning workshops, interpreting floor plans, and contributing to technical tender responses.

• Must have proven project management experience with a focus on product delivery.

• Regional Expertise: Ability to navigate the specific multi-stakeholder landscape of the English healthcare system.

• Mobility: As this is a field-based role, you must have the ability to travel across UK for site visits and customer engagement as required.

The successful candidate must possess a valid UK driving

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Location: Kentucky, Ohio, Indiana and West Virginia (Ideal candidate to live in Lexington, KY) Travel: 100% in assigned territory. This is an exciting time to join the Roche Support Network. If you are passionate about problem solving then this is the position for you! As a research-focused healthcare company, Roche discovers, develops and provides innovative diagnostics and therapeutic products and services that deliver significant benefits to patients and healthcare professionals - from early detection and prevention of diseases to diagnostics, treatment and treatment monitoring. Roche is a successful company that can offer exciting career opportunities. We encourage and support your development in areas of your interest which will prepare you for the next level in your career path. We know that people are responsible for our success, and we value our employees. Our commitment is to create a work environment where feeling valued, respected, and empowered is a daily experience. The Opportunity The Roche Support Network group is committed to providing industry-defining support to its customers. As a Field Engineering Specialist, you will have the opportunity to travel and demonstrate your expertise as a technical repair and/or installation specialist for Roche assigned product lines and provide valued service to your laboratory customers in an assigned territory. This position serves as a technical repair or installation specialist for Roche products for assigned product lines and geographies. Product Responsibility: Clinical chemistry, Immunoassay and lab automation.
• Provides routine technical support to customers on operational and maintenance aspects of system equipment.
• Performs on-site service, repair and/or installation of company product(s). This may include any aspect of field support and is not limited to mechanical/system hardware and software, networking/wireless networking.
• Serves as customer contact on routine technical and service-related problems. Receives training and delivers service within the normal scope of the position. Follows documented practices, policies and procedures in providing repair and installation support.
• Diagnoses mechanical, hardware, software and system failure, using established procedures. Determines the most cost-effective repair/resolution to minimize customer downtime.

titleByLocale.it: Digital Solutions Analytics Lead - Libero professionista

descriptionByLocale.it:
Let’s build a healthier future, together! By combining our unique strengths, we are redefining healthcare through sustainable action and innovation. For a behind-the-scenes look, check out this video to see how we at Roche are making personalized health care a reality. The mySugr GmbH was acquired by Roche in 2017 and our Vienna office is one of Roche's global sites. You will be located here, in the heart of Vienna, no matter if you work on a mySugr®, Accu-Chek®, navify® or any other Roche product or solution. You can read more about the history of mySugr & Roche here . Here's what we're looking for: As a Digital Solutions Analytics Lead , you will act as a data analytics leader for product uptake and product usage, driving insights generation that fundamentally shape the development, product improvement and market adoption of our digital health, IVD, and medical device products. This is a high-impact, independent role requiring deep expertise and the ability to influence critical product and business decisions. Your work will involve strategically shaping analyses involving diverse data types (including usage data, market uptake data, app store data, and digital health data) in close alignment with product and business teams . Your upcoming mission:
• Managing the Analytics around user engagement and product uptake
• Analytics for step-by-step in app customer journeys
• Support of communication and reporting: Reporting Template, Presentations, Data Automation, Dashboard generation
• Ad-hoc analytics for app features improvement
• Documentation and tools management
• Regular report updates and business review support
• Consulting the product teams on analytics and insights generation Essential skills:
• 2-3 years of experience in business analytics
• Familiar with SQL and reporting tools Tableau or PowerBI, SQL.
• English fluent in reading, speaking and writing
• Education: Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering or Business Administration (BS, preferentially an advanced degree) Bonus skills:
• Experience with product usage analytics (e.g., Countly, Amplitude, OpenTelemetry). What to expect:
• Ambitious and passionate people building meaningful products for a global audience
• An innovative agile working environment allowing for collaboration with really smart people and knowledge sharing in cross-functional teams
• Loads of benefits (brand new Apple hardware, fitness, public transport, lunch benefit, language classes, professional training budget, chance to join global conferences...)
• Flexible working hours and home office policy, 5 weeks vacation
• An amazing office with a rooftop terrace, fully stocked kitchen and amazing barista coffee machines in the middle of Vienna… oh, and did we mention the best team in the world! Who we are and what we care about? We are committed to providing a healthy, equal and inclusive working environment for our employees to bring true relief to the patient! We care about family friendly career paths, sustainability, a healthy lifestyle and the flexibility of a modern workplace. We maintain a culture of learning and sharing, as well as open and candid feedback. At every level, there are many opportunities to develop and grow - both professionally and personally. As a healthcare pioneer committed to transforming the lives of billions of people around the globe, we push boundaries to redefine what is possible. We know that early, accurate diagnosis is essential to maintain health, prevent disease and help advance new, targeted treatments and potential cures for the world’s most serious health problems. We have a passion for innovation and a profound commitment to make a lasting impact on society by continuing to improve the standard of care for humankind. Our culture inspires us to create healthcare that is sustainable, efficient and financially viable. Healthcare that is built on people’s needs, strong data and clinical insights. Healthcare that save

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione L'Ingegnere di Piombo Senior porterà il ciclo di vita dell'algoritmo end-to-end - dallo sviluppo attraverso la validazione e l'implementazione di norma-ready - garantendo l'allineamento con GxP, SaMD e Imaging Governance framework. Essendo l'unico punto di responsabilità tra gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS, il ruolo fornirà funzionalità scalabili di piattaforma analitica, promuovere l'automazione e garantire la qualità, la documentazione e gli standard di conformità sono costantemente applicati. Questa posizione guida la visione, la strategia e l'esecuzione dell'ecosistema dell'algoritmo di imaging, consentendo uno sviluppo e una distribuzione più rapidi, riproducibili e conformi tra ricerca e ambiti clinici. Sarete responsabili della definizione dei compiti per gli altri e della guida di iniziative su larga scala su un prodotto. In questo ruolo strategico, istruirai e guiderai altri ingegneri, eccellerai nei negoziati con le parti interessate, e fornirai una direzione per obiettivi a medio e lungo termine. Contribuirai attivamente alla conoscenza tecnica, ispirerai l'innovazione e guiderai la progettazione di soluzioni multi-servizio e multi-modali complesse. Grazie all'esperienza nell'architettura e nell'interoperabilità dei modelli AI/ML, ai framework applicativi avanzati di analisi e alle caratteristiche cloud, promuoverai la consistenza architettonica, guiderai la strategia tecnica per i principali componenti e gli ingegneri senior del mentore per garantire i più elevati standard di qualità ingegneristica in tutta l'organizzazione. Questo ruolo di Senior Lead Engineer richiede l'impegno quotidiano con partner scientifici, normativi, clinici e informatici per allineare la strategia, la priorità e l'esecuzione per rafforzare la collaborazione e la visibilità tra i team globali, fornendo un ponte diretto tra Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development e Platform Operations. L'opportunità:
• Definire ed eseguire la strategia del prodotto e la roadmap per multi-modali (tra cui Radiologia e Patologia Digitale) Imaging Data & Insights all'interno della piattaforma di imaging globale (GIP).
• Priorizzare e fornire iniziative che migliorano la qualità dei dati, l'accessibilità e la riutilizzabilità per R&D, la ricerca traduttiva e lo sviluppo clinico.
• Agire come proprietario principale del prodotto per le applicazioni di analisi delle modalità di imaging, coordinando attraverso gRED, pRED, PD, RDT e RIS.
• Il partner scientifico, clinico e tecnico porta a tradurre i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni tecniche scalabili e conformi.
• Gestire le relazioni degli stakeholder e le collaborazioni esterne per garantire l'interoperabilità, la conformità e l'allineamento strategico.
• supervisionare il ciclo di vita end-to-end di applicazioni di analisi dei dati di imaging multi-modale, visualizzazione e analisi.
• Assicurare la consegna tempestiva dei miglioramenti del prodotto, flussi di lavoro standardizzati e l'integrazione di strumenti abilitati AI/ML.
• Collabora con team di ingegneria, qualità e regolamentazione per garantire l'adesione a standard GxP, FAIR e data-governance.
• Allineamento dell'unità attraverso le funzioni R&D, Diagnostics e Data Science per abilitare i dati condivisi e le pipeline di analisi e processi unificati.
• Gestire dipendenze, rischi e pietre miliari per tutti i materiali di patologia digitale e comunicare i progressi attraverso KPI e report sulle prestazioni.
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per aumentare la scalabilità, l'automazione e l'efficienza attraverso i flussi di lavoro di analisi.
• Monitorare l'industria e le tendenze tecnologiche nella patologia digitale, AI/ML e la salute digitale per guidare l'innovazione dei prodotti in corso.
• Identificare e introdurre il formato comune per la distribuzione, ridurre i costi di conversione e migliorare la velocità di inferenza attraverso l'arros

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position The Senior Lead Engineer will lead the end-to-end algorithm lifecycle—from development through validation and regulatory-ready deployment—ensuring alignment with GxP, SaMD, and Imaging Governance frameworks. Acting as the single point of accountability across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS, the role will deliver scalable analytical platform capabilities, promote automation, and ensure quality, documentation, and compliance standards are consistently applied. This position drives the vision, strategy, and execution of the imaging algorithm ecosystem, enabling faster, reproducible, and compliant development and deployment across research and clinical domains. You will be responsible for defining tasks for others and driving medium to large-scale initiatives across a product. In this strategic role, you will coach and lead other engineers, excel in stakeholder negotiations, and provide direction for mid to long-term goals. You will actively contribute to technical knowledge, inspire innovation, and lead the design of complex multi-service and multi-modal solutions. With expertise in AI/ML models architecture and interoperability, advanced analysis application frameworks and cloud features, you will promote architectural consistency, drive technical strategy for major components, and mentor senior engineers to ensure the highest standards of engineering quality across the organization. This Senior Lead Engineer role requires daily engagement with scientific, regulatory, clinical, and informatics partners to align on strategy, prioritization, and execution to strengthen collaboration and visibility across global teams, providing a direct bridge between Imaging Governance, Algorithm Development, and Platform Operations. The Opportunity:
• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for multi-modal (including Radiology and Digital Pathology) Imaging Data & Insights within the Global Imaging Platform (GIP).
• Prioritize and deliver initiatives that enhance data quality, accessibility, and reusability for R&D, translational research, and clinical development.
• Act as the primary product owner for the imaging modalities analysis applications, coordinating across gRED, pRED, PD, RDT, and RIS.
• Partner with scientific, clinical, and technical leads to translate business requirements into scalable and compliant technical solutions.
• Manage stakeholder relationships and external collaborations to ensure interoperability, compliance, and strategic alignment.
• Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of multi-modal imaging data analysis applications, visualization, and analytics.
• Ensure timely delivery of product enhancements, standardized workflows, and integration of AI/ML-enabled tools.
• Collaborate with engineering, quality, and regulatory teams to ensure adherence to GxP, FAIR, and data-governance standards.
• Drive alignment across R&D, Diagnostics, and Data Science functions to enable shared data and analysis pipelines and unified processes.
• Manage dependencies, risks, and milestones for all digital pathology deliverables and communicate progress through KPIs and performance reports.
• Identify and implement opportunities to increase scalability, automation, and efficiency across analysis workflows.
• Monitor industry and technology trends in digital pathology, AI/ML, and digital health to guide ongoing product innovation .

Als einziger Punkt der Rechenschaftspflicht über gRED, pRED, PD, RDT und RIS wird die Rolle skalierbare analytische Plattform-Fähigkeiten liefern, Automatisierung fördern und Qualität, Dokumentation und Compliance-Standards konsequent anwenden. • Definition und Durchführung der Produktstrategie und Roadmap für multimodale (einschließlich Radiologie und digitale Pathologie) Imaging Data & Insights innerhalb der Global Imaging Platform (GIP).

• Verwalten von Stakeholder-Beziehungen und externen Kooperationen, um Interoperabilität, Compliance und strategische Ausrichtung zu gewährleisten.
• Übersehen Sie den End-to-End-Lebenszyklus von multimodalen bildgebenden Datenanalyseanwendungen, Visualisierung und Analytik.

• Führen Sie die Ausrichtung auf FuE-, Diagnose- und Data Science-Funktionen aus, um gemeinsame Daten- und Analysepipeline und einheitliche Prozesse zu ermöglichen.
• Verwalten von Abhängigkeiten, Risiken und Meilensteinen für alle digitalen Pathologien und kommunizieren Fortschritte durch Kennzahlen und Leistungsberichte.
• Möglichkeiten zur Erhöhung der Skalierbarkeit, Automatisierung und Effizienz in den Analyse-Workflows identifizieren und implementieren.

Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position L'ingénieur principal dirigera le cycle de vie de bout en bout de l'algorithme, depuis le développement jusqu'à la validation jusqu'au déploiement réglementaire, pour assurer l'alignement avec les cadres de gouvernance GxP, SaMD et Imaging. Agissant en tant que point unique de responsabilisation pour gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS, le rôle fournira des capacités de plate-forme analytique évolutives, favorisera l'automatisation et assurera l'application uniforme des normes de qualité, de documentation et de conformité. Cette position stimule la vision, la stratégie et l'exécution de l'écosystème de l'algorithme d'imagerie, permettant un développement et un déploiement plus rapides, reproductibles et conformes dans les domaines de la recherche et de la clinique. Vous serez responsable de la définition des tâches pour les autres et de la conduite d'initiatives de moyenne à grande échelle à travers un produit. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous entraînerez et dirigerez d'autres ingénieurs, excellerez dans les négociations avec les intervenants et fournirez une orientation pour les objectifs à moyen et à long terme. Vous contribuerez activement aux connaissances techniques, inspirerez l'innovation et dirigerez la conception de solutions multiservices et multimodales complexes. Avec une expertise en architecture et en interopérabilité des modèles AI/ML, des cadres d'applications d'analyse avancés et des fonctionnalités cloud, vous favoriserez la cohérence architecturale, piloterez la stratégie technique pour les principaux composants, et mentorez les ingénieurs seniors pour assurer les plus hautes normes de qualité d'ingénierie dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce rôle d'ingénieur principal exige un engagement quotidien avec les partenaires scientifiques, réglementaires, cliniques et informatiques afin de s'aligner sur la stratégie, l'établissement des priorités et l'exécution afin de renforcer la collaboration et la visibilité entre les équipes mondiales, fournissant un pont direct entre la gouvernance de l'imagerie, le développement de l'algorithme et les opérations de la plateforme. La possibilité :
• Définir et exécuter la stratégie et la feuille de route des produits multimodaux (y compris la radiologie et la pathologie numérique) Imager des données et des informations au sein de la plateforme mondiale d'imagerie (GIP).
• Privilégier et mettre en oeuvre des initiatives qui améliorent la qualité des données, leur accessibilité et leur réutilisabilité pour la R-D, la recherche translationnelle et le développement clinique.
• Agir en tant que principal propriétaire du produit pour les applications d'analyse des modalités d'imagerie, en coordonnant entre gRED, pRED, PD, RDT et RIS.
• Partenaire avec des pistes scientifiques, cliniques et techniques pour traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques évolutives et conformes.
• Gérer les relations avec les parties prenantes et les collaborations externes pour assurer l'interopérabilité, la conformité et l'alignement stratégique.
• Surveiller le cycle de vie de bout en bout des applications d'analyse de données d'imagerie multimodale, de visualisation et d'analyse.
• Veiller à ce que les améliorations apportées aux produits, les flux de travail normalisés et l'intégration des outils compatibles avec l'IA et le LM soient fournis en temps voulu.
• Collaborer avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de qualité et de réglementation pour assurer le respect des normes GxP, FAIR et de gouvernance des données.
• Conduire l'alignement entre les fonctions R-D, Diagnostics et Data Science pour permettre le partage de données et d'analyses et des processus unifiés.
• Gérer les dépendances, les risques et les jalons pour tous les produits de pathologie numérique et communiquer les progrès au moyen des ICR et des rapports de performance.
• Identifier et mettre en œuvre des possibilités d'évolutivité, d'automatisation et d'efficacité dans tous les flux de travail d'analyse.
• Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et de la technologie en matière de pathologie numérique, d'IA/ML et de santé numérique pour guider l'innovation de produits en cours.
• Identifier et introduire le format commun pour le déploiement, réduire les coûts de conversion et améliorer la vitesse d'inférence dans tous les secteurs

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Developing enzymes for Roche internally as well as externally means for us the development of tailor-made biocatalysts and biological targets for creating the best-in-class molecules for Roche and our clients. Combining several biotechnological methods such as expression profiling, cell cultivation, enzyme purification portfolio, enzyme engineering and biochemical investigations, we always try to improve, to maintain or to design new enzymes. Mandatory, the complete value chain as a platform thought of Roche is given. We are working cross-functional for both the diagnostic and pharma division of Roche worldwide. Being an R&D function we always try to keep close contacts with our clients as with our production for ensuring a fast, but qualitatively high development which should result in functional Roche products finally. As a Post-Doc Position in Novel Enzymes (m/f/d) , you actively shape the development of new enzymes using biotechnological and bioinformatic methods. Become part of an innovative research team that consolidates a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab to develop customized enzymes for our diagnostics. We offer you a unique opportunity to translate your scientific ideas into practice and thus contribute to the improvement of patient health. The opportunity
• You ensure the development of new enzymes using a combination of biotechnological and bioinformatic methods
• You are responsible for the independent production of tailored proteins/enzymes using molecular biological methods or the establishment of new production and screening methods for protein variants
• You support the consolidation of a platform from dry-lab to wet-lab, suitable for the protein engineering of novel enzymes
• You implement new biochemical and biophysical readouts suitable for the screening and development of tailored enzymes
• You pursue scientific and technical education by continuously following and reading the relevant scientific literature Who you are
• You possess a university degree (Dr. / Ph.D.) in a relevant field
• You have specialized knowledge in the areas of protein engineering, bioinformatics, and molecular biology
• Experience in microbiology, downstream and upstream processing, as well as chemistry, is an advantage
• You demonstrate knowledge and expertise in recombinant protein expression, protein purification, and the development of protein analytical methods for protein characterization
• You are willing to provide consultation and troubleshooting regarding enzyme challenges in Research & Development and Production This position is limited to 2 years. Application documents To make the application process as convenient as possible for you please add only a motivation letter and your updated CV . References and certificates are not required at this stage. We look forward to receiving your application! Your contact to us! With people. For people. Do you need further support? Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability In this pivotal leadership role as the Team Lead Associate Group Director, you will bridge the gap between complex scientific safety activities and strategic business delivery. You will be responsible for fostering a high-performance culture, driving innovation in safety science, and ensuring that our clinical trials and products meet the highest global regulatory standards. The Opportunity:
• Provide line leadership for a diverse team of scientists, physicians, and other HCPs, fostering a culture of growth, agility, and continuous improvement.
• Oversee the delivery of critical pharmacovigilance (PV) and risk management deliverables, including clinical trial safety support, periodic safety reports, and signal management activities.
• Build strong partnerships across global functions to ensure seamless scientific and PV outputs.
• Take accountability for resource planning, recruitment, and the professional development of your team through proactive coaching and mentoring.
• Maintain oversight of team performance and compliance with GxP, ICH, and global Health Authority requirements.
• Role model the mindsets and behaviors necessary to thrive in our evolving global operating model.
• Contribute to the broader Clinical Safety vision and priorities by leading and engaging with strategic Safety projects. Who You Are You are a visionary leader who balances scientific expertise with a passion for people development. You thrive in a global matrix environment and are motivated by the challenge of transforming complex safety data into meaningful actions that protect patients. You will also have:
• Healthcare Professional or Life Sciences graduate (MD, PhD, PharmD, or MSc preferred).
• Extensive experience of at least 10+ years in biopharmaceuticals or clinical research, with a deep understanding of the drug development lifecycle and likely to have direct experience in delivering safety-related activities in support of clinical drug development and/or pharmacovigilance..
• Possess a strong command of PV and clinical risk management, including GVP, GCP, and CTR requirements.
• Track record of leading both people and projects, with the ability to coach diverse teams to reach their full potential.
• Exceptional communicator, able to build relationships and negotiate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• Demonstrate strong critical thinking and the ability to anticipate risks and opportunities in a fast-changing environment. Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting. #MQRS The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 148,568.00 and 194,995.50 of hiring range. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors as determined by the company. We use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants for this role. This posting is for an existing vacancy at Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability. As a Portfolio Clinical Safety Scientist (Associate Medical Director), you will be a key member of the safety team, providing medical expertise and safety oversight across the development and marketed portfolio. You will apply your clinical medical knowledge to deliver safety science and pharmacovigilance support, from early and late phase development through post-marketed signal and risk management. Working under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL), you will ensure our medicines reach patients safely and efficiently. The Opportunity:
• Develop and maintain an understanding of the safety profile for assigned products, providing clinical input into the interpretation of emerging safety data in the context of experience gained whilst practising in relevant areas of clinical medicine/healthcare..
• Contribute to aggregate case analysis and reporting activities including preparation of periodic safety reports (ie. DSUR, PBRER)
• Drive signal management activities, including signal detection and assessment, and contribute to risk management activities (e.g.RMPs/REM) and provide advice and interpretation of whether/how risks may impact the overall clinical risk-benefit balance of an asset, in the context of typical clinical medical practice in the territories/countries where the product/asset will be used.
• Support the preparation and review of safety sections for regulatory filings (IND, NDA, MAA) and labeling documents like the Company Core Data Sheet, or Investigator’s Brochure
• Represent Clinical Safety on development study teams and prepare and/or review safety sections of study documents (e.g. protocol, Informed consent, etc)
• Contribute to and/or and provide input into internal or external Drug Monitoring Committees.
• In partnership with the SSL, support presentation of safety issues to the internal Safety governance committee.
• Coordinate with vendors and may act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.
• Partner with functions including Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Science and Clinical Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives.
• Mentor & Lead: Act as a subject matter expert within the function, coaching junior scientists. Who You Are: You are a proactive medical professional with a passion for drug safety and a desire to shape the future of medicine. You thrive in global, matrix environments and bring a collaborative mindset to complex problem-solving. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of safety science, benefiting from a culture of continuous learning and the chance to make a measurable impact on patient lives worldwide. You will also have:
• A formal medical degree (MD, MB BS, MB ChB) with post-graduate clinical experience in relevant medical specialties.
• 5+ years of clinical drug development experience in pharma or biotech, including at least 2 years specifically in clinical drug safety.
• A solid understanding of GxP, regulated processes, and the en

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As an Intern – Accounts Payable supporting the China region , you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of our financial operations. You will ensure our accounting processes deliver exceptional impact through meticulous document handling, timely invoice processing, and effective communication in Mandarin — helping our global business units maintain the financial health required to deliver care to patients. The Opportunity
• You manage the full cycle of AP documentation , from receiving and sorting to barcoding and pre-archiving, ensuring all records are ready for further processing.
• You validate and process PO and contract-based invoices, Non-PO invoices, and prepayments with high attention to detail.
• You support financial accuracy by reviewing supplier open items, investigating non-successful payments, and performing balance sheet account reconciliations.
• You contribute to month-end excellence by participating in closing activities and preparing operational KPI reports based on affiliate requirements.
• You act as a bridge for our China stakeholders , handling internal and external queries in Mandarin and building effective partnerships with vendors.
• You engage in continuous improvement by supporting system integration testing, participating in team projects, and initiating process enhancements. Who You Are
• You are currently pursuing or hold a Degree or Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Banking, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
• You are fluent in Mandarin (Mandatory) , as this role specifically supports our affiliates and vendors in China ; you are also proficient in English.
• You have a strong interest in corporate finance and accounting , with a desire to learn best practices in a global shared services environment.
• You have a working knowledge of MS Office tools ; familiarity with SAP or other ERP systems is a significant advantage.
• You are a proactive communicator who enjoys resolving queries and working collaboratively within a "Buddy System" framework.
• You are available for a minimum internship duration of six (6) months . Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das ist es, was uns bewegt, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft ständig voran und sorgen dafür, dass alle Menschen heute und in Zukunft Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung haben, die sie brauchen. Eine Welt zu schaffen, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen haben, die wir lieben – das ist es, was uns zu Roche macht. Im Bereich R&D an unserem Standort Mannheim bist Du Teil eines hochinnovativen, interdisziplinären Teams. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir an der Entwicklung zukunftsweisender Sensoren für das kontinuierliche Glukosemonitoring (CGM). In dieser Schlüsselposition bringst Du Deine Expertise in der Chemie und Biophysik ein, um das Leben von Millionen Menschen mit Diabetes nachhaltig zu verbessern. Die Möglichkeiten
• Entwicklung & Design: Du verantwortest eigenverantwortlich die Planung und chemische Formulierung sowie das Design von elektrochemischen Sensoren zur Messung diabetesrelevanter Parameter im Rahmen globaler Entwicklungsprojekte.
• Qualitäts- & Schnittstellenmanagement: Du erstellst Material-, Prozess- und Prüfspezifikationen für chemische Einsatzstoffe im regulierten Umfeld und stimmst Dich eng mit Schnittstellen wie der Produktion und der Messtechnik ab.
• Lieferantenbetreuung: Du identifizierst strategische Lieferanten für Roh- und Einsatzstoffe und betreust diese kompetent bei komplexen technischen sowie physikochemischen Fragestellungen.
• Zukunftsorientierung: Du hast aktuelle wissenschaftliche und technische Entwicklungen stets im Blick und prüfst diese kontinuierlich auf ihre Anwendbarkeit in zukünftigen Produkt-Lifecycles im Sinne eines integrierten, personalisierten Diabetes Managements. Wer bist Du
• Ausbildung: Du bringst ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes, promoviertes naturwissenschaftliches Hochschul- oder Universitätsstudium (Promotion / PhD) der Chemie oder Biophysik mit.
• Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Medizinprodukten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Formulierung von elektrochemischen Sensoren.
• Spezialwissen: Idealerweise besitzt Du vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Polymerchemie, der Elektrochemie sowie im Bereich der Anforderungen von in-vivo -Systemen.
• Systeme & Regularien: Ein sicherer Umgang mit Dokumentenmanagementsystemen im regulierten Umfeld (z. B. ISO 13485 / GMP) ist für Dich selbstverständlich.
• Kompetenzen: Du zeichnest Dich durch hohe soziale Kompetenz, Kommunikationsstärke in internationalen, fachübergreifenden Teams sowie durch Leidenschaft und Motivationsfähigkeit aus.
• Sprachen: Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab. Die Bewerbung: Wir machen es Dir leichter: Bitte lade online nur Deinen aktuellen und aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf sowie das Zeugnis Deines höchsten Studienabschlusses hoch. descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Roche in 50 Worten Eine gesündere Zukunft. Das treibt uns an, innovativ zu sein. Wir bringen die Wissenschaft voran, damit alle die Gesundheitsversorgung erhalten, die benötigt wird. Wir schaffen eine Welt, in der wir alle mehr Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen können, die wir lieben. Das macht uns zu Roche. Beschreibung Abteilung/Team Unser Subchapter „Einsatzstoffentwicklung Proteinchemie“, das zum Bereich Antibody and Protein Technologies innerhalb der Abteilung Reagent Research and Design gehört, entwickelt proteinchemische Einsatzstoffe für diagnostische Tests. Hierbei liegt unser Fokus insbesondere auf Anwendungen für die Elecsys-Plattform. Wir arbeiten an einer spannenden Schnittstelle von Chemie und Biochemie. Wir analysieren, reinigen und modifizieren wir Proteine – sowohl chemisch als auch enzymatisch – um sie funktional zu optimieren. Unser besonderer Schwerpunkt liegt in der Erforschung und Entwicklung von spezialisierten Antikörper- und Antigen-Konjugaten, Entstörproteinen sowie deren Vorstufen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir zukunftsweisende Lösungen für diagnostische Herausforderungen und tragen zur Weiterentwicklung innovativer Gesundheitstechnologien bei. Unser Team ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil des interdisziplinären Bereichs Proteinchemie und fungiert als entscheidende Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Produktion. Im engen Austausch mit Partner:innen aus der Assay-Entwicklung und Produktion arbeiten wir an der Entwicklung von Antikörpern, Antigenen und virusähnlichen Partikeln (VLPs) für unsere innovativen CobasMS- und Elecsys -Plattformen, und die Pharmaforschung. Unser Aufgabenfeld umfasst die Optimierung und den Transfer von Herstellverfahren sowie die Entwicklung analytischer Methoden, um so den Übergang in die Produktion effizient zu gestalten und qualitativ erstklassige Lösungen bereitzustellen. Du wirst Teil eines hochmotivierten und vielseitigen Teams, das sich durch Engagement und eine offene Zusammenarbeit auszeichnet. Mit Leidenschaft und Expertise tragen wir gemeinsam dazu bei, Innovationen in der diagnostischen Entwicklung voranzutreiben und nachhaltige Lösungen für anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen zu schaffen. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten/Position
• Du nutzt modernste biochemische und chromatographische Verfahren, um Antikörper, Antigene oder virusähnliche Partikel (VLPs) aus eukaryotischen oder bakteriellen Biomassen zu isolieren und aufzureinigen.
• Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung produktionsgerechter und reproduzierbarer Verfahren sowie der dazu notwendigen analytischen Methoden für immunologische Reagenzien, einschließlich chemisch und ortsgerichtet derivatisierter Antikörper und Antigene.
• Ein Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit ist die umfassende Charakterisierung und Qualitätsprüfung der produzierten biologischen Einsatzstoffe mit etablierten biochemischen, physikochemischen und immunologischen Methoden.
• Du führst Laborarbeiten durch, wertest Ergebnisse aus und bringst dich aktiv in die Interpretation der Analyseergebnisse ein.
• Neben projektbezogenen Arbeiten unterstützt du im Laborbetrieb, z. B. durch die Betreuung und Pflege von Laborinstrumenten und durch die Übernahme allgemeiner organisatorische Aufgaben.
• Die sorgfältige Protokollführung und Dokumentation nach QM-Vorgaben, sowie die Aufbereitung der Daten für Berichte gehören ebenfalls zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich.
• Du nutzt deine Erfahrung in proteinchemischen Arbeiten, um das Team fachlich zu unterstützen und gemeinsam Fortschritte zu erzielen. ​ Wer bis

Este rol es una pieza clave en la coordinación transfuncional para el diseño, ejecución y éxito de las estrategias de mercadotecnia en todo el ciclo de vida del producto. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:

• Business Intelligence & Forecasting: Desarrollo de pronósticos mensuales de ventas y pacientes por canal, realizando un seguimiento riguroso de indicadores clave (KPIs) frente a los objetivos establecidos.
• Product Launch & Pipeline: Asegurar la ejecución impecable de lanzamientos y extensiones de línea, gestionando la logística y la administración presupuestaria (P&L).

• Operational Excellence: Liderar la planificación y ejecución logística de eventos de educación médica continua y programas de pacientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de tiempos y presupuestos.

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (capacidad de interactuar en entornos globales).
