Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position En Roche , estamos comprometidos con la excelencia en el área de Neurociencias. Buscamos un profesional con visión estratégica y capacidad analítica para integrarse como Marketing Specialists para el portafolio de Neurociencias. Este rol es una pieza clave en la coordinación transfuncional para el diseño, ejecución y éxito de las estrategias de mercadotecnia en todo el ciclo de vida del producto. Sobre Nuestra Oportunidad: Las principales responsabilidades del role incluyen:
• Strategic Execution: Brindar soporte en la implementación de estrategias de portafolio, segmentación y targeting, colaborando estrechamente con Patient Journey Partners (PJP) para asegurar el posicionamiento de marca.
• Business Intelligence & Forecasting: Desarrollo de pronósticos mensuales de ventas y pacientes por canal, realizando un seguimiento riguroso de indicadores clave (KPIs) frente a los objetivos establecidos.
• Product Launch & Pipeline: Asegurar la ejecución impecable de lanzamientos y extensiones de línea, gestionando la logística y la administración presupuestaria (P&L).
• Compliance & Content Creation: Desarrollar materiales promocionales y de entrenamiento bajo estrictos estándares de Compliance , gestionando el proceso de aprobación e implementación en sistemas como Veeva .
• Stakeholder Management: Coordinar esfuerzos con áreas cross-funcionales (Médico, Comercial, Legal y Finanzas) y gestionar relaciones con proveedores estratégicos para Market Research.
• Operational Excellence: Liderar la planificación y ejecución logística de eventos de educación médica continua y programas de pacientes, asegurando el cumplimiento de tiempos y presupuestos.
• Digital Marketing: Generar materiales y colaborar en la estrategia omnichannel en conjunto con el Marketing Manager, para lograr el mejor impacto de la estrategia. Tu perfil: Buscamos candidatos con un alto sentido de responsabilidad, atención al detalle y mentalidad de crecimiento:
• Licenciaturas económicas administrativas, ingenieras industriales o afines
• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (capacidad de interactuar en entornos globales).
• Experiencia previa en la industria farmacéutica. Dominio de google environment, paqueteria microsoft, capacidad de análisis de datos y comprensión de auditorías de mercado.
• Manejo de Veeva, SAP, Simple buy es un diferencial
• Comunicación asertiva e influencia. Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resultados. Resiliencia y gestión del cambio.
• Capacidad de colaboración en equipos multidisciplinarios. Beneficios de relocalización no están disponibles para esta posición Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Driving sustainable impact
Our responsibility extends beyond innovation. You'll contribute to solutions that improve healthcare by addressing the most pressing health challenges and diseases with the highest social burden, while reducing our impact on the planet. Together, we create a healthier workplace, society, and future for generations to come.

The Opportunity
This role leads the regional PV (Pharmacovigilance) and Device Vigilance center , ensuring high-quality operations and regulatory compliance. In partnership with regional Patient Safety teams, you'll manage safety performance, optimize cost and quality, oversee regional Clinical Safety integration, and support the global Patient Safety Operations strategy.

Responsibilities

• Lead and manage the Regional Center team to deliver regulatory commitments and high-quality outcomes; ensure inspection/audit readiness and maintain QMS oversight.

• Operationalize safety processes in compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations; escalate compliance issues and risks appropriately.

• Drive continuous improvement across quality, compliance, and cost optimization; promote innovation through new methodologies and technologies (AI, digital analytics).

• Engage and influence stakeholders through effective collaboration, negotiation, and cross-cultural leadership; represent the Regional Center internally and externally, including with regulators.

• Build and lead a high-performing team with a quality- and customer-centric mindset; role model Roche values and adopt VACC leadership style (visionary, architect, catalyst, coach).

• Foster a culture of empowerment, growth, and learning that enables innovation, experimentation, and succession readiness; manage recruitment, performance, and talent development.

• Serve as an active PSO Leadership Team member, ensuring cross-functional alignment and contributing to departmental strategy; maintain business continuity planning and deputize for the Global Head as needed.

Who you are

• Healthcare professional degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent) with 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience and at least 5 years in PV leadership roles.

• Proven track record managing multi-country or regional operations within large, complex organizations.

• Deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).

• Exceptional communicator: able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English and Spanish.

• VACC leader with a growth mindset committed to inclusive behaviors, developing high-performing diverse teams, and adopting new technologies to improve operational efficiency.
Able and willing to undertake frequent travel (5-10%)

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

Who we are
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

titleByLocale.en: Head of Compliance and Quality Governance

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Operating within an innovation-driven biotech environment, our Technology department (RDT) sits at the intersection of regulatory compliance, quality systems, risk management, and digital transformation. We focus on defining and managing governance frameworks, policies, and processes that ensure our technology platforms—supporting both GxP and non-GxP critical business processes—operate in full compliance with internal standards and external regulations. Our mission is to embed compliance by design, strengthening the quality and risk posture of our systems while simultaneously enabling speed, scalability, and technological innovation. In this collaborative environment, we partner closely with Business Quality, Regulatory, Security, Legal, and Audit functions to advise executives and drive enterprise-wide strategy. As the Head of Compliance and Quality Governance (Practice Leader), you will be accountable for the entire lifecycle of this critical function, from strategic planning and service design to operational execution and continuous improvement. Operating as a senior escalation and decision authority, you will define the functional vision, strategy, and roadmap, transforming business needs into tangible, high-value capabilities. Leveraging a distinctive combination of deep domain expertise, technical proficiency, and business insight, you will lead multidisciplinary teams to build and deliver desirable, viable, and sustainable functional services that meet the evolving needs of our users while maintaining strict regulatory compliance. The Opportunity
• Strategy & Vision: Define and own the Technology Compliance & Quality Governance strategy, establishing clear governance frameworks, decision models, and accountabilities while translating global biotech regulations and corporate policies into clear technology outcomes.
• Stakeholder & Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted partner and senior escalation authority for executives, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Security leadership, representing Technology in executive forums, audits, inspections, and regulatory interactions.
• Functional Management & Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery and lifecycle of defined functions (e.g., QMS), ensuring Technology adherence to GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, and global regulations (FDA, EMA, ICH, ISO) through pragmatic, risk-based interpretations.
• Risk Management & Assurance: Lead enterprise-wide technology risk assessments and compliance maturity evaluations, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings, deviations, and CAPAs.
• Team Leadership & Development: Build, coach, and develop a high-performing global team of professionals, fostering a culture of accountability and transparency while guiding senior leaders on risk-based decision-making.
• Operational Excellence & Improvement: Define success metrics (KPIs/OKRs) and leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions, immediate operational improvements, and strategic optimizations to achieve business goals.
• Financial & Resource Management: Manage the immediate team's budget and resources, developing detailed business cases—including cost-benefit analyses and resource estimates—for new functional initiatives and significant process changes. Who You Are
• Experienced Global Leader: You bring 15+ years of IT domain experience, including 10+ years managing global multidisciplinary teams and 10+ years in Technology, Compliance, Quality, or Risk within highly regulated ind

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Roche puoi apparire come te stesso, abbracciato per le qualità uniche che porti. La nostra cultura incoraggia l'espressione personale, il dialogo aperto e i legami genuini, dove siete valorizzati, accettati e rispettati per chi siete, permettendovi di prosperare sia personalmente che professionalmente. Questo è il modo in cui vogliamo prevenire, fermare e curare le malattie e garantire che tutti abbiano accesso alla salute oggi e per le generazioni a venire. Unisciti a Roche, dove ogni voce conta. La posizione Come parte integrante di Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) svolge un ruolo chiave nei progetti di Capex globali senza soluzione di continuità dalla pianificazione attraverso l'esecuzione, fornendo una forte gestione del progetto, competenze tecniche e prestazioni del progetto sul tempo e sul budget. Manutenzione attiva, idoneità impiantistica e supporto attrezzature per la rete di produzione stanno aggiungendo al mandato di PTT essendo la centrale elettrica PT per la salute dei prodotti tecnici. The Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead è un ruolo di leadership fondamentale responsabile per lo sviluppo, l'implementazione e la gestione operativa dei sistemi di produzione standardizzati nella rete Drug Product. Segnalando al Global Fleet Program Owner, questo ruolo possiede lo sviluppo del concetto di Drug Product Fleet Fleet, assicurando che la filosofia "design one, costruire molti" sia eseguita per guidare l'equivalenza del sito e le efficienze senza precedenti. L'opportunità Lei funge da unico punto di proprietà aziendale per l'aspetto del prodotto Droga della strategia di standardizzazione globale di fabbricazione, responsabile per il suo successo in tutta la rete, e possiede e guida lo sviluppo del concetto di Drug Product Fleet, stabilendo gli standard specifici per i sistemi di produzione DP da implementare in tutta la rete globale. Le tue responsabilità principali sono
• Definire, possedere e guidare la strategia globale pluriennale e la roadmap per il concetto e i sistemi di Drug Product Fleet insieme a gMSAT Drug Product e ai siti di produzione DP e servire come punto primario di responsabilitÃ per tutti i sistemi di flotta specifici DP, garantendo di soddisfare gli standard globali definiti per la rete di produzione. Tenere la massima responsabilità per garantire e mantenere l'equivalenza delle attrezzature e dei sistemi della flotta DP durante tutto il loro ciclo di vita.
• Presentare il bilancio operativo globale (CAPEX e OPEX) e l'allocazione delle risorse per l'implementazione e la manutenzione del sistema DP in tutta la rete.
• Guidare e agire come punto primario di contatto (POC) per tutte le interazioni e le indagini dell'autorità sanitaria all'esterno (comprese le principali ispezioni pre-approvali (PAIs) e i principali dispositivi normativi) che riguardano specificamente i sistemi della flotta di prodotti farmaceutici.
• Assicurare che le attrezzature della flotta DP aderiscano strettamente ai documenti globali, comprese le specifiche dei requisiti degli utenti (URS) e le specifiche funzionali. Proprie e mantengono il ciclo di vita specifico DP, tra cui il Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs e URS e condurre l'analisi delle modifiche proposte sull'equivalenza della flotta DP, garantendo una coerente implementazione in tutti i siti DP interessati.
• Condurre e supervisionare analisi comparative a lato degli aspetti critici e critici del processo GMP per le apparecchiature DP. Superare il monitoraggio continuo delle prestazioni della flotta DP, tracciare parametri critici di processo (CPP) e attributi di qualità critici (CQAs).
• Assicurarsi che gli eventi non pianificati o le discrepanze che influenzano le apparecchiature DP siano valutati per l'impatto su tutta la rete in collaborazione con i principali stakeholder. Chi sei Hai un forte track record dei principali processi di gestione dei cambiamenti in un ambiente altamente regolamentato con un focus sull'impatto cross-site e porti le seguenti qualifiche:
• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria (Chemical, Meccanica, Bioingegneria), Scienze della Vita, o un campo tecnico correlato; PhD è fortemente preferito.
• Un minimo di 15 anni di esperienza nell'industria farmaceutica/biotecnica, con una forte enfasi sulla D

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As an integral part of Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) plays a key role in seamlessly leading global Capex projects from planning through execution by providing strong project management, technical expertise and project performance on time and on budget. Proactive maintenance, facility fitness and equipment support for the manufacturing network are adding to the mandate of PTT being PT`s powerhouse for technical product health. The Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead is a critical leadership role responsible for the end-to-end development, implementation, and operational management of standardized manufacturing systems across the Drug Product network. Reporting to the Global Fleet Program Owner, this role owns the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, ensuring the "design one, build many" philosophy is executed to drive cross-site equivalency and unparalleled efficiencies. The Opportunity You serve as the enterprise-wide single point of ownership for the Drug Product aspect of the Global Manufacturing Standardization Strategy, accountable for its success across the network, and you own and drive the development of the Drug Product Fleet concept, establishing the specific standards for DP manufacturing systems to be deployed across the global network. Your main responsibilities are
• Define, own, and drive the multi-year global strategy and roadmap for the Drug Product Fleet concept and systems together with gMSAT Drug Product and the DP manufacturing sites and serve as the primary point of accountability for all DP-specific fleet systems, ensuring they meet the defined global standards for the production network. Hold ultimate accountability for ensuring and maintaining the equivalency of DP fleet equipment & systems throughout their entire lifecycle.
• Present the global operating budget (CAPEX and OPEX) and resource allocation for DP fleet system deployment and maintenance across the network.
• Lead and act as the primary point of contact (POC) for all outward-facing health authority interactions and inquiries (including leading Pre-Approval Inspections (PAIs) and major regulatory filings) that specifically concern Drug Product fleet systems.
• Ensure DP fleet equipment adheres strictly to global documents, including User Requirements Specifications (URS) and functional specifications. Own and maintain DP-specific lifecycle deliverables, including the Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs, and URS and lead the analysis of proposed changes on DP fleet equivalency, ensuring consistent implementation across all affected DP sites.
• Conduct and oversee side-by-side comparative analyses of GMP-critical and process-critical aspects for DP equipment. Oversee the continuous monitoring of DP fleet performance, tracking critical process parameters (CPPs) and critical quality attributes (CQAs).
• Ensure that unplanned events or discrepancies impacting DP equipment are assessed for network-wide impact in collaboration with key stakeholders. Who you are You have a strong track record of leading change management processes in a highly regulated environment with a focus on cross-site impact and you bring the following qualifications:
• Master’s degree in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Bioengineering), Life Sciences, or a related technical field; PhD is strongly preferred.
• A minimum of 15 years of experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, with a strong emphasis on D

Bei Roche können Sie sich als sich selbst zeigen, umarmt für die einzigartigen Qualitäten, die Sie bringen. Unsere Kultur fördert den persönlichen Ausdruck, den offenen Dialog und die echten Verbindungen, wo Sie geschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert werden, wer Sie sind, so dass Sie sowohl persönlich als auch professionell verehren können. So wollen wir Krankheiten verhindern, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung heute und für die kommenden Generationen hat. Begleiten Sie Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt. Die Position Als integraler Bestandteil von Pharma Technical Operations (PT) spielt die PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) eine Schlüsselrolle bei nahtlos führenden globalen Capex-Projekten von der Planung bis zur Ausführung, indem sie ein starkes Projektmanagement, technisches Know-how und Projektleistung im Zeit- und Budgetbereich bietet. Die Unterstützung der proaktiven Wartung, der Fitness und der Ausrüstung für das Herstellungsnetzwerk ergänzt das Mandat von PTT als PT-Powerhouse für die technische Produktgesundheit. Das Drug Product (DP) Fleet Lead ist eine wichtige Führungsrolle für die End-to-End-Entwicklung, Umsetzung und operative Verwaltung von standardisierten Fertigungssystemen im gesamten Drug Product-Netzwerk. Diese Rolle gehört der Entwicklung des Drug Product Fleet-Konzepts und stellt sicher, dass die "design one, build many"-Philosophie zum Antrieb von Cross-Site-Äquivalenz und unvergleichlichen Effizienzen ausgeführt wird. Die Chance Sie dienen als unternehmensweit einheitlicher Bezugspunkt für den Drug Product Aspekt der Global Manufacturing Standardization Strategy, der für seinen Erfolg im gesamten Netzwerk verantwortlich ist und Sie besitzen und die Entwicklung des Drug Product Fleet Konzepts vorantreiben, indem Sie die spezifischen Standards für DP-Produktionssysteme festlegen, die über das globale Netzwerk eingesetzt werden sollen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben sind
• Definieren, besitzen und fahren Sie die mehrjährige globale Strategie und Roadmap für das Drug Product Fleet-Konzept und -Systeme zusammen mit gMSAT Drug Product und den DP-Produktionsstandorten und dienen als primärer Bezugspunkt für alle DP-spezifischen Flottensysteme, um sicherzustellen, dass sie den definierten globalen Standards für das Produktionsnetzwerk gerecht werden. Halten Sie ultimative Rechenschaftspflicht für die Sicherstellung und Aufrechterhaltung der Gleichwertigkeit von DP-Flottenanlagen und -Systemen während ihres gesamten Lebenszyklus.
• Bereitstellung des globalen Betriebsbudgets (CAPEX und OPEX) und Ressourcenzuweisung für die Bereitstellung und Wartung von DP-Flotten im gesamten Netz.
• Führen und fungieren als primärer Ansprechpartner (POC) für alle nach außen gerichteten Interaktionen und Anfragen der Gesundheitsbehörden (einschließlich führender Vorgenehmigungsinspektionen (PAIs) und großer Regulierungsinstanzen), die sich speziell auf die Systeme der Drug Product Flotte beziehen.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass DP-Flottenausrüstung streng auf globale Dokumente, einschließlich Benutzeranforderungen Spezifikationen (URS) und funktionale Spezifikationen haftet. Eigene und pflegende DP-spezifische Lebenszyklus-Lieferungen, einschließlich des Master Fleet Validation Master Plan (FVMP), Fleet SOPs und URS und führen die Analyse der vorgeschlagenen Änderungen an DP-Flottenäquivalenz und gewährleisten eine konsequente Umsetzung in allen betroffenen DP-Standorten.
• Nebenbei vergleichende Analysen von GMP-kritischen und prozesskritischen Aspekten für DP-Geräte durchführen und überwachen. Überwachen Sie die kontinuierliche Überwachung der DP-Flottenleistung, Verfolgung kritischer Prozessparameter (CPPs) und kritischer Qualitätsattribute (CQAs).
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass unplanmäßige Ereignisse oder Diskrepanzen, die die DP-Ausrüstung beeinflussen, in Zusammenarbeit mit wichtigen Akteuren netzweit bewertet werden. Wer bist du? Sie haben einen starken Überblick über führende Change-Management-Prozesse in einem hochregulierten Umfeld mit Schwerpunkt auf Cross-Site-Wirkung und bringen folgende Qualifikationen:
• Master-Abschluss in Engineering (Chemical, Mechanical, Bioengineering), Life Sciences oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich; PhD ist stark bevorzugt.
• Mindestens 15 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen/biotechnologischen Industrie, mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf D
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position En tant que partie intégrante de Pharma Technical Operations (PT), PT Global MSAT, Engineering and Sustainability (PTT) joue un rôle clé dans la direction transparente des projets globaux Capex, de la planification à l'exécution en fournissant une solide gestion de projet, une expertise technique et une performance de projet à temps et sur le budget. L'entretien proactif, la condition physique des installations et le soutien de l'équipement pour le réseau de fabrication ajoutent au mandat de PTT étant la centrale de PT pour la santé technique des produits. Le chef de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques (PD) est un chef de file essentiel responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en oeuvre et de la gestion opérationnelle des systèmes de fabrication normalisés dans l'ensemble du réseau de produits pharmaceutiques. Sous l'autorité du propriétaire du programme Global Fleet, ce rôle est responsable de l'élaboration du concept de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, en veillant à ce que la philosophie de la « conception, de construire beaucoup » soit mise en oeuvre pour favoriser l'équivalence entre les sites et l'efficacité inégalée. L'opportunité Vous servez de point de propriété unique à l'échelle de l'entreprise pour l'aspect Produit pharmaceutique de la Stratégie mondiale de normalisation de la fabrication, responsable de son succès dans l'ensemble du réseau, et vous possédez et dirigez le développement du concept de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, établissant les normes spécifiques pour les systèmes de fabrication PDD à déployer dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial. Vos principales responsabilités sont :
• Définir, posséder et piloter la stratégie et la feuille de route mondiales pluriannuelles pour le concept et les systèmes de la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, en collaboration avec le produit pharmaceutique gMSAT et les sites de fabrication DP, et servir de point de responsabilisation principal pour tous les systèmes de flotte spécifiques à la flotte de produits pharmaceutiques, en veillant à ce qu'ils répondent aux normes mondiales définies pour le réseau de production. Tenir la responsabilité ultime d'assurer et de maintenir l'équivalence des équipements et systèmes de la flotte de PDD tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
• Présenter le budget global d'exploitation (CAPEX et OPEX) et l'allocation des ressources pour le déploiement et la maintenance du système PDD dans l'ensemble du réseau.
• Diriger et agir en tant que point de contact principal (POC) pour toutes les interactions et les demandes de renseignements des autorités sanitaires externes (y compris les inspections préalables à l'approbation (IPA) et les principaux dossiers réglementaires) qui concernent spécifiquement les systèmes de flotte de produits pharmaceutiques.
• Veiller à ce que les équipements de la flotte PDD respectent strictement les documents mondiaux, y compris les spécifications relatives aux exigences de l'utilisateur (URS) et les spécifications fonctionnelles. Posséder et maintenir des produits livrables propres au cycle de vie du PDD, y compris le plan directeur de validation de la flotte principale, les SOP de la flotte et l'URS, et diriger l'analyse des changements proposés sur l'équivalence du PDD, en assurant une mise en oeuvre uniforme dans tous les sites du PDD touchés.
• Mener et superviser des analyses comparatives côte à côte des aspects critiques des BPF et des processus pour les équipements PDD. Surveiller la surveillance continue du rendement du parc de PDD, le suivi des paramètres critiques du processus (PPC) et des attributs critiques de qualité (AQC).
• Veiller à ce que les événements imprévus ou les écarts ayant une incidence sur l'équipement du PDD soient évalués en fonction de l'impact à l'échelle du réseau, en collaboration avec les principales parties prenantes. Qui vous êtes Vous avez une solide expérience des processus de gestion du changement dans un environnement hautement réglementé, en mettant l'accent sur l'impact intersite et vous apportez les qualifications suivantes:
• Maîtrise en ingénierie (chimie, mécanique, bioingénierie), sciences de la vie, ou un domaine technique connexe; doctorat est fortement préféré.
• Un minimum de 15 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique et biotechnologique, l'accent étant mis sur D

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position About the Role: The Security Affiliate Manager EMEA-LATAM will support affiliates with their product security needs by designing, coordinating, and governing a security network across our affiliates. We are looking for someone with expertise in product security and direct experience working with customers in that field. Your Responsibilities:
• Be an ambassador and evangelist for Roche Diagnostics product security to affiliates.
• Develop strong working relationships with key stakeholders within the regions and around the global organization.
• Design, coordinate, and govern a product security network across our affiliates consisting of colleagues who interface with customers on product security topics.
• Gather intake from affiliates on customer needs and expectations (e.g. data localization, support topics, etc.) to drive global product security & privacy strategy improvements.
• Support affiliates with their product security needs, e.g. hosting training sessions, Q&A’s and other materials to meet customer needs, join affiliates for customer meetings, etc.
• Make relevant product security information on products, services and ecosystem accessible to affiliates.
• Build the bridge between affiliate and global teams, e.g. by facilitating knowledge sharing between those (within PSPO, product teams, etc.), leading cross-functional projects to establish processes, drive implementation of product security changes, etc.
• Create and maintain a knowledge base of the most common product security questions to allow affiliates to respond faster to tenders/questionnaires.
• Gather product security-related metrics and provide report-outs to affiliates and management.
• Strong collaboration within the chapter and other PSPO chapters to ensure affiliate needs are tracked and served. Is considered as a reference for stakeholders and actively shares ideas and expertise and leads/moderates discussions.
• Enable affiliate leaders and customer-facing roles including commercial and service to achieve greater promotion on topics of security with customers. Your Experience & Skills:
• BA/BS in Information Systems, Computer Science, or relevant area of study, required.
• Expertise in working directly with customers in the product security field is required.
• Commercial mindset.
• Fluent in English on a business level with excellent verbal and written skills; other languages welcome, but not required.
• Demonstrated proficiency in communicating security and privacy strategy, products, and ecosystems.
• Exceptional demonstration, presentation, and interpersonal communication (written and verbal) skills are essential.
• Highly influential relationship builder.
• Experience with compliance standards and regulatory mandates, security and privacy laws, regulations and standards.
• Goal-oriented individual, with proven positive leading in the matrix ability, strong business acumen, strong focus motivating and developing teams.
• EU residence/citizenship preferred. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Required:
• Lead multidisciplinary drug discovery project teams from target identification through preclinical candidate selection. Proactively 'invent' future medicines by identifying high-value targets in the obesity and cardiometabolic diseases space.
• Proven expertise in building disease-relevant cellular assays for metabolic disorders using immortalized and/or primary human and animal cells, including co-cultures and/or organoid culture systems
• Capable in design and execution of in vivo studies to characterize the pharmacology of novel targets. Extensive familiarity with in vivo workflows, including experimental design, surgical/dosing techniques, and interpretation of metabolic phenotypic data. This includes evaluating regulation of body weight/composition, glucose and lipid utilization and total energy balance.
• Partner with colleagues in molecular pharmacology, chemistry, and in vivo biology to perform biochemical and molecular assessments on ex vivo samples, ensuring an integral understanding of drug action.
• Requirement for accurate record keeping, independent data analysis, and reporting of data in written and oral formats. Exceptional attention to details with excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly articulate complex concepts at all levels of the organization. Desired:
• Deep expertise in the biology of energy balance regulation and the pathophysiology of adipose tissue (white, brown, and beige fat).
• Hands-on experience with functional metabolic assays, including insulin sensitivity and glucose/lipid metabolism, mitochondrial function and cellular respiration (e.g., Seahorse assays), assessment of body composition (e.g., EchoMRI or DEXA).
• Specific experience studying the interplay between adipose tissue and neural biology (e.g., sympathetic innervation of fat or central control of metabolism) is a plus. Qualifications
• PhD and/or postdoctoral training with a focus on metabolism, physiology, biology or related field with well recognized peer-reviewed publications in metabolic research.
• Proven experience leading drug discovery projects in metabolism discovery within a pharmaceutical or biotechnology setting is highly desired. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Szukamy zorganizowanej i skrupulatnej osoby, która wesprze nasz zespół w zarządzaniu obiegiem używanego sprzętu medycznego. Będziesz kluczowym ogniwem w procesie procesowania zwrotów – od momentu odebrania paczki, przez jej cyfrową ewidencję, aż po koordynację wysyłki do naszej centrali w Niemczech. Twoja Rola:
• Obsługa przesyłek przychodzących: Odbieranie oraz fizyczne segregowanie paczek reklamacyjnych trafiających do magazynu.
• Ewidencja cyfrowa: Wprowadzanie danych o przesyłkach do systemów operacyjnych ( SAP / Rexis ).
• Wstępna diagnostyka: Klasyfikacja urządzeń pod kątem zgłoszonych usterek i uszkodzeń aparatury medycznej.
• Logistyka międzynarodowa: Identyfikacja i przygotowanie wysyłki paczek o statusie „krytycznym” do centrali w Mannheim w celu dalszej ewidencji.
• Współpraca z zespołem: Bieżąca komunikacja z działem serwisu i logistyki. O Tobie:
• Wykształcenie: Minimum średnie (zapraszamy również studentów w trakcie nauki).
• Dyspozycyjność: Możliwość pracy 2 dni w tygodniu (grafik do ustalenia).
• Zdolności analityczne: Umiejętność trafnej klasyfikacji usterki na podstawie dokumentacji i stanu faktycznego.
• Komunikatywność: Jasne przekazywanie informacji i umiejętność pracy w zespole.
• Doskonała organizacja: Umiejętność priorytetyzacji zadań i dbałość o porządek w dokumentacji systemowej.​ Oferujemy:
• Elastyczność: Idealna praca dla osób łączących naukę z życiem zawodowym.
• Cenne doświadczenie: Możliwość pracy w profesjonalnym środowisku opartym na systemie SAP .
• Wpływ na jakość: Realny udział w procesie zapewniania bezpieczeństwa aparatury medycznej.
• Międzynarodowe standardy: Współpraca z centralą w Niemczech i kontakt z nowoczesnymi technologiami medycznymi. Dodatkowe informacje:
• Miejsce pracy: Magazyn Sprzętu Medycznego (Teresin)
• Typ umowy: Umowa zlecenie (16 godzin tygodniowo) Administratorem danych osobowych jest spółka Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie przy ul. Domaniewskiej 28 (02-672). Dane przetwarzane są w celu prowadzenia rekrutacji. Osobom, które zaaplikują przysługuje prawo dostępu do danych, ich sprostowania, usunięcia, ograniczenia przetwarzania, przenoszenia oraz – w sytuacji, gdy są one przetwarzane na podstawie udzielonej zgody – cofnięcia tejże zgody w dowolnym momencie. Kontakt do Inspektora Ochrony Danych: dia.daneosobowe@roche.com. Więcej informacji o zasadach przetwarzania przez Roche danych osobowych pod linkiem: https://www.roche.pl/klauzula-informacyjna-rekrutacja-dia-pl . Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. działa w pełnej zgodności z przepisami prawa i nie toleruje żadnych naruszeń. W Roche Diagnostics Polska sp. z o.o. obowiązuje Procedura zgłaszania naruszeń prawa. W przypadku chęci zgłoszenia nieprawidłowości związanych z naszą działalnością, wszelkie niezbędne informacje dotyczące zgłaszania naruszeń znajdują się na naszej stronie internetowej: https://www.roche.pl/kontakt/ochrona-sygnalistow-zglaszanie-naruszen . ​ Compensation & Benefits Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Warsaw. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process. Information about the compensation package for this position will be provided ahead of any interview Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity: As an Accounts Payable Accountant you are responsible for high quality services to Roche suppliers and internal partners. You will be responsible for booking complex invoices in accordance with Roche and local standards so that the supplier receives the funds in time for the goods supplied and the services rendered. You will have the possibility to have full responsibility for the end-to-end AP process and handling both internal and supplier queries received by phone or mail in local language.
• Process and validate PO based and direct invoices and payment requests, manage and run payments
• Manage vendor accounts
• Audit, report and support AP invoice resolution
• Handle affiliate’s internal invoice queries
• Act as a point of contact, promoting strong collaborative relationships between the affiliate’s finance teams and all other internal SSC teams
• Participate in process improvement and ongoing projects, opportunity to take part in knowledge transfer Who you are:
• University degree in Finance or relevant professional experience
• General understanding of finance processes and standards. Broad experience in accounts payable processes (or related field) and using SAP is an advantage
• Strong communication and advisory skills and you are able to deal with complex issues
• Customer centricity through your day-to-day interactions
• End-to-end accountability, problem-solving skills, growth & agile mindset in ambiguous situations
• Multi-cultural acceptance, ability to work in a fast-paced and changing environment
• Proficiency in English and Arabic In exchange we provide you with:
• Development opportunities: Roche is rich in learning resources. We provide constant development opportunities, free language courses & trainings, the possibility of international assignments, internal position changes and the chance to shape your own career.
• Excellent benefits: Competitive salary and cafeteria package, annual bonus, Private Medical Services, Employee Assistance Program, All You Can Move Sportpass, coaching / mentoring opportunity, buddy program, team buildings, holiday party.
• Flexibility: We also support flexibility to help you find your balance. Home office is commonly available (typically 2 office days/week on average). We create the opportunity for freedom in working, where your corporate and private life coexist in harmony.
• A global inclusive community, where we learn from each other. At Roche, we cooperate, debate, make decisions, celebrate successes and have fun as a team. Our leadership is very focused on people, creating a strong, inclusive culture, so you always have the chance to share your opinion. Please read the Data Privacy Notice for further information about how we handle your personal data related to the recruitment process. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position La atención sanitaria está evolucionando y Roche Diagnostics responde esforzándose continuamente por alcanzar el mayor rendimiento posible, adoptando enfoques innovadores y estratégicos para las asociaciones comerciales y clínicas. Nuestros equipos de ventas gestionan proactivamente el ecosistema sanitario, contribuyendo de forma vital a mejorar los resultados de salud y garantizando que Roche siga haciendo ahora lo que los pacientes necesitarán después. The Responsabilities: Este puesto se integra dentro de la organización Comercial, centrándose en áreas de alta complejidad que están transformando la medicina moderna. Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , serás un motor clave para el desarrollo de negocio en áreas críticas como Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética y Secuenciación. Trabajando en el área de Madrid, aportarás una visión de 360° para gestionar relaciones estratégicas en los centros sanitarios. Serás responsable de identificar oportunidades de alto valor y asegurar la rentabilidad y el crecimiento de tu zona asignada. Actuarás como un socio estratégico, utilizando un enfoque de venta consultiva para acortar la distancia entre las necesidades diagnósticas complejas y nuestras soluciones innovadoras. Como Sales Specialist - Specialty , desempeñarás diversas funciones según tu experiencia, conocimientos y requisitos generales del negocio, incluyendo pero no limitado a:
• Actuarás como experto en tu territorio, identificando y desarrollando nuevas oportunidades de mercado en los segmentos de especialidad (Microbiología, Patología, Genética) en alineación con la estrategia comercial de Roche Diagnostics.
• Serás el responsable de la relación con el cliente, fortaleciendo vínculos con los diferentes interlocutores estratégicos para comprender sus desafíos y transmitir propuestas de valor estructuradas que respondan a sus necesidades específicas.
• Liderarás la ejecución de los planes de acción locales, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de Marketing y Servicio para garantizar la satisfacción del cliente y la sostenibilidad del negocio a largo plazo.
• Adoptarás e impulsarás metodologías comerciales rigurosas y un pensamiento analítico para gestionar tanto los aspectos técnicos como comerciales de tu cartera. Who You Are:
• Posees una titulación universitaria con un sólido trasfondo científico , lo que te permite mantener discusiones técnicas de alto nivel.
• Cuentas con experiencia contrastada en ventas en el sector sanitario , preferiblemente con un conocimiento profundo en Microbiología, Anatomía Patológica, Genética o Secuenciación.
• Tienes un conocimiento sólido en las áreas de Enfermedades Infecciosas y Oncología ; se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia adicional en Genética.
• Eres un experto en venta consultiva , con una mentalidad orientada a resultados y una trayectoria de consecución de objetivos comerciales mediante el uso de metodologías estructuradas.
• Demuestras una visión de negocio de 360° , con capacidad para equilibrar los logros a corto plazo con el crecimiento estratégico a largo plazo.
• Muestras una actitud proactiva hacia la gestión del cambio , con alta capacidad de adaptación, autonomía y toma de decisiones responsable en entornos dinámicos.
• Eres un gran comunicador, capaz de actuar como un asesor de confianza ante decisores clínicos y administrativos.
• Se valorará significativamente el conocimiento en contratación pública y poseer una red de contactos establecida con los principales decisor

Roche Sequencing & Life Science ist auf der Suche nach einem Field Applications Scientist-Sequencing, um einem Expertenteam von Field Application Scientists und Field Engineers beizutreten, das sich auf die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenbetreuung konzentriert, darunter vor- und nachverkaufstechnische Unterstützung, Installation und Service. Dieses hochmotivierte Individuum wird für die Zusammenarbeit mit Vertriebs- und Support-Teams verantwortlich sein, um als wissenschaftliche/technische Experte den Vertrieb zu unterstützen und Kunden zu unterstützen. Kundenkontomanagement, interne und externe Schulung, Vorverkaufsunterstützung und Instrumentenumsetzungen. Dieses Individuum wird routinemäßig mit Sales, Marketing und Support zusammenarbeiten, um wichtige Chancen und Business-Initiativen zu fördern und gleichzeitig ein ergebnisorientiertes, kundenzentriertes, leistungsstarkes Team zu unterstützen. Die Gelegenheit:
• Bereitstellung von Expertenwissen über Produkte und Anwendungen für Kunden, mit dem Ziel, beratende wissenschaftliche Unterstützung, z.B. Unterstützung bei der Produktauswahl, experimentelles Design, Workflow-Optimierung, etc.
• Koordination mit dem Vertrieb, um Kunden die wissenschaftliche und Produktunterstützung zu bieten, die erforderlich ist, um den Verkaufsprozess zu beschleunigen, wie Vorverkaufspräsentationen, die Erfolgsquoten der Produktbewertung zu erhöhen und weiterhin technische Unterstützung nach dem Verkauf zu bieten
• Umfangreiche lokale, regionale und nationale Reisen (50-80 % der Zeit) mit Sales Specialists zu arbeiten, Treffen mit Schlüsselkunden zu besuchen, Ausbildung und Unterstützung bei der Bewertung von NGS-Methoden und Präsentation von wissenschaftlichen Seminaren und technischen Präsentationen.
• regelmäßige Berichte über Aktivitäten auf dem Gebiet der Führung.
• Liefern Sie kundenorientierte Seminare, um Vertriebsmöglichkeiten zu unterstützen
• Nehmen Sie an der laufenden Schulung der Support & Applications Teams teil.
• Beantworten Sie technische Anfragen von Kunden, die per Telefon und E-Mail empfangen werden, während Sie sich aktiv mit dem Sales- und internen Support-Team zusammenarbeiten.
• Überwachen Sie technische Trends und liefern Sie Feedback zu Wettbewerbslandschaft, Konzeption von Produkterweiterungen, Produktpositionierung und Anwendungsentwicklung an Applications Manager und Product Manager.
• Besuchen Sie regionale und nationale Messen.
• Dies ist eine feldbasierte Rolle - das Gebiet wird die Staaten von Kentucky, Ohio, West Virginia, Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, Pennsylvania, New Jersey & New York City Region abdecken. Für diese Position wird 50 % bis 75 % Fahrweg erwartet. Der ideale Kandidat für diese Rolle sollte in einer großen Metropolregion wohnen. Wer sind Sie?
• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige Arbeitserfahrung.
• 3 Jahre Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung und Auswertung komplexer Labors,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Roche vous pouvez vous montrer comme vous-même, embrassé pour les qualités uniques que vous apportez. Notre culture encourage l'expression personnelle, le dialogue ouvert et les liens authentiques, où vous êtes apprécié, accepté et respecté pour qui vous êtes, vous permettant de prospérer à la fois personnellement et professionnellement. C'est ainsi que nous visons à prévenir, à arrêter et à guérir les maladies et à veiller à ce que chacun ait accès aux soins de santé aujourd'hui et pour les générations à venir. Rejoignez Roche, où chaque voix compte. La position C'est une période passionnante pour rejoindre le réseau de soutien Roche. Si vous êtes passionné par la résolution de problèmes alors c'est la position pour vous! En tant qu'entreprise de soins de santé axée sur la recherche, Roche découvre, développe et fournit des produits et des services diagnostiques et thérapeutiques innovants qui procurent des avantages importants aux patients et aux professionnels de la santé, depuis la détection précoce et la prévention des maladies jusqu'au diagnostic, au traitement et au suivi du traitement. Roche est une entreprise prospère qui peut offrir des opportunités de carrière passionnantes. Nous encourageons et soutenons votre développement dans les domaines qui vous intéressent et qui vous prépareront au prochain niveau de votre parcours professionnel. Nous savons que les gens sont responsables de notre succès et nous apprécions nos employés. Notre engagement est de créer un environnement de travail où le sentiment de valeur, de respect et d'autonomie est une expérience quotidienne. Roche Sequencing & Life Science est à la recherche d'un spécialiste des applications sur le terrain pour rejoindre une équipe spécialisée de spécialistes des applications sur le terrain et d'ingénieurs de terrain qui s'emploient à fournir un soutien à la clientèle de premier ordre, y compris le soutien technique, l'installation et le service avant et après la vente. Cette personne hautement motivée sera chargée de s'associer avec les équipes de vente et de soutien en tant qu'expert scientifique/technique pour aider à conduire les ventes et fournir un soutien aux clients. gestion de compte client, formation interne et externe, support prévente et mise en œuvre d'instruments. Cette personne s'associera systématiquement avec les ventes, le marketing et le soutien pour stimuler les occasions clés et les initiatives d'affaires, tout en appuyant une équipe axée sur les résultats, axée sur le client et hautement performante. La possibilité :
• Fournir des connaissances spécialisées sur les produits et les applications aux clients, dans le but de fournir un soutien scientifique consultatif, par exemple en aidant à la sélection des produits, à la conception expérimentale, à l'optimisation des flux de travail, etc.
• Coordonner avec Sales pour fournir aux clients le soutien scientifique et produit nécessaire pour accélérer le processus de vente tels que les présentations avant vente, augmenter les taux de succès de l'évaluation des produits et fournir un soutien technique post-vente continu
• Voyages locaux, régionaux et nationaux approfondis (50 à 80 % du temps) pour travailler sur le terrain avec des spécialistes de la vente, assister à des réunions avec des clients clés, dispenser une formation et aider à l'évaluation des méthodes NGS et présenter des séminaires scientifiques et des présentations techniques.
• Faire rapport régulièrement aux dirigeants sur les activités menées sur le terrain.
• Organiser des séminaires destinés aux clients pour soutenir les opportunités de vente
• Participer à la formation continue des équipes Support & Applications.
• Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients reçues par téléphone et par e-mail, tout en s'associant activement avec l'équipe de vente et de soutien interne.
• Surveiller les tendances techniques et fournir un retour d'information sur le paysage concurrentiel, la conceptualisation des extensions de produits, le positionnement des produits et le développement d'applications aux responsables d'applications et de produits.
• Assister à des salons régionaux et nationaux.
• C'est un rôle de terrain - le territoire couvrira les États du Kentucky, de l'Ohio, de la Virginie occidentale, de la Virginie, du Maryland, du Delaware, de la Pennsylvanie, du New Jersey et de la ville de New York. Un voyage de 50 à 75 % est prévu pour ce poste. Le candidat idéal pour ce rôle devrait résider dans une grande région métropolitaine. Qui vous êtes :
• Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe ou une expérience de travail équivalente.
• 3 ans d'expérience dans la mise en oeuvre et l'évaluation de laboratoires complexes,

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Impacto sostenible Nuestra responsabilidad va más allá de innovar. Contribuyes a soluciones que responden a los desafíos más urgentes de la salud mientras reducimos nuestro impacto en el planeta. Juntos construimos un entorno laboral más sano, una sociedad más justa y un futuro mejor para las próximas generaciones. La Oportunidad La posición de Coordinador de Almacén lidera la operación segura y eficiente del área de reacondicionamiento como soporte clave del Line Manager. Responsable de garantizar el cumplimiento del cronograma, los niveles de servicio y los estándares de calidad (BPA, BPM, BPD) mediante la supervisión autónoma del desempeño del equipo. Responsabilidades
• Gestión de Equipos y Recursos: Coordinar y asignar tareas, personal (interno y subcontratado), equipos y tiempos en el área de Reacondicionamiento para garantizar la productividad y la ejecución oportuna de los pedidos.
• Aseguramiento de Calidad y GxP: Verificar el cumplimiento irrestricto de las Buenas Prácticas (GxP/BPA) y los estándares de seguridad en todos los procesos y colaboradores bajo su responsabilidad.
• Gestión de Desviaciones y CAPA: Soportar el Sistema de Gestión de Calidad (SGC) mediante la documentación, investigación y análisis de desviaciones, incidentes o eventos operacionales, proponiendo y ejecutando acciones correctivas y preventivas (CAPA).
• Control Documental y Capacitación: Revisar y actualizar los Procedimientos Operativos Estándar (SOP) y asegurar que todo el personal a su cargo cumpla con los entrenamientos técnicos y normativos requeridos.
• Monitoreo y Mejora Continua: Evaluar la eficiencia y el desempeño de las operaciones para proponer e implementar proactivamente proyectos de mejora continua que optimicen el flujo de trabajo y el uso de recursos. Quién Eres
• Profesional graduado o en etapa final de carrera en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración de Empresas o afines, con dominio de inglés intermedio-avanzado (conversación, lectura y redacción técnica).
• Trayectoria previa en operaciones de manufactura o logística, idealmente en roles de coordinación como Líder de Línea o Supervisor de Producción.
• Dominio requerido de SAP EWM (gestión de almacenes), análisis de datos y manejo de herramientas informáticas (hojas de cálculo); conocimiento en Gestión de Proyectos es deseable.
• Conocimiento sólido y requerido en Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura, Almacenamiento y Distribución de Productos Farmacéuticos (BPM/BPA/BPD), así como en Seguridad y Salud Ocupacional.
• Dominio de metodologías Lean Manufacturing , Six Sigma y herramientas de Análisis de Causa Raíz (RCA). Beneficios de reubicación no disponibles para este puesto de trabajo. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) team operates in an agile framework to continuously improve the manufacturing of highly integrated sensors and cartridges (S&C). Our work spans from supporting early concept ideas to enabling efficient design transfer into routine manufacturing and ensuring sustainable product care throughout the product lifecycle. Organized into Sub-Networks and Squads supported by Chapters, our agile structure enables rapid adaptation to changing priorities and business needs. We foster collaboration, continuous learning, and mutual mentorship while driving partnerships across and beyond Operations. By combining expertise, data-driven insights, digital solutions, and new technologies, we solve complex challenges and deliver high-quality S&C products that meet customer needs throughout their lifecycle — always guided by our core values: Courage, Transparency, Open-Mindedness, and a Can Do Attitude. The Opportunity:
• Taking responsibility for regular product care activities within the Squad. Like handling of non-conformity notifications, leading investigations and root cause analysis, coordinating corrective actions in the manufacturing process, implementing changes to the process.
• Working according to internal processes defined by GxP-regulated environment
• Monitoring production data and analyzing key production performance indicators
• Driving Continuous Improvement initiations within the sensor production process
• Supporting production operators as an SME on the ramp up of newly established production line
• Plan and execute experiments (DoEs) in laboratory and production environment for investigation and product improvements
• Coordination and collaboration with internal and external partners Who you are:
• University Degree in (Electro-, Analytical- or Technical) Chemistry, (Chemical-, Process- or Manufacturing) Engineering or related field
• First experience in a highly regulated production environment and GxP standards (pharma / medical preferred)
• Strong team player with self-reflection, solution-oriented mindset, and collaboration skills
• Strategic thinking with interest in agile framework (Scrum/Kanban) and project management
• Ability to apply a programming language (e.g., python or R-Studio) or AI Agents in a practical setting
• Fluent in English, German at least B2 level
• Nice to have: statistical analysis, database handling (SQL, Snowflake) or experience with software projects Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. • Monitoring production data and analyzing key production performance indicators
• Driving Continuous Improvement initiations within the sensor production process

• Strong team player with self-reflection, solution-oriented mindset, and collaboration skills
• Strategic thinking with interest in agile framework (Scrum/Kanban) and project management
• Ability to apply a programming language (e.g., python or R-Studio) or AI Agents in a practical setting

Questa posizione basata sul campo richiede esperienza di vendita consultiva e competenza nei flussi di lavoro di test POCC e POC, infrastrutture IT, flusso di dati, informatica, operazioni, applicazioni digitali (cioè middleware, strumenti di business intelligence, ecc.), e Sistemi Informativi di laboratorio (LIS) per consultare efficacemente le parti interessate sulle soluzioni digitali Roche personalizzate e fornire raccomandazioni strategiche sui processi digitali. Questa posizione si impegna presto nel ciclo di vendita per comprendere le esigenze dei clienti, fornire demo personalizzati e progettare soluzioni digitali personalizzate in collaborazione con gli stakeholder interfunzionali tra i team di Roche e i clienti. • Impegnarsi nelle discussioni strategiche digitali con influenze chiave di acquisto dei clienti, dagli utenti finali tecnici ai decisori a livello esecutivo.
• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team di vendita e implementazione per definire e allineare le strategie di vendita di soluzioni totali per soddisfare e superare costantemente gli obiettivi di vendita.
• Condurre analisi del processo del flusso di lavoro, sviluppare presentazioni di proposte di soluzione e fornire raccomandazioni ai clienti in stretta allineamento con gli stakeholder interni.
• Fornire demo software e presentazioni tecniche su misura per il pubblico interno ed esterno.
• Adept per tradurre le esigenze dei clienti in azioni interne per soddisfare tali esigenze, mentre bilanciare le priorità e gli obiettivi aziendali chiave.
• Forte acume clinico e finanziario con una capacità dimostrata di comprendere e tradurre le esigenze del cliente per posizionare efficacemente il valore delle soluzioni digitali Roche.
• Efficacemente qualificare i cavi e utilizzare i risultati dell'analisi del flusso di lavoro e gli studi di impatto per fornire differenziazione e valore competitivi alla soluzione globale del cliente.
• Fornisce competenze tecniche approfondite per quanto riguarda le linee di prodotto assegnate.
• Il lavoro intercorre in modo funzionale con gli stakeholder interni per condividere informazioni e migliori pratiche, pur rimanendo attivamente informati sulle tendenze del settore/cliente che influiscono sul business.

• Corso di laurea in un campo relativo (ossia tecnologia dell'informazione, tecnologia medica, scienze della vita) o esperienza equivalente.
• 5+ anni di esperienza rilevante o equivalente (ad es. vendite di soluzioni digitali sanitarie, vendite di diagnostica)
• Deve essere autonomo e organizzato con efficaci capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e problem solving
• Familiarità con soluzioni digitali, soluzioni middleware e sistemi LIS ospedalieri
• Esperienza con la presentazione di informazioni tecniche a grandi pubblico esterno e interno Requisiti preferenziali
• Esperienza preferenziale nello spazio di prova POC.
• 3+ anni di esperienza

That’s what makes us Roche. The Opportunity Come join the Roche Digital Solutions sales organization as a Near Patient Care Digital Sales Specialist, where you will be responsible for selling the Roche navify digital portfolio in the Point of Care testing space. Responsibilities:

• Engage in strategic digital discussions with key customer buying influences, from technical end users to executive level decision makers.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across sales and implementation teams to define and align on total solution sales strategies to consistently meet and exceed sales targets.
• Conduct workflow process analysis, develop solution proposal presentations, and deliver recommendations to customers in close alignment with internal stakeholders.
• Deliver software demos and tailored technical presentations to internal and external audiences.
• Adept at translating customer needs into internal action to meet those needs while balancing key business priorities and goals.
• Strong clinical and financial acumen with a demonstrated ability to understand and translate customer needs to effectively position the value of Roche digital solutions.
• Effectively qualify leads and utilize outcomes from workflow analysis and impact studies to provide competitive differentiation and value to the overall customer solution.
• Provides in-depth technical expertise regarding assigned product lines.
• Work cross functionally with internal stakeholders to share information and best practices while remaining actively informed on industry/customer trends that impact business.
• Follow a standardized end-to-end approach that creates evidence-based, differentiated value for the solution portfolio, both inside and outside the areas responsible for testing. Who You Are
• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field (i.e. Information Technology, Medical Technology, Life Sciences) or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years relevant or equivalent experience (i.e. healthcare digital solutions sales, diagnostics sales)
• Must be autonomous and organized with effective communication, negotiation, and problem solving skills
• Familiarity with digital solutions, middleware solutions and hospital LIS systems
• Experience with presenting technical information to large external and internal audiences Preferred Qualifications:
• Preferred experience in the POC testing space.
• 3+ years of experien

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. Our Clinical Safety organisation is dedicated to delivering meaningful improvements to patients through medically-differentiated therapies. In this role, you will provide essential safety science and pharmacovigilance support to molecules across the Roche portfolio, ensuring the highest standards of participant safety and data reliability The Opportunity: As an Associate Safety Director, you will be a key member of the safety team providing safety oversight across the development and marketed portfolio. You will deliver safety science and pharmacovigilance support, from early and late phase development through post-marketed signal and risk management. Working under the matrix leadership of the Safety Strategy Leader (SSL), you will ensure our medicines reach patients safely and efficiently.
• Develop and maintain an understanding of the safety profile for assigned products, providing clinical input into the interpretation of emerging safety data.
• Contribute to aggregate case analysis and reporting activities including preparation of periodic safety reports (ie. DSUR, PBRER)
• Drive signal management activities, including signal detection and assessment, and contribute to risk management activities (e.g.RMPs/REM) and provide advice and interpretation of whether/how risks may impact the overall clinical risk-benefit balance of an asset.
• Support the preparation and review of safety sections for regulatory filings (IND, NDA, MAA) and labeling documents like the Company Core Data Sheet, or Investigator’s Brochure
• Represent Clinical Safety on development study teams and prepare and/or review safety sections of study documents (e.g. protocol, Informed consent, etc)
• Contribute to and/or and provide input into internal or external Drug Monitoring Committees.
• In partnership with the SSL, support presentation of safety issues to the internal Safety governance committee.
• Coordinate with vendors and may act as a functional business process owner or subject matter expert to improve our safety science practices.
• Partner with functions including Clinical Science, Regulatory, Data Science and Clinical Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of business initiatives.
• Mentor & Lead: Act as a subject matter expert within the function, coaching junior scientists. Who You Are: You are a proactive and independent safety professional who thrives in a collaborative, matrix environment. You bring a growth mindset and are willing to challenge the status quo to bring agile, innovative approaches to our safety science practices. You will also have:
• 5+ years of experience and hold a degree in Life Sciences or are a qualified healthcare professional (PhD, MSc, or PharmD preferred).
• Extensive experience in drug development, with a significant track record specifically within drug safety or pharmacovigilance.
• Possess a deep understanding of GCP, GVP, and the end-to-end clinical trial lifecycle.
• Skilled at applying complex data analysis to interpret and present scientific data with clarity and impact.
• Excel at influencing stakeholders and building partnerships across global, remote teams.
• Proven ability to manage high-priority projects and act as a subject matter expert in safety science activities. Relocation Benefits are not available for this job posting. #MQRS The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Mississauga is 1

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position As a Policy and Value Partner (PVP) , you will be a key driver in delivering life-changing healthcare to patients by strategically influencing stakeholder perceptions and decision-making. You will engage with both internal and external stakeholders to shape the broader policy ecosystem and demonstrate the immense value of our innovative medicines. By providing sound strategic advice and developing evidence-based materials, you will help Roche Australia navigate the socio-political environment to achieve its long-term goals. What you will be working on includes: In this dynamic role, you will be responsible for a variety of strategic and advocacy activities, including:
• Policy Strategy: Developing and implementing public policy projects designed to shape the socio-political environment in favor of patient access.
• Evidence Development: Conducting research and analysis to create evidence-based policy materials, strategies, and advocacy plans relating to Roche’s pipeline and reimbursement systems.
• Environmental Scanning: Monitoring government communications and actions to identify potential opportunities and threats within the socio-political landscape.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Designing and executing overarching engagement plans for political and health stakeholders to support corporate and portfolio goals.
• Global Collaboration: Engaging with Roche’s global public policy and market access teams to leverage globally-generated positioning and resources.
• Strategic Advice: Providing and acting upon sound strategic counsel to the Enabling Team and other internal cross-functional groups.
• Reputation Management: Developing a strategic plan to build Roche Australia’s reputation as a creative and forward-thinking policy partner.
• Communication Design: Crafting clear, tailored, and timely communications and narratives for both internal and external audiences.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborating with Therapeutic Area Squads and the Value and Access Chapter to ensure policy positions are shared and aligned across the organization.
• External Advocacy: Leading engagement with key external political stakeholders, including MPs, Senators, and health advocacy organizations. Who you are: You are a strategic communicator with high interpersonal intelligence and a deep understanding of the Australian political landscape. You bring:
• Educational Background: A tertiary qualification in communications, public relations, health policy, or business/commerce.
• Industry Expertise: Proven experience in public policy or government engagement within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, or a relevant government department.
• Political Acumen: A strong awareness of the policy process and the ability to navigate complex political environments with composure and resilience.
• Analytical Thinking: The ability to synthesize complex information into clear policy positions and meaningful environmental insights.
• Relationship Building: A track record of building strong, credible, and supportive relationships with external stakeholders, such as political advisors and industry bodies.
• Collaborative Spirit: A high level of interpersonal intelligence and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and global networks.
• Compliance Focus: Completion of (or the ability to complete) the Medicines Australia Code of Conduct training. This role is only open to candidates that have full eligibility to live and work in Australia. May require

• Evidence Development: Conducting research and analysis to create evidence-based policy materials, strategies, and advocacy plans relating to Roche’s pipeline and reimbursement systems.
• Environmental Scanning: Monitoring government communications and actions to identify potential opportunities and threats within the socio-political landscape.
• Stakeholder Engagement: Designing and executing overarching engagement plans for political and health stakeholders to support corporate and portfolio goals.
• Global Collaboration: Engaging with Roche’s global public policy and market access teams to leverage globally-generated positioning and resources.
• Strategic Advice: Providing and acting upon sound strategic counsel to the Enabling Team and other internal cross-functional groups.
• Reputation Management: Developing a strategic plan to build Roche Australia’s reputation as a creative and forward-thinking policy partner.
• Communication Design: Crafting clear, tailored, and timely communications and narratives for both internal and external audiences.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborating with Therapeutic Area Squads and the Value and Access Chapter to ensure policy positions are shared and aligned across the organization.
• External Advocacy: Leading engagement with key external political stakeholders, including MPs, Senators, and health advocacy organizations. Who you are: You are a strategic communicator with high interpersonal intelligence and a deep understanding of the Australian political landscape. You bring:
• Educational Background: A tertiary qualification in communications, public relations, health policy, or business/commerce.
• Industry Expertise: Proven experience in public policy or government engagement within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, or a relevant government department.
• Political Acumen: A strong awareness of the policy process and the ability to navigate complex political environments with composure and resilience.
• Analytical Thinking: The ability to synthesize complex information into clear policy positions and meaningful environmental insights.
• Relationship Building: A track record of building strong, credible, and supportive relationships with external stakeholders, such as political advisors and industry bodies.
• Collaborative Spirit: A high level of interpersonal intelligence and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and global networks.

Build and sustain effective relationships with affiliates and within the team to implement and sustain best practices.
