At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Account Executive - Tissue Diagnostics The Opportunity: This role supports our Tissue Diagnostics franchise and will be responsible for meeting and exceeding sales objectives in targeted accounts across specified territories. Typically responsible for medium to large accounts or have a medium to large quota/territory. Must develop customer prospects and create and maintain relationships with decision makers. Contacts/visits existing and potential customers. Works to build and maintain network of colleagues, partners, and customers to share information and obtain prospects. Additionally, position requires value quantification presentations to potential customers. Must demonstrate in-depth knowledge of product line and have a more in-depth knowledge of other products or services. A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization. Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented position. Has a complete knowledge of company products and services. Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. Responsible for selling the company's products or services, developing new accounts and/or expanding existing accounts. Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments. This is a field based role: the territory includes North and Central Illinois (Chicago down to Springfield) and the state of Iowa. Relocation benefits are not provided for this role. You must live within 50 miles of the territory border. We prefer the candidate to reside in the greater Chicago area. Key Roles & Responsibilities:
• Contacts new and existing customers to meet and exceed sales objectives in targeted accounts, by developing new business, growing existing business, maintaining customer relationships and troubleshooting customer problems. This includes identifying and developing strategic account plans, developing and delivering the differentiating message and quantifiable economic value for products and services, selling the primary differentiation of Roche products, overcoming and managing objections, and negotiating to obtain sales.
• Generates demand and maximizes product awareness by working with and providing education and information to customers.
• Implements strategic initiatives and plans to facilitate sales process and productivity.
• Works with others, as needed or required, to prepare proposals for assigned accounts. Presents all contract proposals to customers to maximize overall business and profitability, which may require some negotiation.
• Conducts and organizes necessary territory planning and routing for efficiency. Conducts business analysis and planning.
• Communicates competitive market information internally.
• Networks and interfaces with internal colleagues to share information and best practices while remaining actively involved in industry/customer organizations that impact business.
• Responsible for maintaining and continuously improving the quality system and achieving quality objectives through daily actions. Who you are:
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
• You hold 3 years relevant sales or equivalent experience
• Participation in an approved accelerated development, fellows

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Business Operations Lead

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.

That’s what makes us Roche .

As a Business Operations Lead , you serve as a strategic and tactical partner to the Functional Leadership team, driving strategy and goals in alignment with Site and Network objectives. You are a multi-discipline professional representing the Site Business Support group, working collaboratively to drive excellence in project portfolio management, change leadership, and operational excellence. You play a key role in deploying site-wide business processes and leading strategic projects, such as product technical transfers and business programs. You push boundaries to enable a continuous improvement mindset and implement lean practices that result in quick and efficient innovation.

Your Opportunity

• Functional Partnership & Excellence: You drive business results by facilitating functional goal development using lean strategy tools. You manage the functional project portfolio process, leading prioritization to ensure alignment with resource management and business timelines.

• Operational Excellence (OE) Deployment: You act as a strong advocacy and change agent for Lean/OE to build a strong continuous improvement culture. You lead process improvement activities to realize productivity outcomes and coach improvement projects to achieve functional goals.

• Organizational Change Management (OCM): You develop and implement effective change management programs to drive execution excellence. You lead site-wide initiatives to build OCM business processes and change leadership capabilities at both leadership and individual levels.

• Program & Project Management: You provide leadership for site-wide initiatives, including CAPEX and Product Technical Transfers. You ensure due diligence is performed to mitigate risks to safety, quality, compliance, and delivery.

• Coaching & Capability Building: You act as a coach for colleagues, helping them develop skills in project management and change leadership methodologies. You serve as a subject matter expert on continuous improvement methods and tools.

• Communication & Safety: You manage functional communications in line with the site plan, ensuring impactful content and timing. You ensure a safe working environment by complying with all Safety, Health & Environmental (SHE) requirements and site security measures.

Who You Are

• Education: You hold a degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, Life Sciences, or an equivalent discipline.

• Experienced Professional: You have a minimum of 8 years of related working experience, preferably within a biotech or pharmaceutical operating environment.

• Project Expert: You possess a proven track record of at least 5 years managing small to medium-scale projects of varying complexity. PMP certification is preferred.

• Technical Specialist : You have essential competencies in Project Portfolio and Program Management, and you are a certified Black Belt in continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma.

• Change Leader: You have experience leading change initiatives on local, regional, or global levels and are familiar with industry change management standards such as PROSCI .

• Strategic Influencer: You possess excellent verbal and written

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. As a Territory Manager based in Bangalore , you will play a crucial role in driving sales, Doctor Promotion, retail promotion, managing distribution networks, and executing sales promotion plans for your territory. You will ensure our products penetration in the assigned market effectively by supporting distributors, gathering market insights, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM) to achieve our business goals. The Opportunity
• Promote pharmaceutical products to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) through scientific communication, relationship building, product detailing, and ethical marketing to increase product awareness and prescriptions.
• You assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials.
• You prepare and execute monthly sales promotion plans—including field activation and merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy.
• You ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the market.
• You manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones.
• You motivate distributors and dealers through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes.
• You organize distributor and dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies, and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups.
• You act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your customer visits. Who You Are
• You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field.
• You have proven practical experience in field sales, distribution management, or a territory management role.
• You have a strong interest in driving market growth, with a focus on relationship building, demand generation, and executing marketing strategies.
• You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Doctors, Chemist & dealer interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings.
• You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/Weekly/Monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections.
• You are comfortable with field travel within the Bangalore territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager. Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Opportunity Are you a visionary leader passionate about shaping the future of Patient Safety? In this pivotal role, you will lead and manage the PV Regional Center, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacovigilance (PV) and Device Vigilance activities across the Europe, Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA) region. You will be at the forefront of driving operational excellence, upholding regulatory compliance, and integrating regional clinical safety activities in a complex, global environment. Working in partnership with Affiliate Patient Safety and Global Leadership, you will contribute to the broader Patient Safety Operations (PSO) strategy. Your leadership will ensure that our safety processes are not only compliant but also innovative, leveraging data-driven insights and digital transformation to protect patients worldwide.
• Lead and inspire a multi-site regional team , acting as a catalyst for a quality- and customer-centric culture.
• Oversee the operationalization of safety processes to ensure full compliance with global Roche standards and local regulations.
• Drive continuous improvement and innovation by embedding technological advances like AI and digital analytics into safety operations.
• Ensure inspection and audit readiness for all regional activities, maintaining a robust business continuity plan.
• Collaborate with cross-functional partners to integrate regionalized clinical safety activities and achieve shared global objectives.
• Foster a culture of growth and empowerment , adopting the VACC (Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, Coach) leadership style to develop future talent.
• Represent the PV function with external parties, including regulators, ensuring Roche’s reputation for excellence remains unmatched. Who You Are You are a strategic thinker and a servant leader who thrives in a fast-paced, matrixed environment. You possess a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical landscape and are motivated by the opportunity to lead large-scale operational changes that have a real impact on patient lives.
• You hold a Health Care Professional Degree (Medical, Pharmacy, or equivalent professional experience).
• You bring 10+ years of pharmaceutical experience , with at least 5 years in significant PV leadership roles.
• You have a proven track record in managing multi-country or regional operations within a large, complex organization.
• You are a VACC leader , committed to inclusive behaviors and developing high-performing, diverse teams.
• You possess deep technical expertise in GVP, ICH-GCP, and global regulatory requirements (FDA/EMA).
• You are an exceptional communicator , able to influence stakeholders and convey complex information clearly in English.
• You have a growth mindset , eager to experiment with new technologies and take smart risks to improve operational efficiency. Location: This position is based in Budapest. Relocation Assistance is not available Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s

The opportunity As a Country Chief Accountant you will be accountable for the financial statements prepared for the affiliate and will coordinate with RSS (Roche Services & Solutions) Budapest Finance teams (Demand to Pay, Record to Report, Travel and Expense, Compliance) and execute month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely and accurate closure of accounts in compliance with the month-end close checklist. R2R
• Overseeing financial accuracy and internal controls, including ICFR documentation and tools management.
• Conducting balance sheet reconciliation, anomaly rectification, and ensuring timely and quality financial statement reporting / month-end closing, yearly reporting
• Managing accounting aspects such as IFRS 16 Leasing, manual journal entries, and management accounting activities.
• Supervising Accounts Receivables, including billings approval, debtors aging, and sales reporting accuracy.
• Handling cash flow management and treasury matters, including fund forecasting, transfers, and banking transactions. DtP
• Handling all accounts payable related matters Master Data
• Managing master data - Chart of Accounts, Cost Center, Profit Center. WBS, vendor & customer master data, UCI, etc. Other
• Overseeing statutory tax calculations, reconciliation, reporting, and Tax Consultant liaison, alongside managing external financial audits
• Managing financial compliance, internal controls on financial reporting
• Serving as central contact for RSS Budapest Finance teams and Finance Managers in the affiliates, addressing financial issues, requests, and advisory needs Who you are:
• University education; preferably in Finance/Accounting related discipline, ACCA or other accounting professional qualifications will be an added advantage
• 8 years of experience in a related field and at least 5 years in accountant / audit role and people management experience
• Knowledge of accounting principles and practices; financial reporting, audit, and taxation, including local accounting principles as advantage
• Proficiency in accounting software, preferably SAP and MS Office

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche. Are you ready to take your career to the next level with a dynamic and global role? As a Global Product Planner, you will be at the forefront of supply chain management, driving operational excellence and ensuring product availability across our hubs and nodes.. You will develop and manage supply plans utilizing both affiliate and statistical forecasts to create accurate and efficient supply chains. By proactively addressing supply and demand planning issues, you will maintain seamless operations and ensure the accuracy and continuous optimization of MRP master data. Leading bottleneck management, allocation, reserve management, and scrap mitigation across the network will be vital components of your role. In this position, you will be the primary point of contact for product supply-related communications with suppliers, regions, business areas, and affiliates. You will guarantee the timely supply of finished goods to regional and local warehouses, aligning with service level agreements (SLAs), and strive to meet customer service objectives at the lowest possible total costs, including distribution, inventory, and write-offs. We are looking for someone with specialized and comprehensive knowledge in supply chain management or a related business area. Your analytical and problem-solving skills will be engaged in varied and complex duties involving research, analysis, and solution development. You will provide expert guidance to department leadership in setting strategic direction and utilize originality and ingenuity in your daily responsibilities and decision-making processes. Applying a wide range of principles, practices, and procedures to navigate more complex and challenging assignments will be crucial. Additionally, your commitment to maintaining and continuously improving the planning objectives and goals through daily actions will be key. This is your opportunity to make a significant impact in a highly professional and strategic role. Join us and contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional service and operational efficiency. Apply now to be part of a global team committed to excellence! The Opportunity
• End-to-End Inventory Management: Accountable to ensure global product availability across all regional and central warehouse locations for a defined portfolio, including the strategic setting and continuous monitoring of global safety levels.
• Supply Planning & Optimization: Responsible for the creation and accuracy of global supply plans by aligning demand inputs with manufacturing and supplier capabilities; provides robust recommendations regarding Master Production Schedules (MPS) and Rough Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP).
• Lifecycle & Launch Coordination: Accountable to liaise with functional leads and lifecycle teams to manage complex product transitions, ensuring seamless availability during critical launch and phase-out periods.
• Operational Execution & Data Integrity: Responsible for the ongoing optimization and accuracy of MRP master data and executes logistics interventions, including batch reservations, to guarantee uninterrupted product flow during emergencies.
• Crisis Management & S&OP Leadership : Serves as the primary lead for initiating escalation

• Analytik von chemischen, biochemischen und biologischen Einsatzstoffen im diagnostischen Umfeld Dein Profil
• Du bist aktuell in einem naturwissenschaftlichen Studium (Bachelor oder Master in Chemie / Biochemie / Molekularbiologie / Lebensmittelchemie / Life Science oder vergleichbar) immatrikuliert oder Du befindest Dich in Deinem Gap-Year
• Du bringst Kenntnisse in der chemischen und/oder biochemischen Analytik mit
• Du bist motiviert, neugierig und möchtest Deine Ideen einbringen
• solide Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich Deine Vorteile
• Flexible Zeiteinteilung
• 2268 € Vergütung im Monat für ein Vollzeitpraktikum > 3 Monate
• Vernetzung mit anderen Studierenden (online/offline)
• Ermäßigte Preise (-50 %) in unserer Kantine

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Roche Diagnostics Solutions (RDS) is the market leader in the In-Vitro Diagnostics business. Within that ecosystem, Research & Early Development is the home for early research activities and plays an integral role in rapidly delivering innovation in discovery and specific customer area needs. For the business to remain competitive in the future, a dedicated management of innovation is of central importance.

To be successful as an Innovation Manager in our organization, a unique capability to thrive in ambiguity is needed, managing research process design to accelerate discovery while ensuring alignment with long-term business strategy. Beyond technical oversight, the role is defined by strategic diplomacy. An Innovation Manager must excel as a research ambassador, translating complex scientific impact into value propositions for diverse stakeholders.

The Opportunity:
• ● Influencing Without Authority: Using organizational and interpersonal awareness and finesse to drive delivery across levels.
• ● Systems Thinking: Navigating the interface between science, medical, and business sectors to manage dependencies at scale.
• ● Resilient Execution: Combining project management rigor with change management and persistence to ensure critical work reaches completion despite structural obstacles.
• ● Supports enterprise research in creating, funneling and harvesting cutting-edge innovation ideas, acts as a neutral thought partner to practice the idea acceptability
• ● Hosts innovation challenges addressing shared problem statements of global RDS Research
● Sparks and cultivates a cross-divisional innovation mindset, acts as change agent to coach the organization on the global research strategy and vision and advocate for the customer and the business role in innovation
• ● Uses independent evaluation, selection, and substantial adaptation and modification of standard project management and communication techniques, procedures and
• criteria to navigate the complex flexible dynamic nature of research and early
• development projects
• ● Actively builds and cultivates connections into the scientific network and maintains
• expert knowledge of industry trends, competition, and emerging innovations,
• contributes to strategic innovation roadmapping for early research
● Organizes and facilitates interdisciplinary workshops applying innovative and agile methodologies to achieve workshop outcomes in creative and effective ways, in order to contribute to problem discovery and challenge-driven ideation
• ● Plans, manages and monitors research operations to support the activities,
• processes, communication and digital infrastructure of research and early
• development and its innovation framework
• ● Collaborates cross-functionally with experts within Research & Development (R&D),CDMA (Clinical Development and Medical Affairs), Partnering and beyond
• ● Monitors and optimizes processes in order to increase quality and efficiency
• standards, promotes and participates in the professional development of best
• practices and process principles to manage risks, to achieve objectives in creative and effective ways and to increase quality and efficiency standards
• ● Coaches and trains other members of the team on the subject matter exp

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
Deja tu Huella - Communications & Intern

What do we offer?
To be part of a new cohort of the Roche-CEU San Pablo postgraduate degree as an expert in the Pharmaceutical Industry. 11 months of internships at Roche where you will participate in challenging projects and benefit from pioneering postgraduate training in the market about the pharmaceutical industry.

You will have the opportunity to get on the job training by working on key projects with your designated department from Monday to Thursday and attend in person postgraduate classes at the university on Friday.

Our main location is Madrid , we are open to applications from all over Spain but relocation will be needed as part of the program expectations. Office attendance is expected (with some flexbility) to enjoy the connection to our colleagues, network and get exposure.

Last but not least, you will have mentorship by a Roche tutor who will give you continuous feedback to develop your professional skills. The mentors for the program are Roche's senior and experienced young talent development professionals.

Apply for this offer and follow us at @RocheES to share with your network a unique opportunity in the market to start your professional career in the pharmaceutical sector.

What is the main purpose of this internship?
Ideation, development, and implementation of the positioning plan and corporate narrative of Roche Farma España, both nationally and across ecosystems, as well as planning and development of Corporate Social Responsibility actions in collaboration with Internal Communication.

What are the main responsibilities of the intern?

• Assist in the design and execution of communication plans for specific therapeutic areas (e.g., Neuroscience, Ophthalmology).

• Draft, edit, and adapt high-quality content (press releases, internal news, talking points) related to clinical milestones and product launches.

• Create engaging assets for social media and digital platforms, ensuring that scientific data is communicated clearly and creatively.

• Support the management of press conferences, scientific forums, and patient advocacy initiatives.

• Analyze the impact of our therapeutic area communications and stay ahead of healthcare trends in the Spanish market.

What are we looking for in this position?

• Graduate or currently finishing a degree in one of the branches of Information Sciences (communications, journalism, etc).

• Training and/or experience in health communication is desirable

• High capacity for communication and public relations

• Skill and speed in creating and composing texts, ability to obtain and edit videos and images, and deep knowledge of the main social networks.

• We want proactive and curious candidates that are willing to learn and grow by challenging the status quo.

• We are looking for flexible talents that adapt to changes and are willing to collaborate with teams in a network organization.

• Advanced level of communication in English and Spanish.

• Desirable to have international experience as a student or working abroad.

• Passion for improving the lives of patients and motivation to give the best of yourself in an innovative and challenging environment.

• Commitment to dedicate yourself full time to the program from September 2026 to August 2027.

For international students, have a valid NIE or work permit in Spain.

And remember, being part of this program offers you:

• Postgraduate University CEU-Roche: "Deja tu Huella" program with great

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position
For over 60 years, Roche has been guided by a profound vision: a future where cancer can be cured. 22.8 million people have been treated with Roche cancer therapy as of 2025. We have had nearly 30 New Molecular Entities (NMEs) approved in our oncology and haematology portfolio. We are committed to developing innovative medicines and diagnostic solutions that help prevent, stop and cure cancer.

Leading with bold moves, while grounded in science and experience, our focus is on turning scientific breakthroughs into better outcomes for people with cancer, healthcare systems and society. We are aiming to deliver seven new transformative cancer medicines by the end of the decade, for those that need them most. To help us achieve this vision we are looking for a dedicated Breast Cancer Specialist Representative to join our dynamic team. If you have a proven track record working in the pharmaceutical industry and a passion for the area of Breast Cancer then we want you to be a part of our success story.

As a Breast Cancer Patient Journey Partner (PJP) , you will play a pivotal role in promoting our exciting portfolio of Breast Cancer treatments to healthcare professionals. You will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with key Breast Cancer stakeholders, including oncologist and other respective healthcare professionals/practice staff, to create meaningful solutions that improve patient outcomes.

The territory will focus on key Breast Cancer accounts across NSW and the ACT.

What you will be working on:
You will independently manage territory metrics and targets, showing resilience and confidence when challenging Healthcare Professionals (HCPs). You will work with your team to advance customers through the adoption ladder, drive market growth to meet our patient-focused goals, and contribute to the development of pioneering therapies. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive adoption of our Breast Cancer products with healthcare providers across NSW and the ACT.

• Develop and execute territory plans to maximise opportunities to create value for our stakeholders and for Roche to and meet our goals

• Build strong, long-term relationships with oncologist and other healthcare professionals

• Review customer engagement metrics to optimise communication channels ensuring regular engagement with target customers through face to face meetings, virtual calls, dinner presentation meetings, clinic/practice luncheons and participation in industry events

• Provide expert knowledge on the clinical data and benefits of our treatment

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams (marketing, medical etc) to drive business growth and great customer experience

• Monitor and analyse territory performance, market trends and competitor activity to adjust strategies/tactics to improve outcomes

• Gather valuable insights from customers and effectively communicate them to the internal team to help validate and define our strategic initiatives.

• Adhere to company policies and industry regulations, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and ethics.

Who you are:
You are someone who demonstrates a passion for patient outcomes, enterprise-level thinking, and an entrepreneurial mindset with an excellent understanding of the pharmaceutical industry. You have:

• 5+ years or equivalent level of experience as a specialist pharmaceutical representative or in similar capacity

• In-depth knowledge of the healthcare system

The Position
Senior Security Engineer (Seamless Access) - RDT Security Platforms
Location: Pune

Our Secure Access team protects the organization’s global workforce by delivering and operating the technologies that enable secure, reliable, and compliant access to corporate resources. We work at the intersection of network security, identity, and cloud—supporting users and business-critical systems in a regulated industry environment.
